jobs.title: Senior .Net Developer / Regio Arnhem - Wageningen - Veenendaal - NL
jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior .NET Developer | Regio Arnhem - Wageningen - Veenendaal

Bij Sogeti werk je als Senior .NET Developer aan software die ertoe doet. Samen met klanten in de regio bouw je moderne cloud-native applicaties die dagelijks gebruikt worden door medewerkers, klanten en partners. Vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en continue verbetering staan daarbij centraal.

Als strategische Microsoft‑partner met een sterke engineering‑focus investeren we actief in onze Microsoft Community. Je komt terecht in een community waarin kennisdeling, experimenteren en persoonlijke expertiseontwikkeling vanzelfsprekend zijn. Vanuit ons kantoor in Utrecht, externe- en klant-locaties organiseren we maandelijkse Microsoft meet‑ups, deep dives en hands‑on sessies over onder andere .NET, Azure, GitHub, Developer Experience en AI‑gedreven development.

Werken als Senior .NET Developer bij Sogeti

Als Senior .NET Developer werk je binnen DevOps- en productteams aan bedrijfskritische softwareoplossingen. Je ontwikkelt functionaliteit en werkt mee aan architectuur, schaalbaarheid, security en beheerbaarheid. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor de kwaliteit van je werk en signaleert actief verbeterkansen in processen, technologie en samenwerking.

Je werkt voor toonaangevende organisaties in de regio Arnhem, Wageningen en Veenendaal, variërend van telecom en utilities tot overheid, logistiek en zakelijke dienstverlening. Samen met klanten en collega's bouw je oplossingen die langdurig waarde leveren. Daarbij denk je mee over de doorontwikkeling van de oplossing en help je teams om duurzame technische keuzes te maken.

Binnen onze Microsoft Community speel je als senior een zichtbare rol. Je deelt kennis, volgt technologische ontwikkelingen op de voet en ontwikkelt een eigen visie op onderwerpen als AI-assisted development, cloud-native softwareontwikkeling en moderne engineeringpraktijken.

Wie ben jij?

Je hebt een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding en minimaal vijf jaar ervaring als .NET Developer.
Je hebt ruime ervaring met .NET Framework/Core, C#, Azure (App Services, Functions), REST API’s en moderne frontend‑ of integratiepatronen.
Je hebt ervaring met softwarearchitectuur, CI/CD, containertechnologie (Docker en/of Kubernetes), en bij voorkeur moderne AI-ondersteunde ontwikkeltools zoals GitHub Copilot.
Je hebt of wilt één of meerdere relevante Microsoft‑certificeringen behalen, zoals Azure Developer Associate (AZ‑204), DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ‑400) of Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI‑102).
Je bent leergierig, deelt graag kennis en denkt mee over technische strategieën.
Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal op minimaal C1-niveau.
Je woont bij voorkeur in of nabij de regio Arnhem, Wageningen of Veenendaal

Dit bieden wij jou

Een dienstverband van 40 uur per week, met flexibele mogelijkheden om parttime te werken.
Een startsalaris tussen de € 4.500 en € 6.800 bruto per maand per maand (inclusief vakantiegeld en mobiliteitsbudget), afhankelijk van ervaring en aantal werkuren.
Een flexibel mobiliteitsbudget, met o.a. opties om elektrisch te rijden.
Hybride werken en een goede werk-privébalans.
Uitgebreide opleidings- en certificeringsmogelijkheden.
26 vakantiedagen per jaar, met de optie om extra dagen bij te kopen.
Toegang tot onze kenniscommunity, meet-ups, hackathons en tech-events. En natuurlijk: ontspanning via game nights, skitrips en meer.

jobs.title: Softwareentwickler - C# JAVA (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Die knowledgepark GmbH entwickelt und betreibt seit über 30 Jahren komplexe medizinische Informationssysteme. Zum Ausbau des Software-as-a-Service Angebotes und Realisierung des geplanten Wachstums, bearbeitet die Knowledgepark GmbH interessante Projekte, die eine offene Komplettlösung im Bereich medizinischer Informationssysteme zum Ziel haben.
Gemeinsam mit einem motivierten Team im Bereich Softwareentwicklung
wirst du diese spannenden Innovationen unterstützen.
Wir suchen Dich als (ggf. Junior) Software-Entwickler (C# JAVA) (m/w/d)
zur Verstärkung unseres Bereiches

Deine Aufgaben
Mitarbeit an der Implementierung neuer Features sowie an der Optimierung bestehender Funktionen
Entwicklung und Ausführung von Unit- und Integrationstests zur Sicherstellung der Qualität unserer Software
Analyse und Behebung von Softwarefehlern und technischen Problemen.
Zusammenarbeit mit dem Entwicklungsteam zur Umsetzung von Projekten nach agilen Methoden (z.B. Scrum oder Kanban)
Teilnahme an Code Reviews, um die Qualität und Sicherheit unseres Codes zu gewährleisten
Dokumentation von Entwicklungsprozessen und -ergebnissen
Integration neuer Technologien in Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Entwicklern in einem dynamischen Umfeld

Dein Profil
Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung
Grundkenntnisse in C#/Java-Entwicklung (idealerweise erste praktische Erfahrung)
Erfahrung mit Microservices-Architekturen
Nachweisliche Kenntnisse in Frontend-Technologien wie Angular
Grundlegende Erfahrung mit .NET-Technologien
Sichere Kenntnisse im Sachgebiet SQL-Datenbanken
Interesse an agilen Entwicklungsmethoden, insbesondere Scrum
Interesse an medizinischen Prozessen und Terminologien
Bereitschaft zur kontinuierlichen Weiterbildung und Entwicklung
Fließend Deutsch

Wir bieten
Hybrides Arbeiten bis 100% remote
Freie Arbeitszeiteinteilung
Weihnachten und Sylvester als zusätzliche Urlaubstage (30+2)
Egym Wellpass
individuelle Arbeitszeitmodelle
Hardware wird zur Verfügung gestellt
flache Hierarchien

Bereichsbeschreibung:

Im Bereich Softwareentwicklung der knowledgepark GmbH konzentrieren wir uns als führender Software-as-a-Service (SaaS)-Dienstleister im medizinischen Bereich auf die Entwicklung fortschrittlicher Lösungen von der medizinischen Dokumentation bis zur Abrechnung. Unsere Entwicklungslandschaft, die von einem monolithischen Legacy-System auf eine moderne Microservices-Architektur umgestellt wird, setzt auf die bewährte .NET- Welt für das Backend, SQL-Datenbanken zur zuverlässigen Datenspeicherung und Angular als Frontend-Technologie. Um die Anforderungen des Arbeitsmarktes zu erfüllen, integrieren wir aktiv die Java-Entwicklungssprache in unserem Stack.
Unsere Entwicklungsteams sind nach dem agilen Scrum-Framework organisiert. Dieser Ansatz fördert die Zusammenarbeit, ermöglicht einen flexiblen und iterativen Entwicklungsprozess und die kontinuierliche Implementierung innovativer Funktionen. Unsere engagierten Teams aus erfahrenen .NET- und Java-Entwicklern streben danach, die digitale Transformation im Gesundheitswesen voranzutreiben und erstklassige Softwarelösungen bereitzustellen, die höchsten Standards der Medizintechnik genügen.

jobs.title: Freelance Game Developer – Unity Multiplayer
jobs.description:
Join a dynamic indie team to architect and optimize multiplayer systems for a large-scale roleplaying game built in Unity. This contract role focuses on developing robust networking solutions to support 100–150 concurrent players in a persistent, shared world. You will play a key part in shaping the technical foundation of a new multiplayer experience, collaborating remotely with a small, dedicated team. The ideal candidate is passionate about scalable game architecture and eager to leverage AI tools to enhance development efficiency.

Responsibilities

Design, implement, and maintain multiplayer networking systems in Unity for high player concurrency
Optimize network performance and scalability for persistent world environments
Collaborate with other developers to integrate networking with gameplay features
Troubleshoot, profile, and resolve network-related issues and bottlenecks
Apply best practices in software engineering and game architecture
Utilize AI-driven tools to accelerate development, testing, and code review processes
Communicate progress and technical challenges effectively within a remote team

Skills And Requirements

Proven experience with Unity 3D and C# in a professional game development context
Strong background in multiplayer networking, including authoritative server models and client synchronization
Demonstrated ability to optimize performance for large-scale multiplayer environments
Solid understanding of game engine architecture and software engineering principles
Experience with profiling, debugging, and resolving network and performance issues
Familiarity with AI-assisted development workflows is a plus
Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable working in a fully remote, flexible contract setting
Open to both short-term and long-term collaboration

Kotlin Developer

contract to run until 25/04/2027

up to £450.80 p/d Umbrella inside IR35

About The Project

The Developer Experience (DevX) Standards and Controls function is building a platform for control owners and development teams to manage/view their compliance with a range of software development controls.

The candidate would be working on Kotlin and Java-based web applications and APIs. There are 2-3 applications and PoCs we are hiring for. Exact candidate allocation will depend on their experience and fit. All have a microservice architecture built using modern coding techniques.

Role Purpose / Summary

Experience in Kotlin (or significant Java experience with a willingness to learn Kotlin)
Experienced in API development, SQL/databases, HTML/Javascript
Excellent writing skills and attention to detail in code
Proactive person who will not wait to be told what to do next or be unblocked by others
Experience working with standard developer collaboration Tools: Github/Bitbucket, Jira, Confluence, etc

Your Responsibilities

Collaborate with developers, testers and the wider organisation to build and run products
Design, develop & implement back-end features as per backlog/priority with a small element of frontend development.
All apps use a simple UI framework so not strictly 'front-end' development.
Collaborate with the rest of the engineering team to design and launch new features.
Proactively work with customers to resolve their issues and respond to feature requests.
Build APIs and microservices
Work in an agile CI/CD environment to deliver rapid iterations at a sustained velocity
Be an active member of a team, participating in peer reviews and in testing others code through automated test scripting

Skills & Experience We Require

Experience in Kotlin (or Java with willingness to learn Kotlin)
Experienced in at least two or three of the following: API development, SQL/databases, HTML/Javascript
Lots of experience of working with microservices
Strong technical and analytical troubleshooting skills
Experience in working with Agile including the use of Jira/ Confluence.
Good interpersonal skills
Strong English skills, written and spoken

Optional/Nice To Have

Good working knowledge of cloud technologies like AWS, Azure and GCP

What We Offer

Contact with top IT technologies available in the market
Internal training events and workshops
In-house seminars with leading industry experts

All profiles will be reviewed against the required skills and experience. Due to the high number of applications we will only be able to respond to successful applicants in the first instance. We thank you for your interest and the time taken to apply!

jobs.title: SAP business architect (Order to cash)Swedish nationals
jobs.description:
SAP Business Architect, Order to Cash

Experience:
10 to 15 years overall IT, with 5 or more years hands-on in SAP order to cash.

Location:
On-site at Sodertalje, Sweden.

Role Summary

We are looking for a hands-on SAP Business Architect to own the order to cash process within a multi-year SAP transformation programme. This is not a purely solution architect role but the person will have a strong SAP solution architect or technical background and must operate from a broader business perspective, owning the process end to end and driving change management across business units.
This is a hands-on delivery role rather than a supervisory one. The successful candidate personally designs, documents, and drives the process rather than delegating the work to others.

Key Responsibilities

Own the end to end order to cash business process design for the commercial business.
Set up commercial order flows in SAP and configure the process to match agreed business rules.
Work closely with finance on the financial model being implemented, keeping the commercial flow and the financial design aligned.
Maintain the link to plan to fulfill so that available to promise behaves correctly across the order flow.
Secure a consistent order to cash flow across a two ERP landscape, including the link to Microsoft Dynamics 365 used for wholesale and retail.
Document and maintain the process model in ARIS using BPMN 2.0, and keep it current as the design evolves.
Act as the business counterpart to the IT-side solution architect, translating business intent into implementable process design.
Facilitate design workshops, resolve design conflicts, and take decisions at process level across several business units and alongside the global implementation partner.
Drive change management and business adoption of the new process.
Personally execute the analysis, design, and documentation work, and transfer knowledge to the permanent organisation.

Required Skills and Experience

10 to 15 years in IT, with 5 or more years hands-on in SAP order to cash.
Deep SAP background with demonstrable ability to set up commercial order flows, covering sales order management, pricing, delivery, billing, and credit management.
Genuine techno-functional depth, with the ability to work at configuration and integration level rather than at presentation level only.
Strong working interface with finance, covering revenue recognition, financial postings, and the integration between the commercial flow and the finance model.
Practical understanding of the link from order to cash into plan to fulfill and manufacturing planning, specifically for available to promise.
Experience of operating in a multi ERP landscape and keeping a single business process consistent across two systems.
Structured business process documentation and modelling in ARIS using BPMN 2.0, with the discipline to keep the model current through a live programme.
Strong technical background in SAP.
Proven change management capability in a multi stakeholder environment.
Track record of individual delivery in a programme environment: an executor rather than a programme manager.

Nice to Have

Automotive and commercial vehicle manufacturing domain experience, covering trucks, buses, and industrial power solutions.
Familiarity with automotive make to order logic based on product individuals rather than articles.
Exposure to Microsoft Dynamics 365 in wholesale and retail order flows.
Experience on large SAP S/4HANA transformation programmes delivered with a global implementation partner in a multi vendor setup.
Working knowledge of Swedish.

Soft Skills

Strong client-facing communication in written and spoken English.
Consulting mindset with disciplined problem-solving.
Able to operate independently and hands-on within a collaborative, multi-stakeholder setup.
Strong documentation, facilitation, and stakeholder alignment skills.
Change management orientation, comfortable driving adoption rather than only designing.

to lead the end-to-end architecture and technical delivery of a Workflow Management Platform built on OutSystems Developer Cloud (ODC)

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Junior Solution Architect
jobs.description:
De tijd van architectuur in isolement ligt achter ons. Architectuur draait vooral om het verbinden van mensen, ideeën en concepten. Het gezamenlijk ontwikkelen en vertalen van ideeën naar een samenhangende architectuurlijn vraagt meer dan kennis van TOGAF, DM\-BOK of ArchiMate; het vereist sterke samenwerking\- en communicatieve vaardigheden. Omdat architecten voortdurend opereren in een veranderende omgeving, zijn ook sociale lenigheid, weerbaarheid en het vermogen om met veranderweerstand om te gaan essentieel. Ben je een beginnend solutionarchitect of heb je de ambitie om solutionarchitect te worden? En wil je bijdragen aan een domein dat essentieel is voor het functioneren van de gehele Belastingdienst: de keten Gegevens? Dan komen we graag met je in gesprek. Lees verder en ontdek hoe jij met jouw talent het verschil kunt maken.


* Bachelor\-hbo
* 32\-36 uur
* ICT
* € 4\.818,\- / € 7\.094,\- bruto p.m.
* Apeldoorn
  
* 


* Reageer t/m 14 oktober 2026
**Dit doe je bij de Belastingdienst**
-------------------------------------


Als junior solution architect speel jij een sleutelrol in het realiseren van een toekomstbestendig en betrouwbaar gegevensdomein. Door complexe vraagstukken te vertalen naar samenhangende oplossingen draag je direct bij aan de wettelijke en maatschappelijke taak van de Belastingdienst.
  

Je werkt actief samen met DevOps\-teams, businesspartners en andere stakeholders aan de ontwikkeling van het gegevenslandschap en de realisatie van architecturen die bijdragen aan de doelen van de keten. Daarbij kijk je over de volle breedte van architectuur: van business en informatie tot applicatie\- en technologiearchitectuur. Je zorgt voor samenhang, bewaakt de architectuurprincipes en helpt teams om gedragen keuzes te maken die waarde toevoegen voor de organisatie.
  

Je bent een verbindende kracht die samenwerking stimuleert en teams helpt verder te groeien. Met jouw sociale lenigheid en overtuigingskracht breng je verschillende belangen samen en creëer je draagvlak voor oplossingen. Je deelt kennis, ondersteunt teams in hun DevOps\-volwassenheid en draagt bij aan de continue verbetering van het voortbrengingsproces en de architectuurfunctie. Daarbij houd je oog voor kwaliteit én voor het eigenaarschap van de teams, zodat duurzame resultaten worden gerealiseerd.


**Een bijzondere baan, omdat...**
---------------------------------


* je gaat werken aan de vernieuwing van IT en processen in een domein met grote impact;
* je samen met je collega\-architecten richting kan geven aan de ontwikkeling van het gegevenslandschap en het begeleiden van teams bij de realisatie van toekomstbestendige oplossingen;
* je een verbindende rol gaat vervullen tussen de meer globale architecturen en realisatie;
* je Intensief samen gaat werken met diverse stakeholders uit zowel business en IT.
* **De afdeling \- Directie Informatievoorziening**
-------------------------------------------------


Toon inhoud van De afdeling \- Directie Informatievoorziening


De directie Informatievoorziening is hét ICT\-bedrijf van de Belastingdienst. Met ruim 3\.000 collega’s zorgen we dat Nederland kan rekenen op betrouwbare informatievoorzieningen en ICT\-systemen. Heel Nederland? Ja, onze ‘klanten’ zijn niet alleen Belastingdienstmedewerkers, maar ook 8\.600 grote ondernemers, 2,2 miljoen mkb\-ondernemers en 8,5 miljoen burgers. En wist je dat wij werken volgens een agile\-mindset? Open, transparant en gericht op leren en kennis delen. Door de toepassing van een DevOps\-werkwijze en ons aanbod van geautomatiseerde technieken kunnen de systemen van de Belastingdienst dagelijks miljoenen data en euro’s verwerken.


Bij ons werk je in een moderne tech\-organisatie met ménsen als kloppend hart. Of je nu als engineer of in een andere rol bijdraagt aan effectieve ICT; jouw inzet doet ertoe. Net als jouw ontwikkeling, waarin wij graag investeren. En jouw ideeën, waar we graag naar luisteren. Ook is er volop ruimte om samen te innoveren met externe partijen. Niet alleen om te moderniseren, maar vooral om nieuwe producten en diensten te ontwikkelen die passen bij de belevingswereld van burgers, bedrijven en collega’s.
*“Door complexe vraagstukken behapbaar te maken in samenwerking met de stakeholders en deze door te vertalen naar een toekomstbestendige IT\-oplossingen draag je direct bij aan een Belastingdienst die toekomstgericht is.” Esther \- solution architect*

**Wanneer past deze baan bij je?**
----------------------------------


* \- Je hebt wo werk\- en denkniveau;
* + Je hebt een sterk analytisch vermogen en vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar heldere en realiseerbare oplossingen;
* + Je hebt kennis van de methodes en tools die we binnen de IV\-keten van de belastingdienst gebruiken, zoals requirementsmanagement, BPMN, Archimate, TOGAF en Business Enterprise Studio;
* \- Je voelt je thuis in een Agile\- en DevOps\-omgeving en stimuleert samenwerking en continue verbetering;
* + Je bent bereid de opleiding Solution architectuur (post\-HBO Create Integrated Solution Architecture) te volgen en ziet dit als een waardevolle stap in je ontwikkeling;
* + Je bent een verbinder die gemakkelijk samenwerkt met DevOps\-teams, architecten en andere stakeholders en weet mensen mee te nemen in verandering;
**Jouw competenties**
---------------------


* analyseren
* organisatiesensitiviteit
* overtuigingskracht
* samenwerken
* zelfontwikkeling

--------------------------

De inschaling vindt plaats op basis van relevante kennis en het aantal relevante werkervaringsjaren passend bij de uit te voeren werkzaamheden in de nieuwe functie.Als voorbeeld: met 3 jaar relevante werkervaring word je ingeschaald in nummer 3 van de betreffende salarisschaal.

Bepaalde tijd, voorafgaand aan onbepaalde tijd

32

### **Overige arbeidsvoorwaarden**


Naast salaris ontvang je ook een individueel keuzebudget (IKB). Jouw IKB bestaat uit geld (IKB\-budget) en tijd (IKB\-uren). Het IKB geeft je de mogelijkheid om naar eigen keuze een deel van je IKB\-budget te laten uitbetalen op de door jou gekozen tijdstippen. Én je hebt de mogelijkheid om je IKB\-budget deels om te zetten in verlof of andersom. Ook kun je het IKB\-budget besteden aan een fiscaal\-vriendelijk doel, zoals bijvoorbeeld een fiets, bedrijfsfitness of vakliteratuur.


De Rijksoverheid hecht sterk aan persoonlijke groei en loopbaanontwikkeling en biedt daarvoor tal van mogelijkheden. Tot de secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden behoren onder meer studiefaciliteiten, ouderschapsverlof en een vergoeding woon\-werkverkeer.


Wij verwachten van onze werknemers dat ze integer zijn en we vragen aan nieuwe medewerkers een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG). Als deze niet kan worden overlegd voor de indiensttreding, volgt geen arbeidsovereenkomst.

jobs.title: AI Architect
jobs.description:
**AI Architect**

  

**Excited to uncover insights from complex data and turn them into impactful business decisions?**

**Do you enjoy building predictive models, experimenting with advanced analytics, and solving real\-world challenges with data?**

  

**About the team:**

  

LexisNexis Intellectual Property Solutions (LNIP) is the global leader in patent intelligence, bringing clarity to innovation for businesses, law firms, universities, and government agencies worldwide. Our mission is to help the innovation community make better decisions faster, with greater confidence, combining the world’s most trusted patent data with sophisticated analytics, AI\-powered insights, and purpose\-built workflows.

  

  

Protégé in PatentSight is LNIP’s next\-generation agentic AI assistant, purpose\-built for strategic patent analysis. Protégé replaces complex filter\-based workflows with natural language questions, surfacing structured, decision\-ready insights grounded in trusted data and established metrics.

  

**About the role :**

  

As an AI Architect, you will be the technical authority for the AI systems that power Protégé within PatentSight\+. You will work across the full stack, from the agentic layer down, ensuring every layer is coherent, scalable, secure, and aligned with RELX Responsible AI standards.


This is a senior individual\-contributor role with broad influence. You will partner closely with Engineering Leads, Product Managers, Data Scientists, and data teams within LNIP.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Define and own the AI architecture vision for Protégé in PatentSight\+, ensuring technical decisions are coherent, future\-proof, and aligned with product strategy.
* Evaluate and recommend AI technologies, modelling approaches, and platform components.
* Stay up to date with advances in agentic AI and domain\-specific AI research. Translate emerging capabilities into practical architectural recommendations.
* Author and maintain Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and system design documentation, providing a clear and durable record of technical choices and their rationale.
* Architect the agentic reasoning systems that enable Protégé to decompose complex patent questions, plan multi\-step analyses, and compose insights from multiple data sources.
* Design retrieval and search architectures that deliver accurate, low\-latency patent intelligence across both structured analytics and unstructured text corpora.
* Define patterns for AI\-driven enrichment and classification of patent data at scale, ensuring results are dependable, auditable, and consistent with established IP metrics.
* Establish prompt engineering standards, evaluation harnesses, and quality frameworks to govern LLM behaviour and maintain output accuracy in production.
* Partner with Product Management to assess technical feasibility and shape the AI roadmap, translating product goals into deliverable system designs.
* Collaborate with Security and Platform teams to ensure AI systems meet enterprise requirements for access control, data privacy, and regulatory compliance.
* Ensure all AI systems comply with RELX Responsible AI Principles.
* Lead AI risk assessment activities, contributing to compliance with applicable regulatory frameworks.
* Communicate complex architectural decisions clearly to senior leadership, engineering teams, and non\-technical stakeholders.
  

**Requirements:**

**Essential \-**

  

* Strong professional software engineering expertise, with experience in a dedicated AI/ML architecture, principal engineer, or distinguished engineer role.
* Proven track record delivering production LLM\-based systems, including RAG pipelines, agentic/tool\-use frameworks, and multi\-step reasoning workflows.
* Strong proficiency in Python for AI service development; working knowledge of C\# or equivalent compiled language for enterprise microservice integration.
* Hands\-on experience with vector databases and semantic search pipeline design.
* Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Experience with large\-scale data platforms such as Databricks and search engines such as Elasticsearch, in an analytical or AI feature engineering context.
* Demonstrated ability to design enterprise\-grade AI systems with strong non\-functional requirements: security, privacy, reliability, cost governance, and observability.
* Experience communicating complex architectural decisions through written documents, diagrams, and presentations to diverse audiences.
  

  

**Desirable\-**

  

* Background in the intellectual property, legal technology, or scientific information domain; familiarity with patent data structures and classification systems.
* Knowledge of Responsible AI Principles.
* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
* Experience designing event\-driven, cloud\-native architectures using Kafka (or equivalent streaming platforms), including topic design, schema governance, and consumer patterns.
  

  

**Why Join Us?**

  

Join our team and contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. If you are ready to advance your career and make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

  

**Work in a way that works for you**  

  



We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long\-term goals.

  

  

Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

  

**Working for you**

  

We know that your well\-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:


* Generous holiday allowance with the option to buy additional days.
* Health screening, eye care vouchers, and private medical benefits
* Wellbeing programs
* Life assurance
* Access to a competitive contributory pension scheme
* Save As You Earn share option scheme.
* Travel Season ticket loan.
* Electric Vehicle Scheme
* Optional Dental Insurance
* Maternity, paternity, and shared parental leave
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Access to emergency care for both the elderly and children
* RECARES days, giving you time to support the charities and causes that matter to you.
* Access to employee resource groups with dedicated time to volunteer.
* Access to extensive learning and development resources
* Access to employee discounts scheme via Perks at Work
  

  

**About the Business**

  

At LexisNexis Intellectual Property (LNIP), we believe that whenever a person works on a patent and understands the future trajectory of a specific technology, that person has the potential to fundamentally change how society operates. We are proud to directly support and serve these innovators in their endeavors to better humankind. We enable innovators to accomplish more by helping them make informed decisions, be more productive, comply with regulations, and ultimately achieve superior results. By harnessing the latest advances in machine learning combined with expert analysis, LexisNexis Intellectual Property is disrupting how actionable insight is extracted from patent data. Information can now be accessed with efficiency, accuracy and at a speed that is just not possible by traditional methods. Our overall success is measured by how well we deliver these results.

  

**We know your well\-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click** **here** **to access benefits specific to your location.**

We are committed to providing a fair and accessible hiring process. If you have a disability or other need that requires accommodation or adjustment, please let us know by completing our Applicant Request Support Form or please contact 1\-855\-833\-5120\.

jobs.description:
Over de functie

is. SRQ168876

Je werkt als Technisch Solution Architect op het snijvlak van business en IT binnen een domein waar digitalisering en complexe logistieke vraagstukken samenkomen. Je bouwt mee aan de digitale ruggengraat achter de treinreis en vertaalt businesswensen naar toekomstbestendige technische oplossingen. Daarbij heb je een sleutelrol in het ontwerpen van complexe oplossingsrichtingen, het verbinden van teams en het bewaken van architectuurkaders. Je opereert in een omgeving waar Agile, DevOps, Continuous Delivery en schaalbare cloudoplossingen centraal staan. Je krijgt de ruimte om richting te geven aan technische keuzes en tegelijkertijd teams te coachen in hun ontwikkeling.

Wat ga je doen

Je slaat de brug tussen businessprocessen en IT en werkt actief samen met teams op de werkvloer.
Je ontwerpt samen met lead developers high-level functionele en technische oplossingsrichtingen voor complexe onderdelen.
Je houdt rekening met standaardisatie, schaalbaarheid, herbruikbaarheid, performance, security en beschikbaarheid.
Je adviseert stakeholders zoals Product Owners, de IT lead en de Lead Solution Architect over gekozen oplossingen.
Je neemt regie op de deliverables die nodig zijn voor de technische architectuur, zoals de inrichting van de cloudomgeving binnen en buiten het domein.
Je ontwikkelt in afstemming met andere architecten een toekomstvisie op de positie van softwarecomponenten binnen het bredere applicatielandschap.
Je zorgt dat oplossingsrichtingen in lijn zijn met wet- en regelgeving en architectuurkaders.
Je bepaalt de impact van organisatorische en technische veranderingen op lopende en toekomstige projecten.
Je adviseert en coacht DevOps-teams bij automatiseringsslagen, continue verbetering van werkwijze, softwarekwaliteit en ontwikkelsnelheid.
Je documenteert en controleert opgeleverde architectuur- en engineeringproducten en draagt de doelarchitectuur en architectuur-roadmap uit.

Over jou

Je hebt WO/HBO werk- en denkniveau en beweegt je gemakkelijk tussen strategisch en technisch niveau.
Je doorgrondt business en bedrijfsstrategie en vertaalt die naar passende technische keuzes.
Je communiceert sterk, van boardroom tot engine room.
Je bent coachend richting DevOps-teams en begeleidt hen in hun dagelijkse ontwikkelproces.
Je bent flexibel, nieuwsgierig en staat open voor feedback.
Je leert snel van fouten en ervaringen en past je gemakkelijk aan veranderende omstandigheden aan.
Je deelt actief je kennis en ervaring met anderen en stimuleert anderen om te leren.
Je voelt je prettig in een grote, complexe organisatie die continu in beweging is.

Je hebt WO/HBO werk- en denkniveau en minimaal 5 jaar recente ervaring in een architectuur- of vergelijkbare rol.
Je hebt kennis van beheer, data- en securityrichtlijnen en requirements engineering.
Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met architectuurmethoden, technieken, tools en frameworks.
Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring met Microsoft Azure en Azure Kubernetes Service.
Je hebt minimaal 4 jaar ervaring met Infrastructure-as-code, met name Terraform.
Je hebt ervaring met Scrum, SAFe, CI/CD en DevOps, zowel in mindset als tooling.
Je hebt ruimschootse ervaring met het inrichten en beheren van CI/CD pipelines, met name in Azure DevOps.
Je hebt ervaring met het implementeren en inrichten van monitoringtools zoals Datadog.
Je hebt kennis van netwerktechnologieën en -infrastructuur, zoals routers, vpn’s, loadbalancers en firewalls.
Je hebt een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

Wensen

Je beschikt over certificeringen zoals TOGAF en ArchiMate.

Je hebt ervaring binnen het logistieke domein.
Je bent in staat mee te bewegen met verandering en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen, ook in relatie tot de komst van genAI.

Je bent sterk in samenwerken en schakelt effectief met verschillende disciplines en stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer
jobs.description:
Ecotricity, the UK’s first true green energy provider, has a strong internal technology team building solutions across mission-critical platforms. The Senior Engineer will create solutions that use artificial intelligence to solve real business problems, with AWS/Databricks as the core production platform and Claude and Codex supporting the engineering workflow. This is a hands-on role spanning discovery, software delivery and the reliable operation of live services

Responsibilities

Own the design, build, deployment and ongoing operation of production-grade AI-enabled data products on AWS and Databricks.
Work with stakeholders to define the user problem, measurable outcomes, data requirements and a pragmatic technical approach.
Prototype rapidly with Claude, Codex and other approved AI tooling, then turn successful concepts into secure, maintainable software.
Build reliable data pipelines, APIs and back-end services, together with front-end web or app experiences where the product requires them.
Apply strong software engineering practices including code review, automated testing, CI/CD, version control, documentation and infrastructure as code.
Create evaluation, monitoring and observability for data quality, model or LLM behaviour, service reliability, performance and cost.
Protect sensitive data and apply appropriate security, privacy, governance and responsible AI controls throughout the product lifecycle.
Operate and support live services, resolve faults swiftly, reduce technical debt and share practical knowledge with the wider team.

About the team

The Ecotricity Technology department is a small friendly team with a strong focus on getting results, with everyone committed to delivering both individually and as part of the group/project.

We have a training programme in place to further advance your skills, with dedicated learning time planned into our workloads. Relevant training and certifications, including Databricks and AWS, are supported by the company, alongside opportunities to deepen applied AI and software engineering skills.

We’re proud to be an ethical company, and this naturally attracts ethical people, making for a good safe working environment and a team that works and wins together. We also have a competitive benefits package and chose to invest in our people whenever we can.

About You

Are you an experienced engineer who enjoys turning business problems and data into useful, production-ready products? We are looking for a practical Senior Engineer who can take ownership from early discovery and prototyping through to deployment, adoption and support.

You will design and build end-to-end AI-enabled solutions on AWS and Databricks. Depending on the problem, this may pipelines, APIs, backend services and user-facing websites or applications.

We value sound engineering judgement over using AI for its own sake. You will select the simplest effective approach, prove value quickly, and then engineer for security, performance, cost, maintainability and scale. Experience in the energy industry is helpful but not essential.

You will work closely with product owners, project managers, subject-matter experts, data teams and other stakeholders. You will explain options clearly, demonstrate working software, gather feedback and translate it into measurable product outcomes.

This is a hybrid role, you will be self-motivated, delivery-focused and comfortable driving work independently. You will also contribute to shared engineering standards, review the work of peers and actively develop your own skills as AI tooling evolves.

If you want to build responsible AI products that move beyond prototypes and deliver tangible value in a dynamic, purpose-led organisation, we encourage you to apply.

Knowledge And Skills

Experience building and operating production software, data products or applied AI systems.
Strong Python, including experience designing APIs and integrating external services.
Practical experience with Databricks
Experience deploying secure, scalable workloads on AWS.
Understanding of applied AI and LLM patterns such as retrieval-augmented generation, tool use, structured extraction and evaluation.
Effective use of AI coding assistants such as Claude and Codex, with the judgement to review, test and own the resulting code.
Strong software delivery practices using GitHub or Bitbucket, automated testing and CI/CD.
Ability to build usable front-end web or app experiences using TypeScript, React or a comparable framework.
Clear communication, product thinking and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Advantageous

MLflow, RAG, Vector Search or comparable model and AI application tooling.
Terraform and automated AWS infrastructure delivery.
Container-based deployment, serverless services or modern application observability.
UX or product design experience for internal or customer-facing applications.
Experience of the energy industry or other regulated, data-sensitive environments.

About Us

What's in it for you...

Healthcare plan, life assurance and generous pension contribution

Volunteering Day

Hybrid Working

Various company discounts (including shops, gyms, days out and events)

Holiday of 25 days (plus bank holidays) & ability to buy/sell days

Cycle to work scheme, car pooling and onsite parking available

As a valued member of the team, you will be supporting the Group Environmental Policy and its associated sustainability objectives and targets.

Flexibility Statement

The fast moving nature of the business means that from time to time you may be asked to perform duties or tasks outside of your original job description on an ad hoc basis. This allows the company to utilise our people in the best possible way at all times and helps our colleagues to make the best contribution in a changing environment.

Ecotricity is Britain's overall greenest energy company- it’s more than just green energy – the breadth and depth of our work on green issues is unmatched. When we started back in 1995, we were the first company in the world to provide a new kind of electricity - the green kind.

Our mission was, and remains, to change the way energy is made and used in Britain - by replacing fossil fuels with clean, renewable energy.

We don't just supply green energy, we use the money from our customers' bills to make it ourselves too – we have built windmills and sun parks in Britain. We call this turning 'bills into mills'.

We don't just focus on energy though- we built the Electric Highway, Britain's leading network of electric vehicle charging points; we helped Forest Green Rovers become the greenest football club in the world; and we launched Britain's greenest mobile phone service, Ecotalk, where they use the money from their customers' bills to protect and regenerate Britain's lost rainforests.

Ecotricity is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to providing equality for all.

and would like to work for European institutions in Brussels? Then this opportinuty is for you!

for the EU Institution in Brussels, Belgium:

Design and implement cloud solutions that meet business objectives, with defined operational Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for availability, reliability, and performance, and clear ownership boundaries.

* Du bringst dich in Architektur\- und Technologieentscheidungen ein und vereinbarst sowie etablierst technische Leitplanken gemeinsam mit dem Team.
* Du arbeitest aktiv im Scrum\-Prozess mit und bringst dich konstruktiv in die Verbesserung von Zusammenarbeit und Entwicklungsprozess ein.

**Dein Profil**
---------------

  

* Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung im Microsoft\-.NET\-Umfeld (z. B. C\#, Visual Studio).
* Fundierte Kenntnisse in mehreren der folgenden Technologien und Schwerpunkte:
	+ C\# / .NET, ASP.NET
	+ REST\-(Web\-)Services
	+ Blazor (Hybrid/WebAssembly)
	+ Bootstrap, CSS
	+ SQL
* Erfahrung im Umgang mit komplexeren Softwareprodukten oder gewachsenen Codebasen sowie die Fähigkeit, diese strukturiert weiterzuentwickeln.

* Freude am Softwareentwicklungsprozess: du denkst in iterativen Schritten, holst früh Feedback ein und lieferst kontinuierlich nutzbaren Mehrwert.
* Hohe Eigenverantwortung und Ownership: du bringst technische Themen proaktiv voran, kommunizierst transparent zu Status und Risiken und übernimmst Verantwortung für Ergebnis, Qualität und kontinuierliche Verbesserung.
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

**Was wir bieten**
------------------

  

* Eine unbefristete Anstellung in Vollzeit in einem stabilen Produktumfeld.
* Ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit klar geregeltem Remote\-Anteil und flexibler Arbeitszeitgestaltung.
* 30 Tage Urlaub sowie jeweils einen halben Sonderurlaubstag an Heiligabend und Silvester.

* Verantwortungsvolle Aufgaben mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum in einem erfahrenen, motivierten Team.

Quality and inspection databases

jobs.description:
The opportunity

We are looking for a highly motivated and ambitious system architect to take on the responsibility for defining and governing the architecture, processes, methods, and infrastructure required to verify and validate industrial control systems throughout their lifecycle.

The role ensures that testability, observability, diagnostics, cybersecurity, reliability, and quality are systematically engineered into control system architectures, enabling continuous validation from concept and design through deployment, operation, maintenance, modernization, and retirement. The architect drives lifecycle testing, automated verification, digital validation environments, and quality-by-design practices across control platforms and solutions.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Define and govern the overall Verification & Validation (V&V) architecture, strategy, standards, and governance framework.
Establish validation approaches for controllers, protection systems, automation applications, HMI/SCADA, communication networks, and integrations.
Define verification gates, acceptance criteria, traceability, and release readiness requirements.
Lead DFMEA activities across systems, subsystems, components, interfaces, and control functions, translating risks into requirements and test cases.
Ensure design for testability, enabling validation of critical safety, reliability, and performance scenarios.
Define and verify preventive and detective controls, including diagnostics, protections, interlocks, alarms, monitoring, and fallback behaviors.
Govern lifecycle testing, including unit, integration, system, acceptance, regression, upgrade, and operational validation.
Drive test automation through CI/CD, automated test frameworks, SIL/HIL simulation, virtual commissioning, and Digital Twin environments.
Ensure end-to-end traceability between requirements, architecture, test evidence, defects, releases, and compliance obligations.
Act as the technical authority for V&V, quality engineering, cybersecurity validation, and continuous improvement, while mentoring cross-functional teams.

Your background

PhD or Master’s degree in Control Systems, Real-Time Systems, Industrial Automation, Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Mechatronics, or a related field, combined with advanced knowledge of control architectures, industrial automation, cyber-physical systems, and systems engineering principles.
10+ years of experience in control systems, industrial automation, power systems, or other mission-critical industrial platforms.
Proven experience defining Verification & Validation (V&V) architectures for control systems and tailoring software development and verification lifecycles to product-specific software and hardware requirements.
Hands-on expertise in verification, validation, test automation, systems integration, and control system lifecycle management.
Strong knowledge of Industrial Control Systems (ICS), SCADA, HMI, PLC, DCS, Protection & Control Systems, and systems engineering methodologies.
Experience with V&V methodologies and advanced validation environments, including UT, SIT, SVT, FAT, SAT, Release Validation, SIL, HIL, Real-Time Simulation, Digital Twins, and Virtual Commissioning.
Proficiency in test automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, requirements management, traceability, configuration management, OT cybersecurity, security validation, reliability engineering, fault analysis, and operational readiness validation.
Experience leading cross-functional engineering teams and technical governance activities, with expertise in DFMEA for software/control systems and tools such as MATLAB/Simulink, PSCAD, RTDS, modern requirements and test management platforms, and GenAI/agentic AI frameworks.

jobs.title: Graphics Programmer
jobs.description:
Based in the heart of Leamington Spa, Pixel Toys have spent over a decade pushing the capabilities of mobile gaming. We have developed multiple award\-winning titles, including: Warhammer 40,000: Freeblade, Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Realm War; and we’re now excited to be exclusively working on a new game, unlike ANYTHING we’ve done previously!

  

As a forward thinking and innovative studio we are always looking for new technologies and techniques to develop and use in our games and make them even more engaging experiences for our customers.

  

We are excited to continue to grow our team and are always on the lookout for highly talented and motivated individuals, who are passionate about gaming and excited to join us on our ambitious journey!

 **The Role:**

  

Join Pixel Toys as a Graphics Programmer at Pixel Toys where you will play a central role in establishing graphics quality and performance across our multi\-platform titles, with a strong focus on mobile hardware. Working in a flexible and collaborative environment, you will bring your technical ideas to enrich both the final visual experience and team dynamics.

  

Partnering closely with Technical Artists, Engineers, and Designers you will architect, prototype, and implement graphics systems that achieve an exceptional balance between visual polish and runtime efficiency.

  

Your day\-to\-day will involve writing and maintaining high\-quality shaders and graphical features while carefully accounting for mobile hardware constraints such as memory usage, overdraw, and thermal throttling. You will take ownership of profiling and investigating performance bottlenecks across diverse devices, utilising mobile graphics APIs like Vulkan and Metal to resolve visual anomalies. From optimising render pipelines to managing post\-processing, culling, LODing, and lightmapping, you will ensure the stability and efficiency of our graphics codebase across a wide spectrum of target hardware.

 **About you:**

  

As a Graphics Programmer bring professional programming experience in C\# or C\+\+, backed by a practical understanding of coding standards, software architecture, and graphics pipelines.

  

We would love to see experience across some of the following areas:


* **Shader Programming:** Practical experience with HLSL, GLSL, or CG shader development, ideally utilising Physically Based Rendering (PBR) workflows.
* **Render Pipelines:** Familiarity with Unity Scriptable Render Pipelines (SRPs), including shader keywords, variants, batching, render passes, and custom renderer features.
* **Mobile Profiling \& Optimisation:** Hands\-on experience with on\-device mobile graphics profiling, debugging, and performance optimisation across Android or iOS hardware.
* **Graphics APIs:** A working familiarity with modern mobile graphics APIs such as Vulkan and Metal.
* **3D Math \& Asset Optimisation:** A solid foundation in 3D math and experience optimising art assets, including post\-processing, culling, LOD systems, and lightmaps.
* **Collaborative Mindset:** An eye for visual detail, effective problem\-solving skills, and a collaborative approach to working alongside technical artists and cross\-functional game teams.

 **What can Pixel Toys offer?**

  

At Pixel Toys we are proud of the progressive, inclusive, and collaborative working environment we have created; a place where everyone has the opportunity to be themselves and is welcomed and valued for who they are and what they contribute. We have some fantastic benefits we offer our employees… Here are just some of them:

  

* Competitive salary, reviewed annually
* 25 days annual leave, excluding bank holidays
* Discretionary Bonus Scheme
* Up to 3 additional long service days (duvet days!)
* Private Medical Insurance (including optical and dental)
* Company Pension scheme
* Death in Service benefit
* Regular socials including epic summer and Christmas parties!
* Staff training and development
* Quarterly Wellness days (On\-site massages and more)
* Flexi\-time working hours

jobs.description:
**Description**  



  

### **About Xe**


Xe is a cross\-border payments platform. We help SMEs and consumers in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand collect, convert, hold, and send money across markets. Each year, over 300 million people use Xe for currency information and over 350,000 use us to send money overseas.


Today, we're rebuilding the platform layer behind cross\-border payments for corporate and consumer clients. We're small enough that your code ships fast and your decisions matter, and Euronet Worldwide (Nasdaq: EEFT) backs us so the problems stay real\-scale.

### **About This Role**


We're hiring a mid\-level back\-end engineer who likes owning real problems end\-to\-end, from API design and data modeling through to service implementation, production reliability, and launch. You already use AI as part of how you think, build, test, and ship.


You'll write code that moves money in production, build and modernize the backend services the platform runs on, and ship new capability as Xe rebuilds its platform layer. You'll work in a small team with direct access to product, compliance, and operations, own your services in production, and partner with architects and team leads on bigger design decisions.

### **What You'll Do**

* Build backend services that move money and manage multi\-currency balances across a range of domains, including onboarding, KYC and KYB, payment initiation, FX, settlement, and other supporting services.
* Partner with product, compliance, and operations from problem framing through launch.
* Build and operate the partner integrations and settlement infrastructure your services depend on.
* Own your services in production, including reliability, observability, on\-call, and incident response.
* Use agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) daily across the SDLC, and help take parts of the platform from legacy services into the modern stack alongside architects and team leads in your domain.

### **What We're Looking For**

**Must\-have**

* 3 to 6 years building production backend services, end\-to\-end.
* Strong backend proficiency in C\# / .NET preferred; other OOP languages welcome (Java, Kotlin, Go, or equivalent).
* SQL and relational database fundamentals.
* Writing and maintaining tests.
* Daily use of agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) across the SDLC.
* Production experience with AWS, including hands\-on deployment and native services such as SQS, DynamoDB, S3, ECS, and Lambda.
* Strong system design fundamentals, including distributed systems and async or event\-driven patterns.
* Strong written and verbal communication.

**Nice\-to\-have**

* Experience in payments, FX, or cross\-border money movement.
* Service\-oriented or microservices architecture experience.
* Experience with ledgers, double\-entry accounting, or other financial\-data systems.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices.
* Experience with caching solutions like Memcached or Redis.
* Experience using project management and documentation tools like Jira and Confluence.
* Knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman or Bruno.
* Writing automated tests alongside development with AI tools (Claude Code or equivalent).

### **Perks \& Benefits**

* Competitive Salary \& Discretionary Bonus
* 23 days annual leave increasing with service (capped at 28 days)
* Paid day off for your Birthday
* 4% employer pension contribution
* Discounted Euronet ESPP
* Life Cover, Income Protection \& Critical Illness cover
* Healthcare
* Plumm Mental Health and Wellbeing
* Volunteering day for a charity of your choice


We want Xe to be a great place to work and to ensure that our communities are represented across our workforce. A vital part of this is ensuring we are a truly inclusive organization that encourages diversity in all respects.


Xe is an **Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment regardless of age, national origin, race, color, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.** We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at recruitment@xe.com.

It is not to be taken as a complete statement of responsibilities or requirements. jobs.title: AI Architect
jobs.description:
**AI Architect**

  

**Excited to uncover insights from complex data and turn them into impactful business decisions?**

**Do you enjoy building predictive models, experimenting with advanced analytics, and solving real\-world challenges with data?**

  

**About the team:**

  

LexisNexis Intellectual Property Solutions (LNIP) is the global leader in patent intelligence, bringing clarity to innovation for businesses, law firms, universities, and government agencies worldwide. Our mission is to help the innovation community make better decisions faster, with greater confidence, combining the world’s most trusted patent data with sophisticated analytics, AI\-powered insights, and purpose\-built workflows.

  

  

Protégé in PatentSight is LNIP’s next\-generation agentic AI assistant, purpose\-built for strategic patent analysis. Protégé replaces complex filter\-based workflows with natural language questions, surfacing structured, decision\-ready insights grounded in trusted data and established metrics.

  

**About the role :**

  

As an AI Architect, you will be the technical authority for the AI systems that power Protégé within PatentSight\+. You will work across the full stack, from the agentic layer down, ensuring every layer is coherent, scalable, secure, and aligned with RELX Responsible AI standards.


This is a senior individual\-contributor role with broad influence. You will partner closely with Engineering Leads, Product Managers, Data Scientists, and data teams within LNIP.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Define and own the AI architecture vision for Protégé in PatentSight\+, ensuring technical decisions are coherent, future\-proof, and aligned with product strategy.
* Evaluate and recommend AI technologies, modelling approaches, and platform components.
* Stay up to date with advances in agentic AI and domain\-specific AI research. Translate emerging capabilities into practical architectural recommendations.
* Author and maintain Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and system design documentation, providing a clear and durable record of technical choices and their rationale.
* Architect the agentic reasoning systems that enable Protégé to decompose complex patent questions, plan multi\-step analyses, and compose insights from multiple data sources.
* Design retrieval and search architectures that deliver accurate, low\-latency patent intelligence across both structured analytics and unstructured text corpora.
* Define patterns for AI\-driven enrichment and classification of patent data at scale, ensuring results are dependable, auditable, and consistent with established IP metrics.
* Establish prompt engineering standards, evaluation harnesses, and quality frameworks to govern LLM behaviour and maintain output accuracy in production.
* Partner with Product Management to assess technical feasibility and shape the AI roadmap, translating product goals into deliverable system designs.
* Collaborate with Security and Platform teams to ensure AI systems meet enterprise requirements for access control, data privacy, and regulatory compliance.
* Ensure all AI systems comply with RELX Responsible AI Principles.
* Lead AI risk assessment activities, contributing to compliance with applicable regulatory frameworks.
* Communicate complex architectural decisions clearly to senior leadership, engineering teams, and non\-technical stakeholders.
  

**Requirements:**

**Essential \-**

  

* Strong professional software engineering expertise, with experience in a dedicated AI/ML architecture, principal engineer, or distinguished engineer role.
* Proven track record delivering production LLM\-based systems, including RAG pipelines, agentic/tool\-use frameworks, and multi\-step reasoning workflows.
* Strong proficiency in Python for AI service development; working knowledge of C\# or equivalent compiled language for enterprise microservice integration.
* Hands\-on experience with vector databases and semantic search pipeline design.
* Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Experience with large\-scale data platforms such as Databricks and search engines such as Elasticsearch, in an analytical or AI feature engineering context.
* Demonstrated ability to design enterprise\-grade AI systems with strong non\-functional requirements: security, privacy, reliability, cost governance, and observability.
* Experience communicating complex architectural decisions through written documents, diagrams, and presentations to diverse audiences.
  

  

**Desirable\-**

  

* Background in the intellectual property, legal technology, or scientific information domain; familiarity with patent data structures and classification systems.
* Knowledge of Responsible AI Principles.
* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
* Experience designing event\-driven, cloud\-native architectures using Kafka (or equivalent streaming platforms), including topic design, schema governance, and consumer patterns.
  

  

**Why Join Us?**

  

Join our team and contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. If you are ready to advance your career and make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

  

**Work in a way that works for you**  

  



We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long\-term goals.

  

  

Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

  

**Working for you**

  

We know that your well\-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:


* Generous holiday allowance with the option to buy additional days.
* Health screening, eye care vouchers, and private medical benefits
* Wellbeing programs
* Life assurance
* Access to a competitive contributory pension scheme
* Save As You Earn share option scheme.
* Travel Season ticket loan.
* Electric Vehicle Scheme
* Optional Dental Insurance
* Maternity, paternity, and shared parental leave
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Access to emergency care for both the elderly and children
* RECARES days, giving you time to support the charities and causes that matter to you.
* Access to employee resource groups with dedicated time to volunteer.
* Access to extensive learning and development resources
* Access to employee discounts scheme via Perks at Work
  

  

**About the Business**

  

At LexisNexis Intellectual Property (LNIP), we believe that whenever a person works on a patent and understands the future trajectory of a specific technology, that person has the potential to fundamentally change how society operates. We are proud to directly support and serve these innovators in their endeavors to better humankind. We enable innovators to accomplish more by helping them make informed decisions, be more productive, comply with regulations, and ultimately achieve superior results. By harnessing the latest advances in machine learning combined with expert analysis, LexisNexis Intellectual Property is disrupting how actionable insight is extracted from patent data. Information can now be accessed with efficiency, accuracy and at a speed that is just not possible by traditional methods. Our overall success is measured by how well we deliver these results.

  

**We know your well\-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click** **here** **to access benefits specific to your location.**

We are committed to providing a fair and accessible hiring process. If you have a disability or other need that requires accommodation or adjustment, please let us know by completing our Applicant Request Support Form or please contact 1\-855\-833\-5120\.

**Job Title** \- Project Engineer (Design)


**Location** \- Wrexham or Caernarfon


**Salary \+ benefits** \- From £45,400 with annual review, performance bonus, comprehensive pension scheme (company doubles your contribution up to 10%), plus extensive benefits package


**Closing date** \- 6th October 2026

  

  

**Help us create a better future, quicker**

  

Join SP Energy Networks as a Project Engineer (Design) and play a vital role in shaping the future of our district distribution network. You'll be at the forefront of planning and designing electrical infrastructure up to 11kV, ensuring network security and integrity while delivering projects typically valued at circa £5m. This role offers the opportunity to apply innovative engineering solutions that balance customer needs with efficient network design, all while enabling Scotland's Net Zero targets. You'll manage connection requests, undertake system evaluation to establish load and generation connections, and develop network reinforcement solutions that improve the safety and longevity of our electrical infrastructure. Working within our Planning \& Design team, you'll help drive the rapid growth in renewable energy that our communities rely on.

  

  

**What you'll be doing**

  

* Manage the regulatory aspects of connection requests and provide quotations, ensuring all processes meet regulatory and licence requirements
* Work within defined scope, volumes, and unit costs to deliver best value from regulatory contracts while maintaining the highest standards of network integrity
* Integrate asset stewardship through sound engineering practices, coordinating planning, design, and ownership activities to improve network safety and longevity while minimizing scheme costs for customer connections
* Manage third\-party Point of Connection and design approvals activities within the SPM and SPD licence areas
* Produce designs in accordance with unit or authorized prime costs, enabling efficient delivery of outputs
* Drive continuous performance improvement through evaluation of outputs and feedback from internal and external sources
* Consider technological, procedural, and commercial solutions to enhance all designs through innovation
* Develop robust stakeholder and customer relationships on behalf of ScottishPower, facilitating delivery of strategic priorities
* Work closely with Local Authorities, Housing Associations, and Independent Network Operators, ensuring programmes of work complement local activities and aspirations
* Promote an exemplary safety culture, ensuring all safety legislation is implemented and delivered through all activities and incorporated into project designs
* Plan your workload and daily activities to meet team goals, ensuring completion of all designs within relevant guaranteed standards and licence conditions
* Contribute to the district's medium and long\-term network plan spanning 3 months to 3 years
  

  

**What you'll bring**

  

* Engineering or professional qualification, or equivalent experience that demonstrates your technical capability
* Experience in a network design role
* Relevant network construction and operational experience that gives you practical insight into how designs translate to real\-world infrastructure
* Thorough knowledge of design standards up to 11kV
* Familiarity with the regulatory environment including relevant output and incentive mechanisms
* Developed skills with network evaluation modelling tools, enabling you to devise solutions to complex problems and requirements
* General commercial awareness with the ability to balance customer service, efficient network design, and maximum return on investment
* Effective stakeholder and customer service engagement skills
* Ability to communicate and present information clearly at all levels of the organization
* Capability to manage multiple priorities using sound engineering and financial judgement to identify optimal solutions
* Awareness of key business drivers and the external commercial context in which ScottishPower operates
* Computer literacy to work with various digital tools and systems daily
* Ability to make balanced judgements, taking into account all available information, consulting with others when applicable, and anticipating possible outcomes
* Technical and operational experience that enables you to plan effectively and contribute meaningfully to team goals
  

  

**What's in it for you**

  

As well as an attractive salary which is reviewed annually, you can also enjoy a number of other benefits. With our pension scheme, we'll double match your contribution up to a company contribution of 10%.


At ScottishPower, we believe it's the little things we do in life that make a big difference. From helping you look after your family's wellbeing, save for your future and take personal steps for climate action \- our benefits are designed to help you do just that \- so that you have everything you need to take care of your world \- today and tomorrow. That's why our benefits include:


* 36 days annual leave
* Holiday Purchase \- perfect your work/life balance with extra annual leave
* Equity Plans
* Payroll Giving and Charity Matched Funding
* Technology Vouchers \- save more and spread the cost of your technology purchases
* Electric Vehicle Schemes \- to help you transition to green/clean driving
* Cycle to Work scheme and Public Transport Season Ticket Loans
* Healthcare benefit options including: Dental Insurance, Private Medical Insurance, Health Cash Plan and annual Health Assessments
* Life Assurance (4x salary)
* Access to Savesmart financial wellbeing assistance
* Plus shopping, leisure, restaurant and gym discounts, and unique employee deals on travel insurance and more
  

  

**Why SP Energy Networks**

  

SP Energy Networks is part of the Iberdrola Group, one of the world's largest integrated utility companies and a world leader in wind energy. We keep electricity flowing to homes and businesses through Central and Southern Scotland, North Wales and in the North West of England. We operate over 4000km of cables and lines that make\-up the transmission network \- connecting infrastructure like wind farms into the electricity system. It's a role that puts us right at the heart of Scotland's ambition to be Net Zero by 2044\. And we're taking it very seriously. We're investing \>£5\.5 billion into our transmission network, directly supporting the rapid growth needed in renewable energy. With diverse opportunities across our businesses and a commitment to invest in our own internal talent, ScottishPower can offer people real career opportunities that meet personal and professional goals, in a global organisation.

  

  

Inclusion, diversity, and a social purpose are at the heart of everything we do. Together with our values, they bring us together into a stronger, more sustainable business with direct links to the communities we serve. It takes all kinds of people to build a large\-scale business like ours, so whatever your background, you'll fit right in.

  

  

We are committed to providing reasonable support or adjustments in our recruiting processes for candidates with disabilities, long term conditions, mental health conditions, or who are neurodivergent or require pregnancy\-related support.
