jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Krakow, Poland Category Engineering, Product, \& UX Design
  
Job description
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high\-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close\-knit, high\-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.
  

  

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.
**Senior Security Engineer**
**Why We Have This Role**


Qualtrics is looking for a CDU Analyst to support the (AMR or KRK) team’s daily operations that are responsible for detecting, triaging, and responding to security threats across our global environment. You'll support the day\-to\-day operations of the team and continuously mature our detection and response capabilities to keep pace with an evolving threat landscape. This is a hands\-on role — you'll support in guiding strategy while staying close enough to work alongside the team and manage incidents.
**How You’ll Find Success**


* Strategic Visionary: You possess an in\-depth understanding of the cybersecurity threat landscape and proactively identify emerging risks. You help shape the Security Operations strategy, ensuring alignment with the organization's overall goals.
* Technical Innovator: You drive continuous improvement by evaluating and implementing cutting\-edge security tools, techniques, and automation. Your relentless pursuit of innovation keeps us ahead of evolving threats.
* Collaborative Leader: You build strong cross\-functional partnerships, championing security across the organization. You foster a collaborative environment where teams work seamlessly to achieve a strong security posture.
* Resilient and Adaptive: You thrive in a dynamic environment, effectively managing complex security projects and leading teams through change. Your ability to adapt and problem\-solve makes you a key asset during challenging situations.

**How You’ll Grow**


* Shape Industry Standards: Participate in leading security conferences, thought leadership initiatives, and industry working groups to shape the future of cybersecurity practices.
* Executive Presence: Gain direct exposure to executive\-level decision\-making, refining your strategic communication and influencing skills.
* Expand Your Leadership Toolkit: Lead a team of skilled security professionals, providing you with ample opportunities to enhance your mentorship, coaching, and talent development abilities.
* Complex Problem\-Solving: Tackle high\-impact security challenges that will push your critical thinking, analysis, and strategy\-building skills.

**Things You’ll Do**


* Respond in a Tier 2 role including 24x7 monitoring, detection, triage, and incident response functions
* Support and develop CDU metrics and KPIs (MTTD, MTTR, alert volume/fidelity, coverage) and report on program health to security leadership
* Drive continuous improvement of detection logic, playbooks, and automation in partnership with detection engineering and threat intelligence teams
* Serve as an escalation point and incident commander for high\-severity security incidents, coordinating cross\-functional response
* Partner with Threat Intelligence, Detection Engineering, IT, Legal, and Product/Engineering teams to close gaps in visibility and response
* Manage relationships with any outsourced/MSSP or co\-managed CDU partners, ensuring SLAs and quality standards are met
* Evaluate and help select CDU tooling (SIEM, SOAR, EDR, XDR, ticketing) and drive adoption of automation to reduce analyst toil
* Own CDU\-related audit, compliance, and customer trust requirements (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP as applicable)
* Build and maintain incident response runbooks, tabletop exercises, and post\-incident review processes
* Participate in an on\-call rotation for incidents and provide leadership presence during major security events

**What We’re Looking For On Your Resume**


* Required
	+ 5\+ years in security operations, incident response, or a related security discipline, including 2\+ years in a people\-management or team\-lead role
	+ Demonstrated experience scaling a 24x7 CDU function, whether in\-house, hybrid, or via MSSP oversight
	+ Strong technical grounding in SIEM/SOAR platforms, EDR/XDR, network and cloud security monitoring, and the MITRE ATT\&CK framework
	+ Experience leading incident response for significant security events, including coordination with legal, communications, and executive stakeholders
	+ Track record of hiring, developing, and retaining security talent
	+ Excellent communication skills — able to translate technical detail into risk\-based language for non\-technical leaders
	+ Experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and SaaS security operations
* Nice to Have
  

	+ Experience in a SaaS or enterprise software company handling customer data at scale
	+ Familiarity with compliance frameworks relevant to Qualtrics' customer base (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, GDPR)
	+ Relevant certifications (CISSP, GCIH, GCFA, CISM, or similar)
	+ Experience building or maturing threat detection and threat hunting programs
	+ Background in scripting/automation (Python, PowerShell) to support SOAR workflows

**What You Should Know About This Team**


* Innovation at Our Core: Our Security Operations team embraces change and thrives on solving complex challenges. We value experimentation, continuous learning, and push the boundaries of conventional security practices.
* Collaborative Environment: We believe in the power of teamwork and foster open communication across the team and the wider organization. Your ideas will be heard, and your collaboration will be essential.
* Data\-Driven Approach: We rely on data\-driven insights to inform our security strategies, measure effectiveness, and continuously improve our posture.
* Growth Mindset: We are committed to your professional development. You'll have opportunities to expand your expertise, contribute to high\-visibility projects, and advance your career in cybersecurity.
* Joining our team means stepping into a role that's vital, challenging, and deeply linked to Qualtrics' aim of reshaping industries by harnessing the power of Experience Management and AI.
**Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits**


* Annual Leave: 20 or 26 annual leave days per annum plus an additional day for each year of service (to a max of 5\).
* Private Medical Insurance\- Luxmed health \& dental cover for you and your dependants.
* Commuter Assistance\- Up to the value of 80 PLN net a month for public transport.
* Savings Plan\- Two company saving plans provided by Nationale Nederlanden: Employee Capital Plan (PPK) \& Employee Saving Plan (PPO),
* QED PROGRAM\- Qualtrics Engineer Development (QED) program: support, engineering learning activities up to 10% of engineering work time each quarter.
* Wellness\- Up to the value of 800PLN gross per quarter can be reimbursed for a variety of wellness activities via our dedicated platform Forma,
* A choice of Multispot cards available.
* Our employee assistance program with Unum provides counselling and wellbeing support to all employees
* Experience bonus\- 7000 PLN gross per annum. Qualtrics experience bonus is a program designed to provide experiences to our employees they might not otherwise have.
* Group Life \& Income Protection Insurance
* Glasses/Contact lenses Reimbursement
* Free breakfasts, lunches, snacks, and drinks for everyone in the office
* Tax\-deductible expenses (up to 50% depending on role)

**The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model**: Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in\-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. \#hybrid
*Qualtrics is an equal opportunity employer meaning that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.*
*Applicants in the United States of America have rights under Federal Employment Laws:**Family \& Medical Leave Act**,* *Equal Opportunity Employment**,* *Employee Polygraph Protection Act*
*Qualtrics is committed to the inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Qualtrics will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please let your Qualtrics contact/recruiter know.*
*Not finding a role that’s the right fit for now? Qualtrics Insiders is the one\-stop shop for all things Qualtrics Life. Sign up for exclusive access to content created with you in mind and get the scoop on what we have going on at Qualtrics \- upcoming events, behind the scenes stories from the team, interview tips, hot jobs, and more. No spam \- we promise! You'll hear from us two times a month max with fresh, totally tailored info \- so be sure to stay connected as you explore your best role and company fit.*

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
We’ve landed! When it comes to innovation and achievement, there are few organisations with a better track record. Join us as we embark on an ambitious journey, evolving our digital commerce platforms and building scalable, resilient, and innovative foundations that enable seamless customer experiences across web, mobile, and connected channels.


Finding brilliant tech talent is vital to the future of easyJet. With opportunities to work across the technology that powers our app, website, and other digital touchpoints, you’ll help connect over 100 million customers to thousands of their favourite destinations!


Located in the One Parc Central building in Sant Martí, with hybrid working available, we’re looking to connect with Product, UX, and Software Development professionals who share our passion for making an impact and helping people all over Europe Get Out There. Apply now and be a part of easyJet’s first digital hub, in the heart of Barcelona!


easyJet is building a new customer retention programme designed to enhance customer engagement, reward repeat spends and create new commercial opportunities


As an Engineering Manager within the eCommerce Customer Retention team, you will provide leadership and technical stewardship across multiple engineers in squads within a defined Mission. You will be responsible for the overall design and accountable for upholding engineering standards, ensuring the delivery of robust, secure, scalable, and high\-performance systems. Your role will involve guiding teams towards technical excellence, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, and driving high performance across all aspects of software development.


Working closely with Product Managers, Agile Delivery Managers, Enterprise Architects, and the Chapter Lead for Software Engineering, you will ensure engineering standards are upheld, guide complex technical solutions, and align strategy, approach, and principles across the Mission. By championing best practices, modern architectures, and innovation, you will build solid foundations for a retention programme spanning easyjet.com, our mobile app and easyJet Holidays.

**What you’ll be doing**

* Own the Mission technical vision, strategy, and roadmap, ensuring alignment with business objectives and platform standards
* Take accountability for the technical delivery and execution of the technical vision and strategy across multiple squads within a Mission, ensuring alignment with objectives and platform standards
* Foster a high\-performance culture within squads, promoting collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement
* Work in partnership with Product Managers to define outcomes and priorities for squads, while maintaining platform integrity and architectural excellence
* Lead the design, architecture, and development of scalable, reliable, and high\-performance software systems, including system design, technology selection, and overall architecture
* Collaborate closely with Agile Delivery Managers, Lead Software Engineers, QE Leads, and Senior Technology Managers to align technical direction, project scope, and roadmaps with Mission objectives
* Own the delivery of key product features, ensuring they meet performance, security, and scalability requirements
* Ensure the quality of code delivered across squads, ensuring adherence to best practices and engineering standards
* Actively contribute to and lead code reviews, providing constructive feedback to continuously improve code quality and team capability
* Utilise metrics and feedback loops to monitor team performance, identify areas for improvement, and drive the continuous development of high\-performing engineering teams
* Mentor and provide guidance to junior and mid\-level engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement
* Stay informed of industry trends, emerging technologies, and methodologies, applying insights to improve software development practices and platform capabilities
**Requirements of the Role**
----------------------------

 **What you’ll bring to the team**

* Ability to link technical strategy and architectural decisions to measurable outcomes, including feature performance, platform reliability, and customer impact
* Extensive software engineering experience with proven capability to lead complex projects and collaborate across cross\-functional teams.
* Proven experience integrating SaaS platforms into complex technology environments, and the ability to work closely with external technology partners and vendors to achieve business outcomes
* Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages and modern software development frameworks such as C\#, Typescript and NodeJS
* Demonstrated expertise in cloud platforms (including AWS), with a strong understanding of cloud well\-architected pillars such as security, reliability, performance efficiency, cost optimisation, and operational excellence
* Deep knowledge of modern design patterns and architectures, including APIs, event\-driven architectures (EDA), microapps, front\-end frameworks, and app technologies, with experience applying these in eCommerce environments
* Familiar with integrating customer retention platforms, MarTech ecosystems or personalisation engines
* Experience using measures such as DORA metrics, release frequency, incident response, and system recovery to drive delivery improvements
* Extensive experience in observability, leveraging tools for monitoring metrics, telemetry, alerts, and logs to ensure system reliability and performance
* Ability to coordinate multiple squads, manage dependencies, and align delivery across Missions
* Proven ability to embed robust security and compliance controls by working closely with Security Architects and InfoSec teams, ensuring alignment with organisational standards and regulatory requirements
* Experience within large\-scale eCommerce or high\-transaction technology environments is advantageous
* Familiarity with modern CIAM solutions and standards (e.g., OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SAML) to ensure secure and seamless customer authentication and authorisation across platforms.

 **What we can offer you**

* Competitive base salary
* Up to 20% bonus
* 25 days holiday
* BAYE, SAYE \& Performance share schemes
* 7% pension
* Life Assurance
* Flexible benefits package
* (Work Away) enabling you to work abroad for up to 30 working days per year.
* Excellent staff travel benefits

jobs.title: Back-end C# / .NET Developer
jobs.description:
**Jij bouwt aan het technische hart van onze e\-commerce operatie: een event\-driven landschap in AWS dat dagelijks 1\.200 orders door meer dan 20 verkoopkanalen en 30\+ landen loodst.** En je verkent met ons spec\-driven development met AI\-agents, waarbij het zwaartepunt van je werk verschuift naar intentie, architectuur en review.

**De uitdaging**


Ons e\-commerceplatform wordt extern ontwikkeld, maar alle integraties tussen systemen en diverse eigen tools bouwen en beheren we zelf. Daarmee houden we de regie over performance, betrouwbaarheid en innovatie. Je krijgt een centrale rol in dat landschap: jij zorgt dat de keten blijft draaien en toekomstbestendig is, en je beslist mee over architectuur en technische keuzes.


Daarnaast werk je spec\-first met AI\-agents: je werkt uit wat een verandering moet doen, de agent bouwt, en jij verifieert build, tests en diff voordat er iets naar review gaat. Niets wordt ongelezen of onbegrepen gemerged. Deze aanpak is volop in ontwikkeling, en jouw ervaring en inzicht bepalen mede waar hij heen gaat. We zetten AI in als sparringspartner op complexe onderwerpen en versneller op duidelijke repitieve taken.

**Wat ga je doen?**

* Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt back\-end microservices in C\# .NET (8\.0\), in leesbare en testbare code
* Je bouwt en beheert event\-driven integraties in AWS tussen ons e\-commerceplatform, ERP (NetSuite), WMS en onze eigen tools
* Je automatiseert binnen NetSuite in JavaScript/SuiteScript
* Je zet AI in waar het jou versnelt, jij staat voor de kwaliteit, maar delegeert taken aan een agent waar dat voor jou werkt.
* Je schrijft de spec, verifieert build, tests en diff van wat de AI\-agent bouwt, en staat in voor wat er in de pull request komt
* Je reviewt pull requests van collega’s en agents tegen de spec en onze standaarden
* Je bewaakt performance, stabiliteit en security van koppelingen die wekelijks miljoenen berichten verwerken
* Je vertaalt wensen van key\-users en business owners naar een technisch plan dat je zelf implementeert

**Wat werken bij KATO Group bijzonder maakt**


KATO Group is onze bedrijfsnaam (Knives And Tools Online), Knivesandtools hoe consumenten in heel Europa ons kennen. Sinds 1999 is Knivesandtools dé snoepwinkel voor iedereen die houdt van hoogwaardige gear. Messen, keukengerei, bijlen, zaklampen, multitools, slijpsystemen, houtsnijsets… als het goed gemaakt is en leuk om te gebruiken, hebben we het waarschijnlijk op voorraad..


Achter die winkel zit een complex landschap van best\-of\-breed SaaS, eigen software en veel data. Je werkt in een klein IT\-team en schakelt direct met Business Development, Finance en key\-users uit de operatie. Weinig managementlagen, korte lijnen, en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief: je overlegt met de mensen die de beslissing nemen en met jouw oplossingen werken.

**Wat wij bieden:**

* Een salaris tussen € 4\.200 en € 4\.800 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur
* 32 tot 40 uur per week, met ruimte voor ontwikkeling en een gezonde werk\-privébalans
* Toegang tot frontier modellen en coding frameworks voor agentic development
* 25 vakantiedagen en 8% vakantiegeld
* Reiskostenvergoeding en een goede pensioenregeling
* 20% personeelskorting op ons hele assortiment aan Next Level Gear
* Een platte, informele organisatie met korte lijnen en veel eigen verantwoordelijkheid
* En ja: de beste koffie van Apeldoorn, verse lunches van onze chef Jesse, en een pingpongtafel voor de broodnodige pauze

 **Wat je meebrengt:**

* Ten minste 3 jaar ervaring als back\-end developer
* Sterke kennis van C\#, .NET (8\.0\) en relationele databases
* Ervaring met cloud omgevingen (AWS en/of Azure)
* Ervaring met het reviewen van code van anderen
* Uitstekend Nederlands en Engels in woord en geschrift

**Fijn als je dit ook hebt**

* Ervaring met AWS Lambda, SQS, Terraform of andere IaC\-tools
* Ervaring met agentic of spec\-driven development
* Ervaring met JavaScript en/of SuiteScript (NetSuite)

**Solliciteren**


Stuur je cv met een korte motivatie: van jezelf, niet van AI. Geen lang verhaal nodig: we maken liever kennis in een gesprek op kantoor in Apeldoorn, gevolgd door een vervolggesprek met het team en soms een proefopdracht of meeloopdag. Daarna stemmen we de voorwaarden af en plannen we je onboarding met directie en teams.


Heb je vragen over de rol of het proces, of heb je iets nodig om goed te kunnen solliciteren? Laat het ons weten, dan denken we mee.

jobs.title: AI Native Software Engineering Manager | Assoc Manager
jobs.description:
**We are:**  

A forward\-thinking services company at the forefront of AI\-native innovation. We partner with enterprise clients to create next\-generation, agent\-powered workflows engineered to scale in real\-world settings. Our engineers embed deeply with customers, moving projects beyond experimentation into operational reality.
  
  

**You are:**  

An AI Native Engineer with a minimum of 5 years of experience building cloud\-native solutions, and deep expertise in designing and deploying agentic systems, especially for enterprise environments. You are a critical thinker that thrives in ambiguity, delivering concrete results by designing, building, and running custom AI agents that augment workflows and scale across modern infrastructure. You’ll help shape the playbook for how enterprises adopt and scale AI\-native engineering globally.
  
  

**The Work:**  

You’ll embed directly with clients — acting as both technologist and trusted advisor. You’ll partner with stakeholders to define use cases, rapidly prototype, and deploy agentic workflows that are robust, secure, and operational in complex enterprise domains. Often, these will be completely net new platforms and systems that need to be stitched together in our clients' environments alongside our Ecosystem partners.
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

**Agent Architecture and Engineering:** Design and engineer enterprise\-ready AI agents encompassing retrieval, orchestration, policy\-based routing, tool invocation, evaluation harnesses, and lifecycle observability.
  
  

**AI Platform Integration:** Develop abstraction layers across AI providers (Anthropic, Google, OpenAI, etc. ) to enable seamless integration and enablement.
  
  

**Cloud\-Native Engineering:** Leverage containerization (Kubernetes, Docker), microservices, serverless, event\-driven architectures, CI/CD, and observability to deliver scalable AI\-native systems.
  
  

**Domain\-Specific Workflows:** Tailor and deploy agentic applications across verticals — e.g., finance, healthcare, retail — addressing domain\-specific processes via intelligent automation.
  
  

**Client Engagement:** Conduct design workshops, POCs, and code\-with sessions to shape data\-driven agent workflows with stakeholders, fostering trust and adoption.
  
  

**Measure \& Improve:** Define and use key metrics, test harnesses, and evaluation plans to measure agent accuracy, latency, safety, and cost effectiveness.
  
  

**Knowledge Sharing:** Craft reusable patterns, documentation, and best practices to influence internal assets and client roadmaps.
  
  

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.
  
  

Assess the organization and processes of a company’s software engineering capability to identify productivity and quality gaps and opportunities. Assist in establishing modern engineering operating models and processes. Advise and coach on software engineering best practices and tools to improve time\-to\-market, quality and efficiency. Work with organizations to prototype the applicability of innovative software engineering practices, such as Gen\-AI assisted software development and green software engineering, to create differentiated and innovative solutions. Benchmark and evaluate the outcomes of prototypes, new processes, tools and ways of working.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Nutrient**
==================


At Nutrient, we're revolutionizing how the world works with documents. Our tools transform static files into intelligent, secure workflows, empowering businesses to innovate faster and smarter. Trusted by thousands of organizations across 80 countries, including Fortune 500 companies and public sector leaders, our platform supports nearly a billion end users globally in industries where documents aren't just files, they're mission\-critical.

**Your Role at Nutrient...**
============================


As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) on our Sales team, your work starts with a customer:

* You will find the document problem that is actually costing them money, and build the working solution yourself, on their documents, that works with or within their environment, against a scorecard we agree on before we start.
* Then you will turn what you built into something the next customer can buy ready made. We commit to the specific outcome for the customer, and we then measure how much of each engagement converts into actual product.


Here’s how this role is different:

* If you are a **solutions engineer** today, the difference is that you ship.
* If you are a **professional services engineer** today, the difference is that the work is not billed by the hour against a spec someone else wrote, and success is not a signed\-off SOW but a customer outcome and a reusable capability in the product.
* If you are a **product engineer** today, the difference is that your users are in the room, on the call, and occasionally disagreeing with you.


This is a role for someone who is genuinely comfortable in all three chairs: the discovery conversation where you work out what job the customer is actually trying to get done, the terminal where you build it by Friday, and the seat at the table when the product is being meaningfully developed.

**What You'll Work On...**
==========================

* **Discover the problem before anyone scopes it**. Get into the customer's process deeply enough to state the job to be done in their words. Most engagements start because someone asked for a feature; the work is finding the outcome behind the request.
* **Build the first implementation yourself**. Working software on the customer's own documents and in their own environment if necessary, fast enough that the demo lands while the problem is still urgent. A prototype that shows beats a deck that tells, and a working solution closes the deal.
* **Agree a scorecard upfront and hit it.** Every engagement starts with a written definition of what success looks like and how it will be measured. We commit to that result.
* **Stitch across the whole platform**. Real solutions cut across Nutrient Workflow, Document Engine, our Document Web Services APIs, the Web and native SDKs, AI data extraction, and whatever the customer already runs. Recent engagements have meant SharePoint and Salesforce integrations, AWS Bedrock models, .NET services behind consistent\-hash routing, bulk export pipelines, and database archiving.
* **Productize what you build**. Choose the implementation that makes the next customer easier, not the one that closes fastest. In a recent engagement we deliberately built a cover\-sheet generator on AI Data Extraction rather than a SQL script, and that task is now stronger for every customer. Several deliverables from that engagement are now licensable product components and self\-service features.
* **Close the loop back into the company**. Write up what you learned, file the defects you hit, articulate the pattern so the next engagement starts from it, and hand the template to the next team. Forward deployed work that stays inside one account is just consulting.
* **Support the deal**. You will work alongside account executives and solutions engineers before the contract as well as after it. What you build during the sales cycle is often what decides whether we win.

**What You'll Bring...**
========================


The shortest description of the profile: a strong software engineer who has moved toward product thinking — you care about the problem, not the ticket — and who is unusually good with customers. You live in a world that exists beyond technical requirements and can quickly go into solution mode to deliver a working solution.  

You are likely a good fit if most of the following are true:* You can run a discovery conversation. You ask about the business process before the API, and you can tell the difference between a use case and a job to be done.
* You get real leverage out of coding agents. Our customers expect the first working version in days, not sprints, and that only happens if you direct agents well.
* You have shipped production software for years, and you still build. You are comfortable being the only engineer on a problem and being a part of a team that delivers the solution.
* You are fluent in at least one of JavaScript or TypeScript, .NET/C\#, Java, Python or Go, and you pick up the others without drama.
* You can stand up and reason about infrastructure: containers, Kubernetes, at least one of AWS, Azure or GCP, reverse proxies and load balancing, Postgres, Redis.
* You have worked with LLMs in production, not only in a notebook. Prompt and retrieval design, evaluating extraction quality, cost and latency tuning.
* You write well. Design docs, scorecards, handover notes and customer\-facing summaries are part of the output, not overhead.


It would be nice if you have:* **Document technology background**: PDF internals, OCR, layout\-aware extraction, e\-signature flows, redaction.
* **Domain time in heavily regulated industries**, such as banking KYC, insurance claims, or healthcare and life sciences.
* Experience in a forward deployed, solutions architecture or founding\-engineer role at an **infrastructure or platform company**.
* **Consulting or agency background**, if you left it because you wanted the work to compound.
* **Integration experience** with the systems enterprises actually run, such as SharePoint, Salesforce, Power Automate, or an internal system nobody has documented since 2011\.
* Comfort working with **regulated environments** and the conversations that come with them, such as HIPAA, FedRAMP, FIPS, and government cloud.


Be honest with yourself — this is probably not for you if:* You want a clean backlog and a quiet quarter. Early engagements will be ambiguous and the team's boundaries with Engineering and Professional Services are still being drawn.
* You prefer to hand off after the design. Here you build it.
* You would rather build the perfect bespoke thing than the slightly less perfect thing three more customers can use.

**Also…**
=========

* **Your first 90 days**: By day 30 you will have shadowed two live engagements and shipped one small thing a customer uses. By day 60 you will own an engagement end to end, from discovery through the agreed scorecard. By day 90 at least one thing you built will be on its way into the product as a template or a component, and you will have written up why.
* **How we will measure your impact**: Customer outcomes against the scorecards you agreed, revenue influenced through the engagements you run, and the share of your work that converts into reusable product rather than staying in one account. That last one is the number that keeps Nutrient a software company.
* **Team and location**: You will join the Forward Deployed Engineering team, reporting into Sales, working daily with Engineering and the Account teams. We are hiring in Raleigh, NC and in London. Expect meaningful travel to customer sites, concentrated in bursts around engagement kickoffs.

**Who Thrives Here...**
=======================


At Nutrient, we’re not just hiring for skills — we’re hiring for mindset. The people who thrive here are:

* **Collaborators**: You collaborate openly, listen actively, and prioritize team success over ego.
* **Hungry Learners**: Rapid learning fuels progress and career growth.
* **Curious Thinkers**: You dig deep to uncover the “why,” valuing understanding over simply being right.
* **Self\-Starters**: You take action without waiting for direction, turning obstacles into opportunities with creativity and persistence.
* **Owners**: You take responsibility for solutions and outcomes, always looking for ways to improve what’s within your control.
* **Doers**: You’re energized by progress, motivated to create meaningful impact, and eager to tackle challenges.

**Why You'll Love Working Here...**
===================================


At Nutrient, we build tools that reshape how businesses and developers work with documents. Our culture is centered on continuous growth and collaboration. Every team member has room to learn, innovate, and drive meaningful impact.

* **Real technical ownership:** you're not just managing relationships; you're running technical discovery, building POCs, and being the engineer in the room for your customers.
* **Cross\-functional influence:** your work sits at the intersection of CS, Solutions Architecture, and Support, with a direct line to shape product direction through customer advocacy.
* **Distributed and async\-first:** minimal meetings, strong writing culture, and the independence to manage your own work.
* **Mission\-critical product:** Nutrient's platform is trusted by 15%\+ of the Global 500 across 80\+ countries.
* **Strong growth trajectory:** ARR grown from $28M to $49M over the past two years, backed by Insight Partners.


Nutrient believes in equal opportunity. We employ people from many cultures and countries, celebrate diversity, and are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, skill sets, and perspectives. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, marital status, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other non\-merit factor.

jobs.description:
**Base Location:** Flexible Scotland \| We're proud to offer a Flexible First approach to work, and this role is no exception. We will, however, need your base 'home' location to be one of our SSEN offices or depots around Scotland, Perth, Glasgow, Aberdeen or Inverness


**Salary:** £59,800 \- £89,800 \+ car /car allowance \+ performance\-related bonus \+ a range of benefits to support your finances, wellbeing and family.


**Working Pattern:** Permanent \| Full Time \| Flexible First options available


**The role**



As a Principal Engineer, you’ll provide technical leadership across multiple projects or portfolios, setting direction for HVDC Systems including converters and control \& protection equipment, standards and long\-term engineering decisions. The role is broader in scope and influence, with accountability for technical governance, risk and consistency, while also shaping supplier strategy, driving innovation, representing the business externally and building capability across the wider engineering community.



We’d also welcome applications from candidates who feel they may not meet all may not yet meet every requirement of the Principal Engineer position and would be happy to be considered for a Senior Engineer position.

  


**You will**


* Write, review existing, maintain, and own technical specifications and guidance notes required for all for all HVDC Converter and Control \& Protection Equipment (i.e. HVDC systems, Converters, Valves, C\&P MACH \& DCSS) used on the Transmission network – Responsible for integrating with existing SSEN specifications for HVDC.
* Provide technical guidance and advice to the transmission business for HVDC network development, refurbishment, or fault investigations of failed plant.
* Participate and lead in supplier engagement and innovation projects for evaluation of new technologies for use in HVDC applications
* As part of the HVDC Technical Authority, review test plans and witness tests to ensure that HVDC technology and equipment selected is adequately tested, proven, validated, and review proposed suppliers to confirm their suitability to be approved for use on the transmission network.
* Provide Subject Matter Expert input to design reviews carried out by the Design Authority, provide specialist input where required and verify project proposals are fit for purpose and identify any scope changes required.


**You have**


* A degree in Electrical Engineering or another relevant engineering discipline and Chartered Engineer status with a relevant institution or working towards chartered status.
* Demonstrable experience on an expert level in the design, specification, construction, control \& operation, and maintenance of HVDC Systems. Specifically, experience in the application and integration of HVDC in various environments.
* The ability and experience to technically assess issues and/or problems and critically assess a range of technical solutions and an in depth understanding of the technical requirements for development, design, planning, control, integration, and operation of HVDC Systems.
* Significant understanding of the interfaces between AC Network design and integration of HVDC Systems.
* A detailed knowledge and understanding of a range of National Grid, British and European Standards, UK grid code and SQSS alongside the capability and experience in writing technical specifications, guidance notes and work instructions for all HVDC aspects.


**About SSE**



SSE’s purpose is to provide energy needed today while building a better world of energy for tomorrow. We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. Our Transforming for Growth investment plan sees us investing £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure across the five years to 2030\.



SSEN Transmission own and operate the electricity transmission network across the north of Scotland. We transport energy from where it is generated to where it is needed, ensuring a safe and reliable electricity supply for the communities we serve. But that's not all – we're upgrading the grid to deliver cleaner, homegrown energy for the future and building a network for net zero to create secure power for generations to come.

As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.

SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. please contact Andy on andrew.torrance@sse.com / 01738 275370 to discuss how we can support you.



We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry.


**Ready to apply?**



Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. jobs.title: Associate Director, Process & Platform
jobs.description:
At M\&G, our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.
  

  

Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long\-term investment and savings solutions.  

  

Through telling it like it is, owning it now and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.  

  

We will consider flexible working arrangements for any of our roles and offer workplace adjustments to ensure you have the support you need to succeed in your role.

 **Associate Director, Process \& Platform**

  

Corporate Pension Solutions (CPS) is a division within M\&G Life with a remit to design and deliver bulk purchase annuities and alternative de\-risking products for Defined Benefit pension schemes. Due to ongoing success, a strong opportunity set, and ambitious growth plans, the team is adding headcount in a number of areas.

  

We’re looking for an exceptional individual to enable M\&G’s Digital Strategy, using technological and actuarial expertise to develop areas within the pricing platform and end\-to\-end new business processes as CPS accelerates its growth plans.

  

The Associate Director, Process \& Platform leads the development of pricing systems, models and business processes that underpin Corporate Pension Solutions' growth strategy. The role brings together actuarial, technology and process expertise to improve operational efficiency, enhance platform capabilities and deliver scalable solutions for new business pricing.

 **Key Responsibilities for this role:**

  

* Support for and ownership of some tools, systems and model infrastructure across pricing and associated workstreams, such as liability cashflow engine, capital projection model, integrated data management, asset portfolio construction and/or financial reporting reconciliation
* Support the design and enable the build and delivery of short, medium and long term strategy for responsible models in partnership with stakeholders across Life, Finance and Technology teams
* Support tools and systems outsourcing arrangements where required
* Identify and deliver day\-to\-day process automation solutions across the CPS business
* Build a close partnership with broader CPS Pricing team and the wider business to deliver process enhancement, build technical capability, and drive continuous improvement for areas of responsibility

 **Key Knowledge, Skills \& Experience:**

  

* Demonstrable track record of development of DB pricing or Solvency II and related actuarial models, tools and processes
* Excellent software development skills (C\# strongly preferred; Python \& VBA experience valuable)
* Qualified Actuary or actuarial skillset required
* Strong knowledge of at least one area of DB benefits, IFRS 17 and Solvency UK for life insurance (in particular balance sheet construction). Asset strategy \& ALM valuable
* Ambitious and self\-motivated with ability to work on own initiative/prioritise workload to strict deadlines
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to bridge the gap between actuarial and IT

 **Location:** London or Edinburgh

**Work Level:** Manager / Expert

**Recruiter:** Amy Curtis

**What we offer:**

  

We’re dedicated to supporting your wellbeing and helping you thrive, both at work and beyond. Our benefits are designed to help you balance your professional and personal life**,** and financially plan for the future. **Our UK benefits include**:

  

* A valuable **pension scheme of up to 18%** (13% made up of employer contributions and 5% employee contributions).
* Access to our **Share Save** and **Share Incentive Plan,** alongside financial wellbeing and support services to help **give you real confidence to put your money to work.**
* Enjoy 38 days annual leave (including bank holidays), with the opportunity to purchase up to five extra days. Our **Time Off When You Need It** policy gives you the flexibility \- to balance work and personal commitments.
* Our market\-leading **Inspiring Families** policy includes comprehensive support and paid parental leave covering maternity, adoption, surrogacy, and paternity leave \- because supporting families is an important part of our inclusive culture.
* Health \& Protection cover includes **Private Healthcare, Critical Illness cover** and **Life Assurance** for you, with additional family options \- for peace of mind.

  

To explore more about life at M\&G and our full benefits offering, visit **Life at M\&G**

  

At M\&G we strive to have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture, underpinned by our policies and employee\-led networks that offer networking, support and development opportunities for the diverse communities our colleagues represent. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds – across gender, ethnicity, age, disability, sexual orientation and more – including neurodivergent individuals, career returners and those with military service experience.

  

M\&G is proud to be **Level 3:** **Disability Confident Leader**under the UK Government Disability Confident employer scheme, and we welcome applications from candidates with disabilities and long\-term health conditions. If you would like to participate in the initiative, you will have the opportunity to indicate this on your application.

  

We are committed to providing an inclusive recruitment process. All candidates have the opportunity to request reasonable adjustments when applying. If you need any additional support at any stage, please contact us at: careers@mandg.com

jobs.title: ML/AI Engineer
jobs.description:
### **Twoja rola:**


* Współpraca z klientami: Przeprowadzanie analizy potrzeb klientów oraz identyfikacja możliwości zastosowania sztucznej inteligencji i uczenia maszynowego w danym obszarze biznesowym.
* Projektowanie rozwiązań: Opracowywanie i proponowanie innowacyjnych rozwiązań w oparciu o technologie Microsoft, które spełniają konkretne wymagania i cele biznesowe klientów.
* Projekty: Uczestnictwo w projektach wdrożeniowych z zakresu wdrożenia nowoczesnych aplikacji napędzanych przez sztuczną inteligencje (Chatbot, inteligentne wyszukiwarki, automatyzacja przetwarzania dokumentów z wykorzystaniem NLP itp.) a także w projektach związanych z zaawansowaną analityką wykorzysującą metody Machine Learning (prognoza, segmentacja, detekcja anomalii itp.)
* Badania i rozwój: Śledzenie najnowszych trendów, technologii i narzędzi w dziedzinie sztucznej inteligencji i uczenia maszynowego, oraz wnioskowanie o ich potencjalnym zastosowaniu w projektach. Przygotowanie aplikacji demo w ramach wewnętrznego R\&D.

### **Czego oczekujemy?**


* Doświadczenie w projektach związanych z implementacją rozwiązań uczenia maszynowego, obejmujące budowę, trenowanie, optymalizację, wdrażanie, monitorowanie oraz utrzymanie modeli ML w środowisku produkcyjnym.
* Praktyczne doświadczenie w tworzeniu, trenowaniu i wdrażaniu modeli ML, w tym ich integracji z systemami produkcyjnymi oraz utrzymaniem w chmurze w usługach Azure Machine Learning oraz Fabric. Znajomość Databrics oraz Synapse będzie dodatkowym atutem.
* Znajomość zasad MLOps, obejmująca w szczególności automatyzację pipeline’ów ML, wersjonowanie modeli i danych, monitorowanie ich jakości oraz zarządzanie pełnym cyklem życia modeli.
* Doświadczenie w walidacji modeli ML oraz ich wersjonowaniu w środowisku produkcyjnym, z uwzględnieniem monitoringu, testów regresyjnych i kontroli dryfu.
* Znajomość narzędzi do zarządzania eksperymentami ML, takich jak MLflow, Azure ML, oraz praktyczne doświadczenie w walidacji, porównywaniu i fine‑tuningu modeli.
* Znajomość języków programowania – wymagane: Python; mile widziane: SQL, C\#.
* Umiejętność efektywnej komunikacji i pracy z klientami, w tym tłumaczenia złożonych zagadnień technicznych na język zrozumiały dla odbiorców nietechnicznych.
* Znajomość koncepcji i doświadczenie z technikami generatywnej AI, takimi jak prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, bazy wektorowe oraz podstawy fine‑tuningu LLM‑ów.
* Doświadczenie w pracy z dużymi modelami językowymi (LLM)
* Znajomość MAF (Microsoft AI Framework) , LangChain, LangGraph jako narzędzi wspierającegych budowę aplikacji wykorzystujących modele językowe i usługi Azure AI.
* Znajomość narzędzi i platform Microsoft związanych z AI, takich jak Azure Document Intelligence, Azure AI Search, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Services.

### **Co oferujemy?**


* Swobodę w działaniu oraz decyzyjność
* Kulturę organizacyjną opartą na odpowiedzialności, zaufaniu i realizacji założonych celów
* Elastyczne godziny pracy, możliwość częściowej pracy zdalnej
* Szkolenia i certyfikacje Microsoft
* Opiekę medyczną, Kartę Multisport, Ubezpieczenie na Życie, naukę języka angielskiego

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior Software Engineer
Overview  

  

We are the global technology company behind the world’s fastest payments processing network. We are a vehicle for commerce, a connection to financial systems for the previously excluded, a technology innovation lab, and the home of Priceless®. We ensure every employee has the opportunity to be a part of something bigger and to change lives. We believe as our company grows, so should you. We believe in connecting everyone to endless, priceless possibilities.  

  

Our team within Mastercard – Services within Mastercard:  

  

The Data \& Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing the cutting\-edge services that are used by some of the world's largest organizations to make multi\-million dollar decisions and grow their businesses. Focused on thinking big and scaling fast around the globe, this agile team is responsible for end\-to\-end solutions for a diverse global customer base. Centered on data\-driven technologies and innovation, these services include payments\-focused consulting, loyalty and marketing programs, business Test \& Learn experimentation, and data\-driven information and risk management services.  

  

Advance Analytics Program:  

  

Within the D\&S Technology Team, the Advance Analytics program is a program that is comprised of a rich set of products that provide accurate perspectives on Credit Risk, Portfolio Optimization, and Ad Insights. Currently, we are enhancing our customer experience with new user interfaces, moving to API\-based data publishing to allow for seamless integration in other Mastercard products and externally, utilizing new data sets and algorithms to further analytic capabilities, and generating scalable big data processes.  

We are looking for an innovative software engineering manager who will lead the team responsible for the design and build of a full stack web application and data pipelines, and thrive in a fast\-paced, agile environment. This individual will partner closely with other areas of the business to build and enhance solutions that drive value for our customers.  

Engineers work in small, flexible teams. Every team member contributes to designing, building, and testing features. The range of work you will encounter varies from building intuitive, responsive UIs to designing backend data models, architecting data flows, and beyond. There are no rigid organizational structures, and each team uses processes that work best for its members and projects.  

  

Here are a few examples of products in our space:  

  

* Portfolio Optimizer (PO) is a solution that leverages Mastercard’s data assets and analytics to allow issuers to identify and increase revenue opportunities within their credit and debit portfolios.

  

* Audiences uses anonymized and aggregated transaction insights to offer targeting segments that have high likelihood to make purchases within a category to allow for more effective campaign planning and activation.

  

* Credit Risk products are a new suite of APIs and tooling to provide lenders real\-time access to KPIs and insights serving thousands of clients to make smarter risk decisions using Mastercard data.

  

Role  

  

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will:  

  

* Participate in scoping, design and implementation of complex features.
* Delivery First time right scalable solution to push the boundaries of analytics applications.
* Design and implement intuitive, responsive UIs that allow issuers/acquirer's/fintech's to better understand data and analytics.
* Build and maintain analytics and data models to enable performant and scalable products.
* Ensure a high\-quality code base by writing and reviewing performant, well\-tested code.
* Mentor junior software engineers and teammates.
* Drive innovative improvements to team development processes.
* Partner with Product Managers and Customer Experience Designers to develop a deep understanding of users and use cases and apply that knowledge to scoping and building new modules and features.
* Collaborate across teams with exceptional peers who are passionate about what they do.

  

All about you / Ideal Candidate Qualifications  

  

* 8\+ years of full stack engineering experience in an agile production environment.
* Experience in design and implementation of complex features in full\-stack applications.


\- Experience working with cross regional Product \- Tech Team's.  

* Strong technologist eager to learn new technologies and frameworks.
* Proficiency with Java , Spring Boot , JPA , React, Redux, Typescript,
* Good to have .NET/C\# and Python.
* Solid experience with RESTful APIs and JSON/SOAP based API.
* Experience with SQL, Multi\-threading, Message Queuing \& Distributed Systems.
* Experience with Design Patterns.
* Expertise in Nunit/Junit or other automated unit testing frameworks.


Knowledge of Splunk or other alerting and monitoring solutions.  

* Fluent in the use of Git, Jenkins.
* Knowledge of cloud native development such as cloud foundry, AWS, etc.
* Customer\-centric development approach.
* Passion for analytical / quantitative problem solving.
* Ability to identify and implement improvements to team development processes.
* Strong collaboration skills with experience collaborating across many people, roles, and geographies.
* Motivation, creativity, self\-direction, and desire to thrive on small project teams.
* Superior academic record with a degree in Computer Science or related technical field.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Make a difference with Laerdal where immersive technology transforms healthcare quality and education across the globe. With over 2,200 colleagues, join a team where collaboration and engagement are prioritized in helping save one million more lives, every year, by 2030\.

**About the role**


In the Digital Customer Platforms team at Laerdal, we shape how customers around the world discover, buy, and use products and services that help save lives. Through our global e‑commerce platform on laerdal.com, we deliver scalable, secure, and increasingly AI‑supported digital solutions across more than 25 markets.


As Engineering Manager, based in Stavanger, you will lead a great team of software engineers working on business‑critical platforms with real societal impact. You’ll balance people leadership with technical insight, creating an environment where collaboration, learning, and long‑term product sustainability come first. Your role is to help teams succeed—today and over time—while continuously improving how we build and evolve our digital solutions.


Our technology landscape is modern and evolving, with C\#/.NET on Azure at the core and React and Vue.js on the frontend. Experience with our stack is valuable, but we especially welcome leaders with strong fundamentals in cloud technologies, APIs, and product‑focused software development, who are curious about how AI can be applied responsibly and meaningfully.

**Some of what you will be doing**

* Lead and support a team of engineers by setting clear direction, building trust, and encouraging growth
* Shape technical choices with an eye on quality, sustainability, security, and long‑term platform health
* Partner closely with Product and Design to turn ideas into well‑prioritized, valuable customer solutions
* Strengthen ways of working across the team—from planning and delivery to testing and continuous improvement
* Promote good engineering practices and thoughtful use of emerging technologies, including AI
* Help create a positive, inclusive team culture where diverse perspectives are valued

**Who we think will thrive here**


You are a leader who enjoys enabling others and believes strong teams build the best products. You bring technical credibility, curiosity, and empathy to your work, and you’re motivated by creating durable solutions rather than quick fixes. Whether you already lead teams or are ready to take the next step into engineering leadership, you care deeply about collaboration, quality, and impact.  

Experience that will support your success includes:

* A solid background in software development and modern engineering practices and relevant higher education
* Experience leading, mentoring, or guiding engineers in a product‑focused environment
* Comfort working with cloud‑based systems; Azure experience is a plus
* Experience from agile, empowered, cross‑functional teams
* A leadership style that communicates clearly, listens actively, and builds engagement
* Takes initiatives and move ideas into action
* Approaches challenges with structured problem solving and critical thinking. .


We know strong leaders don’t all look the same—if this role speaks to you, we’d love to hear from you.

**What we offer**


At Laerdal, you will get the opportunity to learn, develop, and innovate and you will be a part of an international working environment where the possibility to make an impact is endless.

* An interesting, impactful and important job contributing to our mission
* Great opportunities for growth and personal development
* A multicultural office environment and collaboration with colleagues located around the world
* A creative, diverse, and inclusive organization
* A job in a company driving forward\-thinking technology

jobs.title: Software Engineer in Asset Management (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Das Asset Management der Zürcher Kantonalbank ist der zweitgrösste Anbieter in der Schweiz mit über CHF 364 Milliarden Assets\-under\-Management (per 31\.08\.2026\) und rund 280\+ Anlageexpertinnen und Anlageexperten. Gemeinsam mit Deinen Kollegen übernimmst Du die Verantwortung für die Entwicklung und die operative Wartung der Core Plattform Services und sorgst für einen effizienten und stabilen Betrieb. Ausserdem leistest Du Support für das Incident Management und setzt Change Requests prozesskonform um.
Deine Aufgaben
* Entwicklung und Pflege von qualitativ hochwertigen Softwarelösungen im Kontext des Asset Managements.
* Effektive Nutzung von Git für Versionskontrolle und kollaborative Entwicklung.
* Zusammenarbeit mit einem Team von Entwicklern zur Verbesserung der Systemeffizienz und Funktionalität.
* Verstehen und Implementieren von regulatorischen Anforderungen und Standards der Finanzindustrie in Softwarelösungen.
* Beiträge zum Design und zur Implementierung der Portfolio Management Plattform im Asset Management.

Dein Profil
* Universitätsabschluss in Quantitative Finance, Informatik, Physik, Statistik, Mathematik oder ähnlichem
* Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung im Bereich Finanzdienstleistungen, Risiko und Compliance sind von Vorteil
* Kenntnisse in Python, C\# und gutes Verständnis von relationalen Datenbanken und Abfragen (SQL)
* Beherrschung von DevOps und Betriebstechnologien \- Python, Kafka, ETL, JSON, XML, GIT, AzureDevOps
* Angemessene Linux\-Kenntnisse, Kenntnisse in Shell\-Skripting
* Kenntnisse über Finanzprodukte und nicht\-finanzielle Risiken in der Vermögensverwaltung sind ein Plus
* Erste Berührungspunkte mit Risk oder Portfoliooptimierung von Vorteil
* Selbstorganisation, neugierige Denkweise und ein gutes Auge für Details
* Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

Unser Angebot
* Ein exzellentes Team aus IT Spezialisten und Business Engineers welche die Asset Management Plattform der ZKB vorantreiben und die Herausforderungen der Zukunft gemeinsam meistern.
* Wir sind einer der wenigen Asset Manager, welche das Schicksal selber in die Hand nehmen und unsere eigene Plattform bauen und betreiben. Wir bieten viel Raum für Innovation.
* Abwechslungsreiche Arbeiten mit einem breiten Themenfeld in Daten Bewirtschaftung, Risiko Management, Portfolio Analyse und vieles mehr.
* Eine innovative und integrative Arbeitsumgebung
* Unterstützung seitens Arbeitgeberin mit attraktiven Weiterbildungsangeboten und die Möglichkeit, dir deine Arbeit flexibel zu organisieren.
* Ein attraktives Gesamtpaket u.a. mit interessanten Nebenleistungen und Mitarbeitervergünstigungen (Sport, Freizeit, Kinderbetreuung, Krankenkasse).
* Eine Arbeitgeberin, die sich um ihre Mitarbeitenden kümmert und in sie investiert. Zudem hast du Zugang zu diversen Netzwerken und Mentoring Programmen in\- und ausserhalb der Bank (bspw. bankinternes Talentförderprogramm, Fondsfrauen\-Mitgliedschaft, Mitarbeiternetzwerke, etc.)

By advancing cutting-edge technologies and solutions, they continue to shape the future of eye health worldwide.

About The Project

As part of their ongoing innovation, our client is enhancing their medical devices with advanced connectivity features and cloud-based services. Since adoption of next-generation solutions is gradual, the project must ensure smooth integration between legacy and modern systems in real-world environments.

The mission is to design and deliver a comprehensive set of tools, services, and libraries that enable seamless interoperability of existing devices with both cloud and on-premises infrastructures. The focus is on ensuring data integrity, security, and interoperability across all systems.

Project Status

The project has successfully completed its high-level requirements definition and initial technical planning. The next stage involves detailed design, implementation, and verification & validation activities. To achieve this, our client is now scaling up the software engineering team and seeking skilled professionals to join this critical phase of development.

Requirements

Exploratory Test Engineer combines two complementary responsibilities in a split role (Scrum Master 20‑40%, Exploratory Device Testing 60‑80%). As Scrum Master, the role serves primarily the RTD FrontEnd development team and may expand to cover the VideoUnit team (approx. 20% SM capacity per team). As Exploratory Test Engineer, the role performs hands-on testing directly on the NextGenRS Refractive Treatment Device hardware in a regulated medical device environment.

The RTD FrontEnd is a Windows x86-64 embedded system hosting multiple applications (FESupervisorApp, FEUserApp, FELogTransport, FemtoScan Service) that drive the full clinical workflow from patient selection through treatment execution. The VideoUnit is a Xilinx Zynq Ultrascale Linux system responsible for real-time image processing, eye tracking (SmartCam interface), and the Ophthalmic Digital Microscope. Both systems are safety-classified software under IEC 62304 and require rigorous test coverage. The Scrum Master is a key role responsible for enabling team effectiveness and high-quality delivery in a safety-critical, highly regulated environment.

Core Qualifications Include:

3+ years of experience in exploratory or hands-on functional software testing, ideally on real embedded hardware or medical devices.
Familiarity with Session-Based Test Management (SBTM) or comparable structured exploratory testing approaches.
Practical experience with Azure DevOps (backlog management, sprint boards, defect tracking, build/release pipelines).
Solid understanding of Windows desktop application testing (UI workflows, configuration, error handling).
Ability to read and interpret C++ application architecture and system integration diagrams for test planning purposes.
Experience working in Agile teams using feature-driven development, time-boxing, and artifact management.
Interpersonal skills with a proven ability to achieve constructive solutions in cross-departmental topics, as well as in organizing and motivating team members.
Fluent English; intermediate-level German. Onsite, Erlangen, no home office

Job responsibilities

Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies for the FrontEnd team (sprint planning, daily stand-up, sprint review, retrospective) and optionally a second team (VideoUnit).
Coach team members on Agile/Scrum principles, continuous improvement, and self-organization; act as a servant leader and team advocate.
Identify and actively remove impediments; manage cross-team dependencies and escalate blockers to management as needed.
Maintain team health metrics (velocity, sprint burndown, defect aging) and communicate progress transparently to stakeholders.
Collaborate closely with the Product Owner on backlog refinement, sprint goal clarity, and Definition of Done alignment.
Support adoption of AI-assisted development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and Azure DevOps tooling within the team.
Facilitate continuous process improvement using retrospective data; drive Agile maturity across one or two Scrum teams.
Plan, design, and execute exploratory test sessions on the NextGenRS Refractive Treatment Device (hardware-in-the-loop), focusing on clinical user workflows of the FrontEnd application.
Apply Session-Based Test Management (SBTM) and exploratory test charters; document findings with clear reproducibility steps and severity classification.
Collaborate with software engineers and verification engineers to triage defects; create and track issues in Azure DevOps.
Contribute to test strategy and risk-based coverage decisions alongside the Quality and Architecture team.
Produce lightweight test artifacts required under IEC 62304 (test session reports, defect records, anomaly reports) in coordination with the Quality team.
Validate integration of FrontEnd with BackEnd, VideoUnit, and Refractive Server Device (RSD) at the system level during sprint deliveries.

.

Dlaczego warto?

Ta rola to wyjątkowa szansa, by połączyć pasję do programowania z praktycznym wpływem na przemysł

Nasza firma specjalizuje się w integracji technologii IT z produkcją przemysłową, koncentrując się głównie na branży spożywczej i chemicznej. posiadasz ponad 3-letnie doświadczenie jako inżynier produkcji cyfrowej, szczególnie z produktami AVEVA (Wonderware) (IDE, MES (Performance Operations, Quality), Batch, WEI, itp.),

jobs.title: Test Engineer for SmartLink IoT Platform
jobs.description:
Your role

Connectivity is KEY! And within Atlas Copco, it has become one of the fastest-growing strategic domains. A decade of investment has given us an industry-leading fleet of more than 300,000 connected machines and 100,000 users, whose data powers SMARTLINK and drives our sales, service and operational processes worldwide. Behind it sits our IoT platform: the cloud-agnostic, event-driven backbone that ingests device telemetry, holds the model of every connected asset, and serves the portal, the mobile apps and a growing number of internal consumers. We are expanding our platform team with a Test Engineer who owns the quality of that backbone.

You are the quality owner of the platform itself, not of the screens in front of it. Your working level is services, APIs, messages and data: does a domain service behave as its contract promises, does a telemetry value survive ingestion, aggregation and retrieval unchanged, and does any of it still hold at the scale of a global fleet. You work in an agile team of developers, architects and product owners, following and sharpening our platform testing standard
so that quality is a property of how we build, not a phase at the end. The total platform team is 14 people.

Test automation here is real engineering. Our suites are written in C# on .NET
by the same standards as the product code: xUnit, Testcontainers
to spin up Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis and ClickHouse per run, .NET Aspire
to bring up the distributed application, and a shared helper library published as a NuGet package so every service team tests against the same building blocks. Suites run in Azure DevOps
pipelines per component and per environment, reporting into Xray
.

Your first months land in the middle of a platform generation change, with two generations running side by side while we migrate. It is a demanding start and the fastest way to learn the platform inside out, but it is not the whole job: the migration will finish, the platform will keep growing, and so will your scope.

In This Role, You Will

Test the platform where it lives: contract, schema and integration testing of domain services and APIs, message and event flows, and the persistence behind them.
Validate the data, not just the code: event streams, time-series and aggregated telemetry, from the message a device sends to the value the platform serves to its consumers.
Extend the shared test framework the other service teams build on, and keep those suites running as quality gates in CI/CD rather than by hand.
Solve testability as a design problem. Where a service cannot be validated on its own, work out what is needed (governed test data, stubs, simulators, contract tests, observability) and get it into the backlog before the feature is built, instead of testing on production machines.

Cover performance and load at fleet scale, through harnesses that drive the real processing pipeline rather than a simplified copy of it.
Prove migrations and domain transitions: dual-source comparison between old and new, backward compatibility per domain, and confidence at cutover.
Shape quality upstream and after the fact: turn requirements into test cases during refinement, challenge anything that cannot be verified, and triage defects across service boundaries.
Leverage AI in your daily work, and help the team keep raising the bar on how we use it.

Solid grounding in testing methodology, QA practice and defect analysis: functional, regression and risk-based testing.

37\.5 hrs per week, Full Time, Hybrid (minimum 1 day per week in Leamington office)

**About Bravissimo**


Part of Wacoal Europe Group, Bravissimo is an award\-winning, multi\-channel lingerie retailer on a mission to uplift women. Since 1995, our purpose has stayed the same: to inspire our customers to feel supported, celebrated, and confident every day.


We have 26 shops in the UK alongside a thriving ecommerce community, which offers a wide range of beautiful lingerie, swimwear and nightwear for women who wear a D to L cup, giving them so much choice.


We are on an exciting journey of growth and are loving every minute of it!

**Bravissimo Benefits**

* Up to 25 days holiday

**About the role**


We're looking for a mid\-level Software Engineer to join our Back of House engineering team and help build, support and evolve a range of business\-critical applications. Working across a range of Bravissimo applications, you'll develop APIs, backend services and event\-driven solutions that support key business areas including product management, customer acquisition, ordering and fulfilment.


Bravissimo is in the middle of a major digital transformation programme, with plans to transition our legacy .NET estate to new service\-based architectures. We're evolving towards a full\-stack engineering environment, with TypeScript, Node.js, React and AWS at the heart of our modern applications and services.


You'll contribute to modern cloud\-based solutions while also supporting established business\-critical applications as part of our ongoing technology modernisation programme.


This is a hands\-on development role for someone who enjoys writing quality software, problem solving and continually developing their technical skills. It requires a blend of backend and frontend skills, but with a heavy focus on the backend. You'll work collaboratively to shape technical solutions and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities:**

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer - Pensions and Spend
jobs.description:
**Senior Product Engineer \- Investments**

**About Kota**


Kota is reimagining insurance and retirement benefits for the modern workforce. Through our two flagship products \- Kota Platform, the first fully integrated benefits platform, and Kota Embed, our embedded insurance solution \- we're making benefits more accessible, valued, and global.


Today, we power benefits for tens of thousands of employees at Europe's most forward\-thinking companies, including Carwow, Tines, Zoe, and Remote. Founded in 2022, we've raised more than €20M from leading investors such as EQT Ventures, Eurazeo, Northzone, and Frontline, as well as founders and executives from Workday, Remote, Personio, OpenAI, and more.

 **The role \& team**


We're looking for a Senior Product Engineer to join the Investments team, building the product that powers workplace pensions, retirement savings and our spend product at Kota. It's a full stack role with a backend lean, your strongest expertise will be backend and you'll work in the frontend when the product needs it.


The Investments team owns more than pensions. On one side, pension infrastructure is genuinely complex: multi\-provider, multi\-market and largely unmodernised. You'll design the systems that connect pension providers to employers and employees, covering contributions, fund data, payroll integrations and compliance across multiple markets.


On the other hand, you'll own our Spend product. This lets employers create allowances and issue cards to employees, who get a virtual Stripe card they can add to Apple or Google Wallet and spend in real time. It spans card issuing, wallet provisioning, transaction flows and the controls employers need to manage it. We want someone who starts with the customer, not the code, and proactively adds to the roadmap rather than just picking up tickets. This is an autonomous role, you'll be trusted to make product calls, not just technical ones.

 **What you'll do**

* Design and build the systems that power Kota's Investments products; pensions, retirement savings and Spend: contributions, onboarding, provider integrations, employer\-facing configuration, card issuing and wallet provisioning
* Own technical architecture for the Investments stream, integrating with external pension and savings providers as well as payment and card infrastructure (Stripe)
* Contribute to frontend code (React \+ TypeScript) when a feature calls for it
* Join client calls where it helps you understand or explain a problem, and proactively shape the roadmap rather than just picking up tickets
* Use AI actively in your day\-to\-day work, for building, reviewing and speeding up how you ship
* Contribute to code reviews and technical planning, and keep the systems you own stable and observable
* Help shape how the Investments team works as it grows

 **What we're looking for**

* 6\+ years building backend systems in production (.NET 10, PostgreSQL, Azure/AWS), comfortable picking up frontend (React/TypeScript) when needed
* Experience designing and maintaining integrations with third\-party APIs
* Strong understanding of data modelling, event\-driven patterns, and building for correctness and auditability
* A clear communicator who can talk to engineers and customers, and knows which version to use with which audience
* A product mindset and a bias to bring ideas, not just execute them, proactively adding to the roadmap
* You take real ownership, if a request from a client or lead doesn't match your own understanding of the problem, you say so rather than building to spec anyway
* You think carefully about reliability, security and compliance, and are comfortable with ambiguity and ownership in a fast\-growing startup
* AI\-forward mindset, we use AI daily to build and improve our systems and expect you to as well

 **Why join us?**

* **Technically interesting problem** \- pension infrastructure is genuinely complex: multi\-provider, multi\-market and largely unmodernised
* **Modern stack** \- .NET 10, PostgreSQL, React, TypeScript, Next.js, Azure/AWS, event\-driven
* **Agency** \- we hire people and trust them. You'll own meaningful parts of the system end to end
* **Customer proximity** \- you'll see the impact of what you build, and hear directly from the people using it
* **High\-quality culture** \- we care about clean design and thoughtful engineering
* **Impact from day one** \- we're a small, focused team. What you build ships fast and matters
* **AI\-first** \- we invest heavily in AI tooling and token usage. We're not precious about the spend, if it helps you build better or faster, use it

 **Our hiring process**

* **Introductory call (30 mins):** a casual chat with one or two of our product team
* **Technical interview (90 mins):** a collaborative, open\-book session with two engineers, working through a real\-world problem together
* **Call with founders (30 mins):** we'll share our vision and hear your thoughts
* **Final response:** we'll follow up promptly with next steps

 **Kota benefits**

* Health insurance via Kota
* Workplace pension with matched contributions up to 5% via Kota
* WFH stipend to support your home office setup
* Generous paid time off, work hard and take the time you need
* Access to office space in Dublin or a co\-working space, wherever you're based
* Flexible working hours, we're remote\-first with some fixed hours for team alignment


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer (Linux/Kubernetes) (m/k/n)
jobs.description:

Specjalizujemy się w budowie, rozwoju i utrzymaniu systemów i aplikacji, oraz doradztwie IT. Wierzymy, że najlepsze rozwiązania powstają wtedy, gdy jest przestrzeń na eksperymentowanie \- dlatego mamy własne R\&D Center na czele z NexioBot naszym mobilnym robotem asystującym, wykorzystującym sztuczną inteligencję do komunikacji.
