**Opis stanowiska**
-------------------


Poszukujemy Platform Engineera, który dołączy do zespołu budującego i rozwijającego nowoczesną, wysoce dostępną platformę infrastrukturalną on\-premises pod aplikacje biznesowe .NET. Szukamy inżyniera, który chce współtworzyć architekturę platformy od podstaw, wdrażać podejście GitOps i pracować z technologiami cloud\-native w środowisku on\-prem.


**Twój zakres obowiązków**
--------------------------


* Projektowanie, wdrażanie oraz utrzymanie klastrów Kubernetes (środowiska oparte o Talos Linux i wirtualizację Proxmox VE).
* Implementacja i rozwój podejścia GitOps (FluxCD lub ArgoCD) oraz standaryzacja wdrożeń przy użyciu Helm.
* Projektowanie warstwy sieciowej, a także wdrażanie rozwiązań storage.
* Utrzymanie i rozwój platformy monitoringu opartej o OpenTelemetry oraz SigNoz.
* Automatyzacja procesów administracyjnych, monitorowanie wydajności i niezawodności platformy oraz diagnostyka problemów produkcyjnych.
* Bliski kontakt z zespołami deweloperskimi .NET, tworzenie standardów operacyjnych i dokumentacji technicznej.
  
**Nasze wymagania**
-------------------


* Min. 4 lata udokumentowanego doświadczenia w administracji systemami Linux.
* Praktyczne doświadczenie z Kubernetes w środowiskach produkcyjnych oraz bardzo dobra znajomość jego architektury.
* Doświadczenie w projektowaniu i utrzymaniu środowisk wysokiej dostępności (HA).
* Bardzo dobra znajomość Helm oraz pracy z repozytoriami Git.
* Praktyczne umiejętności automatyzacji zadań administracyjnych.
* Praktyczna wiedza sieciowa: TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS/SSL, Reverse Proxy, Load Balancing.
* Umiejętność analitycznego diagnozowania problemów wydajnościowych i usuwania awarii produkcyjnych.
* Komunikatywna znajomość języka angielskiego (poziom mi. B2\)

**Mile widziane**:


* Praktyka z Talos Linux oraz Proxmox VE.
* Praca z Terraform / OpenTofu lub Ansible.
* Doświadczenie ze środowiskami on\-premises o dużej skali.
* Certyfikaty inżynierskie: CKA, CKAD lub CKS.
**To oferujemy**
----------------


* Stabilność zatrudnienia \- długofalowe projekty, współpraca z wiodącymi firmami, możliwość rozwoju w różnych obszarach branży IT.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Data Ingestion Platform)
jobs.description:
**Who we are**


4C Strategies builds organisational readiness and military training management software for clients in over 70 countries. Our flagship product, Exonaut, is used by NATO and allied forces to plan, run and evaluate exercises in real time. Our consultants and engineers work alongside armed forces across the UK, Europe, North America and beyond to deliver training and exercise management solutions.

**What we're building**


We're building the data ingestion platform behind large\-scale training exercises: a service that takes traffic from simulation federations, unmanned\-system sensor networks and real\-world sensor feeds, and turns it into one coherent stream that subscribing systems can act on. The bet is that these streams should be interpreted and mapped to an internal Ontology rather than re\-interpreted by every product that needs it. So the hard part is as much modelling as engineering — deciding what those bytes actually mean, and then holding that meaning stable as the number of sources and consumers grows. The platform is greenfield, and you'll have real influence over its shape.

**How we build**


Modern Java. The principles are conservative on purpose: boring technology, simplicity over cleverness, in\-process over distributed, shared\-nothing over shared state, domain wrapped by ports and adapters. Redundancy is an architectural property, not an operational afterthought. Designs are argued from the problem, not from what a framework happens to make easy. Proposals go through RFCs; decisions are recorded in ADRs.


Two constraints shape most of what we do. Everything the platform produces must be traceable back to the raw feed and the exact configuration that produced it — a customer has to be able to replay an exercise and defend the result. And it has to run where exercises actually run: constrained hardware, intermittent connectivity, air\-gapped sites, limited patch windows, secure by design and observability good enough for an operator in the field with no one to call.

**You**


Substantial engineering experience, opinionated about design, and comfortable arguing a position in writing. Sound judgement on reliability, security, performance, operations and cost is mandatory. Familiarity with simulation or sensor standards, IoT, geospatial mathematics or high\-throughput ingestion is a real advantage — the domain is learnable, the principles less so. We'd also rather hear about how you simplified a distributed system rather than the one you built using multiple services.


The engineering team is small, but what we are building sits at the centre of the portfolio and draws the people who know this domain best — some of the strongest simulation and modelling expertise anywhere in the field is in this building, and closely engaged in what we're building. The bar is high. Your designs will be challenged, and you'll be expected to challenge back — including on scope, since most of the pressure on a platform like this comes as reasonable\-sounding requests for one more special case.


Research shows some people only apply when they meet every requirement. If you don't tick every box but recognise yourself in much of the above, please apply anyway. We'd genuinely like to hear from you.

**Security and citizenship**


This role supports defence work, so the successful candidate must hold Swedish citizenship and pass Swedish security vetting (säkerhetsprövning). We will explain what the check involves early in the process rather than late — a requirement like this should never be a surprise at offer stage.


This requirement comes only from the security rules that govern defence work, not from personal preference.

**Why it matters**


Deterrence works only when a capability is real, and a capability is only real once it has been trained and tested under conditions close to the ones it would face. This is about making sure the organisations that would hold the line are ready.

**How we hire**


Every interview has a written script and a scored rubric, applied the same way to every candidate.

* **Hiring Manager Screen** — a conversation about your experience, how you work and what


you want next.

* **System Design** — a design discussion drawn from problems like the ones above.
* **Programming** — a hands\-on session in a language of your choice (Java, C\#, TypeScript, Python or Go).
* **Culture Interview** — how you collaborate, disagree and make decisions with others.
* **Candidate Q\&A** — your time to interrogate us. We expect you to use it.


We then debrief as a panel and decide. We review applications on a rolling basis.

**What you can expect from 4C Strategies**

* Stockholm\-based, with hybrid working.
* Competitive salary, reviewed annually.
* Occupational pension (tjänstepension).
* Wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag).
* Healthcare insurance, including insurance for treatment.
* Parental pay.
* Vaccinations.
* A supportive, collaborative team building meaningful products for mission\-critical work.

**Why Join 4C Strategies**


If you're happiest when the path isn't drawn yet, this is a rare chance to own hard, open problems on a large, multi\-year programme — real scale, real production systems, and the freedom to shape how they're built — with a collaborative team to figure the hard parts out alongside you. You'll work alongside experienced engineers and military specialists, with the individual\-contributor track valued as highly as management, so you can grow without leaving the code behind.


The work matters: what you build helps armed forces, public safety and resilience organisations train, prepare, and respond. If you want senior\-level ownership on systems that are used in earnest — not a backlog ticket factory — this is that role.

**How to apply**


To apply, click the Apply today button and submit your CV. A short cover note on your experience and motivation is welcome but not required. We review applications on a rolling basis, so please apply as soon as you can.


4C Strategies is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: People and Project Manager - for AI-assisted diagnostic medical software

In 3Shape we work to improve treatment and diagnostics for dental patients by providing innovative scanners and advanced software, tied together in collaborative workflows for the global community of dental professionals worldwide. We are using AI and machine learning methods for analyzing large amounts of medical (dentistry) data – pushing a field which traditionally has looked at 2D images towards 3D scan data.

**The product**


TRIOS Dx offers AI\-assisted dental diagnostic aid tools for monitoring oral health conditions and assessing changes in teeth and gingiva. By analyzing a 3D scan TRIOS Dx assists in diagnosing Caries, Tooth Wear, Gingival recession, and Plaque.


TRIOS Dx was made public and available to end users last year. We are now in a phase where we listen to market feedback and improve the product. We also plan to add new and existing functionality to it over the next many years.

**The position**


We are looking for a skilled People \& Project Manager for the AI team currently responsible for the AI’s diagnosing Caries, Tooth Wear, Gingival recession, and Plaque. You will be driving end\-to\-end delivery of innovative AI solutions and will during this play a key role in ensuring we use state\-of\-the\-art AI solutions, have the right data for AI development, and have thorough and efficient documentation required to get AP approved for use in a Medical Device software. Your main tasks include:

* Build, coach, and develop the team, cultivating an environment where people can do the best work of their lives.
* Lead your team through the full product lifecycle \- from ideation and development to deployment, monitoring, and iteration based on customer feedback.
* Ensure the team have clear ownership of domains, responsibilities, and deliverables.


You will be collaborating with various professionals such as application developers, AI developers, QA, RA, Product Management, and a Clinical Research team of dental professionals.

**Your profile**


We are looking for candidates with a good understanding of the AI and AI development. You may have experience from related positions, and you have a relevant education.

* Master’s degree or a PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Bioinformatics, Engineering or a related field
* 2\+ years of leadership experience managing and growing engineering teams.
* Proven experience with Machine Learning (e.g. deep neural networks, supervised and unsupervised learning), preferably within image processing or processing of 3D data
* Solid software development skills, preferably in Python and C\#
* Mindset for quality, flexibility, creativity, emerging technologies


In our search for a new colleague, we always look for people with a cross\-disciplinary and open mindset. Through cooperation with program managers, project managers, developers, testers, and Regulatory Affair specialists; you will get an in\-depth understanding of all aspects of medical software development and use this to enable further growth and success.

**Get in touch now!**


Please do not hesitate to apply as soon for this exciting opportunity at one of Denmark’s most successful and fastest\-growing high\-tech companies, as applications will be processed continuously. The deadline for application is **10\. October**. We look forward to hearing from you.


We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

**About us**


3Shape started with a simple idea \- to make 3D scanning better. First, we applied it to the hearing industry, then we succeeded in dentistry. Twenty years later, 3Shape has 2,000\+ employees globally. With the help of dental professionals and amazing colleagues we’re creating award\-winning scanning and CAD/CAM solutions to change dentistry together! Together, we contribute to a better world. Experience the everyday \#lifeat3Shape across the globe on LinkedIn.

jobs.title: Electrical and Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**Electrical and Automation Engineer**
======================================

Requisition ID: 19377
Location:
Zug, CH, 6300
Pay Type:
Holcim is the leading partner for sustainable construction, creating value across the built environment from infrastructure and industry to buildings. Headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, Holcim has more than 48,000 employees in 45 attractive markets – across Europe, Latin America, Asia, Middle East \& Africa. Holcim offers high\-value end\-to\-end Building Materials and Building Solutions, from foundations and flooring to roofing and walling – powered by premium brands including ECOPlanet, ECOPact, and ECOCycle®. Find out more at www.holcim.com


**WHO IS HOLCIM?**
  

As a global leader in innovative and sustainable building solutions, Holcim is enabling greener cities, smarter infrastructure and improving living standards around the world. With sustainability at the core of our strategy, we are becoming a net\-zero company, with our people and communities at the heart of our success. We are driving circular construction as a world leader in recycling to build more with less. It’s all thanks to our 70,000 talented people around the world who are passionate about building progress for people and the planet through four business segments: Cement, Ready\-Mix Concrete, Aggregates and Solutions \& Products.


**WHO ARE HOLCIM PEOPLE**
  

Holcim people are passionate about finding better ways to build. They embrace innovation and improvement with a pioneering spirit. They work as trusted partners, creating better solutions and experiences for their customers, communities, and colleagues.

  

Holcim is the leading partner for sustainable construction with net sales of CHF 15\.7 billion in 2025, creating value across the built environment from infrastructure and industry to buildings. Headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, Holcim has more than 50 000 employees in 45 countries – across Europe, Latin America and Asia, Middle East \& Africa – and has been recognized as a Global Top Employer by the Top Employers Institute. Holcim offers high\-value end\-to\-end Building Materials and Building Solutions, from foundation and flooring to walling and roofing – powered by premium brands including ECOPact, ECOPlanet, ECOCycle, and Ytong.

  

**Role Overview**

  

Support the Holcim Group and provide advanced electrical and automation engineering support for greenfield and brownfield plants across all project phases (definition, planning, and execution) as our **Electrical and Automation Engineer based in Zug Switzerland**. This role focuses on industrial CAPEX projects in Cement and Geocycle operations globally as well as large\-scale Carbon Capture, Utilization, and Storage (CCUS) initiatives

  

**Main Responsibilities**

  

**Health, Safety \& Environment (HSE)**  

* Drive a strong safety culture across all engineering activities, integrating "Safety in Design" and "Safety in Construction" principles.

* Ensure full compliance with Group HSE standards, security policies, and technical regulations across all assigned projects.

**Project Conceptualization \& Feasibility**  

* Develop robust, safe, and cost\-effective electrical and automation engineering concepts for business cases, feasibility studies, and tender packages.

* Analyse plant KPIs to assist CAPEX Project Managers in establishing accurate CAPEX/OPEX estimates and production targets.

* Evaluate tender submissions to identify technically sound, commercially optimal solutions.

**Detailed Engineering \& Quality Control**  

* Review detailed design documentation to ensure compliance with Group standards, safety requirements, maintainability, durability, and cost efficiency.

* Oversee quality control, technical inspections, and execution of electrical and automation packages during project implementation.

* Provide targeted, high\-value technical support during the commissioning and performance\-testing phases.

**Supplier Management \& Technical Governance**  

* Qualify global suppliers for electrical systems, power distribution, and drive technologies, maintaining a strong understanding of market capabilities.

* Develop and continuously refine standard design criteria, engineering tools (e.g., eDM, IBS), and technical best practices across the organization.

* Represent the discipline in knowledge\-sharing platforms and cross\-functional technical roundtables.

**Project \& Stakeholder Management**  

* Simultaneously manage electrical and automation deliverables across multiple concurrent projects based on priority.

* Collaborate effectively within diverse, multicultural, and multidisciplinary engineering teams across international locations.

**Your Profile**

  

* **Education:** University degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a closely related discipline.

* **Experience:** Minimum 5 years of hands\-on experience in industrial CAPEX project engineering (Cement, Heavy Industry, or Process Engineering preferred).

### **Technical \& Functional Skills**

  

* Deep knowledge of international electrical and automation engineering standards, tools, and methodologies.

* Proven experience in large\-scale CAPEX project execution, tender preparation, and vendor selection.

* Familiarity with heavy process industries (e.g., Cement, Energy, Carbon Capture).

  

  

### **Leadership \& Behavioural Competencies**

  

* **Technical Leadership:** Ability to influence stakeholders and establish credibility through technical expertise rather than direct authority.

* **Adaptability \& Resilience:** Comfortable working autonomously, managing shifting priorities, and conducting site assessments in remote or challenging environments.

* **Communication \& Negotiation:** Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to bridge complex technical details with commercial and operational teams across global sites.

* **Mindset:** Highly analytical, rigorous, cost\-conscious, and open to continuous improvement and technical innovation.

### **Languages \& Mobility**

  

* **Languages:** Professional working proficiency in English (written and spoken) is required. Proficiency in additional core Group languages is a plus.

* **Mobility:** Willingness to travel frequently to project locations, supplier facilities, and construction sites worldwide, including regions with basic infrastructure or remote conditions.

  

  

  

**Benefits**

  

* Hybrid work contract
* Family Support: Subsidized child care and paid maternity/paternity leave
* Professional Growth: Company\-sponsored training and professional development.
* Discounts and Perks: Subsidized meals, exclusive discounts, and company gifts for special occasions.
* Long\-service awards
* Employee referral bonus
* Pension and Savings: Access to a comprehensive pension fund and an employee savings scheme.

*Holcim is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We support equal opportunities for everyone, regardless of race, national origin, gender, sexuality, disability, or age.*

  

*Important Notice: Holcim recruiters only contact candidates via official @\[holcim.com] email addresses. We do not use Gmail or any other non\-Holcim domains to conduct recruitment processes. Please verify the sender address before responding."*

  

Do you want to work in an international and dynamic working environment with attractive benefits? We are looking for colleagues to join our team to build progress for people and the planet.


Please submit your CV, a motivation letter and relevant documents with information on the career portal. No agencies can be considered.

jobs.title: AI Software Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wir sind mutig und innovativ, neugierig und kreativ, bodenständig und ganz klar auf den Erfolg unserer Kunden fokussiert. Unsere Ideen und unser Know\-how fließen in einzigartige Maschinen\- und Anlagenlösungen für **internationale Unternehmen** aus der **holz\-, metall\- und kunststoffbearbeitenden Industrie**. **International bekannte Möbelmarken** setzen ebenso auf unsere Erfahrung wie der **weltgrößte Flugzeughersteller** oder der **anspruchsvolle Tischlerbetrieb von nebenan**. Manche Anlage erreicht die **Größe von bis zu zwei Fußballfeldern** – das geht, weil wir über **100 Jahre Pionierarbeit auf höchstem Niveau** mit im Gepäck haben. Ambitionierte Nachwuchs\-, Fach\- und Führungskräfte finden bei uns das perfekte Umfeld für ihre Talente. **Bist Du mit dabei?**

**Wir bieten**

* Spannende Aufgaben in einem international tätigen Hightech\-Unternehmen
* Die Chance, KI bei uns von der Idee bis in den produktiven Einsatz zu bringen – in unseren Produkten, im Service und in der täglichen Arbeit
* Ein internationales Umfeld mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen an Standorten in Europa, Asien und Amerika
* Ein Themenfeld, das Du inhaltlich prägst, statt es zu verwalten
* Kurzen Weg zur KI\-Strategie der Unternehmensgruppe und schnelle Entscheidungen
* Flexible Arbeitszeiten
* Kollegiales Umfeld mit flachen Hierarchien
* Individuelle Weiterbildungs\- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten – Lernzeit ist bei uns Arbeitszeit
* Attraktive Benefits (Gesundheitsförderung, Digibon, Mitarbeiterrabatte, Bikeleasing, Firmenevents,..)

**Deine Aufgaben**

* Du verfolgst, was sich bei KI\-Technologien tut, prüfst neue Ansätze auf ihren Nutzen und setzt das Passende bei uns ein – von großen Sprachmodellen über Agenten bis zu Retrieval\-Verfahren
* Du entwirfst und baust KI\-gestützte Werkzeuge und begleitest sie vom ersten Versuch bis zu einer Lösung, die im Alltag zuverlässig läuft
* Du machst unsere internen Abläufe mit KI spürbar schneller und einfacher – in Entwicklung, Service, Vertrieb und Verwaltung
* Du bringst KI dorthin, wo bei uns gearbeitet wird – in unsere Softwareprodukte und in die Systeme der Unternehmensgruppe
* Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Entwicklerinnen und Entwicklern sowie den Fachbereichen zusammen und übersetzt zwischen Anforderung und Technik
* Du behältst unsere KI\-Werkzeuge im Betrieb im Blick, schärfst sie nach und entwickelst sie weiter – damit sie nach dem Start nicht liegen bleiben
* Du gibst Dein Wissen weiter und begleitest unsere Teams beim Einsatz von KI\-Werkzeugen

 **Dein Profil**

* Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich Informatik oder Softwareentwicklung (HTL, FH, Universität oder vergleichbare Qualifikation)
* Du hast bereits selbst mit Sprachmodellen, Agenten, RAG, MCP und Prompt Engineering gearbeitet
* Du schreibst Code, den auch andere noch warten können – idealerweise in Python oder C\#
* Du weißt, wie Agenten aufgebaut sind und wie sich Abläufe zwischen ihnen sinnvoll steuern lassen
* Echte Begeisterung für das Thema – und Freude daran, laufend Neues dazuzulernen
* Freude daran, mit Fachbereichen zu sprechen und aus einem Problem einen greifbaren Anwendungsfall zu machen
* Grundverständnis für Cloud\-Themen (Microsoft Azure) – Erfahrung im DevOps\-Umfeld ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss
* Gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse

jobs.description:
We are knowmad mood!


Somos una compañía líder en transformación digital, en constante evolución y a la vanguardia de la tecnología. Nacimos para provocar un cambio real a través de la innovación y el desarrollo sostenible, con la misión de aportar valor a los clientes e impulsar nuestro talento.


Formado por más de 3\.000 personas creativas, digitales e innovadoras conectadas a un propósito y capaces de generar conexiones con personas de todo el mundo. Un equipo responsable, flexible y con alta capacidad de adaptación a las necesidades de nuestros clientes y del mercado, a la vez que proporciona valor, visión, creatividad, expertise, profesionalidad y pasión por la tecnología en cada proyecto.


Los valores que marcan nuestro rumbo y nos guían hacia la excelencia son la colaboración, la innovación, el compromiso, la diversión y la conﬁanza.

 **¿Qué es lo que valoramos?**


Experiencia de al menos 5 años como Desarrollador Senior .NET o Consultor Técnico en entornos empresariales complejos:

* Experiencia sólida en desarrollo y mantenimiento de aplicaciones .NET y .NET Framework.
* Conocimientos avanzados en arquitectura de aplicaciones, refactorización de código, modernización tecnológica y gestión del ciclo de vida del software.
* Experiencia trabajando con observabilidad, monitorización y análisis de rendimiento mediante herramientas como Kibana, Grafana, Elastic Stack o similares.
* Conocimientos en actualización y migración de frameworks, dependencias y componentes tecnológicos en entornos productivos.
* Experiencia en la gestión y mitigación de vulnerabilidades de seguridad, tanto a nivel de código como de arquitectura e infraestructura.
* Capacidad para analizar dependencias técnicas complejas entre aplicaciones, servicios, sistemas operativos y componentes corporativos.
* Experiencia en documentación técnica, inventariado de aplicaciones y definición de relaciones entre sistemas.
* Capacidad de trabajo en equipo y comunicación efectiva con equipos técnicos, arquitectura, ciberseguridad y negocio..

**¿Cuáles serían tus funciones?**

* **Modernización y Evolución Aplicativa:** Refactorizar, optimizar, actualizar y sanear las aplicaciones actualmente en producción, garantizando su mantenibilidad, rendimiento y alineamiento con los estándares tecnológicos corporativos.
* **Observabilidad y Monitorización:** Diseñar e implementar métricas, trazabilidad y dashboards que permitan mejorar la observabilidad de las aplicaciones mediante herramientas como Kibana, Grafana y otras soluciones del ecosistema.
* **Gestión de Vulnerabilidades:** Analizar y mitigar vulnerabilidades identificadas por los equipos de ciberseguridad, impulsando tanto mejoras de código como actualizaciones de componentes, frameworks y plataformas.
* **Arquitectura e IT4IT:** Participar en iniciativas de arquitectura técnica y gobierno IT4IT, evaluando dependencias, definiendo soluciones de mejora continua y asegurando la sostenibilidad tecnológica de los sistemas.
* **Actualización Tecnológica:** Liderar procesos de actualización de frameworks, librerías, componentes y sistemas operativos cuando las aplicaciones presenten dependencias que lo requieran.
* **Documentación Técnica:** Mantener actualizado el inventario de aplicaciones y componentes, documentando la arquitectura desplegada y las relaciones existentes entre los diferentes sistemas.
* **Colaboración Multidisciplinaria:** Trabajar estrechamente con equipos de desarrollo, operaciones, arquitectura y ciberseguridad para garantizar la evolución continua de los entornos tecnológicos.

 **Además, valoraremos muy positivamente si tienes experiencia y/o conocimientos en:**

* Arquitecturas distribuidas, microservicios y patrones de integración.
* Elastic Stack (ELK), Grafana, Prometheus o herramientas equivalentes de observabilidad.
* Azure Cloud y arquitecturas basadas en la nube.
* DevOps, CI/CD y automatización de despliegues.
* SonarQube, análisis de calidad de código y gestión de deuda técnica.
* OWASP, Secure Coding y buenas prácticas de ciberseguridad.
* Kubernetes, Docker y plataformas de contenedorización.
* Metodologías ágiles de desarrollo (Scrum, Kanban).

jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Network Technology Engineer
jobs.description:
**Entity:**

Technology  

  

**Job Family Group:**

IT\&S Group  

  

**Job Description:**

  

Our purpose is to deliver energy to the world, today and tomorrow. For over 100 years, bp has focused on discovering, developing, and producing oil and gas in the nations where we operate. We are one of the few companies globally that can provide governments and customers with an integrated energy offering. Delivering our strategy sustainably is fundamental to achieving our ambition to be a net zero company by 2050 or sooner.

  

It's an exciting time to join bp. Meeting the energy challenge requires many different approaches and solutions. And as part of Finance Business \& Technology (FBT), you’ll be fully connected into the world of bp. You’ll play an increasingly important part within a network of like\-minded colleagues partnering on strategic projects that stretch across the globe. And it starts with you. There’s a world of opportunities to build new skills, challenge yourself and grow a long\-term career at bp. And no matter where you work, your role will have meaning, purpose and impact. So if you want to be part of a caring, supportive environment where you can realize your full potential, we’re with you.

  

*Join our Technology Team and advance your career as a* ***Senior Enterprise Network Technology Engineer***

  

The **Senior Enterprise Network Technology Engineer** is a senior technical role within Enterprise Network


Services (ENS), responsible for designing, implementing and continuously improving bp's enterprise network services.


The role provides deep technical expertise across enterprise LAN, Wireless LAN (WLAN), SD\-WAN and network infrastructure technologies, supporting network transformation, site refresh, migration and operational improvement initiatives. The incumbent acts as a senior partner concern point for complex technical issues, provides technical guidance to operations teams and suppliers, and contributes to the development of secure, reliable and scalable network solutions that support bp's global business operations.

  

***In this role You will:***


* Design, implement and support enterprise LAN, WLAN and SD\-WAN solutions across bp's global network estate.
* Lead technical delivery of network engineering, migration, site refresh and modernization initiatives.
* Act as a senior technical issue point for complex network incidents, major problems and engineering challenges.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance to Level 2 support teams, engineering peers and managed service providers.
* Engineer and support Aruba switching, Aruba wireless, Aruba Central and associated network management platforms.
* Produce and maintain network designs, implementation plans, technical standards and operational documentation.
* Solve complex routing, switching, wireless, authentication and connectivity issues.
* Drive root cause analysis and implementation of permanent corrective actions.
* Collaborate with architecture, security, operations, project delivery teams and vendors to ensure successful solution delivery.
* Find opportunities for automation, standardization and continuous improvement across the network environment.
* Ensure compliance with bp technology, cyber security and operational standards.
  

***What You will need to be successful:***


* Degree in computer science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent relevant industry experience
* Relevant industry certifications are beneficial
* Solid experience in enterprise network engineering within large and complex environments
* Advanced knowledge of Cisco networking technologies
* Experience with enterprise routing, switching and network fix
* Strong hands\-on practical skills in LAN and wireless networking technologies
* Proficiency with Aruba switching, Aruba Wireless and Aruba Central platforms
* Experience with SD\-WAN technologies and enterprise connectivity solutions
* Familiarity in diagnosing and resolving complex technical issues beyond standard operational support
* Experience designing, implementing and supporting network infrastructure projects and migrations
* Experience producing and reviewing network designs and user documentation
* Understanding of network authentication and access control technologies
* Experience working with globally distributed teams, suppliers and service providers
* Strong analytical, solve and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to work independently, take technical ownership and deliver outcomes in a fast\-paced environment
  

***Desirable criteria:***


* Experience with Versa SD\-WAN solutions
* Knowledge with Juniper and Fortinet technologies, Aruba ClearPass
* Ability to reviewing wireless survey outputs and WLAN optimization activities
* Knowledge of cloud networking concepts within Azure and/or AWS environments
* Familiarity with network automation using Python, Ansible or REST APIs
* Exposure working in industrial or operationally critical environments
* ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent knowledge
* Cisco, Aruba, Juniper, Versa or Fortinet certifications
  

***At bp, we provide the following environment \& benefits to you:***


* Different bonus opportunities based on performance, wide range of cafeteria elements
* Life \& health insurance, medical care package
* Hybrid working arrangement aligned with team arrangements and business needs
* Opportunity to build up long\-term career path and develop your skills with wide range of learning options
* Celebrate in bp’s success. You may be eligible to join bp’s Global ShareMatch plan. This non\-contractual benefit lets employees buy bp shares and receive matching shares, in line with plan rules
* Family friendly workplace e.g.: Extended parental leave, Mother\-baby room
* Employees’ wellbeing programs e.g.: Employee Assistance Program, Company Recognition Program
* Possibility to join our social communities and networks
* Chill\-out and collaboration spaces in our beautiful Budapest Agora and Szeged offices e.g.: Play Zones, Office massage, Sport and music equipment
  

**bp Hungary won the Most Attractive Employer 2024 Award (SSC / BSC sector) fourth time in a row at PwC's annual employer research. Come and join us!**

  

At bp, we support our people to learn and grow in a diverse and ambitious environment. We believe that our team is strengthened by diversity. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment in which everyone is respected and treated fairly. There are many aspects of our employees’ lives that are meaningful, so we offer benefits to enable your work to fit with your life.

  

Disclaimer: Please note that, according to Hungarian law (2012/I. 113\. §), mothers or single parents caring for a child under three years of age cannot be employed in night shift positions.

  

  

**Travel Requirement**


Negligible travel should be expected with this role  

  

**Relocation Assistance:**


This role is eligible for relocation within country

This position is a hybrid of office/remote working  

  

**Skills:**


Commercial Acumen, Communication, Data Analysis, Data cleansing and transformation, Data domain knowledge, Data Integration, Data Management, Data Manipulation, Data Sourcing, Data strategy and governance, Data Structures and Algorithms (Inactive), Data visualization and interpretation, Digital Security, Extract, transform and load, Group Problem Solving
.

jobs.title: Full Stack .NET Developer
Senior Full Stack Developer(EN)
jobs.description:
Create your own future

As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will help build digital solutions that support wealth planners in guiding clients through one of life's most important decisions: planning the transfer of wealth across generations.

ClientCenter is the central platform used by our commercial colleagues and is being extended with new capabilities that help wealth planners better understand client situations, streamline succession planning processes, and provide more personalised advice. Your work will directly contribute to improving how our colleagues support clients in achieving their long-term wealth goals.

This is a highly collaborative role where technology, business expertise and user needs come together. We believe the best products are built by teams that stay close to their users. That's why we're looking for someone who is curious, user-oriented and eager to understand both the business domain and the people who use the software every day.

Your responsibilities:

Design, build and maintain scalable applications and services
Develop end-to-end solutions using modern full stack technologies
Work closely with wealth planners to understand user workflows, validate assumptions and deliver solutions that create measurable value
Translate complex wealth and succession planning requirements into robust, secure and maintainable software
Develop a deep understanding of the Belgian wealth and succession planning domain and actively contribute to shaping digital solutions in this space
Collaborate with other development teams within the cluster to deliver seamless and integrated client journeys
Contribute to architecture decisions, technical design and the evolution of the platform
Leverage AI throughout the entire software development lifecycle while maintaining high standards for quality, security, and maintainability
Take ownership from analysis through implementation and release
Continuously improve development practices, testing approaches and system reliability
Coach and support junior team members through knowledge sharing, feedback and technical guidance

Your talents

As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you combine strong technical expertise with curiosity for the business domain and the people who use the products you build. You take ownership, communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and are comfortable working in complex environments where business and technology intersect.

In addition, you have:

At least 5 years of experience as a Full Stack Developer
Strong experience with C# .NET, Angular, and modern web development technologies
Experience working with Azure-based solutions
A pragmatic approach to AI-assisted software development, balancing productivity gains with sound engineering judgement
Strong collaboration skills and experience working across multiple teams and stakeholders
A strong interest in understanding end-user workflows and improving the user experience
The ability to quickly understand complex functional domains and translate them into technical solutions
Excellent communication skills and experience working in Agile teams

Move ahead at Van Lanschot Kempen

Investing in a more future-oriented, sustainable, and data-driven way with various clients. Both nationally and internationally. With nearly 300 years of experience, we make this ambition a reality at Van Lanschot Kempen. We do this with more than 2,100 colleagues in various fields of expertise.

You will join a Scrum team that develops and evolves digital solutions supporting wealth and succession planning within the Private Clients domain. Working across the full stack, you will help create solutions that simplify complex processes and support colleagues in delivering high-quality advice to clients. You'll have the opportunity to influence technical decisions, contribute to product evolution and help establish best practices within the team.

An organisation's degree of innovation and agility also depends on the diversity of its workforce. Our differences make us stronger together. We promote an inclusive work environment where all colleagues feel at home. With us, you can be yourself. And we are proud of that.

Curious about the stories of colleagues and how they experience working at Van Lanschot Kempen? Go to Podcasts and find out more

That is what we do! The fact is, if you add value, you can expect the same from us in return. A good work-life balance with our ‘hybrid way of working’ is a good example of this. As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will also be given: 

a gross monthly salary between €5.500 and €7.000, depending on knowledge and experience
a flexible budget of 19.47% of your gross salary (including 13th month, 8% holiday pay, and 7 extra days off), to be spent on things like a bike, gym, or sabbatical
hybrid working with flexibility, with the team typically working from the Amsterdam office on Tuesdays and Thursdays
27 vacation days, including 7 within the flexible budget
a competitive pension scheme, with an average employer contribution of around 20%
the opportunity to work abroad for up to 2 months per year
a fully equipped home office setup, including an electric standing desk, ergonomic chair and monitors, delivered to your home
working from home allowance
an employee share plan, where Van Lanschot Kempen matches your investment in Van Lanschot Kempen shares up to €3,500 per year
Dutch and English language courses
extensive training opportunities and room for personal and professional development
weekly drinks at our bar in the office
discounted collective health insurance
chair massage and physio at the office

And many more employment benefits ready for you.  Discover all the benefits of working at Van Lanschot Kempen.

Excited about this opportunity? Apply through our website.

If you have any questions, feel free to contact Anna Skorobohata, Recruiter at a.skorobohata@vanlanschotkempen.com

Hier krijg je als engineer écht de ruimte om het verschil te maken bij grote organisaties. Geen eindeloze rapporten, maar direct bouwen, verantwoordelijkheid nemen en samen met een scherp team impact maken.

Je werkt aan het ontwerpen en bouwen van maatwerkapplicaties, slimme AI-tools en integraties met het Power Platform. Jij zorgt dat de wensen van de klant vertaald worden naar heldere technische oplossingen. Je begint met het scherp krijgen van de klantvraag, bedenkt samen met je team de beste technische aanpak en bouwt die uit tot werkende software. Je ontwikkelt cloud-native applicaties, legt integraties tussen systemen en houdt je bezig met het opzetten van een veilige, onderhoudbare architectuur.

Op een gemiddelde dag ben je bezig met het uitdenken en ontwikkelen van nieuwe features, het reviewen van code van collega’s en het begeleiden van minder ervaren engineers. Je overlegt direct met de klant over wensen en eisen, maakt inschattingen voor nieuwe projecten en zorgt dat de software netjes wordt uitgerold via CI/CD. Je werkt met C#, Azure, Power Platform en AI en tilt samen de technische standaard omhoog.

Hier krijg je de vrijheid om zelf keuzes te maken, verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en direct invloed te hebben op het eindresultaat. Is deze rol iets voor jou? Solliciteer direct of kom langs voor een kop koffie.

Salaris tussen €4500 en €6250 per maand
Leaseauto of mobiliteitsbudget
Hybride werken: thuis, op kantoor of bij de klant
Opleidingsbudget om je verder te ontwikkelen
Maandelijkse teamuitjes en sportbudget
Grote projecten bij bekende klanten

Over het bedrijf:

Je werkt bij een IT-bureau in de regio Utrecht waar weinig managementlagen zijn en veel ruimte is voor initiatief. De sfeer is informeel, direct en iedereen denkt mee over het eindresultaat. Samen met andere engineers werk je aan softwareprojecten, AI- en Power Platform-oplossingen voor grote organisaties. Er is veel kennisdeling en ruimte om te groeien. Je merkt meteen dat het team energiek en open is en dat iedereen gericht is op het maken van oplossingen die werken.

Vereisten:

Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring als software engineer (medior of senior)
Kennis van C#, Power Platform, Azure en AI
Ervaring met softwareontwikkeling van idee tot implementatie
Mentaliteit: bouwen, aanpakken, verantwoordelijkheid nemen
Je durft je eigen technische keuzes te maken en initiatief te tonen

Łączymy wiedzę techniczną z doświadczeniem projektowym zdobywanym w branżach przemysłowych i technologicznych. Pracujemy w międzynarodowym środowisku, stawiając na jakość, współpracę i ciągłe doskonalenie.

Projekt realizowany jest dla międzynarodowej firmy technologicznej z branży automotive, rozwijającej zaawansowaną platformę SaaS wspierającą sprzedaż i obsługę klientów. Rozwiązanie integruje procesy marketingowe, sprzedażowe i obsługę posprzedażową w jednym systemie, wspierając organizacje w zarządzaniu relacjami z klientami i optymalizacji procesów biznesowych.

Dlaczego warto rozważyć ten projekt?

To propozycja dla osób, które chcą pracować nad rozwojem skalowalnego produktu SaaS, wykorzystywanego w codziennej pracy przez organizacje na wielu rynkach. Projekt jest w fazie intensywnego rozwoju, co oznacza realny wpływ na architekturę, technologie oraz kierunek rozwoju platformy. Pracujesz w środowisku fullstackowym — zarówno przy backendzie (Java), jak i frontendzie (TypeScript), mając wpływ na cały cykl życia produktu. W projekcie wykorzystujesz język niemiecki w komunikacji z interesariuszami, jednocześnie pracując w szerszym, międzynarodowym środowisku.

W tej roli będziesz odpowiadać za:

rozwój i utrzymanie aplikacji webowej w modelu fullstack (Java + TypeScript),
implementację nowych funkcjonalności oraz rozwój logiki biznesowej po stronie backendu i frontendu,
projektowanie i rozwój API oraz integrację systemu z zewnętrznymi rozwiązaniami,
pracę z technologiami backendowymi (Java, Spring Boot) oraz bazami danych (MySQL, Elasticsearch),
rozwój warstwy frontendowej z wykorzystaniem TypeScript oraz frameworków takich jak Vue.js,
analizę wymagań biznesowych i ich przekład na rozwiązania techniczne,
dbanie o jakość kodu poprzez testy jednostkowe i integracyjne oraz udział w code review,
diagnozowanie i rozwiązywanie problemów technicznych w środowisku produkcyjnym,
współpracę z zespołem produktowym i interesariuszami biznesowymi,
udział w procesach Agile oraz rozwój i usprawnianie praktyk zespołowych.

Jesteś naszym brakującym ogniwem, jeśli:

masz minimum 5 lat doświadczenia w tworzeniu aplikacji fullstack,
pracujesz z językiem Java oraz frameworkiem Spring Boot,
masz doświadczenie w pracy z TypeScript oraz frameworkami frontendowymi (np. Vue.js, React lub Angular),
masz doświadczenie w tworzeniu API oraz integracji systemów,
pracowałeś/-aś z bazami danych (np. MySQL) oraz rozwiązaniami typu Elasticsearch,
masz doświadczenie w pracy w środowisku SaaS lub przy rozwoju produktów,
znasz metodyki Agile/Scrum i pracowałeś/-aś w zespołach developerskich,
posługujesz się językiem niemieckim na poziomie minimum B2,
posługujesz się językiem angielskim na poziomie minimum B2,
dbasz o jakość kodu i stosujesz dobre praktyki programistyczne.

Docenimy również:

doświadczenie z AWS,
doświadczenie w pracy z CI/CD (np. GitLab CI/CD),
doświadczenie w pracy z architekturą mikroserwisową,
doświadczenie w pracy z produktami CRM lub systemami sprzedażowymi.

W Etteplan możesz liczyć na:

pracę w międzynarodowym środowisku produktowym,
udział w rozwoju platformy wykorzystywanej na wielu rynkach,
możliwość pracy zdalnej,
realny wpływ na rozwój produktu i technologii,
współpracę z doświadczonym zespołem technologicznym.

Wyślij nam swoje CV – najlepiej w języku angielskim. W formularzu daj nam znać, jakie masz oczekiwania finansowe, preferowaną formę współpracy oraz od kiedy możesz rozpocząć pracę.

oin Amaris Consulting
and work on AI‑powered payroll and human resources management platforms

. You will work on a cutting‑edge intelligent assistant that automates and streamlines payroll workflows, enabling practitioners to manage payroll operations efficiently through a conversational AI experience. You will contribute across the full stack — from micro frontends and web components
, through REST APIs and relational databases
, to cloud‑hosted AI agents
— and integrate with multiple enterprise payroll systems.

✅ What we’re looking for

7+ years of experience as a Full‑Stack or Backend Engineer working with Python and/or .NET in complex enterprise environments.
Strong experience designing and building Python‑based services, ideally including AI agents or integrations with cloud AI platforms.
Solid experience with .NET Core for building RESTful APIs and backend services.
Experience with modern frontend frameworks, ideally Angular, and with web components (Stencil or similar) and micro frontend architectures.
Strong knowledge of relational databases (preferably SQL Server): writing complex queries, understanding schemas, and integrating with existing data models.
Experience with infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform, and cloud deployments (Azure/AWS/GCP).
Solid understanding of software architecture and distributed systems (modularization, scalability, resilience).
Experience integrating with or modernizing legacy enterprise systems without impacting existing functionality.
Good understanding of security best practices: identity and access management, trust boundaries, idempotency, audit trails, PII protection, feature flags/kill switches.
Hands‑on experience with CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.) and use of Git.
Strong knowledge of software engineering best practices: clean code, design patterns, testing, code review, documentation.
Professional level of English, able to collaborate with international teams – your day‑to‑day work will be in English.

🛠 What you will do

Design, build, and maintain Python‑based AI agents using modern agentic frameworks and cloud AI runtimes.
Develop and maintain .NET Core APIs that act as downstream services for the AI agent layer.
Build and integrate Angular micro frontends and Stencil web components into an existing enterprise shell application.
Work with SQL Server databases: write and optimize queries, understand and evolve schemas, and integrate with existing payroll data models.
Write and maintain Terraform code to define and manage cloud infrastructure for the platform.
Integrate new AI and automation capabilities into legacy enterprise payroll systems without breaking existing functionality.
Collaborate closely with frontend, backend, AI, and infrastructure teams to deliver end‑to‑end features.
Implement and enforce security and compliance best practices across the stack (identity, auditability, PII redaction, feature flags, etc.).
Contribute to technical design documentation, READMEs, and the team knowledge base, helping to spread best practices and onboard new team members.

🧠 Your mindset & soft skills

Strong problem‑solving skills and analytical thinking, with the ability to understand complex business and technical domains (payroll, HR, compliance).
Excellent communication skills and ability to work in multidisciplinary teams (engineering, architecture, product, operations, business stakeholders).
Proactive attitude, strong sense of ownership, and focus on continuous improvement and automation.
Comfortable working in agile environments (Scrum, Kanban), participating in ceremonies and contributing to team rituals.

Experience in financial services, payroll, HR tech or other highly regulated sectors.
Experience with event‑driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.).
Experience with DevSecOps tools (SAST, DAST, dependency analysis, secrets management).
Familiarity with observability and reliability practices (monitoring, logging, alerting, SRE concepts).
Experience with API gateways, service mesh, or service discovery tools.

🚀 Why join us?

Career growth: 70% of our senior leaders started in junior positions.
Continuous learning: access to our Technology Academy, Udemy courses, webinars, and company‑funded certifications.
Flexibility: remote work options, flexible working policies, and social benefits (meal vouchers, transport, childcare support, private health insurance, etc.).
Well‑being: our WeCare program supports employees in critical situations.
Personal development: annual training budget to boost both your hard and soft skills.

Who are we?

Amaris Consulting, part of Mantu is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1,000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects for over a decade – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Our solutions focus on four different Business Lines: Information System & Digital, Telecom, Life Sciences and Engineering. We’re focused on building and nurturing a top talent community where all our team members can achieve their full potential. Amaris is your steppingstone to cross rivers of change, meet challenges and achieve all your projects with success.

At Amaris, we strive to provide our candidates with the best possible recruitment experience. We like to get to know our candidates, challenge them, and be able to give them proper feedback as quickly as possible. Here's what our recruitment process looks like:

Brief Call
: Our process typically begins with a brief virtual/phone conversation to get to know you! The objective? Learn about you, understand your motivations, and make sure we have the right job for you!

Interviews
(the average number of interviews is 3 - the number may vary depending on the level of seniority required for the position). During the interviews, you will meet people from our team: your line manager of course, but also other people related to your future role. We will talk in depth about you, your experience, and skills, but also about the position and what will be expected of you. Of course, you will also get to know Amaris: our culture, our roots, our teams, and your career opportunities!

Case study
: Depending on the position, we may ask you to take a test. This could be a role play, a technical assessment, a problem-solving scenario, etc.

As you know, every person is different and so is every role in a company. That is why we have to adapt accordingly, and the process may differ slightly at times. However, please know that we always put ourselves in the candidate's shoes to ensure they have the best possible experience.

We look forward to meeting you!

ing-Techniken

jobs.title: (Senior) SQL Server DBA & Database Developer
jobs.description:
Te veel vacatures in IT? Stop met zoeken en word DBA bij Monta!

### **Over Monta**


Monta is hét e\-commerce bedrijf dat de logistiek voor ruim 3\.000 webwinkels verzorgt. We werken vanuit meerdere zelfstandige e\-commerce warehouses en zorgen wereldwijd voor de verwerking en bezorging van orders van haar klanten.

### **Over de rol**


Als SQL Server DBA \& Database Developer ben jij verantwoordelijk voor een omvangrijk SQL Server\-landschap met bedrijfskritische databases. Je werkt samen met softwareontwikkelaars, architecten en infrastructuurspecialisten aan een platform dat continu groeit. Je combineert operationeel beheer met databaseontwikkeling en denkt actief mee over performance, schaalbaarheid, beveiliging en toekomstige ontwikkelingen.


Daarnaast speel je een belangrijke rol bij de verdere professionalisering van ons databaseplatform en draag je actief bij aan Cloud ontwikkelingen binnen Azure.

### **Het team**


Je komt terecht binnen het IT\-team van Monta, waar development, operations en innovatie nauw samenwerken. Je werkt dagelijks samen met softwareontwikkelaars, architecten en infrastructuurspecialisten aan een platform dat continu in ontwikkeling is.


Als database specialist ben jij dé inhoudelijke sparringpartner voor alles wat betrekking heeft op SQL Server, databasearchitectuur en performance.

### **Wat ga je doen?**

* Beheer, configuratie en optimalisatie van SQL Server\-omgevingen
* Ontwerpen en verbeteren van databasestructuren en datamodellen
* Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van complexe T\-SQL oplossingen, stored procedures en views
* Query tuning en performance optimalisatie van bedrijfskritische applicaties
* Ontwerpen en beheren van indexstrategieën en partitioning\-oplossingen
* Opzetten en beheren van monitoring\- en beheeroplossingen
* Implementeren van security\-, encryptie\- en compliance\-maatregelen
* Beheer van Always On Availability Groups en high\-availability oplossingen
* Automatiseren van beheerprocessen middels PowerShell
* Uitvoeren en optimaliseren van back\-up\-, recovery\- en onderhoudsprocessen
* Ondersteunen van ontwikkelteams met databasevraagstukken en performance analyses
* Adviseren over architectuur, schaalbaarheid en toekomstige databaseontwikkelingen
* Actief bijdragen aan cloudontwikkelingen binnen Azure

  

Daarnaast deel je actief je kennis met collega's en help je ontwikkelteams om databases optimaal te gebruiken.

### **Wie zoeken wij?**


Je bent iemand die energie krijgt van complexe databaseomgevingen en technische uitdagingen. Je werkt graag aan bedrijfskritische systemen, denkt proactief mee over verbeteringen en voelt eigenaarschap voor jouw omgeving. Je bent zorgvuldig, kwaliteitsgericht en weet technische vraagstukken helder te bespreken met zowel ontwikkelaars als andere stakeholders. Daarnaast deel je graag jouw kennis met collega's en blijf je jezelf ontwikkelen binnen je vakgebied.

  

Daarnaast beschik je over:

* HBO werk\- en denkniveau
* Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als SQL Server DBA, Database Developer of vergelijkbare functie
* Ervaring met grote en bedrijfskritische SQL Server\-omgevingen

  

Je hebt diepgaande kennis van **meerdere** van onderstaande onderwerpen:

* SQL Server configuratie en beheer
* Data modellering en normalisatie
* T\-SQL en stored procedures
* tSQLt database unit testing
* Query tuning en performance troubleshooting
* Isolation levels en concurrency
* Indexes en indexed views
* Table partitioning
* Data archivering
* Back\-up\-, restore\- en onderhoudsprocessen (o.a. Ola Hallengren)
* Multi\-server administration
* Monitoring met Query Store, sp\_WhoIsActive en Extended Events
* Security, autorisaties en encryptie
* Always On Availability Groups (Enterprise Edition)
* Service Broker
* Full\-Text Search
* Werken met multi\-terabyte databases
* Datawarehousing principes
* PowerShell automatisering
* Azure (IaaS en PaaS)
* GitHub en versiebeheer

  

Daarnaast worden wij extra enthousiast als je beschikt over Microsoft SQL Server\- of Azure\-certificeringen, ervaring hebt binnen een complexe softwareontwikkelomgeving, bekend bent met DevOps en CI/CD\-processen of al hebt gewerkt met AI\-ondersteunde tooling binnen development en beheer.

### **Interesse?**


Ben jij de SQL Server specialist die ervoor zorgt dat onze systemen altijd snel, veilig en beschikbaar blijven? Solliciteer dan direct en word onderdeel van het IT\-team van Monta.

### **Bureaus en derden**


Hee topverkoper!


We weten dat jij DE perfecte kandidaat voor ons hebt! Laten wij nou net het allerbeste HR\-team van Nederland zijn! Wij werven onze nieuwe Monta toppers dan ook he\-le\-maal zelf. Ontzettend bedankt voor je interesse, een belletje/mailtje wordt niet op prijs gesteld. We wensen je een stralende dag toe!

jobs.title: Product Owner Data Platform
jobs.description:
**Product Owner Data Platform** **(Amersfoort)**

ANVA bouwt al meer dan 50 jaar de software waarop de Nederlandse verzekeringsmarkt draait. Meer dan 21 miljoen polissen draaien op ons platform, samen goed voor bijna 60% van het premievolume in de markt. Iedere dag werken meer dan 10\.000 professionals met onze software. Vrijwel elke Nederlander heeft een verzekering die op ANVA draait.

Nu bouwen we de volgende generatie van dat platform en migreren we een groot bestaand klantenbestand hiernaartoe. In al die polissen zit informatie waarmee onze klanten hun bedrijf kunnen sturen. Als Product Owner Data Platform bouw je de propositie die deze informatie toegankelijk en waardevol maakt.

**AI bij ANVA**

ANVA wil het tempo bepalen op het gebied van AI in verzekeringssoftware, niet volgen.

Op het dataplatform maken we die ambitie concreet: AI die patronen in een portefeuille zichtbaar maakt, afwijkingen signaleert voordat klanten ze zelf ontdekken en vragen over de eigen organisatie beantwoordt zonder dat iemand eerst een rapport hoeft te bouwen.

We verwachten dat AI een centraal onderdeel is van hoe je werkt en vragen je om tijdens het sollicitatieproces te laten zien wat je ermee hebt gebouwd.

**Jouw impact**

Je bent eigenaar van het dataplatform waarmee onze klanten inzicht krijgen in hun eigen organisatie, waaronder productiviteit, commerciële resultaten, efficiëntie en portefeuilleprestaties.

Klanten kunnen deze inzichten afnemen via API's, rechtstreeks of via een tussenpartij, en via geïntegreerde BI\-tooling binnen het platform zelf.

Dit is geen ondersteunende laag, maar een propositie op zichzelf, met ruimte om uit te groeien tot een zelfstandig product. Je bepaalt welke inzichten we bieden, hoe klanten erbij komen en waar we geld mee verdienen. Je werkt in een duo met de Engineering Manager, die verantwoordelijk is voor de engineering binnen het team.

**In deze rol**

* Bepaal je de productstrategie en roadmap voor het dataplatform als klantpropositie.
* Bepaal je welke inzichten we leveren op het gebied van productiviteit, commerciële resultaten, efficiëntie en portefeuille\-inzicht.
* Ontwikkel je de manieren waarop klanten die informatie afnemen: via API's, via tussenpartijen en via geïntegreerde BI\-tooling.
* Bouw je de propositie uit tot een zelfstandig product met een eigen verdienmodel.
* Zet je AI in om inzichten te leveren die klanten zelf niet uit hun data zouden halen.
* Werk je samen met commerciële collega's aan positionering, prijsstelling en marktintroductie.

**In je eerste jaar**

* Ligt er een gepubliceerde roadmap voor het dataplatform als propositie, gedragen door Product Management en Commercie.
* Nemen klanten inzichten af via zowel de API als de geïntegreerde BI\-tooling.
* Is ten minste één nieuw inzichtenproduct succesvol in de markt gezet en actief in gebruik.
* Ligt er een onderbouwd verdienmodel voor de propositie.

**Wie je bent**

Je begrijpt dataplatforms én hoe je er een product van maakt dat klanten daadwerkelijk willen kopen. Je bent net zo thuis in een gesprek over datamodellen en API's als in de vraag waar een gevolmachtigd agent of verzekeraar voor wil betalen. Je denkt in proposities, niet in rapporten.

* HBO\- of WO\-werk\- en denkniveau, met aantoonbare ervaring als Product Owner of Product Manager van een dataplatform of dataproduct.
* Ervaring met het vermarkten van data, bijvoorbeeld analytics, BI of data als commerciële propositie.
* Inzicht in hoe klanten data afnemen via API's, tussenpartijen en ingebouwde tooling.
* Voldoende technische diepgang om goede afwegingen te maken met engineering.
* AI staat al centraal in hoe je werkt en je kunt laten zien wat je ermee hebt gebouwd.
* Affiniteit met verzekeren of de financiële sector is een pre.

**Eerlijk over de rol**

De propositie is nog niet volledig uitgewerkt. Er ligt een platform en er is een duidelijke ambitie, maar wat we precies verkopen, aan wie en tegen welke prijs, bepaal jij mede.

Dat betekent dat je een deel van je tijd bezig bent met vragen waarop nog geen antwoord bestaat en dat je zowel commercie als engineering moet meenemen in de keuzes die gemaakt worden.

Deze rol is minder geschikt voor iemand die vooral een bestaande roadmap wil uitvoeren. Wie energie krijgt van het neerzetten van een nieuwe propositie, vindt hier juist veel ruimte en verantwoordelijkheid.

**Waar je terechtkomt**

ANVA ontwikkelt al meer dan 50 jaar software voor de verzekeringsbranche. Wat begon als een initiatief vanuit de sector, is uitgegroeid tot een fintechbedrijf dat dagelijks door meer dan 10\.000 professionals wordt gebruikt.

Met onze software helpen we verzekeraars, gevolmachtigd agenten en adviseurs om miljoenen eindklanten beter te bedienen.

Vanuit onze kantoren in Amersfoort en Bergen op Zoom geven ruim 220 collega's vorm aan de toekomst van financiële dienstverlening met slimme technologie. AI is voor ons geen experiment, maar een kernonderdeel van hoe we het platform bouwen en verbeteren.

Naast technologie maakt vooral onze samenwerking het verschil: over disciplines heen, met eigenaarschap en de ambitie om elke dag beter te worden.

**Wat we bieden**

* Marktconform salaris \+ dertiende maand
* Een tijdelijke workation vanaf een van onze internationale locaties in het Caribisch gebied.
* Een thuiswerkbudget van €750 om je werkplek goed in te richten.
* Een dertiende maand.
* 27,5 vakantiedagen.
* Een premievrij pensioen, volledig betaald door ANVA.
* Opleiding, coaching en internationale doorgroeimogelijkheden.
* Barista\-koffie, verse sappen en vers fruit op kantoor.

**Solliciteer als je**

* Een propositie wilt neerzetten in plaats van een backlog wilt afwerken.
* Data net zo goed begrijpt als klantwaarde en verdienmodellen.
* Trots bent op hoe je met AI werkt en dat graag laat zien.
* Wilt dat duizenden professionals hun organisatie sturen op basis van wat jij bouwt.

**Solliciteer niet als je**

* AI nog geen serieus onderdeel van je werk hebt gemaakt.
* Een uitgewerkte roadmap wilt uitvoeren in plaats van er zelf een te ontwikkelen.
* Liever op afstand blijft van de commerciële kant van het product.
* Volledig op afstand wilt werken.

**Klaar om mee te bouwen?**

Laat het ons weten! Stuur je CV of stuur ons iets dat je met AI hebt gebouwd en help mee het platform verder te ontwikkelen waarop de Nederlandse verzekeringsmarkt draait.

Soort dienstverband: Fulltime, Vaste baan

Salaris: Tot €100\.000,00 per jaar

Arbeidsvoorwaarden:

* Bedrijfsfeesten
* Bedrijfsopleiding
* Budget voor professionele ontwikkeling
* Extra vakantiedagen
* Fietsplan
* Kerstpakket
* Kosteloos parkeren
* Lunchkorting
* Pensioen
* Reiskostenvergoeding
* Vrijdagmiddagborrel

* Heb je ervaring in een software product organisatie?

Taal:

* Nederlands (Vereist)

Werklocatie: Hybride werken in 3817 Amersfoort

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
**What is Digital Speed?**

Digital Speed is a full\-service product and engineering agency delivering strategy, design, and development for global clients. Our expertise spans Brand, Discovery, UX/UI, and Full\-Stack Engineering, alongside product strategy and marketing. We partner with organisations in finance, automotive, sport, and technology to ship dependable, high\-quality outcomes at scale.We are driven by 4 key values:

* Open – We arrive with options, welcome feedback, and find the best way forward together.
* Thriving – New challenges energise us; we learn and improve as a team.
* Experts – Specialists who care about their craft and deliver results with structure.
* Caring – We take our clients’ goals as seriously as our own and build trusted relationships.

**Where do you fit in?**

You'll join as a full\-stack engineer in London, working closely with agency leadership and a client teams to build various products. Your main account will include a product aimed at engineers and AI coding agents. You'll shape high\-quality engineering practices, reusable components, strong pipelines, production\-ready software while owning the parts of the product that determine whether developers and agents actually succeed with it: documentation, onboarding, and sandbox testing. This is a role for someone who enjoys breadth and ownership: context\-switching across languages, designing for both human and machine consumers, and collaborating across agency and client teams.

**Responsibilities**

* **Core Engineering:** Design and build robust, reusable services and libraries across multiple languages (Java, .NET, Python, TypeScript, Go), for a product consumed by both developers and AI coding agents.
* **Documentation:** Build and maintain a docs\-as\-code platform \- API references, quickstarts, and guides \- structured for both human readability and machine parsing (OpenAPI/JSON Schema, MCP tool definitions, llms.txt where relevant).
* **Onboarding:** Design and build the onboarding path from signup to first successful integration \- CLI/SDK scaffolding, guided setup, and error handling clear enough for an agent to self\-correct on, not just a human.
* **Sandbox Testing:** Build isolated sandbox environments \- mock services, seeded test data, ephemeral instances \- where engineers and agents can safely test integrations without touching production.
* **Architecture \& Review:** Analyse requirements, propose technical approaches, and lead peer reviews to maintain high standards.
* **CI/CD \& Quality Gates:** Implement and refine pipelines with linting, tests/coverage, artifact signing, and versioning discipline.
* **Release Management:** Ensure clean, traceable, secure releases across environments, with strong changelog hygiene — especially important where agents consume versioned APIs programmatically.
* **Collaboration \& Handover:** Work directly with the client's Architecture/Platform teams; produce documentation, run\-books, and recorded walkthroughs as part of agency delivery.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Optimise build times, automate repeatable tasks, and keep outputs deterministic and reproducible.

**Characteristics**

* **Simplify:** Turn messy requirements into clear, repeatable systems \- and clear systems into documentation that needs no follow\-up questions.
* **High\-performance:** Care about reliability, observability, and regression safety.
* **Collaborative:** Give/receive reviews; document decisions; unblock others.
* **First\-principles:** Handle ambiguity and make trade\-offs explicit.
* **Ownership:** Proactive, organised, and comfortable leading end\-to\-end \- from architecture through to the docs page a developer or an agent is reading when they get stuck.

**Requirements**

* 5\+ years building production software (libraries, services, or dev\-tools a plus \- developer platforms or API products especially relevant here).
* Proficiency in Java \& TypeScript. Skills in C\#/.NET, Python \& Go are a bonus.
* Solid grasp of modern API and integration patterns.
* Experience building or maintaining developer\-facing documentation: docs\-as\-code, API reference generation, or interactive examples.
* Comfortable with CI/CD (GitHub Actions and/or Jenkins), git, and code review.
* Experience publishing artifacts and managing repos (Maven, NuGet, PyPI, Nexus/Artifactory).
* Working knowledge of semantic versioning, release notes, and changelog hygiene.
* Basic security hygiene: artifact signing, checksums, SBOM mindset.
* Right to work in the UK; fluent in written and spoken English.

**Desirable Extras**

* Experience designing APIs or tools built for AI agent consumption \- function calling, MCP, tool/schema design.
* Building sandbox environments, mock servers, or contract/conformance testing frameworks.
* Go (concurrency patterns), idiomatic TypeScript design.
* Docs\-as\-code, ADRs, conformance/contract testing.
* Exposure to OAuth/OIDC, mTLS, and PKI basics.
* Cloud \& infra awareness (AWS/Azure/GCP, containers, runners).
* Prior agency/consulting experience and/or regulated industries.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: £45,000\.00\-£65,000\.00 per year

Ability to commute/relocate:

* London W2 6LG: reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (required)

Application question(s):

* What is your current notice period?

Language:

* English (required)

Work authorisation:

* United Kingdom (required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in London W2 6LG

jobs.title: 2027 Software Dev Engineer Intern - Poland
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Do you want to solve real customer problems through innovative technology? Do you enjoy working on scalable services in a collaborative team environment? Do you want to see your code directly impact millions of customers worldwide?
  

  

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. Customer obsession is part of our company DNA, which has made us one of the world's most beloved brands.
  

  

Our Software Development Engineer (SDE) interns use modern technology to solve complex problems while seeing their work's impact first\-hand. The challenges SDE interns solve at Amazon are meaningful and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products globally. We seek individuals passionate about creating new products, features, and services while managing ambiguity in an environment where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years.
  

  

At Amazon, we believe in ownership at every level. As an SDE intern, you'll own the entire lifecycle of your code \- from design through deployment and ongoing operations. This ownership mindset, combined with our commitment to operational excellence, ensures we deliver the highest quality solutions for our customers.
  

  

We're looking for curious minds who think big and want to define tomorrow's technology. At Amazon, you'll grow into the high\-impact engineer you know you can be, supported by a culture of learning and mentorship. Every day brings exciting new challenges and opportunities for personal growth.
  

  

Amazon internships across all seasons are full\-time positions, and interns should expect to work in office, Monday\-Friday, up to 40 hours per week typically between 8am\-5pm. Specific team norms around working hours will be communicated by your manager. Interns should not have conflicts such as classes or other employment during the Amazon work\-day. Applicants should have a minimum of one quarter/semester/trimester remaining in their studies after their internship concludes.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Collaborate and communicate effectively with experienced cross\-disciplinary Amazonians to design, build, and operate innovative products and services that delight our customers, while participating in technical discussions to drive solutions forward.
  

  

Break down complex, ambiguous problems into well\-defined, solvable components before implementation.
  

  

Contribute to the design and development of scalable, reliable services, with distributed\-systems scope varying by team.
  

  

Participate in code reviews as a core engineering practice, providing constructive feedback and validating correctness.
  

  

Contribute to clear and accurate technical documentation.
  

  

Use GenAI and AI\-powered tools to enhance development productivity, and critically validate, verify, and integrate AI\-generated code, exercising sound judgement about when to trust AI output.
  

  

Write clean, maintainable code following best practices and design patterns.
  

  

Work in an agile environment practicing CI/CD principles while participating in operational responsibilities including on\-call duties.
  

  

Demonstrate operational excellence through monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving production issues.
  

  

A day in the life  

As an intern, you will be matched to a manager and a mentor and will have the opportunity to influence the evolution of Amazon technology and lead critical projects early in your career.
  

  

In addition to working on an impactful project, you will have the opportunity to engage with Amazonians for both personal and professional development, expand your network, and participate in activities with other interns throughout your internship. No matter the location of your internship, we give you the tools to own your project and learn in a real\-world setting.
  

  

About the team  

Intern Community:
  

  

As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a vibrant, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.
  

  

Support:
  

  

The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.
  

  

Learning Sessions:
  

  

Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's cutting\-edge learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.
  

  

Opportunities:
  

  

Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Are enrolled in a Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields at time of application
* Knowledge of computer science fundamentals such as object\-oriented design, operating systems, algorithms, data structures, and complexity analysis
* Experience with at least one general\-purpose programming language such as Java, Python, C\+\+, C\#, Go, Rust, or TypeScript

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience from a technical internship
* Experience with distributed, multi\-tiered systems, algorithms, and relational databases
* Experience in optimization mathematics such as linear programming and nonlinear optimization
* Experience with Cloud platforms (preferably AWS), database systems (SQL and NoSQL), AI tools for development productivity, contributing to open\-source projects, and/or version control systems
* Experience using AI\-assisted development tools in academic or professional settings
* Ability to effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions
* Adept at handling ambiguous or undefined problems as well as ability to think abstractly
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.  

The minimum gross base pay salary for this position is listed below. The base salary listed corresponds to working on a full\-time basis. For part\-time hours, the salary will be pro\-rated.


Company supplementary benefits apply subject to further terms, including pension plans, health insurance, life and disability insurance, business travel insurance, MultiSport card, employee discount code and program (EDC/Extras), and the Employee Assistance Program (private and confidential counselling and referral service to support health and well\-being).
