Company Description

Netcompany was founded in 2000 with the headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark. Today, we are an international company with more than 9000+ employees working from over 10 locations. We serve a wide array of customers in their digital transformation journeys in public and private sectors across Europe.

We are excited by the challenge of doing things differently. At Netcompany we rely on one another and we develop quickly. We are team players. We change societies by creating life-changing IT solutions for variety of customers – from small private companies to large projects in the public sector. Our culture builds on low bureaucracy with a strong focus on high agility and flexibility.

Job Description

Continue your development with us

In Netcompany we focus on your personal and professional development. We offer a structured career model where you can build upon the experiences you bring with you.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will be your sparring partner for your ongoing development as well as for your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in the leadership group provides you with concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and wishes.

Furthermore, you will participate in our training program, Netcompany Academy, where you will be offered courses and seminars tailored to your career stage. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your expertise. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company also creates a strong network and provides a solid foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Be a part of an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we prioritize community highly. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture that is built on collaboration and trust, and where there is always room for mutual sparring and support.

It is part of our culture and values that all employees, irrespective of backgrounds, identities, and experiences, are met with understanding and respect, as well as equal opportunities for development and well-being.

You will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate with colleagues from various cultures and nationalities, as we are an international company with offices in many countries.

We provide a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we offer a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network already early in your career.

As our new colleague in the Cloud Platform Services team, you will play a key role in agile projects for both large Danish and international customers. You have a unique opportunity to be part of a team responsible for multiple disciplines: Cloud Governance, Cloud Operations, Cloud Center of Excellence, and Cloud Consultancy.

We design and implement business-critical solutions on state-of-the-art infrastructure for customers, where you get hands-on experience with Azure. You will help build and operate our central architecture and solutions, impacting all our cloud solutions across all customers. You will ensure operations in the intersection of infrastructure, security, and the development of customer solutions. Additionally, you will have the opportunity to be lent out to other projects within the organization as a cloud consultant for both shorter and longer periods. All of which we convert to services that enhance and develop our central capability.

As a Cloud DevOps Engineer, Your Tasks Will Include

Monitoring, alerting, automation, and scaling of cloud solutions.
Creating coherence between development, operations, and security in accordance with DevOps and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tasks, e.g., Terraform, Bicep.
Operating with Version controlling system, e.g., Git.
Automation and standardization of Cloud Infrastructure processes (PowerShell/ Azure CLI).
Design and implementation of Cloud governance solutions.
Delivering internal methods/methodologies/principles into customer projects.
Leading or contributing to technical initiatives in the internal cloud infrastructure through experience from customer projects.

Qualifications

We expect that you:

Have a bachelor's, master's, or engineering degree in ICT/IT, computer science, software/computer engineering, infrastructure, or other relevant vocational education experience.
Have experience with coding/scripting (.NET, Java, Web, PowerShell, Python) and/or DevOps (Terraform, CI/CD) from education or previous work.
Have experience with Azure or other Global Cloud Providers (e.g., AWS, GCP, OCI) from education or previous work.
Possess an analytical mindset, are motivated, and know how to work in a structured manner.
Have good communication skills and Teamwork.
Have an excellent command of the English Language (written & verbal).
Have to be a member of the on-call duty shift outside of business hours.
It would be beneficial (but not a must) if you:
Have work experience.
Have experience with infrastructure and operations.
Have experience with IaaS or PaaS services in cloud-hosted environments.
Have certification in Azure or other relevant Microsoft areas.
Have experience with Kubernetes, containers, or Docker.

Additional Information

Benefits we offer:

Scandinavian work environment.
Medical Insurance, Life Insurance, Multisport Card.
English and Danish language lessons.
Drinks, snacks & fruit available at the office.
Career development programme for each employee and regular feedback.
Internal and external training and certifications.
International cooperation with colleagues from Denmark, the Netherlands, Norway, the UK, and Vietnam.
Attractive office with a view and great location in Warsaw (Metro Wilanowska).

Do you still have questions?

Please upload your CV to our recruitment system via the link. If you haven't received answers to all your questions, feel free to reach out to pl.hr@netcompany.com

We are a Disability Confident Employer and are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment that welcomes every individual. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please send an email to pl.hr@netcompany.com for assistance.

All qualified candidates are invited to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disabilities, age, religion and beliefs, political beliefs, nationality, ethnic or social background.

Är du en erfaren konsult som brinner för att skapa välfungerande och optimerade molnlösningar? Vill du vara med och skapa framtidens digitalisering med hjälp av Cloud? Hos oss på Accigo får du vara med och stärka cloudaffären samtidigt som du utvecklar ditt självledarskap genom frihet under ansvar.

Vem är du?

Vi vill jobba med dig som vill vara med och bygga branschens starkaste affär och team inom Azure cloud consulting. Du drivs av teknisk utveckling samtidigt som du är en stjärna på att kommunicera på ett enkelt språk med kunder och kollegor. Du är lyhörd för kundens nuvarande behov och vågar samtidigt utmana befintliga arbetssätt och lösningar.

Vi söker dig som har

Flerårig erfarenhet av design och implementation av lösningar i Azure, inklusive god kännedom om Microsoft well architected framework & Cloud adoption framework.
Du har jobbat med on premises- eller hybrida system.
Du är bevandrad inom agilt arbetssätt och har stor kunskap av DevOps.
Kompetens inom Infrastructure as code (IaC) & PowerShell/CLI
Du har viss erfarenhet av att designa nätverk och tillhörande komponenter, i Azure och OnPrem.
Du har erfarenhet inom kravinsamling och presale-arbete
Mycket god kommunikationsförmåga och förmågan att leda ditt projekt och dig själv.
Gedigen erfarenhet som konsult där du jobbat med medelstora och stora bolag.

Ett plus om du har

Du har erfarenhet att vårda kundrelationer och driva säljprocesser
Erfarenhet av andra publika molntjänster
Microsoft Certifikat: AZ-104, AZ-305 och AZ-400
IT-Arkitektcertifiering från Dataföreningen eller liknade instans.
Erfarenhet av Cisco och Ubiquitinätverkstekniker

Detta kommer du att göra

Vi arbetar med att möjliggöra våra kunders digitalseringsresor genom att vara djupt tekniska specialister på kundens teknikplattformar, med utgångspunkt i Microsofts ekosystem. Du kommer jobba med kunder som behöver hjälp att flytta upp sina On Premis miljöer till Azure. Du kommer att designa lösningarna utifrån kundens krav och Microsoft well architected framework. Samt hjälpa till att implementera lösningarna.

Vi lägger stor vikt på gemensamma teamleveranser och vi samarbetar ofta med andra team på Accigo. Därför är det viktigt att du trivs med att jobba tillsammans med andra och samtidigt tar ansvar för din egen leverans.

I din roll som Cloud-arkitekt kommer du att agera lösningsarkitekt i våra kunduppdrag, hjälpa till med införsäljning, genomföra externa och interna kompetensutvecklingsinitiativ, design och uppsättning av Azurelösningar, samt hands-on och problemlösning. Du förväntas driva uppdrag och ta stort eget ansvar i dina projekt. Du kommer med din kompetens och branscherfarenhet vara en mycket viktig länk mellan affärsverksamhet och IT-infrastrukturen i Azure.

Vårt team

Vi är ett nyfiket och samarbetsvilligt team, med ett gemensamt brinnande intresse för teknik och digitalisering. Vi ser oss som Sveriges vassaste (och gladaste) team inom våra fokusområden, och har en långsiktig strategi att växa och bli fler. Vi arbetar dagligen med varandra, både i kundleveranser och med erbjudandeutveckling och att driva våra fokusområden.

Förutom att arbeta tillsammans bjuder vi även in till frukostar där vi delar med oss av pinsamheter och udda fakta, kompetensspridning, veckovisa team-träffar och spontana fikastunder. Vi strävar efter att skapa en vardag fylld med spännande projekt och möjligheter hos kund, samt glädje, energi och gemenskap i teamet där dina idéer får ta plats.

Kompensation och förmåner

Vår förmånspolicy är utvecklad för att möta både dina professionella och personliga behov. I vårt omfattande förmånspaket ingår friskvårdsbidrag, tjänstepension och frivillig sjukvårdsförsäkring. Vår ersättningsmodell består av en konkurrenskraftig fast del och en rörlig del som ger dig möjlighet att påverka din lön baserat på din prestation och ambition. Vi erbjuder både professionell och personlig utveckling.

Har du några frågor eller är du bara nyfiken? Vi berättar gärna mer om oss över en kaffe: tyra.drakenberg@accigo.se

Accigo är ett konsultbolag som hjälper företag och organisationer med digital affärs- och verksamhetsutveckling med tekniken som möjliggörare. För oss handlar digitalisering till 90% om människor och 10% om teknik. Det är när samspelet mellan människa och teknik fungerar som digitaliseringens fulla styrka visar sig.

För många handlar digitalisering mest om teknik. För oss är det så otroligt mycket större. Omnium develops a 100% cloud-based Order Management System (OMS) that helps businesses consolidate and handle orders from all sales channels; e-commerce, customer service, POS systems and more. Our solution simplifies complex processes and creates a seamless and efficient shopping experience.

We like to call ourselves a start-up with eight years of experience. With some of the Nordics' largest retail and brand players in our customer portfolio and a rapidly growing market, we are well positioned for further expansion. With us, you'll help build a product in strong development – with modern technology, high pace and no legacy.

THE ROLE

As a fullstack developer at Omnium, you'll become part of a cross-functional development team. You'll work closely with a modern SaaS platform built on .NET, with Azure, Elasticsearch and Vue.js, used by some of the Nordics' largest commerce players. You'll work across the stack, from backend to frontend, and take technical ownership of how functionality is designed, built and further developed in production.

This is a domain-heavy role. Our customers are retailers and brands running high volumes across e-commerce, stores and customer service, and their business logic lives in our platform — orders, inventory, fulfilment, returns, payments, channel complexity. Setting up Omnium well means genuinely understanding how each customer operates, so we're looking for someone who recognises these processes from experience and can translate them into solid technical solutions.

HERE YOU'LL GET:

Technical ownership of the development of a complex and modern SaaS platform
Variety between back-end (C#/.NET, integrations, API development) and front-end (Vue.js)
A short path from idea to production in close collaboration with product and design
Significant influence on architecture, technical choices, priorities and how we work as a development team
The opportunity to work in a strong technical team where you actively participate in code reviews and technical discussions, contributing to better code quality, performance and stability

WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS

Experience building systems for retail or e-commerce, for example OMS, ERP, e-commerce platforms, POS, WMS, payments or logistics. This is a requirement: you need to understand the commerce domain, not just the code
5+ years of experience as a developer, preferably from SaaS or other complex systems in production

In this software engineering role, you will work as part of a multi-disciplinary agile team developing software that helps clinicians monitor patients and make timely care decisions. You will learn and apply modern software engineering practices in a regulated medical device environment, with support from experienced engineers and the wider team. Continuously build technical skills, product understanding, and knowledge of software development in a regulated healthcare environment.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll focus on designing and implementing 3D model conversion and checking algorithms while helping guide our transition to a modular, component\-based architecture. If you’re looking for a role that combines technical depth with architectural influence, it’s a strong match.

#### **Who are we**


BIMcollab is a global market leader in BIM quality control and collaboration tools, helping the construction industry build smarter, faster, and more sustainably. Making 3D models run smoothly in the browser is anything but simple. Massive files, fast rendering, real\-time interactions \- users expect it all to work seamlessly.


We empower users to create and maintain high\-quality buildings that are circular, energy efficient, and offer a safe environment. We shape the construction industry by facilitating an integrated BIM process with fast, innovative, and user\-friendly solutions that integrate with all popular BIM tools. Through high\-quality, service\-oriented support, we let our users experience the power and joy of a smooth BIM process.

#### **What you’ll do**


As an engineer of our SaaS platform organization, you will work on core capabilities that are critical to the performance, scalability, and quality of our product. Your focus will be on developing and optimizing complex, performance\-sensitive functionality where accuracy and efficiency are key differentiators for our customers.


You will collaborate in a multidisciplinary, agile setup alongside product, engineering, and quality roles, contributing to both the technical direction and the continuous improvement of our platform.


You will:

* Design and implement performance\-sensitive core platform functionality
* Develop and optimize 3D model conversion and validation algorithms
* Contribute to the transition toward a modular, cloud\-enabled architecture
* Work across desktop and cloud environments (Azure, Windows, Mac)
* Mentor and support fellow engineers while ensuring best practices are applied
* Balance new feature development with long\-term technical improvements
* Keep a strong focus on security, quality, and delivered business value

**Our tech stack**


Backend: mostly C\#, with some C\+\+  

Frontend: VueJS, React  

Cloud: Azure

#### **What we offer**


You’ll join a team with international impact and work on a platform used by some of the world’s largest construction companies. You can expect:

* A competitive salary of 4\.900 \- €7\.000 based on experience
* 27 vacation days \+ option to buy extra days
* Strong benefits package including a generous pension scheme
* Green benefits (e.g. home sustainability reimbursements, bike scheme)
* €1,500 annual learning budget \+ room for personal and professional growth
* Hybrid work: 2 days per week at the office in the heart of Eindhoven
* A nearly energy\-neutral office environment
* Monthly home\-office allowance
* Up to 4 weeks per year fully remote from abroad
* Daily catered lunch and fresh fruit

#### **What you bring**

* You have 5\+ years software engineering and have strong knowledge of computer science fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, and performance.
* You have good knowledge of and experience using, Design Patterns, SOLID principles and TDD and you value an agile mindset.
* You have a proven record of working with large\-scale applications.
* You can mentor and help other Engineers grow or you would like to develop these skills.
* You thrive in a highly collaborative environment where innovation and initiative is valued.
* You have a learning mindset and continually research best practices and new tooling.

**Bonus points**

* You have experience with software optimization and algorithms.
* Knowledge and experience in 3D technology or BIM.
* Knowledge and experience in component based development and API\-first development.

#### **The work environment**


Our engineering team consists of over 40 Engineers, Testers, and Product Owners, divided over six Scrum teams. Our development team is diverse and international (we have over 20 nationalities!), and our working language is English.

  

At BIMcollab, we strive for an inclusive and diverse work environment where everyone is welcome, regardless of their background, gender, age, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, or disability. We encourage applicants with diverse perspectives and backgrounds to apply and believe in equal opportunities for all. We value the unique contributions that each employee can make and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is respected and appreciated.

#### **Interested? We’d love to meet you!**


Do you recognize yourself in the above? Then apply immediately! Do you want to know more? Then take a look around at www.bimcollab.com. For questions, you can always call us at \+31 (0\)40 213 1950\.


Acquisition in response to this vacancy is not appreciated.

Our software connects terminals, vessel operators, and supply chain partners worldwide, helping them collaborate more efficiently across liquid and dry bulk operations.


You **design, build, and improve** scalable enterprise applications within a modern Microsoft ecosystem. Working primarily with C\#, .NET and related technologies, you will contribute to software solutions that control hardware, acquire and process scientific data, and provide advanced data visualisation and analysis capabilities.

  

This is a hands\-on software engineering role supporting multiple products and projects across Andor's portfolio. You will work closely with multi\-disciplinary teams to deliver robust, maintainable and high\-quality software that enables customers to achieve groundbreaking scientific results.

  

Key responsibilities include:

  

* Design, develop, maintain and support customer\-facing Windows desktop applications using C\# and .NET.

jobs.title: AI Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Wij zoeken een ervaren .NET-developer die de stap naar architectuur heeft gemaakt en zich de afgelopen jaren actief is gaan verdiepen in AI. Iemand met een stevige basis in C#/.NET, die weet wat er nodig is om software in productie te krijgen en te houden, en die zijn technische kennis en nieuwsgierigheid naar AI nu wil inzetten om het totaalontwerp van AI-oplossingen naar zich toe te trekken.

Concreet: samen met onze andere senior engineers bepaal je welke modellen en infrastructuur we inzetten, hoe die aansluiten op de bestaande systemen van ons en onze klanten, en je bouwt zelf mee om het werkend te krijgen. We zoeken nadrukkelijk geen AI-specialist zonder developmentachtergrond, en ook geen developer zonder affiniteit met AI. We zoeken de combinatie: een doorgewinterde .NET-engineer die het pad naar AI is ingeslagen.

Groeien met Hoppinger

We zijn eerlijk over waar we staan. Hoppinger is op dit moment nog geen AI-native organisatie. Onze platformen voor bedrijfskritische processen in zorg, housing, kennis en onderwijs en industrie zijn gebouwd op een stevige softwarebasis, met C#/.NET als belangrijk fundament. AI voegen we daar gericht aan toe.
De ambitie is wel duidelijk: we groeien naar een AI-first manier van werken, waarbij AI geen losstaand experiment is, maar een beheersbaar en schaalbaar onderdeel van het platform. Om die stap te zetten hebben we mensen nodig die hun technische ervaring en hun nieuwsgierigheid naar AI al effectief combineren in de praktijk. Jij helpt die transformatie waarmaken en geeft er mede richting aan.

Jouw rol: van bedrijfsprobleem naar werkende oplossing

Je vertaalt het vraagstuk van onze klanten naar een technische oplossing en bepaalt hoe AI wordt ingezet binnen hun platformen. Dat is breder dan modellen kiezen: het gaat om het ontwerpen van een complete oplossing, van architectuur tot productie. Je staat met één been in de code en met het andere aan het whiteboard bij de directie van onze klanten.
Je dagen zijn afwisselend en bestaan onder andere uit:
Het vertalen van een bedrijfsprobleem naar een technische architectuur
Het beoordelen welke AI-aanpak past: agents, klassieke ML of een combinatie, en de afweging tussen bouwen, kopen of een API aanroepen
Het zelf meebouwen aan oplossingen, in een omgeving waar C#/.NET en moderne frameworks de basis van onze platformen vormen
Het bewaken van non-functionals: schaalbaarheid, latency, kosten, beveiliging en compliance
Het werken aan agentic systemen: orkestratie, tool use, human-in-the-loop patronen en meer
Het samenwerken met experience architects, engineers en data-analisten, en het leiden van zowel een architectuurreview met developers als een whiteboard-sessie met een directeur

Wie ben jij

Je bent in de eerste plaats een ervaren software engineer met een sterke .NET-achtergrond, doorgegroeid naar een architectuurrol. Je hebt aantoonbaar software gebouwd en live gebracht, en je verdiept je actief in wat er nodig is om AI betrouwbaar in productie te draaien. Die laatste stap heb je al gezet of je bent er serieus mee bezig.
Je herkent jezelf hierin:
Ruime ervaring in softwareontwikkeling, met C#/.NET als vaste waarde in je gereedschapskist. Dit is voor deze rol een harde eis, geen pré
Kennis van softwarearchitectuur: API-design, microservices, event-driven architectuur en containerisatie
Ervaring met minstens één hyperscaler (Azure, AWS of Google Cloud)
Hands-on ervaring met LLM's en het bouwen van AI-toepassingen. Productie-ervaring is een pré, een aantoonbare en al actieve drive om hierin verder te groeien is een eis
Affiniteit met agentic development en de ambitie om je hierin te specialiseren
Het vermogen om technische keuzes uit te leggen aan niet-technische stakeholders, van product owner tot C-level
Relevante certificeringen (zoals Azure Solutions Architect of AWS Solutions Architect) zijn een pré, aantoonbare kennis en ervaring wegen zwaarder

Wat bieden wij

Veel vrijheid en een ambitieuze cultuur waar persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal staat. Natuurlijk draait niet alles om werk, en bovenop alle gebruikelijke benefits die je mag verwachten bieden we ook:
Salaris :
een marktconform salaris, € 4.900 - € 7.500, o.b.v. 40 uur en afhankelijk van ervaring
Celebration Leave: ruil 3 nationale feestdagen in voor jouw eigen feestdagen
Alleo: kies extra benefits op basis van je eigen interesses

Job Description

Stefanini Group is seeking an experienced Network Technical Architect to join our Hybrid Cloud & Infrastructure (HCI) cluster, within the Infrastructure Services Division.

The successful candidate will design and implement secure, resilient enterprise network solutions across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments, covering SASE, ZTNA, next-generation firewalls, SD-WAN, and complex routing.

This role combines presales support for solutioning with extensive hands-on implementation and acts as the last level of support for operational teams. It may include occasional travelling and direct technical discussions with vendors.

Job Responsibilities:

Solution Design and Implementation: Architect, deploy, and migrate enterprise network solutions end to end, including SASE, ZTNA, next-generation firewalls, SD-WAN, and campus and data center networks, remaining hands-on from day 1.
Presales Support: Act as the technical authority in presales engagements, qualifying requirements, designing target architectures, estimating effort, and contributing to RFP/RFI responses, proposals, and customer presentations.
Complex Routing and Cloud Networking: Design and implement complex routing environments (BGP, OSPF, route redistribution, traffic engineering) and cloud networking architectures in AWS and Azure, including hybrid connectivity.
Operational Escalation: Act as the last level of support for operational teams, leading root cause analysis and resolution of the most complex network and security incidents.
Vendor Engagement: Drive technical discussions with vendors and technology partners, including product evaluations, proof of concepts, roadmap reviews, and support escalations.
Documentation and Standards: Produce high-level and low-level designs, migration plans, and operational runbooks; define network standards, reference architectures, and best practices.
Training and Development: Provide training, coaching, and structured knowledge transfer to operational teams and clients on new network technologies and practices.
Continuous Improvement: Continuously evaluate and improve network architectures and strategies to adapt to changing technologies and business needs.

Job Requirements

At least 10 years of hands-on experience designing, implementing, and operating enterprise networks in complex, multi-vendor environments
At least 5 years of experience as a network architect, owning end-to-end solution design for large-scale enterprise environments.
Demonstrated ability to perform hands-on implementation from day 1, combining architecture responsibilities with direct configuration and deployment work.
Preferred: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field preferred. Mandatory: Minimum high school diploma (or equivalent). Bachelor's degree in any field with equivalent professional experience relevant for the job.

Technical Skills:

Expert-level knowledge of routing and switching in complex environments, including BGP, OSPF,route redistribution, and traffic engineering.
Deep hands-on experience with next-generation firewalls (e.g., Fortinet FortiGate, Palo Alto Networks, Check Point), covering design, implementation, upgrades, and migrations.
Strong hands-on experience with SASE and ZTNA solutions (e.g., FortiSASE, Zscaler, Netskope,Prisma Access), from architecture through rollout and day-2 operations.
Proven experience designing and deploying SD-WAN solutions (e.g., Fortinet Secure SD-WAN, Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN, VMware VeloCloud).
Solid experience with cloud networking in AWS and/or Azure, including VPC/VNet design, Transit Gateway, Virtual WAN, ExpressRoute/Direct Connect, and hybrid connectivity.
Strong understanding of network security concepts, including segmentation, IPsec and SSL VPN, IDS/IPS, and Zero Trust principles.
Mandatory 3 years of experience acting as technical project lead, driving the technical discussions with customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
Knowledge of network automation and scripting (e.g., Python, Ansible, REST APIs) is considered a plus.

Soft Skills

Proficiency in English for professional communication and documentation.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and multitasking skills capable of handling a vast variety of systems.
Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to stay effective under pressure during critical incidents and escalations
Client Orientation & Communication
Accountability
Adapting & responding to chang
Teamwork & cooperation

This is a hands-on platform development role for an experienced ServiceNow architect with demonstrable AI capability on the Now Platform. ServiceNow development experience and AI/Now Assist experience are both prerequisites. CPQ-specific and Logik.ai product knowledge can be developed on the job for a candidate who already brings the platform and AI foundation.

Duties And Responsibilities

Design, develop and configure solutions across Sales and Order Management, CSM and CPQ, including product catalogue, quoting, pricing logic and order orchestration.
Build and extend CPQ capability on the Logik.ai-powered stack: configuration rules, pricing logic, transaction handling, and integration with the wider ServiceNow order lifecycle.
Develop AI-enabled capability using Now Assist and AI Agent Studio — designing AI agents, skills and prompts to support quoting, product discovery and sales workflows.
Build integrations between CPQ/SOM and external systems (CRM, ERP, billing) using REST APIs, IntegrationHub and custom spokes.
Develop scoped applications, business rules, script includes, flows and UI (UI Builder / Now Experience) to the highest technical standard.
Translate commercial requirements — product structures, pricing, discounting, approvals — into maintainable platform logic.
Guide and review the work of mid-level and junior developers; act as a technical reference point for CPQ and AI-related build decisions.
Contribute to the growth of the practice's CPQ and AI capability: reusable assets, standards and internal knowledge sharing.
Support scoping and estimation of CPQ and AI workstreams.

Required Qualifications & Experience

The position requires working from the office in Madrid 2-3 days per week.

Academic Background

Degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field.

Professional Certification — required

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) — required.
ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) — required.
CIS certification in a CRM-family product line (CIS-CSM or equivalent) — strongly preferred.
Note: no standalone ServiceNow certification currently exists for Now Assist / AI or agentic capability. AI experience will be assessed through demonstrated hands-on build work, not certification.

Years & Area Experience

4+ years of hands-on ServiceNow platform development. Non-negotiable.
Demonstrable delivery experience in ServiceNow CRM and Industry Workflows — Sales and Order Management, CSM, Product Catalogue or Order Management.
Hands-on experience building AI capability on the Now Platform — Now Assist, AI Agent Studio, AI agents, or Virtual Agent/Predictive Intelligence at a build (not demo) level.

Technical Skills — Required

Strong ServiceNow scripting: JavaScript, GlideRecord, server-side and client-side scripting, script includes, business rules, ACLs.
Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, scoped application development.
REST/SOAP API integration, authentication patterns (OAuth/JWT), transform maps and data import.
Now Assist / AI Agent Studio: configuring AI agents and skills, prompt design, grounding AI in platform data.
UI development: UI Builder / Now Experience or Service Portal.
Automated Test Framework (ATF) and source control (Git) / update-set discipline.

Technical skills — desired (ramp-up areas, not entry filters)

Logik.ai experience — configuration and solving engine, pricing logic, composable/API-first implementation patterns. Rare in the market; treated as a strong differentiator.
CPQ domain knowledge: product configuration, constraint-based rules, pricing and discounting models, quote-to-cash processes.
CPQ experience on other platforms (Salesforce CPQ / Revenue Cloud, Oracle CPQ, SAP CPQ/Callidus, Conga, PROS, Tacton).
Agentic AI patterns beyond the platform: MCP-based integrations, multi-agent orchestration.
Industry exposure to complex-product sectors: manufacturing, high-tech, telecommunications, industrial, medical devices.

Soft skills

Strong ownership and accountability for technical quality and delivery.
Able to communicate with commercial stakeholders (sales, pricing, finance) as well as technical teams.
Analytical mindset; able to decompose complex commercial rules into structured, maintainable logic.
Consultative — challenges requirements constructively and presents options with pros, cons and risks.
Comfortable working in a fast-evolving product area with limited established precedent.
Excellent written and verbal communication in English.

What We Offer

Early role in building a CPQ and AI practice on a newly established, high-demand ServiceNow capability.
Company-sponsored training on Logik.ai CPQ and ServiceNow AI capability, plus continued certification support.
Work on complex, high-visibility CRM transformation engagements.

Company

Being part of THEWHITEAM
means joining a company made up of professionals with extensive experience in technology consulting.

We firmly believe that companies and clients set the direction of the industry, but it is people who build it. We consider it essential that our organization is founded on our greatest asset and key differentiator: our people
.

Benefits

We operate under the Spanish Consulting and Market Research Collective Agreement.
We offer 23 vacation days per year.
We provide 14 salary payments per year: 12 monthly payments plus 2 additional payments (June and December).
As part of our flexible benefits package, you can request childcare vouchers as well as private medical and dental insurance.

Aktív részvétel a csapat munkájában agilis módszertan szerint.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Robotica, MES, SCADA, Digital Twins en slimme productiesystemen. Bij VDL Weweler werk je niet aan een theoretisch automatiseringsvraagstuk, maar aan een moderne productieomgeving waar jouw oplossingen direct zichtbaar zijn op de werkvloer.Onze fabriek in Apeldoorn behoort tot de meest geautomatiseerde productielocaties binnen VDL. Hier spelen robotica, data en procesautomatisering een cruciale rol in de productie van luchtveersystemen voor trucks, trailers en bussen die wereldwijd worden ingezet. Als Automation Engineer krijg je de kans om bestaande systemen verder te ontwikkelen en een belangrijke rol te spelen in nieuwe automatiseringsprojecten.
Wat ga je doen?


Als Automation Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het verbeteren, ontwikkelen en ondersteunen van onze industriële automatiseringssystemen. Je werkt op het snijvlak van engineering, IT en productie en hebt direct invloed op de prestaties van onze fabriek. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

* Het optimaliseren van onze procesbesturing, waaronder MES\-, SCADA\- en PLC\-systemen
* Het ontwikkelen en verbeteren van robotica\-oplossingen binnen de productieomgeving
* Het initiëren, begeleiden en documenteren van automatiserings\- en verbeterprojecten
* Het testen van nieuwe functionaliteiten binnen een Digital Twin omgeving
* Het analyseren en verhelpen van storingen aan PLC\-, robot\-, SCADA\- en MES\-systemen
* Het ondersteunen van productie en technische dienst bij vraagstukken op het gebied van besturings\-, meet\- en regeltechniek


Wie ben jij?


Je bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch en krijgt energie van het verbeteren van techniek en processen. Je schakelt gemakkelijk tussen projecten en operationele vraagstukken en voelt je thuis in een productieomgeving waar automatisering, technologie en samenwerking samenkomen. Ook herken je jezelf in onderstaande punten:

* Een afgeronde hbo\- of wo\-opleiding richting Industriële Automatisering, Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar
* Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal
* Ervaring met of interesse in industriële automatisering
* Kennis van of affiniteit met Siemens S7/TIA Portal, MES\- en SCADA\-systemen, ABB RobotStudio of productieautomatisering


Heb je niet overal ervaring mee, maar wel de motivatie om jezelf hierin verder te ontwikkelen? Dan gaan we ook graag met je in gesprek.


De kracht van VDL


Bij VDL Weweler ontwikkelen, produceren en verkopen we innovatieve luchtveer\- en asliftsystemen voor de internationale automotive industrie. Onze producten worden wereldwijd toegepast door toonaangevende fabrikanten van trucks, trailers en bussen. In onze fabriek hebben we een modern productieproces waarin automatisering, digitalisering en continue verbetering altijd centraal staan. We investeren volop in nieuwe technologieën en ook in onze mensen. Je komt terecht in een informele organisatie met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en collega's die net als jij graag bouwen aan slimme technische oplossingen. Werken bij VDL Weweler betekent werken aan technologie die ertoe doet. Daar staat natuurlijk ook iets tegenover:

* Salaris tussen de €4\.300 en €6\.000 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring
* Volop opleidings\- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden
* Een goede pensioenregeling volgens de cao Metalektro
* 27 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV\-dagen
* Jaarlijkse winstdeling
* Collectieve voordelen via VDL
* Een uitdagende functie voor 32 tot 40 uur per week
* De mogelijkheid om gebruik te maken van het VDL\-fietsplan
* Leuke personeelsactiviteiten, sportevenementen en het jaarlijkse VDL\-feest


Een kijkje achter de schermen bij


https://www.youtube.com/embed/QBFm2hqW3Wo?si\=ZBbNXmaemFhSWl8I


Klaar om jezelf uit te dagen?


Wil jij werken in een technisch uitdagende omgeving waar automatisering, robotica en innovatie samenkomen? Solliciteer dan direct op de functie van Automation Engineer bij VDL Weweler. Wij kijken uit naar jouw reactie.

 **Hoe wij werven**


Bij VDL Groep geloven we in persoonlijk contact met onze kandidaten. Daarom verzorgen wij de werving en selectie voor deze vacature zelf en maken wij alleen gebruik van geselecteerde recruitmentpartners waarmee afspraken zijn gemaakt. Ontvangen wij toch ongevraagd een cv via deze vacature? Dan behandelen wij dit als een directe sollicitatie van de kandidaat. Er ontstaat hierdoor geen bemiddelings\- of plaatsingsovereenkomst. Bedankt voor je begrip en interesse in VDL Groep.

Bij VDL Weweler ontwikkelen, produceren en verkopen we luchtveer\- en aslift systemen voor producenten van assen, trailers, trucks en bussen. In onze moderne fabriek in Apeldoorn beschikken we over een uniek productieproces, waarbij automatisering en procesbeheersing centraal staan. Je krijgt veel vrijheid om jezelf te ontwikkelen en mee te denken over allerlei bedrijfsprocessen voor onze ‘Factory of the Future’.

LEE0000Q6 Requisition \#  

Graduate Infrastructure Mechanical Engineer – Leeds


See it differently \- Early Careers at Arup


See it differently


You see the world through a unique lens and that’s exactly what we need. We embrace how you see things differently – it’s essential for creating a sustainable future.


Arup is a global consultancy with advisory and technical expertise across more than 150 disciplines. We guide, plan and design the future of the built environment. Globally, each year we recruit hundreds of graduates and students who help us see things differently and solve the most complex challenges facing our clients, climate and communities.


The Opportunity


Infrastructure Mechanical Engineers deliver design and consulting services for the vital infrastructure that makes modern life possible.


Our work is very varied and crosses industry sectors. In the water sector, we deliver potable and wastewater treatment, pumping stations, reservoirs and flood defences. We work in energy markets focussing on industrial decarbonisation technologies like energy storage, hydrogen, steam generation, carbon capture and renewable energy. We support the development of nuclear infrastructure, manufacturing facilities and process plants through integrated mechanical and piping system designs.


We design new systems, improve existing asset performance and are actively pursuing more sustainable infrastructure for the societies we live and work within.


* Design of mechanical systems of pipework and equipment for essential infrastructure and industry.
* Investigating and understanding problems and design challenges.
* Calculations, specifications, modelling and layouts.
* Collaborating with other disciplines to develop complex solutions.
* Designing for safety and operability of equipment.

https://www.arup.com/projects/leeds\-flood\-alleviation\-scheme/


https://www.arup.com/projects/tpark\-waste\-to\-energy\-facility/


https://www.arup.com/projects/morecambe\-net\-zero/


Is this role right for you?


For this opportunity, we are seeking the following qualifications, skills and attributes: A bachelor's degree in relevant academic discipline, such as Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics / Robotics Engineering; Aeronautical Engineering; Aerospace Engineering.


Skills and experience we look for: strong numeracy (Mathematics) and working proficiency in Excel


Willingness to learn new things.


To be considered for a graduate opportunity, your application must include a copy of your academic transcript and meet the following criteria:


* Full working rights in the country of application
* No more than 12 months of full\-time experience in a comparable role
* Recently graduated, or on track to graduate, from your most recent degree, related to your role of choice, before employment starts.

Alongside your degree, we look for the following core attributes;


* Changemakers: A passion for sustainable development and creating a better world is key.
* Innovative minds: We’re looking for critical thinkers who embrace new ideas and challenge the status quo.
* Growth seekers: You have a growth mindset, always eager to learn and explore new ways of working.
* Adaptable adventurers: You’re ready to take on any challenge that comes your way.

Please note, in the event of high applicant volume, this role may be closed ahead of the advertised closing date. Early application is recommended.
  

  

Eligibility
  

Please note that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Therefore, you must ensure that you are eligible to work permanently in the UK without our sponsorship


What we offer you


At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.


Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.


We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling permanent members to share in the results of our collective efforts.

jobs.title: WTG Operations & Maintenance Engineer
jobs.description:
**Base Location:** Dogger Bank O\&M Base, Port of Tyne.


**Salary:** £44,000\-£65,900 depending on experience \+ performance\-related bonus \+ a range of benefits to support your finances, wellbeing and family.


**Working Pattern:** Permanent \| Full Time \| Flexible First options available


**What is the Role?**



As a WTG O\&M Engineer, you’ll play a key role at the heart of the Dogger Bank Operations \& Maintenance team—supporting one of the world’s most significant offshore wind projects. This is a unique opportunity to be involved from the early commissioning stages through to long\-term operations, giving you full lifecycle exposure to turbine performance and reliability.



In the early phase, you’ll take ownership of turbine commissioning, acceptance, and handover—ensuring each asset meets the highest standards before entering service. As the wind farm transitions into full operations, your focus will shift toward maintenance strategy, fault diagnosis, and performance optimisation, helping maximise energy output and asset reliability.



This is a hands\-on and highly collaborative role, combining offshore field support with data\-driven engineering. You’ll work closely with OEMs, contractors, and internal stakeholders, influencing technical decisions and driving continuous improvement across the fleet.


**You will**


* Lead turbine acceptance, commissioning, and handover activities while ensuring compliance with contractual, corporate, regulatory, and internal standards across the fleet, providing hands\-on field support where required.
* Develop, document, and maintain a technical knowledge base to support engineering problem\-solving, fault diagnosis, and provide key input into systems and service providers for analysis and rectification.
* Design, implement, and execute service quality walkdown check sheets, conducting detailed inspections to verify asset condition, safety, and performance.
* Track and manage engineering defects, working closely with OEMs and stakeholders to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.
* Conduct onsite monitoring, inspections, and coordination of maintenance activities, collaborating with specialist contractors and engaging internal and external stakeholders to ensure high standards of safety and technical performance.


**You have**



To be considered for this role, we would love you to have:


* A qualification of HND level in an engineering or relevant experience in wind turbine, major components or rotational plant.
* Experience of technical support delivery including management of refurbishment activities for major components including root cause analysis.
* Competency in discussing machinery safety legislation and implementation of such through recognised safe systems of work.
* High level of competency in using IT systems and platforms such as Power BI, Power Automate, Python etc with capability in writing procedures and technical reports concisely and to a high standard.
* Understanding and ability to interpret and conduct data acquisition and analysis.


**About SSE**



SSE’s purpose is to provide energy needed today while building a better world of energy for tomorrow. We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. Our Transforming for Growth investment plan sees us investing £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure across the five years to 2030\.



SSE Renewables delivers the green energy the world needs today and tomorrow. We lead the way in the development, build, and operation of renewable power assets, including windfarms, hydro power stations, and solar and battery projects. Join a global team of 1,800 energy experts powering the transition to a net zero future.


**Flexible benefits to fit your life**



Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest\-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.


**Work with an equal opportunity employer**



SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. Please contact Andrew.Duncan2@sse.com to discuss how we can support you.



We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry.


**Ready to apply?**



Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further. If you're offered a role with SSE, you'll need to complete a criminality check and a credit check before you start work.

jobs.title: Graduate Measurement & Hydrocarbon Allocation Engineer
jobs.description:
Wood is delighted to present an exciting Graduate Development Opportunity within our Measurement \& Hydrocarbon team, offering a unique platform for a highly motivated and ambitious graduate to enhance their technical capabilities, gain valuable industry exposure, and embark on a rewarding and progressive career within the energy sector.


This is an Aberdeen\-based role, with a minimum of three days per week at the Client office, Aberdeen, and the remaining two days at Sir Ian Wood House, Aberdeen. Additional days at the Client office may occasionally be required to support holiday or sickness cover.


***\#LI\-Hybrid***

**The Role**

In this position, you will shadow our experienced Hydrocarbon Allocation Engineer. Your core responsibility will be to assist in the provision of accurate daily flow measurement totals to both internal and external stakeholders. Your work will maintain the daily and monthly production allocation process for the client asset.


This job ensures correct hydrocarbon accounting, production reporting, metering validation, data correction, and compliance. Through Energy Builder and related metering systems, you will support financial reporting, partner allocations, regulatory obligations, and daily production operations.


This is not only a fantastic learning opportunity, but also a chance to work directly within a fast\-paced operations environment. This opportunity is designed to help build technical skills in hydrocarbon measurement and accountancy, while gaining invaluable business insight into the internal workings of an oil and gas operator.


Graduates would hope to gain experience in hydrocarbon accounting and metering, validation of production data, operating Energy Builder allocation systems, managing fiscal metering corrections, conducting production reconciliations and mismeasurements, issuing partner allocation reports, and delivering accurate daily and monthly hydrocarbon accounts.


**Our Clients and Projects**

**Designing the future. Transforming the world.**

Our Production Optimisation team are part of our Digital consulting business unit. We support our clients to secure economic recovery from existing infrastructure, optimising assets and enabling extension of productive field life whilst accelerating the move towards net Zero. The work we do predominately enables Energy security whilst we transition. However, we are also growing our services across Carbon Capture Utilisation and storage and transportation of Hydrogen and Ammonia.


With Wood’s ambitious growth within energy transition related business, you will have the opportunity to learn from and contribute to our global pool of knowledge experts in a range of topics, including traditional oil and gas, CO *2* and H *2* transport.


Wood is an inclusive and diverse global community of inquisitive minds and recognised industry innovators, partnering to create new possibilities.
 

**What we can offer**

* **Meaningful and interesting projects** delivered to high profile clients across the Energy Sector within the UK and other international locations as required
* **Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** ; we are an organisation actively committed to diversity and inclusion across our business
* **Competitive renumeration package** with regular reviews to ensure we are rewarding at the right level in line with the market
* **Commitment to continued professional development** ; development plans that are tailored to your individual needs and interests
* **Global connections** ; join experts around the world who are at the leading edge of our industry, shaping the standards of our profession

  
**Daily Data Management \& Allocation**

* Gathered and checked daily production, laboratory, and equipment reports to ensure information to Energy Builder
* Run hourly and daily allocation tracking to correctly split up and count total production
* Spot and fixed data errors to meet mass balance targets, generate and issue reports and XML files with partners

**Quality Control \& Problem Solving**

* Review data and identify total errors, equipment errors, system upsets, or unusual laboratory data
* Calculate and issue mismeasurement reports
* Check and verify allocation data across oil, gas, water, and injection systems to ensure plant balanced

**System \& Software Management**

* Daily use of Energy Builder, including updating well statuses, storage data, and cargo details
* Run key calculations for hourly, daily, and monthly production reports and verification checks
* Keep clear auditable records for measurement and allocation

**Hydrocarbon Accounting \& Finance Support**

* Monitor plant operations, oil and gas measurement and overall mass balances daily
* Managed Bill of Lading (BOL) shipping reviews to support production and scheduling teams

**Teamwork \& Communication**

* Connected offshore operations, lab teams, measurement technicians, and business partners
* Distributed regular allocation updates, balance sheets, and monthly financial reports
* Offered fast technical help whenever tracking or measurement problems came up

**Technical Skills \& Expertise Developed**

* Mastered tracking oil, gas, and water production using mass balance, uncertainty and mismeasurement calculations
* Learned to manage financial\-grade (fiscal) metering systems and measurement errors
* Developed knowledge of tank inventory, cargo records, and offshore production workflows

**Systems \& Software Knowledge**

* Databases \& Allocation: Energy Builder, Oracle, and production reporting databases
* Data Analytics: PI Process Book, PI Datalink, and advanced Microsoft Excel
* Specialised Tools: FLOCALC (Kelton), instrumentation systems, and Adobe Acrobat

  
**What makes you remarkable?**

At Wood, we are committed to equal opportunities and welcome all talented individuals to consider joining our team. So even if you don't match every statement below but feel you have some of the experience, knowledge or skills needed for this role, we encourage you to apply. It will take all of us working together to deliver solutions to the world’s most critical challenges.
 

Expected:


* Recent graduate engineer with a minimum 2:1 bachelor’s degree (BEng or MEng) in an Engineering discipline preferred
* Industry experience is preferable
* Demonstrate initiative, and have good communication skills
* Possess an ability to learn quickly and be adaptable and flexible to match business requirements
* Ability and desire to work in diverse and multi\-disciplinary team environments
* Must have the right to work in the UK

  
Wood is a global leader in consulting, engineering and operations for the energy and materials sectors. With 33,000 people in around 50 countries, Wood supports clients across the full asset lifecycle, delivering safe, predictable outcomes while enabling resilient operations and a lower carbon future. Wood forms the Energy \& Materials pillar of Sidara \- a global partnership uniting leading multidisciplinary engineering, design, and project management companies. www.woodgroup.com  

  

**Diversity Statement**We are an equal opportunity employer that recognises the value of a diverse workforce. All suitably qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment on the basis of objective criteria and without regard to the following (which is a non\-exhaustive list): race, colour, age, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status, or other characteristics in accordance with the relevant governing laws.

jobs.title: Support Engineer (SQL)
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

Legal \& General (L\&G) is a leading UK financial services group and major global investor.

**We’ve been safeguarding people’s financial futures since 1836, and strive to build a better society, while improving the lives of our customers and creating value for shareholders.**


We are one of the world’s largest asset managers and provide powerful asset origination capabilities. Together, these underpin our retirement and protection solutions: we are an international player in pension risk transfer, in UK and US life insurance, and in UK workplace pensions and retirement income.

**Who we are**


Our Retail business supports customers throughout their lives, to help them save, plan, protect and enjoy retirement.


We’re a leading provider of retirement and protection solutions. We aim to support our c.12\.8 million policyholders and workplace members throughout their lifelong financial journeys.


We focus on helping the customers of today and tomorrow achieve better long\-term outcomes. We either talk with them directly or work with intermediaries and employers to meet their needs. We use the latest technology to connect with them quickly, efficiently and wherever possible in highly personalised ways.

 **Job Description**  

We’re looking for a Support Engineer to help keep our data services running smoothly. You’ll join a collaborative support team responsible for our Snowflake data warehouse, investigating pipeline issues, responding to internal queries and helping colleagues access the accurate data they need.


This is an opportunity to work with Snowflake, DBT, SQL and Azure technology in a varied environment where your troubleshooting and communication skills will be equally valued. We welcome candidates from different backgrounds who can demonstrate the relevant skills, even if they do not meet every desirable requirement.


What you'll be doing:

* Monitoring scheduled ETL jobs and data ingestion pipelines
* Confirming that data has loaded successfully into Snowflake
* Investigating pipeline failures and coordinating timely resolutions
* Responding to incidents and service requests from internal colleagues
* Troubleshooting missing, incomplete or inconsistent data
* Supporting technical and non\-technical users with Snowflake queries
* Communicating progress and solutions in clear, accessible language
* Prioritising issues effectively within a fast\-paced support environment


Who we're looking for:

* Practical experience of working with Snowflake would be ideal
* Good working knowledge of DBT
* Strong SQL skills
* Previous experience within a support or service desk environment
* Effective troubleshooting and analytical problem\-solving skills
* An approachable communication style and the ability to explain technical subjects clearly
* The ability to remain organised and make sound decisions under pressure
* Experience of Azure Data Factory or the wider Azure ecosystem would be beneficial


Whatever your role, we reward performance and behaviour with a package that looks after all the things that are important to you. Here are some of the benefits we offer:

* The opportunity to participate in our annual, performance \-related bonus plan and valuable share schemes
* Generous pension contribution
* Life assurance
* Healthcare Plan (permanent employees only)
* At least 25 days holiday, plus public holidays, 26 days after 2 years’ service. There’s also the option to buy and sell holiday
* Competitive family leave
* Participate in our electric car scheme, which offers employees the option to hire a brand\-new electric car through tax efficient salary sacrifice (permanent employees only)
* There are many discounts we offer – both for our own products and at a range of high street stores and online
* We’re creating net‑zero carbon workplaces by 2030 by investing in our sustainable, modern offices across the UK, all designed to bring people together and elevate the in‑person experience


\#LI\-NH1

 **Additional Information**  

At L\&G, we believe it's possible to generate positive returns today while helping to build a better future for all.


If you join us, you’ll be part of a welcoming, inclusive culture, with opportunities to collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds, views, and experiences. Guided by leaders with integrity who care about your future and wellbeing. Empowered through initiatives which support people to develop their careers and excel.


We care passionately about outcomes rather than attendance and are therefore open to discussing all kinds of flexible working options including part\-time and job shares. Although some roles have limited flexibility due to customer demand, we accommodate requests when we can.


It doesn’t matter if you don’t meet every single criterion in this advert. Instead, think about what you excel at and what else you can bring in terms of strengths, potential and connection to our purpose.

jobs.title: Fullstack/DevOps-utvecklare
jobs.description:
Startdatum: 2026\-10\-12  

Slutdatum: 2027\-12\-31, med option till förlängning  

Omfattning: 100%  

Plats: Stockholm / hybrid 3\-4 dagar på plats

### **Uppdragsbeskrivning**


Vi söker en senior fullstackutvecklare med stark DevOps\-profil som kan ta ett helhetsansvar genom hela utvecklingskedjan. Rollen kombinerar mjukvaruutveckling med teknisk styrning, integrationsarbete, miljöhantering och driftsättning.


Du kommer att bidra till utvecklingen av moderna webbapplikationer och kringliggande tjänster som tillsammans utgör en ny digital förmåga inom verksamheten. Uppdraget innebär nära samarbete med flera utvecklingsteam och verksamhetsintressenter, där du förväntas kunna omsätta verksamhetsbehov till hållbara tekniska lösningar.


En viktig del av rollen är att bidra till tekniska vägval, kvalitetssäkring och arbetssätt samt att fungera som en teknisk länk mellan utveckling och övriga delar av organisationen.

### **Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:**

* Utveckla och vidareutveckla webbapplikationer med tyngdpunkt på React/TypeScript och .NET/C\#.
* Ansvara för teknisk konfiguration och förvaltning av on\-premise\-miljöer samt containerbaserade plattformar.
* Utforma och förvalta CI/CD\-flöden, automatiserade tester och kvalitetskontroller.
* Driva integrationsarbete mellan olika team, system och verksamhetsfunktioner.
* Bidra till arkitektur, teknisk vägledning och kvalitetssäkring inom utvecklingsteamet.
* Utveckla tillgängliga användargränssnitt och samarbeta med UX/UI\-kompetenser kring funktionella och användarvänliga lösningar.

### **Skall\-krav**

* Minst 5 års professionell erfarenhet av frontendutveckling med React och/eller TypeScript, inklusive minst 3 års praktisk erfarenhet av React.
* Minst 3 års erfarenhet från ledande eller tekniskt ansvarstagande roller där du ansvarat för kodkvalitet och väglett andra utvecklare, fördelat på minst 2 uppdrag.
* Minst 4 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av server\-side\-utveckling med .NET (C\#).
* Minst 2 års erfarenhet av att utveckla webblösningar enligt tillgänglighetskrav såsom WCAG.
* Erfarenhet av TDD samt automatiserade end\-to\-end\-tester med exempelvis Cypress eller Playwright från minst 2 uppdrag.
* Minst 2 uppdrag där du ägt och konfigurerat CI/CD\-pipelines och DevOps\-verktyg såsom Azure DevOps/Azure Pipelines eller GitLab CI/CD.
* Erfarenhet från minst 2 uppdrag av Docker och Kubernetes i drift av verksamhetskritiska system.

### **Meriterande**

* Erfarenhet från uppdrag inom offentlig sektor.
* Aktuell molncertifiering, exempelvis inom Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate eller motsvarande.
* Erfarenhet av att etablera och konfigurera lösningar för observability, monitorering och teknisk övervakning.
* Erfarenhet av Kubernetes i on\-premise\-miljö med RKE2 och Rancher.

* Nära samarbete med övriga utvecklare och andra delar av verksamheten
* Löpande förbättring av kod, struktur och arbetssätt

**Din profil**


Vi söker dig som har ett genuint intresse för systemutveckling och som trivs med att både lösa problem självständigt och tillsammans med andra.


För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:

* Minst 2 års erfarenhet av professionell systemutveckling
* God erfarenhet av C\# och .NET
* Erfarenhet av frontendutveckling i React
* God förståelse för utveckling av moderna webbapplikationer
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta enligt agila metoder
* Flytande kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift
* God samarbets\- och kommunikationsförmåga


Som person är du lösningsorienterad, ansvarstagande och nyfiken. Du uppskattar en miljö där vägen från idé till implementation är kort och där du får möjlighet att påverka hur lösningar utformas.

**Vi erbjuder**


Hos RECAS får du möjlighet att arbeta i ett tekniskt intressant uppdrag där du blir en viktig del av den fortsatta utvecklingen av en etablerad digital plattform.


Du får en roll med stort eget ansvar, varierande tekniska utmaningar och nära samarbete med både utvecklare och verksamhet. För rätt person finns goda möjligheter att utvecklas tillsammans med uppdraget och ta ett större ansvar över tid.

jobs.title: Senior .NET-utvecklare
jobs.description:
Är du en erfaren .NET\-utvecklare som gillar modern teknik, smarta kollegor och uppdrag där du faktiskt får påverka? Då vill vi gärna prata med dig.


Just nu söker vi flera .NET\-utvecklare till våra kommande konsultuppdrag i Stockholm. Skicka gärna in en ansökan om du är på jakt efter ett nytt spännande uppdrag eller bara nyfiken på vad marknaden har att erbjuda, så kikar vi om vi har något inne som kan passa.

**Om Devoote**


På Devoote tror vi på nära relationer, tekniskt intressanta uppdrag och en vardag där konsulterna faktiskt känner varandra. Hos oss handlar det inte bara om nästa uppdrag, utan om att bygga långsiktiga relationer med både kunder och konsulter.


Oavsett om du är anställd eller underkonsult blir du en del av vårt nätverk med erfarenhetsutbyten, tekniksnack, AW:s, middagar och aktiviteter som vi gör för att det är roligt!

**Om rollen**


Som konsult hos Devoote kommer du att arbeta i uppdrag hos våra kunder i Stockholm. Uppdragens innehåll varierar beroende på kund, team och bransch, men du kommer vanligtvis att arbeta med utveckling av moderna affärskritiska system och digitala tjänster.


Beroende på uppdrag kan du vara involverad i hela utvecklingsprocessen, från design och arkitektur till implementation, testning och drift. Du kan också komma att arbeta nära utvecklare, arkitekter, produktägare och andra intressenter i agila team där kvalitet, innovation och kunskapsdelning står i fokus.


Vi arbetar med längre uppdrag hos välkända företag och strävar efter att hitta uppdrag som matchar din kompetens, erfarenhet och dina karriärmål.

**Vi söker dig som har**

* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av systemutveckling i .NET
* Goda kunskaper i .NET och C\#
* Erfarenhet av React och TypeScript
* Erfarenhet av Azure
* Flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift

**Personliga egenskaper**

**Vi tror att du:**

* Är lösningsorienterad och nyfiken
* Tar eget ansvar och driver ditt arbete framåt
* Trivs med samarbete och kunskapsdelning

**Därför väljer utvecklare Devoote**


Hos oss får du mer än bara ett nytt uppdrag.

* Långa uppdrag där du får möjlighet att skapa verkligt värde över tid
* Frihet att påverka hur du arbetar och vilka lösningar du driver fram
* Snabba beslut och korta vägar mellan idé och genomförande
* Möjlighet att arbeta hos några av Sveriges mest välkända företag
* Regelbundna middagar, aktiviteter och event för den som vill vara med


Låter det intressant?


Oavsett om du är nyfiken på att bli anställd konsult eller driver eget är du varmt välkommen att höra av dig.


Vi ser fram emot att lära känna dig!

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Robotics
jobs.description:
Vil du utvikle programvaren som får avanserte roboter og boreutstyr til å fungere sikkert, presist og autonomt?  

  



**Om stillingen**  

Maskin Control utvikler software og kontrollsystemer for boreutstyr, robotiserte løsninger og automatiserte prosesser. Vi kombinerer industriell automasjon, robotteknologi og softwareutvikling for å løse krevende oppgaver i operasjoner der sikkerhet, tilgjengelighet og presisjon er avgjørende.  



  

Vi søker nå en erfaren robotprogrammerer som vil bidra i utviklingen av neste generasjon kontrollsystemer. Du blir en sentral del av et tverrfaglig miljø og får ansvar for å utvikle, integrere, teste og sette i drift robotløsninger som inngår i komplette maskin\- og automasjonssystemer.  



  

Stillingen passer for deg som liker å gå fra problemforståelse og systemdesign til fungerende løsning på virkelig utstyr. Du trives med å feilsøke i komplekse systemer, samarbeide tett med andre fagmiljøer og ta eierskap til leveranser fra idé til idriftsettelse.


**Hvorfor NOV?**  

Hos NOV blir du en del av et sterkt fagmiljø som utvikler teknologi for krevende operasjoner over hele verden. I Maskin Control arbeider vi tett på både utstyret og kundens behov, og du får påvirke hvordan fremtidens automatiserte bore\- og robotsystemer skal bygges.  

  



Du får:
  

* Spennende og teknisk krevende oppgaver med synlige resultater
* Mulighet til å jobbe med avansert robotikk, autonomi og maskinstyring
* Et kompetent og tverrfaglig miljø med høy grad av samarbeid og faglig sparring
* Mulighet til å påvirke arkitektur, arbeidsmetoder og videre produktutvikling
* Gode utviklings\- og karrieremuligheter
* Konkurransedyktige betingelser og et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø
**Mangfold og inkludering**

Vi ønsker å fremme mangfold og like muligheter. Derfor oppfordrer vi alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke – uavhengig av kjønn, alder, kulturell bakgrunn, funksjonsevne eller livssyn.


**Arbeidssted** : Kristiansand


**Oppstart** : etter avtale  



  

**Vi vurderer søknader fortløpende.** Send oss din søknad dersom du ønsker å være med på å utvikle robuste og intelligente robot\- og kontrollsystemer for fremtidens boreutstyr.


**Kontakt for teknisk informasjon om stillingen** : Ståle Enes \+47 90 600 353


  
**Arbeidsoppgaver**

  

* Programmering og konfigurering av industrielle roboter og robotceller
* Utvikling av sekvenser, bevegelseslogikk, baner, griperfunksjoner og sikker oppførsel
* Integrasjon mellom robot, PLS, drivsystemer, sensorer, HMI og øvrige kontrollsystemer
* Design, implementasjon og videreutvikling av kontrollarkitektur for automatiserte maskiner
* Testing og verifisering i simulator, testoppsett og på fysisk utstyr
* FAT, idriftsettelse, feilsøking og teknisk støtte i prosjekt\- og leveransefasen
* Bidra til standardisering, gjenbrukbare løsninger og gode utviklingsmetoder
* Utarbeidelse og vedlikehold av teknisk dokumentasjon

  
**Vi ser etter deg som har**

  

* Flere års erfaring med programmering og idriftsettelse av industrielle roboter
* Relevant høyere utdanning innen **robotikk, automasjon, kybernetikk, mekatronikk, software** eller tilsvarende praktisk erfaring
* God forståelse av robotceller, koordinatsystemer, bevegelsesplanlegging og samspill mellom robot og maskin
* Erfaring med feilsøking i sammensatte kontrollsystemer og evne til å se helheten fra software til mekanikk og elektro
* Evne til å arbeide strukturert og selvstendig, samtidig som du deler kunnskap og samarbeider godt i team
* Gode norsk\- og engelskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig
  

**Det er en fordel om du har erfaring med**

  

* En eller flere robotplattformer, for eksempel ABB, KUKA, FANUC, Yaskawa eller tilsvarende
* Robotprogrammering, offline\-programmering og simulering
* PLS\-programmering, særlig Siemens TIA Portal.
* Kommunikasjonsprotokoller og integrasjon, som OPC UA, Profinet, eller TCP/IP
* C\#, C\+\+, Python eller andre relevante programmeringsspråk
* Maskinsikkerhet, risikovurdering og standarder for industrielle robot\- og automasjonssystemer
* Erfaring fra drilling, offshore, tungt utstyr eller andre krevende industrielle miljøer

jobs.title: Release Train Architect - Tieto Caretech (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Jyväskylä, Finland


* Full\-time
* Application and Product Development
* Hybrid
* Tieto Caretech

  
Job Description **At Tieto Caretech you’ll get a chance to provide patients and end users with product offerings that help them in their life, reinventing the world for good. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading.**

**About us**


Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency \- have more time to care.


We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from intensive care to laboratory and social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.

  

**About the role**


We are now looking for **a Release Train Architect (RTA)** to work with **Tieto Caretech** healthcare products where you will contribute to simplifying everyday life for patients, professionals and customers. In the architect role you will be ensuring that the architectural and technical decisions taken are aligned with Lifecare strategy, data security and set of requirements.

 **In this role you will**

* Design, implement, and verify software architecture with a focus on the bigger picture and product architecture.
* Utilize advanced .NET concepts, design patterns, and SOLID design principles to develop robust software solutions.
* Lead and mentor teams in web development using WebApi, Angular, HTML5, JavaScript, TypeScript, SPA, and NgRx/Redux.
* Apply hands\-on experience in the .Net Stack and other frameworks to deliver full\-stack solutions.
* Implement SOA, IOC, REST API, Microservices, and Event\-driven architecture.

 **We are looking for someone with**

* 10\+ years of experience in the software industry.
* Proficiency in **both** **English** and **Finnish** languages.

Extensive knowledge of web technologies and patterns.  
* 

**It would be beneficial if you also have**

* Experience with cloud development and deployment, preferably in Azure.
* Understanding of Domain Driven Development and Test\-Driven Development.
* Familiarity with C\#, Angular, C\+\+, RabbitMQ, XML, WCF, WPF, IIS/Windows services, SOAP.
* Knowledge of DevOps, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Deployment.
* Awareness of cross\-browser compatibility and web standards.
* Understanding of OpenEHR.
* Experience in the healthcare domain.
* Familiarity with integration standards like FHIR, HL7\.

  

As a person we believe you are a team player who takes action and demonstrate responsibility to organize your work and solve your tasks. With our agile end to end development process you will continuously both learn from and coach your colleagues, so communication is important for us. Technology is developing fast, so learning new cutting\-edge technologies is something you strive to do.

  

**AI knowledge requirement**


AI literacy is expected for this role. You will be comfortable using approved AI tools to improve quality and productivity in everyday work (e.g., drafting, summarising, analysing, and automating routine tasks). You can write clear prompts/instructions, critically evaluate and validate AI outputs, and apply sound judgement when results are incomplete, biased, or incorrect. You understand and follow company policies and applicable legal/regulatory requirements for confidentiality, privacy, security, and responsible AI use (including not sharing sensitive data in unapproved tools).

 **What’s in it for you?**


With us you will be part of the important and meaningful work of developing healthcare for all of us. You have an important mission to make a difference that really matters. In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, open and friendly culture, and an outstanding work\-life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.


Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in. For example, we host an annual ‘Keep Learning Week’, a week where everyone at Tieto has the possibility to join different training courses in a truly global setting.

  

**Could you be our new colleague?**  

  

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager Teijo Mustonen \[teijo.mustonen@tieto.com]

  

Additional Information  

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.  

Diversity, equity and inclusion \| Sustainability \| Tieto

**Stay alert to recruitment scams:**  

* Tieto only communicates via **@tieto.com** email addresses.
* We never ask candidates to pay fees or share financial details during recruitment.
* If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Tieto, don't respond — verify it via our official careers site.
* For more information visit Important Advisory Regarding Recruitment Fraud \| Tieto Blog

  
We provide customers across different industries with mission\-critical solutions through our specialized software businesses Tieto Caretech, Tieto Banktech and Tieto Indtech as well as Tieto Tech Consulting business.


Our around 14 000 talented vertical software, design, cloud and AI experts are dedicated to empowering our customers to succeed and innovate with latest technology.


Tieto’s annual revenue is approximately EUR 2 billion. The company’s shares are listed on the NASDAQ exchange in Helsinki and Stockholm, as well as on Oslo Børs.
