jobs.description:
Werk aan zorgsoftware met impact

Je hebt complexe systemen gebouwd, grote codebases doorgrond en weet hoe software zich ontwikkelt zodra meerdere teams eraan werken. Juist in zulke omgevingen ligt voor jou de uitdaging: structuur aanbrengen, keuzes verbeteren en systemen toekomstbestendig maken.

Bij ChipSoft zoeken we senior developers die hun ervaring inzetten om onze zorgsoftware structureel beter te maken — niet alleen om deze draaiende te houden.

We bouwen aan het Elektronisch Patiënten Dossier (EPD): software die dagelijks in ziekenhuizen wordt gebruikt en waarin nieuwe functionaliteit altijd samenkomt met bestaande complexiteit.

Binnen R&D werk je aan uiteenlopende technische vraagstukken: van EPD-doorontwikkeling en complexe domeinlogica tot afhankelijkheden die vragen om doordachte ontwerpkeuzes.

Ook data speelt een steeds grotere rol, bijvoorbeeld in analytische toepassingen, gebruiksinzichten, datawarehousing, modellering en AI-ondersteunde oplossingen.

Daarnaast zijn hosting, performance, betrouwbaarheid en schaalbaarheid onderdeel van het dagelijkse werk. De software moet stabiel draaien in omgevingen waar uitval geen optie is.

Je helpt ook onze manier van ontwikkelen verbeteren: tooling, processen, samenwerking en technische keuzes moeten meegroeien met een grote R&D-organisatie.

We zoeken developers die al op seniorniveau werken: mensen die grotere systemen overzien, complexiteit beheersbaar maken en rust brengen in technische keuzes.

Je voegt nieuwe perspectieven toe, scherpt keuzes aan en helpt bestaande oplossingen verder te verbeteren.

Wil je werken aan software waarin productontwikkeling, zorgimpact en technische diepgang samenkomen? Dan is dit een plek waar jouw ervaring echt verschil maakt.

Dit Breng Je Mee

Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met softwareontwikkeling, waaronder C# en .NET.
Ervaring met grote, bedrijfskritische softwareproducten.
Ervaring met meerdere teams en gedeelde codebases.
Sterk in softwarearchitectuur, codekwaliteit en technische ontwerpkeuzes.
Gestructureerd werken, met aandacht voor testbaarheid, onderhoudbaarheid, performance, schaalbaarheid en SOLID.
Je analyseert complexe technische vraagstukken en onderbouwt oplossingsrichtingen.
Onderzoekende houding en drive om continu te verbeteren.
Je draagt kennis over en geeft richting aan technische discussies.

Wat bieden wij?

Marktconform salaris
Een 13e maand*
8,25% vakantiegeld in mei
25 vakantiedagen
Een premievrij pensioen
Flexibel werken: op kantoor en/of deels thuis
Interne opleidingen en jaarlijks een persoonlijk opleidingsbudget t.w.v. € 1.000
Faciliteiten die bijdragen aan een gezonde en energieke werkdag, met mogelijkheden voor sport en een goede lunch.

jobs.title: Cloud Software Developer
jobs.description:
Als Cloud Software Developer ga je aan de slag met onze SaaS-dienst Zorgplatform, onze oplossing voor samenwerking en gegevensuitwisseling in de zorg. Voor de ontwikkeling hiervan gebruiken wij Microsoft-technologie. Zie jij dit als een uitdaging? Lees dan verder!

Jouw baan

Als Cloud Software Developer ga je werken aan Zorgplatform, een veilig API-platform dat is gebaseerd op open standaarden. Zorgplatform biedt uitgebreide ondersteuning voor samenwerking tussen zorginstellingen en met patiënten.

Je gaat aan de slag met (inter)nationale initiatieven en standaarden, zodat zorginstellingen op een goede manier gegevens kunnen uitwisselen via Zorgplatform. Wij ontwikkelen dit in C# en .NET 10. Het up-to-date houden van de gebruikte techniek vinden we erg belangrijk.

Je verzorgt bijvoorbeeld de integratie met andere systemen op basis van het Twiin-afsprakenstelsel, je koppelt aan toestemmingsvoorziening Mitz of je bouwt software die voldoet aan (inter)nationale kwalificaties, zoals van MedMij. Dit is dé Nederlandse standaard voor het veilig uitwisselen van gezondheidsgegevens tussen zorggebruikers en zorgaanbieders. Hiermee zorg jij voor digitale ondersteuning van patiëntverwijzingen, dat zorgverleners elkaars patiënten kunnen consulteren en bij elkaar kunnen meekijken en dat patiënten hun gegevens kunnen delen met alle andere gekwalificeerde zorgsystemen in Nederland en internationaal.

Jouw team

Je komt in een team met veel ervaring op het gebied van software development. Het team bestaat uit 15 personen die voornamelijk werken vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Amsterdam. Naast ontwikkelaars werk je met een aantal consultants die het contact met de klanten onderhouden en het team ondersteunen. Iedere maand vindt er in Amsterdam een Zorgplatform-dag plaats, waarbij jullie elke keer verschillende onderwerpen bespreken die met de ontwikkeling van Zorgplatform te maken hebben.

Jouw werkdag

Je begint de dag met een stand-up met je team. Jij vertelt dat je vandaag een eerste uitwerking van de door jouw bedachte oplossingsrichting wil maken. Na de stand-up bel je met een collega om te bespreken of de oplossing die je voorstelt geschikt is. Je collega geeft nog wat tips en dat werk je daarna zelf verder uit. ’s Middags geef je feedback voor een code review van een collega. Zo waarborgen we de kwaliteit van ons product. Aan het eind van de dag is de eerste versie van jouw oplossing afgerond en kun je alvast lokaal testen. Morgen verder met het verwerken van de testresultate

Wat bied jij?

Je hebt goede programmeerskills, bij voorkeur met C# en .NET 10
Je hebt kennis van microservices-architectuur
Je hebt oog voor detail en kunt het totaalplaatje overzien
Je wordt enthousiast van werken met nieuwe technieken
Kennis van RESTful API's en Entity framework zijn pluspunten
Je kan goed zelfstandig werken, maar bent ook een echte teamspeler

Werken bij ChipSoft betekent meer dan alleen een baan, je krijgt er namelijk een hele ervaring bij!

Van een goed salaris tot gezellige borrels en van volop ontwikkelmogelijkheden tot dagelijks genieten in ons eigen ChipCafé. Wij zorgen ervoor dat jij je werk met plezier en energie kunt doen.

Wat je van ons krijgt (naast een warm welkom en een goede bak koffie):

Een salaris waar je blij van wordt
Een 13e maand* (zo voelt de decembermaand nóg feestelijker)
8,25% vakantiegeld in mei (zodat je die vakantie of dat nieuwe tuinsetje alvast kunt plannen)
25 vakantiedagen om de batterij weer helemaal op te laden

Flexibel werken: samen op kantoor voor de gezelligheid en afstemming, soms thuis voor de focus (in overleg met je teamleider)

Alle ruimte om te groeien: via onze ChipSoft Academy en met een persoonlijk opleidingsbudget twv € 1.000, wat jaarlijks beschikbaar wordt gesteld voor jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling

jobs.title: Software Designer – High-Tech Semiconductor Equipment (PLC / C++ / C#)
jobs.description:
As a Software Designer – High-Tech Semiconductor Equipment (PLC / C++ / C#), you have experience to design and define PLC, machine control software and higher-level system software for next-generation semiconductor equipment

In this role, you contribute to the development of advanced high-tech semiconductor machines, such as next-generation sintering equipment. You operate across the full stack of machine and system control: from PLC-based machine control (TwinCAT / Siemens) to higher-level software components in C++ or C#.

You work in either an environment where software is developed from scratch or with large legacy source code, which is tightly integrated with hardware and electronics, requiring a balanced skillset across machine control and modern software engineering.

What excites you as a Software Designer – High-Tech Semiconductor Equipment (PLC / C++ / C#)?

As a Software Designer, you work on technically challenging semiconductor equipment where machine control and higher-level software come together. You translate requirements into robust designs, take ownership of modules or subsystems, and ensure a consistent design from the PLC layer up to system software.

From our office in Eindhoven, at customer locations, and remotely when appropriate, you enjoy working on:

Designing and implementing machine control software using PLC technologies (TwinCAT 3 / Siemens) and or SECS/GEM.
Developing higher-level equipment control software components in C++ and C#.
Translating system requirements into integrated hardware–software solutions and challenging requirements to drive optimal designs.
Bridging the gap between control engineering and software engineering disciplines.
Contributing to the development and evolution of both greenfield and legacy architectures for high-tech machines.
Integrating, testing, and commissioning complex semiconductor equipment.
Collaborating within Scrum teams and multidisciplinary engineering groups across software, electronics, and mechanics to deliver high-quality solutions.

Sounds good so far? We'd love to tell you more…

Your future workplace

This is what you bring to the table

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, or a related field, combined with 5–10+ years of experience in high-tech machine building and software development.
Strong expertise in PLC-based machine control (Beckhoff TwinCAT 3 and/or Siemens) and experience with SECS/GEM combined with solid software development experience in C++ or C#.
Proven experience designing and implementing control software for complex machines and industrial automation systems.
Good understanding of Object-Oriented Design, software architecture principles, and requirements engineering, with the ability to translate requirements into effective technical designs.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and with modern development tools such as Git and Azure DevOps.
Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to bridge machine control and software domains, challenge unclear requirements, and take ownership of solutions.
Collaborative and flexible mindset, with willingness to travel within the Netherlands and occasionally across Europe, and to work in a hybrid on-site/remote environment.
Nice to have: Python, Java, TwinCAT Safety, or industrial robotics experience (e.g., KUKA).

This is what you can expect in return

Flexible 32-40 hour working week, with room to work from home. A healthy work-life balance is very important to us.
We have 28 holidays with an option to buy an additional 12 holidays.
You will work with passionate colleagues who share your drive for technology and business success.
By combining our expertise in software, electronics, mechanics, mechatronics, mathematics and assembly, we make the impossible possible for our customers and get to work on challenging high-tech projects.
You get a lot of freedom and responsibility; after all, you know exactly what you are doing.
Personal coaching and a training budget of €6000 per year, so that you can continue to develop yourself.
We also find it important to have fun together. We organize a lot for our employees, from family festivals and sparkling Christmas parties, to inspiring knowledge sessions for the high-tech community.
You will be working at a prime location in the heart of the Brainport region. At our main office you can enjoy lunch, sports, making music, and share your knowledge in one of the Sioux Tech Labs (hobby clubs).

High Tech & High Fun

We can tell you all about the typical Sioux-culture and the high-tech challenging projects. About how you can develop yourself, like nowhere else. But we’d rather have you hear it from our own employees.

Go to testimonials >

If you want to know more about our challenging projects, please click here.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Role:
Principal Software Engineer
Location:
Wilmslow / Remote (UK)
We are The Citation Group - a collective of businesses dedicated to supporting small and medium-sized enterprises across a range of essential services. We know that running a business means juggling a lot. Our mission is to ease these pressures by providing expertise, guidance, and solutions that enable business leaders to focus on what they do best. From HR and Health & Safety to Cybersecurity, E-Learning, and ISO compliance, we’ve got you covered.

Citation Group has achieved strong growth through a combination of organic expansion and strategic acquisitions, continually broadening our expertise, services, and reach to create a one-stop shop that supports businesses across the UK, Canada and Australia.

Role Purpose

This is a hands-on engineering role at the heart of a significant platform transformation. You will be a core contributor to a squad that is actively changing how it builds, owns, and delivers software, and you will have real influence over the quality and direction of that work.
We are moving from a traditional release cycle to CI/CD, shifting shared services into team-owned boundaries, and embedding AI into how the team thinks and delivers. This is not a role where you maintain the status quo. You will be working alongside a Tech Lead to drive those changes forward, bringing technical craft and an AI-native approach to everything you build.
The right person for this role is someone who takes genuine pride in their work, wants to grow in a team that holds itself to a high standard, and is excited by the idea of building something better rather than just keeping things running.

Key Responsibilities

Hands-on Delivery

Write production-quality code every day across the full stack, covering backend, front-end, and the infrastructure that supports it.
Take ownership of features and workstreams from design through to deployment, delivering working software in shippable increments.
Contribute to technical design and architecture discussions, bringing well-reasoned input and a practical perspective.
Run technical spikes and proofs-of-concept to explore approaches and reduce uncertainty before committing to a direction.
Manage your own technical debt responsibly, keeping the codebase in a state you are proud of.

Platform Transformation

Play an active part in the decomposition of shared services into team-owned components, taking on defined pieces of that work and delivering them with care.
Support the move to CI/CD by contributing to pipeline work, writing automated tests, and adopting trunk-based development as the default way of working.
Build with observability in mind from the start, covering instrumentation, logging, and monitoring so that your team can see what their systems are doing in production.
Contribute to the team's growing DevOps capability, taking on operational responsibility for the systems you build.

Code Quality and Engineering Practice

Write clean, testable, secure code and hold that standard consistently, not just when it is convenient.
Practise test-driven development and contribute to a culture where good testing is the norm, using AI to generate scaffolding and explore edge cases as part of that workflow.
Participate actively in code review, giving and receiving feedback that improves the work and raises the bar for the whole team.
Apply secure coding practices as a matter of course: dependency management, threat awareness, and security testing.

AI-Native Engineering

Use AI natively in your engineering work, as part of how you think through problems, generate and review code, and build and test solutions.
Contribute to AI-powered workflows that improve the team's delivery capability, whether that is in automation, testing, code generation, or observability.
Engage actively with the team's AI agents and tooling, helping to refine and improve them as your understanding of what works deepens.
Bring a critical eye to AI-generated output, verifying quality and maintaining the standards you would apply to anything else you ship.

Collaboration and Growth

Work closely with your Tech Lead and teammates through pairing, mob programming, and shared problem-solving.
Support less experienced engineers where you can, sharing knowledge through code review, pairing, and day-to-day conversation.
Contribute to planning, refinement, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives as an engaged and thoughtful team member.
Take an active interest in your own development, staying current with the technologies and practices the team uses and bringing new ideas back to the team.

Required Experience and Skills

Technical

Solid experience as a software engineer with a proven ability to deliver complex features on production systems.
Strong full-stack capability across backend and front-end development, with experience working with databases and cloud infrastructure.
Practical experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and infrastructure-as-code.
Working knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure/AWS) and containerisation (Docker/Kubernetes).
Sound security fundamentals: secure coding, dependency management, and an awareness of common vulnerabilities.
Experience working on evolving systems, including refactoring and improving existing codebases.

AI-Native Engineering Practice

Demonstrable experience using AI as a genuine part of your engineering workflow, not just as a code completion tool.
Comfortable working with AI-generated output critically, knowing how to verify, refine, and take responsibility for what ships.

Behavioural

High standards: you care about the quality of your work and take pride in shipping something you can stand behind.
Collaborative: you work well with others, share openly, and make the people around you better.
Self-directed: you can take a piece of work, make sensible decisions, and see it through without constant oversight.
Comfortable with change: you adapt well when priorities shift or approaches evolve, and you contribute positively to that process.
Curious and committed to learning: you keep developing your skills and bring new thinking back to the team.

Nice to Have

Experience in B2B SaaS or Citation domains such as HR, Health and Safety, Compliance, Certification, or eLearning.
Experience building or contributing to AI agents or automated workflows in a production context.
Experience with event-driven architectures, message queues, or reactive systems.
Contributions to open source or active participation in technical communities.

jobs.title: Integration Architect
jobs.description:
At Axiell, we're looking for a Integration Architect
to play a key role in shaping how our products, platforms, and services connect across a global technology landscape.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys combining strategic thinking with technical leadership. You will work at the intersection of architecture, business needs, and modern technology, helping to build a future-ready integration ecosystem that supports innovation, scalability, and growth across the organization.

Working closely with architects, developers, product teams, DevOps, and Group IT, you will influence both the long-term direction and day-to-day evolution of our integration capabilities.

What you'll do

As our Integration Architect, you will lead the development of Axiell's integration architecture and shared platform capabilities. You will establish standards, governance, and best practices that enable teams to build secure, scalable, and reliable integrations across cloud, SaaS, and on-premises environments.

You will drive the adoption of modern integration approaches such as API-first and event-driven architectures, support strategic technology decisions, and ensure alignment across products, teams, and business domains. In addition, you will act as a trusted advisor and mentor, helping teams solve complex integration challenges while promoting excellence in security, performance, observability, and maintainability.

What we're looking for

We're looking for a senior architect who thrives in complex environments and enjoys enabling others through strong technical leadership. You are passionate about modern integration technologies and understand how cloud services, automation, and AI are transforming enterprise architecture.

You bring a strategic mindset, strong communication skills, and the ability to balance long-term architectural vision with practical business needs. Experience evaluating, integrating, or governing AI-powered solutions in enterprise environments is considered a strong advantage.

Architecture & Integration

API-first architecture
Event-driven architectures (EDA)
Microservices and service-oriented architectures
Enterprise integration patterns
API lifecycle management and governance
Integration platform strategy and platform ownership

Cloud & Platform Technologies

Azure, AWS, or hybrid cloud environments
Azure Integration Services, Boomi, MuleSoft, Workato, or similar platforms
Kafka, Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, or other messaging technologies
Modern SaaS and distributed application ecosystems

Security & Governance

OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and JWT
Secure integration patterns and Zero Trust principles
Versioning, policy management, and governance frameworks
Enterprise-scale architecture standards

Technical Leadership

Influencing technical strategy across teams
Coaching developers and technical leads
Translating complex technical concepts into business value
Collaborating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Nice-to-have

GitHub, CI/CD, and DevOps practices
Power Platform (Power Automate and Power Apps)
AI-assisted development tools
Development in Java or C#

We believe you have:

8+ years of experience within integration and solution architecture
Experience designing scalable cloud-based integration solutions
Strong understanding of architecture governance and best practices
Excellent communication skills in English
Relevant degree or equivalent professional experience

Why join Axiell?

At Axiell, you'll be part of an international company where technology drives innovation and growth.

We offer flexible ways of working, a collaborative culture, modern cloud-first technologies, and the opportunity to influence our technical direction while contributing to knowledge, culture, and education worldwide.

jobs.title: Cloud Architect (Azure)
jobs.description:
Grow. Make a difference. Together.

We want to help our clients understand why cloud services can support their growth and how to embark on a sustainable cloud journey. Our strong Azure expertise, combined with our highest-level Microsoft partnership, enables us to act as a long-term and trusted partner to our customers, helping them develop their cloud services securely, efficiently and with cost optimization in mind.

We are now looking to strengthen our team of Azure professionals with an Azure Architect
and invite you to join us in building a sustainable future! Sustainability is one of our core principles, and we have, for example, signed the Microsoft Partner Pledge.

As an Azure Architect, you will design, implement, maintain and continuously develop new and sustainable cloud services for a wide range of customers. Our clients include major organisations such as Valmet, S Group and Varma (customer case).

What is the role about?

We are looking for an Azure Architect with strong expertise and experience particularly in Kubernetes solutions. In this role, you will take the lead in designing and implementing demanding container solutions using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
, ensuring that they are scalable, secure and reliable.

A key part of the role is also strategically planning future technology directions, designing environments that support evolving business needs, and driving innovation through new cloud technologies. You will play an important role in developing business continuity and resilience solutions tailored to container-based applications, guiding smooth migrations and optimising system performance for both current and future needs.

In this key role, you will work with a diverse range of clients across different industries, providing both strategic direction and technical leadership in using container technologies to transform their businesses.

As a professional at Knowit, you will have every opportunity to put your expertise to use while continuing to develop your skills with the latest modern technologies. We encourage experimentation and trying new things, and you can steer the development of your expertise in the direction that best supports your growth as a cloud professional.

Building service solutions based on Microsoft Azure cloud architectures covers the entire journey, from definition and design to development and deployment. You will work as part of client teams alongside other experienced Azure professionals, right at the intersection of technology and our clients’ businesses.

What do we expect from you?

At Knowit, we are all makers at heart: we keep our promises and approach our work with passion. We are proud of our broad expertise and take pride in what we do. Being a consultant at Knowit can be summarized as follows

The ability to present and communicate ideas, best practices, and technical solutions to various stakeholders—from development teams to non-technical audiences.
The ability to see technologies as tools for solving technical problems and delivering value.
A built-in curiosity to learn new things, experiment with new technologies and practices, develop professionally, and share knowledge with others.

In addition to the maker mindset, we expect you to have a genuine interest in the technical side of Azure. One thing all our Azure professionals have in common is the ability and willingness to do hands-on technical work when needed. You are also able to communicate fluently and confidently with both technical and non-technical stakeholders in English
.

We hope you have:

3–5 years of experience with Azure cloud services. This means an interest in designing and defining architectures and/or strong expertise in implementing them. Infrastructure as Code (IaC) is our preferred way of working.
3–5 years of experience in container orchestration, preferably in an Azure environment, particularly in designing, developing, deploying, maintaining and troubleshooting container-based applications and their architectures using technologies such as Kubernetes and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
A DevOps mindset: you understand modern approaches to building solutions using native tools and code, and actively look for opportunities to automate everything from infrastructure to business logic.
Strong expertise in designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines for container-based applications, including Azure Container Registry integrations and the use of Helm package management.
Experience in implementing and managing security practices in Kubernetes environments, such as network policies and security contexts, as well as a good understanding of Azure security tools such as Defender for Cloud.

Skills that are considered an advantage, but are not required:

Ingress controllers and Gateway API

You will join a cross-functional team with full ownership of our products and codebase, where you will take part in every step of the development process, from ideation to maintenance. This is a place where you can grow as an individual, learn from senior mentors, and have a real influence on the direction of our projects.
About the team: 

You will be joining a brand new team being built within the Trust Tech department, focusing specifically on businesses.
The team is responsible for building and maintaining automated systems that enforce Trustpilot’s terms of use for businesses. This includes developing systems for automatic detection, enforcement of misuse, and internal investigation tools.
This work is vital to maintaining Trust and Transparency on the platform. To achieve this, we collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Data Ops, and ML Ops to build sophisticated automated architectures that integrate detection models and robustly scale our misuse enforcement.
What you’ll be doing:

Work in a cross-functional “full ownership” team alongside Product, Design, and Data Science.
Implement and release new features with a focus on backend stability and scalability.
Help build solutions to handle high-volume data processing for fraud detection.
Maintain and improve the internal tooling frontends (React) used for investigations.
Troubleshoot existing software, squash bugs, and learn how to optimize database performance.
Participate in technical discussions and learn best practices for Infrastructure as Code.
Collaborate with Data Scientists to support the integration of detection models.

Experience in full-stack web development (commercial experience or a strong portfolio), with a focus on backend systems.
Solid knowledge of JavaScript and TypeScript.
Solid understanding of backend development with Node.js.
Understanding of SQL (e.g., PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB) database concepts.

A friendly, helpful personality, open to giving and receiving feedback constructively.
Ambitious and passionate about your work, motivated to continually improve.

Interest in Applied AI and how it integrates with backend engineering.

Backend: Node.js, Serverless Framework

A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you
Competitive compensation package + bonus
25 days holiday per year, increasing to 28 days after 2 years of employment
Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community
Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist
Pension and life insurance 
Health cash plan, online GP, 24/7 Employee Assistance Plan
Full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health
Paid parental leave

Central office location complete with all the snacks and refreshments you can ask for

Access to over 4,000 deals and discounts on things like travel, electronics, fashion, fitness, cinema discounts, and more.

About us

Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve.
Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we’re headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in  Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York. 
We’re driven by connection. It’s at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it’s built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas. 
Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We’re a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you’re ready to grow, let’s go.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer in Test
jobs.description:
**Job Requisition ID \#**


26WD100960
Autodesk is looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test with an interest in CI/CD and release engineering to help build the automated quality and software delivery systems for a new Electron\-based desktop platform. In this hands\-on individual contributor role, you will develop and maintain test automation, CI/CD pipelines, desktop packaging, and release validation. You will work with experienced engineers to improve developer feedback, automate repeatable release processes, troubleshoot technical issues, and help ensure that customer releases are reliable and well tested. This is a hybrid role based in our Sheffield office.

 **Responsibilities**

* **Test automation \- approximately 35%:** Develop and maintain automated functional, integration, end\-to\-end, installer, upgrade, and regression tests. Add automated coverage for new features and improve existing tests as the product evolves
* **CI/CD and build automation \- approximately 30%:** Develop and maintain continuous integration pipelines using Jenkins or similar systems. Automate build, test, packaging, artifact creation, and related engineering workflows
* **Release qualification and automation \- approximately 20%:** Help automate Windows desktop packaging, code signing, publishing, installation validation, upgrade testing, and release\-candidate qualification
* **Troubleshooting and quality improvement \- approximately 15%:** Investigate build, test, installer, and application failures. Work with software engineers to identify root causes, reproduce issues, and implement or automate solutions
* Review product requirements and user stories to understand test scope, identify quality risks, and contribute to test plans
* Execute functional, integration, regression, and other forms of testing when automation is not yet available or when exploratory validation is appropriate.
* Build and maintain reusable test utilities, test data, and automation components
* Help create automated Windows test environments using virtual machines or other reproducible infrastructure
* Participate in release\-readiness activities, bug bashes, defect triage, and risk assessment
* Monitor test and pipeline results, report failures clearly, and help distinguish product defects from test or infrastructure issues
* Improve flaky tests and unreliable pipeline stages to increase the quality of developer feedback
* Document build, test, and release procedures so they can be understood and maintained by the broader engineering team
* Collaborate with software engineers, product teams, and infrastructure teams to improve product quality and engineering productivity

 **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* Software development or test automation experience using a language such as Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, PowerShell, C\#, Java, or similar
* Experience developing automated tests for software applications
* Familiarity with continuous integration and delivery concepts and tools such as Jenkins, CloudBees CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar
* Understanding of source control systems such as Git and common software development workflows
* Ability to troubleshoot common software, test automation, build, and environment problems
* Understanding of software testing practices including functional, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end testing
* Ability to work collaboratively with software engineers and other technical team members
* Strong written and verbal communication skills

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Windows desktop applications
* Experience with Electron or applications built using web technologies
* Experience with Windows packaging technologies such as MSI, WiX, NSIS, or similar
* Experience working with Jenkins or CloudBees CI pipelines
* Familiarity with Windows code signing and software publishing workflows
* Experience automating install, upgrade, uninstall, and application\-startup scenarios
* Experience using virtual machines or other automated test environments
* Familiarity with enterprise Windows environments, device\-management systems, corporate proxies, or restricted\-user configurations
* Experience investigating intermittent or flaky automated tests

 **The Ideal Candidate**


You enjoy writing code that makes software development and testing more reliable. You are interested in understanding how software moves from a developer's change to a tested customer release, and you like working across test automation, build systems, and desktop application behavior.


You are comfortable troubleshooting technical problems, learning unfamiliar tools, asking questions when needed, and working with more experienced engineers on complex issues. You look for opportunities to automate repetitive work and improve the reliability of the team's development and release processes.


You also value the benefits of hybrid collaboration and are comfortable working regularly from Autodesk's Sheffield office while partnering with distributed teams across the company.

  

We are building a new desktop platform that enables Autodesk's web\-based products to deliver richer, higher\-performance experiences on Windows. Forma is the first product adopting the platform, with the longer\-term goal of creating reusable desktop capabilities for additional Autodesk products.


You will join a new cross\-functional platform team working across desktop application engineering, test automation, continuous integration and delivery, and software release.

**This is a hybrid working position based out of Autodesk's Sheffield office.** You will collaborate both in person with colleagues in Sheffield and remotely with engineering and partner teams across Autodesk.

**Learn More**

**About Autodesk**


Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.


We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.


When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

**Salary transparency**


Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package. **Belonging**  

We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/global\-belonging

 **In\-Person Onboarding and Identity Verification**


This role may require in\-person onboarding and/or in\-person ID verification.

jobs.title: Software Ontwikkelaar Medische Technologie
jobs.description:
Ben jij een software ontwikkelaar met passie voor innovatie? Wil je bijdragen aan vernieuwende medische oplossingen die het werk van artsen, verpleegkundigen en onderzoekers direct ondersteunen?

Dit ga je doen

Als Software Ontwikkelaar Medische Technologie ga je ontwerpen, ontwikkelen, en testen van softwareoplossingen voor innovatieve medische toepassingen. Je werkt in een multidisciplinair team aan verschillende vraagstukken, waarbij jij verantwoordelijk bent op het gebied van software en productintegratie, binnen een gereguleerde omgeving.

Je Werkzaamheden Bestaan Onder Andere Uit

Ontwikkelen van software voor (prototype) medische hulpmiddelen, onderzoeksopstellingen, en digitale zorgoplossingen.
Rechtstreeks schakelen met eindgebruikers zoals artsen, onderzoekers en zorgprofessionals om hun behoeften te vertalen naar concrete oplossingen.
Samenwerken met collega's uit de disciplines (embedded) software, elektronica, mechanica, en advies MDR.
Vastleggen van ontwerpkeuzes, testresultaten en risicoanalyses conform ISO 13485 en IEC 62304.
Optreden als projectleider in ontwikkelprojecten.
Bijdragen aan het verbeteren van ontwikkelprocessen, kwaliteitssystemen en technische standaarden binnen het team.

Hier ga je werken

Je komt te werken binnen het Team Ontwikkeling van het cluster Medische Technologie & Klinische Fysica van het UMC Utrecht, een bijzondere plek waar technologie, onderzoek en zorg samenkomen. Het multidisciplinaire team bestaat uit ontwerpers op het gebied van mechanica, elektronica, (embedded) software, instrumentmakers en advies rondom MDR. Samen ontwikkelen jullie innovatieve medische technologie, onderzoeksapparatuur en maatwerkoplossingen voor de zorg.

De cultuur is professioneel maar informeel: er is ruimte voor creativiteit en een sterke focus op het leveren van de juiste kwaliteit, passend bij elke unieke vraag. Je werkt nauw samen met onderzoekers, artsen en zorgprofessionals en ziet daardoor direct de impact van jouw werk in de praktijk.

Dit neem je mee

Je neemt graag verantwoordelijkheid, houdt van uitdaging en krijgt energie van samenwerken aan innovatieve oplossingen. Je werkt zelfstandig en proactief, maar bent ook een echte teamspeler die verschillende technische disciplines weet te verbinden en collega’s enthousiast maakt. Met jouw communicatieve vaardigheden, oog voor kwaliteit en drive om continu te verbeteren, draag je bij aan slimme oplossingen én een sterk eindresultaat.

Wat breng je mee?

Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in Informatica, Software Engineering of een vergelijkbare richting.
Ongeveer 3 tot 5 jaar ervaring als softwareontwikkelaar, of in een vergelijkbare functie.
Bij voorkeur ervaring binnen een gereguleerde omgeving, zoals medische technologie of de industrie.
Goede kennis van Python en C#.
Ervaring met DevOps-principes en versiebeheer met Git.

Een Pré Als Je Ook Ervaring Hebt Met

Het coördineren van projecten of begeleiden van technische ontwikkeltrajecten.
Kwaliteits- en ontwikkelstandaarden zoals ISO 13485 en IEC 62304.
Medische instrumentatie, signaalverwerking of high-frequency waveform-analyse.
Interoperabiliteitsstandaarden, zoals SDC (Service-Oriented Device Connectivity).

Een mooie uitdaging voor een professional die techniek, innovatie én maatschappelijke impact wil combineren.

Dit bieden we jou

Een salaris tussen de € 3.724,- en € 5.867,- bruto per maand (schaal 10), op basis van een fulltime dienstverband (36 uur).
Eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% en vakantietoeslag van 8%.
Gunstige pensioenregeling bij ABP: wij betalen 70% van de premie.
100% vergoeding van je OV-kosten. Kom je lopend, fietsend of met de auto? Dan ontvang je € 0,21 per km (tot max. 40 km enkele reis).
Mogelijkheden om jezelf persoonlijk en op werkgebied te blijven ontwikkelen.
Cao à la carte: kies extra arbeidsvoorwaarden in ruil voor brutosalaris, zoals voor de aanschaf van een fiets, vergoeding van je internetabonnement en lidmaatschappen.

Wij geloven in de kracht van een divers team waarin ruimte is voor verschillende vaardigheden, expertises, sociale en culturele achtergronden. Wij zijn benieuwd naar jou!

Onze nieuwe collega's werven we zelf. We hebben geen behoefte aan acquisitie.

Welkom! Wat fijn dat je bij ons aan de slag gaat! Heel veel werkplezier!

Kom je bij ons werken? Dan geldt voor jou de cao umc. Daarnaast bieden we je nog veel meer. Zo hebben we een Personeelsvereniging die zorgt voor leuke extra's en we organiseren van alles zodat jij jezelf kan blijven ontwikkelen.

jobs.title: Medior Support Engineer
jobs.description:
Ben je de standaard supporttickets inmiddels ontgroeid en wil je jezelf technisch verder ontwikkelen? Dan krijg je bij Collabite de ruimte om die volgende stap te zetten.

Wat jij gaat doen

Als Medior Support Engineer werk je nog steeds mee in de dagelijkse 1e- en 2e-lijns support, maar pak je daarnaast steeds vaker complexere technische vraagstukken op. Je leert verschillende klantomgevingen kennen, werkt met Microsoft-, server- en netwerktechnologie en groeit stap voor stap naar meer technische verantwoordelijkheid. Op termijn kun je je verder ontwikkelen richting bijvoorbeeld security, monitoring of System Engineer.

Je zorgt eerst dat de klant verder kan, maar kijkt daarna vooral naar de oorzaak. Waarom gebeurt dit en hoe zorgen we ervoor dat het niet opnieuw voorkomt? Juist die technische diepgang maakt deze functie anders dan een reguliere servicedeskrol.

Daarnaast ben je een belangrijke vraagbaak voor je collega’s. Wanneer zij technisch vastlopen, kunnen ze bij jou terecht om te sparren en samen tot een oplossing te komen. Om deze rol goed te vervullen, houd jij je dagelijks bezig met:

Analyseren en oplossen van complexere incidenten binnen server-, cloud- en netwerkomgevingen
Werken met onder andere Microsoft 365, Azure, Intune, Active Directory en Windows Server
Onderzoeken van terugkerende problemen en zoeken naar structurele oplossingen
Ondersteunen van eerste- en tweedelijns collega’s bij technische escalaties

Waar je terecht komt

Je komt terecht op de servicedesk van Collabite, een MSP die IT-omgevingen beheert voor verschillende organisaties. Daardoor werk je niet iedere dag in dezelfde omgeving, maar krijg je te maken met verschillende klanten, infrastructuren en technische vraagstukken.

Het serviceteam bestaat momenteel uit ongeveer elf collega's en groeit verder. Het is een relatief jong team waarin samenwerken belangrijk is. Heb jij ruimte en zie je dat een collega vastloopt? Dan help je elkaar. Tegelijkertijd is de afdeling volop in ontwikkeling. Collabite gaat de verdeling tussen eenvoudige en complexe tickets verder aanscherpen. Jij krijgt daarin juist de complexere vraagstukken en kunt vanuit jouw technische kennis meedenken over hoe processen slimmer kunnen worden ingericht.

Wil je jezelf verder specialiseren? Dan zijn er mogelijkheden richting bijvoorbeeld security, monitoring of uiteindelijk System Engineer.

Wie jij bent

Jij vindt het leuk om een technisch probleem echt uit te zoeken. Een tijdelijke oplossing is soms nodig, maar je wilt vooral begrijpen waarom iets gebeurt en hoe je herhaling voorkomt. Daarnaast breng je het volgende mee:

Minimaal mbo-4 werk- en denkniveau richting ICT
Ervaring binnen IT-support, systeembeheer of een vergelijkbare technische functie
Kennis van Microsoft 365, Azure, Active Directory en Windows Server
Basiskennis van netwerken, VPN, DHCP en firewalls
Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal

Ervaring binnen een MSP is mooi meegenomen, maar geen harde eis. Belangrijker is dat je technisch voldoende diepgang hebt en makkelijk tussen verschillende omgevingen kunt schakelen.

Über EASY Photonics
EASY Photonics ist ein junges Deep-Tech-Startup aus Paderborn.
Wir entwickeln ein kompaktes Multisensorsystem für die automatisierte Analyse von Flüssigkeiten – zunächst für Wasser- und Umweltanwendungen. Unser Ziel ist, komplexe Messungen stärker zu automatisieren und direkt dort verfügbar zu machen, wo die Proben entstehen, z. B. in Kläranlagen, industriellen Prozessen oder wissenschaftlichen Messkampagnen.
Aktuell überführen wir unseren Forschungsdemonstrator in ein robustes, reproduzierbar herstellbares Produkt und bauen gleichzeitig Geräte-, Mess- und Laborautomation auf.
Dafür suchen wir einen Mathematisch-technischen Software Engineer (m/w/d).
Deine Rolle
Du entwickelst Software dort, wo sie auf reale Hardware trifft.
Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf Automation und produktnaher Software:
Steuerung kartesischer Robotersysteme
automatisierte Probenvorbereitung und Pipettierung
Ansteuerung von Motoren, Pumpen, Ventilen und Sensoren
automatisierte Messabläufe
Kommunikation zwischen Messgeräten und Automation
Ablauf- und Zustandssteuerungen
Fehlererkennung, Logging und Diagnose
Prüf- und Kalibrierabläufe
Geräte- und Konfigurationsmanagement
strukturierte Speicherung und Zuordnung von Messdaten
Benutzeroberflächen und Schnittstellen

Je nach Projekt und Interesse können auch Scientific Data Visualization, Dashboards oder georeferenzierte Messdaten Teil deiner Arbeit werden. Der Schwerpunkt bleibt aber klar auf Softwareentwicklung und Automation.
Du bist nicht unser „einziger Entwickler“
Wir bauen gerade ein wachsendes technisches Team auf.
Du arbeitest eng zusammen mit:
einem weiteren Software Engineer, der insbesondere an KI-gestützter Auswertung und Datenfusion arbeitet
einem Product & Automation Design Engineer, der die mechanische Seite unserer Geräte, Robotik und Automation entwickelt
unserem Gründer und der technischen Systementwicklung

Zusätzlich erhalten wir Entwicklungsunterstützung durch Innowise sowie das Jülich Supercomputing Centre (JSC).
Du musst also nicht gleichzeitig Embedded Developer, Frontend-Entwickler, KI-Spezialist, Data Scientist und Maschinenbauer sein.
Wie wir Automation entwickeln
Wir wollen nicht für jedes Problem eine teure fertige Industrieanlage einkaufen.
Viele Systeme entwickeln wir selbst – unter anderem mit kartesischen Achssystemen auf Basis moderner 3D-Drucker-Mechanik, Standardmotoren, Sensoren, Kameras und eigener Hardware.
Der Maschinenkonstrukteur entwickelt beispielsweise die Mechanik eines Pipettierroboters – du entwickelst die Software, mit der daraus ein funktionierendes Automatisierungssystem wird.
Was du mitbringen solltest
Für die Einstufung im öffentlich geförderten Projekt benötigen wir einen abgeschlossenen Master- oder Diplomabschluss, z. B. in:
Informatik
Technischer Informatik
Software Engineering
Scientific Computing
Mathematik mit Informatikschwerpunkt
Computational Science
Embedded Systems
Automatisierungstechnik mit starkem Softwareanteil
oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung

Du solltest:
sehr gut programmieren können
analytisch und strukturiert denken
Interesse an mathematisch-technischen Problemen haben
keine Scheu vor realer Hardware haben
dich selbstständig in neue technische Systeme einarbeiten können
auch mit noch nicht vollständig definierten Anforderungen umgehen können

Berufserfahrung ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung.
Eigene Projekte, wissenschaftliche Software, Robotik, Embedded-Systeme, Open-Source-Beiträge oder eine technisch interessante Masterarbeit sind für uns besonders interessant.
Technologien können z. B. Python, C/C++, C#, Rust, Git, Linux, Mikrocontroller, Gerätekommunikation, Datenbanken oder Computer Vision umfassen. Du musst nicht alles davon beherrschen.
Wie wir arbeiten
Eine typische Aufgabe könnte lauten:
„Unser Pipettierroboter soll diese Proben automatisch vorbereiten und anschließend die Messung starten.“
Dann konkretisieren wir gemeinsam die Anforderungen und setzen die Lösung praktisch um:
programmieren → an echter Hardware testen → Fehler finden → verbessern → erneut testen
Wenn dir diese Art von Softwareentwicklung Spaß macht, passt die Stelle gut zu dir.
Dein Arbeitsplatz
Wir arbeiten in der garage33 in Paderborn. Dort haben wir umfangreiche Möglichkeiten für Prototyping und Fertigung und bauen einen großen Teil unserer Messgeräte und Automation direkt vor Ort auf.
Softwareentwicklung findet bei uns deshalb nicht losgelöst von der Hardware statt.

3.000 € brutto pro Monat
Vollzeit, Start ab sofort
Arbeit in einem wachsenden Deep-Tech-Team
viel technischer Gestaltungsspielraum
direkter Kontakt zu Robotik und wissenschaftlicher Messtechnik
kurze Entscheidungswege
eigene technische Verantwortung
Möglichkeit, unsere Software- und Automatisierungsarchitektur früh mitzuprägen
Entwicklungsumgebung in der garage33
Finanzierung der Stelle im Rahmen von Grüne Gründungen.NRW

Interesse?
Dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und gerne Beispiele deiner bisherigen Projekte, z. B. GitHub, wissenschaftliche Software, Robotikprojekte oder deine Masterarbeit.
Wir suchen nicht den längsten Lebenslauf, sondern jemanden, der sehr gut denken und programmieren kann und Lust hat, gemeinsam mit einem technischen Team reale Maschinen und wissenschaftliche Messgeräte zu entwickeln.

Our research recently helped fix a P1 security flaw in Google's Gemini CLI.

Has a strong academic foundation - an undergraduate or/and master's degree, ideally in a STEM subject like computer science, engineering, maths, physics… and has demonstrated real academic excellence.
Has strong engineering fundamentals and a real appetite to learn - can write clean, correct code in a known language, and is genuinely curious about how things work under the hood.
Has built things they're proud of - side projects, open source, hackathons… And is excited by the pace and rate of change that is inevitable in any successful, early stage startup.
Gets their energy from getting things done and in the hands of customers but is also here to have fun along the way!

If you don’t fit this bill exactly but think you could make a difference here - please, apply!

Role

Reporting to Niall, our Engineering Lead, and with significant exposure to our CTO and Co-Founder, Sam, you’ll join a team of other awesome engineers looking to make their mark on the world.

This Includes

Working face to face with both founders, the whole engineering team and our customers and prospects to build a delightful product that solves real problems.
Working across the stack, mostly in C# on .NET Core 10 (here's why), but also Terraform and building out our frontend in HTMX.
All the good practices you’d expect from technical co-founders who’ve done this before (CD, Infrastructure as code, simple but scalable and powerful architecture)
We’re a small, tight team with demanding customers so expect to be shipping every day with very little bureaucracy.
We actively encourage AI-assisted development and give every engineer full access to tools like Claude and Codex.
We’re based in a Central London office and work here 5 days a week (and everyone we hire will too).

FAQs

How is work organised at Tracebit?

It’s a small, tight team - we have a standup everyday, each team member is usually responsible for delivering something reasonably large for customers and we meet every few weeks to talk about longer term plans. Between that - there’s a tonne of discussions, customer feedback and analysis, but not a huge amount of process, the team is trusted to prioritise where to spend their time.

Where is the office?

The whole team works together in an office right next to Warren Street tube station - there are lots of great places to grab lunch nearby.

Are you doing hybrid/remote?

‍Short answer: No, but flexible on a day to day basis.

Long answer: We are set on building the company on a foundation of an office based culture. We are a very early stage company and think that we’ll build the best company at the fastest pace we can whilst also having a lot of fun by physically working together 5 days a week. On a case by case basis (e.g. leaving early for a holiday, staying home for a builder, working remote for a few days to visit family, etc. etc.) we’re very reasonable and flexible. We respect that this is not for everyone.

‍ What are the working hours like?

‍We think 9am-6pm will bring a great cadence to work. As a Founding Engineer there will definitely be times you need to pick up work outside of these hours, we’re keen to limit this where we can but also offer flexibility in return.

Can you sponsor visas?

We can support various types of working visas in the UK, including:

Skilled Worker Visa (both from within and outside the UK)
Intra-Company Transfer Visa
Graduate Visa Transition

We are keen to support candidates who require visa sponsorship. Please let us know which specific visa type you might need during the initial application or interview process. Our team is committed to helping talented individuals navigate the necessary visa requirements.

This is not a traditional application development role. Instead, you will help build a reusable identity platform that enables other engineering teams to adopt standardised authentication and authorisation services while improving security, developer experience and operational efficiency.

The capability provides shared identity and access management services that help applications authenticate users securely, authorise access to business resources and integrate with enterprise identity providers.

Built on Auth0, Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) and modern Azure services, it includes reusable SDKs, reverse proxy services and developer tooling that make secure integration simpler across ICT’s technology landscape.

You will work closely with architects, product teams, platform engineers and business stakeholders helping deliver secure, scalable and high-quality technology solutions that create value for WTW and its customers. You will be expected to work with a high degree of autonomy, take ownership of significant work packages and make sound technical decisions within the agreed platform direction.

Contribute to automation, CI/CD and cloud platform improvements that make delivery faster and more predictable.
Collaborate with architects, product owners, QA, DevOps and consuming product teams to solve identity and access management challenges.
Actively learn, share knowledge and contribute to a positive engineering culture within the Quartz team.

Identity Platform Development

Design, develop and maintain authentication and authorization services using modern .NET technologies.
Develop reusable platform services supporting secure authentication and authorization across multiple business applications.
Build scalable REST APIs and integration services used throughout the organisation.
Develop and maintain Angular-based administration portals supporting user, group and permission management.
Contribute to the evolution of Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) capabilities and centralized access management services.

Platform Services & Developer Experience

Develop reusable SDKs, libraries and APIs that simplify integration with the enterprise identity platform.
Build developer tooling that improves onboarding and adoption of shared authentication services.
Improve developer experience by simplifying authentication, authorization and platform integration.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation using Azure DevOps.

jobs.title: AI Engineering Expert
jobs.description:
We are Reckitt

Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.

Information Technology & Digital

In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.

Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.

Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.

About The Role

Join our Global Data & Analytics team and embark on an exciting journey to unravel the hidden insights within vast data oceans. We're dedicated to empowering smarter decisions and delivering superior products to our global consumers and customers.

As an AI Engineering Expert you will play a crucial role in developing and deploying AI and GenAI solutions to support R&D Stream. This role combines technical leadership—guiding external teams and ensuring alignment with best practices—with hands-on delivery of AI-driven solutions. You will work closely with the platform team to align the tech stack with organizational standards while staying at the forefront of AI advancements. Your ability to seamlessly integrate AI into business workflows will be instrumental in transforming insights into tangible impact.

Your responsibilities

Developing & Delivering GenAI Solutions: Lead the deployment and management of AI/GenAI capabilities, primarily leveraging existing APIs and third-party models, while ensuring practical and impactful integration into product concept creation.
Technical Leadership & Cross-Team Coordination: Guide external teams in implementing AI solutions while collaborating with internal platform and engineering teams to align with organizational standards and ensure scalability, security, and efficiency.
Stakeholder Engagement: Act as a key interface between R&D and the broader Data & Analytics ecosystem, translating business needs into AI-driven solutions and effectively communicating progress, challenges, and best practices.
AI Technology & Best Practices: Stay ahead of GenAI advancements (e.g., Transformer architectures, large language models, MLOps), assessing and integrating new tools to enhance existing AI capabilities.
Data Strategy & Infrastructure: Advocate for robust data foundations, working with data engineering teams to optimize data pipelines, storage, and processing, ensuring AI solutions are built on high-quality, well-structured data.
Measurement & Optimization: Define KPIs, conduct experiments (e.g., A/B testing), and refine AI applications based on real-world performance to maximize their impact on product innovation and decision-making.
Mentorship & Knowledge Sharing: Provide technical leadership, mentoring junior data scientists and analysts while fostering a collaborative, AI-driven culture within the Global Data Science Chapter.

The experience we're looking for

Right Education: Master’s or PhD in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, etc.).
Technical Expertise:
Strong experience developing GenAI applications using Python: hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG architectures, embeddings, and prompt engineering.
Strong software engineering fundamentals, including API development, testing, version control, and maintainable code design.
Experience designing and deploying AI solutions in Azure cloud environments.
Strong knowledge of SQL and data management principles, experience with Databricks is a plus.
Familiarity with ML/LLMOps tooling, model evaluation, monitoring, and deployment practices (with e.g. LangFuse or MLflow)

Domain Knowledge: Understanding of R&D process is an advantage.
Leadership & Communication: Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to lead technical teams and bridge technical and business functions, effectively translating complex AI concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Adaptability: Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities, ready to pivot as AI technologies evolve.

The skills for success

Digital Strategy, Product Solution Architecture, Data Governance, Product Compliance, Digital Transformation, Stakeholder Relationship Management, Outstanding Communication, stakeholder engagement, Innovation Processes, Innovation, User Experience Design.

What we offer

With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.

Equality

We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

i det største norskeide IT- konsulenthuset
. Vi kaller det «liten i stor»
– et lokalt, engasjerende fagmiljø med korte beslutningsveier, høy faglig puls og støtte fra noen av landets fremste teknologer og arkitekter.

er vår base. Det er stedet hvor vi bygger fagmiljø, fellesskap og kultur. Her skjer det faglige og sosiale: sparring, læring, fagkvelder og gode samtaler over en kaffe.

. Du får en variert arbeidshverdag, der du både får faglig utfordring og muligheten til å se resultatene av det du skaper.

Konkurransedyktige betingelser

Integrasjon: API-er, asynkron kommunikasjon

DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Observability
Kvalitet: Test, Code Reviews
KI: KI-assistert utvikling og agentisk utvikling

Utvikle robuste løsninger i større systemlandskap med tydelige kvalitetskrav
Delta i tekniske beslutninger og arkitekturdiskusjoner (på et nivå som passer rollen/prosjektet)
Jobbe tett med UX/design, sikkerhet, data/plattform og produkt
Bidra til ryddig, lesbar og langsiktig kode, og gode utviklingsprinsipper i teamet
Veilede andre når det er naturlig (f.eks. parprogrammering og kodegjennomgang)

Fullført høyere utdanning innen relevant fagområde
5+ års erfaring som utvikler
God erfaring med C# og .Net
Erfaring med API-design og integrasjoner i moderne systemer
Erfaring med frontend (React/TypeScript eller lignende)
Erfaring med, og trives i, smidige tverrfaglige team

God formidlingsevne på norsk, muntlig og skriftlig (tilsvarende C1)

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Machine Control Diagnostic Tool
jobs.description:
Job Description

Vil du utvikle produktet som gir teknikere bedre oversikt, raskere feilsøking og tryggere drift av avansert boreutstyr?

Om stillingen

Maskin Control utvikler software og kontrollsystemer for boreutstyr, roboter og automatiserte prosesser. Vi søker nå en erfaren softwareingeniør som vil bidra til videreutviklingen av MCDT - Machine Control Diagnostic Tool, et produkt som kobler sammen kontrollsystemer, instrumentering, visualisering og operativ feilsøking.

MCDT gir riggelektroteknikere og hydraulikere sanntidsinnsikt i maskiner og komponenter. Produktet samler blant annet alarmer, I/O-data, trendkurver, P&ID-visning, komponentinformasjon, 3D-visualisering, kalibrering og veiledet diagnostikk i én helhetlig løsning. Målet er å gjøre det enklere å forstå hva som skjer, finne rotårsaken og gjennomføre riktige tiltak.

Som Software Engineer blir du en sentral del av et tverrfaglig produktmiljø. Du vil arbeide med videreutvikling av eksisterende moduler og nye funksjoner, og følge løsningene fra behov og design via implementasjon og testing til installasjon og bruk på boreutstyr.

Hvorfor NOV?

Hos NOV får du jobbe med et produkt som brukes til å gjøre komplekse maskiner enklere å forstå og vedlikeholde. Du blir del av et sterkt fagmiljø i Maskin Control, der softwareutviklere, automasjonsingeniører, robotprogrammerere og fageksperter samarbeider tett om løsninger som skal fungere i krevende operasjoner over hele verden.

Du Får

Arbeide med et produkt i skjæringspunktet mellom software, automasjon og boreutstyr
Mulighet til å påvirke produktarkitektur, brukeropplevelse og videre funksjonalitet
Teknisk krevende oppgaver med tydelig verdi for drift, vedlikehold og sikkerhet
Et tverrfaglig miljø med høy grad av samarbeid og faglig sparring
Mulighet til å følge løsningen fra utvikling til bruk på virkelig utstyr
Gode utviklings- og karrieremuligheter samt konkurransedyktige betingelser

Mangfold og inkludering

Vi ønsker å fremme mangfold og like muligheter. Derfor oppfordrer vi alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke – uavhengig av kjønn, alder, kulturell bakgrunn, funksjonsevne eller livssyn.

Arbeidssted
: Kristiansand

Oppstart
: etter avtale

Vi vurderer søknader fortløpende.
Send oss din søknad dersom du ønsker å utvikle neste generasjon verktøy for diagnostikk, service og kontroll av boreutstyr.

Kontakt for teknisk informasjon om stillingen:
Ståle Enes +47 90 600 353

Responsibilities

Arbeidsoppgaver

Videreutvikling av MCDT-plattformen og produktets brukergrensesnitt basert på WinCC OA fra Siemens
Utvikling av funksjonalitet for sanntidsdata, I/O-visning, alarmer og trendanalyse
Arbeid med visualisering av elektriske og hydrauliske P&ID-er med levende prosessdata
Utvikling av diagnostikk- og veiledningsfunksjoner som hjelper brukeren å finne rotårsaker
Integrasjon mot PLS-er, kontrollsystemer, instrumentering, sensorer og maskindata
Arbeid med komponentinformasjon, datasheets, 3D-visning og kobling mellom fysisk utstyr og digital modell
Utvikling og testing av kalibrerings- og servicefunksjoner for autoriserte brukere
Testing i simulator, testmiljø og på fysisk boreutstyr, samt FAT og idriftsettelse
Teknisk dokumentasjon, feilsøking og samarbeid med prosjekt-, service- og automasjonsmiljøer

Qualifications

Vi ser etter deg som har

Flere års erfaring med softwareutvikling av industrielle, tekniske eller produktnære løsninger
Relevant høyere utdanning innen software, datateknologi, automasjon, kybernetikk, mekatronikk eller tilsvarende erfaring
God forståelse av sanntidsdata, kontrollsystemer, instrumentering eller industriell automasjon
Erfaring med å utvikle robuste brukergrensesnitt for komplekse tekniske systemer
Evne til å omsette behov fra teknikere og operatører til intuitive og driftssikre løsninger
Strukturert og analytisk arbeidsform, med interesse for feilsøking og rotårsaksanalyse
Gode norsk- og engelskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig

Det er en fordel om du har erfaring med

C#, C++, Python eller tilsvarende programmeringsspråk
WinCC OA fra Siemens og utvikling av HMI/SCADA-løsninger
PLS- og kontrollsystemer, for eksempel Siemens TIA Portal
OPC UA, Profinet, TCP/IP eller andre industrielle kommunikasjonsprotokoller
Trenddata, alarmhåndtering, logging og visualisering av prosessverdier
P&ID, elektriske/hydrauliske skjemaer, instrumentering eller maskindiagnostikk
3D-modeller, simulering eller digital representasjon av fysisk utstyr
Erfaring fra drilling, offshore, tungt utstyr eller andre krevende industrielle miljøer

About Us

Every day, the oil and gas industry’s best minds put more than 150 years of experience to work to help our customers achieve lasting success.

We Power the Industry that Powers the World

Throughout every region in the world and across every area of drilling and production, our family of companies has provided the technical expertise, advanced equipment, and operational support necessary for success—now and in the future.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building robust, secure and innovative solutions and excited by the possibilities of AI and data-driven development? Channel Services is looking for a Software Engineer to join our team.

About the team:

We are a small, high-impact team
with big responsibility,
we own the full stack for DNB's communication services across web and mobile channels. Working in a BizDevOps model
, we sit at the intersection of business, development and operations, making sure our decisions are driven by both customer needs and technical excellence. With lean structure comes real ownership: every team member has a meaningful voice in how we build, ship and run our services. You'll be joining a tight-knit group where collaboration is close, the work is varied, and your contributions are visible.

What will your day look like?

You'll take end-to-end ownership of what you build, from scoping and specifying requirements together with stakeholders, through design and development, all the way to deployment and production operations. No handoffs, no silos. You'll work across the full backend lifecycle: designing APIs, building services, reviewing incidents and iterating quickly on feedback. Because we're a small team, you'll often be the one driving a feature from the first conversation to the last deploy. You'll collaborate directly with frontend engineers, product owners and business stakeholders to make sure what we ship is both technically sound and genuinely useful.

What kind of developer are we looking for?

We're looking for someone who wants real ownership, not just a ticket to close, but a problem to solve. You're comfortable stepping into ambiguity, asking the right questions, and turning business needs into concrete technical solutions. You take responsibility for the full lifecycle of your work and don't wait for someone else to define the next step. At the same time, you're a team player who communicates openly, shares knowledge, and helps the team grow. You thrive in a small team environment where autonomy and accountability go hand in hand.

Your knowledge and skills:

Strong expertise in Kotlin and Java, with solid knowledge of multithreading, Kotlin Coroutines, and functional Programming
Hands-on experience building and deploying production services on AWS using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CDK), with deep understanding of API Gateway, Lambda, SQS, ECS, EC2, VPCs and networking
Proven ability to design, build and operate high-performance, low-latency distributed systems, troubleshooting at scale comes naturally to you
Strong data modelling skills across both SQL (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (DynamoDB)
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and a DevOps mindset, you're comfortable owning services end-to-end in production
Familiarity with serverless architectures is a plus
Working knowledge of Go, auth protocols, OPA, Kubernetes and K6 is a significant advantage
Fluent in English, written and verbal; Norwegian is a plus
Relevant higher education or equivalent experience

Work location:
Oslo

What's in it for you?

Challenging tasks that allow you to grow professionally, competitive terms, a strong engineering culture, and good career opportunities. We offer good pension conditions, employee terms on DNBs products, insurance schemes, access to resorts in Norway, sports, cultural and other activities plus a wide range of discount schemes. In addition, knowledge and experiences are our most important assets, so you will have the opportunity to participate in courses and conferences such as JavaZone and NDC, both to build your own competency and to represent DNB externally. We also have flexible working hours, extra days off and reduced working hours from May to August (summertime).

Are you curious about the position, and would like to know more about how it is like to work with us?

For questions about the position, please get in touch with:
Department Manager / Sanel Sarajlija / mail:
sanel.sarajlija@dnb.no / phone:
+47 91827881

A job in Norway's largest financial group offers professional challenges in an exciting work environment with many opportunities. DNB strives to create an inclusive workplace where people thrive and feel comfortable. We believe that equality and inclusion boost innovative thinking and collective competency which contributes to create an attractive and flexible company equipped for a changeable business landscape. We are looking for skilled and motivated employees to meet customer needs and to achieve our goals. With so many varied disciplines and exciting opportunities in the future, we are looking for employees with different background, age and expertise. Are you engaged in focusing on the customer, and in addition fit our values: curious, brave and responsible, you might be exactly the person we need.

* Comunicar decisiones arquitectónicas, impartir workshops internos y compartir conocimiento técnico.
* Redactar guías de integración y documentación técnica clara para facilitar la adopción de soluciones.
* Detectar cuellos de botella de rendimiento en herramientas y workflows de desarrollo, implementando quick wins de forma autónoma.

Backend & BFF (Backend-for-Frontend)

* Backend Ecosystem: Dominio avanzado en el desarrollo de servicios robustos y escalables utilizando .NET Core / C# y Node.js (NestJS / Express).
* API Design & Resilience: Diseño y consumo de REST APIs, aplicando patrones de resiliencia (circuit breakers, retries, rate limiting).

Modern Frontend & Micro-Frontends (MFE) Architecture

* Core Frameworks: Dominio experto de React / TypeScript o Next.js para desarrollar interfaces complejas, modulares y de alto rendimiento.
* Module Federation: Experiencia práctica con Webpack / Vite Module Federation para la carga dinámica de MFE en runtime, gestionando shared scopes y el aislamiento de errores mediante Error Boundaries.

CI/CD, GitOps & Quality

* CI Pipelines: Creación y gestión de Continuous Integration pipelines para automatizar builds, ejecutar unit/integration tests, realizar static code analysis y publicar imágenes en registries (Harbor).
* GitOps & CD: Experiencia práctica con GitOps workflows y Continuous Deployment, con preferencia por ArgoD.
* Testing: Experiencia en automated testing y en promover una cultura de calidad shift-left.

Trabajamos día a día para ser el partner tecnológico de nuestros clientes y partner profesional de nuestros colaboradores.
