Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

We are Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI + Data + CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer too, driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good, you've come to the right place.

About The Role

Production experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You'll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.

The Builder Experience

AI-Powered Development: Ship real customer solutions, supported by best-in-class AI tools — Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes — embedded into your day-to-day workflow.
Collaborative Delivery: You'll work alongside Senior Forward Deployed Engineers and a Deployment Strategist. You'll own real components, benefit from structured mentorship from people who've shipped agentic systems at scale, and have a clear path to leading complex deliveries yourself.
Frontier Access: Our agentic AI platform is evolving in real time. You'll work on capabilities most engineers won't touch for months — spanning Agentforce, data, platform, and headless architectures and your field insight will feed directly to the product teams building them.
Continuous Innovation: You'll be expected to stay at the forefront, experimenting with emerging AI tools, models, and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.

What You'll Actually Be Building

Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output

Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

You have 3+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you'd be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models
You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field

You're fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.
You've been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you'd change.
You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.
You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.
You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.
You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what's coming next.
You thrive in the group chat that's building something, not just talking about it.
You're excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.

Nice-to-Haves

Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Vil du lede oppbyggingen av et av Norges sterkeste Microsoft Fabric-miljøer i Oslo?

Sted: Oslo, Norge |
Visumkrav: Gyldig arbeidstillatelse for Norge |
Språkkrav: Norsk og engelsk på et profesjonelt nivå, muntlig og skriftlig

I dag har vi våre sterkeste Fabric-miljøer i Trondheim, Hamar og Bergen. Nå står Oslo for tur. Som Head of Fabric Platform

Du bidrar til fagutvikling, kompetansedeling, pre-sales og rekruttering, og får stor frihet til å påvirke både rollen og retningen videre. Samtidig blir du en sentral stemme i vårt nasjonale Fabric-community.

Faglig ledelse av  Fabric -teamet i Oslo og ansvar for å bygge miljøet videre
Designe og  implementere moderne dataplattformer på Microsoft  Fabric  som gir kundene verdifull innsikt og muliggjør maskinlæring og generativ KI
Være arkitekt og teknisk lead i kundeprosjekter – fra rådgivning og løsningsdesign til implementering

Bygge kompetanse i teamet gjennom fagsamlinger, sertifiseringer og tett samarbeid med  Fabric -miljøene i Trondheim, Hamar og Bergen
Sikre solide løsninger innen datamodellering, integrasjon, data  governance og rapportering

Vi tror du har solid erfaring med Microsoft Fabric og/eller tilgrensende Azure data-teknologier, og at du trives i skjæringspunktet mellom teknologi, mennesker og forretning.  Erfaring vi ser etter: 
Dyp kompetanse på Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Data Factory, Synapse/Spark, Power BI, OneLake) eller sterk bakgrunn fra Azure-dataplattformer med ambisjon om å gå i front på Fabric 
Datamodellering og utvikling av datapipelines (SQL, Python, DAX, dbt e.l.) 
Erfaring som teknisk lead, arkitekt eller fagansvarlig – og lyst til å bygge et miljø, ikke bare levere prosjekter 
Kundeorientert erfaring, gjerne fra konsulentbransjen 
Stor interesse for kunstig intelligens og hvordan Fabric muliggjør KI i praksis 

Hvorfor oss? 

Et av Norges mest erfarne Fabric-miljøer: 20+ prosjekter, 30 Fabric-konsulenter og etablerte miljøer i Trondheim, Hamar og Bergen som du kan spille på fra dag én 
Muligheten til å bygge noe fra grunnen – med ryggdekning fra et etablert fagmiljø og en organisasjon i vekst 
Kompetansehevingsmuligheter, sertifiseringer og konferanser nasjonalt og internasjonalt 
Jevnlige sosiale og faglige arrangementer, hack-a-thons 
Bedriftsavtale med Sats og bedriftsidrett (Crossfit, Padel, styrketrening, Cage ball m.m.) 
Gode forsikringsordninger samt rekrutterings- og sertifiseringsbonuser 
Samarbeid i tverrfaglige team med anerkjente data scientists, systemutviklere og sikkerhetseksperter 
Mulighet til å delta i globale utviklingsteam 

Company description

Om SoftwareOne og SoftwareOne NO (tidligere Crayon Consulting) 

SoftwareOne og Crayon har slått seg sammen for å danne en global leverandør av programvare- og skytjenester drevet av AI, med en dristig visjon for fremtiden. Above all else, you will have the freedom to drive innovation and take ownership of your work while honing your problem-solving, collaboration, and automation skills. Together, we can make a difference in the world of cloud-based managed services.

The career path ahead is full of exciting opportunities to grow and advance within the job family. Excellent coding skills and solid development experience (Java, Python, .Net etc.) with debugging and problem-solving skills

Knowledge of architecture design - Microservices architecture, containers (Docker & k8s), messaging queues

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT CARAVELO

Airlines have spent decades selling one trip at a time. At Caravelo, we help them build recurring relationships with their customers instead.
We build the technology behind airline subscription products used by carriers around the world, combining SaaS, payments, booking systems and airline integrations in one platform.
Our Product & Platform teams build the common technology. Our Professional Services team makes it work in the real world for each airline
.
That is where this role comes in.

THE MISSION

Caravelo has one platform, but no two airline implementations are exactly the same.
As a Customer Solutions Engineer in our Professional Services team
, your job is to bridge that gap.
You will learn how our core platform can be configured, integrated and extended, and use those capabilities to create the implementation each customer needs — without modifying or forking the core platform.
For every airline, we build a customer plugin
that wraps the specific integrations, extensions, business rules and behaviours required to make Caravelo fit naturally into that customer's technology landscape.
Working closely with Project Managers and customer stakeholders, you will understand requirements, identify the peculiarities of each implementation and decide how best to solve them: configuration, extension, integration or, when justified, a dedicated service or module.
The goal is simple:
Make every customer rollout feel unique while keeping it cleanly built on top of a common, scalable platform.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Bring customers live

You will be one of the engineers turning a signed customer into a working production implementation.
That means:
Understand customer requirements together with the Project Manager.
Translate business and technical requirements into a concrete implementation.
Configure and extend the Caravelo platform using the capabilities provided by our Product & Platform teams.
Build and maintain the customer plugin that contains customer-specific logic and integrations.
Take implementations through development, testing, launch and production stabilisation.

You'll work closely with our Platform and Product engineers, who will provide the documentation, tooling and training needed to understand the core platform and its extension points.
Your job is not to rebuild what already exists. It is to understand the platform deeply enough to use it intelligently and extend it where necessary
.

Solve integration problems

Airlines have complex technology ecosystems.
Some systems are modern. Others have been running successfully for decades.
You will make them work together.
Depending on the customer, you may integrate Caravelo with:
Airline reservation and passenger service systems.
Payment gateways and payment infrastructure.
Identity and authentication platforms.
CRM and communication systems.
Loyalty platforms.
Data platforms.
Internal airline APIs.
Third-party and legacy systems.

Sometimes the solution will be straightforward.
Sometimes the API documentation will be incomplete, the behaviour will differ between environments, or two systems will have fundamentally different assumptions.
You should enjoy figuring those problems out.

Build customer-specific extensions

Most customer needs should be solved using the common platform.
But not all of them will be.
When there is a genuine gap, you may:
Build an additional connector.
Extend an existing workflow.
Create customer-specific business logic.
Develop an isolated service or module.
Implement data transformation or migration processes.

The challenge is knowing when to configure, when to extend and when to build something new
.
We want engineers who can solve the customer problem without creating unnecessary complexity.

Own the implementation beyond go-live

Our work does not stop when a customer launches.
Customer systems evolve, vendors change and integrations eventually need to move with them.
You will help:
Investigate and debug production issues.
Maintain customer-specific integrations.
Upgrade connectors as external systems evolve.
Support customers through technical migrations.
Replace or introduce integrations while keeping the service running.
Improve existing implementations when better platform capabilities become available.

For example, an airline may decide to replace its payment gateway.
Your work could involve enabling the new payment connector in Caravelo, adapting the customer plugin, helping define the migration approach for existing payment tokens, validating the transition and supporting the rollout together with the Project Manager and customer team.
These are not theoretical architecture exercises. They are real production systems with real customers behind them.

Work across the stack when needed

Your centre of gravity will be Java and backend engineering
.
But customer implementations do not always respect stack boundaries.
You should be comfortable following a feature or problem wherever it goes: backend services, APIs, integrations, databases, scripts, data migrations or occasional frontend changes in Vue.
You do not need to be a frontend specialist.
You do need to be comfortable enough to understand the problem, use AI-assisted development effectively and validate that the result is production-quality.

Use AI as an engineering tool

We actively use AI coding tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and similar assistants
.
You will use them for things like:
Implementation.
Exploring unfamiliar code.
Writing and extending tests.
Debugging.
Refactoring.
Documentation.
Working with APIs and integrations.
Accelerating occasional frontend work.

We are particularly interested in Spec-Driven Development
: defining clearly what needs to be built before asking AI to help implement it.
AI should make you faster. It should not replace engineering judgment.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

You are succeeding in this role when:
You can take a customer requirement and turn it into a clean, production-ready solution.
Customers launch successfully without unnecessary changes to the core platform.
Customer-specific behaviour remains well isolated and maintainable.
Integrations are observable, reliable and understandable by engineers other than their original author.
You can diagnose complex problems across Caravelo and customer systems.
You understand when to configure the platform, when to extend it and when custom development is genuinely necessary.
You become increasingly independent in understanding new customer technology landscapes.
Migrations and changes to existing integrations can be delivered without destabilising the customer's service.

WHAT YOU BRING

Must have
Strong professional experience building production software in Java
, with solid backend engineering fundamentals.
Experience designing and integrating APIs, distributed services and cloud-based systems.
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, especially when working across multiple systems or external dependencies.
Good understanding of testing, CI/CD, databases, observability and production software quality.
Comfortable understanding an existing platform and extending it cleanly rather than rebuilding from scratch.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work with Project Managers, engineers and technical customer stakeholders.

Nice to have
Experience in Professional Services, implementation engineering, solutions engineering or customer-facing technical delivery
.
Experience integrating enterprise or legacy systems, particularly in complex customer environments.
Experience with payments, payment gateways, data migrations or other business-critical integrations.
Experience in travel technology, airlines, reservation systems or similarly integration-heavy industries.
Familiarity with the technologies listed in our stack, especially Vue/Nuxt, Couchbase or Datadog.
Experience working in security-, compliance- or reliability-sensitive environments.

OUR STACK

You do not need to arrive knowing every technology we use.
Some of the technologies you may encounter include:
Java · SpringBoot · Vue.js · Nuxt · Couchbase · PostgreSQL · AWS · Datadog · Gitlab · Docker · Opentofu · Claude Code · Cursor

More important than matching every technology is your ability to understand unfamiliar systems, investigate how things work and build reliable solutions around them.

THE KIND OF ENGINEER WHO TENDS TO ENJOY THIS ROLE

This role may be a good fit if you like engineering problems where the answer is not always obvious.
You enjoy understanding how systems behave, not just implementing predefined tickets.
You are comfortable opening documentation for an unfamiliar API, talking through requirements with a Project Manager, tracing a strange production issue across several systems and then writing the code that solves it.
You appreciate good architecture, but you are pragmatic.
And when confronted with a 15-year-old airline system that behaves differently from its documentation, your reaction is closer to “interesting”
than “that's someone else's problem.”

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive salary with a clear progression framework.
Flexible working hours.
Barcelona-based hybrid model: 4 days in the office and 1 day working from home
.
Tax-efficient benefits including private health insurance, restaurant and transport cards, and kindergarten support.
Budget for training and conferences.
Regular company events and celebrations.
23 days of annual leave
.
Exposure to complex airline technology environments around the world.
The opportunity to work across software engineering, integrations and real customer implementations.
Meaningful ownership: you will see the systems you build go from requirements to production.

INTERESTED?

If you enjoy solving complex integration problems, getting customers live and making different systems work together without turning every implementation into a one-off project, we'd like to hear from you.
Apply and tell us about a difficult integration, migration or production problem you've solved.

jobs.description:
Buscamos incorporar a nuestro equipo a un/a Ingeniero/a de QA de nivel intermedio/senior
, con experiencia y una actitud muy proactiva. En este puesto, serás responsable de diseñar, crear y mantener frameworks de automatización de pruebas, identificar riesgos de producto y riesgos técnicos, mejorar nuestra estrategia de testing y trabajar estrechamente con desarrolladores, product managers y equipo de DevOps para prevenir los problemas en lugar de limitarse a detectarlos.
Este puesto es ideal para una persona que se desenvuelva bien en entornos colaborativos, que se anticipe a los retos antes de que surjan y que impulse las buenas prácticas en automatización y estrategias de testing.
Trabajarás en un producto digital de investigación de mercados disponible en tres plataformas: Android, iOS y extensiones de navegador.

¿Qué buscamos en ti?

Tus responsabilidades:

Investigación y reporte de defectos:
Identificar, reproducir, investigar y documentar claramente los defectos, incluyendo su impacto, pasos para reproducirlos, logs/evidencias y el contexto técnico (JIRA). Colaborar con los desarrolladores para llevar las incidencias hasta su resolución y evitar que vuelvan a producirse.
Gestión de la cobertura de pruebas:

Revisar de forma proactiva la cobertura de pruebas manuales y automatizadas, identificando y cubriendo cualquier vacío existente.
Estrategia y responsabilidad sobre la automatización:

Definir las estrategias, frameworks y herramientas de automatización para maximizar la cobertura y la eficiencia de las pruebas automatizadas. Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener scripts de automatización robustos, escalables y reutilizables para pruebas de API, UI e integración.
Mejora proactiva de procesos:

Analizar y mejorar los procesos de QA, identificando carencias y proponiendo mejoras antes de que afecten a la calidad del producto, fomentando una cultura de calidad desde las primeras fases del desarrollo.
Colaboración y comunicación transversal:

Participar activamente con product managers, desarrolladores, DevOps y otros stakeholders para asegurar que la calidad esté presente en todas las fases del desarrollo.
CI/CD y fiabilidad de las pruebas:

Configurar y optimizar pipelines de ejecución automatizada de pruebas dentro de entornos CI/CD, garantizando un feedback rápido y resultados fiables y consistentes.

Principales aptitudes y habilidades:

Mentalidad proactiva: con iniciativa y capacidad para anticiparse a los desafíos y actuar antes de que se conviertan en problemas.
Capacidad para liderar con el ejemplo y promover la mejora continua de la calidad.
Capacidad para equilibrar la velocidad de entrega con el nivel de testing adecuado en función del riesgo.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para liderar conversaciones entre equipos y cuestionar decisiones o planteamientos cuando sea necesario.
Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente manteniendo informados y alineados a los miembros del equipo y a los stakeholders sobre los riesgos y bloqueos relevantes.
Mentalidad analítica y gran atención al detalle.
Disposición para aprender nuevas técnicas y tecnologías.
Nivel de inglés conversacional.

Lo que buscamos en ti:

Imprescindibles

Sólidos conocimientos de QA:
capacidad para evaluar los riesgos del producto, definir estrategias de testing adecuadas, diseñar casos de prueba efectivos, identificar carencias en la cobertura de pruebas y aplicar enfoques de testing exploratorio y basado en riesgos.
Sólida experiencia en análisis y resolución de defectos:
capacidad para reproducir problemas, analizar fallos, analizar la causa y comunicar los defectos de forma clara
Más de 3 años de experiencia en QA/testing, con experiencia práctica en automatización de pruebas.

Experiencia práctica en testing de aplicaciones en Android e iOS, utilizando tanto dispositivos físicos como emuladores/simuladores, incluyendo pruebas de permisos, comportamiento de la aplicación en diferentes condiciones de conectividad y escenarios específicos de cada plataforma.

Buen conocimiento del testing de APIs, bases de datos y CI/CD, incluyendo validación de APIs, SQL básico e integración de pruebas automatizadas en pipelines CI/CD.

Se valorará

Experiencia en testing de extensiones de navegador, permisos, compatibilidad entre navegadores y procesos de instalación/actualización.
Experiencia con JIRA, Confluence y Testmo.
Familiaridad con Docker y plataformas cloud como AWS.
Experiencia en pruebas de rendimiento/carga, BDD/Cucumber, accesibilidad, seguridad o pruebas visuales.

El Enterprise IT Systems Engineer es responsable de la ejecución técnica de proyectos tecnológicos en casa de cliente (On-Prem), asegurando la correcta implementación, configuración y soporte de las soluciones definidas. Trabaja en coordinación directa con el Enterprise IT Manager y otros equipos técnicos, garantizando el cumplimiento de los requisitos técnicos, de calidad y de tiempo establecidos en cada proyecto. Además, participa activamente en la resolución de incidencias, la documentación de los procesos y la transferencia de conocimiento al cliente y al equipo interno.

Funciones Principales

Ejecutar la implementación, configuración, migración y soporte de soluciones tecnológicas en entornos On-Prem según los planes de proyecto establecidos.
Realizar tareas técnicas en sistemas Windows (Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, GPO’s, Servicios WEB, RDS, MS Exchange, SQL Server, etc.), sistemas Linux, virtualización (VMWare, Hyper-V), almacenamiento (NetApp, HP), backup (Veeam, Commvault), y networking/firewalls.
Participar en la elaboración y actualización de la documentación técnica de los proyectos.
Identificar y resolver incidencias técnicas durante la ejecución de los proyectos, escalando cuando sea necesario.
Colaborar con el equipo de proyecto para asegurar la calidad de los entregables y el cumplimiento de los requisitos técnicos y de negocio.
Realizar pruebas, validaciones y puesta en marcha de las soluciones implementadas.
Proporcionar soporte técnico post-implementación durante el periodo de garantía del proyecto.
Cumplir con los procedimientos, metodologías y estándares definidos por la compañía.
Reportar el avance de las tareas asignadas y posibles riesgos o desviaciones al Enterprise IT Manager..
Garantizar la calidad de los entregables y el cumplimiento de los requisitos técnicos y de negocio.
Asegurar el cumplimiento de los procesos y metodologías establecidos.
Realizar la evaluación final del proyecto y documentar lecciones aprendidas.

Funciones Secundarias

Participar en la identificación de oportunidades de mejora en procesos, herramientas y metodologías de trabajo.
Apoyar en la capacitación y transferencia de conocimiento a otros miembros del equipo técnico y a los clientes.
Colaborar en la gestión de recursos materiales y tecnológicos necesarios para la ejecución de los proyectos.
Asistir a reuniones técnicas internas y con clientes para la definición de alcances o resolución de incidencias.
Colaborar en la elaboración de propuestas técnicas bajo la supervisión del Enterprise IT Manager.

Responsabilidades

Ejecución técnica y soporte de proyectos On-Prem.
Cumplimiento de los objetivos de calidad, tiempo y alcance de las tareas asignadas.
Actualización y mantenimiento de la documentación técnica.
Transferencia de conocimiento y soporte a usuarios finales y otros técnicos.

Conocimientos Necesarios

Poseerá conocimientos sólidos sobre las diversas tecnologías utilizadas en nuestros clientes:
Windows: Active Directoy, DNS, DHCP, GPO’s, Servicios WEB (IIS, Tomcat), Granjas RDS, MS Exchange, SQL Server y Office 365.
Gestión de backups: Veeam y Commvault.
Virtualización: VMWare, Hyper-V.
Sistemas de almacenamiento: NetApp y HP.
Virtualización de escritorios: UDS.
Networking / firewalls.
Sistemas Linux

Conocimientos valorables

Metodologías de gestión de proyectos (Cadena crítica, PMI, Agile, etc.).
Certificaciones técnicas relacionadas con las tecnologías mencionadas.

Experiencia

Experiencia mínima requerida: Mínimo 2 años en ejecución de proyectos tecnológicos On-Prem.

Idiomas

Idiomas: catalán y castellano. Deseable inglés nivel B2.

Que ofrecemos?

Sistema híbrido de teletrabajo
Horario flexible

Clases Semanales de inglés
Retribución Flexible (Ticket restaurant, Ticket guardería, Ticket transporte y Seguro Médico)

We are hiring a L2 technical Support Engineer to join a large-scale technology environment in Abu Dhabi. You will provide L2 technical support across AI platforms, developer tools, APIs, cloud infrastructure and enterprise integrations. The role combines hands-on troubleshooting with incident management, monitoring and coordination across engineering, infrastructure, security and external technology partners.

You will own support requests from initial diagnosis through to resolution or escalation, helping ensure reliable and effective use of business-critical technology platforms.

This is an opportunity to work within a large-scale, technically advanced environment

jobs.title: Senior C# Software Engineer – London
jobs.description:
Our Story

Hello there. We’re Zopa.

We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com !

We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces.

If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife

The engineering challenge

You will design and evolve the services that power core banking products. The systems you help build process thousands of financial transactions every day. They must be scalable, resilient and secure. When money moves, it has to work. Every time.

But this role goes beyond implementation.

You will shape technical direction. Influence cross-team initiatives. Own complex, high-impact work from concept through to production. You will help decide not just how we build, but what we build and why.

This is senior in impact, not just title.

We’re growing across several of our product-engineering tribes at Zopa, with current opportunities in Current Accounts, Lending, Credit Cards and Product Enablement .

We care deeply about great engineering, which is why our core stack is Kotlin, running on a modern platform with Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker and AWS Aurora Postgres. But great engineers aren’t defined by a single language which is why we are agnostic with our hiring.

We want the right people, not the 'right' language, so if you come from a C#/.NET background, bring solid fundamentals, and have an appetite for learning something new, we’ll invest in you, help you grow your skills and confidently step into our Kotlin ecosystem.

Your Impact

Owning complex initiatives end to end, from idea to measurable outcome
Designing scalable backend systems that stand up to real-world scale and complexity
Making architectural decisions that balance immediate delivery with long-term sustainability
Bringing structure and clarity to ambiguous problems
Influencing prioritisation and trade-offs across teams
Raising the bar for engineering quality, reliability and accountability
Mentoring engineers and strengthening overall team capability
Driving continuous improvement in how we build and operate systems

Your Toolkit

You'll work with C#, Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS Aurora Postgres, and other modern technologies. If you haven't worked with all of these, we value skilled engineers with a willingness to learn.
A track record of delivering high-impact, complex systems in production environments
Strong testing discipline, with a commitment to strictly following Test-Driven Development (TDD)
Strong systems thinking and architectural judgement
The ability to navigate ambiguity and turn complexity into clear, actionable plans
Confidence making data-informed technical decisions with long-term consequences in mind
Experience influencing beyond your immediate team
A deep customer focus and a bias toward measurable outcomes
Experience mentoring others and amplifying team impact
Ownership beyond your own output

We’ll support your transition and cross-training into a JVM/Kotlin environment. What matters most to us is how you think, how you approach problem-solving, and the scale and impact of what you’ve built.

Our Engineering Culture

Customer impact over unnecessary complexity
Team success over individual heroics
Operational ownership, not just feature delivery
Continuous improvement through honest feedback

Added Bonus

Experience with fintech or banking is a plus, but we value problem-solvers from all backgrounds

At Zopa we value flexible ways of working.

We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week.

You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.

Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice

Diversity Statement

Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments.

Our approach to AI in interviews

At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030 , we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs.

Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process.

Behavioural and competency-based interviews
: please don't use AI . These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other.

Technical interviews:
it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

Senior QA Engineer - F1 Motorsport - C#, Selenium & Postman
4 days onsite + 1 day remote (commutable from Northamptonshire / Buckinghamshire / Oxfordshire / Bedfordshire)

Permanent - basic salary DOE, championship & race weekend bonuses, flexible onsite hours (10am - 3pm), pension (5%), daily lunch allowance, life insurance (4x salary), private healthcare, onsite gym & EV charging.

—
2.62 seconds. The time it takes to service an entire F1 racing car at the pit stop.

In Formula 1, every line of code, tool, and application you help develop has a direct impact on performance on the track. In a sport watched by over 525 million fans globally, even the smallest software gain can translate into meaningful lap time improvements.

You’ll be the third QA Engineer in a brand-new QA and Testing function, becoming an extra pillar in the Technology department, alongside Software Engineering, Platform Engineering, and Data Science.

What you’ll do

You'll contribute to the overall QA vision, supporting the direction of the function while helping shape testing approaches that are tailored to the needs of the technology platforms. This includes both manual and automated testing methods, ensuring software is robust, reliable, and race-ready.

You’ll test a range of software applications that support racing operations - including web-based tools, desktop applications, and APIs. Most of these applications are developed in C#, and the QA process involves validating their performance, reliability, and correctness with tools like Postman & Selenium.

As systems become more complex and interdependent, the need for rigorous testing and seamless integration is critical. By embedding quality assurance into the development lifecycle, you'll help reduce failure risk, increase velocity, and ultimately improve performance.

You'll introduce and standardise testing methodologies, tools, and workflows across multiple development teams to ensure consistency and reliability. You will plan and execute end-to-end testing across a diverse technology landscape, ensuring that all components, regardless of origin, function reliably and with high performance.

What you’ll need

jobs.title: AI-Engineer
jobs.description:
**Are you passionate about how AI can shape the insurance market?**
===================================================================

  

Join either **Data Discovery \& Experience** or **API Platform** , two teams within API \& Data Products Solutions.


Our mission is to make APIs, MCPs and Data easy to discover, understand, and use. To support that journey, we are looking for an AI Developer who is excited about building the next generation of AI\-powered experiences.

  

  

**About the role**
------------------


You will help shape AI\-powered experiences by enabling AI agents, APIs, MCPs, and Data Products to create value for developers, employees, partners, and customers.

  

  

Working hands\-on with modern AI technologies, agent frameworks, APIs, and platform capabilities, you will build scalable solutions that enable teams across If to discover, access, and use digital capabilities more effectively.

  

  

As part of a cross\-functional team of Product Managers, Architects, Engineers, and business stakeholders, you will turn emerging AI opportunities into practical solutions with measurable business impact.

  

  

* Help evolve our Data Discovery \& Experience or API Platform capabilities.
* Design and develop AI\-powered platform capabilities using AI agents, APIs, MCPs, and Data Products.
* Improve how APIs, MCPs, and Data Products are discovered, understood, and used across If.
* Help ensure secure access using open standards.
* Apply platform engineering and product thinking to solve real business problems.
* Contribute to AI literacy and AI\-enabled ways of working.

**We offer**
------------


In the same way that we place high demands on you as an employee, we also expect you to place high demands on us as an employer. Here are some of the benefits of working at If:

  

  

* An including work environment where everyone is welcome
* Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
* Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
* Possibility of hybrid workplace
* Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
* Great insurance benefits
* Lunch benefit
  

  

**About the team**
------------------


Depending on your background, interests, and experience, you may join either the **Data Discovery \& Experience** team or the **API Platform** team.


The **Data Discovery \& Experience** team works closely with business and technical stakeholders to improve how APIs and Data are discovered, understood, and used as Products across If.

  

  

The **API Platform** team focuses on building and evolving common platform capabilities that enable secure, scalable, and efficient API consumption and integration across If and with external partners.


Both teams use agile ways of working and collaborate closely with stakeholders across business and technology domains.

  

  

This position is also a part of a larger agile Tribe responsible for providing common API and IAM capabilities that enable If's business to grow in a secure, scalable, and compliant manner. We support both internal teams and external partners through technology, products, processes, training, and governance.

  

  

**Who are you?**
----------------


You are curious, innovative, and motivated by making hard things look easy.

  

  

You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and turning ideas into working solutions. You combine strong technical skills with a product mindset and are excited about creating experiences that are useful, intuitive, and valuable to users.

  

  

You are comfortable navigating uncertainty, learning quickly, and working in a field that is evolving.

  

  

You see AI not as a standalone technology, but as a capability that becomes powerful when combined with data, business processes, and great user experiences.

  

  

You are passionate about agile ways of working, continuous improvement, and exploring new technologies.

  

  

You have the ability to make complex technical concepts understandable and actionable for both technical and business stakeholders.  

  



You also have:


* Relevant university degree, preferably within Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data \& Analytics, or a related technical field. Equivalent practical experience is also valued.
* Experience in the insurance industry or another regulated industry, such as banking, finance, healthcare, telecommunications, or the public sector.
* At least 3 years of experience in software engineering and modern application development.
* At least 1\-2 years of practical, hands\-on experience applying AI engineering practices in production or real\-world applications.
* Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
* Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as C\#, TypeScript, or Python.
  

  

Experience from one or more of the following areas is considered a strong advantage:


* AI Agents, Agentic Workflows, and Agent Frameworks such as LangGraph, Pydantic AI, Microsoft Agent Framework, or similar technologies.
* MCP (Model Context Protocol), including providing AI systems with context, tools, and access to enterprise capabilities.
* Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), prompt and context engineering, evaluation, and model orchestration.
* Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, embeddings, and semantic search technologies.
* APIs, API Platforms, integration technologies, and secure access using open standards, as well as Data Products, Data Discovery, Analytics Platforms, and Developer Experience capabilities.
* Cloud\-native application development using Microsoft Azure or similar cloud platforms.

Je werkt nauw samen met Enterprise Architects, developers en verschillende stakeholders en zorgt ervoor dat nieuwe en bestaande oplossingen aansluiten bij de technische en organisatorische doelstellingen.

Vertalen van de doelarchitectuur naar concrete oplossingen die door developmentteams gerealiseerd kunnen worden.

Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.

At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.

Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer
who thinks like a product builder, thrives in a collaborative, cross-functional environment, and is passionate about creating robust, scalable financial infrastructure. You'll be part of a domain team where various engineering crafts (Backend, Frontend, Mobile, ML/AI engineers, and QA) work together to own and evolve a shared product area that delivers real value to hundreds of thousands of businesses across Europe.

You're pragmatic, learn quickly, and have a proven track record of shipping products that matter. You communicate clearly across disciplines and genuinely enjoy the dynamics of a cross-functional team where everyone contributes to solving the same customer problems. Above all, you're curious – about the product, the users, the business, and how your technical decisions impact all three.

You have deep expertise in .NET and C# with a strong appreciation for maintainable, scalable code, and distributed architectures. But more importantly, you know when to apply that expertise and when simpler solutions serve the product better. You've built data-intensive applications before and understand the concepts of working in a regulated environment.

You take ownership not just of your code, but of the outcomes. You move without being prompted, whether that's jumping into a customer issue, improving team processes, or mentoring colleagues. You're curious about adjacent domains – you might peek at the frontend code, ask questions about the ML models, or dive into analytics to understand how features perform.

Quality is non-negotiable for you. Automated testing, thorough code reviews, and security best practices are fundamental to how you work. You balance technical excellence with pragmatism, always keeping the end user and business goals in mind.

Excellent knowledge of .NET platform and C#

Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer

Novatus is a Series B scale-up RegTech SaaS provider and boutique advisory practice, enabling financial services firms to solve complex challenges and redefine what’s possible through expert-led technology and consulting. Across both our technology and consulting services, Novatus delivers practical solutions to some of the most complex regulatory, data and operational challenges in financial services.

Our SaaS platform, En>ACT (short for ensuring more accurate, complete and timely reporting) , is a market-leading solution for regulatory transaction reporting and reconciliation, providing real-time, independent oversight of transaction reporting across all global regulatory regimes. En>ACT is the only real-time assurance solution that tests 100% of transactions and 100% of fields, replacing sample-based reviews and static PDF reports delivered months after the event with live, actionable insights. This helps firms remediate quickly, reduce risk, and meet regulatory obligations with confidence. Already trusted by more than 45 firms worldwide, the platform is scalable, proven, and designed for both business and technical users.

Alongside our SaaS offering, our unique model delivers consulting services to solve complex challenges, combining deep expertise, ownership and delivery to create lasting change. Our expertise spans Strategy & Operations, Data & AI, Risk & Resilience, Compliance, Transaction Reporting, and ESG. We embed ourselves within client teams to deliver both insight and execution, taking ownership of outcomes and driving measurable impact.

Since our launch in 2019, we have scaled rapidly, creating space for our people to grow the business. Backed by North American private equity investment, and partnerships with the London Stock Exchange Group and Snowflake’s global data platform, we are shaping the future of financial services through innovation in both consulting and technology. This position is critical in enabling us to deliver highly scalable, secure, multi-tenant SaaS software to clients worldwide. Candidates should have proven experience in designing, building, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps (YAML), along with a solid understanding of infrastructure as code tools such as Bicep, ARM, or Terraform. Proficiency in scripting languages like PowerShell and the Azure CLI is required. A strong appreciation for secure-by-default platform design principles, including Key Vault, managed identities, role-based access control (RBAC), and least privilege, is essential. Additionally, candidates should have hands-on experience with monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery strategies, including incident response and resolution. Familiarity with SQL Server management, Agile SCRUM methodologies, and environment data management is also necessary.

Desirable qualifications include Microsoft certifications such as AZ-104 (Azure Administrator) or AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer Expert). Experience working with Azure PaaS services like Azure Service Bus, Azure Functions, Azure API Management, Logic Apps, Data Factory, Synapse, or Microsoft Fabric is advantageous. Knowledge of C#/.NET for reading application code and debugging, as well as experience consolidating single-tenant deployments into multi-tenant platforms, is preferred. Candidates with experience in enterprise security requirements, such as ISO 27001 controls and penetration test remediation, will stand out. Practical use of AI-assisted tooling in platform and pipeline work is also desirable.

Responsibilities

Environment management. Provision, configure, and maintain the Astral environment estate—including development, testing, UAT/load, and production environments. Ensure environments are consistent, reproducible, and well-documented through infrastructure as code. Manage environment refreshes and test data in compliance with data protection policies.
CI/CD pipelines. Build, maintain, and continuously improve Azure DevOps build, test, and release pipelines. This includes artifact management, controlled build configurations, pipeline variables, and automated quality and security gates. Work towards consolidating multiple per-client pipelines into a unified deployment process as the platform evolves into a multi-tenant architecture.
Release management. Plan and execute deployments through various environment stages to production, with rehearsed rollback procedures for each release. Support product go-lives and maintain a clear, communicated release calendar to ensure smooth transitions.
Security and access. Manage secrets and certificates using Azure Key Vault and managed identities. Implement role-based access control (RBAC) with a focus on least privilege, oversee platform patching, and collaborate with IT security teams on audit remediation and security release planning.
Monitoring, reliability, and recovery. Own observability tools such as Application Insights and Log Analytics. Set up alerting, backups, and disaster recovery plans, including periodic disaster recovery tests. Lead incident response efforts for platform issues and conduct blameless root-cause analyses to prevent recurrence.
Cost management. Monitor and optimize Azure spending across environments and clients. Right-size resources and report on key cost drivers to ensure efficient use of resources and budget adherence.
Documentation and knowledge sharing. Keep runbooks, environment documentation, and configuration records current by documenting work promptly. Aim to eliminate single points of failure through thorough documentation and knowledge transfer.

jobs.description:
About The Company

Candour Solutions Limited is a forward-thinking, technology-driven organization dedicated to delivering innovative digital solutions that streamline business operations and enhance customer experiences. With a strong commitment to excellence and continuous investment in cutting-edge technologies, Candour Solutions has established itself as a leader in providing scalable and reliable software systems across various industries. The company's culture fosters collaboration, innovation, and professional growth, making it an ideal environment for talented professionals to thrive and contribute to impactful projects.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Backend Systems Developer to join our dynamic engineering team at Candour Solutions Limited. In this role, you will be instrumental in developing and maintaining critical backend integrations that underpin our digital platform. Your work will ensure seamless data exchange between customer-facing applications and core operational systems such as warehouse management, ERP, and finance platforms. This position offers a unique opportunity to work on high-performance, scalable, and resilient systems that support millions of data points daily. As part of our team, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders, including product managers, engineers, and operational teams, to deliver robust technical solutions that drive business success.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess a minimum of four years of professional experience in backend software development, with a strong background in strongly typed programming languages. You should have proven expertise in integrating complex business-critical systems, particularly ERP, warehouse management, or finance platforms. Strong SQL skills, including database design and performance tuning, are essential. A solid understanding of software architecture principles such as SOLID, Clean Architecture, and Domain-Driven Design is required. Experience with modern development practices, including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and version control systems like Git, is also necessary. Hands-on experience with Docker and containerized applications, message queues, and event-driven architectures will be highly advantageous. Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders are critical for success in this role.

Responsibilities

Your key responsibilities will include designing, developing, and maintaining backend integrations between digital platforms and core business systems such as warehouse, ERP, and finance solutions. You will build scalable middleware to support order processing, inventory synchronization, and real-time data exchange, ensuring high efficiency and reliability. Developing and maintaining REST APIs and event-driven integrations across multiple systems will be a core part of your role. You will implement queue-based processing to support high-volume asynchronous workloads while enhancing system resilience through retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and fault-tolerant design principles. Collaborating with engineering teams, product managers, and operational stakeholders, you will deliver high-quality technical solutions aligned with business needs. You will contribute to engineering standards, conduct code reviews, mentor junior team members, and share knowledge to foster continuous improvement. Developing modern, cloud-ready services with clean, maintainable, and scalable architecture will be essential. Monitoring system performance and identifying opportunities for enhancement in reliability, scalability, and efficiency will be ongoing aspects of your responsibilities.

Benefits

At Candour Solutions Limited, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your professional growth and personal well-being. You will receive a competitive salary within the range of £50,000 to £60,000, complemented by flexible hybrid working arrangements that promote work-life balance. Our benefits include opportunities for training and development, access to cutting-edge technologies, and participation in innovative projects. We foster a collaborative environment with a focus on diversity and inclusion, ensuring all team members feel valued and empowered. Additional perks may include health insurance options, pension schemes, and regular team-building activities. We are committed to providing a positive and stimulating workplace where your contributions make a meaningful impact.

Equal Opportunity

Candour Solutions Limited is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that a diverse workforce enhances our creativity, innovation, and overall success, and we are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

będzie rozwijać zarówno możliwości platformy KAIN, jak i rozwiązania wykorzystujące generatywną AI, agentów AI, przetwarzanie dokumentów oraz integracje z procesami i systemami Grupy KRUK.

Rozwój platformy KAIN oraz jej komponentów wspierających udostępnianie modeli, agentów i usług AI.
Projektowanie i development rozwiązań wykorzystujących generatywną AI, Large Language Models oraz architektury agentowe.

Samodzielność, odpowiedzialność za dostarczane komponenty i gotowość do pracy w interdyscyplinarnym, międzynarodowym środowisku.

This is a hands-on opportunity for an experienced IBM Datacap professional to contribute to the development and evolution of an enterprise document-processing platform. The role spans Datacap development, platform administration, integrations, troubleshooting, testing, deployment, and production support. You will help transform business requirements into secure, scalable, and reliable technical solutions. Working within an Agile product engineering environment, you will collaborate across development, architecture, testing, and operations. The position offers the opportunity to build new capabilities while supporting critical enterprise workflows. Experience with modern integrations, DevSecOps practices, and secure enterprise environments will be highly valuable. This is an ideal role for someone who combines deep Datacap expertise with strong software development and problem-solving capabilities.

Accountabilities

Design, develop, configure, enhance, and maintain IBM Datacap applications, including rulesets, tasks, actions, document hierarchies, workflows, validation rules, and verification processes.
Configure and optimize OCR, document recognition, classification, data extraction, field validation, image processing, and batch-processing capabilities.
Develop reusable Datacap components and custom actions or extensions, including business rules for document routing, validation, exception handling, and processing.
Install, configure, administer, monitor, and maintain Datacap environments across Development, Test, QA, UAT, and Production.
Administer and troubleshoot Datacap Server, Rulerunner, Datacap Studio, and Datacap Navigator, including processing queues, logs, performance, failed batches, OCR issues, workflow failures, connectivity problems, and production incidents.
Participate throughout the product development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, sprint planning, development, testing, deployment, release planning, and post-deployment stabilization.
Translate business requirements and user stories into technical solutions, estimate development effort, conduct peer reviews, troubleshoot defects, and implement sustainable fixes.
Develop and support integrations using REST APIs, SOAP web services, databases, file-based interfaces, enterprise content repositories, workflow platforms, and business applications.
Integrate document-processing capabilities with enterprise platforms such as IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator where applicable.
Manage metadata mapping, database lookups, document and metadata exports, API data exchange, retries, error handling, audit logging, and exception management.
Develop and maintain custom components using C#, .NET, Java, JavaScript, SQL, XML, REST, and SOAP, with particular emphasis on C#/.NET for custom Datacap actions and extensions.
Support secure enterprise and federal environments, including practices related to NIST, FISMA, IAM/RBAC, audit logging, vulnerability remediation, application security, PII protection, and configuration management.
Contribute to source control, CI/CD, automated deployments, release management, environment configuration, monitoring, incident management, and DevSecOps practices.

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on IBM Datacap experience, including strong experience with IBM Datacap 9.x/9.1.x.
Strong Datacap Studio development experience, along with hands-on Rulerunner administration and development.
Proven experience developing Datacap rulesets, workflows, tasks, actions, and other custom processing components.
Strong understanding of document capture and intelligent document processing, including OCR, classification, extraction, validation, verification, and image processing.
Enterprise-level Datacap administration experience across multiple environments, with strong production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
Experience integrating Datacap with databases and enterprise systems, including strong SQL capabilities and REST and/or SOAP integration experience.
Working knowledge of Windows Server and IIS.
Experience participating in Agile application or product development environments, from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
Experience with IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator is highly preferred.
C#/.NET experience and a background in developing custom Datacap actions or extensions are highly valued.
Experience with Java, JavaScript, SQL Server, Oracle, or DB2 is advantageous.
Familiarity with federal government IT environments, FISMA, NIST, DevSecOps, CI/CD, enterprise application integration, and secure handling of sensitive or PII data is preferred.
Experience building and enhancing new enterprise products, rather than exclusively maintaining legacy applications, is a strong advantage.

Benefits

Remote work opportunity.
Contract engagement with an enterprise-focused technology environment.
Opportunity to work on a large-scale document-processing product with significant technical scope.
Exposure to IBM Datacap, enterprise integrations, intelligent document processing, and modern DevSecOps practices.
Opportunity to contribute across development, architecture, administration, integration, deployment, and production support.

jobs.description:

Omni is the AI analytics platform that turns company data into a trusted source of truth for AI. Built on a semantic model, Omni gives enterprises a governed context graph for analytics and AI. Teams use Omni to ask questions in plain English, refine answers in workbooks, and bring trusted data into tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and Slack.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Omni has raised $217M from the world’s top investors, including ICONIQ, Theory Ventures, First Round Capital, Redpoint Ventures, and GV. Its latest $120M Series C valued the company at $1.5B.

About The Role

We are seeking a Managing Architect to join our Professional Services team, helping customers get to value faster while driving successful outcomes across the customer lifecycle. You will lead complex technical engagements, serve as a trusted advisor to customers, and partner closely with Sales and delivery partners from pre-sales scoping through implementation and expansion.

In this role, you will scope, sell, and deliver projects across a range of complexity, including internal BI and embedded analytics initiatives. You will own delivery outcomes, advocate for customers, and identify challenges and product gaps, partnering with internal teams to address them. Your insights will help shape product direction, strengthen the customer experience, and create opportunities for continued growth.

Responsibilities

Serve as the deep technical expert to solve complex data problems while defining best practices and design patterns for the Omni platform.
Provide insight and guidance on how to leverage Omni’s AI features to maximise impact of the platform.
Manage a portfolio of primarily Enterprise customers, overseeing scoping, resource allocation, and delivery approach.
Act as the primary customer-facing technical contact, building strong, long-term relationships.
Drive project results by managing consulting and delivery partners, ensuring alignment across all workstreams.
Partner with Product and Engineering teams to translate frontline customer feedback into actionable product direction.

About You

7+ years in technical consulting / project management, ideally in the data space
Deep hands-on expertise in data engineering and BI tools (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI, Mode), with a specific mastery of semantic layers like Omni or Looker.
Ability to bridge the gap between technical and non-technical audiences while thriving in fast-paced, collaborative, and evolving environments.
Experience across the full project lifecycle from positioning and scoping through to execution, ideally as a consultant.

A typical day for you at Omni:

30% Pre-sales technical support & scoping
40% Hands-on customer delivery
30% Internal best practices and ecosystem support

Location:

This is a hybrid role for candidates based in Dublin (3 days per week in-office). Candidates based in the UK will work remotely.

Why Join Us

Passionate, supportive team with extensive experience in the space (including founders from Looker and Stitch Data) all working together to win as a team
Health, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) Plan (for US-based roles)
Unlimited PTO

Omni is an equal opportunity employer.
We value diversity and encourage you to apply even if you don’t check every single box. Please, let us know if you need any reasonable accommodations during the interview process.

About the Opportunity

HRM Search Partners has partnered with a a leading international manufacturing organisation headquartered in Dublin, with operations spanning Europe and North America.
We are seeking a Senior Microsoft Dynamics AX Developer to join their global ERP and technology engineering team. In this role, you will lead complex AX developments, customisations, system enhancements, and integrations across core manufacturing, supply chain, and operational modules. Working within a multi-site environment, you will translate business requirements into clean, scalable X++ code and maintain the technical integrity of enterprise solutions.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

Development & Customisation: Design, develop, and deploy robust customisations, modifications, and extensions within Microsoft Dynamics AX using X++, MorphX, and Application Object Tree (AOT).
Technical Integration: Build and maintain high-performance integrations between Dynamics AX, manufacturing execution systems (MES), enterprise reporting tools, third-party logistics platforms, and cloud services (AIF, DIXF, Web Services/APIs).

Requirements Mapping: Collaborate with solution architects, functional consultants, business analysts, and global operational leads to translate manufacturing workflow needs into technical design specifications.
Release & Governance: Maintain technical documentation, manage version control, adhere to structured application lifecycle management (ALM) processes, and support environment builds and transport deployment.
L3 Technical Support: Provide high-tier technical troubleshooting, debugging, and escalation management for critical production platform customisations across EU and US manufacturing sites.

AX Experience: 8+ years of hands-on experience in Microsoft Dynamics AX development, modification, and architecture customisations (Dynamics AX 2009, 2012 R2/R3).
Technical Mastery: Deep mastery of X++, MorphX environment, AOT, Security Framework, Application Integration Framework (AIF), Data Import Export Framework (DIXF), and SSRS reporting.
Language & Communication: C1/C2 Professional English Proficiency (IELTS 8+ equivalent) with excellent written and verbal communication skills for collaborating across international operational teams.
Database & SQL: Strong proficiency with Microsoft SQL Server, T-SQL query writing, stored procedures, index tuning, and database layer troubleshooting.
Development Practices: Demonstrated track record in software engineering best practices, design patterns, testing, object-oriented programming (OOP), and release management.
Desirable Qualifications & Experience
Experience operating within global Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Logistics, or Process/Industrial operations.
Relevant Microsoft certifications (e.g., MB-500: Microsoft Dynamics 365: Finance and Operations Apps Developer or legacy AX Technical Certifications).

To Apply

To discuss this contract opportunity in confidence, please submit your updated CV through HRM Search Partners. Or you can email Shannon directly at shannon.begley@hrmrecruit.com

jobs.title: Release Train Architect - Tieto Caretech (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Job Description

At Tieto Caretech you’ll get a chance to provide patients and end users with product offerings that help them in their life, reinventing the world for good. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading.

About Us

Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency - have more time to care.

We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from intensive care to laboratory and social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.

About The Role

We are now looking for a Release Train Architect (RTA)
to work with Tieto Caretech
healthcare products where you will contribute to simplifying everyday life for patients, professionals and customers. In the architect role you will be ensuring that the architectural and technical decisions taken are aligned with Lifecare strategy, data security and set of requirements.

In this role you will

Design, implement, and verify software architecture with a focus on the bigger picture and product architecture.
Utilize advanced .NET concepts, design patterns, and SOLID design principles to develop robust software solutions.
Lead and mentor teams in web development using WebApi, Angular, HTML5, JavaScript, TypeScript, SPA, and NgRx/Redux.
Apply hands-on experience in the .Net Stack and other frameworks to deliver full-stack solutions.
Implement SOA, IOC, REST API, Microservices, and Event-driven architecture.

We are looking for someone with

10+ years of experience in the software industry.
Proficiency in both English and Finnish languages.
Extensive knowledge of web technologies and patterns.

It would be beneficial if you also have

Experience with cloud development and deployment, preferably in Azure.
Understanding of Domain Driven Development and Test-Driven Development.
Familiarity with C#, Angular, C++, RabbitMQ, XML, WCF, WPF, IIS/Windows services, SOAP.
Knowledge of DevOps, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Deployment.
Awareness of cross-browser compatibility and web standards.
Understanding of OpenEHR.
Experience in the healthcare domain.
Familiarity with integration standards like FHIR, HL7.

As a person we believe you are a team player who takes action and demonstrate responsibility to organize your work and solve your tasks. With our agile end to end development process you will continuously both learn from and coach your colleagues, so communication is important for us. Technology is developing fast, so learning new cutting-edge technologies is something you strive to do.

AI knowledge requirement

AI literacy is expected for this role. You will be comfortable using approved AI tools to improve quality and productivity in everyday work (e.g., drafting, summarising, analysing, and automating routine tasks). You can write clear prompts/instructions, critically evaluate and validate AI outputs, and apply sound judgement when results are incomplete, biased, or incorrect. You understand and follow company policies and applicable legal/regulatory requirements for confidentiality, privacy, security, and responsible AI use (including not sharing sensitive data in unapproved tools).

What’s in it for you?

With us you will be part of the important and meaningful work of developing healthcare for all of us. You have an important mission to make a difference that really matters. In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, open and friendly culture, and an outstanding work-life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.

Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in. For example, we host an annual ‘Keep Learning Week’, a week where everyone at Tieto has the possibility to join different training courses in a truly global setting.

Could you be our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager Teijo Mustonen [teijo.mustonen@tieto.com]

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Diversity, equity and inclusion | Sustainability | Tieto

Stay Alert To Recruitment Scams

Tieto only communicates via @tieto.com email addresses.
We never ask candidates to pay fees or share financial details during recruitment.
If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Tieto, don't respond — verify it via our official careers site.
For more information visit Important Advisory Regarding Recruitment Fraud | Tieto Blog

die we zoeken! Je komt terecht in een enthousiast Scrum team. Samen ontwikkelen jullie business kritische applicaties en websites
om de groei en vooruitgang van VAB te ondersteunen.

Wat ga je doen?

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het functioneel en technisch testen
van software, websites of applicaties. Dit kan gaan om integratietesten, regressietesten, testautomatisatie,…
Je documenteert
de testen in ons tracking systeem en zorgt voor de verdere opvolging.
Je bent volledig mee met het shift left principe
en levert al waardevolle input in de vroege fases van ontwikkeling, nog vóór de testuitvoering start. Hierdoor draag je bij aan een efficiënter en kwalitatief sterker eindproduct.

Je behoudt een helikopterview, denkt vooruit en handelt proactief.
Je blijft kalm en efficiënt onder druk. Je werkt zelfstandig en neemt de nodige verantwoordelijkheid
op.

Wat breng je mee?

Je beschikt over een goede algemene kennis van software testing
en hebt een passie voor IT-systemen. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar hoe verschillende componenten met elkaar integreren en legt vlot verbanden. al vroeg in het ontwikkelingsproces helpt optimaliseren.

Je bent in het bezit van een Bachelor of Master
diploma, een technische IT-achtergrond is een pluspunt.

opgebouwd in software testing, met een stevige basis in functionele en geautomatiseerde testen
. Hierdoor kan je moeiteloos optreden als sidekick van onze test coördinator.

Je hebt ervaring met het opstellen en uitvoeren van testscenario's en testplannen. Documenteren van testresultaten en opvolgen van defects in Azure Devops.

Je kan risico's en de impact van bugs inschatten en advies geven rond de prioritisering
.
Ervaring met tools zoals Selenium, Postman en SoapUI.

Je werkt graag in een team
, denkt proactief mee, stelt kritische vragen om processen te verbeteren en draagt oplossingsgericht
bij aan het versterken van kwaliteitsnormen.
Met jouw communicatieve vaardigheden
breng je helderheid, enthousiasme en verbinding, terwijl je het overzicht bewaart.

Zijn volgende punten ook op jou van toepassing? Dan heb je een streepje voor!
ISTQB Foundation certificaat
Je hebt ervaring met Confluence en Azure DevOps.
Je hebt reeds eerder in een Microsoft Dynamics omgeving gewerkt (Power Platform en/of Finance & Operations)
Ervaring binnen SAFe of een ander op Agile gebaseerd framework.

Wat krijg je hiervoor terug?

Een warme welkom in ons team bij VAB, groot genoeg om van betekenis te zijn, klein genoeg om elkaar en onze business persoonlijk te kennen.
Een uitdagende functie in een dynamische werkomgeving, waar flexibiliteit en teamwerk centraal staan

Een elektrische firmawagen, met laadpaal en marktconforme energievergoeding van thuisladen zodat ook jij kan bijdragen aan duurzame mobiliteit. Mogelijkheid tot laden in binnen- en buitenland

De toffe collega’s krijg je er bovenop!
