jobs.title: Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer based in Belgium.

This is a hands-on opportunity for an experienced IBM Datacap professional to contribute to the development and evolution of an enterprise document-processing platform. The role spans Datacap development, platform administration, integrations, troubleshooting, testing, deployment, and production support. You will help transform business requirements into secure, scalable, and reliable technical solutions. Working within an Agile product engineering environment, you will collaborate across development, architecture, testing, and operations. The position offers the opportunity to build new capabilities while supporting critical enterprise workflows. Experience with modern integrations, DevSecOps practices, and secure enterprise environments will be highly valuable. This is an ideal role for someone who combines deep Datacap expertise with strong software development and problem-solving capabilities.

Accountabilities

Design, develop, configure, enhance, and maintain IBM Datacap applications, including rulesets, tasks, actions, document hierarchies, workflows, validation rules, and verification processes.
Configure and optimize OCR, document recognition, classification, data extraction, field validation, image processing, and batch-processing capabilities.
Develop reusable Datacap components and custom actions or extensions, including business rules for document routing, validation, exception handling, and processing.
Install, configure, administer, monitor, and maintain Datacap environments across Development, Test, QA, UAT, and Production.
Administer and troubleshoot Datacap Server, Rulerunner, Datacap Studio, and Datacap Navigator, including processing queues, logs, performance, failed batches, OCR issues, workflow failures, connectivity problems, and production incidents.
Participate throughout the product development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, sprint planning, development, testing, deployment, release planning, and post-deployment stabilization.
Translate business requirements and user stories into technical solutions, estimate development effort, conduct peer reviews, troubleshoot defects, and implement sustainable fixes.
Develop and support integrations using REST APIs, SOAP web services, databases, file-based interfaces, enterprise content repositories, workflow platforms, and business applications.
Integrate document-processing capabilities with enterprise platforms such as IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator where applicable.
Manage metadata mapping, database lookups, document and metadata exports, API data exchange, retries, error handling, audit logging, and exception management.
Develop and maintain custom components using C#, .NET, Java, JavaScript, SQL, XML, REST, and SOAP, with particular emphasis on C#/.NET for custom Datacap actions and extensions.
Support secure enterprise and federal environments, including practices related to NIST, FISMA, IAM/RBAC, audit logging, vulnerability remediation, application security, PII protection, and configuration management.
Contribute to source control, CI/CD, automated deployments, release management, environment configuration, monitoring, incident management, and DevSecOps practices.

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on IBM Datacap experience, including strong experience with IBM Datacap 9.x/9.1.x.
Strong Datacap Studio development experience, along with hands-on Rulerunner administration and development.
Proven experience developing Datacap rulesets, workflows, tasks, actions, and other custom processing components.
Strong understanding of document capture and intelligent document processing, including OCR, classification, extraction, validation, verification, and image processing.
Enterprise-level Datacap administration experience across multiple environments, with strong production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
Experience integrating Datacap with databases and enterprise systems, including strong SQL capabilities and REST and/or SOAP integration experience.
Working knowledge of Windows Server and IIS.
Experience participating in Agile application or product development environments, from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
Experience with IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator is highly preferred.
C#/.NET experience and a background in developing custom Datacap actions or extensions are highly valued.
Experience with Java, JavaScript, SQL Server, Oracle, or DB2 is advantageous.
Familiarity with federal government IT environments, FISMA, NIST, DevSecOps, CI/CD, enterprise application integration, and secure handling of sensitive or PII data is preferred.
Experience building and enhancing new enterprise products, rather than exclusively maintaining legacy applications, is a strong advantage.

Benefits

Opportunity to work on a large-scale document-processing product with significant technical scope.
Exposure to IBM Datacap, enterprise integrations, intelligent document processing, and modern DevSecOps practices.

jobs.title: Senior Requirements Engineer Digital Product, 80-100%
jobs.description:
PEAX bietet eine Lösung für automatisierten Dokumenteneingang, intelligentes Document Processing und Weiterverarbeitung in nachgelagerten Geschäftsprozessen. Damit werden unsere Kunden von administrativem Aufwand befreit und erkennen den Wert ihrer Daten. Wir suchen Menschen, die unsere Produktentwicklung mit analytischer Tiefe und einem ausgeprägten AI-First-Mindset auf das nächste Level bringen.

Aufgaben
Das bewegst du

Du verantwortest das fachliche Herz unseres Produkts: das Domänenmodell. Capabilities, Business Objects, Business Rules und Prozesse hältst du korrekt, widerspruchsfrei und aktuell. Und du sorgst dafür, dass sie über Domänen hinweg zusammenpassen.

Aus vielschichtigen, oft widersprüchlichen Anforderungen machst du klare Struktur: Nachvollziehbare Use Cases, scharf geschnittene Anforderungen und eindeutige Akzeptanzkriterien. Dein wichtigster Beitrag ist dabei nicht, jeden Einzelwunsch zu spezifizieren. Es ist zu erkennen, wann mehrere Einzelfälle dasselbe allgemeine Problem sind, und die allgemeine Lösung durchzusetzen.

Du präzisierst Produktentscheide für die Umsetzung: Regeln, Grenzfälle, Zustände und Sollverhalten. Bei komplexen und domänenübergreifenden Themen führst du die Spezifikation selbst. Im Übrigen setzt du den Standard, nach dem im Team spezifiziert wird, und entwickelst die Modellierungskompetenz deiner Kolleg:innen weiter.

Qualität ist für dich Teil der Spezifikationsarbeit und kein nachgelagerter Schritt. Du erstellst E2E-Testkonzepte und Testfälle für deinen Bereich und prüfst Features. Wir sind ein kleines Team, in dem alle die Qualität des Produkts mittragen.

Du bist für die von dir verantworteten Features die fachliche Ansprechperson für Engineering, Design, Customer Success und Sales sowie für Partner, Reseller und Kunden. Du bist auch die Person, die „so geht das fachlich nicht“ sagen kann und dafür gehört wird.

Deine Arbeit startet in der Product Discovery: Bei der Problemrahmung, nicht erst bei der Übersetzung fertiger Entscheide. Zudem bringst du deine fachliche Sicht in Architekturentscheide ein, wo sie Konsequenzen für das Domänenmodell haben.

PEAX baut gerade agentische Architekturen. Du nutzt AI-Tools strukturiert und verantwortungsvoll als Bestandteil unseres Requirement Engineering Prozesses.

Qualifikation
Das bringst du mit

Mehrjährige Senior-Erfahrung als Requirements Engineer, Business Analyst oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle im B2B-SaaS-Produktumfeld, idealerweise in einer Scale-up-Phase und mit Hintergrund in Document Management, ECM, Workflow-Automatisierung oder einem verwandten Information-Hub-Umfeld. Du hast dabei nachweisbar Verantwortung für fachliche Modelle getragen und nicht nur für Spezifikationsdokumente.

Ausbildungshintergrund in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Business Engineering, BWL mit IT-Affinität (FH, Universität). MSc-Niveau ideal, Bachelor mit entsprechender Senior-Erfahrung ebenfalls möglich.

Echte Modellierungstiefe: Du kannst ein Geschäftsproblem in Entitäten, Zustände, Regeln und Prozesse zerlegen, so dass das Ergebnis widerspruchsfrei ist. Du formulierst Akzeptanzkriterien so, dass sie prüfbar sind. Sicherer Umgang mit BPMN, UML, Use Cases und User Stories sowie mit Jira und Confluence. Kenntnisse in ArchiMate sind ein Pluspunkt.

Generalisierungsinstinkt: Du erkennst, wann mehrere Einzelfälle dasselbe allgemeine Problem sind, und setzt die allgemeine Lösung durch. Du fragst nach dem Problem, bevor du nach der Lösung fragst, und du kannst eine Anforderung auch ablehnen.

Eingehendes Verständnis für administrative Prozesse in KMU, die Aufbereitung von Daten und zur Verfügungstellung via Schnittstellen an Drittanwendungen. Damit zusammenhängend die Fähigkeit, Problemstellen in bestehenden Prozessen zu analysieren und durch intelligente Abläufe zu ersetzen.

Hohe Affinität zu AI-Tools, idealerweise erste Erfahrung mit AI-gestützter Spezifikationsarbeit, Prompt Engineering oder agentischen Systemen aus Produkt-Sicht.

Deutsch auf Muttersprach-Niveau, Englisch verhandlungssicher (C1). Sicheres Auftreten auf C-Level.

Are you ready to own the edge runtime for thousands of smart fridges and coffee machines across Switzerland and the US? As our new Fleet & Device Engineer
(100%) in Zurich, you will join a close-knit 8-person engineering team to rebuild and manage the systems that power our hardware. In this hybrid role, you will take full ownership of our edge domain from day one, ensuring that our unglamorous but highly reliable hardware works seamlessly for real people getting their lunch every day.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Take full, end-to-end ownership of the edge runtime on our smart fridges and Gavetti coffee machine controllers, managing everything from zero-touch provisioning, device bootstrap, call-home and on-device applications.
Drive the consolidation of our fleet management onto a single, reliable platform (such as Azure IoT Hub or KubeEdge), taking charge of making and defending the architectural choices.
Streamline the technology stack by reducing the number of languages running on the edge, bringing the device world closer to our cloud environment.
Collaborate closely with and report directly to the Head of Engineering to specify the next generation of hardware, select vendors, and define software contracts.
Inherit and manage crucial vendor relationships and integrations, including those for our vendors and various badge reader suppliers.
Ensure the team maintains a grounded, honest understanding of what is actually running and performing in the field.

Solid background with roughly 5+ years of experience building and operating production systems, specifically managing a real fleet of devices with live users, outages, and OTA updates.
Proficiency in at least two of the following languages: C#, Go, or Kotlin, coupled with a willingness to consolidate and standardize our tech stack.
Working knowledge of edge platform networking (VPNs, NAT, flaky links, office networks), running Linux and Android on small hardware, OS-level debugging, and observability for offline-tolerant systems.
Strong ability to treat hardware as an interface, including practical experience with Modbus, USB, serial connections, reading sensor datasheets, and working with vendor SDKs.

jobs.title: Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer based in Switzerland.

This is a hands-on opportunity for an experienced IBM Datacap professional to contribute to the development and evolution of an enterprise document-processing platform. The role spans Datacap development, platform administration, integrations, troubleshooting, testing, deployment, and production support. You will help transform business requirements into secure, scalable, and reliable technical solutions. Working within an Agile product engineering environment, you will collaborate across development, architecture, testing, and operations. The position offers the opportunity to build new capabilities while supporting critical enterprise workflows. Experience with modern integrations, DevSecOps practices, and secure enterprise environments will be highly valuable. This is an ideal role for someone who combines deep Datacap expertise with strong software development and problem-solving capabilities.

Accountabilities

Design, develop, configure, enhance, and maintain IBM Datacap applications, including rulesets, tasks, actions, document hierarchies, workflows, validation rules, and verification processes.
Configure and optimize OCR, document recognition, classification, data extraction, field validation, image processing, and batch-processing capabilities.
Develop reusable Datacap components and custom actions or extensions, including business rules for document routing, validation, exception handling, and processing.
Install, configure, administer, monitor, and maintain Datacap environments across Development, Test, QA, UAT, and Production.
Administer and troubleshoot Datacap Server, Rulerunner, Datacap Studio, and Datacap Navigator, including processing queues, logs, performance, failed batches, OCR issues, workflow failures, connectivity problems, and production incidents.
Participate throughout the product development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, sprint planning, development, testing, deployment, release planning, and post-deployment stabilization.
Translate business requirements and user stories into technical solutions, estimate development effort, conduct peer reviews, troubleshoot defects, and implement sustainable fixes.
Develop and support integrations using REST APIs, SOAP web services, databases, file-based interfaces, enterprise content repositories, workflow platforms, and business applications.
Integrate document-processing capabilities with enterprise platforms such as IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator where applicable.
Manage metadata mapping, database lookups, document and metadata exports, API data exchange, retries, error handling, audit logging, and exception management.
Develop and maintain custom components using C#, .NET, Java, JavaScript, SQL, XML, REST, and SOAP, with particular emphasis on C#/.NET for custom Datacap actions and extensions.
Support secure enterprise and federal environments, including practices related to NIST, FISMA, IAM/RBAC, audit logging, vulnerability remediation, application security, PII protection, and configuration management.
Contribute to source control, CI/CD, automated deployments, release management, environment configuration, monitoring, incident management, and DevSecOps practices.

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on IBM Datacap experience, including strong experience with IBM Datacap 9.x/9.1.x.
Strong Datacap Studio development experience, along with hands-on Rulerunner administration and development.
Proven experience developing Datacap rulesets, workflows, tasks, actions, and other custom processing components.
Strong understanding of document capture and intelligent document processing, including OCR, classification, extraction, validation, verification, and image processing.
Enterprise-level Datacap administration experience across multiple environments, with strong production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
Experience integrating Datacap with databases and enterprise systems, including strong SQL capabilities and REST and/or SOAP integration experience.
Working knowledge of Windows Server and IIS.
Experience participating in Agile application or product development environments, from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
Experience with IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator is highly preferred.
C#/.NET experience and a background in developing custom Datacap actions or extensions are highly valued.
Experience with Java, JavaScript, SQL Server, Oracle, or DB2 is advantageous.
Familiarity with federal government IT environments, FISMA, NIST, DevSecOps, CI/CD, enterprise application integration, and secure handling of sensitive or PII data is preferred.
Experience building and enhancing new enterprise products, rather than exclusively maintaining legacy applications, is a strong advantage.

Benefits

Remote work opportunity.
Contract engagement with an enterprise-focused technology environment.
Opportunity to work on a large-scale document-processing product with significant technical scope.
Exposure to IBM Datacap, enterprise integrations, intelligent document processing, and modern DevSecOps practices.
Opportunity to contribute across development, architecture, administration, integration, deployment, and production support.
Collaboration within an Agile product engineering environment.
Experience working with enterprise and secure federal technology environments.
Compensation and contract benefits aligned with the engagement and applicable market conditions.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice:
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. jobs.title: FullStack (.Net+React)
jobs.description:
¡En Aszendit, crecemos juntos!

Buscamos un/a Programador/a Full Stack
con más de 4 años
de experiencia, especializado en .Net y React.

Funciones:

* Investigar los principales puntos de dolor de los equipos de desarrollo y proporcionar soluciones que aporten valor.
* Facilitar el self-service mediante la automatización de procesos y la elaboración de documentación técnica completa.
* Traducir las necesidades del negocio en decisiones de arquitectura backend y frontend escalables y fiables, considerando su impacto global.
* Desarrollar soluciones y código reutilizable orientados tanto al usuario final como a los equipos de desarrollo.
* Escuchar, comprender, debatir y priorizar las necesidades de otros desarrolladores teniendo en cuenta el contexto y estado de los productos.
* Diseñar APIs, boilerplates y soluciones técnicas destinadas a reducir la fricción y abstraer la complejidad.
* Fomentar la autonomía de los equipos mediante soluciones self-service y reutilizables.
* Mantener un enfoque práctico y orientado a la generación de valor.
* Desarrollar soluciones frontend, backend e infraestructura, resolviendo bloqueos reales y evitando el over-engineering.
* Comunicar decisiones arquitectónicas, impartir workshops internos y compartir conocimiento técnico.
* Redactar guías de integración y documentación técnica clara para facilitar la adopción de soluciones.
* Detectar cuellos de botella de rendimiento en herramientas y workflows de desarrollo, implementando quick wins de forma autónoma.

Requisitos:

Backend & BFF (Backend-for-Frontend)

* Backend Ecosystem: Dominio avanzado en el desarrollo de servicios robustos y escalables utilizando .NET Core / C# y Node.js (NestJS / Express).
* API Design & Resilience: Diseño y consumo de REST APIs, aplicando patrones de resiliencia (circuit breakers, retries, rate limiting).

Modern Frontend & Micro-Frontends (MFE) Architecture

* Core Frameworks: Dominio experto de React / TypeScript o Next.js para desarrollar interfaces complejas, modulares y de alto rendimiento.
* Module Federation: Experiencia práctica con Webpack / Vite Module Federation para la carga dinámica de MFE en runtime, gestionando shared scopes y el aislamiento de errores mediante Error Boundaries.
* Authentication & State: Gestión de flujos de identidad y autenticación OIDC / OAuth2, junto con la gestión de estado global/context.

Containers & Orchestration

* Docker: Experiencia demostrable en la gestión y optimización de imágenes (multi-stage builds), así como en la securización de Docker containers.
* Kubernetes (K8s): Experiencia en la orquestación, despliegue y administración de aplicaciones en clusters de K8s (deployments, services, ingresses, configmaps).

CI/CD, GitOps & Quality

* CI Pipelines: Creación y gestión de Continuous Integration pipelines para automatizar builds, ejecutar unit/integration tests, realizar static code analysis y publicar imágenes en registries (Harbor).
* GitOps & CD: Experiencia práctica con GitOps workflows y Continuous Deployment, con preferencia por ArgoD.
* Testing: Experiencia en automated testing y en promover una cultura de calidad shift-left.

¿Por qué Aszendit?

Trabajamos día a día para ser el partner tecnológico de nuestros clientes y partner profesional de nuestros colaboradores.
Nuestro objetivo principal es solventar el gran problema presente en el sector tecnológico, eliminar la rotación de los colaboradores poniendo en el centro el capital humano, ya que sin vosotros nada de esto sería posible.

Ofrecemos:

Modalidad remota
Horario flexible de oficina
Proyectos de gran impacto e indefinidos
Incorporación inmediata - contrato indefinido
Acompañamiento de un líder técnico
Bonus de formación
Plan de carrera
Team Buildings

¿Te gustaría tener la libertad de elegir el desarrollo de tu carrera profesional y tener las herramientas para hacerlo? ¡Esta oferta es ideal para ti!

This is a hands-on opportunity for an experienced IBM Datacap professional to contribute to the development and evolution of an enterprise document-processing platform. The role spans Datacap development, platform administration, integrations, troubleshooting, testing, deployment, and production support. You will help transform business requirements into secure, scalable, and reliable technical solutions. Working within an Agile product engineering environment, you will collaborate across development, architecture, testing, and operations. The position offers the opportunity to build new capabilities while supporting critical enterprise workflows. Experience with modern integrations, DevSecOps practices, and secure enterprise environments will be highly valuable. This is an ideal role for someone who combines deep Datacap expertise with strong software development and problem-solving capabilities.

Accountabilities

Design, develop, configure, enhance, and maintain IBM Datacap applications, including rulesets, tasks, actions, document hierarchies, workflows, validation rules, and verification processes.
Configure and optimize OCR, document recognition, classification, data extraction, field validation, image processing, and batch-processing capabilities.
Develop reusable Datacap components and custom actions or extensions, including business rules for document routing, validation, exception handling, and processing.
Install, configure, administer, monitor, and maintain Datacap environments across Development, Test, QA, UAT, and Production.

Integrate document-processing capabilities with enterprise platforms such as IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator where applicable.
Manage metadata mapping, database lookups, document and metadata exports, API data exchange, retries, error handling, audit logging, and exception management.
Develop and maintain custom components using C#, .NET, Java, JavaScript, SQL, XML, REST, and SOAP, with particular emphasis on C#/.NET for custom Datacap actions and extensions.
Support secure enterprise and federal environments, including practices related to NIST, FISMA, IAM/RBAC, audit logging, vulnerability remediation, application security, PII protection, and configuration management.
Contribute to source control, CI/CD, automated deployments, release management, environment configuration, monitoring, incident management, and DevSecOps practices.

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on IBM Datacap experience, including strong experience with IBM Datacap 9.x/9.1.x.
Strong Datacap Studio development experience, along with hands-on Rulerunner administration and development.
Proven experience developing Datacap rulesets, workflows, tasks, actions, and other custom processing components.
Strong understanding of document capture and intelligent document processing, including OCR, classification, extraction, validation, verification, and image processing.
Enterprise-level Datacap administration experience across multiple environments, with strong production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
Experience integrating Datacap with databases and enterprise systems, including strong SQL capabilities and REST and/or SOAP integration experience.
Working knowledge of Windows Server and IIS.
Experience participating in Agile application or product development environments, from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
Experience with IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator is highly preferred.
C#/.NET experience and a background in developing custom Datacap actions or extensions are highly valued.
Experience with Java, JavaScript, SQL Server, Oracle, or DB2 is advantageous.
Familiarity with federal government IT environments, FISMA, NIST, DevSecOps, CI/CD, enterprise application integration, and secure handling of sensitive or PII data is preferred.
Experience building and enhancing new enterprise products, rather than exclusively maintaining legacy applications, is a strong advantage.

Remote work opportunity.
Contract engagement with an enterprise-focused technology environment.

jobs.title: (Senior) DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.description:
What We Need

Oivan is a digital engineering, AI, cloud, and cybersecurity services company. We help governments, giga-projects, and large enterprises build, modernize, operate, and secure mission-critical digital services. Our mission is to build intelligent digital platforms that matter — then help our clients run and improve them at scale.

We combine Nordic engineering standards with deep regional commitment, with our operational headquarters in Riyadh and delivery teams across the Middle East, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. Our clients come to us when they need to turn complex transformation goals into reliable, secure production systems.

Why This Role Matters

As a DevSecOps Engineer, you will design and operate the platforms that let our clients build, ship, and run software safely at enterprise scale. You will work across CI/CD, cloud, container orchestration, and security — bridging the gap between development, operations, and security teams so that releases are fast, repeatable, and secure.

This is a hands-on, client-facing role based in Riyadh. You will work on complex, mission-critical environments, lead discovery and migration activities, and help raise the bar on how Oivan delivers engineering platforms.

What You'll Do

Build and run CI/CD: Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitLab, following DevOps and DevSecOps best practices.
Architect cloud and hybrid environments: Design, implement, and manage cloud and hybrid environments across GCP, Oracle Cloud, or Azure.
Automate with IaC: Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and deployments using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and Ansible).
Operate container platforms: Design and operate container platforms using Kubernetes, SUSE Rancher, and OpenStack.
Run resilient data services: Deploy, manage, and maintain PostgreSQL clusters and Redis clusters (Sentinel-based) for high availability and resilience.
Manage service discovery: Implement and operate Consul clusters for service discovery and configuration management.
Design for resilience: Design and test Disaster Recovery (DR) solutions, including data replication, failover strategies, and DR networking setup.
Lead discovery and migration: Lead discovery and assessment of existing SDLC, CI/CD, and infrastructure environments, and plan and execute migrations from existing GitLab instances or other DevOps platforms (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Bitbucket) to new GitLab environments.
Stand up GitLab: Install, configure, and operate GitLab on-premise environments, and design GitLab reference architectures.
Document operations: Create and maintain Runbooks and Playbooks for product- and project-based operations.
Embed security: Implement security scanning and automated security testing within CI/CD pipelines.
Bridge teams: Connect Development, Operations, and Security teams to deliver secure, reliable platforms.
Keep platforms healthy: Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize platform performance, availability, and reliability.
Share knowledge: Conduct training sessions and knowledge transfer for customers and internal teams.
Engage clients: Work closely with customer stakeholders in on-site engagements in KSA.

What You Have

Core Experience

5+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, CI/CD, or Platform Engineering.
Strong experience working in on-premise enterprise environments.
Ability to work independently in a customer-facing role.
Cloud
Experience with cloud administration on at least one of the following:
Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
Microsoft Azure
Infrastructure as Code

Strong hands-on experience with:

Terraform
Ansible
CI/CD & GitLab
Hands-on experience with GitLab migrations and high-availability GitLab implementations.
Container & Orchestration
Expertise in container orchestration and platforms:
Kubernetes
SUSE Rancher
OpenStack
Data & Platform Services
Experience managing PostgreSQL clusters.
Experience with Redis clusters, including Sentinel.
Hands-on experience with object storage solutions.
Experience with Consul clusters for service discovery and configuration.
Resilience
Strong Disaster Recovery (DR) skills, including:
Data replication strategies
DR networking setup and failover planning

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

What We Offer

At Oivan, you'll join a diverse team of experts committed to delivering digital services that operate reliably for real users. We combine the speed and ambition of a scale-up with the stability required for mission-critical government and enterprise work.

Your growth and wellbeing are priorities. We offer continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a collaborative culture where we win together.

How We Work

Production impact: We build solutions that work in real operating environments — useful, measurable, secure, and maintainable.

Nordic engineering standards: We prioritize engineering excellence, security, and long-term maintainability.

One team: We match tasks to the right owner, stay agile as priorities shift, and collaborate to win.

Transparency: We go deep, ask questions, and understand the "why" behind every decision.

Application Process

Initial Screening (TA + Hiring Manager)

Technical Discussion (Deep dive into DevOps/DevSecOps experience)

Technical Task (Hands-on scenario)

Final Interview

Responsible for maintenance and emergency callouts for fire alarms and life safety systems. This includes fire systems, aspirating, PAVA and disabled refuge. A key part of your role will be first\-time fixes and excellent customer communication.

  

Attending planned maintenance and reactive visits, using SECOM’s digital platform to manage workflows, uploading documentation, planning routes with NSB, ordering parts, logging into client portals, and updating service teams. A background fire and life safety systems, experience with signalling, wireless, conventional \& addressable fire alarm systems and compliance. A full UK driving licence is essential. You’ll be customer\-focused, adaptable, and confident using digital tools and reporting systems.

jobs.title: Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer based in Netherlands.

This is a hands-on opportunity for an experienced IBM Datacap professional to contribute to the development and evolution of an enterprise document-processing platform. The role spans Datacap development, platform administration, integrations, troubleshooting, testing, deployment, and production support. You will help transform business requirements into secure, scalable, and reliable technical solutions. Working within an Agile product engineering environment, you will collaborate across development, architecture, testing, and operations. The position offers the opportunity to build new capabilities while supporting critical enterprise workflows. Experience with modern integrations, DevSecOps practices, and secure enterprise environments will be highly valuable. This is an ideal role for someone who combines deep Datacap expertise with strong software development and problem-solving capabilities.

Accountabilities

Design, develop, configure, enhance, and maintain IBM Datacap applications, including rulesets, tasks, actions, document hierarchies, workflows, validation rules, and verification processes.
Configure and optimize OCR, document recognition, classification, data extraction, field validation, image processing, and batch-processing capabilities.
Develop reusable Datacap components and custom actions or extensions, including business rules for document routing, validation, exception handling, and processing.
Install, configure, administer, monitor, and maintain Datacap environments across Development, Test, QA, UAT, and Production.
Administer and troubleshoot Datacap Server, Rulerunner, Datacap Studio, and Datacap Navigator, including processing queues, logs, performance, failed batches, OCR issues, workflow failures, connectivity problems, and production incidents.
Participate throughout the product development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, sprint planning, development, testing, deployment, release planning, and post-deployment stabilization.
Translate business requirements and user stories into technical solutions, estimate development effort, conduct peer reviews, troubleshoot defects, and implement sustainable fixes.
Develop and support integrations using REST APIs, SOAP web services, databases, file-based interfaces, enterprise content repositories, workflow platforms, and business applications.
Integrate document-processing capabilities with enterprise platforms such as IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator where applicable.
Manage metadata mapping, database lookups, document and metadata exports, API data exchange, retries, error handling, audit logging, and exception management.
Develop and maintain custom components using C#, .NET, Java, JavaScript, SQL, XML, REST, and SOAP, with particular emphasis on C#/.NET for custom Datacap actions and extensions.
Support secure enterprise and federal environments, including practices related to NIST, FISMA, IAM/RBAC, audit logging, vulnerability remediation, application security, PII protection, and configuration management.
Contribute to source control, CI/CD, automated deployments, release management, environment configuration, monitoring, incident management, and DevSecOps practices.

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on IBM Datacap experience, including strong experience with IBM Datacap 9.x/9.1.x.
Strong Datacap Studio development experience, along with hands-on Rulerunner administration and development.
Proven experience developing Datacap rulesets, workflows, tasks, actions, and other custom processing components.
Strong understanding of document capture and intelligent document processing, including OCR, classification, extraction, validation, verification, and image processing.
Enterprise-level Datacap administration experience across multiple environments, with strong production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
Experience integrating Datacap with databases and enterprise systems, including strong SQL capabilities and REST and/or SOAP integration experience.
Working knowledge of Windows Server and IIS.
Experience participating in Agile application or product development environments, from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
Experience with IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator is highly preferred.
C#/.NET experience and a background in developing custom Datacap actions or extensions are highly valued.
Experience with Java, JavaScript, SQL Server, Oracle, or DB2 is advantageous.
Familiarity with federal government IT environments, FISMA, NIST, DevSecOps, CI/CD, enterprise application integration, and secure handling of sensitive or PII data is preferred.
Experience building and enhancing new enterprise products, rather than exclusively maintaining legacy applications, is a strong advantage.

Benefits

Remote work opportunity.
Contract engagement with an enterprise-focused technology environment.
Opportunity to work on a large-scale document-processing product with significant technical scope.
Exposure to IBM Datacap, enterprise integrations, intelligent document processing, and modern DevSecOps practices.
Opportunity to contribute across development, architecture, administration, integration, deployment, and production support.
Collaboration within an Agile product engineering environment.
Experience working with enterprise and secure federal technology environments.
Compensation and contract benefits aligned with the engagement and applicable market conditions.

The programme covers landing zone design, image and application modernisation, profile and data migration, security and regulatory alignment, run-model transition, and user adoption.

Responsibilities

Own the target-state EUC architecture on Azure (AVD host pools, session hosts, FSLogix profile management, image pipeline, networking, identity via Entra ID / hybrid AD).
Define the migration strategy: wave planning, persona segmentation, lift-and-shift vs. re-platform decisions, and Citrix Cloud on Azure vs. native AVD trade-offs.
Produce and defend design authority artefacts — HLD, LLD, security design, DR/BCP design — through the bank's architecture and risk governance forums.
Lead the migration factory: discovery and application rationalisation, packaging (MSIX app attach / App Layering), pilot, UAT, production waves, and hypercare.
Manage a mixed team of Azure engineers, Citrix/VMware specialists, packaging engineers, and service desk staff across multiple locations and time zones.
Own the migration plan, RAID log, dependencies on network, security, identity, and application owners, and report progress to steering committee.
Drive cost management: right-sizing, autoscaling policies, reserved instances, and FinOps reporting against the programme business case.
Ensure the target design meets the bank's control framework and regulatory obligations (data residency across jurisdictions, privileged access, session recording, DLP, endpoint hardening, audit and evidence trails).
Work with CISO, internal audit, and regional regulators' liaison teams to obtain design and go-live approvals.
Define the operating model, support processes, and monitoring/observability for the AVD estate; transition to the run organization with documented runbooks and knowledge transfer.
Establish digital experience monitoring and performance baselines; own remediation of latency and application performance issues, particularly for trading and market-data users.
Act as the senior point of contact for business heads, regional IT leads, and vendor partners (Microsoft, Citrix, ISVs).
Own the change and communications plan: user comms, training material, floor-walking, and early-life support.

Profile

Minimum Bachelors degree in IT/Computer Science or other relevant discipline
10+ years in end user computing / workplace infrastructure, with at least 3 years leading large-scale VDI transformation programme.
Deep hands-on background in Citrix
(CVAD, Citrix Cloud, NetScaler/ADC, Provisioning Services, WEM, FSLogix or UPM) and demonstrable experience decommissioning or re-platforming a Citrix estate.
Strong Azure
expertise: Azure Virtual Desktop, landing zone and hub-spoke networking, ExpressRoute, Azure Files / NetApp Files, Entra ID, Conditional Access, Intune, Azure Monitor / Log Analytics.
Windows 10/11 multi-session, image lifecycle automation, application packaging and delivery (MSIX, App-V, Intune Win32).
Infrastructure-as-code and automation: PowerShell, Terraform or Bicep, CI/CD for image builds.
Proven delivery in a regulated financial services environment
— familiarity with change control, segregation of duties, audit evidencing, and multi-jurisdiction data residency constraints.
Experience leading distributed teams and managing third-party vendors and SIs.
Programme-level planning and reporting; comfortable presenting to CIO-level stakeholders.
Microsoft certifications: AZ-140 (Azure Virtual Desktop Specialty), AZ-305, MD-102.
Citrix CCP-V / CCE-V.
Exposure to trading floor or market-data desktop environments (low-latency, GPU, multi-monitor, Bloomberg/Reuters integration).
Experience with digital experience monitoring tools (ControlUp, Nexthink, Aternity).

jobs.title: Headless CMS Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Headless CMS Solutions Architect based in Turkey.

This is a senior, client-facing opportunity focused on designing modern, scalable digital content platforms using headless and composable CMS technologies.

You will lead discovery engagements, translate business and editorial needs into technical solutions, and guide clients through technology evaluation and architecture decisions.

The role combines content strategy, cloud architecture, systems integration, development considerations, security, and enterprise digital transformation.

You will work across platforms including Storyblok, Sanity, Contentful, and Strapi, objectively assessing their capabilities against specific client requirements.

The position also requires a strong understanding of AWS environments and how CMS platforms integrate with cloud-based applications and infrastructure.

You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and communicate architectural recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

This role is well suited to an experienced architect or consultant who enjoys solving complex digital-content challenges and shaping practical implementation roadmaps.

Accountabilities

Lead client discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, and consulting engagements to understand business, editorial, technical, integration, security, and content requirements.
Gather, analyze, and document current-state requirements and translate them into scalable future-state digital platform architectures.
Evaluate headless CMS platforms and objectively recommend solutions based on client needs, technical constraints, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
Design scalable content models, schemas, reusable components, taxonomies, metadata structures, and composable content architectures.
Define editorial workflows, approval processes, role-based permissions, localization strategies, and publishing processes.
Design integrations between CMS platforms and enterprise applications, services, APIs, and other digital systems.
Develop architectures for multilingual content, accessibility, technical SEO, search, content governance, and modern web standards.
Design CMS migration strategies for legacy platforms such as Drupal, WordPress, Sitecore, and custom-built systems.
Assess how headless CMS solutions should integrate with AWS-based applications and infrastructure, including services such as S3, CloudFront, Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, RDS, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, Cognito, IAM, Route 53, WAF, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, and EventBridge.
Collaborate closely with front-end, cloud, DevOps, security, UX, and development teams to ensure architectural decisions can be implemented effectively.
Produce architecture diagrams, technology recommendations, implementation roadmaps, technical documentation, and other solution-design materials.
Present architectural recommendations clearly to executives, business stakeholders, content teams, IT departments, and developers.
Identify technical risks, dependencies, and potential scalability challenges throughout discovery and solution design.
Challenge requirements constructively when simpler, more scalable, or more maintainable approaches are appropriate.
Support implementation planning and ensure proposed solutions align with business objectives and technical realities.

Requirements

Significant professional experience working with headless CMS and composable digital-platform architectures.
Strong hands-on experience with at least two of Storyblok, Sanity, Contentful, or Strapi, with familiarity across the broader platform landscape preferred.
Practical experience with Storyblok features such as Visual Editor, components, workflows, localization, roles and permissions, Content Delivery API, and Management API.
Practical experience with Sanity, including Sanity Studio, structured content, schemas, GROQ, Content Lake, custom editorial experiences, and integrations.
Practical experience with Contentful, including content models, localization, environments, permissions, workflows, Content Delivery API, and Content Management API.
Practical experience with Strapi, including Content Type Builder, components, Dynamic Zones, REST and GraphQL APIs, permissions, plugins, and cloud or self-hosted deployments.
Experience leading CMS or digital-platform discovery and recommending enterprise content-management solutions.
Strong understanding of AWS and cloud-based architecture, with the ability to design solutions and collaborate effectively with cloud and DevOps specialists.
Strong knowledge of REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, API integrations, structured content, and composable architecture.
Experience with JavaScript and/or TypeScript and modern front-end frameworks such as React, Next.js, Vue, or Nuxt.
Experience designing enterprise systems integrations and CMS migration strategies.
Strong understanding of content governance, multilingual and localized content, role-based permissions, editorial workflows, technical SEO, accessibility, and modern web standards.
Experience producing architecture diagrams, technical documentation, implementation roadmaps, and technology recommendations.
Strong consulting, communication, facilitation, and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for different audiences.
Comfortable working with executives, business stakeholders, content teams, IT departments, developers, and other technical specialists.
Ability to evaluate technologies objectively, identify risks and dependencies, and communicate architectural trade-offs clearly.
Experience with enterprise search, Digital Asset Management, CRM, LMS, marketing automation, analytics, or identity platforms is an asset.
Additional experience with AWS Solutions Architect certification, CMS certifications, Next.js/React, Node.js, Terraform or Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, DevOps, AWS OpenSearch, Digital Asset Management platforms, CRM, marketing automation, or Learning Management Systems is considered a plus.

Benefits

jobs.title: Manager / Senior Manager - Cloud Architect
jobs.description:
About PwC

At PwC Switzerland, we help clients build trust and reinvent so they can turn complexity into competitive advantage. We're part of a tech-forward, people-empowered network and help clients build, accelerate and sustain momentum across audit, assurance, tax, legal, workforce, deals and consulting.

Manager / Senior Manager - Cloud Architect

Your Impact

Lead and collaborate with a dynamic team to deliver high-impact cloud transformation projects and engage with senior stakeholders from prestigious clients in industries such as Technology, Financial Services, Retail & Consumer, Healthcare, and Government Services.​

Enable clients to achieve digital innovation by designing and implementing comprehensive, end-to-end cloud architectures that incorporate the latest technological advancements, including AI/GenAI platforms, data & analytics, event-driven architectures, containerisation (Kubernetes), and Infrastructure-as-Code.

Lead and support the architectural design and implementation of cloud solutions, ensuring scalability, security, resilience, compliance, cost- efficiency and sustainability.

Define and evolve target operating models, cloud landing zones, and reference architectures, and establish architecture governance and best practices across enterprise-wide cloud programmes.

Communicate complex architectural concepts and technical information effectively to facilitate stakeholder decision-making.

Challenge the status quo, proactively seek necessary information, comprehend the challenges presented, and communicate ideas clearly to senior stakeholders.​

Contribute to business development activities, including proposals, client pitches, thought leadership, and the growth of the Cloud practice within PwC Switzerland and across the global network.

Apply and continually expand knowledge of best practices in cloud-native technology, cloud architecture, engineering methodologies, and consulting strategies.​

Your Skill Set

Hold a degree (bachelor / master / diploma) in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related discipline.​

Possess 5+ years of work experience focusing on cloud architecture, cloud engineering, or platform solutions. Consulting experience is advantageous.

Demonstrate a proven track record in designing, implementing, and delivering complex, end-to-end cloud architecture or solutions for internal or external clients. Detail-oriented, strong problem-solving abilities, and proficient in technology.

Strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Azure is a must, including designing and implementing Azure Landing Zones (Cloud Adoption Framework), AKS, Azure Networking, Entra ID, and AI services such as Azure OpenAI. Additional experience with AWS and/or Google Cloud is considered a plus.

Certified in cloud architecture for one or more platforms, such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Professional), or Google Cloud Certified Professional Cloud Architect. Additional certifications (e.g. TOGAF, CKA, security or AI specialisations) are a plus.

Excellent interpersonal, listening, and communication skills, proactive and enthusiastic about delivering value to clients. 

​You are fluent in English (German is a big plus) and are willing to travel within Switzerland, and occasionally also internationally

jobs.description:
Über diese Stelle

In dieser Rolle verantwortest du als Solution Architect wesentliche Bereiche unserer Digitalisierung. Du hilfst uns dabei, Mehrwert aus bestehenden und neuen Lösungen im Microsoft-Ökosystem zu generieren – von Microsoft 365 über Power Platform, Workflow Automation und Robotic Process Automation (RPA) bis hin zu modernen AI- und Agentenlösungen. Gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen identifizierst du Digitalisierungspotenziale, entwickelst zukunftsfähige Lösungsarchitekturen und steuerst externe Umsetzungspartner von der Idee bis zum produktiven Einsatz. Darüber hinaus gestaltest du die Weiterentwicklung unserer Software- und Lösungsarchitektur, etablierst Entwicklungs-, Architektur- und Qualitätsstandards und entwickelst einen zukunftsfähigen Technologie-Stack für digitale Lösungen, Automatisierung und AI. Dabei unterstützt du den Einsatz moderner AI-gestützter Entwicklungsansätze und stellst sicher, dass sowohl klassisch8 entwickelte als auch AI-generierte Lösungen höchsten Anforderungen hinsichtlich Qualität, Wartbarkeit, Sicherheit, Skalierbarkeit und Compliance entsprechen.

Deine Aufgaben

Beratung von Management und Fachbereichen bei Technologieentscheidungen und Digitalisierungsvorhaben
Förderung einer unternehmensweiten AI- und Automatisierungskultur
Identifikation, Bewertung und Priorisierung von AI- und Automatisierungspotenzialen sowie Erarbeitung von Zielbildern und technologischen Entscheidungsgrundlagen
Strategische Weiterentwicklung der Microsoft-365-, Power-Platform-, Automatisierungs- und AI-Landschaft einschließlich Definition von Zielarchitekturen, Entwicklungsrichtlinien, Qualitätsstandards und Governance Modellen
Konzeption und Einführung innovativer Lösungen auf Basis von Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Claude, Azure AI Services und weiteren Large Language Models
Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung einer unternehmensweiten Strategie für Workflow Automation und Robotic Process Automation (RPA) sowie Konzeption und Umsetzung moderner Automatisierungslösungen mit Power Automate, Power Apps und weiteren Low-Code-Technologien
Definition und Etablierung von Entwicklungs-, Test-, Review- und Freigabeprozessen sowie Standards für AI-gestützte Softwareentwicklung und Citizen Development
Steuerung und fachliche Führung externer Implementierungs- und Beratungspartner
Beobachtung von Markttrends und Evaluierung neuer Technologien im Bereich AI, Low-Code und Automation

Dein Profil

Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Solution Architect, Enterprise Architect, Lead Consultant oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle im Industrieumfeld
Fundierte Kenntnisse im Microsoft-Ökosystem, insbesondere Microsoft 365, Azure und Power Platform
Erfahrung in der Definition von Softwarearchitekturen, Entwicklungsstandards, Test- und Reviewverfahren sowie der Qualitätssicherung von Software- und Automatisierungslösungen
Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Einführung von Enterprise-Lösungen im Cloud- und AI-Umfeld
Praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, Claude oder vergleichbaren Lösungen
Erfahrung im Bereich Workflow Automation und Robotic Process Automation
Sehr gute Kenntnisse der Microsoft Power Platform (insbesondere Power Automate, idealerweise Power Apps und Power Pages)
Erfahrung in der Integration von Unternehmenssystemen über APIs, Microsoft Graph, Datenplattformen und moderne Integrationsarchitekturen
Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung und Steuerung externer Implementierungs- und Beratungspartner
Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Governance, Security, Compliance und Datenschutz
Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Inhalte verständlich an Fachbereiche und Management zu vermitteln
Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Von Vorteil:

Zertifizierungen im Bereich Microsoft Azure, Power Platform oder AI
Erfahrungen mit AI Agents, Agentic AI, Multi-Agent-Systemen sowie AI-gestützter Softwareentwicklung (z. B. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code oder vergleichbare Werkzeuge)
Kenntnisse von RPA-Plattformen wie UiPath, Automation Anywhere oder Power Automate Desktop
Erfahrung mit Process Mining und Business Process Management
Kenntnisse in Fertigungs-, Engineering-, PLM- oder ERP-Prozessen
Erfahrung im Aufbau von Citizen-Development-Programmen und Low-Code Governance-Modellen
Projektmanagement-Erfahrung in internationalen Transformationsprojekten

Bei uns steht der Mensch im Mittelpunkt – nicht das perfekte Profil. Auch wenn Sie nicht alle genannten Anforderungen vollständig erfüllen, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen. Ihr Jahresbruttogehalt startet bei € 75.000,- auf Vollzeitbasis. Die konkrete Vergütung richtet sich nach Ihrer Ausbildung, Ihrer beruflichen Erfahrung sowie Ihren individuellen Qualifikationen und kann bei entsprechender Erfahrung und Expertise deutlich darüber liegen.

FACC als internationales Unternehmen bietet darüber hinaus sehr gute Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und attraktive Sozialleistungen und Benefits.

Definir estrategias de observabilidad, monitorización, trazabilidad y resiliencia de sistemas críticos.

Establecer estándares de desarrollo basados en Clean Code, principios SOLID y metodologías TDD.

Definir arquitecturas de seguridad End-to-End, incluyendo modelos Zero Trust y gestión de identidades.
Liderar la adopción de entornos contenerizados mediante Docker y Kubernetes/K3s.
Diseñar soluciones de mensajería y procesamiento asíncrono utilizando tecnologías como Kafka, RabbitMQ o MQTT.
Colaborar con equipos multidisciplinares internacionales en la definición y ejecución de soluciones tecnológicas innovadoras.
Participar en la toma de decisiones técnicas estratégicas y en la definición de hojas de ruta tecnológicas.

Titulación en Ingeniería Informática, Telecomunicaciones o similar.
Al menos 5 años de experiencia en diseño, desarrollo y despliegue de sistemas distribuidos.
Experiencia demostrable definiendo arquitecturas basadas en microservicios y eventos.
Conocimientos sólidos de Event-Driven Architecture, CQRS, DDD y Clean Architecture.
Experiencia en plataformas cloud como AWS, Azure o Google Cloud.
Experiencia trabajando con Docker, Kubernetes y/o K3s.
Conocimientos de bases de datos SQL y NoSQL.
Experiencia diseñando APIs REST, GraphQL y gRPC.
Experiencia con tecnologías de mensajería y streaming como Kafka, RabbitMQ o MQTT.
Conocimientos de arquitecturas de seguridad, Zero Trust y gestión de identidades.
Experiencia en desarrollo con tecnologías como C#, .NET, Python o Java.
Experiencia en migración de aplicaciones hacia arquitecturas basadas en servicios y soluciones cloud.

Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, liderazgo técnico y resolución de problemas.

Proyecto innovador y de alto impacto tecnológico.

You will lead discovery engagements, translate business and editorial needs into technical solutions, and guide clients through technology evaluation and architecture decisions.

The role combines content strategy, cloud architecture, systems integration, development considerations, security, and enterprise digital transformation.

You will work across platforms including Storyblok, Sanity, Contentful, and Strapi, objectively assessing their capabilities against specific client requirements.

The position also requires a strong understanding of AWS environments and how CMS platforms integrate with cloud-based applications and infrastructure.

You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and communicate architectural recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

This role is well suited to an experienced architect or consultant who enjoys solving complex digital-content challenges and shaping practical implementation roadmaps.

Accountabilities

Lead client discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, and consulting engagements to understand business, editorial, technical, integration, security, and content requirements.
Gather, analyze, and document current-state requirements and translate them into scalable future-state digital platform architectures.
Evaluate headless CMS platforms and objectively recommend solutions based on client needs, technical constraints, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
Design scalable content models, schemas, reusable components, taxonomies, metadata structures, and composable content architectures.
Define editorial workflows, approval processes, role-based permissions, localization strategies, and publishing processes.
Design integrations between CMS platforms and enterprise applications, services, APIs, and other digital systems.
Develop architectures for multilingual content, accessibility, technical SEO, search, content governance, and modern web standards.
Design CMS migration strategies for legacy platforms such as Drupal, WordPress, Sitecore, and custom-built systems.
Assess how headless CMS solutions should integrate with AWS-based applications and infrastructure, including services such as S3, CloudFront, Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, RDS, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, Cognito, IAM, Route 53, WAF, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, and EventBridge.
Collaborate closely with front-end, cloud, DevOps, security, UX, and development teams to ensure architectural decisions can be implemented effectively.
Produce architecture diagrams, technology recommendations, implementation roadmaps, technical documentation, and other solution-design materials.
Present architectural recommendations clearly to executives, business stakeholders, content teams, IT departments, and developers.
Identify technical risks, dependencies, and potential scalability challenges throughout discovery and solution design.
Challenge requirements constructively when simpler, more scalable, or more maintainable approaches are appropriate.
Support implementation planning and ensure proposed solutions align with business objectives and technical realities.

Requirements

Significant professional experience working with headless CMS and composable digital-platform architectures.
Strong hands-on experience with at least two of Storyblok, Sanity, Contentful, or Strapi, with familiarity across the broader platform landscape preferred.
Practical experience with Storyblok features such as Visual Editor, components, workflows, localization, roles and permissions, Content Delivery API, and Management API.
Practical experience with Sanity, including Sanity Studio, structured content, schemas, GROQ, Content Lake, custom editorial experiences, and integrations.
Practical experience with Contentful, including content models, localization, environments, permissions, workflows, Content Delivery API, and Content Management API.
Practical experience with Strapi, including Content Type Builder, components, Dynamic Zones, REST and GraphQL APIs, permissions, plugins, and cloud or self-hosted deployments.
Experience leading CMS or digital-platform discovery and recommending enterprise content-management solutions.
Strong understanding of AWS and cloud-based architecture, with the ability to design solutions and collaborate effectively with cloud and DevOps specialists.
Strong knowledge of REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, API integrations, structured content, and composable architecture.
Experience with JavaScript and/or TypeScript and modern front-end frameworks such as React, Next.js, Vue, or Nuxt.
Experience designing enterprise systems integrations and CMS migration strategies.
Strong understanding of content governance, multilingual and localized content, role-based permissions, editorial workflows, technical SEO, accessibility, and modern web standards.
Experience producing architecture diagrams, technical documentation, implementation roadmaps, and technology recommendations.
Strong consulting, communication, facilitation, and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for different audiences.
Comfortable working with executives, business stakeholders, content teams, IT departments, developers, and other technical specialists.
Ability to evaluate technologies objectively, identify risks and dependencies, and communicate architectural trade-offs clearly.
Experience with enterprise search, Digital Asset Management, CRM, LMS, marketing automation, analytics, or identity platforms is an asset.
Additional experience with AWS Solutions Architect certification, CMS certifications, Next.js/React, Node.js, Terraform or Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, DevOps, AWS OpenSearch, Digital Asset Management platforms, CRM, marketing automation, or Learning Management Systems is considered a plus.

Benefits

BlueVi / Vacatures / Security Engineer

Deel vacature

Vacature

Security Engineer

HBO
32-40 uur
Hengelo, Eindhoven

Deel vacature

Bij BlueVi bewaak jij de security en privacy van een product dat dagelijks gezondheidsgegevens van meer dan 3,5 miljoen werknemers verwerkt. Dat vraagt om meer dan compliance op papier: security en privacy moeten in de kern van ons product zitten, en jij bent daar de technische eigenaar van. Dat gaat van secure coding tot risicobeoordeling, van incident response tot

certificering.

Wat ga je doen?

Je beoordeelt de technische risico’s van nieuwe features en verwerkingen, toetst DPIA’s, en

houdt ons vulnerability- en dependency-beleid scherp. Ook denk je actief mee over de tooling

die we daarvoor gebruiken, zoals Aikido. Je richt security monitoring en detectie in en bewaakt deze, en bent bij een incident of (vermeend) datalek het eerste aanspreekpunt; ook organiseer en volg je pentests op. Je bewaakt secure coding in onze PHP-, .NET- en Golang-codebases en houdt ons compliance-framework (ISO 27001, ISAE 3000, NEN-7510, AVG/GDPR) actueel.

Het hoge securityniveau dat we nastreven is een belangrijk deel van je werk. Je werkt in een multidisciplinair team met cloud- en devops engineers, waarmee je samen bouwt aan stabiele, schaalbare en veilige producten en Azure-infrastructuur. Ook de interne AI-ontwikkelingen, zoals ons gebruik van Azure AI Foundry, vallen binnen jouw aandachtsgebied. Een mooi terrein om als security engineer je stempel op te drukken.

Wie zoeken wij?

Je hebt hands-on ervaring met secure coding en code reviews (PHP, .NET en/of Golang), niet alleen vanuit een adviesrol.
Je hebt bij voorkeur gewerkt met gevoelige data, zoals in de medische sector (NEN-7510-kennis is een pluspunt) en kunt de technische inhoud van een DPIA beoordelen en toelichten.
Ook heb je eerder andere engineers getraind in of gecoacht op security best practices.
Engineers zijn je belangrijkste doelgroep, maar je durft ook de bredere organisatie mee te nemen in security bewustwording.
Je bent analytisch en pragmatisch, en net zo makkelijk zelf aan de code als in de rol van coach.

Wat bieden wij?

Je krijgt een rol met directe impact op ons product en de manier van werken van het engineering team, met de ruimte om mee te denken over tooling en de inrichting van ons securitybeleid.
Een aantrekkelijk salaris
Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden,
Hybride werken vanuit Hengelo,
Een informeel, internationaal team dat security net zo serieus neemt als jij.

Over BlueVi

BlueVi helpt meer dan 3,5 miljoen werknemers veilig, gezond en duurzaam inzetbaar te houden. Dat doen wij door samen met onze klanten de meest flexibele, complete en gebruiksvriendelijke online-software en apps te ontwikkelen voor verzuimbegeleiding, verzuimpreventie, het verzekeren van inkomen en het inzetbaar houden van werknemers. Daarbij geloven wij sterk in de kracht van eenvoud, connectiviteit en data. Wij groeien sterk en zijn met meer dan 300.000 actieve gebruikers marktleider in Nederland. Vele grote en minder grote Nederlandse bedrijven gebruiken onze software en daar zijn we trots op.

Wir unterstützen einige der größten Unternehmen Europas bei komplexen Identity‑Transformationen, Active‑Directory‑Konsolidierungen, Tenant‑Migrationen, M&A‑Integrationen und Hybrid‑Identity‑Projekten, regelmäßig in Umgebungen mit mehreren Active Directories, mehreren Entra‑Tenants und hunderttausenden Identitäten. Für diese Herausforderungen suchen wir einen erfahrenen Identity‑Spezialisten, der sich sowohl in klassischen Microsoft Identity Manager (MIM)‑Landschaften als auch in modernen Microsoft Entra Identity Services zuhause fühlt und an Projekten arbeiten möchte, in denen Standardlösungen oft nicht ausreichen.

Deine Aufgaben

Architektur & Consulting: Analyse, Design und Implementierung komplexer Hybrid‑Identity‑Architekturen; Entwicklung von Zielarchitekturen für Active Directory, Entra ID und Hybrid‑Identity‑Landschaften inkl. technischer Assessments und Architektur‑Workshops.
Synchronisation & Identity Lifecycle: Design und Betrieb von MIM‑Umgebungen, Entwicklung komplexer Synchronisationslösungen zwischen Verzeichnisdiensten, Konzeption von Join‑, Projection‑ und Correlation‑Logiken, Attribut‑Mappings, Transformationsregeln sowie individuellen Connectoren, inklusive Behebung tiefgehender Synchronisations‑ und Datenqualitätsprobleme.
Hybrid & Cloud Identity: Implementierung und Optimierung von Microsoft Entra Connect Sync, Entra Cloud Sync, PTA, PHS, Seamless SSO und Federation Services; nahtlose Integration von Active Directory und Microsoft Entra ID.
Migration & Transformation: Planung und Durchführung von Tenant‑to‑Tenant‑Migrationen, AD‑Konsolidierungen, Multi‑Forest‑Transformationen sowie M&A‑/Carve‑Out‑Projekten inkl. Bereinigung großer Identity‑Datenbestände.
Entwicklung & Automatisierung: Entwicklung von Identity‑Integrationen, Erweiterungen sowie PowerShell‑ und C#‑basierter Tooling‑Lösungen zur Automatisierung von Betriebs‑, Governance‑ und Migrationsprozessen, auf Basis moderner APIs und Cloud Services.
Führen & Moderieren: Du leitest Workstreams, moderierst Workshops, erstellst tragfähige Konzepte und Decision Papers und präsentierst Ergebnisse bis auf C‑Level.

Qualifications

Qualifikation und Erfahrung

Must‑have – Identity & Directory Services

Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Identity Manager (MIM) und tiefes Verständnis der MIM‑Synchronisationsengine (Metaverse, Connector Space, Management Agents, Join/Projection/Sync Rules, Attribute Flows, Identity Correlation, Data Mapping & Transformation).
Fundierte Kenntnisse in Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Entra Connect Sync, Entra Cloud Sync, Hybrid Identity, LDAP, DNS, PKI/Zertifikatsinfrastrukturen, Kerberos und NTLM.

Must‑have – Authentication & Federation

Tiefgehende Kenntnisse in SAML 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), OAuth 2.0, SCIM 2.0 und WS‑Federation sowie praktische Erfahrung mit SSO, Federation, AD FS, MFA und Conditional Access.

Must‑have – Data Engineering & Entwicklung

Erfahrung mit SQL Server, Datenanalyse und Datenmodellierung im Identity‑Kontext.
Sehr gute Kenntnisse in PowerShell, C# und .NET sowie Erfahrung mit Microsoft Graph API, REST APIs, XML, JSON und Git.

Nice to have

Identity Governance: Microsoft Entra ID Governance, Access Reviews, Entitlement Management, Lifecycle Workflows, IGA, RBAC, PIM.
Security & Zero Trust: Zero‑Trust‑Architekturen, PAM, Identity Security, Conditional Access Frameworks, Microsoft Security Stack, inkl. sicherem Umgang mit Angriffsvektoren wie Pass‑the‑Hash, Golden Ticket, Kerberoasting sowie Protokollangriffen auf OIDC/SAML.
Weitere IAM‑Lösungen: One Identity Manager, SailPoint IdentityIQ oder Saviynt.
DevOps & Automatisierung: CI/CD‑Pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, Terraform, Bicep, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions.

Über dich

Beratungskompetenz ist uns besonders wichtig: Du überzeugst Kund:innen durch professionelles Auftreten, Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, auch komplexe Themen souverän zu präsentieren und tragfähige Lösungen gemeinsam zu erarbeiten.
Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten, hohe technische Neugier und Freude an technisch anspruchsvollen Herausforderungen.
Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich zu kommunizieren.
Kundenorientierung und Beratungsstärke; Bereitschaft, mit Kund:innen in kleinen oder großen Avanade‑Teams zusammenzuarbeiten.
Fließende Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch (Mindestniveau C1).
Reisebereitschaft in Absprache mit Dir.

Starte beruflich durch

Einige Der Vorteile, Wenn Du Bei Avanade Arbeitest

Die Möglichkeit, für Microsofts Global Alliance Partner des Jahres zu arbeiten (14 Jahre in Folge), mit außergewöhnlichen Möglichkeiten zur Weiterentwicklung und Schulung (mindestens 80 Stunden pro Jahr für Schulungen und bezahlte Zertifizierungen).
Anspruchsvolle Projekte bei namhaften internationalen Unternehmen und Arbeit an komplexen M&A‑, Konsolidierungs‑ und Transformationsprojekten.
Ein Team aus erfahrenen Identity‑, Security‑ und Cloud‑Spezialisten mit großen Gestaltungsspielräumen.
Ein engagierter People Lead, der dich bei deinem Karrierewachstum unterstützt, sowie motivierte und hilfsbereite Kolleg:innen, die wirklich an dir interessiert sind.
Flexible Arbeitsmodelle und Remote‑Arbeit.
Erfahre mehr über einige unserer Vorteile hier.

Der perfekte Ort zum Arbeiten

Über 60.000 Professionals, 26 Länder und ein Universum – das ist Avanade. Egal welche digitale Fragestellung, im Microsoft-Ökosystem finden wir die Lösung. Denn: Wir sind nicht von schlechten Eltern. Accenture LLP und die Microsoft Corporation haben uns 2000 in die Welt gesetzt. Logisch, dass wir das Beste aus beiden Welten gekonnt verbinden.

Wenn du dich dafür entscheidest, deine Fähigkeiten und individuellen Talente bei Avanade einzubringen, wirst du im Gegenzug einzigartige Erfahrungen, unbegrenzte Lernmöglichkeiten und ambitioniertes Wachstum erleben.

Und während wir auch weiterhin in unsere vielfältige und inklusive Kultur investieren, dabei noch innovativer und kreativer werden, sorgen wir dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen von unseren technischen Innovationen profitieren und es unseren Communities gut geht. Du wirst Teil eines smarten Teams, das dich unterstützt, fördert, leitet und auf deine Expertise baut. Der perfekte Start in einem Unternehmen, das gegründet wurde, um geschäftskritische, führende Technologielösungen zu implementieren und gleichzeitig die Art und Weise, wie Menschen arbeiten, interagieren und leben verbessern möchte.

Do What Matters

Wir glauben daran, dass inklusive und diverse Teams jede Challenge meistern – wer sich Herausforderungen mit Leidenschaft und Mut stellt, ist bei uns genau richtig. Deine Bewerbung ist willkommen - unabhängig deiner Herkunft, Nationalität, Glaube, Behinderung, Alter, Familienstand, Partnerschaftsstatus, sexueller Orientierung und deines Geschlechts. Bei uns darfst du einfach du sein. Vielfalt in jeder Form ist uns eine echte Herzensangelegenheit und ein fester Bestandteil der Avanade-Kultur.
