jobs.title: Supply Chain Engineer
jobs.location: Alphen aan den Rijn, ZH, NL
jobs.description:
**Wil jij bouwen aan de supply chain van de toekomst?**


Krijg jij energie van complexe logistieke vraagstukken, het verbeteren van processen en projecten die zichtbaar resultaat opleveren? En ligt jouw kracht in projectmanagement, data\-analyse óf WMS/ERP\-systemen? Dan is deze rol iets voor jou.


Bij Technische Unie werken we continu aan de automatisering en digitalisering van onze supply chain. Als Supply Chain Engineer krijg je veel ruimte om vanuit jouw eigen expertise bij te dragen. Je hoeft dus niet alles al te kunnen: we zoeken iemand die sterk is in minimaal één van deze richtingen en zich graag verder wil ontwikkelen.

**Dit ga je doen**
------------------


Als Supply Chain Engineer werk je op het snijvlak van logistiek, techniek, IT en procesverbetering. Je analyseert waar processen slimmer en efficiënter kunnen en vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar concrete verbeteringen.


Afhankelijk van jouw ervaring en expertise ligt jouw focus bijvoorbeeld op het doelgericht aansturen van projecten, het analyseren en vertalen van grote hoeveelheden data of het verbeteren en vernieuwen van onze logistieke systemen.


Je werkt samen met collega’s uit verschillende disciplines en maakt deel uit van het Supply Chain Engineering Team: een ambitieus en multidisciplinair team dat werkt aan automatisering, digitalisering en robotisering binnen onze supply chain.

 **Jouw verantwoordelijkheden**

* Analyseren en verbeteren van supply chain\-processen en ondersteunende systemen.
* Vertalen van data en complexe vraagstukken naar inzichten en concrete verbetervoorstellen.
* Opstellen van businesscases en onderbouwen van verbeterinitiatieven.
* Leiden of ondersteunen van projecten binnen onze logistieke operatie.
* Bewaken van voortgang, planning, budget en risico’s.
* Verbinden van collega’s, afdelingen en externe partijen en zorgen voor duidelijke afspraken en opvolging.
* Begeleiden van de implementatie en borging van nieuwe processen en systemen.
* Adviseren over logistieke automatisering, digitalisering en procesoptimalisatie.

 **Waarom deze rol?**


Bij Technische Unie krijg je de ruimte om mee te bouwen aan een van de meest innovatieve supply chains van Nederland. De komende jaren staan er grote ontwikkelingen op de planning, waaronder de verdere vernieuwing van onze logistieke systemen.


Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid en kunt vanuit jouw eigen expertise echt impact maken. Of jouw kracht nu ligt in projectmanagement, data\-analyse of systemen: jouw ideeën worden gehoord en kunnen direct bijdragen aan het verbeteren van onze logistieke operatie.

**Wij bieden**
--------------


Jouw ontwikkeling, gezondheid en veiligheid staan centraal. Als Top Employer bieden we veel goede arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals:

* Geniet van 40 verlofdagen (vakantie\- én ATV\-dagen op fulltime basis) én de optie om dagen te kopen of verkopen
* Profiteer van winstdeling en goede pensioenregeling
* Blijf vitaal met een vitaliteitsbudget, thuiswerkregeling, sportschoolkorting en gezondheidschecks
* Altijd blijven groeien met ons brede trainings\- en opleidingsaanbod

**Heb jij het in je?**
----------------------


Lef, durf en aanpassingsvermogen! Dat is de mentaliteit waarmee onze collega’s het verschil maken. Of je nu net begint of al wat ervaring meebrengt, bij Technische Unie krijg je de ruimte om te ontwikkelen op jouw manier.


Iedereen brengt iets unieks mee. Juist die mix van verschillen maakt ons sterker als team. We geloven in een werksfeer waarin je jezelf kunt zijn, kunt groeien en elke dag iets nieuws kunt ontdekken.


Met meer dan 2\.000 collega’s bouwen we dagelijks aan een slimmer, duurzamer Nederland. We helpen onze klanten vooruit met een breed aanbod technische producten, diensten en een krachtige online omgeving die behoort tot de grootste B2B\-platforms van Nederland. Maar het echte verschil maken we met elkaar, met mensen die energie, ideeën en lef meebrengen. Heb jij het in je?

**Dit breng je mee**
--------------------

* Een afgeronde hbo\-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in Logistiek, Supply Chain Management, Technische Bedrijfskunde of Bedrijfskunde.
* Enkele jaren relevante werkervaring binnen supply chain, logistiek, procesverbetering of projectmanagement.
* Je herkent jezelf in minimaal één van deze richtingen:
* Je bent een doelgerichte projectmanager die voortgang bewaakt, mensen in beweging krijgt en zorgt dat afspraken worden nagekomen.
* Je bent analytisch sterk, werkt makkelijk met grote hoeveelheden data en vertaalt deze naar bruikbare inzichten.
* Je hebt ervaring met WMS\- of ERP\-systemen en weet hoe systemen en logistieke processen elkaar beïnvloeden.
* Je communiceert makkelijk met verschillende stakeholders en kunt complexe onderwerpen helder uitleggen.
* Je neemt initiatief, werkt resultaatgericht en houdt overzicht.
* Je bent flexibel en naast ons DC in Alphen aan den Rijn ook regelmatig aanwezig op onze andere logistieke locaties.
* Ervaring met Manhattan WMS is een pré.

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Java Engineer
jobs.description:
**Ready for a challenge?**
--------------------------

  

Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We’re a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience.


Whether it’s a Friday\-night feast, a post\-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe.

**About this role**
-------------------

  

We are seeking a motivated and experienced engineer to join our team as we consolidate fragmented partner data into a global event\-driven architecture. You'll help build tooling that empowers our operations team to manage restaurant partners, breaking down monolithic .NET applications into microservices using Java Spring Framework and Kubernetes. We are big on communication, collaboration and innersourcing across teams.

* ***Please note that this position is located in Amsterdam (3 days a week from our Amsterdam office and 2 days working from home)***

**These are some of the key components to the position:**
---------------------------------------------------------

  

* Design and implement high\-performance, highly scalable, event\-driven microservices for the partner domain.
* Partner with product teams to translate requirements into technical specifications, and align with cross\-functional teams on API/Event contracts (e.g., OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, Confluent).
* Write clean, efficient, and well\-documented code while actively mentoring junior developers and driving code reviews to ensure system maintainability.
* Maintain, investigate, and document the revenue\-driving legacy platform, acting quickly to debug and resolve any operational issues.
* Proactively explore emerging technologies and AI\-driven tools to automate repetitive tasks, simplify full\-stack complexities, and elevate overall code quality.
* Actively participate in team brainstorming sessions, communicate progress on complex features, and remain open to learning and innersourcing across new tech stacks.

**What will you bring to the team?**
------------------------------------

  

* In\-depth knowledge of backend ecosystems (Java/Spring Framework OR C\#/.Net) and design patterns, with expertise building event\-driven microservices using message queues (e.g., Apache Kafka, AWS SNS/SQS).
* Experience in full\-stack development, including proficiency in modern front\-end frameworks (such as Vue, React, etc.).
* Hands\-on experience with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm charts, alongside working knowledge of relational (MySQL) and NoSQL databases.
* Strong background in modern frontend and backend testing frameworks (e.g., JUnit, Testcontainers) and distributed tracing for microservices (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Datadog).
* Hands\-on experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS), DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm charts.
* Familiarity with PHP, broad exposure across multiple backend ecosystems (Java, .NET), and experience with cybersecurity practices.

**At JET, this is how we play**
-------------------------------

  

Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best\-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment.


Being the best at what we do isn’t just about delivering on our strategy. It's a competition for something incredibly valuable – our customers' choice. Every time a customer decides where to order, they're picking a side.

  

At the heart of the JET Customer League are our values and behaviours. They guide every interaction, every decision, every innovation. These are the actions we need to perform consistently and brilliantly, to surpass the competition and earn our customers’ loyalty, again and again.


Fun, fast\-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth, helping one another to succeed and celebrating wins. By truly living our values and embodying our behaviours, we’re building a customer\-first culture which enables us to stay one step ahead of the competition.

**Inclusion, Diversity \& Belonging**

No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day.

**What else are we delivering?**
--------------------------------

  

Want to know more about our JETers, culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people's stories, blogs, podcasts and more JET journeys.

Als Senior Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Developer (m/w/d) entwickelst du kundenindividuelle Lösungen mit C#/.NET sowie JavaScript/TypeScript und sorgst dafür, dass aus fachlichen Anforderungen saubere, nachhaltige technische Lösungen entstehen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Kunden und Projektteams zusammen und bringst dein Senior-Know-how aktiv in unsere Projekte und unser Team ein.

Tätigkeiten

Microsoft Dynamics 365 (CRM): Du berätst unsere Kunden bei anspruchsvollen CRM-Projekten, analysierst ihre Geschäftsprozesse und entwickelst passgenaue Lösungen auf Basis von Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Sales / Customer Service / Marketing / Field Service).
Lösungsdesign & Entwicklung: Du konzipierst und entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungen mit C#/.NET sowie JavaScript/TypeScript und legst dabei großen Wert auf sauberen Code, Qualität und Wartbarkeit.
Anforderungen technisch übersetzen: Du arbeitest eng mit Kunden und Consultants zusammen, verstehst fachliche Anforderungen und überführst sie in durchdachte technische Konzepte.
Technische Verantwortung übernehmen: Du bewertest Lösungswege, unterstützt bei der Priorisierung technischer Themen und sorgst dafür, dass Projekte strukturiert und zuverlässig umgesetzt werden.
Wissen weitergeben: Du teilst deine Erfahrung im Team, unterstützt Kolleginnen und Kollegen bei komplexen Fragestellungen und bringst dich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer technischen Standards ein.
Workshops & Kundentermine: Du bringst deine technische Expertise in Workshops, Präsentationen und Pitch-Terminen ein und hilfst so dabei, Kunden von unseren Lösungen zu überzeugen und neue Projekte zu gewinnen.

Anforderungen

Ausbildung: Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (B.Sc. / M.Sc.) mit dem Schwerpunkt (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder eine Ausbildung mit vergleichbarer Qualifikation. Wichtiger als dein schulischer Werdegang ist uns aber, dass du fachlich stark bist und Verantwortung übernehmen willst.
Erfahrung: Du hast bereits mehrere Beratungs- und Umsetzungsprojekte im CRM-/Business-Software-Umfeld erfolgreich begleitet und fühlst dich besonders in der technischen Konzeption und Umsetzung sicher. Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung mit Microsoft Dynamics 365 oder vergleichbaren Plattformen mit. Erste Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung von Teams oder Projekten ist wünschenswert; disziplinarische Führungserfahrung ist ein zusätzliches Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.
Technisches Know-how: C#/.NET sowie JavaScript/TypeScript gehören zu deinem Werkzeugkasten. Du legst Wert auf sauberen, wartbaren Code und entwickelst Lösungen mit einem hohen Anspruch an Qualität und Nachhaltigkeit.
Persönlichkeit: Du denkst strukturiert, kommunizierst offen und direkt und kannst fachliche Anforderungen in durchdachte technische Lösungen übersetzen. Die Kombination aus technischer Tiefe, Eigeninitiative und direktem Kundenkontakt passt perfekt zu dir.
Begeisterung: Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen, fachlich vorangehen und dein Wissen nicht nur in Projekte, sondern auch in die Weiterentwicklung unseres Teams einbringen.
Kommunikation: Dein Profil wird abgerundet durch sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie ein souveränes Auftreten in Workshops, Kundenterminen und Pitch-Terminen.

Team

Warum wir?

Technische Verantwortung mit echtem Einfluss: Du bringst dein Know-how aktiv in unsere Projekte und die Weiterentwicklung des Teams ein, übernimmst Verantwortung für technische Lösungen und unterstützt andere bei komplexen Fragestellungen.
Qualität statt Standardlösungen: Dich erwarten vielseitige CRM-Projekte, in denen du saubere, wartbare und nachhaltige Lösungen entwickelst – mit dem Anspruch, nicht nur funktionierenden, sondern wirklich guten Code zu schreiben.
Echte Wertschätzung: Wenn du Teil unseres Teams wirst, dann haben wir dich auserwählt. Das heißt, dass uns deine Leistungen, dein Wohlergehen sowie deine Meinung sehr viel bedeuten – und das zeigen wir auch.
Deine Weiterentwicklung ist unser Erfolg: Daher gibt es regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche, die dein Verbesserungspotenzial auslegen. Hast du Interesse an einer Weiterbildung oder einem Kurs, der dich begeistert und deine Fähigkeiten stärkt? Sprich uns gerne an – wir sind immer offen für deine Ideen!
Mitgestaltung ausdrücklich erwünscht: Deine Ideen zu Architektur, Prozessen, Teamaufbau oder Kundenprojekten sind willkommen. Wenn etwas besser geht, hören wir zu.
Perspektive über die Rolle hinaus: Wenn du neben der fachlichen Führung auch Lust auf disziplinarische Verantwortung hast, bieten wir dir auch dafür die passende Entwicklungsperspektive.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Full-Stack Applications - Ratings Technology (Manchester)
jobs.description:
As one of the world’s top three credit ratings agencies, Fitch Ratings plays a critical role in global capital markets by providing credit analysis, ratings, research, and commentary to financial market participants. For over 100 years, Fitch Ratings has been creating value for global markets through its rigorous analysis and deep expertise, which have resulted in a variety of market leading tools, methodologies, indices, research, and analytical products. Fitch Ratings is part of Fitch Group, a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries, which also includes Fitch Solutions. With dual headquarters in London and New York, Fitch Group is owned by Hearst.

Senior Software Engineer, Full-Stack Applications – Ratings Technology

Fitch Ratings is seeking a Senior Software Engineer
to join our global Ratings Technology team in Manchester
. This is your opportunity to not just build mission-critical applications, but to shape the future direction
of technology that powers how a world-leading credit ratings agency delivers insights. Your leadership, architectural decisions, and vision will directly impact analysts, executives, and decision-makers who shape global financial markets.

You'll work closely with our talented engineering teams supporting Ratings workflow and analytical applications, influencing both technical architecture and organizational direction
. We're looking for a seasoned technologist who thrives on challenging assumptions, experimenting with emerging technologies (especially AI), and pushing boundaries
—not an MLE or AI specialist, but a full-stack engineer who's curious, unafraid to question the status quo, and excited to explore how AI can transform analytical workflows, as well as delivering high quality user experiences in their applications. This is a critical role
for an organization expanding rapidly and building for the future, offering mobility and upward potential for the right visionary.

What We Offer

Strategic leadership with organizational impact – Shape technical architecture and product direction for applications used by analysts worldwide, with high visibility to senior leadership and the ability to influence technology strategy across Ratings Technology
Innovation-first culture and experimentation – Permission to challenge established patterns, explore emerging technologies including AI, and drive proof-of-concepts with access to cutting-edge tools and a community that celebrates curiosity and bold thinking
Continuous learning and career growth – Training, certifications, conferences, mentorship opportunities, and clear paths to principal/architect/leadership tracks as you establish yourself as a thought leader
Flexibility and world-class environment – Work from premier offices in London, Manchester, or Toronto with hybrid flexibility, competitive compensation reflecting your seniority, comprehensive benefits, and a culture that values both innovation and work-life harmony

We'll Count On You To

Deliver technical excellence and build game-changing solutions – Design robust, scalable full-stack applications using Java/Springboot, C#/.NET, Python and REACT, drive architectural decisions, establish technical standards, and lead exploration of AI/ML integration opportunities that transform workflows
Offer influence and mentorship – Partner with product managers, analysts, and senior stakeholders as a trusted technical advisor, mentor engineers, facilitate technical discussions, and foster a culture of experimentation, learning, and psychological safety
Challenge the status quo and drive innovation – Question existing approaches, champion better solutions even when uncomfortable, experiment with emerging technologies, create proofs-of-concept, and push the organization toward what's possible rather than what's comfortable
Champion engineering excellence and quality – Implement CI/CD pipelines, conduct architecture reviews, solve complex performance and scalability challenges, establish best practices that scale across teams, and balance innovation with pragmatic delivery
Shape organizational and team direction – Influence team processes, lead strategic technical initiatives spanning multiple teams, bring fresh perspectives while respecting institutional knowledge, and model the curiosity, humility, and boldness needed across the organization
Own reliability and navigate complexity – Provide expert troubleshooting for sophisticated issues, maintain system performance at scale, balance multiple strategic priorities, and deliver excellence in fast-paced Agile environments

What You Need To Have

Deep full-stack engineering expertise – 10+ years of hands-on experience building enterprise applications, with expert-level proficiency in Java/Springboot and/or C#/.NET, good familiarity with Python, REACT and modern web technologies in production environments.
Architectural mastery and technical depth – Proven track record of designing maintainable, scalable systems; excellent understanding of software architecture, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, and the ability to make architectural decisions and live with their consequences
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
Visionary problem-solving and growth mindset – Exceptional analytical abilities, demonstrated curiosity about emerging technologies, track record of experimentation and learning from failures, comfort with ambiguity, and ability to bring your whole self while remaining open to others' perspectives
Outstanding collaboration and communication skills – Proven success with cross-functional teams, ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences, and emotional intelligence to navigate organizational dynamics

What Would Make You Stand Out

Modern engineering practices and DevOps prowess – Experience with Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, and hands-on cloud expertise with microservices and cloud-native architecture
AI curiosity and exploration mindset – Genuine interest in how AI/ML, generative AI, or intelligent automation could transform software delivery, business processes, systems and applications; experience experimenting with new technologies and evaluating practical applications; comfort with emerging technology ambiguity
Financial services domain expertise – Experience with analytical workflows, regulatory processes, financial products, credit ratings, or understanding of how technology enables better decision-making
Agile mastery and change agent experience – Track record of establishing practices, challenging established patterns constructively, and creating space for teams to innovate and take calculated risks

If you are a seasoned technologist with a passion for innovation, a desire to shape organizational direction, and the courage to question the status quo, we would love to hear from you!

Why Choose Fitch

Hybrid Work Environment: 2 to 3 days a week in office required based on your line of business and location
A Culture of Learning & Mobility: Dedicated trainings, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity
Investing in Your Future: Retirement planning, financial wellness and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long-term goals
Promoting Health & Wellness: Comprehensive healthcare offerings that prioritize a healthy body & mind
Supportive Parenting Policies: Family-first policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively
Dedication to Giving Back: Paid volunteer days and support for community engagement initiatives

At Fitch, AI is embedded in how we work every day—supporting smarter decision-making, streamlining workflows, and enabling new ways to create value for our business and clients. Intelligent solutions are increasingly part of our day-to-day operations, helping teams work more efficiently and think differently as we continue to evolve. We’re looking for colleagues who are comfortable operating in an AI-enabled environment—or who are curious, adaptable, and eager to build their AI literacy over time. We value professionals who embrace technology as part of continuous learning and who are committed to using it thoughtfully to enhance how work gets done.

Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch’s credibility and reputation, our employees must take every precaution to avoid conflicts of interests or any appearance of a conflict of interest. Should you be successful in the recruitment process at Fitch Ratings you will be asked to declare any securities holdings and other potential conflicts prior to commencing employment. If you, or your immediate family, have any holdings that may conflict with your work responsibilities, you may be asked to divest yourself of them before beginning work.

Fitch is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, and other statuses protected by law.

jobs.title: AI Architect
jobs.description:
Deloitte is the world’s number one professional services firm and making an impact is more than what we do. It is why we are here. We bring challenge, curiosity and edge to every project, driving positive progress for our clients, our people, our communities and the planet. This purpose inspires us to work to the highest standards and to tackle the challenges that matter. Number one never stops challenging.

Joining us means becoming part of a Technology and Transformation team that brings challenge, curiosity and edge to every engagement. Working with leading technologies and exceptional people, you will deliver meaningful change for high profile local and international clients. You will help shape the future of digital transformation within a people first culture that is collaborative, innovative and welcoming. At Deloitte, the world’s number one professional services firm, you will tackle complex challenges in an environment where number one never stops challenging.

We offer a competitive starting salary of €91,500.00 for this role, with salary adjustments reflecting your experience level and expertise. .

At Deloitte, our Artificial Intelligence & Data Team drives innovation by helping clients use artificial intelligence, machine learning, and generative AI to solve complex business challenges and unlock measurable value. As an AI Architect, you will play a pivotal role in designing and delivering cutting-edge AI solutions across diverse industries, leveraging the latest technologies and our global network.

This role offers a unique opportunity to lead impactful AI-enabled transformation projects, collaborate cross-functionally, and develop your leadership skills in a dynamic, supportive environment focused on continuous learning and personal growth.

Key Skills And Prior Experience

A minimum of a third-level degree in Maths, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related discipline
Proven experience designing and delivering complex artificial intelligence, machine learning, advanced analytics, or generative AI solutions, with the ability to motivate and guide teams to achieve outstanding results
Strong stakeholder management skills, including influencing senior leaders, translating business challenges into practical AI use cases, and providing expert advice based on industry best practices
Commercial experience in AI solution architecture, with familiarity in enterprise-grade AI technologies such as Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI Service, Databricks Mosaic AI, MLflow, AWS SageMaker, Google Vertex AI, Snowflake Cortex, or equivalent platforms
Strong understanding of AI and machine learning solution patterns, including large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, intelligent assistants, chatbots, recommendation engines, agentic workflows, MLOps, and model deployment
Practical knowledge of responsible AI, including model governance, evaluation, explainability, privacy, security, bias and fairness considerations, and regulatory expectations
Working knowledge of data architecture principles, including how trusted data platforms, data products, APIs, and governance controls support successful AI delivery

What type of work will I be doing?

Scoping, designing, and leading the implementation of scalable AI, machine learning, and generative AI solutions using open source, proprietary, and cloud-native technologies
Translating business challenges into practical AI use cases, target architectures, delivery roadmaps, and measurable value cases
Designing AI solution patterns such as assistants, chatbots, retrieval-augmented generation, document intelligence, prediction services, recommendation engines, optimisation models, and agentic workflows
Developing technical specifications and architecture designs for AI applications, model pipelines, orchestration layers, knowledge bases, integration patterns, and deployment environments aligned with enterprise standards
Ensuring security, privacy, responsible AI, model governance, monitoring, and evaluation are embedded within all AI architectural designs
Leading and mentoring data scientists, AI engineers, ML engineers, software engineers, and analysts to deliver solutions aligned with target architectures
Collaborating across Deloitte's Technology and Transformation business areas to integrate AI capabilities with broader organisational goals, data platforms, cloud services, and business workflows
Managing client engagements across various industries, building trusted relationships and identifying growth opportunities
Coaching junior team members, aligning their responsibilities with their professional development objectives

Who is the Hiring Manager?

The hiring manager is an experienced leader within Deloitte's Artificial Intelligence & Data Team, known for a collaborative and inclusive leadership style.

They value open communication, professional development, and fostering a positive team culture. Their approach balances high performance expectations with empathy, encouraging innovation and continuous learning while maintaining a strong focus on delivering exceptional client outcomes.

Where is this role based?

This role is based in Dublin or Cork, with a flexible working model that includes hybrid arrangements between office and client sites.

For more information, please visit our Deloitte Works webpage.

If you meet most of the criteria above, we encourage you to apply. Deloitte is an equal opportunities employer and will ensure that any reasonable accommodations are implemented throughout the recruitment and selection process.

What We Offer

Your reward at Deloitte is competitive, purpose driven and designed to support your growth. It is more than salary. We invest in your personal and professional development, empower your work life balance and offer benefits that support you at every stage of life. These include health and wellbeing supports, pension and savings options, training and coaching and enhanced leave options .

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer
jobs.description:
**Field Service Engineer \- Telehandler \& Roto Hire Specialist \| East Midlands**

**Package:** £38,000 \+ Vehicle \+ Overtime \+ 25 Days Annual Leave \+ Extensive Benefits Package

**Location:** East Midlands \- field\-based, covering customer sites across the region

**Type:** Full\-time, permanent (40 hours per week \- Door to Door)

**The Opportunity**

Plenty of field service roles have you chasing whatever lands in the van that day \- a different make every visit, no manufacturer support, and a parts department that sees you as a nuisance. This one is different.

Our client is the specialist telehandler and roto hire division of one of the UK’s best\-known equipment rental groups. They do one thing \- telehandlers and rotating telehandlers \- and they do it properly. Their engineers are trained by the biggest manufacturers in the industry, their service vans are profiled for telehandlers and rotos only, and they fully service and maintain their own fleet on site rather than leaning on the manufacturers to do it for them.

They’re looking for a skilled Field Service Engineer to look after their machines and customers across the East Midlands. If you’re an experienced plant or agricultural fitter who wants to specialise, get manufacturer\-level training on the latest kit, and work for a business that openly says it invests heavily in its field engineers, this is well worth a conversation.

**About the Company**

Our client is a nationally recognised specialist in telehandler and roto hire, part of a listed specialist equipment rental group whose heritage goes back to 1954 and which celebrated its 70th anniversary in 2024\. The group turns over more than £350 million a year across a portfolio of specialist rental businesses serving infrastructure, construction, housebuilding, utilities and energy.

The division runs what it describes as the most diverse telehandler and roto fleet in the UK \- from compact 4m telehandlers right up to 35m rotating machines, alongside 7\.2 and 12 tonne heavy lift telehandlers, electric telehandlers and Teletruks. The fleet is built around the leading manufacturers, including JCB, Manitou and Merlo, so you’ll be working on modern, well\-maintained machines rather than tired kit that’s been run into the ground.

A depot network stretching from Aberdeen to Penzance means there’s nowhere in the UK they can’t reach, and a centralised hire and service desk handles enquiries nationwide \- giving engineers in the field real technical back\-up over the phone when they need it. Customers range from national housebuilders and main contractors to infrastructure and utilities clients, and many have been working with the business for years.

Safety is taken seriously too. The group’s approach is built around getting everyone home safe and healthy, with third\-party validation of how it manages risk, and it has had its net\-zero targets validated by the Science Based Targets initiative \- so you’ll see more electric and low\-emission machines coming through the fleet.

**The Role**

As Field Service Engineer, you’ll be the face of the business on customer sites across the East Midlands \- keeping hire machines working, getting broken\-down machines back to work quickly, and making sure customers want to hire again.

You’ll plan and manage your own workload, work closely with the service desk and wider operations team, and take ownership of the machines and customers on your patch. Expect a mix of planned servicing, breakdowns and fault\-finding across construction, housebuilding, infrastructure and utilities sites.

What you’ll be doing:

* Carrying out planned maintenance and servicing on hire telehandlers and rotos on customer sites
* Responding to breakdowns and delivering fast, effective repairs to keep customer downtime to a minimum
* Diagnosing and resolving mechanical, hydraulic and electrical faults on site
* Acting as the frontline representative for the business, building strong, lasting relationships with customers
* Working with the service desk and wider operations teams to spot and deliver improvements to the service
* Keeping accurate records of every repair, service and customer interaction
* Managing your own diary and time effectively across a busy regional patch

**About You**

* Proven experience repairing and servicing plant equipment, including telehandlers \- essential
* A recognised mechanical qualification in plant or agricultural engineering (NVQ, City \& Guilds or equivalent) \- desirable
* Experience with rotating telehandlers, heavy lift machines or electric telehandlers is a bonus, but full training is provided
* A practical problem\-solver who uses their initiative and is confident working on their own
* A good communicator with a genuine customer service mindset
* Well organised, with experience of managing your own time and workload
* Happy to travel to customer sites across the region as required
* A valid UK driving licence

**What’s On Offer**

* Competitive salary
* 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, with the option to buy additional holiday
* Salary sacrifice pension
* Life assurance at 3x salary
* Share save scheme \- a real stake in the business you help grow
* Manufacturer\-led training on the latest telehandler and roto technology, plus structured in\-house and external training
* Access to the group’s online learning Academy for ongoing development
* Free tool hire from across the group
* Health cash plan at discounted premiums, eye care vouchers and gym discounts
* 24/7 accident helpline, cycle to work scheme and long service recognition
* Employee discount platform with savings at thousands of well\-known brands, plus discounts on HP products and EE mobile contracts
* Recommend a friend scheme
* The security of a long\-established, nationally recognised group, with genuine career progression across its specialist businesses

**How to Apply**

If you’re an experienced plant or telehandler engineer looking to specialise with a business that invests in its engineers and backs them properly in the field, we’d like to hear from you. Apply through Rommbic with your CV, or get in touch with us for a confidential conversation about the role.

Pay: £35,000\.00\-£38,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Additional leave
* Company car
* Company pension
* Cycle to work scheme
* Health \& wellbeing programme

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**About the role** **Job Title**: Materials Engineer


**Location:** Aberdeen


**Project Type:** Civils / Energy


**Company:** Balfour Beatty Group



Balfour Beatty is a leading national infrastructure and construction company with more than a century of heritage in Scotland, delivering key projects that strengthen communities and improve national connectivity.



The Netherton Hub is a major new energy infrastructure development located near Peterhead in Aberdeenshire, forming a key part of SSEN Transmission’s multi‑billion‑pound **Accelerated Strategic Transmission Investment (ASTI)** programme and its wider **Pathway to 2030** upgrade of the Scottish transmission network.



Designed to strengthen the UK’s ability to transport renewable electricity from the north of Scotland to high‑demand centres nationwide, the hub will incorporate a new High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) converter station, a 400 kV substation, a 132 kV substation, and associated operational facilities. Once complete, it will enable efficient long‑distance transmission of offshore and onshore renewable energy, supporting both UK and Scottish Government net‑zero targets while delivering significant economic benefits, job creation, and local supply‑chain opportunities.



By joining the ASTI Netherton Hub project, candidates will gain hands‑on experience delivering one of the UK’s most significant energy programmes, developing advanced personal and professional skills, benefiting from long‑term career progression within a national framework, and playing a direct role in strengthening Scotland’s renewable‑powered future

 **What you'll be doing**  

The Materials Engineer will provide technical expertise and support across civil engineering projects, mainly a large earth moving project near Peterhead, ensuring compliance with specifications, standards, and regulatory requirements. This role is critical to maintaining quality assurance in materials testing and advising on material selection on the project.


* **Materials Testing \& Analysis**
* + Conduct laboratory and site\-based testing of aggregates, soils, concrete, and asphalt in accordance with UKAS and project specifications.
	+ Interpret test results and provide technical reports to project teams.
* **Compliance \& Standards**
* + Ensure adherence to Balfour Beatty’s quality management systems and relevant British Standards.
	+ Support compliance with environmental and safety regulations, including IRR17 and Dangerous Goods Safety requirements.
* **Technical Support**
* + Advise project teams on material suitability, grading, and performance.
	+ Assist in troubleshooting and assist with materials issues
* **Documentation \& Reporting**
* + Prepare accurate records of tests, calibrations, and inspections.
	+ Contribute to risk assessments and method statements for laboratory and site operations.
* **Collaboration**
* + Work closely with Senior Materials Technician, and site engineers.
	+ Participate in weekly project review meetings and provide updates on material performance.

  

**Who we're looking for**  

#### **Skills \& Qualifications**


* Experience in materials testing within a construction or infrastructure environment.
* Knowledge of UKAS accreditation processes and relevant standards.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and report\-writing abilities.
* Confident leading audits and developing staff
* Full driving licence
* Health and safety conscientious on site and the laboratory

#### **Desirable**


* Membership of a professional body (e.g., ICE).
* Familiarity with environmental authorisations and radiation safety (advantageous for certain projects).
* Ability to manage workload across multiple projects.
* SSSTS qualified.

  

**Why work for us*** Be part of a major energy infrastructure investment that’s shaping the UK’s low\-carbon future.


* Work on challenging, high\-profile projects with the support of a skilled, multi\-disciplinary team.


* Join a culture of learning, improvement, and excellence—where your voice makes a difference.


* Enjoy a competitive salary, development opportunities, and a flexible, inclusive working environment.



Professional and personal development



The size and scale of Balfour Beatty coupled with our strong pipeline of work provides incredible opportunities, regardless of what stage you are at in your career.



We encourage and empower our employees to take control of their career and explore which part of the business they want to work in and what role is right for them. We actively encourage our managers and employees to have open communication throughout the year about wellbeing, development and career opportunities.



We're proud of the Balfour Beatty Academy. Whether it’s sharpening your technical expertise, improving your personal skills or seeking support to become professionally qualified, our 70:20:10\* approach to development means we have a learning approach that suits everyone.


* 70% learning on the job, 20% learning from those around you, and 10% formal training courses and learning events.



For further information about Balfour Beatty Regional Scotland please go to www.balfourbeatty.com/careers/Scotland \- You can also check out further job opportunities in the careers section

 **About us**  

From Dunfermline’s tramways in 1909 to highland hospitals today, Balfour Beatty has been trusted for over a century to deliver the complex and critical infrastructure and iconic buildings Scotland relies on.



We have the people, knowledge and experience to safely deliver projects right first time, maximising value for money and ensuring a positive social impact and inclusive economic growth for local communities.



Our award\-winning sustainable projects, including active travel, Passivhaus and retrofit, demonstrate our commitment to supporting Scotland’s transition towards net zero in the built environment.



Diversity and inclusion



At Balfour Beatty we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential components of any successful, happy workplace. Through our Value Everyone Diversity and Inclusion Strategy and Action Plan, we are growing our diverse workforce and developing our inclusive culture where everyone is able to thrive and reach their full potential, regardless of their identity or background. To find out how we are making this a reality, visit www.balfourbeatty.com/diversityandinclusion



To help and support us with our desired commitment to create an inclusive culture we are members of WISE, enei, Business Disability Forum and the Association for Black and Minority Ethnic Engineers (AFBE). In 2020, we signed the Audeliss and Involve Open Letter to demonstrate our commitment to taking key long term and sustainable actions on Black Inclusion. Balfour Beatty is also a Gold Award holder in the Ministry of Defence 'Employer Recognition Scheme' and actively encourage applications from Armed Forces personnel, veterans and reservists.



As a Disability Confident Employer, we are committed to working with people who have disabilities and long\-term health conditions to remove barriers for them in obtaining employment. We are also committed to offering applicants with a disability an interview if they meet the minimum requirements for the role. For more info, visit: https://disabilityconfident.campaign.gov.uk/



We are looking to continually improve our resourcing process and ensure that it is fair and inclusive for all. If you have any feedback on the process, please share this with us at: candidaterecruitmentqueries@balfourbeatty.com

jobs.title: Vulnerability Management Engineer, Madrid
jobs.description:
Vulnerability Management Engineer
  
Seleccionamos un Vulnerability Management Engineer especializado en Application Security para integrarse directamente en el equipo de ciberseguridad de una compañía del sector tecnológico.
  
  

Buscamos a un profesional técnico con experiencia en la detección, priorización y mitigación de riesgos de seguridad en aplicaciones Web, Mobile y Cloud. El candidato ideal aportará una sólida base técnica en el análisis de código y la capacidad de coordinar soluciones de remediación efectivas junto a los equipos de desarrollo.
  
  

Responsabilidades principales
  
  

**Evaluación de vulnerabilidades:** Ejecutar análisis SAST, DAST y SCA, asegurando que los hallazgos reportados sean precisos, accionables y alineados con el nivel de riesgo del negocio.
  
**Triage y validación:** Descartar falsos positivos, documentar las vulnerabilidades confirmadas y realizar pruebas de re\-testing para verificar la efectividad de las soluciones aplicadas.
  
**Integración en el ciclo de vida (SDLC):** Colaborar en la automatización e integración de los escaneos de seguridad dentro de los pipelines de CI/CD.
  
**Interlocución técnica:** Traducir los hallazgos de seguridad en recomendaciones técnicas claras, facilitando los planes de remediación con los equipos de desarrollo e infraestructura.
  
**Métricas y reporte:** Mantener y evolucionar cuadros de mando para el seguimiento de métricas clave (como SLAs de remediación y MTTR).
  
  

Perfil requerido
  
  

Entre 5 y 7 años de experiencia contrastada en seguridad de aplicaciones o gestión de vulnerabilidades.
  
Comprensión profunda de las vulnerabilidades del OWASP Top 10 y principios de arquitectura segura.
  
Dominio de Burp Suite para pruebas manuales en Web y APIs (validación de lógica de negocio, autenticación y autorización).
  
Experiencia con herramientas como Fortify, Checkmarx, SonarQube, Black Duck, Tenable o Nmap.
  
Capacidad de automatización mediante lenguajes de scripting (Python, Java, .NET o similares).
  
**Valorables:** Experiencia previa con entornos Azure DevOps, ServiceNow o certificaciones del sector (OSCP, GWAPT, CISSP, etc.).
  
  

Condiciones de la oferta
  
  

Contrato indefinido directamente en plantilla de la empresa final.
  
Flexibilidad horaria orientada a la conciliación.
  
Entorno técnico dinámico con proyectos complejos de infraestructura en la nube.
  
  

If you are interested in this challenging position we are looking forward to receiving your comprehensive application for ref.no. 111\.495 preferably through our ISG career portal or via email.
  
  

SAST, DAST, SCA, OWASP

Opdrachtomschrijving

Het MCC ontwikkelt momenteel apps met MAUI technologie maar zit in transitie naar native technologie (Swift/Swift-UI en Android Kotlin/Jetpack Compose). Jij bent Senior DotNet (app) backend ontwikkelaar met kennis van mobile ontwikkelplatforms voor het ontwikkelen van backends voor mobiele oplossingen voor Apple en Android. Daarnaast zie je jezelf als een ontwikkelaar met kennis en ervaring met het ontwikkelen van API's, hoogbeschikbare en hoogperformance systemen, databases (SQL-server) en authenticatiekennis (JWT).

Samen met de rest van ons deels MAUI en deels native ontwikkelteam werk je aan het vertalen van concepten naar technisch uitvoerbare code, waarbij je de nadruk legt op prestatieoptimalisatie, de ontwikkeling van intuïtieve gebruikersinterfaces en een naadloze integratie van services. Kwaliteitsborging staat centraal in je werk; je voert uitgebreide tests uit om de stabiliteit, betrouwbaarheid en veiligheid van de apps te waarborgen.

Achtergrond Opdracht

Het Mobile Competence Center Belastingdienst ontwikkelt mobiele oplossingen op basis van het ontwikkelplatformen (development Apple (Swift) en Android (Kotlin) mobiele apps i.c.m. .Net back-ends voor Burgers Bedrijven (extern) en voor medewerkers (intern), daarnaast ontwikkelen wij ook Apps voor de Rijksdienst (ministeries) voor de mobiel platformen iOS en Android. Daar horen grote, kleine en creatieve opdrachten bij. We verwachten van de kandidaten dat zij enthousiast en energiek te werk gaan in dit innovatieve traject en ook open staan om persoonlijk te investeren.Daarnaast verwachten wij een ‘Agile Scrum DNA’ met drive voor constant veranderen en innoveren passend in de dynamische cultuur van het Mobile Competence Center.

De Belastingdienst draagt bij aan een financieel gezond Nederland. Dat doen we door eerlijk en zorgvuldig belasting te heffen en te innen. Met deze missie zorgen we ervoor dat er in Nederland geld is voor onder meer zorg, onderwijs en openbaar vervoer. Onze visie helpt ons om onze taken uit te voeren in een steeds veranderende samenleving. De IV- organisatie van de Belastingdienst is verantwoordelijk voor en verzorgt de ICT-voorzieningen. Dit gebeurt deels door gebruik te maken van de expertise die intern aanwezig is, maar ook door het aantrekken van (kant-en-klaar) oplossingen en expertise uit de markt.

jobs.description:
Be visionary

Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.

We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

Job Description

Senior Software Engineer - Flight Data Analysis Software

Uxbridge, West London, 4 days onsite, 1 day from home

Every commercial flight records thousands of parameters — control inputs, engine performance, altitude, warnings. When the aircraft lands, that data has to be retrieved, decoded and turned into something an airline's safety team can act on. We build the software that does it. Over 300 airlines use our ground systems, including most of the world's major carriers, alongside military operators. When an airline spots an unstable approach trend before it becomes an incident, our software is usually how they found it.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the team in Uxbridge that builds it.

What you'll actually do

You'll Own Features End To End — From Design Discussion Through To Release — Across a Stack That Spans a Mature .NET Backend, Angular Front Ends, And Python Tooling. Specifically

Design and build backend services and APIs that process large volumes of flight data, where performance and correctness genuinely matter
Take technical ownership of a product area: make the architectural calls, and be the person the team asks about it
Review other engineers' code and mentor two or three developers earlier in their careers
Work with QA, product and the engineering lead across a normal Agile cycle — planning, standups, reviews, retros
Help us modernise: we have a long-lived .NET codebase with some older Windows service components, and part of this role is bringing it forward sensibly rather than rewriting for its own sake

What we need

Around 4+ years building production software commercially
Strong C#/.NET and solid relational database skills (we use MySQL)
Comfortable working across the stack — you don't have to be a front-end specialist, but you should be able to work in TypeScript/Angular when a feature needs it
Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs
Genuinely good at debugging: the ability to work out why a system is misbehaving from incomplete information
Git and modern version control workflows

Useful, but we'll teach you

Python
AWS (EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS)
Docker and CI/CD pipelines
Automated testing frameworks
Aviation or aerospace domain knowledge — almost nobody arrives with this, and we don't expect you to

You do not need to tick every box. If you're strong on the backend and curious about the rest, apply.

What we offer

As part of the wider Teledyne UK group, we offer our employees a range of company benefits that include:

Salary sacrifice-led pension plan that matches employee contributions up to 7%.
Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
Free life assurance cover at the value of four times basic annual salary.
⁠Salary sacrifice Electric & Hybrid Vehicle car scheme
25 days holiday per annum, plus bank holidays.
Holiday purchase scheme which enables employees to purchase an additional 5 days worth of annual leave each year.
Company funded medical cash plan (MediCash) which allows eligible members to offset the cost of routine medical treatments.
Internal reward and recognition scheme linked to internal benefits platform.
Employee Assistance Programme.
Comprehensive wellbeing programme that supports employees with their physical, mental and financial health, as well as their cultural/environmental wellbeing.
Competitive employee discounts platform that provides employees with discounts with leading brands/retailers.
Cycle to Work scheme.
Enhanced family-friendly benefits and policies.
Company sick pay.
Free Onsite parking
Career development across the wider Teledyne group — a lot of our engineers have moved between teams, sites and disciplines
Software that matters: what you ship affects how safely aircraft are operated

The commute, honestly

We're onsite four days a week with one day from home. We know that rules us out for some people. But if you live anywhere in West London, Hillingdon, Buckinghamshire or along the M4/M40, this is likely the shortest commute you'll find for a role at this level — Uxbridge is the end of the Metropolitan and Piccadilly lines, and there's parking. Several of our team took this job specifically to stop commuting into central London.

Interview process

A Teams call with the hiring manager and site manager — informal, both ways
An onsite session covering technical discussion and a paired programming task, plus competency-based questions with our Head of Digital Solutions
Offer

About Teledyne Controls

Since 1964 we've designed and manufactured aircraft data recording and management systems, working directly with airlines and with OEMs including Airbus and Boeing. Teledyne Controls Flight Data Company in Uxbridge is our principal UK office, where we develop the ground-based software used to replay and analyse recorded flight data.

Teledyne and all of our employees are committed to conducting business with the highest ethical standards. We require all employees to comply with all applicable laws, regulations, rules and regulatory orders. Our reputation for honesty, integrity and high ethics is as important to us as our reputation for making innovative sensing solutions.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer — AI & Workflow Automation
jobs.description:
Nion is an IT consultancy with offices in Stockholm, Malmö, Gothenburg, Skopje, Bitola and Sofia, where 200+ IT specialists work together to deliver tailored digital solutions. Our clients operate in industries such as telecom, fintech and insurance, and we help organisations simplify complex challenges and create real business value.

We're now expanding our AI & Workflow Automation practice and are looking for an experienced Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
for our Stockholm office.

A Forward Deployed Engineer works inside the client organisation — not at arm's length. You sit with their teams, learn how the business actually runs, and turn AI from a proof-of-concept into a trusted, working part of daily operations. This is the role at the centre of AI and workflow automation at Nion: the person who takes an ambition to "use AI" and produces something that delivers measurable value.

The hardest part of AI isn't the demo — it's the gap between a clever prototype and a secure process people actually use every day. Closing that gap is what this role is about.

What You'll Do

Every Nion FDE brings four core skills, and you'll work across all of them:

Analysis — finding where AI and automation genuinely create value, and where they don't.
Process definition — designing the new, AI-first way of working before any tool is deployed.
Implementation — building, integrating and hardening agents, models and automations into the client's live environment.
Adoption — making it stick through enablement, change and handover, so the value outlasts the engagement.

You'll own outcomes end-to-end: discovery and workflow mapping, solution design, hands-on implementation with AI tooling, and the change work that gets people using it. Throughout, you account for business value, AI sovereignty, AI spend, governance and compliance — GDPR and the EU AI Act built in, not bolted on.

Your profile

Minimum 5 years in a delivery, consulting or solutions role where you've taken automation or AI solutions from discovery to production in real business environments
Strong process analysis and design skills — mapping workflows, quantifying value, and redesigning how work gets done
Hands-on experience implementing LLM-based and agentic solutions (prompt engineering, RAG patterns, multi-step/agent workflows, tool use)
Practical command of modern AI tooling and automation platforms (examples below)
Comfortable integrating AI into business systems via APIs and connectors
Experience driving adoption — enablement, stakeholder management, training and handover
Solid understanding of data protection, security and AI governance (GDPR, EU AI Act)
Confident working embedded in client teams and translating between business and technical stakeholders
Fluent in Swedish and English, written and spoken

This is not
a deep software-engineering role. We're looking for someone who builds working solutions with AI tooling and integration — not someone writing large custom codebases from scratch. Comfort with light scripting (e.g. Python) to glue things together is expected, but the emphasis is on process, tooling and implementation.

Tools you'll work with

LLM platforms: Anthropic Claude, OpenAI / Azure OpenAI, Watson.X
Agent & orchestration frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen or similar
Workflow & automation platforms: n8n, Make, Power Automate, Zapier, or comparable iPaaS / low-code tools
RAG & retrieval: vector databases and embedding models (working knowledge)
Integration: REST APIs, webhooks, connectors to business systems
Supporting: Python for scripting/glue, Git, basic containerisation (Docker)

Meritorious

Anthropic Claude certification or equivalent AI platform credentials
Prior consulting or client-facing delivery experience
Domain experience in telecom, fintech or insurance
Experience with LLM evaluation, testing and guardrails
Familiarity with agile ways of working

We're looking for someone who is

Professional and committed to delivering solutions that meet real business needs
Accountable and self-driven — you take ownership of the big things and the small things
Communicative and a team player who's comfortable embedded with clients
Flexible and open to some travel in connection with client projects

With us you get

A collaborative, flat organisation where support is a given. Your consultant manager acts as a mentor to ensure your professional development and wellbeing.
A clear career path and continuous learning through projects, mentorship and skills development.
A vibrant company culture with strong team spirit, knowledge sharing and social activities that make work fun.

Company laptop, phone and subscription

jobs.title: Principal Data Architect
jobs.description:
emagine is looking for: Principal Data Architect – Group Information Model and Data Architecture

emagine is looking for a Principal Data Architect for our client in the financial and information services sector. The client operates across four Nordic markets and is at the start of a multi-year transformation. Data from Oracle, Db2 and mainframe environments will be consolidated into a governed operational data platform on AWS, while existing systems continue to support the business.

This is the most senior architectural role in the programme. You will own the Group information model, domain model and data architecture. The core challenge is to distinguish genuine business differences between markets from historical inconsistencies, and to build a common model that endures regardless of technology choices. The programme is deliberately small: existing staff supported by a handful of senior specialists.

Responsibilities

Define the Group information model: common business concepts, entities and relationships, and where local variation is required.
Own the domain model, including bounded contexts, context maps, shared language and service boundaries based on DDD. The model is implemented through versioned data contracts, semantic models and domain services.
Introduce anti-corruption layers between new domain contracts and legacy systems of record.
Define how the model, governance and data contracts are implemented on the operational data platform, and contribute to platform decisions.
Design the migration architecture, covering patterns, reconciliation, dependency sequencing and acceptance criteria for a gradual transition without a big-bang cutover.
Design data governance: classification, lineage, information ownership, retention, access control and country-specific regulatory requirements.
Set architecture principles, standards and review processes, and support delivery teams.

Requirements

Principal-level experience in data architecture, information architecture or enterprise architecture within a regulated business.
Experience establishing common information models across multiple markets, business lines or organisations.
Practical experience with domain-driven design (bounded contexts, context maps, domain ownership).
Experience designing and governing large-scale analytical or operational data platforms, such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric or equivalent.
Experience with data migration or CDC from operational systems such as Oracle, Db2 or PostgreSQL.
Experience treating schemas, data contracts and semantic models as versioned engineering artefacts.
Solid understanding of GDPR, DORA and related governance requirements.
Strong ability to build consensus across business and technology teams.
Fluent written and spoken English.

Nice to have

Experience from Nordic financial services, information services or other regulated data businesses.
Domain knowledge in credit, risk, lending or decisioning.
Modernisation of mainframe, Db2 or Oracle environments.
ML/AI governance, feature stores or model lineage.
Evaluation of public-cloud, sovereign-cloud or hybrid deployment models.
Swedish

Technology landscape

AWS, Amazon S3, CDC from Oracle/Db2/PostgreSQL, SQL, Python, Java/Spring Boot, rules-engine based decisioning, and tooling for metadata, lineage and information governance.

Een trekkende rol opnemen binnen de agile werking en ontwikkelaars begeleiden waar nodig

SERVICENOW ARCHITECT

Madrid, España - Hibrido
5+ años de experiencia
Inglés avanzado

Funciones y responsabilidades

Diseñar, desarrollar y configurar soluciones en las áreas de ventas y gestión de pedidos, CSM y CPQ, incluyendo el catálogo de productos, la elaboración de cotizaciones, la lógica de precios y la coordinación de pedidos.
Crear y ampliar la capacidad de CPQ en la pila impulsada por Logik.ai: reglas de configuración, lógica de precios, manejo de transacciones e integración con el ciclo de vida de los pedidos de ServiceNow en general.
Desarrollar capacidades basadas en IA utilizando Now Assist y AI Agent Studio: diseñar agentes de IA, habilidades y indicaciones para apoyar la cotización, el descubrimiento de productos y los flujos de trabajo de ventas.
Crear integraciones entre CPQ/SOM y sistemas externos (CRM, ERP, facturación) utilizando API REST, IntegrationHub y spokes personalizados.
Desarrollar aplicaciones específicas, reglas de negocio, inclusiones de scripts, flujos y la interfaz de usuario (UI Builder / Now Experience) con los más altos estándares técnicos.
Traducir los requisitos comerciales —estructuras de productos, precios, descuentos, aprobaciones— en una lógica de plataforma fácil de mantener.
Orientar y revisar el trabajo de los desarrolladores de nivel medio y junior; actuar como punto de referencia técnico para las decisiones de desarrollo relacionadas con CPQ e IA.
Contribuir al crecimiento de las capacidades de CPQ e IA de la práctica: activos reutilizables, estándares e intercambio interno de conocimientos.

.

Experiencia demostrable en la implementación de ServiceNow CRM
y flujos de trabajo de la industria: ventas y gestión de pedidos, CSM, catálogo de productos o gestión de pedidos.
Experiencia práctica en el desarrollo de capacidades de IA
en la plataforma Now:
Now Assist, AI Agent Studio, agentes de IA o agente virtual/inteligencia predictiva a nivel de desarrollo (no de demostración).

desarrollo de aplicaciones con alcance definido.

Now Assist / AI Agent Studio
: configuración de agentes de IA y habilidades, diseño de prompts, entrenamiento de la IA con datos de la plataforma.

to join projects focused on the development, evolution and transformation of solutions on the ServiceNow platform
, with a particular focus on Sales and Order Management (SOM), Customer Service Management (CSM) and CPQ
.

.

Minimum 5 years of experience working with ServiceNow.

Hands-on experience developing AI capabilities on the Now Platform, using technologies such as Now Assist, AI Agent Studio, AI Agents, Virtual Agent or Predictive Intelligence.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Be visionary**


Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.


We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

  



**Job Description**

  



Senior Software Engineer \- Flight Data Analysis Software


Uxbridge, West London, 4 days onsite, 1 day from home

  

Every commercial flight records thousands of parameters — control inputs, engine performance, altitude, warnings. When the aircraft lands, that data has to be retrieved, decoded and turned into something an airline's safety team can act on. We build the software that does it. Over 300 airlines use our ground systems, including most of the world's major carriers, alongside military operators. When an airline spots an unstable approach trend before it becomes an incident, our software is usually how they found it.

  

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the team in Uxbridge that builds it.

  

What you'll actually do


You'll own features end to end — from design discussion through to release — across a stack that spans a mature .NET backend, Angular front ends, and Python tooling. Specifically:

* Design and build backend services and APIs that process large volumes of flight data, where performance and correctness genuinely matter
* Take technical ownership of a product area: make the architectural calls, and be the person the team asks about it
* Review other engineers' code and mentor two or three developers earlier in their careers
* Work with QA, product and the engineering lead across a normal Agile cycle — planning, standups, reviews, retros
* Help us modernise: we have a long\-lived .NET codebase with some older Windows service components, and part of this role is bringing it forward sensibly rather than rewriting for its own sake


What we need

* Around 4\+ years building production software commercially
* Strong C\#/.NET and solid relational database skills (we use MySQL)
* Comfortable working across the stack — you don't have to be a front\-end specialist, but you should be able to work in TypeScript/Angular when a feature needs it
* Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs
* Genuinely good at debugging: the ability to work out why a system is misbehaving from incomplete information
* Git and modern version control workflows


Useful, but we'll teach you

* Python
* AWS (EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS)
* Docker and CI/CD pipelines
* Automated testing frameworks
* Aviation or aerospace domain knowledge — almost nobody arrives with this, and we don't expect you to

  

You do not need to tick every box. If you're strong on the backend and curious about the rest, apply.

  

What we offer

*As part of the wider Teledyne UK group, we offer our employees a range of company benefits that include:*

* + Salary sacrifice\-led pension plan that matches employee contributions up to 7%.
	+ Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
	+ Free life assurance cover at the value of four times basic annual salary.
	+ ⁠Salary sacrifice Electric \& Hybrid Vehicle car scheme
	+ 25 days holiday per annum, plus bank holidays.
	+ Holiday purchase scheme which enables employees to purchase an additional 5 days worth of annual leave each year.
	+ Company funded medical cash plan (MediCash) which allows eligible members to offset the cost of routine medical treatments.
	+ Internal reward and recognition scheme linked to internal benefits platform.
	+ Employee Assistance Programme.
	+ Comprehensive wellbeing programme that supports employees with their physical, mental and financial health, as well as their cultural/environmental wellbeing.
	+ Competitive employee discounts platform that provides employees with discounts with leading brands/retailers.
	+ Cycle to Work scheme.
	+ Enhanced family\-friendly benefits and policies.
	+ Company sick pay.
	+ Free Onsite parking
	+ Career development across the wider Teledyne group — a lot of our engineers have moved between teams, sites and disciplines
	+ Software that matters: what you ship affects how safely aircraft are operated

  

The commute, honestly


We're onsite four days a week with one day from home. We know that rules us out for some people. But if you live anywhere in West London, Hillingdon, Buckinghamshire or along the M4/M40, this is likely the shortest commute you'll find for a role at this level — Uxbridge is the end of the Metropolitan and Piccadilly lines, and there's parking. Several of our team took this job specifically to stop commuting into central London.

  

Interview process

* A Teams call with the hiring manager and site manager — informal, both ways
* An onsite session covering technical discussion and a paired programming task, plus competency\-based questions with our Head of Digital Solutions
* Offer

  

About Teledyne Controls


Since 1964 we've designed and manufactured aircraft data recording and management systems, working directly with airlines and with OEMs including Airbus and Boeing. Teledyne Controls Flight Data Company in Uxbridge is our principal UK office, where we develop the ground\-based software used to replay and analyse recorded flight data.

  



Teledyne and all of our employees are committed to conducting business with the highest ethical standards. We require all employees to comply with all applicable laws, regulations, rules and regulatory orders. Our reputation for honesty, integrity and high ethics is as important to us as our reputation for making innovative sensing solutions.
