jobs.description:
The Institute

Technology Innovation Institute (TII) a publicly funded research institute based in Abu Dhabi, the United Arab Emirates. It is home to a diverse community of leading scientists, engineers, mathematicians, and researchers from across the globe, transforming problems and roadblocks into pioneering research and technology prototypes that help move society ahead.

Propulsion and Space Research Centre

The digital engineering team within TII’s Propulsion & Space Research Centre develops software and engineering capabilities supporting propulsion and flight-vehicle research programmes.
Current capabilities include an operational engineering platform supporting requirements and system models, test campaigns and results, risk and evidence registers, and interactive 3D visualization; validated physics and gas-turbine simulation software; an AI engineering assistant grounded in live platform data and operating on local infrastructure; and a growing hardware capability spanning data acquisition, engine telemetry and hardware-in-the-loop testing.
The platform is already operational within an existing deployment. The team’s next phase is focused on establishing product-line standards, enabling versioned components, repeatable releases, multiple deployments and reliable engineering evidence outputs, with the longer-term ambition of developing a commercial-grade offering.
The team operates with direct communication, short decision paths and high individual ownership. Software is developed against real engineering models, test-bench hardware and campaign data, with physics models serving as the technical source of truth.

Role Purpose

The Senior Software Engineer – Simulation & Engineering Products will play a key role in developing and productizing the software backbone supporting propulsion and flight-vehicle research programmes within TII’s Propulsion & Space Research Centre.
The role sits within a small digital engineering team responsible for an operational engineering platform, physics-based simulation software, AI-enabled engineering tools, and an expanding hardware and test integration capability.
The successful candidate will be responsible for evolving these capabilities from programme-specific solutions into robust, maintainable and reusable software products built to product-line and commercial-grade standards. This includes establishing repeatable releases, versioned components, reliable deployment processes, stable APIs, test-evidence pipelines, and software that can support multiple programmes and future external applications.

Key Responsibilities
Software Product Engineering

Evolve the existing engineering platform from a single-deployment system into a configurable, maintainable and reusable product capable of supporting multiple programmes and, in the future, external customers.
Develop and enhance backend and frontend capabilities using technologies including Python/FastAPI and React
.
Support platform capabilities covering requirements and system models, including SysML v2
, test campaigns and results, risk and evidence registers, and interactive 3D visualization.
Improve overall product quality, including frontend experience, documentation, installation, upgrades, maintainability and security hardening.
Apply a strong product mindset to software architecture and development, considering users, roadmaps, maintainability and total cost of ownership.

CI/CD & Release Engineering

Own and enhance CI/CD and release-engineering practices across the product.
Develop automated build, test and deployment pipelines and comprehensive regression suites.
Establish reliable versioning and release-management practices.
Implement containerized deployments suitable for standard, offline and restricted-network environments.
Develop deployment documentation, operational runbooks and repeatable installation and upgrade processes.
Ensure releases are reliable, controlled and reproducible across deployments.

Numerical & Simulation Software

Support the engineering of physics-based software used as the technical source of truth, including:
Validated gas-turbine performance solvers.
Engine model adaptation using test data.
Compiled real-time engine models.
Extract existing model-adaptation and model-test correlation capabilities into independently versioned libraries with stable APIs.
Enable numerical libraries to be consumed through the platform backend, command-line interfaces and future engineering tools.
Apply appropriate software-engineering practices around scientific and numerical code, including tolerance-based testing, units management and floating-point considerations.
Work closely with physics and model-development specialists to ensure numerical models are integrated and used appropriately.

Test Data & Engineering Evidence

Design and develop pipelines for ingesting engineering and test data using formats including TDMS and HDF5
.
Implement physics-based consistency and validation checks.
Develop traceable and reviewable engineering evidence outputs and reports.
Ensure test results and supporting evidence can be reliably linked to engineering models, requirements and programme activities.

Hardware & Real-Time Integration

Support software integration at the hardware boundary, including data acquisition systems, engine telemetry and real-time targets.
Contribute to the development and integration of a real-time hardware-in-the-loop (HIL)
test capability.
Support high-rate data logging, time synchronization and reliable data transfer between acquisition systems, real-time systems and the engineering platform.

Engineering Quality & Collaboration

Act as a senior technical reviewer for software, architecture and engineering designs.
Conduct high-quality code reviews, identifying defects, maintainability concerns and opportunities for improvement.
Work closely with the platform’s Lead Engineer and other technical specialists within a small, highly autonomous engineering team.
Contribute to establishing and maintaining software-engineering standards across the team.
Use AI-assisted development tools where appropriate while maintaining robust human review, testing and evaluation controls.

Research & Publication

Contribute to research and technical publications where the work presents publishable outcomes.
Potential research areas include test-driven model adaptation, evaluation of grounded AI engineering assistants, and test-data engineering.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering
, or a related technical discipline.
Advanced academic qualifications in a relevant engineering or scientific discipline would be advantageous.

Experience

Minimum 7 years of experience building and shipping production-grade software
.
Demonstrated experience working with numerical, scientific, simulation or engineering software in domains such as aerospace, energy, automotive, scientific computing or quantitative finance.
Proven experience owning software through the full development lifecycle, including deployment, operation, maintenance and support.
Demonstrated experience shipping a software product, application, library or engineering tool through controlled and versioned releases.
Experience making and managing API decisions, breaking changes, upgrade paths, bug fixes and ongoing product maintenance.
Strong experience with CI/CD, DevOps, containerization, environment management, configuration management and release engineering.

Technical Competencies

Strong proficiency in Python
.
Strong full-stack software-development capability.
Experience developing backend services using FastAPI, Django, Node.js, .NET
, or comparable technologies.
Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React or Angular
.
Strong understanding of API design and user experience.
Comfortable working alongside C/C++
codebases.

code where required.
Strong knowledge of Git
and modern source-control practices.
Practical experience with Linux, containers and software deployment infrastructure
.
Understanding of numerical software considerations including:
Tolerance-based testing.
Units and dimensional consistency.
Floating-point behaviour and associated pitfalls.
Appropriate integration and validation of physics-based models.
Strong software architecture, debugging, testing and code-review capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications & Experience

Build robust software solutions. Join our innovation team developing and implementing technical solutions that solve real business challenges. Design, build, and scale software that directly impacts how our organization works. At Deloitte.

Benefits

An opportunity to benefit from tax-efficient facilities such as company fitness, a bicycle scheme or the opportunity to lease a bicycle.
The opportunity to use 55 hours of babysitting service per calendar year if your child is 12 years old or younger.
A flexible budget, which you can use to make choices in flexible benefits, for example purchasing extra leave days or financing a bicycle plan.
Various leave options tailored to meet your individual needs, from parental leave (also for rainbow families) to the flexibility of exchanging three national holidays for non-national holidays.

Be the true you

We have a dynamic way of working, which means not all our solutions work with the same stack. One day you’re building the newest prototype we’d like to develop for our Audit department, the next day one of our battle-tested solutions requires its monthly software update. Your mental context window allows you to do both in the same week, in addition to this expectation, we are looking for someone that identifies with the following profile:

Has a few years of experience with developing production-grade software using C#, Java, Python or TypeScript and is well-versed in architectures that are usually occurring in those languages.
Previously has worked with technology that enables those products, think of AWS, GCP or Azure
Experience packaging and running applications in containers, using Docker and an orchestrator such as Kubernetes.
Have collaborated with other developers via Git, using a platform like GitHub or Azure DevOps
Able to communicate about their work, both the outcome and process, estimations and possible issues

What impact will you make?

Team Tomorrow is a team of ~90 employees with a very wide array of skills. We’re innovating how Deloitte works by optimizing internal processes, implementing novel technical solutions, and generally elevating how our colleague’s work. As a Software Engineer, you’re part of our group of Builders. We are responsible for delivering technical solutions, developing rapid prototype(s) and serving as experts for our colleagues that are not involved in the technical part of these solutions.

How do you do this?

As a Software Engineer, you will be actively involved in the development of our solutions in collaboration with designers, product owners and other engineers, as well as stakeholders in the business. You have a curious mind, in the age of AI simply writing code doesn’t just do it for you. You want to understand how and why code works and why some solutions are used within a specific context. You have an eye for detail and take a proactive approach when creating new features and/or solutions. Your expertise is valued within all steps of the process from idea to product.

In addition to creating, you also value growth and learning for yourself and your colleagues. We invite you to learn from us and have us learn things from you. This can be about a niche subject you’re captivated by or the newest version of a front-end framework.

Beyond that, we value ownership and eminence. We don’t expect you to understand and/or master everything when you join, but we expect you to continuously learn and grow in this matter. Your basics are strong and from there, you’re open to exploring more advanced and complex patterns. AI serves as your accelerator, not as your substitution. Among all the points mentioned above, we have some indicators whether you could be suited for this role:

You have a foundational knowledge of a language like C#, Java, Python or similar and have worked with this in a production environment for a few years.
In addition, you’ve embedded frameworks or plugins using package managers and are familiar with the ecosystems that surround the mentioned languages above.
Collaboration is key, which means that you are suited to work with Git and can share your work on GitHub or a similar environment. This also means you’re able to explain your code in writing and speech.
You are a curious, creative, and social person. We don’t expect you to immediately stand in front of all of us to present, but you are communicative by nature, are okay to challenge people on their ideas and not afraid to receive constructive feedback.
Our core business is innovation, so keeping up with trends and/or taking an active role in learning new things is expected.

Greetings

We are Hiring Principal AI-Native Systems Engineer Position in London, UK

Principal AI-Native Systems Engineer
Telecom
London
6 Months duration

3 days

The Principal AI-Native Systems Engineer is a senior technical leadership role within DD Ops, accountable for designing and engineering complex cloud-native, data-intensive and AI-enabled systems that support network operations outcomes across RAN, Core, data and automation domains.

This role matters because Telco is moving from large, coordination-heavy delivery models towards small expert engineering pods that use AI agents as force multipliers. The Principal AI-Native Systems Engineer owns the system engineering discipline, translates business problems into robust technical designs, and ensures that AI-assisted delivery remains governed, secure, testable and outcome-focused.

Own system architecture
: You will define the end-to-end architecture for AI-native, cloud-native and data-intensive systems, including system boundaries, interfaces, data contracts, resilience patterns and operational controls.

Lead specification-first engineering

Set engineering standards

Design distributed systems
: You will design scalable, secure and resilient systems across cloud platforms, APIs, event-driven architectures, data pipelines and observability patterns.

Assure quality and production readiness
: You will partner with AI-Native Test Engineers to ensure generated and human-authored outputs meet functional, security, performance, resilience and operational acceptance criteria.

Influence and communicate
: You will translate complex technical concepts into clear language for senior stakeholders, engineers and business users.

Coach and develop capability
: You will coach engineers in systems thinking, AI-native engineering practices, software fundamentals and accountable technical decision-making.

jobs.description:
Backendutvecklare – dags att göra avtryck i höst!

När löven skiftar färg och luften blir krispigare, är det ett perfekt tillfälle att blicka framåt – mot ny teknik, spännande utmaningar och nästa steg i karriären. På HiQ vill vi gärna komma i kontakt med erfarna backendutvecklare som är nyfikna på framtida möjligheter i rollen som konsult tillsammans med oss. 🍂

Vi är övertygade om att teknik ska vara rolig, enkel och mänsklig. På HiQ kombinerar vi spetskompetens inom IT med en kultur där det finns plats för nyfikenhet, samarbete och lekfullhet. Här får du bidra med din expertis och utvecklas tillsammans med kollegor som brinner för att skapa verkligt värde med hjälp av modern teknik och robusta backendlösningar.

Så här kan du bidra

Beroende på din profil och kommande uppdrag kan du få arbeta med att skapa och förvalta robusta, skalbara och säkra backendlösningar inom olika branscher – från fordon och medtech till offentlig sektor och finans. Det kan exempelvis handla om att bygga helt nya plattformar från grunden eller att vidareutveckla och optimera befintliga system. Du arbetar nära kollegor inom bland annat arkitektur, frontend, test och UX för att skapa välfungerande helhetslösningar. Du får även möjlighet att utforska olika branscher och tekniker, delta i tekniska diskussioner samt dela med dig av din kunskap och inspirera andra.

Vi letar efter dig som…

Har minst 7 års relevant erfarenhet inom backendutveckling.
Har erfarenhet av C# och ramverk eller tekniker som .NET, ASP .NET eller .NET Core.
Har erfarenhet av C++ och Linux.
Har erfarenhet av Python eller Golang samt ramverk som Django eller Flask.
Har erfarenhet av molnplattformar som Azure, AWS eller GCP.
Har relevant akademisk utbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet.
Behärskar svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.

Vi ser positivt på erfarenhet av att utveckla skalbara, säkra och hållbara system, liksom kunskap inom arkitektur, testning och moderna utvecklingsmetoder. Som person är du nyfiken, lösningsorienterad, flexibel och kommunikativ. Du uppskattar gemenskapen i ett team, men kan också ta egna initiativ och driva ditt arbete framåt.

Varför HiQ?

Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med varierande uppdrag hos några av regionens mest intressanta kunder. Vi satsar på kompetensutveckling genom utbildningar, certifieringar och intern kunskapsdelning – och erbjuder en kultur där vi stöttar varandra, firar framgångar och har riktigt roligt längs vägen. Tillsammans bygger vi det bolag vi själva vill arbeta på! 🥳

Nyfiken på framtida möjligheter?

I Syd har vi kontor i Malmö, Helsingborg och Karlskrona. Vi vill gärna komma i kontakt med dig som är nyfiken på HiQ och öppen för nya utmaningar. Genom att lära känna dig, din kompetens och dina drivkrafter kan vi tillsammans hitta ett sammanhang där du kan utvecklas och göra skillnad.

👉 Skicka in din ansökan och berätta mer om dig själv. När din kompetens möter rätt uppdrag kan det bli starten på något riktigt bra!

Sist men inte minst!

Vi välkomnar ansökningar från alla – oavsett ålder, könsidentitet eller uttryck, livserfarenhet och bakgrund. Vi tror att mångfald skapar nytänkande och bidrar med fler perspektiv. Hoppas vi hörs i höst!

Location: Oslo, Norway

About The Role

As a Senior Azure Agentic AI Architect, you will make an impact by designing and delivering cutting-edge, enterprise-grade Agentic AI solutions that push the boundaries of what's possible with Microsoft Azure. You will be a valued member of our AI & Emerging Technology practice, working collaboratively with cross-functional engineering teams, enterprise clients, and senior business stakeholders to transform bold AI ambitions into production-grade reality.

This is not a role for those who want to follow the playbook — it's a role for those who want to write it. If you thrive at the intersection of deep technical mastery and strategic innovation, and you're passionate about shaping the next generation of intelligent systems, we want to hear from you.

In This Role, You Will

Architect and implement enterprise-grade Agentic AI solutions on Microsoft Azure — leveraging Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, and Azure Machine Learning — with well-defined data flows, component architecture, and resource optimization that scale to meet real-world enterprise demands.
Engineer advanced LLM-powered applications and RAG pipelines using Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Search, building retrieval-augmented generation systems that are efficient, grounded, and production-ready.
Design and deploy sophisticated multi-agent systems using Azure ecosystem tools such as Semantic Kernel and custom orchestration layers — enabling collaborative, goal-driven agent workflows across complex enterprise use cases.
Drive responsible AI governance and compliance by embedding Azure-native governance frameworks, Responsible AI principles, monitoring pipelines, model evaluation strategies, and security controls into every solution you deliver.
Lead stakeholder engagement and solution design sessions — translating complex AI architectures into clear, compelling narratives for business and technical audiences alike — and championing enterprise transformation through innovative AI strategy.

Work Model

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured — we will always be clear about role expectations.

What You Need To Have To Be Considered

Proven expertise in Microsoft Azure AI services — including hands-on experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, and Azure Machine Learning — and a strong portfolio of AI solutions delivered end-to-end, from prototyping through to production.
Deep knowledge of LLM engineering and RAG architectures, including the design and optimization of Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines integrated with Azure AI Search and other Azure-native data services.

Hands-on experience with multi-agent orchestration frameworks such as Semantic Kernel and/or LangChain (Azure-integrated), including the design of collaborative, goal-driven agent workflows.
Advanced prompt engineering skills and expertise in grounding techniques, model performance tuning, and response quality optimization for enterprise-scale AI applications.

These Will Help You Stand Out

Experience with Azure data platforms such as Azure Databricks and Azure Synapse, including the design of vector store integrations and scalable embedding and retrieval mechanisms using Azure AI Search vector capabilities.
A strong grasp of Responsible AI principles and practical experience implementing compliance controls, risk mitigation frameworks, and model governance in regulated enterprise environments.
Demonstrated ability to lead architecture discussions at the executive level — influencing technical strategy and helping clients navigate the complexities of enterprise AI transformation.
Familiarity with the latest developments in Agentic AI research, including autonomous planning patterns, tool-use frameworks, and emerging orchestration paradigms.

jobs.title: Chief Architect - TradeNet
jobs.description:
GovTech is the lead agency driving Singapore’s Smart Nation initiatives and public sector digital transformation. As the Centre of Excellence for Infocomm Technology and Smart Systems (ICT & SS), GovTech develops the Singapore Government’s capabilities in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, Application Development, Smart City Technology, Digital Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity.

At GovTech, we offer you a purposeful career to make lives better where we empower our people to master their craft through robust learning and development opportunities all year round.

Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today!

Learn more about GovTech at tech.gov.sg.

How we build

TradeNet is Singapore's National Single Window for trade permit processing. It handles over 9 million permit applications annually and accounts for around 10% of national tax revenues. We are replacing the decades-old legacy system with a modern, cloud-native platform.

The rebuild touches everything: decomposing a monolithic Java/J2EE application into cloud-native services, reconstructing undocumented business logic from incomplete legacy code, clearing compliance and data-governance constraints, and delivering a platform that multiple government agencies depend on daily.

The Chief Architect owns the technical coherence of this effort. You define how the system is structured, how teams interface with each other, and where the hard boundaries are. You work across product squads, TechOps, and programme leadership — but your authority is technical, not managerial.

Teams here use AI-assisted development workflows daily, including LLM/agentic-AI tooling for spec building, code generation, and test automation. You are expected to push the boundaries of what's possible with these tools.

[What you will be working on]

Architecture & technical direction

Set the overall system architecture for the TradeNet platform — service decomposition, data architecture, API contracts, infrastructure patterns.
Make binding technical decisions across teams. Resolve cross-squad technical disputes. Own the architecture decision record.
Design for resilience: fault isolation, blast-radius containment, defensive API contracts, and graceful degradation across a system that cannot go down.
Define the architectural guardrails, contracts, and patterns that teams build on — enabling independent delivery without architectural drift.

Legacy modernisation

Lead the technical strategy for decomposing and replacing the legacy monolith, including where to strangle, where to rewrite, and where to leave alone.
Reconstruct undocumented business logic from incomplete legacy codebases — using source analysis, documentation archaeology, dependency tracing, and AI-assisted reverse-engineering.
Navigate compliance and data-governance constraints that shape what can be migrated, how, and when.

Hands-on technical work

Write architecture documents, design specs, and technical RFCs that teams implement against.
Review code and designs across squads — particularly at integration boundaries and in foundational components.
Prototype and prove out critical technical approaches before committing teams to them.
Lead root-cause analysis on hard production and programme-level technical problems.

AI-assisted engineering

Pioneer and refine AI/LLM-assisted approaches to legacy analysis, code generation, test creation, and documentation.
Set the technical standards for how AI-generated output is evaluated, attributed, and held to quality.
Push the programme's use of agentic AI beyond basic code completion into architectural and analytical workflows.

Technical leadership

Earn trust with engineering teams through technical credibility — you lead by being right and being helpful, not by title. Your authority comes from the quality of your decisions and your willingness to get into the details.
Resolve technical disputes across squads. People will disagree on approach, and you are the one who makes the call and gets buy-in from both sides.
Balance technical debt against migration timelines. Know when to take a shortcut to hit a delivery date and when to say no because the long-term cost is too high. Make these tradeoffs explicitly and visibly.
Grow technical leads across squads. Mentor senior engineers. Raise the bar on technical decision-making across the programme.
Provide technical input to programme-level decisions: sequencing, risk, feasibility, and pivot recommendations.
Secure executive alignment on technical direction, particularly under ambiguity or when course corrections are needed.

[What we are looking for]

At least 12 years of hands-on software engineering, with significant time spent as a principal/staff engineer or architect on large-scale systems (not purely management track).
Experience as the overall technical lead across multiple teams (5+ teams, 40+ engineers) — setting architecture that others build on, without directly managing them.
Deep experience with legacy modernisation: decomposing monoliths, migrating off on-prem platforms, reconstructing business logic from incomplete or undocumented systems. You've done this before and know where it goes wrong.
Strong cloud-native architecture background — service design, event-driven systems, API-first platforms, infrastructure-as-code. Ideally on AWS.
Demonstrated ability to make hard technical calls under ambiguity — pivoting programmes, resolving cross-team disputes, and getting executive buy-in for technical direction when the path isn't clear.
Experience designing defensive/resilient architectures for systems that cannot afford downtime — fault isolation, contract enforcement, blast-radius containment.
Hands-on proficiency in a modern backend stack. The programme uses Kotlin, but deep experience in Java/JVM ecosystems, PostgreSQL, and cloud-native tooling is the important part.
Experience with AI/LLM-assisted engineering beyond basic code completion — reverse-engineering pipelines, agentic workflows, or AI-augmented analysis at the architectural level.
Strong written technical communication. Your architecture documents and RFCs need to stand on their own and be implementable by teams without further explanation.

Good to have

Experience in Singapore government technology ecosystem (GovTech, SGTS, IM8/CSA frameworks).
Background in trade, customs, regulatory, or financial platform engineering.
Prior engineering management experience (team lead, EM) — useful for mentoring and influence, though this is an IC role.
Experience with data-governance and compliance constraints that shape architecture (data residency, classification, audit trails).
Familiarity with the Java/J2EE legacy ecosystem you'd be migrating away from.

We are seeking an AI Deployed Engineer (Agentic) to serve as a forward-deployed engineer on the agentic project team — partnering closely with the customer to build, deploy and operate agentic AI solutions end to end. In this hands-on role you will design and build full-stack systems and AI agents, writing production-grade code to take solutions from first prototype through to stable production, and then support Day 2 operations to keep the Azure platform underpinning the solution healthy, secure and cost-efficient. Build agentic solutions (software development): Design and build full-stack systems and AI agents, writing production-grade code that takes solutions from first prototype through to stable production.

Required Qualifications

Production-grade software development proficiency in Python, JavaScript or comparable stacks, with the ability to contribute directly in code.
Experience building or deploying systems powered by LLMs, agentic AI or generative-AI models.
Experience scoping and delivering complex systems in fast-moving or ambiguous environments, including customer-facing technical delivery.
Hands-on experience operating and maintaining Microsoft Azure platforms in production (Virtual Machines, App Services, Function Apps).
Experience with Azure Container Apps (ACA) and Azure Container Registry (ACR).
Strong DevOps / CI-CD experience, particularly GitHub Actions pipelines.
Experience with Azure Monitor and Microsoft Sentinel for logging, monitoring and security alert handling.
Working knowledge of IAM / RBAC and cloud security best practices.
Experience supporting Day 2 / run-and-maintain operations — patching, backups, incident and ticket handling — with an SRE mindset.
Ability to communicate clearly with engineers, product teams and customer stakeholders, with sound judgement under pressure.
Singapore Citizen who is eligible to obtain and maintain Singapore Government security clearance, and willing to undergo the required MINDEF vetting process.
Willingness to work on-site at client premises, including secured MINDEF facilities, as required.

Performance Evaluation

Performance in this role will be assessed through periodic performance feedback evaluation provided directly by the customer (MINDEF). The successful candidate is expected to consistently meet the customer's quality, delivery, and professionalism standards throughout the engagement.

Experience with agentic AI solutions and using SRE agents to automate operational tasks.
Prior experience working within secured or classified government environments.
Microsoft certifications such as Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400), Azure Security Engineer (AZ-500) or Security Operations Analyst (SC-200).
Experience with container platforms and cloud-native application deployment on Azure.

The opportunity to work at the forefront of enterprise AI and agentic solutions, delivering and operating mission-critical systems for one of Singapore's most security-conscious public-sector clients. Contract van onbepaalde duur.

Zorg jij ervoor dat software niet alleen werkt, maar ook blijft werken?

Een Support & Test Automation Engineer speelt een sleutelrol tussen klanten, softwareontwikkeling en kwaliteit.

In deze functie combineer je twee uitdagende werelden. Enerzijds ben je het aanspreekpunt voor klanten wanneer zij ondersteuning nodig hebben. Anderzijds zorg je ervoor dat onze software kwalitatief, stabiel en betrouwbaar blijft door testautomatisatie en kwaliteitscontroles.

Je analyseert technische vraagstukken, zoekt mee naar de oorzaak van incidenten en zorgt ervoor dat issues efficiënt hun weg vinden naar de juiste oplossing. Tegelijk werk je aan geautomatiseerde testen en releasevalidaties, zodat problemen worden opgespoord nog vóór ze impact hebben op klanten.

Je werkt nauw samen met onze developers en met partners zoals Microsoft, Tungsten en dox42.

Je dagelijkse avontuur

Geen enkele dag is hetzelfde. Je verdeelt je aandacht tussen support, analyse en kwaliteitsbewaking.

Je helpt klanten vooruit
Je behandelt supportvragen en incidenten.
Je analyseert en reproduceert technische problemen.
Je begeleidt klanten via e-mail, Teams en telefoon.
Je bewaakt de opvolging en communicatie van issues van A tot Z.
Je stemt af met externe softwareleveranciers wanneer nodig.
Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van onze software
Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt geautomatiseerde testen met Playwright.
Je voert functionele testen, regressietesten en releasevalidaties uit.
Je controleert nieuwe functionaliteiten en bugfixes.
Je detecteert risico's en denkt mee na over verbeteringen.
Je helpt onze QA-aanpak en teststrategie verder uitbouwen.

Vaardigheden

Jij krijgt energie van het uitpluizen van complexe vraagstukken en laat niet los tot je begrijpt wat er speelt.

Daarnaast Herken Je Jezelf In Onderstaande Punten

Je hebt ervaring met software testing, technische support of beide.
Je hebt ervaring met Playwright of een gelijkaardig testautomatiseringsframework.
Je hebt een technische achtergrond en kan code lezen, begrijpen en gebruiken om problemen te analyseren.
Je denkt analytisch en werkt oplossingsgericht.
Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands en Engels.
Je bent klantgericht en voelt je comfortabel in rechtstreeks contact met klanten.
Je neemt ownership en volgt zaken consequent op.
Je werkt graag samen met collega's en externe partners.

Mooi Meegenomen

Ervaring met Microsoft Dynamics 365.
Kennis van Azure, SQL, API's of integraties.
Ervaring met supportprocessen of ticketingsystemen.
Kennis van ERP-, workflow- of document management oplossingen.

Bij 9altitudes krijg je niet zomaar een job, maar de kans om mee te bouwen aan software en oplossingen die het verschil maken voor onze klanten.

Je komt terecht in een gespecialiseerd team waar samenwerking, kennisdeling en persoonlijke groei centraal staan.

Wat Je Mag Verwachten

Een aantrekkelijk verloningspakket met een competitief salaris, maaltijdcheques, hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering én een elektrische firmawagen met laadpas.
Flexibiliteit via ons 9A Flexplan, waarmee je jouw eindejaarspremie kan inzetten voor voordelen die voor jou belangrijk zijn, zoals extra IT-materiaal of een ergonomische thuiswerkplek.
Een sterke start én groeitraject op maat. Dankzij een uitgebreide onboarding en een persoonlijk ontwikkelingsplan werk je samen met je teamlead aan jouw ambities, interesses en professionele groei.
Blijven leren zit in ons DNA. Via opleidingen, certificeringen en kennisdeling binnen de 9A-community krijg je alle kansen om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.
Een afwisselende en impactvolle rol waarin testing, support en technologie samenkomen en je dagelijks het verschil maakt voor klanten en collega's.
Samenwerking over landsgrenzen heen. Je maakt deel uit van de internationale 9altitudes-groep en werkt samen met collega's uit verschillende landen, waardoor je kennis en best practices breed kan inzetten.
Een hecht team en sterke bedrijfscultuur. Van afterworks en business updates tot onze Family Day, Summer Event en Elevate Together Day: verbinding staat centraal.
De kans om mee te groeien met een ambitieuze organisatie. Jouw ideeën en expertise dragen rechtstreeks bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van 9altitudes in België en Europa.
Een innovatieve werkomgeving waarin je werkt met moderne technologieën en deel uitmaakt van een Microsoft Gold Partner met een sterke focus op digitale transformatie.

Neem contact op

Bij 9altitudeskrijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan de internationale voorloper op technologie en procesoptimalisatie. Met meer dan 750 collega’s in 9 landen combineren we diepgaande expertise in o.a. ERP, CE, BI & AI, Document Management, PLM, IoT & Augmented Reality, CAD en eCommerce. Samen creëren we meer dan oplossingen: we leveren échte waarde en zetten mee de toon voor duurzame resultaten bij onze klanten.

Klaar om met ons mee te groeien en je carrière naar nieuwe hoogtes te tillen? Zet vandaag nog de eerste stap in jouw nieuwe avontuur en solliciteer eenvoudig via onze website.

Systems Technical Support Engineer

We’re a leader in data and AI. Through our software and services, we inspire customers around the world to transform data into intelligence - and questions into answers.

If you're looking for a dynamic, fulfilling career with flexibility and a world-class employee experience, you'll find it here. We're recognized around the world for our inclusive, meaningful culture and innovative technologies by organizations like Fast Company, Forbes, Newsweek and more.

About The Job

The Middle Tier Technical Support team is looking for a Systems Technical Support Engineer to provide technical support for customers using SAS 9.4 and SAS Viya environments. Our team supports the systems, services, and infrastructure that enable SAS web applications to run securely, reliably, and at scale. We help customers troubleshoot complex issues across web and application servers, authentication and single sign-on, security and encryption, clustering and performance.

In this role, you will join a highly collaborative global team working at the intersection of systems engineering, customer success, and SAS technology. You will have the opportunity to work with a broad range of technologies, solve challenging technical problems, and develop expertise across both traditional SAS 9.4 architectures and modern SAS Viya environments.

Diagnose and resolve authentication, single sign-on, security, and encryption issues involving technologies such as Kerberos, SAML, OAuth/OIDC, Integrated Windows Authentication (IWA).
Support highly available and clustered environments by troubleshooting clustering, JMS brokers and cache locator services.
Ensure all applicable security policies and processes are followed to support the organization's secure software development goals.
Embrace curiosity, passion, authenticity, and accountability. These are our values and influence everything we do.

Consultor .NET - Lisboa
Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Nilfisk's Digital Product department builds the software around the machines: customer portals, connected-machine and fleet services, mobile apps, service and field tooling, internal applications for our own colleagues. Today that is cross-functional product teams working on different products, and it is growing.

We are hiring our first Solution Architect to make those products add up to one landscape rather than separate ones. You will define the target architecture, and the shared building blocks our teams design within. You will also be the person the organisation comes to when a new idea, product or roadmap needs an architectural answer, and the person who says, clearly and early, what it will take.

How We Will Work, And Where You Fit

Our product teams are cross-functional and durable. A Product Owner, UX and engineers own a problem area end to end, from discovery through to running it in production. They make their own technical decisions inside their boundary, and we intend to keep it that way.

That shapes this role in a specific way. You are not an approval gate, and you do not design other teams' services for them. You own the decisions that cross team boundaries, and for everything else you make the good path the easy path: clear patterns, reusable building blocks, sensible defaults, and documentation developers actually read. A team should build within your architecture because it is the fastest route to something that lasts, not because someone mandated it.

What You Will Own

The target architecture for the Digital Product portfolio, and a realistic roadmap to get there from where we are
The principles, reference architectures and design standards teams work within, and the boundaries between products and teams
The shared building blocks: integration and event patterns, API standards, identity, and how customer, product and service data is owned and shared across products
Architectural evaluation of new work: proposals, roadmaps, partner technologies. What fits, what it takes to build, what it reuses, what it breaks, what it costs to run. A clear early answer with the reasoning attached
Honest assessment of what we already have, on a regular cadence, and a clear statement of what needs to change
Security, GDPR privacy by design and operability built into the architecture from the start, working with our Security team and our DevOps function on how solutions are built, released and run
Design review for internal teams and external development partners, early enough that the feedback still matters
The architecture record: decisions written down, documentation and diagrams kept current
Growing architectural judgement in the teams, through coaching and pairing, so it does not all live with one person

Throughout, we will expect you to

Say no with a rationale, and say yes quickly when it is a yes. Both matter
Be clear about uncertainty. A rough estimate with an honest error bar is worth more to us than a precise number that turns out to be wrong
Translate trade-offs into business terms for Product Owners and management, without flattening the technical substance
Write things down. Decision records and current diagrams are part of the work, not admin that comes after it

Essential

What we are looking for

Substantial experience as a solution architect across a portfolio of products, including setting the architecture other teams build within
A track record of evaluating proposals and existing solutions and giving an organisation a clear architectural answer with a rationale. We will ask you to walk us through what you assessed, what you recommended, and what actually changed as a result
Hands-on depth in modern application architecture: APIs, event-driven integration, microservices where they earn their keep and modular monoliths where they do not, and the judgement to tell which is which
Production experience with cloud-native architecture on Microsoft Azure, including the platform services, data stores and integration services you would actually reach for
Experience designing user-facing digital products (web, mobile, portals) and integrating them with enterprise systems such as ERP and CRM
Experience working inside an enterprise architecture you do not control, aligning product architecture with IT-owned systems, standards and governance
Professional English, written and spoken

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst — CTRM Platform (Systems Design)
jobs.description:
Who we need

We are looking for someone who has learned system design discipline in a big-tech engineering environment and structured problem-solving, stakeholder handling and delivery rigour in a consulting environment — and who has since applied both to physical commodity trading.
You will sit inside the technology delivery team. Your job is to convert how business actually works into the design artefacts a development team builds from: process models, decision rules, data models, event definitions, state machines, and acceptance criteria. You are the person who makes sure the system that gets built reflects the real mechanics of the commodity trade lifecycle.

What this role is not

This is not
an economist or market analyst role. No market fundamentals, price forecasting, supply/demand balances or trading research.
This is not
a strategy or corporate development role. No market entry assessments, business cases for investment, or operating model strategy decks.
This is not
a pure project management or delivery coordination role, though you will own sequencing within your workstreams.

It is a hands-on systems design role, embedded in a business architecture team, producing artefacts that are consumed directly by product owners, architects and engineers.

What you will do

Design the business architecture of the platform

Model business processes across Trading, Finance, Logistics and Risk as structured, decomposable process definitions — not narrative descriptions
Define the business entity model and data dictionary: entities, attributes, relationships, identifiers, cardinality, lifecycle ownership
Specify state models for the core objects of the commodity trade lifecycle including valid transitions and the events that trigger them
Maintain a business rules catalogue — conditions, decision tables, tolerances, thresholds and their owners — separated cleanly from process flow

Turn design into buildable specification

Write functional specifications and acceptance criteria precise enough that an engineer can implement without reinterpreting the business intent
Translate operational workflows into system logic: validations, calculations, allocations, postings, and automated decisions
Specify integration contracts and data flows between the trading platform, finance systems and external services
Work with architects and engineers through build and test, validating that delivered behaviour matches the design

Own the decision record

Run design decisions to closure: frame the options, present the trade-offs and risks honestly, secure the decision, record it
Maintain a decision log and a register of open items, assumptions and change requests
Prioritise across releases, sequencing scope on business value and technical dependency

Work with stakeholders

Elicit requirements directly from business stakeholders— including reconciling what they say they do with industry best-practices
Present designs and recommendations to senior stakeholders, including trading and operations leadership
Design the change-management dimension into the solution itself: role definitions, controls, adoption safeguards, and migration away from spreadsheet-based practice

Applied AI

Design AI-enabled and automated steps inside commercial workflows — document extraction, validation, drafting, anomaly detection — with clear boundaries on where a human decision is mandatory

What we expect

Experience in a large technology organisation (product, platform or engineering environment) with exposure to formal system design practice
Experience in a top-tier management consultancy or equivalent professional services environment
Experience with physical commodity trading, energy markets or CTRM systems
Fluent in both English and Russian (mandatory)
Deep working knowledge of the physical deal lifecycle
Understanding of trade finance and accounting interfaces: prepayments, invoicing, accruals, letters of credit, treasury and statutory reporting boundaries
Understanding of oil logistics of commodity trading
Demonstrable ability to produce structured design artefacts — process models (BPMN or equivalent), entity-relationship and data models, state diagrams, decision tables, interface specifications
Comfort working directly in an engineering delivery cadence: backlog, refinement, acceptance, release
Precision with terminology and versioned documentation
Strong commercial and financial analysis capability applied to system design questions
Location: Dubai, alternatively remote with regular travel to Dubai to work alongside the client's trading and operations team.

Nice to have

Crude, refined products or LNG flows specifically
Risk management functions: exposure, credit limits, position management, VaR
Pricing and reference data: Platts, Argus, ICE, forward curves, netbacks
Event-driven or microservices architecture experience; familiarity with event sourcing
Experience with CTRM platforms as implementation lead, BA or power user
Hands-on use of LLMs and automation tooling in a commercial delivery context
Chartering or shipping S&P exposure

Why this role

Direct influence over the architecture and roadmap of a trading platform being built from the ground up
Work at the point where deep physical trading knowledge meets modern platform engineering
High ownership: you define the design, you defend it, you see it built

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Background:

Agilio Software Group is a leading UK healthcare operations software provider, delivering integrated, mission critical solutions that support primary care, dental, pharmacy, hospital, and veterinary organisations. We have ambitious and exciting growth plans and are looking for talented individuals to be part of our journey. iLearn is our learning and compliance platform, supporting healthcare organisations to meet regulatory requirements, maintain workforce competence, and deliver high quality patient care.

The Role:

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to join Agilio and take ownership of several of our engineering teams and products.
The exact shape of the role will evolve, but you’ll likely be working across 3–4 engineering teams and around 6 products. It’s a broad role, so you’ll need to be comfortable balancing priorities across different teams and products and knowing where to focus your time.

Agilio has grown significantly over the last seven years, bringing together around 20 businesses through acquisition. As a result, we have a large and varied portfolio of healthcare software, with products at different stages of maturity, built using different technologies and architectures.

We’re investing in modernising and consolidating our technology, improving how we build and operate software, and exploring how AI can change the way our engineering teams work. This creates some interesting engineering challenges and plenty of opportunity to influence what the next stage of Agilio’s technology looks like.

Key Responsibilities:

You’ll be responsible for the people, delivery and engineering health of your teams and products.
You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product and stakeholders across the business to agree priorities, solve problems and make the right decisions about where we invest our engineering time.

Lead, coach and develop engineers across your teams.
Support Lead Engineers and other technical leaders to take ownership and lead effectively.
Work closely with Product to shape priorities, plans and the longer-term direction of your products.
Build strong relationships across the business and represent Engineering in decisions affecting your products.
Own the technical direction and architecture across your products, working with Lead Engineers and teams to make good technical decisions and ensure they align with our wider technology direction.
Understand the technical health of your products, including security, reliability, performance, maintainability and technical debt.
Make sure technical risks and investment needs are understood and factored into plans alongside product and customer priorities.
Help teams create realistic delivery plans, manage dependencies and identify risks early.
Help remove blockers and make decisions and trade-offs when teams need support.
Improve engineering practices across areas such as automated testing, CI/CD, observability, security and operating software in production.
Help teams make practical use of AI across the software development lifecycle and share what works across Engineering.
Work with other Engineering Managers and technical leaders to solve common problems, align technical approaches and reduce unnecessary duplication across products.
Recruit and onboard engineers as the teams grow.
Contribute to engineering initiatives that span teams and products.

You’ll need to be comfortable with technology. You won’t make every technical decision, but you’ll be accountable for the technical direction of your area. You’ll need to understand the important decisions, challenge where necessary and make sure, we’re making choices that work beyond an individual team or product.

You’ll also need to know when to step back and trust the engineers closest to the problem

Our technology

Our technology reflects the range of products that have come together as Agilio has grown.
Most of our software is .NET, alongside products built using PHP and Python. Our products are predominantly web-based, with a mixture of server-side rendered applications and SPAs, alongside a smaller number of mobile applications built using Flutter.

Today our products run across Microsoft Azure, AWS and Google Cloud, with Azure as our strategic cloud platform going forward.
Part of the opportunity is helping us evolve this estate — making sensible decisions about where we standardise and consolidate while continuing to support and improve the products our customers rely on today.

Essential

Proven experience leading and developing multiple software engineering teams.
Previous experience in an Engineering Manager, Software Development Manager, Head of Engineering, or similar leadership role.
Experience working closely with Product teams and business stakeholders to prioritise work and balance competing demands.
Strong understanding of modern software development practices, including Agile delivery methodologies.
Experience overseeing the technical direction of products and making decisions relating to architecture, security, scalability, reliability and technical debt.
Ability to identify, assess and manage technical and delivery risks.
Experience coaching, mentoring and developing engineers and technical leaders.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence at all levels of an organisation.
Experience managing products or platforms across a varied technology estate.
Good understanding of cloud-based software environments (Azure, AWS or GCP).Experience improving engineering practices such as CI/CD, automated testing, observability and secure software development.Ability to make pragmatic decisions and trade-offs in complex technical environments.
Right to work in the UK.

Additional Information

The role is remote with occasional travel to one of our offices on an ad-hoc basis.
Salary:
Competitive + generous benefits

Income Protection

Enhanced pension
Health Cash plan
28 days annual leave + bank holidays

Please note: Due to the volume of applications received, we may not be able to contact every applicant individually. We appreciate your interest in Agilio Software Group and thank you for taking the time to apply.

This role would essentially suit someone with a passion for Mechanical Engineering/Physical Modelling with commercial Software Development experience - you must have written production grade code in C#, C++ or Python for application development (not web apps or embedded) and an interest in pushing Machine Learning over time.

Crucially we are looking for experience with AWS Cloud / Distributed Computing to be considered.

Your new role

In this role you'll be tackling engineering challenges that most organisations simply can't touch and building proprietary software that makes a difference in the world. You will thrive in an environment where new challenges appear daily and innovation is the expectation.

Your role will involve developing core modules within the Engineering design platform, and integrating modules into a cloud compute environment for a team that runs Agile. You'll wrap commercial simulation tools, integrate everything into automated workflows and help streamline complex engineering processes through high quality automation. The right person will be motivated and hungry to solve first-of-their-kind challenges.

With the rapid expansion and new investment into the company it's an exciting time to be joining with solid progression opportunities. You're also safe in the knowledge the future is bright as their customer list boasts some of the worlds leading tech, automotive, aerospace and engineering brands.

What you'll need to succeed

We're looking for candidates with a Bachelors, Masters or PhD Degree in a STEM or Computing discipline - ideally from a Russell Group University.

We need 2-8 years proficiency working in a commercial Software Engineering role/team using either C#, C++ or Python. Ideally you'll have worked with Vue/Django, JavaScript/Typescript.

You should have Distributed Computing experience, ideally in an AWS environment and working with Cloud Architecture to apply for this role. this will be supported by a mix of Kubernetes cluster experience, PostgreSQL and Linux platform background.

You'll have a strong knowledge of software design patterns and modern engineering principles and clear communication/interpersonal skills are a must for working closely with internal teams. Experience to help guide the team and confidently push back when needed is essential.
Experience in a Mechanical Engineering environment will stand out with some exposure to Computional Fluid Dynamics (CFD) or Finite Element Analysis (FEA).

What you'll get in return

The company offers 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays, flexible working hours, a pension with a 9% employer contribution, private healthcare covering dental & health screening. There are company share options and a huge collection of local discount schemes including gym membership and there is parking on site.

What you need to do now

To find out more and to be considered for this position please apply directly, or contact Max Wilcock, Business Director on 0333 010 5724.

At Hays Technology, we are shaping the future of recruitment. The rapid adoption of cloud, which is making customer interfaces more engaging and creating a seamless engagement with businesses, means that from the foundation of your organisation up, software developers are critical to success. As the competition for talent grows, we're ready and waiting to help developers really make an impact on organisations, so talk to us today. We are Hays Technology.

Coventry, West Midlands (England), CV1 2WT : Manchester, North West England, M1 2WD : City of Westminster, London (region), SW1P 3BT

Job Summary

These are exciting times in the Department for Education.

Our digital services have been migrated onto public cloud and we’re on a journey of maturing our technology, and how we work, to take full advantage of cloud-native and network technologies. Our goal is to make our digital delivery faster, cheaper and more secure.

Our diverse and inclusive culture in DfE reflects the society we live in - this helps us to achieve better outcomes for all our users. We typically work in Agile teams, so we can innovate and radically improve services that: raise education standards and provide the best start in life for children; support disadvantaged and vulnerable children and young people; and drive economic growth.

If you are successful, you will be working in the Schools Digital portfolio. Our aim is to support schools and teachers to have the best environment, tools and support so that every child can achieve and thrive. We work with Schools Group to deliver Manifesto commitments on recruiting and retaining teachers, including the 6.5k manifesto commitment, SEND reform and helping schools improve.

This is an exciting time to join the portfolio with significant reform programmes underway for SEND and schools, which will have a direct impact on the outcomes on the teaching landscape and help every child achieve and thrive.

We work in multi-disciplinary teams using Agile methods to innovate and radically improve services that:

Support schools to manage and improve their performance
Support teachers and teacher trainee mentors to provide the best start in life for children
Support children to get the best SEND support
Drive economic growth

Job Description

As a Senior Technical Architect, your main responsibilities will include:

Defining, maintaining, and championing the technical strategy for a service or group of services - keeping up to date with the latest technologies and trends, whilst delivering working software early and often.
Leading technical specialists in multiple projects and services, on problems that require broad architectural thinking.
Defining how to build and operate user-centred, open-source web systems in an agile environment, to serve a variety of citizen and government needs.
Being responsible for the technical design and development of services in your programme, including how they interact with their surroundings, and how they evolve over time.
Challenging entrenched practices and influencing decision-makers, looking for deeper underlying problems to solve, and larger opportunities for digital transformation.
Communicating the vision for government services to developers and non-developers alike, working in multi-disciplinary teams that bring policy and delivery together.
Playing an active role in the DfE architecture community, where you will share knowledge of tools and techniques, as well as joining related communities of practice and events where appropriate, such as product, user research, design, platforms, security, etc.
Helping to build a diverse, inclusive culture across the technical architecture community.
Working with your Lead Technical Architect, colleagues and peers on profession-based activities (and cross-profession), such as defining standards and guidance around best practice.

Helping to build a diverse, inclusive culture across the technical architecture community.
Working with your Lead Technical Architect, colleagues and peers on profession-based activities (and cross-profession), such as defining standards and guidance around best practice.

Person specification

Essential Criteria

Applications will be assessed against the following criteria:

Assessed At Application And Both Interview Stages

Experience working and coaching in technical teams and delivering user-centred services in an agile environment.
Experience working with cloud-first architectures and how to build applications that take advantage of the opportunities they offer.
Experience of software development in C# .Net (or similar), and introducing modern software engineering practices, such as Test-Driven Development (TDD), continuous integration/development (CI/CD), automated deployment pipelines and version control with Git and DevOps.

Assessed At Application And Second Interview Stage

The ability to work with technical and non-technical stakeholders to achieve agreement on technical plans.
The ability to look beyond immediate technical problems and identify the wider implications.
Practical knowledge at many levels of the web stack, from front-end code, down to infrastructure and networking.

Desirable Criteria

The following criteria are desirable. Applicant’s evidence against these criteria will be used at interview in the event of a tie break situation, to make an informed decision:

Experience using automated tests to continuously validate your work.
Experience of applying the UK Government Service Standard and service assessment.
Experience of mentoring and supporting colleagues in multi-disciplinary teams, one-to-one or in groups.
Ability to work with stakeholders to produce effective strategies for technology choices, using the most appropriate languages, frameworks and tools to meet user and business needs.

Alongside your salary of £60,222, Department for Education contributes £17,446 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides (opens in a new window).

Applicants currently holding a permanent post in the Civil Service should note that, if successful, their salary on appointment would be determined by the Department’s transfer / promotion policies.

As a member of the DfE, you will be entitled to join the highly competitive Civil Service Pension Scheme, which many experts agree is one of the most generous in the UK.

You will have 25 days leave, increasing by 1 day every year to a maximum of 30 days after five years’ service. In addition, all staff receive the King’s Birthday privilege holiday and 8 days’ bank and public holidays.

We offer flexible working arrangements, such as job sharing, term-time working, flexi-time and compressed hours.

Most DfE employees will be working a hybrid pattern, spending at least 60% of their time in an office or work setting. Changes to these working arrangements are available in exceptional circumstances but must be agreed with the line manager and in line with the requirements of the role.

Travel to your primary office location will not be paid for by DfE, but costs for travel to an office which is not your main location will be covered.

As an organisation, which exists to support education and lifelong learning, we offer our staff excellent professional development opportunities.

Artificial intelligence

Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance (opens in a new window) for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.

Selection process details

Application/sift

At application you will be asked to provide your CV and a statement of suitability. Both should be anonymised (all personal information removed, such as your name, date of birth, gender, contact information, nationality etc).

Your CV should include details of previous roles held and responsibilities / previous skills and experience.
Your statement of suitability (max 1250 words) should demonstrate how you meet the essential criteria listed in the person specification section above.

Your CV and statement will be assessed together against the listed essential criteria.

First Stage Interview

Longlisted candidates may be invited to attend a preliminary interview, typically involving a commitment of up to 1 hour.

The interview will consist of a series of questions to further assess the essential criteria for the role, focused on the first three essential criteria.

Interviews will be on MS teams, which may be remote or from a DfE office - we will confirm which when you are invited to an interview.

If successful, candidates will then be invited to a second interview.

Second Stage Interview

At this interview we will ask questions to further assess your experience in relation to all of the listed essential criteria.

This will be used to assess your experience against the essential (and in the case of a tie, the desirable) criteria.

Interviews will be on MS teams, which may be remote or from a DfE office - we will confirm which when you are invited to an interview.

Feedback

Feedback will only be provided if you attend an interview.

Timing

We expect to sift in week commencing 5 October 2026

First stage interviews will likely take place in the week commencing 19 October 2026.

Second stage interviews will likely take place in the week commencing 2 November 2026.

Once a provisional offer has been made, you will be invited to participate in a capability assessment to determine the value of the CBP allowance we can offer you. The assessment compares your skills against the Senior Technical Architect role described in DfE’s local Technical Architecture Capability Framework, which is based on the Government Digital and Data Profession Capability Framework.

Subject to your availability, we will aim to conduct the capability assessment and confirm the allowance offer to you within a week of the provisional offer being made.

This is a discretionary non-consolidated, non-pensionable allowance which, if awarded, is attached to the post. The value of the allowance is based on the outcome of a capability assessment and is reviewed annually. Allowance values range up to £19,400, with the highest values reserved for candidates whose capability is above the expected level for all of the skills.

Other Information

Interviews may be via Microsoft teams or face to face; the vacancy manager will confirm prior to the Interview.

In your application, please don’t include personal information that identifies you.

This means we can recruit based on your knowledge and skills, and not background, gender or ethnicity - it's called name blind recruitment (opens in a new window).

jobs.description:
Are you looking to grow your career in software engineering? Join Social Security Scotland and help build digital services that make a real difference to people's lives across Scotland.

As an Associate Software Engineer, you'll work as part of a supportive and collaborative team, contributing to the development, maintenance and improvement of modern digital services. You'll have the opportunity to work with experienced engineers, learn new technologies, and develop your technical skills through hands-on experience, coaching and mentoring.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone at the early stages of their software engineering career who is keen to learn, solve problems and build high-quality digital solutions. You'll be supported to develop your knowledge across software development, testing, security, user-centred design and modern engineering practices, while gaining valuable experience working within a large public sector organisation.

At Social Security Scotland, continuous learning and professional development are encouraged. You'll have access to training, development opportunities and a clear pathway to progress your career within the Digital Profession. Whether you're building on existing experience or taking the next step in your career, you'll be part of a team that values collaboration, innovation and personal growth.

Together, we deliver digital services that are secure, accessible and user-focused, helping provide vital support to people across Scotland.

An Associate Software Engineer learns on the job by delivering software components.

At This Role Level, You Will

develop skills while working under supervision to deliver stories in a multidisciplinary team
understand and be proficient in different types of testing
be aware of but not responsible for security

Responsibilities

Support the development, testing, maintenance and improvement of software applications, services and infrastructure.
Assist in designing, building and documenting software components, programs and scripts, following established standards and guidance.
Work from user stories and requirements to help deliver solutions that meet user needs and improve user experience.
Contribute to system integration activities, including building and testing interfaces between systems.
Help identify, investigate and resolve software faults and technical issues using agreed processes and procedures.
Support the delivery of secure solutions by following information security requirements and applying security controls.
Assist with maintaining service availability, reliability and performance to ensure systems can meet expected demand.
Use prototyping techniques to explore ideas, test solutions and support development activities.
Collaborate with colleagues and wider project teams to contribute to the design and delivery of larger systems.
Apply modern software engineering standards, tools and practices, with support and guidance from experienced team members.

Success Profiles 

We use an assessment framework called ‘Success Profiles’ which lists the elements we test and provides detailed descriptions of each. Find out more about the framework here.

For this post, the following Success Profile elements will be assessed:

Experience

Experience of contributing to the development of low-complexity software components and working collaboratively as part of a wider team to deliver larger solutions.
Understanding of core Modern JavaScript Framework and/or AEM concepts, with the ability to deliver straightforward development tasks and user stories, seeking feedback and guidance where needed.

Behaviours

Communicating and Influencing (Level 2)
Working Together (Level 2)

You can find out more about Success Profiles Behaviours here:

Technical / Professional Skills

This role is aligned to Junior Developer
within the Government Digital and Data Profession.

These skills will be tested during the Technical Assessment if you are successful at sift stage. They will be not be assessed at application stage.

How To Apply 

Apply online, you must provide a CV and Supporting Statement (of no more than 750 words) which provides evidence of how you meet the Experience and Behaviours listed in the Success Profiles above. 

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools can be used to support your application, but all statements and examples provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, and presented as your own) applications will be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action.

Please see our candidate guidance for more information on acceptable and unacceptable uses of AI in recruitment.

Should a large number of applications be received, an initial sift may be conducted using the CV and Supporting Statement against the first experience criteria. Candidates who pass the initial sift will have their applications fully assessed.

Please note there may be a telephone interview prior to the final interview stage.

Successful candidates will be invited to an interview which will assess the experience and behaviours, and a technical assessment comprising a technical question and answer session to assess the technical skills.

Full details of the interview and assessment process will be shared with shortlisted candidates once the sift has been completed.

We aim to provide feedback on request. However, if we receive a large number of applications it may not be possible for us to provide specific feedback on your application. We will provide feedback on request to candidates who attend an interview/assessment.

(subject to change)

Sift - week commencing 5th October 2026

Interview – week commencing 19th October 2026

Location - In Person
in either Dundee or Glasgow

In the event that there are more successful candidates than posts available, a reserve list will be kept for up to 12 months.

Social Security Scotland is an Executive Agency of the Scottish Government. Our benefits help people from all walks of life in Scotland. We offer rewarding careers and employ people across Scotland in a wide range of professions and roles. We are committed to recruiting a diverse workforce that is representative of the clients we serve.  Find more about us here.  

We offer a supportive and inclusive working environment along with a wide range of employee benefits. Find out more about what we offer. 

As part of the UK Civil Service, we uphold the Civil Service Nationality Rules.   

GDD Pay Supplement

This post is part of the Government Digital and Data (GDD) profession and currently attracts a £6,000 annual GDD pay supplement, which is paid monthly. Pay supplements are reviewed regularly.

Working Pattern

Our standard hours are 35 hours per week and we offer a range of flexible working options, depending on the needs of the role. We embrace a hybrid working style where all colleagues will spend time in either our Glasgow or Dundee offices. There is an expectation of a minimum 2 days per week in your assigned location, which will be either Glasgow or Dundee.  If you have specific questions about the role you are applying for, please contact us. 

Security Checks

Successful candidates must complete the Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS), before they can be appointed. BPSS is comprised of four main pre-employment checks – Identity, Right to work, Employment History and a Criminal Record check (unspent convictions).

You can find out more about BPSS on the UK Government website, or read about the different levels of security checks in our Candidate Guide.

We believe in the power of ingenuity to build a positive human future.

As strategies, technologies, and innovation collide, we create opportunity from complexity.

Our teams of interdisciplinary experts combine innovative thinking and breakthrough technologies to progress further, faster. Our clients adapt and transform, and together we achieve enduring results.
