jobs.title: Medior/Senior Cloud Center of Excellence Azure Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Medior/Senior Cloud Center of Excellence Azure Platform Engineer (Belgium)

LANGUAGES

English
REQUESTED START DATE

5 Oct 2026

The Cloud Center of Excellence (CCoE) is responsible for the design, governance and scaling our Azure and self-service platform.
We are looking for a senior engineer to help clean up the technical depth — from landing zone architecture to Terraform Enterprise module engineering, networking
design and enterprise system integrations. This is a medior/senior individual contributor role: you're expected to work independently on well-defined scopes, but you'll be ramping up within an existing team structure rather than owning the full platform strategy from day one.
Current Situation
Our Azure platform has grown fast — more application teams, more subscriptions, more consumers of our self-service capabilities every quarter. That growth has been a success story, but it also means parts of our platform (governance controls, identity and access processes, networking/DNS patterns, and our Terraform Enterprise setup) were built for an earlier stage of adoption and now need to be modernized to keep pace with scale.
We're tackling this step by step: moving toward more standardized, automated and maintainable ways of working across governance, identity, networking and infrastructure-as-code, so the platform can keep scaling without a proportional increase in manual effort.
To do that well, we're expanding the team with senior engineers who can contribute on two fronts: keeping day-to-day platform operations running smoothly for the teams that depend on us, while also helping design and build the more standardized, scalable solutions we're moving toward.
Day-to-Day Responsibilities
Act as second-line escalation for Azure platform issues (RBAC, DNS, VNET/Private Endpoint connectivity, AD integration, Terraform Enterprise runs) and write up root cause analyses.
Maintain and incrementally improve landing zones, archetypes, Azure Policy and naming/tagging standards; process governance exception requests.
Build, version and maintain Terraform modules; review consumer changes and evaluate Azure Verified Modules (AVM) as replacements for custom modules.
Handle recurring IAM tickets (RBAC assignments, group memberships, access troubleshooting) and contribute to cleanup of legacy/exception-based access.
Support DNS/connectivity requests and troubleshooting across the hybrid environment within existing patterns.
Maintain and troubleshoot existing PowerShell automation scripts used across platform operations.
Keep governance documentation current and contribute to internal Terraform Enterprise workshops and application team enablement.

Required Technical Expertise
Azure (hands-on production experience required)
Governance: management groups, subscriptions, Azure Policy (built-in and custom), RBAC design and troubleshooting.
Identity: Microsoft Entra ID — group-based access models, app registrations, managed identities, service principals.
Networking: VNET peering/hub-spoke, Private Endpoints, Private DNS Zones, Azure Firewall, Application Gateway, Azure Front Door, hybrid/on-prem DNS
integration.
Landing zone concepts aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) archetypes.
Exposure to Azure Databricks networking (VNet injection) is a plus.

Infrastructure as Code
Solid production-level Terraform authoring — designing, versioning and publishing modules, not just consuming them.
Terraform Enterprise or Terraform Cloud experience specifically: workspaces, private module registry, VCS-driven workflows, policy checks (Sentinel/OPA).
Familiarity with Azure Verified Modules (AVM) and module lifecycle/versioning practices.

DevOps & Automation
CI/CD pipeline experience (Azure DevOps preferred): build/release pipelines, YAML pipelines, service connections.
Scripting for automation and troubleshooting (PowerShell, Bash or Python).
Comfortable working with KQL/Log Analytics for diagnostics is a plus.

Identity & Access Management
Practical RBAC design and troubleshooting at enterprise scale (role assignments, group nesting, inheritance issues, propagation delays).
Experience managing access for both human users and service/application identities.
Understanding of access governance concepts (ownership, periodic reviews, exception handling).

Networking
Solid understanding of enterprise DNS architecture, including hybrid on- prem/cloud scenarios.
Experience troubleshooting connectivity issues across VNETs, firewalls, and hybrid links.

Prior Experience we're Looking For
4–7 years in a cloud platform engineering, DevOps or infrastructure engineering role, ideally within a large, governed enterprise (not a greenfield/startup environment).
Demonstrated experience operating (not just building) an Azure landing zone platform at scale — supporting real application teams with real tickets.
Prior role involving Terraform Enterprise/Cloud in a production capacity, ideally including module authorship and CI/CD integration.
Experience working across team boundaries (IAM, Networking, Security, external partners/vendors) to resolve platform issues.
Microsoft certifications (AZ-104, AZ-204, AZ-305, or Terraform Associate) are a strong plus but not a substitute for demonstrable hands-on experience.

Personal Characteristics
Can operate independently on a well-scoped task from day one — this is a "plug in and go"; role, not a ramp-up position.
Comfortable working in a live, legacy-entangled environment where not everything is fully standardized yet.
Detail-oriented, especially around governance, documentation and naming/tagging consistency.
Good communicator — able to support application teams directly without needing everything translated by the platform lead.
Takes ownership of tickets/incidents end-to-end rather than escalating prematurely

jobs.title: Fullstack Software Engineer (x/f/m) - Global Architecture
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait
.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance.
Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a
unique culture
. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🤘 How we do it ?

About

People joining Alan are always surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work, such as:

🎯 What drives us - We're obsessed with helping members live healthier

Mission is the Boss
: long-term thinking, mission above all else
Member & customer-led
: obsessed with solving problems and delighting users

🏆 How we build excellence - We hire the best and empower them to succeed

Champions of excellence
: extremely high standards and talent density
Distributed ownership
: everyone owns their decisions and results
Radically transparent
: all information accessible, written-first, async decisions

🤝 How we grow together - We improve through honest feedback and bold thinking

Optimistic alchemy
: optimists who collaborate with genuine care
Empathetic challengers
: direct, caring feedback to help each other grow
Bold contrarians
: think differently, try new approaches

⚡ How we move fast — We fight complexity and focus on what matters

Disciplined execution
: decisive action with compounding focus
Fight for simplicity
: high-impact processes, smart frugality

⭐ The Engineering team ⭐

In our engineering team, we build the infrastructure, interfaces, and applications to provide first-class service to our members, health professionals, and even ourselves!

Being an engineer at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate engineers, with a lot of product interaction.

We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

Our process is very simple: those who make product decisions are the same ones who build them.

Our stack is Python/Flask, React, React Native, PostgreSQL.

Want to know more? Read this article if you want to discover how life as an Engineer at Alan and this article on our Engineering career path.

🌐 Enabling Global-First product development

In Alan's early expansion, we made a strategic decision to create separate codebases for each country we ventured into. This approach allowed us to quickly adapt and tailor our applications to meet the unique healthcare and regulatory requirements of France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada.

In 2024, we reached a crucial point where it was essential to merge these codebases into global, configurable modules
. Yet, writing local code is still easier than building global solutions. The Global Architecture team is central to this transformation — our goal is to enable any team at Alan to develop and launch features seamlessly across markets, as outlined in our 2025 technical strategy.

🚀 Your mission

Design Cross-Cutting Modules
You'll transform country-specific implementations into elegant global components that will become the new building blocks of other teams to build global features
Remove Technical Blockers for Product Teams
You’ll tackle technical blockers that cut across several domains and eliminate the need for team-specific workarounds, allowing product teams to focus on their core business
Orchestrate Data Transformations
You'll implement strategies to harmonize different countries' data models without losing local flexibility and consolidate existing data into unified schemas
Build and Own What You Create
You'll be responsible for the entire lifecycle of your solutions, from initial design through long-term maintenance. We don't just design — we build, deploy, and maintain what we create

🌟 Why This Role Matters

Focus on High-Impact, Cross-Domain Solutions
You work exclusively on blockers that span multiple business domains that are heavily depended upon. This means every solution you build has an impact across multiple teams
Enable Teams, Don't Replace Them
Your job isn't to substitute other teams or globalize everything. Instead, you'll work on technical obstacles that prevent teams from building global-first solutions and work with them to remove those obstacles
Learn and Share Globalization Patterns
As you design and implement global solutions, you'll develop an expertise in globalization patterns. You'll share these learnings with other teams, helping them make better decisions about global vs. local solutions in their own work

🚀 What we're looking for

You write code and maintain what you build. At Alan there is no architect in an ivory tower, we implement what we design
You’re able to navigate complex systems spanning multiple business domains and technical boundaries
You've worked with diverse architectural patterns and can articulate the nuanced trade-offs between them
You can spot technical obstacles that are blocking multiple teams and design solutions that remove those obstacles

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

We are looking for problem-solver engineers with 5+ years of experience who get excited about simplifying complex business problems:

You’ll be able to tackle high-impact & high-risk projects involving many engineers.
You’ll design efficient systems and engineering practices to align with and facilitate interactions between multiple teams/products.
You’ll have the opportunity to mentor other engineers & lead crews (more details in this article).
You’ll be able to contribute to hiring your future coworkers and shape candidates’ hiring experience (improving our technical assessment process etc...)

You would be a good fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you:

Well-versed in Object Oriented Programming such as Python, Java, C#, and enthusiastic about web technologies such as modern Javascript.
Willing to work in Python/JavaScript (but you don’t need to have experience with those 2 languages!).
Passionate about building products.
Self-starting and entrepreneurial.
Humble and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!).
Collaborative, enthusiastic about teamwork, learning, and teaching.
Fluent in English (no need to speak French!).

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-F level range.

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need,
and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time
with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

Fair rewards
. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.
Flexible Office
. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.
All the tools you need
. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and noise-canceling headphones.
Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours
. Organize your time as you wish.
Delightful healthcare insurance:
Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).
Transport
. Country-specific commuter benefits.
Learning & Training opportunities.
A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.
Personal growth through coaching
: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk -
it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.
Learn more about our coaching culture
.

Parental leave.
Extended parental leave for all new parents.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you.
Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman
: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

🔄 A quick note about the process

Note: While you're applying for a specific area,, you may join a different engineering team based on where we think you'll have the most impact. Check out descriptions of other areas here .

jobs.description:
Challenge yourself and us

At AdvanceWorks, we learn together, grow together, and have fun together. And we do all this while creating great software solutions for clients across many industries and geographies.
We are constantly challenging ourselves and each other to use the latest technologies and the best methodologies and make sure we walk the talk.

About the project

You’ll join a technology team working in a collaborating environment closely with Data Scientists, DevOps, Software Architecture, and Platform teams.
The project focuses on bringing machine learning solutions from experimentation into production, building scalable services and reusable frameworks that enable ML solutions to be developed, deployed, and operated efficiently at scale.
You’ll contribute to the full machine learning lifecycle, from data collection and processing strategies to model training, evaluation, deployment, and inference services. You’ll work on production-grade solutions, helping establish common technical frameworks, accelerate the adoption of machine learning practices, and promote the reuse and sharing of solutions across projects and departments.
This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of software engineering, cloud technologies, data engineering, and machine learning, contributing to business-critical solutions in a collaborative and technically driven environment.

What will be your role

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer with strong software development skills and a solid understanding of machine learning technologies and production environments.
You’ll be responsible for working closely with Data Scientists to productionize machine learning models, developing robust and scalable APIs and inference services, and contributing to the design of frameworks and platforms that support machine learning solutions at scale.
You’ll participate in the development of end-to-end ML pipelines, working across data processing, model training and evaluation, deployment, and production inference. You’ll also collaborate with DevOps, Software Architecture, and Platform teams to ensure that ML solutions are scalable, reliable, maintainable, and aligned with engineering best practices.

Your responsibilities will include

Working closely with Data Scientists to bring machine learning services and models into production.
Designing, developing, and maintaining robust and scalable web APIs to serve machine learning models.
Developing frameworks and reusable technical solutions for recurring machine learning problems.
Promoting the adoption of common frameworks and engineering practices that accelerate the delivery of machine learning solutions at scale.
Contributing to the design and implementation of machine learning pipelines, from data collection and processing strategies to model training, evaluation, deployment, and inference.
Developing and maintaining production-grade inference services and supporting their integration with other systems.
Collaborating with DevOps, Software Architecture, and Platform teams to design scalable and reliable ML solutions.
Working with cloud platforms and cloud-native services to support machine learning workloads and production deployments.
Contributing to data processing solutions using technologies such as Spark, Beam, or Flink.
Working with streaming and messaging platforms, particularly Kafka, where applicable to ML and data pipelines.
Contributing to the automation of infrastructure and processes for training, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models.
Implementing unit tests and following software engineering best practices throughout the development lifecycle.
Using Git and established build and release processes to ensure reliable software delivery.
Contributing to containerized solutions using Docker and Kubernetes.
Monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuously improving production ML services and supporting infrastructure.
Contributing regularly to the documentation of systems, frameworks, tools, APIs, and technical processes.
Promoting knowledge sharing and the reuse of solutions across projects and departments.
Participating in technical discussions and contributing to architectural and engineering decisions.

What should you bring to the team?

Professional experience in software development and machine learning engineering.
Strong programming skills in at least one object-oriented programming language, such as C# or Java.
Professional experience with Python and familiarity with its use in data science and machine learning environments.
Familiarity with machine learning frameworks and libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and/or Scikit-Learn.
Clear understanding of the machine learning lifecycle, from data preparation and model development to evaluation, deployment, and inference.
Experience with data processing technologies such as Spark, Beam, Flink, or similar.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Good knowledge of SQL and/or other query languages such as Spark SQL.
Experience working with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra, or similar.

Stefanini Group is seeking an experienced Network Technical Architect to join our Hybrid Cloud & Infrastructure (HCI) cluster, within the Infrastructure Services Division.

The successful candidate will design and implement secure, resilient enterprise network solutions across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments, covering SASE, ZTNA, next-generation firewalls, SD-WAN, and complex routing.

This role combines presales support for solutioning with extensive hands-on implementation and acts as the last level of support for operational teams. It may include occasional travelling and direct technical discussions with vendors.

Job Responsibilities:

Solution Design and Implementation: Architect, deploy, and migrate enterprise network solutions end to end, including SASE, ZTNA, next-generation firewalls, SD-WAN, and campus and data center networks, remaining hands-on from day 1.
Presales Support: Act as the technical authority in presales engagements, qualifying requirements, designing target architectures, estimating effort, and contributing to RFP/RFI responses, proposals, and customer presentations.
Complex Routing and Cloud Networking: Design and implement complex routing environments (BGP, OSPF, route redistribution, traffic engineering) and cloud networking architectures in AWS and Azure, including hybrid connectivity.
Operational Escalation: Act as the last level of support for operational teams, leading root cause analysis and resolution of the most complex network and security incidents.
Vendor Engagement: Drive technical discussions with vendors and technology partners, including product evaluations, proof of concepts, roadmap reviews, and support escalations.
Documentation and Standards: Produce high-level and low-level designs, migration plans, and operational runbooks; define network standards, reference architectures, and best practices.
Training and Development: Provide training, coaching, and structured knowledge transfer to operational teams and clients on new network technologies and practices.
Continuous Improvement: Continuously evaluate and improve network architectures and strategies to adapt to changing technologies and business needs.

Job Requirements

At least 10 years of hands-on experience designing, implementing, and operating enterprise networks in complex, multi-vendor environments
At least 5 years of experience as a network architect, owning end-to-end solution design for large-scale enterprise environments.
Demonstrated ability to perform hands-on implementation from day 1, combining architecture responsibilities with direct configuration and deployment work.

Strong hands-on experience with SASE and ZTNA solutions (e.g., FortiSASE, Zscaler, Netskope,Prisma Access), from architecture through rollout and day-2 operations.
Proven experience designing and deploying SD-WAN solutions (e.g., Fortinet Secure SD-WAN, Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN, VMware VeloCloud).
Solid experience with cloud networking in AWS and/or Azure, including VPC/VNet design, Transit Gateway, Virtual WAN, ExpressRoute/Direct Connect, and hybrid connectivity.
Strong understanding of network security concepts, including segmentation, IPsec and SSL VPN, IDS/IPS, and Zero Trust principles.
Mandatory 3 years of experience acting as technical project lead, driving the technical discussions with customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
Knowledge of network automation and scripting (e.g., Python, Ansible, REST APIs) is considered a plus.

Proficiency in English for professional communication and documentation.

jobs.title: Medior Full Stack Developer (.NET)
jobs.description:
Ben jij een Full Stack Developer die niet alleen enthousiast wordt van goede code, maar vooral van software die écht iets oplost voor de business? Vind je het leuk om met collega's uit verschillende onderdelen van de organisatie om tafel te gaan, processen te begrijpen en samen slimme oplossingen te bedenken? Dan zijn wij bij Amega op zoek naar jou!

Wat
ga je doen als Full Stack Developer?

Als Medior Full Stack Developer werk je aan applicaties en oplossingen binnen het Microsoft-domein. Je krijgt veel ruimte om mee te denken over zowel de technische oplossing als de vraag erachter. Je bouwt dus niet alleen wat er gevraagd wordt: je denkt mee, stelt vragen en helpt onze organisatie steeds slimmer en digitaler te werken.

Amega is continu in ontwikkeling. Binnen onze verschillende bedrijven en afdelingen zien we veel mogelijkheden om processen slimmer te maken met software en automatisering. Als Full Stack Developer speel jij daarin een belangrijke rol.

Je werkt nauw samen met collega's vanuit de business. Dat kunnen bijvoorbeeld collega's zijn uit sales, aftersales, finance, marketing of onze ondersteunende afdelingen. Samen breng je een vraagstuk terug tot de kern en vertaal je dit naar een passende softwareoplossing.

Vervolgens ben je ook zelf betrokken bij de realisatie. Van database en back-end tot gebruikersinterface: jij vindt het juist leuk om over de volle breedte van een applicatie mee te denken en te ontwikkelen.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

ontwikkelen en doorontwikkelen van interne applicaties en digitale oplossingen;
vertalen van wensen en processen uit de business naar concrete softwareoplossingen;
ontwikkelen van back-endfunctionaliteit met C# en .NET;
ontwikkelen van gebruiksvriendelijke webinterfaces;
bouwen en onderhouden van API's en integraties tussen verschillende systemen;
werken met databases, bijvoorbeeld Microsoft SQL Server;
meedenken over architectuur, kwaliteit, security en onderhoudbaarheid;
testen, reviewen en verbeteren van bestaande software;
signaleren van mogelijkheden om processen verder te automatiseren.

Je werkt daarbij niet vanaf een eiland. Juist het contact met gebruikers en collega's vinden we belangrijk. Soms begint je werk met een technisch vraagstuk, maar net zo vaak met een gesprek als: “We doen dit nu iedere dag handmatig, kan dat niet slimmer?” Daar krijg jij energie van.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij Amega krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan de verdere professionalisering van onze softwareontwikkeling. Je werkt in een organisatie waar veel gebeurt en waar digitalisering volop in ontwikkeling is. Daarnaast bieden wij jou:

veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief: Zie jij een betere technische oplossing of een kans om iets slimmer te organiseren? Dan horen we dat graag.
direct contact met de business: Je ziet voor wie je software maakt en ervaart ook daadwerkelijk wat jouw oplossing oplevert.
veel afwisseling: Door de diversiteit binnen Amega kom je in aanraking met uiteenlopende processen, systemen en vraagstukken.
hybride werken: Je combineert werken vanuit onze locatie in Dordrecht met thuiswerken.
ontwikkelmogelijkheden: Ruimte om jezelf technisch én persoonlijk verder te ontwikkelen door opleidingen, trainingen en praktijkervaring.
werken binnen het Microsoft-domein: Je werkt met technologie zoals .NET, C# en Microsoft SQL Server.
korte lijnen: Je werkt in een organisatie waarin je gemakkelijk kunt schakelen met collega's, management en andere afdelingen.
een marktconform salaris en goede arbeidsvoorwaarden passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring.
een informele werksfeer met enthousiaste collega's en een organisatie waarin samenwerken centraal staat.

Wat vragen wij van jou?

We zoeken geen developer die het liefst de hele dag met een koptelefoon op alleen tickets wegwerkt. Natuurlijk vinden we technische kennis belangrijk, maar minstens zo belangrijk vinden we jouw nieuwsgierigheid naar de organisatie achter de software.

Je wilt begrijpen hoe processen werken, waarom gebruikers bepaalde wensen hebben en hoe technologie hen écht verder kan c.

Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:

HBO werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld richting Informatica, Software Engineering of vergelijkbaar;
enkele jaren relevante ervaring als softwareontwikkelaar;
goede kennis van C# en .NET;
ervaring met webontwikkeling, zowel back-end als front-end;
ervaring met API's, integraties en databases;
ervaring met Microsoft SQL Server;
ervaring met Git en moderne ontwikkelprocessen;
je schrijft graag duidelijke, onderhoudbare en goed testbare software;
je bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch en denkt graag in oplossingen;
je communiceert gemakkelijk met zowel technische als niet-technische collega's;
je vindt het leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen van vraagstuk tot werkende oplossing.

Je hoeft niet ieder onderdeel van onze technische omgeving al volledig te beheersen. We vinden het belangrijker dat je een goede technische basis hebt, breed geïnteresseerd bent en graag nieuwe technologie en bedrijfsprocessen leert kennen.

Hier kom je te werken

Je komt te werken binnen de ICT-organisatie van Amega in Dordrecht. Amega is een grote en groeiende automotive dealerholding waarin verschillende bedrijven en disciplines samenwerken rondom mobiliteit.

Die diversiteit maakt jouw werk als developer juist interessant. Achter onze organisatie zitten allerlei processen rondom auto's, klanten, werkplaatsen, verkoop, mobiliteit, finance en dienstverlening. En overal liggen mogelijkheden om met slimme software het verschil te maken.

Binnen ICT werken we samen aan het ondersteunen én verder ontwikkelen van de organisatie. Daarbij willen we steeds meer zelf kunnen bouwen, automatiseren en integreren.

Als Full Stack Developer krijg jij de kans om daarin vanaf het begin mee te denken en zichtbaar bij te dragen.

Waarom deze functie bij Amega?

Omdat je hier niet alleen aan software werkt.

Je werkt aan oplossingen waarvan je vaak letterlijk een paar dagen later van een collega kunt horen wat ze hebben opgeleverd. Je krijgt de ruimte om de business in te gaan, vragen te stellen en samen iets nieuws neer te zetten.

Dus ben jij een Full Stack Developer die graag code combineert met nieuwsgierigheid naar mensen, processen en business?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Waarom kiezen voor Amega?

Werken met de gaafste automerken!
Sluit je aan bij een groeiend en succesvol bedrijf
Grootste automotive dealerholding in de regio
Financieel sterkste automotive bedrijf van Nederland
Professionele en positieve familiesfeer waardoor medewerkers gemiddeld 10,5 jaar bij ons blijven werken
8,5 medewerkers tevredenheid

Met CI/CD, monitoring, security en bewezen engineering best practices draag je bij aan stabiele cloudomgevingen die dagelijks door duizenden gebruikers worden gebruikt.

Naast je opdrachten blijf je jezelf continu ontwikkelen. Je verdiept je in de nieuwste Azure-services, AI-tools en cloudontwikkelingen en deelt je kennis binnen de Codefield-community tijdens DEV-Days, kennissessies en andere technische events. Salaris tussen € 5.000 en € 7.000 per maand.

Leaseauto (inclusief tankpas voor privégebruik), OV Business Card of reiskostenvergoeding
25 vakantiedagen, 8,33% vakantiegeld en de mogelijkheid om 6 extra vakantiedagen bij te kopen

Volop ruimte en budget voor opleidingen, trainingen en Microsoft-certificeringen
€5.000 onboardingbudget voor je laptop, workgear en thuiswerkplek
DEV Community Days, wekelijkse borrels, padel, teamactiviteiten en een jaarlijks teamweekend
Een modern kantoor in Utrecht met goede koffie, een gameroom (simrig, PS5, pooltafel en dartbord) en volop ruimte om collega's te ontmoeten.

Technologieën waar je mee werkt

Geen opdracht is hetzelfde. Daarom werk je niet altijd met exact dezelfde technologieën. Afhankelijk van de opdrachtgever en het project kom je regelmatig onderstaande technieken tegen. Je hoeft niet overal ervaring mee te hebben, maar je vindt het leuk om jezelf hierin verder te ontwikkelen.
Azure App Services, Azure Functions, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Landingzones, Azure Networking, Azure Storage, Bicep, Microsoft Azure, Terraform

RESTful APIs
AI assisted development, GitHub Copilot

Je bent een ervaren Azure Cloud Developer die verder kijkt dan alleen code. Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Azure Cloud Developer, Azure Cloud Engineer of Platform Engineer.

Je voelt je thuis binnen Agile-, Scrum- en DevOps-teams.

Herken je jezelf niet in ieder punt, maar denk je dat Codefield goed bij jou past? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

jobs.title: MES/MOM Developer
jobs.description:
Fantastic challenges. Amazing opportunities.

GKN Aerospace is reimagining air travel: going further, faster and greener! Fuelled by great people whose expertise and creativity sets the standards in our industry, we’re inspired by the opportunities to innovate and break boundaries. We’re proud to play a part in protecting the world’s democracies. And we’re committed to putting sustainability at the centre of everything we do, opening up and protecting our planet. With over 16,000 employees across 32 manufacturing sites in 12 countries we serve over 90% of the world’s aircraft and engine manufacturers and achieved sales of £3.6bn in 2025. There are no limits to where you can take your career.

Job Summary

As MES/MOM engineer at GKN Aerospace in Papendrecht, The Netherlands, you will be involved in the Development, Implementation, Validation and Support of our Manufacturing Execution System (MES) solution based on Siemens Opcenter Execution, deployed at sites in the APAC, EU and NA regions.

Job Responsibilities

Support and maintain current MES deployments in multiple Production sites.
Package and deploy new GKN customization releases to Test and Production environments.
Install/upgrade and configure Opcenter for new implementations and deployments.
Set up and maintain integrations with surrounding applications using Opcenter Connect MOM.
Understand business processes and functional requirements and convert into technical specifications.
Translate functional and design specifications into MES objects: workflows, equipment classes, etc.
Develop custom logic when justified by a valid business case and no out of the box solution is available.
Define test specifications, participate in tests and validation.
Develop tools and templates to speed up the design process, make the support process more efficient and increase application stability and usability.
Conduct technical training when required to share development best practices.

Job Qualifications

To help us make a difference, you’ll bring your passion and talent for what you do along with the following skills, experience, qualifications and attributes:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, or equivalent work experience.
Minimum of 5 years of working experience in a similar role.
Extensive experience in Windows server administration, application management and configuration including IIS, certificates, services, firewall, Powershell.
Experience with Kubernetes and managing applications running as Docker Containers an
Extensive experience in Oracle/MS SQL database management and query methods.
Experience with Siemens Opcenter Execution (formerly known as Camstar), including Designer, Portal Studio, Opcenter Connect MOM or similar experience.
Experience with Mendix development.
Knowledge of basic programming languages such as .NET, HTML, C++/C#, XML/XSL/XSD, VB Script.
Experience in supporting and troubleshooting applications, ideally in the field of manufacturing or production.
Experience in supporting the implementation of software solutions and participating in IT projects.
Strong commitment and responsibility to maintain and support production environments.
Eagerness to expand current knowledge and learn new skills.
Strong verbal and written English communication skills, Dutch would be a plus.
Ability to work in multi-cultural environments, team player.
Willingness to travel.

What do we offer?

We are committed to offer you fantastic challenges and amazing opportunities, a career that can go in many directions thanks to our breadth of international opportunities. By being part of GKN Fokker Aerospace that has proven itself to be at the cutting edge of our industry, you will know that you will be working towards being the most trusted partner in the aerospace industry.

Role

In the role of MES\MOM Systems Developer/Engineer you will belong to an international team of experts. We will not only provide you with the conditions to perform at the best of your capabilities, but we will also support and promote your professional and personal development. Furthermore, we will offer you:

A gross monthly salary in scale K for a medior at € 3.952 up to € 5.715,- depending on your work experience,
8% holiday allowance,
40 paid holidays for full-time employment in line with the Collective Labor Agreement Metalektro (27 holidays and 13 ADV days),
An excellent pension scheme (PME) and travel allowance,
Hybrid working, giving you the opportunity to balance home and office working,
Profit sharing scheme,
A pleasant and informal working environment, in which we work together to achieve the best result for our customers.

Next to a competitive package, we will offer you a world of opportunities: we want to see your career fly! We will support your career progression by providing you with learning and development opportunities. That's the beauty of being part of a global business, once you're on board you never know where your career journey may take you!

We’ll offer you fantastic challenges and amazing opportunities. This is your chance to be part of an organisation that has proven itself to be at the cutting edge of our industry; and is committed to pushing the boundaries even further. And with some of the best training on offer in the industry, who knows how far you can go?

A Great Place to work needs a Great Way of Working

Everyone is welcome to apply to GKN. We believe that we can only achieve our ambitions through a coming together of diverse minds who enjoy collaborating in an inspirational environment. Through our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging and by living our five powerful principles we’ve created a culture where everyone feels welcome to contribute. It’s a culture that won us ‘The Best Workplace Culture Award’. By embracing and celebrating what makes us unique we encourage everyone to bring their full self to work.

We’re also committed to providing an accessible recruitment process, so if you require reasonable adjustments at any stage during our recruitment process please get in touch and let us know.

We are the place where human dreams, plus human endeavour, shape the future of aerospace innovation and technology.

Bon(ne) communicant(e), à l'écrit comme à l'oral, vous savez vulgariser des concepts techniques et adapter votre discours à des interlocuteurs non techniques.

Bonne maîtrise de Python.
Bonne maîtrise de JavaScript / TypeScript.
Développement backend.
Conception logicielle.
API REST.
Connaissance des outils d'IA générative (LLM, APIs d'IA, agents, MCP...).
Capacité à apprendre et mettre en œuvre rapidement de nouvelles technologies.
Compréhension des enjeux métier.
Anglais (courant)

Rejoindre une équipe Innovation expérimentée composée de quatre développeurs.

We're Capital on Tap 👋

💳 Capital on Tap started because small businesses were underserved. Big banks were slow, their products weren't fit for purpose, and small business owners often couldn't access what they needed. We set out to fix that.

Today we're a financial platform - not just a credit card company. We offer a best-in-class business credit card, SME-focused spend management platform, a savings product that hit £1 billion in funds within its first year, and a growing suite of tools and financial products that make running a small business easier.

1,000+ employees, £20bn in annual card spend, 200,000+ customers, 17,000+ Trustpilot reviews averaging 4.7 stars, and we're profitable. We've done a pretty good job so far, but we're just getting started!

🏡🏢This is a remote B2B contract role.

This is a multiple-headcount role, so please don't be put off if you've seen it advertised for a while.

The Role

We're looking for Software Engineers to help us build the products that small businesses across the UK and US rely on every day. You'll work across cross-functional teams alongside Product Managers, QA Engineers, and fellow Software Engineers, owning problems end to end, from the first line of code through to production, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

This isn't a role for someone who wants to be handed a ticket and told what to build. We're looking for engineers who understand the problem, challenge the approach when it needs it, and take pride in the quality of what they ship. We only build what the customer wants.

What You'll Be Doing

We're looking for Full stack Engineers to help us build the best credit card and payment products for small businesses. If you're looking for an environment where you're given the freedom to make empowered decisions, research new technologies, and learn/share knowledge with your peers. Then keep on reading!

You'll build robust and scalable solutions using .Net technology
From the first line of code to production, monitoring, and continuous improvement - you'll own the SDLC
You'll craft slick, responsive user interfaces with modern JavaScript frameworks (React), making sure our products don't just work, they feel great to use
Teamwork makes the dream work - you'll partner with Product Managers, QA's, and fellow Software Engineers
You'll build bulletproof unit and integration tests to keep our software sharp and our users happy
Bugs happen. When they do, you'll be ready to troubleshoot and tweak as needed
You'll bridge the gap between tech speak and business goals, ensuring everyone's on the same page and moving forward together

We're Looking For 🔎

Required skills:

A minimum of 3+ years hands-on experience in C#, .Net Core, SQL Server, ideally JavaScript and React also!
Good testing practices, in both Unit and Integration testing
Good understanding of database technologies
Experience in using Agile development practices
A passion for learning new skills and technologies
A proactive, supportive, and collaborative team player

Our Tech Stack

Backend: C#, .Net,
Frontend: React, JavaScript
Mobile: Flutter, Dart
Databases: SQL Server, MongoDB
Cloud: Azure & GCP

Interview Process 🤝

First stage: 30-minute intro, CV review, and values with a Talent Partner

Diversity & Inclusion

jobs.title: .NET-utvecklare till riskbedömning
jobs.description:
Att jobba som . NET utvecklare

Vill du utveckla moderna försäkringslösningar och samtidigt få möjlighet att påverka både teknik och arbetssätt?

Hos oss blir du en del av ett erfaret team där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och dialog är en naturlig del av vardagen. Du får arbeta nära verksamheten och användarna, vilket ger dig snabb återkoppling på det du utvecklar och möjlighet att se hur dina lösningar används i praktiken.

Här får du dessutom vara med i en spännande teknisk förflyttning. Vi har lanserat den första versionen av vårt nya riskbedömningssystem och fortsätter nu utvecklingen samtidigt som äldre lösningar successivt ersätts.

Därför kan det här vara jobbet för dig:

Du får kombinera nyutveckling och förvaltning och följa lösningar hela vägen från kod till produktion.
Du arbetar med verksamhetskritiska lösningar som bland annat används för digital hälsodeklaration och medicinsk riskbedömning.
Du får arbeta i ett erfaret team med nära samarbete och frekvent feedback från verksamheten.
Du får möjlighet att bredda din kompetens mellan .NET och React, oavsett om din tyngdpunkt idag ligger inom backend eller frontend.
Du har flera möjliga utvecklingsvägar framåt, exempelvis mot systemansvar, Scrum Master eller mjukvaruarkitektur.

Som .NET-utvecklare arbetar du med utveckling och förvaltning av applikationerna i teamets portfölj. En viktig del är vår digitala hälsodeklaration och vårt riskbedömningssystem med regelmotor och handläggarstöd. Rollen innebär att du successivt bygger upp förståelse för helheten och tar ansvar för lösningarna även efter att de gått i produktion.

Dina Huvudsakliga Arbetsuppgifter Är Att

utveckla och vidareutveckla lösningar i .NET och React
arbeta med felsökning, incidenthantering och förvaltning
testa din egen kod och delta aktivt i code reviews
hantera release och deploy samt arbeta med Azure DevOps och Octopus Deploy
arbeta med SQL, integrationer och teamets olika applikationer
samarbeta med bland annat riskbedömare, processägare och andra utvecklingsteam
bidra med idéer, feedback och problemlösning tillsammans med dina kollegor.

Vi är 8 personer i teamet som består av bland annat utvecklare, testare, Product Owner, Scrum Master och mjukvaruarkitekt. Vi utgår från vårt huvudkontor på Kungsholmen i Stockholm och arbetar hybrid, med en kombination av arbete på kontoret och på distans. Du rapporterar till gruppchef IT inom IT Risk & Hälsa.

För att lyckas i rollen

Vi söker dig med omkring fem års erfarenhet av systemutveckling och som relativt snabbt kan bidra i teamets leveranser. Du har erfarenhet av .NET-utveckling och gärna React, men det viktiga är att du är nyfiken på helheten och vill utvecklas över gränserna mellan frontend och backend.

Du behöver kunna kommunicera väl på svenska i tal och skrift. Kunskaper inom SQL, Azure DevOps, CI/CD och releasehantering eller motsvarande är värdefulla eftersom du arbetar med hela utvecklingskedjan. Erfarenhet från försäkringsbranschen är meriterande.

Som person är du är noggrann, ansvarstagande och problemlösningsorienterad med förmåga att självständigt planera ditt arbete. Du söker orsaken när problem uppstår och tar dem vidare till en lösning, vilket är viktigt i arbetet med nyutveckling, förvaltning, felsökning och incidenthantering.

Samarbete och kommunikation är en naturlig del av rollen. Du delar kunskap, lyfter frågor och kan ge och ta emot feedback på ett konstruktivt sätt. Vi uppskattar också din nyfikenhet och vilja att sätta dig in i nya områden och förstå helheten.

Vad händer nu?

Vi jobbar med löpande urval så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet.

Läs mer om hela vår rekryteringsprocess här.

Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef (namn på chefen) på (mailadress).

Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocess, vänligen ta kontakt med rekryterande chef Patric Wu via patric.wu@skandia.se eller Talent Acquisition Partner på madelene.skogh@skandia.se.

Vi kommer att återkoppla till alla som söker oavsett om du går vidare eller inte.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Mer om IT

Vi på Skandia IT är stolta över att vara en kundorienterad enhet som levererar effektiva och säkra lösningar för våra kunder. Med cirka 600 engagerade medarbetare är vi mitt i en spännande transformationsresa, där vi utvecklas tillsammans och har kul på vägen. Framåt tillsammans är vårt motto! 

Vi arbetar agilt och har sedan 2017 använt oss av SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) ramverket, där leverans och kundvärde alltid står i centrum. Våra tågledningar och team, jobbar verksamhetsbaserat med aktiviteter som sprintplanering, daily stand-ups, team-synk, code reviews och retrospektiv. 

Var 12:e vecka samlas vi alla i vår ljusa och inspirerande Ljusgård på kontoret i Stockholm för 2 planeringsdagar. Planeringsperioden består av 6 tvåveckorssprintar, där den sista sprinten är en innovationssprint. Här får du chansen att, själv eller tillsammans med ditt team, utveckla och förfina våra system.

jobs.title: .NET utvikler
jobs.description:
Fra solid .NET-utvikling til praktisk AI: vil du være med fra starten?

Handelshøyskolen BI
er Norges største handelshøyskole og en selveid stiftelse med et tydelig samfunnsoppdrag. Vår forskning og utdanning bidrar til å løse samfunnets største utfordringer. Vi gir virksomheter kunnskapen de trenger for å lykkes, og mennesker muligheten til å bygge meningsfylte karrierer.

Endringstakten i samfunnet, teknologisk utvikling, KI, cybersikkerhet og nye forventninger fra studenter, spesielt etter pandemien krever en klar digital strategi. Derfor har vi de siste årene jobbet strategisk med å utvikle BI Digital som består av rundt 80 ansatte som er organisert i ulike produkt-team og som både bygger videre på markedsledende SaaS løsninger og egenutviklede og egenforvaltede løsninger.

Digitalavdelingen ved Handelshøyskolen BI utvikler tjenester som skaper en sømløs digital hverdag for våre 24 000 studenter, 1 000 ansatte og 300 000+alumni.

Nyopprettet initiativ og nyopprettede stillinger

BI har etablert en tverrfaglig AI Enabler Group (AEG) for å akselerere bruk av kunstig intelligens i hele organisasjonen. Vi samarbeider med forskningsmiljøer, undervisningsmiljøer og administrative avdelinger for å identifisere muligheter, gjennomføre pilotprosjekter og bidra til at vellykkede initiativer tas videre i organisasjonen. Målet er å bygge varig AI-kompetanse og styrke BIs evne til å ta i bruk kunstig intelligens på tvers av organisasjonen.

Vi skal nå rekruttere to hands-on og rådgivende utviklere med solid .NET erfaring og AI interesse til å bli med på denne spennende reisen sammen med oss.

Rollene

Som AI-utvikler vil du få en sentral rolle i BIs videre digitale utvikling. Du vil jobbe med å utforske, prototype og utvikle løsninger basert på generativ AI, LLM-er, RAG, søk, dokumentbehandling, integrasjoner og agentbaserte arbeidsflyter.

Du vil samarbeide tett med produktteam, arkitekter, utviklere og fagmiljøer for å forstå behov, teste hypoteser og bygge løsninger som kan tas videre fra idé til praktisk bruk. I rollen vil du også vurdere AI-verktøy og rammeverk opp mot BIs behov, arkitektur og krav til sikkerhet, personvern og etterlevelse, bidra til tekniske standarder og beste praksis, støtte overgangen fra eksperiment til produksjon og dele erfaringer på tvers av organisasjonen.

Du vil blant annet jobbe med

Microsoft Azure og Azure AI Foundry
Azure OpenAI og moderne språkmodeller
.NET/C# og API-utvikling
Designe og bygge løsninger basert på språkmodeller (LLM-er), RAG, agenter, søk, dokumentbehandling og automatisering
Integrasjoner mot BIs systemlandskap
CI/CD og moderne DevOps-praksis

Rollene er 100 % dedikert til AEG, men du vil samtidig være en del av Digital og inngå i et sterkt fagmiljø med utviklere, arkitekter og produktledere. Avhengig av initiativer og behov kan du også bidra i prioriterte utviklingsprosjekter utenfor de rene KI-løsningene.

Du vil også spille en viktig rolle i å bygge bro mellom eksperimentering og produksjon, og bidra til at vellykkede AI-initiativer kan skaleres og skape verdi i organisasjonen. For den rette kandidaten vil det være mulighet til å få et særskilt faglig lederansvar som Tech Lead eller lignende og bidra til å forme den tekniske retningen for AI-satsingen på BI.

Hvem er du?

Du er en utvikler med sterk teknisk forståelse, nysgjerrighet og evne til å lære raskt. Du trenger ikke nødvendigvis å ha jobbet lenge med AI, men du bør ha interesse for teknologien og helst ha testet ut AI-verktøy i utviklingsarbeid eller egne prosjekter. Du er initiativrik, selvdreven og trives med å samarbeide tett med både tekniske og ikke-tekniske miljøer.

Vi ser etter deg som har:

Solid erfaring med programvareutvikling innen .NET/C#, skyplattformer og integrasjoner
Erfaring med eller sterk interesse for generativ AI, språkmodeller, RAG, agenter eller tilsvarende AI-teknologier
Evne til å bygge prototyper, teste nye ideer og gjøre teknologi praktisk anvendbar
Erfaring med smidige utviklingsmetoder og tverrfaglige team
Høyere utdanning innen datateknologi, IT, informatikk eller tilsvarende
Gode kommunikasjonsevner på norsk og engelsk

Vi er opptatt av å finne de rette menneskene. Det viktigste er ikke hvor lenge du har jobbet med AI, men at du har solid .NET utviklingskompetanse, lærelyst og evne til å omsette ny teknologi til løsninger som skaper verdi i praksis med spesielt fokus på AI. Du har faglig trygghet til å kvalitetssikre og videreutvikle løsninger som bygges med støtte fra AI. Du trives med komplekse problemstillinger, arbeider selvstendig og evner å kommunisere tekniske avveininger til både tekniske og ikke-tekniske interessenter.

Hva kan vi tilby?

Nyopprettede stillinger med stor påvirkningskraft hvor du kan være med å forme egen rolle
Muligheten til å være med på å bygge opp et nytt AI-miljø og påvirke hvordan kunstig intelligens tas i bruk ved en av Nordens ledende handelshøyskoler med stor innflytelse på fremtidens arbeidsliv
En solid og trygg arbeidsplass, i en virksomhet som investerer betydelig i digitale tjenester hvor du vil følge løsningene du er med på å skape over tid, og få tid til å fordype deg i våre produkter og en spennende sektor.
Du får dyktige fagfolk rundt deg å lære av, gode utviklingsmuligheter, deriblant kurs og muligheter for gratis videreutdanning.
Og ja, hos oss får du en fleksibel og familievennlig arbeidshverdag med fokus på balanse mellom jobb og privatliv, deriblant fri i romjulen og påskeuken i tillegg til fem ukers ferie.
Konkurransedyktige betingelser samt gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

Høres dette spennende ut?

Da håper vi du sender oss din CV i dag og noen ord om hvorfor du er interessert og passer.

Er du egentlig ikke på utkikk etter ny jobb, men ble nysgjerrig og vil vite mer, er du velkommen til å ta kontakt med vår rekrutteringspartner i Glasspaper People, Marianne Støen på telefon 920 35 260 og Thomas Schibbye på telefon 410 43 853.

Om Handelshøyskolen BI

Handelshøyskolen BI er en privat, uavhengig og internasjonalt akkreditert institusjon for forskning og høyere utdanning innenfor økonomi og ledelse. Med trippel akkreditering (EQUIS, AMBA, AACSB), en bred forskningsportefølje, 1.000 ansatte, 20.000 studenter og 300.000 alumni, er BI blant Europas ledende handelshøyskoler.

BIs Strategi 2030 har definert tydelige mål for å sikre at skolen leverer kunnskap som forandrer gjennom førsteklasses forskning og enestående læringsopplevelser. Dette gir virksomheter innsikt for å lykkes og enkeltpersoner muligheten til å bygge meningsfulle karrierer.
BIs hovedcampus ligger i Oslo, med tilleggscampuser i Bergen, Stavanger og Trondheim.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
EasyPost is looking for a hands-on Senior Software Engineer to help build and operate our secure document-delivery platform.

Our customers use EasyPost to send invoices and business documents through channels such as Peppol e-invoicing, Belgian eBox, electronic registered delivery, e-signing, email and print. Behind this experience is a large event-driven AWS platform that processes sensitive documents, integrates with external providers and coordinates long-running delivery workflows.

You will take ownership of features from technical design through production. This role focuses on backend and cloud engineering. You will work closely with our team lead, product management and other engineers to design reliable, secure and maintainable solutions.

As one of the team’s senior engineers, you will also help shape the platform’s architecture, evaluate technical trade-offs and turn business requirements into practical technical designs.

What You Will Do

Design and develop TypeScript services, AWS Lambda functions and NestJS APIs.
Build and maintain serverless infrastructure using AWS CDK.
Translate business requirements into clear technical designs together with the team lead.
Contribute to architectural decisions and document their context, trade-offs and consequences.
Create resilient event-driven workflows that handle retries, duplicate events, timeouts, concurrency and partial failures.
Integrate with external e-invoicing, e-delivery and e-signing providers through APIs and webhooks.
Work with AWS services such as Lambda, DynamoDB, EventBridge, SQS, Step Functions, API Gateway, S3 and CloudWatch.
Apply security practices including encryption, least-privilege access, audit logging and safe handling of sensitive data.
Write unit, integration and end-to-end tests using Jest.
Monitor production systems and investigate issues across application code, AWS infrastructure and external integrations.
Review code, mentor colleagues and raise engineering standards across the team.
Improve our development, CI/CD and deployment processes.
Collaborate with frontend engineers to ensure backend services and APIs support complete, reliable user journeys.

As part of our international Principal Engineers team
, you’ll craft tailor-made solutions that wow our clients. We’re hunting for a passionate Principal Cloud Engineer with a solid technical background. Your mission is not just to build infrastructure, but to design, evolve and scale cloud-native and AI-driven platforms
that are secure, resilient, and production-ready.
This role is for engineers who enjoy owning architecture decisions
, working close to product and AI teams, and pushing cloud platforms to the next level.

Here’s the deal:
You'll tackle the unique challenges of cloud infrastructure, working alongside a team of brilliant minds to build scalable and reliable solutions.
You’ll dive into cutting-edge projects using the latest tech to push boundaries and make an impact.
Whether you prefer working from home or vibing with us at our offices, the choice is yours.
AGILE isn’t just a buzzword here, it’s how we roll. Multidisciplinary teams? Check. Full ownership of projects? Double check.

You will be responsible for:

Design and lead cloud architectures on Azure
, covering networking, security, governance, IaaS, PaaS and serverless solutions.
Ensure the technical quality of proposals,
RFP responses and solution definitions within the discipline.
Own the shared knowledge strategy of the Chapters
, ensuring relevant content, documentation and best practices are available.
Lead the mentoring framework
within the Chapter, enabling senior engineers to guide practitioners at all levels.
Helps to identify strong technical talent
across the company that aligns with the discipline.
Identify emerging trends and opportunities, validating new services, accelerators and reusable assets.
Own the infrastructure of AI-powered platforms
, including conversational AI systems with: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Document ingestion, processing and vector search and Integration with LLM providers and AI services.
Build and evolve CI/CD pipelines
for both application and infrastructure, following DevSecOps best practices.
Develop Infrastructure as Code
(Terraform) with a strong focus on reusability, scalability and maintainability.
Design and operate production-grade environments
, ensuring: High availability and performance, monitoring, logging and observability and cost optimization and reliability
Collaborate closely with AI, data and software teams
to productionize ML/LLM solutions (MLOps mindset). Actively propose improvements and new technical approaches
, contributing to architectural decisions and technical roadmaps.
Work in Agile, autonomous, multidisciplinary teams
, with real ownership from design to production.

What are we looking for?

Strong experience with Microsoft Azure
in real production environments.
8+ years of hands-on experience
in Cloud / Platform Engineering roles.
Ability to engage with clients
, understand their needs, and design technical proposals
tailored to business goals.
Experience in technical presales
, including demos, solutioning, and proposal writing.
Capable of leading projects independently and mentoring other engineers.
Proven experience designing and implementing IaaS, PaaS and cloud-native architectures
.
Solid knowledge of networking, security and governance models
in cloud environments.
Experience with Azure DevOps
(Repos, Pipelines) or similar and CI/CD practices.
Strong background in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
.
Experience monitoring and operating high-traffic, production web platforms
.
Familiarity with AI/ML or LLM-based platforms
in production environments.
Comfortable working with Agile methodologies
, Jira and Confluence.
Fluent English (mandatory)
— you’ll work daily with international teams and clients.

Very nice to have:

Experience in hybrid and multi-cloud environments
(AWS / GCP).
Kubernetes
and container orchestration knowledge.
Experience with GitHub
and GitHub Actions.
MLOps practices
(model lifecycle, deployment, monitoring, retraining).
Scripting skills (PowerShell, Bash, Python).
Software development background (Python, Go, .NET or similar).
Experience with observability tools
(Azure Monitor, App Insights, Prometheus, Grafana, etc.).
A proactive mindset: autonomy, technical leadership and continuous improvement.

What do we offer?

Salary determined by the market and your experience 🤑
Flexible schedule 35 Hours / Week 😎
Fully remote work (optional) 🌍
Flexible compensation (restaurant, transport, and childcare) ✌
Fully free health insurance, with a co-payment for dental services 🚑
Individual budget for training or equipment and free Microsoft certifications 📚
English lessons 🗽
Birthday day off 🌴🥳
Monthly bonus for electricity and Internet expenses at home 💻
Discount on gym plan and sports activities 🔝
Plain Camp (annual team-building event) 🎪
Extra perks: events attendance and speakers, welcome pack, baby basket, Christmas basket, discount portal for employees ➕ The pleasure of always working with the latest technological tools!

Will you let us know you better?

The selection process: Simple, just 3 steps.
Phone screen
2 interviews with the team 🤘

What is Plain Concepts?

Plain Concepts is a global company of over 500 people passionate about technology and innovation. Since our founding, we have grown through technical proficiency and confidence in ideas that others might consider risky, creating custom solutions for our clients. With offices in more than 6 countries, our mission is to continue to drive cuttingedge projects around the world.

We are highly committed to technical excellence. We are known for developing highly customized projects, offering specialized technical consultancy and training.

Thanks to the great work of our technicians, we have been recognized for our ability to lead innovative projects that generate value, from artificial intelligence to blockchain, driving solutions that help companies optimize their performance.

What we do at Plain Concepts?

We pride ourselves on being a 100% technical team, dedicated to crafting custom projects from scratch, offering expert technical consultancy, and providing top-tier training.

Our approach goes beyond traditional outsourcing; we focus on creating value together with our clients.
Our teams are diverse and multidisciplinary, operating in a flat, collaborative structure.
We live and breathe AGILE principles, ensuring flexibility and efficiency in everything we do.
Knowledge-sharing is at our core: from supporting each other internally to contributing to the broader tech community through conferences, events, and talks.
Innovation drives us — even the boldest ideas are welcome here.
Transparency underpins all our relationships, fostering trust and long-term partnerships.

jobs.title: Associate Applied (AI) Value Engineer (Nordics) - Orbit Program
jobs.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

Location: Madrid for an onboarding period of 2 years and a possible relocation to Stockholm or Copenhagen after. Customer base will be in the Nordics region, involving travel to meet clients in person.

Start date: 1st of February 2027.

Role Description

As an Applied (AI) Value Engineer you are pushing the envelope in solving business-critical problems for our customers. You are part of our Value Engineering team and are the trusted advisor for customers working on the intersection of technology and business. You will be working with our most strategic customers, understanding their objectives and key challenges, and building Celonis solutions using the world’s leading Process Intelligence (PI) platform in combination with the largest AI and ML technology partners, such as Microsoft, OpenAI and Databricks. With Celonis’ Process Intelligence (PI) platform we feed operational context to AI so it understands our customers’ business and enables them to industrialize AI unlocking real ROI on AI deployments and at scale. There is no AI without PI. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to Executives and ensure successful implementation, adoption and value realization in order to increase the footprint of Celonis at those customers.

Launch Your Enterprise Software Career - Orbit Graduate program

Kickstart your career in enterprise software through our immersive 12-month Orbit Program.

During the Orbit Graduate program, you will be joining the Global VE Center of Excellence which is an international, diverse, and dynamic organization at the core of the Celonis Value Engineering team supporting our local field teams. As a team, we enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and share a sense of belonging to an international community that wants to learn and grow together. The team culture is one based on building trust, continuous development, and improvement through coaching & mentoring.

This program offers a unique blend of client engagements, dedicated mentorship, and a strong team culture where collaboration and shared success are paramount. You'll leverage your technical background to develop essential skills, build lasting client relationships, and establish yourself as a trusted advisor, paving the way for significant career growth within Celonis.

Your journey begins with comprehensive onboarding and enablement, followed by hands-on experience in customer engagements and targeted training. You will gain expertise in:

Discovery & AI Solutioning
Building and coding within the Celonis platform (SQL, PQL and Python)
Scoping business and technical requirements
Effectively handling objections
Developing industry domain knowledge
Delivering impactful presentations and demos
Understanding value selling and realization
Managing customer accounts

What You'll Do:

AI Discovery & Solutioning: Understand customers AI strategy and business critical challenges. As Celonis product & domain expert, find the best problem-solution fit and translate customer requirements into innovative solutions that move the needle
Hackathons & Prototyping: Think out of the box, have a “can-do“ attitude and don’t shy away from complex problems. Leverage cutting edge AI technologies to rapidly build creative prototypes in customer hackathons solving business critical problems
Agentic Process Transformation: Support our customers in achieving real ROI out of AI deployments at scale enabling a fundamental shift in business operations from traditional, rule-based automation to the use of autonomous AI agents empowered by our Celonis Process Intelligence Platform
Proof Projects: End-to-end execution of business-critical Proof-of-Value projects showcasing the value of Celonis Process Intelligence tailored to customers and align our solutions with their AI strategy.
Specialize in Domains or Industries: To scale knowledge across the organization specialize in domains (e.g. supply chain) and industries
Business Impact Presentations: Articulate and quantify strategic business value for customers, delivering impactful presentations to senior executives to ensure successful value realization for customers.
Ensure Successful Project Outcome: Applied AI Value Engineers stay involved with projects until agreed value & adoption thresholds are reached
Best Practice Modeling: Contribute to the Global Value Engineering Center of Excellence by creating reusable collateral, best practices, and tools.

What You Need:

Degree in Engineering, Data Analytics/Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related STEM field.
Excellent academic performance
Extensive internship experience or 1-2 years of full-time work experience. Ideally at the intersection of business and technology.
Understanding of generative AI techniques like RAG, few shot learning, prompt/context engineering, multi-agent orchestration, multimodal understanding, or fine-tuning that are used to build high-impact use cases like intelligent chatbots and automated text processors.
Good knowledge of Python and common ML libraries (such as LangChain, pandas, pydantic, sklearn, PyTorch) as well as data engineering tools and technologies.
Excellent analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with the ability to apply technology to business challenges.
A customer-centric mindset with a focus on delivering value.
Confidence in presenting to diverse audiences.
A proactive approach to problem-solving, with a willingness to learn from mistakes.
Curiosity, self-motivation, a commitment to continuous learning, and the desire to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and execute on deadlines.
Excellent communication skills and fluency in English and at least one Nordic language (Finnish, Danish, Norwegian, Swedish, etc.).
Foundational business acumen and domain understanding, e.g. in areas such as Supply Chain.

Bonus Points:

Degrees combining technical (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science) and business (e.g., Economics, Marketing) skills.
Customer-facing, customer success/service, or sales experience.
Hands-on experience with technical Proof of Concept projects
Hands-on experience building agentic systems using LLM orchestration, RAG, function calling, and prompt engineering
Working knowledge of tools in the LLM ecosystem such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or other OSS packages.
Supply Chain process experience (Procurement, Order Management, Inventory Management, Production).
Experience modeling ROI and TCO for business case justification.
Experience with ERPs such as SAP and/or Oracle

What Celonis can offer you:

Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Stefanini Group is seeking an experienced Network Technical Architect to join our Hybrid Cloud & Infrastructure (HCI) cluster, within the Infrastructure Services Division.

The successful candidate will design and implement secure, resilient enterprise network solutions across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments, covering SASE, ZTNA, next-generation firewalls, SD-WAN, and complex routing.

This role combines presales support for solutioning with extensive hands-on implementation and acts as the last level of support for operational teams. It may include occasional travelling and direct technical discussions with vendors.

Job Responsibilities:

Solution Design and Implementation: Architect, deploy, and migrate enterprise network solutions end to end, including SASE, ZTNA, next-generation firewalls, SD-WAN, and campus and data center networks, remaining hands-on from day 1.
Presales Support: Act as the technical authority in presales engagements, qualifying requirements, designing target architectures, estimating effort, and contributing to RFP/RFI responses, proposals, and customer presentations.
Complex Routing and Cloud Networking: Design and implement complex routing environments (BGP, OSPF, route redistribution, traffic engineering) and cloud networking architectures in AWS and Azure, including hybrid connectivity.
Operational Escalation: Act as the last level of support for operational teams, leading root cause analysis and resolution of the most complex network and security incidents.
Vendor Engagement: Drive technical discussions with vendors and technology partners, including product evaluations, proof of concepts, roadmap reviews, and support escalations.
Documentation and Standards: Produce high-level and low-level designs, migration plans, and operational runbooks; define network standards, reference architectures, and best practices.
Training and Development: Provide training, coaching, and structured knowledge transfer to operational teams and clients on new network technologies and practices.
Continuous Improvement: Continuously evaluate and improve network architectures and strategies to adapt to changing technologies and business needs.

Job Requirements

At least 10 years of hands-on experience designing, implementing, and operating enterprise networks in complex, multi-vendor environments
At least 5 years of experience as a network architect, owning end-to-end solution design for large-scale enterprise environments.
Demonstrated ability to perform hands-on implementation from day 1, combining architecture responsibilities with direct configuration and deployment work.
Preferred: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field preferred. Mandatory: Minimum high school diploma (or equivalent). Bachelor's degree in any field with equivalent professional experience relevant for the job.

Technical Skills:

Expert-level knowledge of routing and switching in complex environments, including BGP, OSPF,route redistribution, and traffic engineering.
Deep hands-on experience with next-generation firewalls (e.g., Fortinet FortiGate, Palo Alto Networks, Check Point), covering design, implementation, upgrades, and migrations.
Strong hands-on experience with SASE and ZTNA solutions (e.g., FortiSASE, Zscaler, Netskope,Prisma Access), from architecture through rollout and day-2 operations.
Proven experience designing and deploying SD-WAN solutions (e.g., Fortinet Secure SD-WAN, Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN, VMware VeloCloud).
Solid experience with cloud networking in AWS and/or Azure, including VPC/VNet design, Transit Gateway, Virtual WAN, ExpressRoute/Direct Connect, and hybrid connectivity.
Strong understanding of network security concepts, including segmentation, IPsec and SSL VPN, IDS/IPS, and Zero Trust principles.
Mandatory 3 years of experience acting as technical project lead, driving the technical discussions with customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
Knowledge of network automation and scripting (e.g., Python, Ansible, REST APIs) is considered a plus.

Soft Skills

Proficiency in English for professional communication and documentation.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and multitasking skills capable of handling a vast variety of systems.
Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to stay effective under pressure during critical incidents and escalations
Client Orientation & Communication
Accountability
Adapting & responding to chang
Teamwork & cooperation

.

As a Quality & Support Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of software applications through comprehensive testing strategies while providing technical support to maintain optimal system performance. You will design and implement automated testing solutions, troubleshoot application issues, and work closely with development teams to deliver high-quality digital solutions across Lockton MENA operations.

Collaborate with product teams and external vendors to resolve complex problems.

Update user guides and FAQs to aid in problem-solving and user training.
Maintain knowledge base articles for common issues and solutions.
Document system configurations and technical procedures.

User Support and Training
