Assist in the development of training materials and user documentation.
Conduct user training sessions and workshops as needed.
Support user onboarding for new applications and system updates.

Collaboration and Communication
Work with cross-functional teams, including product teams and business units, to implement improvements and solutions.
Communicate issues effectively to stakeholders and participate in resolution planning.
Coordinate with vendors and third-party providers for application support.
Participate in project teams for application implementations and upgrades.

Identify opportunities to improve application efficiency and user experience.
Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies relevant to supported applications.
Recommend process improvements and automation opportunities.
Contribute to the development of best practices for application support.

Required Qualifications

Experience
4-6 years of experience in quality assurance, automated testing, or application support roles.
Proven experience in designing and implementing automated testing frameworks.
Experience with both manual and automated testing methodologies.
Experience in troubleshooting application issues and providing technical support.

Technical Skills
Proficiency with automated testing tools, particularly Playwright, Selenium, or similar frameworks.
Strong experience with test automation in CI/CD pipelines.
Knowledge of programming languages for test scripting (JavaScript, Python, or Java).
Experience with SQL databases and data validation techniques.
Proficiency in using diagnostic tools and understanding error logs.
Experience with application monitoring tools and ticketing systems.
Understanding of web technologies, APIs, and system integrations.

Education

Experience with performance testing tools and methodologies.
Knowledge of security testing practices and tools.
Experience in insurance or financial services industry.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Ability to work collaboratively within a team and across departments.
Adaptability to new tools and technologies as required.
Organizational skills with ability to prioritize tasks effectively.
Quick learner with adaptability to new technologies.

Flexible work arrangements available depending on company policy and operational needs.

Uitstekende beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als de Engelse taal in woord en geschrift.

Werken in kleine zelfsturende teams bestaande uit experts in je vakgebied.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
CSQ327R45

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) you will work with customers to build and productionize solutions to their data & AI challenges using the Databricks platform. You will own the architecture, lead design decisions, and implement end-to-end systems spanning data engineering, AI, and application development. We work cross-functionally to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives alongside engineering, product, and developer relations. FDEs deliver with customer empathy, integrating with client systems, training, and other technical needs to help customers get most value out of their data.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for builders who thrive at the intersection of technology and business impact. The ideal candidate combines engineering expertise with adaptability, curiosity, and a passion for working with customers and teammates to solve complex problems that drive measurable outcomes. FDEs are billable and know how to complete projects according to specification with exceptional customer empathy.

The Impact You Will Have

Production Solution Delivery: Lead impactful customer technical projects by delivering production-grade systems, designing and building reference architectures, custom applications and data ingestion and ML/AI model integration
Transformational Impact: Guide strategic customers as they implement transformational big data projects including end-to-end design, build and deployment of industry-leading big data and AI applications. Work with engagement managers to scope technical delivery work with input from the customer
Empower Customers: Guide customers on architecture and design; bootstrap or implement customer projects which leads to a customers' successful understanding, evaluation and adoption of Databricks.
Own the Architecture: Lead architecture and design decisions, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with both customer needs and Databricks best practices.
Work with the Databricks technical team, Project Manager, Architect and Customer team to ensure the technical components of the engagement are delivered to meet customer's needs.
Work with Engineering and Databricks Customer Support to provide product and implementation feedback and to guide rapid resolution for engagement specific product and support issues.
Customer Immersion: Embed with customer teams, engaging with stakeholders from technical ICs to executives to deeply understand challenges and deliver impact.
Reusable Assets & Scale: Contribute accelerators, frameworks, and best practices that scale impact across accounts and influence the Databricks product roadmap.

What We Look For

Extensive experience in data engineering, data platforms & analytics, or software engineering
Comfortable writing code in either Python, Scala, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks
Working knowledge of two or more common Cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP) with expertise in at least one
Deep experience with distributed computing with Apache Spark™ and knowledge of Spark runtime internals
Familiarity with CI/CD for production deployments
Working knowledge of MLOps, ML/AI models and AI APIs
Design and deployment of performant production end-to-end data architectures and applications that combine data pipelines, ML/AI models, and user-facing interfaces.
Experience with technical project delivery - managing scope, timelines and measurable outcomes, translating complex concepts into actionable solutions.
Documentation and white-boarding skills.
Experience working with enterprise clients and managing conflicts across a broad stakeholder range
Build skills in technical areas, and demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and eagerness to explore new technologies which support the deployment and integration of Databricks-based solutions to complete customer projects.
Travel to customers 20% of the time
Databricks Certification

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

Benefits

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

An exciting opportunity to kick-start your career as a junior software engineer

- someone who likes connecting systems, figuring out how different technologies work together, and building practical solutions that make things happen.
You’ll be working across a range of projects and products, helping to integrate services, move data between systems, and turn complex processes into reliable, working software. We don’t expect you to know everything upfront - what matters most is your curiosity, your willingness to learn by doing, and your interest in understanding how real-world systems fit together.

Responsibilities

You will help create and test software within a skilled team that likes getting things done.

There is flexibility in shaping the role around your strengths and interests, but some of the key technical areas you might encounter are listed below:

You’ll gain experience of a range of full-stack relevant technologies such as:

Python, C#

Complex data-platform architecture, multi-tenant, partitioned, and access-controlled environments supporting secure and scalable data access
Docker & Microservices
Modern Web Applications built in React.js, and TypeScript

You are someone who enjoys learning new skills, finding out things and also learning from mistakes. We’d like you to be reliable, curious, and ready to deal with problems and get them solved. We strongly encourage those from under-represented groups to be confident in applying to us.

You will also be keen to contribute ideas to both the business and the social side of the company.

Life Assurance
Private Healthcare Cover
Work related training courses as required
Complimentary snacks and refreshments including fresh fruit
Office-Centric role

Secure bike storage and shower facilities
Social events

Join an award-winning team, named ‘ The Sunday Times Best Medium-sized Technology Company 2025’ . At One Big Circle, you’ll be part of a fast-growing team where your ideas and contributions are truly valued.

WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology business is a global leader in P&C, Life and Health insurance software and advisory services, with over 1,700 colleagues across 35 markets. jobs.description:
What Makes Us, Us  

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!  

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT FOR US

SimCorp is investing in the integration layer of SimCorp One. We are looking for a Platform Test Architect to extend our platform capabilities for automated, repeatable cross-system testing, the crucial layer between system tests and end-to-end flows. Your work will enable product and platform teams to validate release candidates after the merge gate and qualify deliveries at scale across our service ecosystem.

You will work closely with our Application Test Architect to cover the full testing spectrum. In addition, you will collaborate with architects responsible for platform services, engineering pipelines, and infrastructure to ensure testing capabilities integrate seamlessly into our delivery processes. Your focus will be on platform capabilities and execution, while our Application Test Architect leads application-side practices and client-facing testing coordination. Together with other architects, you will close today’s gaps and establish modern, scalable testing as a first-class engineering concern.

What You Will Be Responsible For

To ensure success in this role, you will be involved in the following areas:

Integration testing platform: Design and deliver a shared platform for integration testing of SimCorp One services (Microsoft Azure, Azure Kubernetes Service, .NET), enabling teams to add, run, and automate cross-system tests efficiently and repeatedly.
Quality gates: Operationalize post-merge quality gates for release candidates, including contract and application programming interface testing, integration suites, sanity and smoke tests, and define the process for exceptions or waivers.
Drive requirements: Help standardize testing capabilities in our eco-system and define how systems can test integration patterns.
Adoption and enablement: Drive organization-wide adoption through templates, reference implementations, and recommended practices that teams can extend.
Test data and environments: Define the strategy for test data and environments, including synthetic data, data masking, and production-equivalent snapshots, in collaboration with our operations and platform teams.
Performance and load testing: Lay the groundwork for performance and load testing as a future phase, including tooling choices, service level agreements, and monitoring.
Documentation and alignment: Document and align at scale by authoring reference architecture documents, patterns, and playbooks; publishing via the Architecture Hub; and measuring adoption and impact.

Your role will be pivotal in ensuring that SimCorp remains an efficient, transparent leader in financial services, directly contributing to our strategic objectives and long-term success.

What We Value

To ensure success in this role, possessing one or more of the following skills will be highly beneficial:

Integration testing experience: Experience in building integration testing capabilities for service-based architectures at scale, ideally in a business-to-business or software-as-a-service context.
Cloud and platform expertise: Experience with Microsoft Azure and Azure Kubernetes Service; strong background in .NET.
Testing strategies: Knowledge of testing strategies, including black/grey/white box testing, consumer-driven contract testing, integration layering, pipeline governance, and quality gates.
Test data management: Practical experience with synthetic data approaches, data masking, and designing environments for testability.
Testing economy: Optimization of cost-of-testing, including experience with shift-left patterns and ability to formulate various tradeoffs when adhering to economic testing approaches.
Automation mindset: An automation-first mindset, with a track record of improving lead-time-for-changes, minimizing escaped defects, reducing failure rates, and increasing recovery speed.
Stakeholder management: Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive consensus across platform, application, Site Reliability Engineering, and product teams, and to remain resilient in complex or ambiguous situations.
Performance and security testing: Experience with performance and load testing, resilience testing, or security testing integration is a plus.
Compliance and best practices: Exposure to compliance frameworks such as Service Organization Control 2 (SOC2) or Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) is beneficial but not required.
Developer experience: Experience curating recommended practices and developer experience artifacts is valued.

These skills will empower you to contribute significantly to our service delivery strategy and help maintain the highest standards of communication and efficiency for our platforms and services.

How We Work

At SimCorp, we believe that our success is driven by the collaboration and innovation of our people. Here is what you can expect and what we hope you'll bring to our team:

Community leadership: You will be a key driver in the Testing Technical Collaboration Council, collaborating daily with platform and application architects, product owners, product managers, and value streams.
Decision rights and alignment: You will have architectural decision rights and ensure alignment with adjacent core areas, including security, compliance, Site Reliability Engineering, and product.
Testing review: As part of our architectural review of system and services, you will be responsible for reviewing the testing strategy of the system
Enablement and scaling: The role is focused on building foundations and guidelines for other teams to scale; documentation and alignment are essential.
Coaching and enablement: Parts of your time will be dedicated to the coaching and enablement of our Tech Leads and Engineering teams, with most of your time focused on architecture decisions and design.

Benefits   

Flexible working hours and hybrid model - 2 days in the office, 3 days remote
Modern office (next to Wilanowska metro station) with quiet zones and ergonomic workstations
Base salary with annual bonus structure 
Holiday allowance upon a 2-week vacation
Occasional remote work across Poland and international options available (up to 24 days domestic, 20 days international per year - subject to internal policy)
Employer-paid Medicover Platinum healthcare package (employee-paid family upgrade available)
Multisport card with 75% employer contribution
Unum group life insurance (employee-paid upgrade available)
Medicover travel insurance for private trips and global business travel insurance
Possibility to join Deutsche Börse Group Share Plan (eligible after 1 year)
Copyrights program for certain roles 
Possibility to develop your career in an international environment
Professional training and courses provided by SimCorp
Polish language classes for foreign employees; German and English classes based on business needs
Integration events, volunteering initiatives and employee-led clubs

NEXT STEPS 

Please click below to apply to learn more about the vacancy and what SimCorp has to offer regarding salary, benefits, and perks. Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your CV in English as soon as possible. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is the right fit, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process, we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of business and technology, helping our organisation move from manual and fragmented ways of working towards connected, scalable, and transparent processes.

The ability to influence, guide, and challenge stakeholders without relying on formal management authority.

*Research shows that some candidates often feel confident enough to apply when they meet about 60% of the job requirements, whereas other candidates tend to apply only when they meet all the criteria. If this role truly suits you but you’re unsure whether you meet every requirement, we would still love to hear from you.

About Virtual Vaults

Virtual Vaults is the leading data room provider in the Benelux and expanding rapidly across Europe. Founded to simplify and accelerate dealmaking for the mid-market, it has become the trusted partner for advisors and deal teams who value clarity, control, and speed. The platform brings preparation, diligence, and closing together in one connected environment, supported by transparent pricing and a customer success team that stays engaged at every stage. By reducing friction and cost while improving quality, Virtual Vaults helps dealmakers move faster and close with confidence.

From idea to production

You have a knack for turning unclear challenges into clear, actionable plans. You bring people together, drive decisions, and follow through to ensure solutions deliver real value. Because for you, the job isn’t finished when the code is merged. It’s finished when the outcome works for the people who depend on it.

We're looking for a hands-on senior engineer to join our Workspaces or Data Room team. You'll work across .NET, Angular, and Azure, using AI to support your engineering work and building AI capabilities into our products. You'll help shape the solution, write the code, and stay involved through release and production operations.

You’ll be part of a multidisciplinary team that combines different perspectives to build the best possible product. Together with a team lead, medior developers, QA engineers and product designers, you’ll collaborate closely to solve complex challenges, refine ideas, and deliver valuable solutions. Everyone contributes to shaping the product, and you’ll have the opportunity to influence both technical decisions and overall user experience.

What you will own

Delivery from start to finish
. Clarify requirements with your team, agree what success looks like, and take features through implementation, testing, release, and production verification. Close the follow-up work too.
A workable plan for complex problems.
Break projects and operational changes into manageable steps. Make dependencies and risks visible, identify a useful first release, and adjust the plan as you learn. Keep an overview of the whole process.
Clear, proactive communication.
Keep colleagues and stakeholders informed without waiting to be asked. Raise risks early, explain the trade-offs, and bring a recommendation. Present your work in team discussions and product demos.
Full-stack engineering.
Build and maintain backend services, frontend experiences, and infrastructure as code. Contribute to architecture, automated testing, performance, and safe delivery.
Practical AI.
Use coding assistants and agents thoughtfully, reviewing and testing their output. Build AI-enabled features and evaluate their usefulness, accuracy, security, cost, and latency.
Reliable, secure operation.
Help respond to incidents, investigate root causes, assess risks, and complete improvements that prevent repeat problems. Protect customer data throughout the system.
A stronger team
. Be a technical leader, share knowledge, review code, mentor colleagues, and welcome constructive challenges.

Ownership here is shared accountability, not doing everything alone. We value people who involve others early, ask for help when needed, and keep responsibility for the outcome.

What you will bring to the table

Your way of working

A track record of finishing substantial work. You can explain what you personally delivered, how you handled setbacks, and how you knew the result was working in production.
The ability to create structure when requirements are incomplete, coordinate across teams, and keep progress moving without repeated chasing.
Excellent spoken and written English (minimum C1 level). You can lead a technical discussion, write a precise update, and explain a complex issue to a non-technical colleague. Dutch is a strong plus.

Your engineering foundation

C# / .NET:
6+ years of professional C# development, with recent hands-on experience building and maintaining production services and APIs.
Angular / TypeScript:
Practical production experience and the ability to independently deliver the frontend side of a feature, not only its backend.
Azure and delivery:
Hands-on experience with Azure PaaS, containers, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and production troubleshooting. AI-200 (or AZ-204) certification is a plus.
Messaging:
Experience with Azure Service Bus or equivalent, including retries, duplicate delivery, and failure recovery.
Quality and security:
Automated testing, pragmatic architecture, safe releases, and a security-first approach. You understand tenant-scoped authorization, least privilege, secrets management, and keeping sensitive information out of logs.
Education:
A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.

AI is part of the basics

You use AI coding tools in your development workflow and can show how you check their output, catch mistakes, and protect confidential code and data through approved tooling.
You've implemented AI features or working prototypes and can explain your contribution and how you evaluated the results.
You understand large language models (LLMs), embeddings, vector search, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), including their limitations and when they are useful.
You understand Model Context Protocol (MCP) and how it connects AI applications to tools and data with authenticated, least-privilege access.
You account for hallucinations and prompt injection, enforce tenant authorization before retrieval or tool execution, and keep sensitive prompts, document contents, and personal data out of logs. You don't rely on prompts to enforce access control.

We're looking for practical application engineering and sound judgment, not a model-training specialist.

What we offer you

A hands-on role with room to influence both the product and how it's built. You'll work in an open, flat, collaborative team where sharing knowledge, asking questions, and improving the way we work are part of the job.
Salary: €6.000 – €7.500 depending on skills and experience
32-40 hours per week with flexible working hours (hybrid work, with 3 days in the office and 2 days from home, based on 40 hours per week
27 vacation days.
100% pension contribution paid by Virtual Vaults.
NS Business Card for commute, or a allowance of 23ct per kilometer (based on living a minimum of 10km from the office)
Training budget for personal and professional development
A professional, ambitious and informal work environment
Fun company events and team outings
Daily fresh lunch and fruit provided at the office

Let's talk

An informal video call (15-30 minutes):
We'll discuss your experience, what you're looking for, and the role.
An onsite interview with potential future colleagues (60 minutes)
: We'll explore the work you've delivered, how you approach complex problems, and your engineering and AI experience. There will be time for your questions, too. It will be a two-way conversation, to make sure you van also determine if we are a match for you.
A case, which is to be made at home:
You’ll work on a case that mirrors a real-world challenge. We’re interested not just in the end result, but also in how you think, prioritize, and solve problems.
Onsite case presentation (60 minutes):
You’ll present your case to the team and talk us through your reasoning, choices, and conclusion. It’s a chance for us to learn more about how you work and for you to get a feel for how we collaborate.
An offer
if we're a mutual match.

Apply with your CV and motivation.

Indra Group is paving the way to a more secure and better-connected future through innovative solutions, trusted relationships and the very best talent. Sustainability sits at the heart of its strategy and culture, driving efforts to address current and future social and environmental challenges.

Innovation

Trust

Transport for London (TfL) has awarded Indra a long-term contract to operate, develop, enhance and expand ticketing and access control systems across London's transport network through to 2034, with extension options to 2039.

Drawing on over 30 years of experience in urban public transport solutions, Indra will manage and evolve all aspects of the system. Job Description

Senior Software Engineer (.NET)

Competition Management & Digital Engagement (CMDE) | Sportradar

Company Description

We're the world's leading sports technology company, at the intersection between sports, media, and betting. More than 1,700 sports federations, media outlets, betting operators, and consumer platforms across 120 countries rely on our know-how and technology to boost their business.

About CMDE

Competition Management & Digital Engagement (CMDE) is a key engineering organization within Sportradar. We build and operate products that help sports organizations manage competitions, run tournaments, distribute sports content, and deliver high-quality digital experiences for fans.

Working with federations, leagues, governing bodies, event organizers, and other sports organizations, our teams develop reliable platforms for competition administration, scheduling, results management, statistics, content distribution, and fan-facing experiences.

Our systems support complex operational environments and must remain dependable, adaptable, and easy to operate at scale.

The Challenge

This is a role for an experienced developer who wants to own things, not just deliver them. You will take complex technical initiatives from design through production, work across a high-performing distributed team, and influence the architecture and engineering practices of strategically important CMDE platforms.

You will remain hands-on while helping modernize systems, improve reliability, and translate competition-management needs into scalable software capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and operate scalable, high-performance services and applications using C# and .NET.
Take independent ownership of complex technical initiatives from initial design through production delivery and continuous improvement.
Contribute to architecture decisions across distributed systems, APIs, cloud platforms, and event-driven services.
Guide platform modernization while balancing delivery needs, operational risk, technical debt, and long-term maintainability.
Mentor engineers through code review, pairing, design guidance, and constructive feedback.
Drive improvements in reliability, security, observability, performance, testing, and engineering practices.
Collaborate with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to connect technical decisions with customer and organizational value.
Build expertise across competition management, tournament operations, scheduling, results, statistics, and digital engagement.

About You

You are an experienced software developer who can independently design, build, and operate complex software systems. You combine deep .NET expertise with pragmatic judgment, enjoy solving challenging technical problems, and can influence engineering decisions beyond your immediate deliverables.

You communicate clearly, help other engineers grow, and understand that engineering excellence includes coperability, customer outcomes, and sustainable delivery.

Required Experience And Expertise

15+ years of professional software development experience, including responsibility for business-critical production systems.
Expert-level knowledge of C#, .NET, APIs, asynchronous programming, performance, testing, and modern software design practices.
Proven ability to design and operate distributed systems in production using cloud platforms and contemporary architecture patterns.
Independent ownership of complex initiatives, from architecture and delivery through production operation and incident learning.
A strong record of mentoring engineers and conducting technical reviews that are direct, constructive, and useful.
Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including the ability to explain trade-offs and build alignment around difficult decisions.
Experience with sports technology, competition-management platforms, enterprise SaaS, or similarly complex operational domains.
Demonstrated Snooker domain expertise, including competition structures, tournament formats, scheduling, scoring, results, statistics, and operational workflows.

Our Offer

A collaborative environment with colleagues from around the world, including engineering offices in Europe, Asia, and the United States.
The ability to shape your own workday and career through a clearly defined professional and personal development plan.
Opportunity to work with senior leadership and influence strategically important competition-management platforms.
A vibrant and inclusive community, including Women in Tech and Pride groups that welcome all participants.
Flexible working hours.

Sportradar | Competition Management & Digital Engagement

At Sportradar, we celebrate our diverse group of hardworking employees. Sportradar is committed to ensuring equal access to its programs, facilities, and employment opportunities. Tana Oy is a Finnish environmental technology company founded in 1971. We are one of the leading developers and providers of mobile equipment and solutions for solid waste management focusing on waste treatment companies and waste yards.

The company slogan is TANA From Waste to Value®. We not only produce the best fit-for-purpose machines designed to reduce the environmental impact of waste, but also provide tailored life cycle services, supported by a strong local presence and expertise. Our commitment to sustainability and core competence in innovative R&D ensure that we not only meet but exceed industry standards, delivering efficient solutions to our customers worldwide. Nowadays TANA machines are exported to more than 50 countries.

Are you inspired by connected machines, digital services and turning data into practical customer value? In this role, you will play an important part in developing Tana’s digital services portfolio, including TanaConnect, eSpares and future AI-enabled solutions.

Your responsibilities: 

As a Digital Solutions Engineer, you act as the link between business needs, solution users and software development teams. You ensure that digital solutions meet customer needs, support Tana’s long-term vision and deliver measurable value throughout their lifecycle.

You coordinate day-to-day cooperation with our digital development partners, including sprint activities, requirement clarification and development follow-up. You monitor progress and quality, ensure that agreed requirements are met and escalate technical, schedule or resource-related risks when needed.

You gather and analyze requirements from customers, dealers and Tana internal teams and translate them into clear technical specifications. You maintain development backlogs, coordinate acceptance testing and validate delivered functionality against the agreed requirements.

You support the continuous development of TanaConnect and other customer- and dealer-facing digital services. You contribute to the implementation of approved roadmap initiatives and releases and drive continuous improvement across the digital service lifecycle.

You also participate in the development of data-driven services, analytics and AI-enabled solutions. This includes initiatives related to predictive maintenance, intelligent reporting and machine performance monitoring, as well as evaluating new technologies and development opportunities.

In this role, you collaborate closely with customers, dealers, internal stakeholders and external partners in digitalization, integration and AI projects. Through your work, you help ensure that business needs, technical development and customer value remain aligned.

What we expect from you: 

We are looking for a technically minded professional with relevant education in software engineering, information technology, automation, data engineering or another related field. Equivalent practical experience may also provide a strong foundation for succeeding in the role.

You have previous experience in digital services, software products, industrial IoT solutions or a similar environment. You understand requirements engineering, backlog management, testing and release coordination, and are familiar with agile software development practices.

You have a good understanding of cloud services, APIs, integrations and data platforms. Experience in coordinating external development partners and working with multiple stakeholders is important.

Experience in fleet management, telematics, industrial IoT, mobile machinery, industrial equipment or heavy-duty vehicle environments is considered an advantage. Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Power BI, Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps or similar platforms is also beneficial. Experience in AI, machine learning, data analytics or predictive maintenance solutions would further support your success in the role.

You work systematically and take ownership of development topics, while remaining able to prioritize and respond pragmatically when requirements, schedules or technical circumstances change. You communicate clearly, cooperate effectively with different stakeholders and approach challenges with a solution-oriented mindset. Fluency in written and spoken English is required; Finnish is considered an advantage.

What we offer: 

You will become part of a skilled and collaborative R&D organization, where your work will directly influence how Tana’s connected machines and digital services evolve and create value for customers.

The position gives you the opportunity to broaden your expertise across industrial IoT, cloud technologies, data analytics and AI in an international technology company. You will work closely with engineering professionals, software development partners and stakeholders across the business, providing a wide perspective on both our products and customer needs.

Our culture is practical, open and collaborative, with a shared commitment to moving ideas into action. At Tana, you can make a tangible contribution to digital solutions used globally while supporting more efficient and sustainable waste management.

If you are ready to help shape the next generation of Tana’s digital services and turn connected-machine data into meaningful solutions, we would love to hear from you!

jobs.description:
Our partner is a growing Belgian group developing technology-driven solutions across mobility and energy.

As its different platforms, products and services continue to grow and become increasingly integrated, technology plays a central role in supporting scalability, operational excellence and compliance. The organisation is therefore looking for an Enterprise Solution Architect
to define and govern its future technology landscape.

In this role, you will ensure that applications, platforms, integrations, data flows, security and infrastructure evolve as one coherent and sustainable ecosystem. This is not a purely theoretical architecture position: you will combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, translating business and technology priorities into pragmatic architectural decisions.
You will also lead a focused architecture team of two specialists covering AI architecture and cloud infrastructure.

Your Responsibilities

Define and evolve the enterprise and target architecture across the organisation’s platforms, products and services, establishing clear architectural standards, principles and technology roadmaps.
Govern solution architecture across strategic initiatives, reviewing designs, defining reusable patterns and ensuring consistency across applications, integrations, data and security.
Identify technical debt, legacy components and unnecessary complexity, and drive simplification, standardisation and remediation initiatives.
Design an architecture capable of supporting continued growth, new business models and the integration of future acquisitions.
Own architecture-related security and compliance activities, including security reviews, risk and remediation follow-up and frameworks such as NIS2, GDPR and ISO 27001.
Lead and coach a two-person architecture team covering applied AI and AWS/Azure cloud infrastructure, setting priorities and acting as an escalation point for key architectural decisions.
Own enterprise data and integration architecture, including data governance, API and integration standards, while establishing architectural guidelines for AI and automation initiatives.
Act as a trusted advisor to management and senior stakeholders, translating complex technical topics into business language and creating alignment around long-term technology decisions.

Your Profile

You bring at least 10 years of experience in Solution Architecture, Enterprise Architecture or a related technology leadership role.
You have strong experience with complex enterprise application landscapes, integrations and technology transformation, including ERP, CRM and customer platforms.
You have a deep understanding of cloud environments, preferably Microsoft Azure and AWS, and experience reducing technical debt and simplifying technology landscapes.
You have strong knowledge of data architecture and governance, AI and automation, as well as security architecture and compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, GDPR and/or NIS2, including the operational follow-up of security activities.
You have experience leading or coordinating architects, technical experts or multidisciplinary technology teams.
You have worked in fast-growing or transformation environments, with exposure to mergers, acquisitions or organisational integration.
You combine strategic thinking with a pragmatic, hands-on approach, can influence senior stakeholders
You are fluent in English and either Dutch or French.

A strategic role with significant ownership and visibility across the organisation.
The opportunity to shape the technology landscape of a growing company active in sustainable mobility and energy.

, including an annual bonus.

Meal vouchers, pension insurance and hospitalisation insurance.
Flexible working arrangements, including homeworking and an internet allowance.
Access to training and development opportunities through the group’s academy.
Long-term career opportunities within a large and established Belgian group.

Ready for your next challenge?

Are you an experienced architect who enjoys combining long-term technology strategy with hands-on governance and execution?

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a broad technology landscape, lead a specialised architecture team and help shape how a growing organisation builds and scales its future technology ecosystem.

As a global biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the lives of patients with serious and rare diseases, you’ll be part of a community that prioritizes the human experience, celebrates curiosity, and values every person’s contributions to meaningful progress. That commitment has earned us recognition as Science magazine’s No. 1 Top Employer for five consecutive years, certification as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., and a place on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work list in the UK.
For patients, for each other, and for the future of science, we’re in. Are you?

About The Role

Here at Insmed we are building a cutting edge wet-lab and computational platform to develop therapies for rare genetic diseases.
We are looking for an exceptional full stack developer, who is also comfortable working close to our cloud infrastructure. As part of the Informatics and Data Science team, you will both build the bioinformatic web-ecosystem that empowers our scientists and assist in the deployment of services in our cloud infrastructure.
You will work in close collaboration with SW developers, DevOps engineers, bioinformaticians, human geneticists, machine learning / data science specialists, wet lab scientists. We are looking for someone who can blend production grade architecture and development of scientific code with expertise in CI/CD, platform scaling, and cloud infrastructure deployment.

What You'll Do

Be a key contributor in a dynamic, multidisciplinary team to help shape the future of data exploration and interpretation at Insmed
Contribute to the design and implementation of a flexible bioinformatic web-ecosystem empowering our wet-lab scientists and data scientists to get more out of their data
Engineer, optimise and validate internal pipelines to be flexible, scalable and configurable while maintaining production-quality standards
Promote data integrity and responsibility by employing best practices for data handling and storage, enabling broad-scale analyses
Liaise with stakeholders and external collaborators
Develop and deploy applications and data workflows on the organisation's cloud platform (mostly GCP)
Build and deploy containerised workloads onto the organisation's managed Kubernetes platform
Manage CI/CD pipelines, builds and Docker images (GitHub + GCP)
Support machine learning model deployment, training and inference

Who You Are

A degree (or equivalent experience) in computer science, engineering, bioinformatics, biology, machine learning, statistics or a related field.
Full-stack development experience, with strong coding skills in Python.
Experience in life-sciences applications, workflows, and systems in the fields of drug development, bioinformatics, or a related field
Experience designing, maintaining, and interfacing with SQL databases – preferably PostgreSQL.
Experience with cloud environments (especially GCP)
Experience with Docker and container-based workflows.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions).
Experience with version control using git, with familiarity of different branching and merging strategies.
Experience coding within a team
Excellent communication skills to collaborate with our computational, IT, and laboratory science teams.

JavaScript development skills – preferably Svelte
Experience deploying machine learning models and optimising deep-learning model training on GPUs
Experience with Kubernetes
Experience working with Pydantic & SQLAlchemy
Experience with Nextflow or other bioinformatics workflow languages
Experience with ArgoCD and Argo Workflows
UI/UX experience
Familiarity with event queues
Experience developing tools for drug discovery

Life at Insmed

Our research site in Cambridge, UK is situated in brand new labs and offices at the Babraham Research Campus—a leading hub for bioscience innovation and collaboration. Our team of biologists, human geneticists, bioinformaticians, data scientists, computational and synthetic chemists bring together a wide range of technologies and modalities to deliver powerful new ways of treating serious diseases.
At Insmed, you’ll find a culture as human as our mission—intentionally designed for the people behind it. You deserve a workplace that reflects the same care you bring to your work each day, with support for how you work, how you grow, and how you show up for patients, your team, and yourself.

Galderma is building a dedicated enterprise AI capability to deliver secure, scalable solutions across the organisation. As Manager of AI Engineering, you will lead the technical execution of our AI Factory, overseeing the architecture, engineering standards, and operational reliability of AI solutions from concept through to production.

Reporting to the Senior Manager of AI & Automation, you will translate business demand into robust technical designs, assess feasibility of new use cases, and ensure solutions are delivered with strong lifecycle management and production discipline. jobs.title: Product Engineer - Knowledge Intelligence Pod
jobs.description:
Reports to:
Knowledge Intelligence Pod (KIP) Lead

Working Pattern :
Full Time

Location:
Singapore

This role is based in Singapore and we're not able to offer relocation support for candidates outside this location. Applicants must already be based in or eligible to work in this location.

About Multiplier

Multiplier Holdings is a VC-backed startup that acquires and scales professional services firms with AI and automation. We operate in regulated, high-stakes verticals like tax and corporate accounting, where complex workflows and talent shortages make automation especially valuable.

Unlike traditional software vendors, we combine technology and service delivery under one roof, building in-house AI and workflow components configured per firm to boost efficiency and improve the experience for clients and staff. Learn more at multiplierholdings.com.

About The Knowledge Intelligence Pod

The Knowledge Intelligence Pod (KIP) is a vertical product team that owns knowledge-heavy product experiences end-to-end.

KIP helps firms and internal pods find the right information, extract the right facts, verify the evidence behind those facts, and use that knowledge to answer client information requests, prepare accounting working papers, and review documents. The team owns both user-facing product experiences and the core services behind them: document intelligence, search and retrieval, evidence/provenance, answering systems, evaluation, and quality loops.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior/Staff Engineer
to help define and build the technical foundation for KIP.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role spanning product engineering, systems architecture, applied AI, and correctness and reliability. You will write production code, design durable abstractions, set technical direction, mentor other engineers, and stay close enough to users to know whether the system is actually making professionals faster and more confident.

Beyond building these systems, you’ll own how they perform, scale, and stay reliable once real professionals depend on them.

What You'll Own

KIP already runs extraction, retrieval, review, and answering systems in real tax workflows. As Staff Engineer, you'll own the core and scale what's working:

Artifact-First Knowledge Platform

Evolve the core data model across documents, emails, uploads, and new sources.
Harden the workflow we run today: ingest, extract, correct, approve, search.
Extend the APIs behind extracted data, provenance, corrections, and approvals.
Push abstractions so new firms onboard without bespoke work.

Document Retrieval, Structuring, and Quality Control

Own the extractors, document analytics, and review surfaces in production.
Deepen structured outputs with confidence signals, provenance, and correction paths.
Expand observability: traces, prompt/model versions, failure modes, regressions.

Full-Stack Product Ownership

Own the review, correction, and answering surfaces professionals use.
Partner with tax professionals and accountants to automate their real workflows.
Turn ambiguous problems into scoped bets and shipped systems.

Technical Leadership

Set technical direction as systems scale across firms and pods.
Mentor engineers through design reviews, pairing, and hardening.
Raise the bar on testing, evals, observability, and security.
Partner with the Pod Lead to own the roadmap.

Who You Are

8+ years building software, including Staff-level technical leadership on complex systems.
Product-minded and close to users. You judge success by whether professionals work faster and trust the output, not just whether the system returned a response, and you'll sit with tax pros and accountants to watch real work firsthand.
Strong across the stack. You move comfortably between backend systems, APIs, data models, review UIs, and production debugging.
Ideally experienced with applied AI and/or financial systems and data. You've worked deeply with LLMs, retrieval, extraction, and agents, or with the data behind financial and accounting workflows.
Calm with ambiguity, high on ownership. You turn a fuzzy problem into a plan, a shipped system, and a measurable feedback loop, validating hypotheses and adapting as you learn, without waiting for perfect specs.
A strong technical communicator. You write crisp design docs, explain tradeoffs plainly, and align engineering, product, and domain experts around a path forward.

What This Role Is Not

A research-only AI role. You'll experiment with models, retrieval, and agents, but the job is shipping reliable systems into real workflows.
A prompt-engineering-only role. Prompting matters, but the hard work is systems design, evaluation, and earning user trust.
An internal platform or infrastructure-only role. KIP is a vertical product team measured by direct customer value, not internal tickets.
A pure people-management role. You'll lead technically and mentor engineers, but this is a hands-on Staff Engineer role.

Why Join Us

You'll help build the knowledge layer for AI-native professional services firms: the systems that turn messy documents, communications, and firm knowledge into structured, verifiable intelligence professionals can act on. KIP sits at the intersection of financial data and applied AI, where correctness is non-negotiable and the bar for accuracy is high.

The work is early enough that you can shape the architecture, engineering standards, and product direction, and real enough that you'll see whether staff trust what you build and whether it removes painful manual work. If you want to build applied AI systems that become dependable infrastructure for high-stakes professional work, this is it.

What We Offer

A high-impact Staff Engineer role shaping KIP's technical foundation, with direct access to real users and fast feedback loops.
Scope to influence architecture across extraction, retrieval, evaluation, and product surfaces.
Competitive salary plus performance-based bonus and equity.
Unlimited paid leave to rest and recharge.
Remote or flexible hybrid work depending on location.
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance.

Strong functional and technical command of standard Business Central modules, including Finance (GL, AP, AR), Supply Chain, Inventory, Purchasing, and Sales.

Proven experience maintaining source code, versioning, and automated build pipelines using GitHub Actions, AL Go for GitHub, or Azure DevOps.
Deep understanding of SQL Server fundamentals, Business Central telemetry, index tuning, and performance profiling to eliminate lockups and slow-running queries.

Practical experience navigating Microsoft AppSource validation workflows and technical compliance checks.

Experience implementing system interfaces such as APIs and working with structured data exchanged between different software systems
Understanding of data provenance, data quality, security, auditability or trusted-data mechanisms

Ability to work with colleagues and external partners and to translate technical requirements into implemented solutions.

jobs.title: Application Developer
jobs.description:
NAPA Design Solutions offers a comprehensive solution for 3D ship modeling and design tools covering hull form design and hydrodynamics, hydrostatics and stability, structural design, and information sharing across the shipbuilding process. These are among the most powerful tools in the industry, trusted by the world's largest shipyards and classification societies.

The role: what is it about?

The team is now looking for a Software Developer who will focus on application usability development with .NET, C#, WPF and XAML. Development, testing, and maintenance of the NAPA ship design solutions are part of your daily work. In this role you will mainly work on developing NAPA Engineer , a modern design and computing platform for naval architects. It combines trusted NAPA calculation capabilities with a redesigned, intuitive user experience and a powerful visual approach to engineering workflows. You can read more about the solution at: https://www.napa.fi/software-and-services/ship-design/software/napa-engineer/

You will do this work with artificial intelligence (AI) as a normal part of your toolchain. We use agentic coding capability across our development teams, which means using AI coding agents to plan, write, test, review and refactor code, and doing it in a way that improves both delivery speed and code quality. We expect you to use these tools in your daily work, to help us learn where they work well and where they do not, and to share those learnings with your team.

You will be working with Windows desktop applications, native libraries, third-party components, including a 3D graphics library, database engines, a licensing solution, and more
.
This job is permanent and full-time
.

Your team and job location

You will work in an international team where your closest colleagues are experienced software developers and naval architectural domain experts who will support you in your role. You will also interact with local and global colleagues
from various teams in software development, UX design, DevOps, and sales. Together with them you will also shape how we use AI coding agents in practice, from tooling choices to review practices.

Our office is located in Helsinki (Ruoholahti), and you can work at the office or in hybrid mode
.
We hope to meet you at our Helsinki office regularly. We require you to be eligible to work in Finland.

What are we looking for?

What matters most: you're curious about UI development, energized by AI-assisted development tools, and hungry to solve real problems as a self-starter
. If the visual side of UI excites you too, that's a big plus.

Our ideal candidate would have:

Academic degree in a relevant field such as computer science, mathematics, physics, naval architecture, or engineering
Completed basic studies and/or having a good understanding of algorithms, data structures, and OOP (object-oriented programming)
2+ years of experience in building native Windows desktop applications
Experience in UI design
Experience using WPF, C#, and XAML
Understanding of user experience and the ability to apply it in your own design work
Hands-on experience of using AI coding assistants or coding agents in real development work, together with the judgment to review, test and take responsibility for what they produce
Interest in NAPA’s domain (maritime business)

Additionally, the following skills would be considered an advantage:

Experience with agentic coding workflows
Knowledge or studies in usability
Experience with database solutions
Experience in automated testing methods
Knowledge of software reliability and maintainability
Experience in CAD or CAE applications

You do not need to tick every box on these lists. If this role feels like a good fit for you and you have most of what we are looking for, we hope you will apply.

We work in English
across all our offices, so you need to be comfortable using it in your daily work, both in writing and in conversation.

Why you will enjoy working in this role

You get to combine modern desktop application development on a next-generation engineering platform, combined with AI agentic development that we are scaling across the company
The design work of the world's largest shipyards and classification societies happens in the software you develop
Great colleagues with expertise in, for example, naval architecture, software development and UX design
A global team of 230 experts who support you and share what they know
When you join NAPA, you will be assigned an onboarding buddy who will help ensure a smooth start and introduce you to the NAPA way of working

Ready to get on board and join the napa crew?

We kindly ask you to send your application and CV to us as soon as possible (by clicking the "Apply for this job" button on the job ad page), but no later than 11 October 2026
. The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate has been found.

For more information about the position, please send your questions by e-mail to jobs@napa.fi . Notice that we cannot accept job applications sent by e-mail.

NAPA as a company and as an employer

With over 35 years of operation, NAPA is a leading software and data services provider for ship design and operations to enable safe, sustainable, and future-proof maritime industry. Headquartered in Finland, NAPA employs 230 experts, combining expertise in naval architecture, fleet operations and digital services. NAPA operates globally, with a presence in Japan, Korea, China, Singapore, the USA, Germany, Greece, Romania and India.

With over 90% of new vessels built by NAPA customers, NAPA’s ship design software is the global de facto standard in shipbuilding. Furthermore, NAPA is a market leader in ship stability management and safety data services for passenger ships, and its cloud-based solutions for ship performance monitoring and voyage optimization support shipping’s decarbonization journey. For more information, visit www.napa.fi .

Meaningful work

We are proud to play our part in creating a sustainable world, and a career at NAPA means working with a purpose. We focus on building the best possible products for our customers, with whom we have close and long-lasting relationships. We protect the environment and human life at sea by powering safer and greener vessels with our technology.

NAPA way of working

At NAPA, we lead and manage the company together. We help and learn from each other, while making impactful decisions for a cleaner, safer maritime industry.
At its heart, our co-leadership philosophy is founded on trust. We trust that our people are smart enough that if they make a decision, having consulted the right people, it will be good for our company. And if it's not the right decision on that occasion, that's fine too. We trust that we'll make it right, learn from the decision, and grow as a company as a result.

Enjoy working together

...is one of our core values. Learning from and respecting each other provides a healthy and pleasant working environment. We, as NAPArians, share our knowledge and help each other when needed. NAPA has offices and customers around the world, and you will be able to meet people from many different cultures. We are a diverse team with a shared goal.
Read more about our values and culture: https://www.napa.fi/careers/

jobs.description:
Über Uns

Seit unserer Gründung 1998 ist die QualityHosting auf Microsoft-Technologien für geschäftskritische IT-Anwendungen spezialisiert. Wir sind Microsoft Cloud Solution Provider (CSP) und Deutschlands Marktführer für Hosted Exchange. Unser Unternehmen bietet ein erweitertes Cloud-Portfolio inklusive Microsoft 365, Copilot & AI sowie leistungsfähige CloudServer für Unternehmen jeder Größe an.

Für unser Entwicklungsteam in Frankfurt am Main und Gelnhausen suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen erfahrenen Senior .NET Software Developer (m/w/d)
für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Cloud-Plattform.

Über unsere Web-Anwendungen beziehen und verwalten Kunden und Partner ihre Microsoft-Cloud-Services im Self-Service. Dazu gehören unter anderem:
unser Cloud-Marketplace zum Buchen und Verwalten von Abonnements
Verwaltungsportale für Endkunden und Reseller
Managed Security 365 zum laufenden Schutz von Microsoft-365-Umgebungen
Backend-Prozesse zur automatisierten Bereitstellung und Abrechnung von Microsoft-365-, CSP- und Azure-Diensten

Deine Aufgaben

Du entwickelst rund 50 bis 70 Prozent
deiner Zeit selbst – an den oben genannten Web-Anwendungen und Backend-Prozessen.
Du organisierst und priorisierst die Entwicklungsarbeit und sorgst dafür, dass das Team jederzeit Klarheit darüber hat, welche Themen als Nächstes umgesetzt werden.
Du verantwortest den Backlog und übersetzt Anforderungen aus Support, Account Management und Geschäftsführung in klar definierte und umsetzbare Arbeitspakete.
Du formulierst präzise Specs, mit denen sowohl Entwickler als auch Coding Agents zuverlässig arbeiten können.
Du strukturierst Aufgaben so, dass mehrere Claude-Code-Agenten parallel und möglichst konfliktfrei
arbeiten können, und planst Review-, Test- und Verifikationsschritte von Anfang an mit ein.
Du entwickelst unser technisches Projektgedächtnis aus CLAUDE.md, Claude Skills und MCP-Anbindungen
weiter und machst Wissen für Entwickler und Agents gleichermaßen nutzbar.
Du organisierst die Zusammenarbeit im Team mit leichtgewichtigen Sprints, Refinements und Retrospektiven – pragmatisch und passend zu unserer Teamgröße statt mit unnötigem Prozess-Overhead.
Du koordinierst Releases unserer .NET-Anwendungen und stellst sicher, dass vereinbarte Qualitätsstandards, Tests, Contracts und Definition of Done eingehalten werden.
Du stellst die Qualität der Umsetzung sicher und hinterfragst AI-generierten Code genauso kritisch wie menschlich geschriebenen Code.

Das bringst du mit

Mehrjährige professionelle Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit C# und .NET
, idealerweise an gewachsenen Anwendungen mit anspruchsvoller Fachlogik im produktiven Betrieb.
Praktische Erfahrung mit AI-gestützter bzw. agentischer Softwareentwicklung
, die deutlich über Autocomplete und einzelne Copilot-Vorschläge hinausgeht.
Idealerweise hast du bereits intensiv mit Claude Code
gearbeitet und Erfahrung damit, Specs für Agents zu schreiben, mehrere Agents parallel einzusetzen und Kontext bzw. Projektwissen strukturiert für Agents bereitzustellen.
Erfahrung mit agiler Arbeitsorganisation
, beispielsweise Scrum oder Kanban, sowie mit Priorisierung, Stakeholder-Management und Moderation. Zertifikate wie PSM oder CSM sind willkommen – gelebte Praxis ist uns wichtiger.
Eine ausgeprägte Verifikations- und Qualitätsorientierung: Du verlässt dich weder bei menschlichem noch bei AI-generiertem Code auf den ersten Entwurf, sondern setzt auf Tests, Reviews und Smoke-Checks.
Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.
Hands-on-Mentalität und Entscheidungsfreude. Du hast Lust, in einem kleinen Team mit flachen Hierarchien zwischen eigener Entwicklung, Organisation, Priorisierung und Qualitätssicherung zu wechseln.

Nice-To-Have

Erfahrung mit SaaS- und Self-Service-Anwendungen
, insbesondere Multi-Tenancy und Subscription-Modellen
Erfahrung mit cloud-nativer Architektur auf Azure
, beispielsweise Worker-Patterns, Managed Services und resilienten Architekturen
Claude Skills, MCP-Server oder Automatisierungen
rund um Claude Code
Microsoft-Cloud-Domänenwissen, beispielsweise CSP/Partner Center, Microsoft 365 oder Entra ID

Erfahrung mit CI/CD sowie GitHub Actions und Azure DevOps

Arbeiten, wie es zu dir passt
Hybrides Arbeiten ist bei uns keine Ausnahme, sondern Normalität: 2 Tage Home-Office, 3 Tage im Office – so bleibst du flexibel und trotzdem nah am Team.

Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag bei einem etablierten Cloud-Dienstleister mit Standorten in Frankfurt am Main und Gelnhausen.
Dein Budget, deine Entwicklung
2.000 € Weiterbildungsbudget pro Jahr – für Zertifizierungen, Konferenzen, Bücher oder Coaching. Plus kostenfreie Sprachkurse on top.

Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, bei der wir deinen Beitrag verdoppeln – plus ein faires Bonussystem on top.

Firmenrabatte bei Adidas, Apple, Expedia, home24 und vielen weiteren Partnern – plus 400 € jährliches Budget für unseren QualityHosting-Merch-Shop.

– Du arbeitest in einem motivierten Team, übernimmst Verantwortung und unterstützt Kunden und Kollegen, während du mit verschiedenen Branchen in Kontakt kommst, eigenverantwortlich Themen erarbeitest und die agile Projektpraxis kennenlernst. Du hast dein Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, Mathematik, Physik oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich überdurchschnittlich abgeschlossen und mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Umfeld Cloud, Data & AI gesammelt.

About The Company

TEKsystems, a leading technology services company, is dedicated to connecting talented professionals with innovative organizations worldwide. As part of Allegis Group, one of the largest staffing and services providers globally, TEKsystems specializes in delivering IT staffing, talent management, and IT consulting solutions. The company prides itself on fostering a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and technological excellence. With a strong focus on building diverse and inclusive teams, TEKsystems strives to create an environment where innovation thrives and employees are empowered to make meaningful contributions. Their commitment to delivering high-quality solutions has established TEKsystems as a trusted partner for organizations seeking to leverage cutting-edge technology to achieve their business objectives.

About The Role

The Azure Engineer role at TEKsystems is a vital position responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure, primarily utilizing Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). The ideal candidate will be a hands-on engineering professional with extensive experience in full-stack development and cloud infrastructure management. Strong proficiency in Java, especially with Spring Boot, REST API development, performance tuning, and testing strategies.
Hands-on experience with Python for service development and automation, preferably using frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask.
Proven experience in building and maintaining front-end applications with React, ideally leveraging TypeScript, modern hooks, and comprehensive testing methodologies.
Extensive experience managing workloads on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), including deployments, ingress, autoscaling, secrets management, and service-to-service communication.
Practical knowledge of containerization using Docker and deploying containerized applications.
Experience designing and executing deployment strategies such as blue/green deployments, canary releases, and rolling upgrades.
Strong understanding of Azure DevOps, with the ability to design and implement CI/CD pipelines incorporating automated testing, security scans, and environment management.
Knowledge of security best practices, including role-based access control, secrets management with Azure Key Vault, and identity management using OAuth2 and OIDC.
Excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills, with the ability to mentor team members and promote best practices across teams.

Responsibilities

The primary responsibilities of the Azure Engineer include:

Leading the end-to-end delivery of full-stack applications, including React (TypeScript) front-end applications and Java/Python back-end services, ensuring high standards of quality and performance.

Collaborating with cross-functional teams to plan delivery, manage risks, and ensure successful project outcomes.

Employees are empowered to take ownership of their projects, contribute to meaningful solutions, and grow their careers within a global organization committed to excellence in technology services.

jobs.description:
Role: Solution Architect - Data Platform

🟡 Languages: Fluent Polish & English
🟡 Location: 100% remote or hybrid - you choose. You can always book a desk in our office in our office in Warsaw or Cracow
🟡 Salary: B2B contract 150-200 PLN h/net + VAT
🟡 Long-term cooperation

You'll design data platforms and enterprise-scale data solutions on Azure, working across architecture, implementation and client needs. The role combines hands-on architectural work with close collaboration with implementation teams and stakeholders, from shaping the solution to supporting its delivery.

What you'll actually work on?

Gather requirements and translate business and technical needs into data platform architectures.
Design enterprise-scale Data Platforms, Data Warehouses, Data Lakehouses, ETL processes and Machine Learning solutions.
Identify where AI can add value within a data platform and help clients translate potential use cases into practical platform requirements.
Consider how data platforms should evolve to support AI-driven solutions, taking into account data availability, access, governance and scalability.
Define architecture across connectivity, authentication and authorization, CI/CD, data access, governance, scalability and cost management.
Work with clients on data strategy and help shape practical approaches to adopting and modernizing cloud data platforms.
Prepare cloud adoption roadmaps, project documentation, estimations and delivery timelines.
Support implementation teams from concept through delivery, providing architectural guidance and helping resolve complex technical challenges.
Stay close to evolving Data Platform and AI architecture patterns and assess how new capabilities can be applied to real project needs.

What you'll work with?

Azure | Databricks | Delta Lake | Delta Live Tables | Unity Catalog | Azure Data Factory | SQL | CI/CD | AI / ML

You'll work with Azure infrastructure and identity components, including VNETs and VMs, as well as Cloud Adoption Framework concepts across enterprise and data environments.

You'll probably enjoy working with us if...

You like turning complex business and technical requirements into architectures that teams can actually implement.
You're interested not only in building data platforms, but also in finding the right place for AI within them.
You enjoy exploring how AI can be supported by the underlying data, architecture and governance rather than treating it as a separate layer.
You enjoy working at both the strategic level and close to the technical details.
You are comfortable bringing different perspectives together and moving architectural decisions forward.
You can explain technical trade-offs clearly to business stakeholders, engineers and technology leaders.
You like taking ownership of difficult architectural questions rather than waiting for a predefined solution.
You keep an eye on how data platform and AI architecture is evolving and enjoy exploring what new capabilities can bring to projects.

This collaboration might not be for you if...

You're looking for one predictable project that will stay largely unchanged for the next few years.
You want to receive a finished specification, build exactly what's written there and move to the next topic.
You'd rather stay away from client conversations and collaboration with different stakeholders.

Elitmind is a consulting company.
Projects, clients, industries and technologies change. You'll collaborate with experienced people around you, but you'll also have a lot of freedom and responsibility for figuring out how to move your own area forward.

What collaboration with Elitmind looks like?

Help build Enterprise IQ

Build the Data & AI foundations behind more intelligent organizations, connecting data, analytics, AI and business context to turn technology into better decisions, smarter actions and measurable value.
Close to Microsoft

As one of Microsoft's key partners in Poland, we get early exposure to new technologies and solutions across the Microsoft ecosystem.
Strong Data & AI expertise

Collaborate with experienced Data & AI experts across different areas, technologies and enterprise projects.
Technology that keeps moving

Work across the Microsoft, Databricks and Snowflake ecosystems, with new technologies regularly explored and applied to real business challenges.
Different projects, different challenges

Our projects span different industries, technologies and business contexts, so there's always something new to solve.
Real autonomy

Take ownership of your scope and independently organize how you deliver the agreed outcomes.

Flexibility that works around your life

Choose where you work best and organize your working hours with flexibility. Work remotely or book a desk in our office whenever you want to collaborate or meet the team in person.

What we're looking for?

Strong practical knowledge of Azure and its data platform ecosystem.
Experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale Data Platforms, Data Warehouses, Data Lakehouses or Delta Lake solutions.
Hands-on experience with Databricks, including modern capabilities such as Delta Live Tables and Unity Catalog.
Good understanding of Azure infrastructure, networking and identity components.
Very good understanding of the Data perspective of the Cloud Adoption Framework and basic understanding of the Enterprise perspective.
Experience designing architecture covering connectivity, authentication, authorization, CI/CD, data access, governance, scalability and cost management.
Experience working directly with clients and different technical and business stakeholders.
Very good command of English.

Recruitment process

1. HR conversation

We talk about your experience, motivation and expectations, and give you the context you need to decide whether Elitmind makes sense for you.
2. Skills interview

You'll meet one of our experts and talk about your experience, previous projects and how you approach real problems relevant to the role.
3. Final conversation

You'll meet the person responsible for the area to talk about projects, expectations and mutual fit.

Whatever the outcome, you'll hear back from us. We provide feedback after our recruitment interviews because if you've invested your time in meeting us, you deserve to know where you stand.

You support the continuous development of TanaConnect and other customer- and dealer-facing digital services. You contribute to the implementation of approved roadmap initiatives and releases and drive continuous improvement across the digital service lifecycle.

You also participate in the development of data-driven services, analytics and AI-enabled solutions. This includes initiatives related to predictive maintenance, intelligent reporting and machine performance monitoring, as well as evaluating new technologies and development opportunities.
In this role, you collaborate closely with customers, dealers, internal stakeholders and external partners in digitalization, integration and AI projects. Through your work, you help ensure that business needs, technical development and customer value remain aligned.

What we expect from you:

We are looking for a technically minded professional with relevant education in software engineering, information technology, automation, data engineering or another related field. Equivalent practical experience may also provide a strong foundation for succeeding in the role.

You have previous experience in digital services, software products, industrial IoT solutions or a similar environment. You understand requirements engineering, backlog management, testing and release coordination, and are familiar with agile software development practices.

You have a good understanding of cloud services, APIs, integrations and data platforms. Experience in coordinating external development partners and working with multiple stakeholders is important.

You work systematically and take ownership of development topics, while remaining able to prioritize and respond pragmatically when requirements, schedules or technical circumstances change. The position gives you the opportunity to broaden your expertise across industrial IoT, cloud technologies, data analytics and AI in an international technology company. Our culture is practical, open and collaborative, with a shared commitment to moving ideas into action. At Tana, you can make a tangible contribution to digital solutions used globally while supporting more efficient and sustainable waste management.
