jobs.description:
Vous souhaitez rejoindre une entreprise qui place l’humain au cœur de ses préoccupations ? On vous attend chez Extia !

Société de conseil spécialisée dans les métiers de l’IT et du digital, Extia privilégie depuis sa création en 2007 une approche qui allie performance et bien-être au travail
. Une vision de l’entreprise partagée aujourd’hui par plus de 2 500 Extiens en France et à l'international et récompensée par le label Great Place to Work® depuis 15 ans
dont 10 ans sur le podium et 3 années consécutives à la première place du palmarès !

Nous croyons en l'égalité des chances et nous offrons à chaque candidat la possibilité de révéler son potentiel, sans distinction et de quelque nature qu'elle soit. Chez Extia, c’est « D’abord qui, ensuite quoi
» alors, allons-y !

Ayant soif d’apprendre
, vous aimez prendre part aux projets les plus novateurs,

Persévérant(e)
, vous ne perdez jamais, soit vous gagnez, soit vous apprenez,

Indépendant(e)
, vous appréciez une certaine liberté d’action,

Efficace
, vous ne remettez pas à demain ce qui peut être fait dès aujourd’hui.

Description Du Poste

Intégré(e) dans une équipe dynamique et passionnée, vous travaillerez principalement sur des serveurs Linux/Windows dans divers environnements Cloud tels que AWS ou Azure. Vous aurez pour mission :

D’identifier, comprendre et répondre aux besoins des clients,
De mettre en place et d’améliorer les systèmes de supervision de l'application et les outils de monitoring (SLI/SLO/SLA),
D'assurer la haute disponibilité, le bon fonctionnement, la stabilisation et la sécurisation des produits et des services,
D'installer et exploiter les plateformes de production au travers des outils d'orchestration et/ou de gestion de configuration notamment Puppet et Ansible,
D'assurer l'automatisation de toutes les tâches récurrentes,
D’orchestrer et automatiser les différentes chaînes d’intégration continue et de déploiement,
De maintenir à jour la documentation du projet.

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

Diplômé(e) d'une école d'ingénieurs ou équivalent Bac +5, vous justifiez d'une première expérience réussie en tant que SRE (Site Reliability Engineer) évoluant avec la culture DevOps (minimum 3 ans).
Vous maîtrisez un langage de développement informatique, idéalement Python, R, .Net ainsi qu'à minima un langage de scripting parmi Perl, Bash ou Shell.
Vous avez déjà eu l’opportunité de configurer ou de travailler avec des outils d’orchestration (Kubernetes) et des conteneurs comme Docker par exemple.
Une expérience sur Ansible et Puppet est un vrai plus.
Vous maîtrisez un outil d’intégration continue, idéalement Jenkins ou Gitlab CI.
Vous parlez Anglais, Français et/ou Néerlandais.

PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT

Échangez avec un ou une chargée de recrutement pour un premier contact téléphonique
Rencontrez un ou une Ingénieure d’Affaires (Business Manager) sur vos souhaits d’évolution
Approfondissez avec nos responsables et directeurs d’agence pour connaître la vision de l'agence

Selon votre profil, des tests ou entretiens techniques pourront vous être demandés. Tout au long du processus, vous pourrez échanger avec nos consultants pour en savoir + sur leur quotidien chez nous !

PACKAGE SALARIAL

Chez Extia Belgique IT, la transparence fait partie intégrante de l'expérience positive, voici un aperçu des éléments de package salarial dont peuvent profiter nos collaborateurs, sous réserve d'éligibilité

👛 Voiture de société ou budget mobilité ✨ Chèques repas & Ecocheque 🎁 Assurance groupe 🎉 Frais de représentation 📈 Plan cafétéria / Flex Income Plan 🚀 Primes d'apport d'affaire, de cooptation et de formation 🌍 20 jours de congés légaux + 12 jours de récupération

Ces informations sont communiquées à titre indicatif et seront abordées plus en détails lors du processus de recrutement.

LES PETITS PLUS

🎉 250 événements par an pour rencontrer tes collègues et des locaux feel good 📢 Des formations, conférences et une plateforme d'e-learning avec LinkedIn pour monter en compétences #greatplacetolearn 👩‍ Des Communautés Métiers et du Mentorat pour partager son expertise et en apprendre sur de nombreux sujets #greatplacetoshare 🕹️ Une communauté de e-sport : Extia Gaming ! #greatplacetoplay 🌏 Envie d’évoluer ? Grâce à notre politique de mobilité interne, explorez de nouvelles opportunités en Belgique ou dans l’un de nos 7 autres pays !

jobs.description:
Who are we?

We are part of the Alkemy Group, specializing in driving growth through our technological expertise, tackling complex challenges, and fostering operational excellence.

We are digital natives and technology-neutral thanks to our rapid adaptation capabilities and problem-solving skills in any business situation.
We are passionate about technology challenges that have a significant impact on business. To address these, we have high-performance teams and the ability to quickly and effectively combine technologies.
We support our clients in their digital evolution to achieve maximum efficiency in their businesses, leveraging our extensive multi-sector experience.

We invite you to get to know us in depth by exploring the various sections of our website.

What will you do?

Technology stack you will work with:

.NET Core
Messaging systems (Kafka, Azure Service Bus, etc.)
Application observability using the ELK Stack (Elasticsearch and Kibana)
Azure Key Vault, authentication with Service Principals and Managed Identities
Azure Pipelines for CI/CD, deployments, and application delivery
Azure Functions and other Azure services
Relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, etc.)
NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB, etc.)
LINQ
Docker, AKS, GKE, EKS, etc.
SOLID principles
Unit testing
SonarCloud (Code Quality)
AI-based development models and agent orchestration (BMAD)
Scrum and Azure DevOps for development planning, collaboration, and project management

What do we value?

Experience developing web applications with .NET Core.
Experience working with Agile methodologies.
Experience using Git for version control.
Ability to design application architectures and digital products following engineering best practices, including TDD, DDD, Continuous Integration (CI), Design Patterns, SOLID principles, and related practices.
Experience with cloud architectures, particularly Microsoft Azure and Kubernetes.
Experience designing and developing APIs, including REST APIs, Swagger/OpenAPI, and API Management.

While not required, the following skills and experience would be highly valued:

Experience with front-end development, preferably using Angular.
Experience with AWS and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Experience developing software in multiple programming languages.
Experience with automated testing.
Experience working on the same application within a development team of more than five engineers.
Advanced English proficiency.

If you are a person who likes to be updated
on the latest trends, restless
to try new technologies, and you like to find other ways of doing things, this is the place for you. If you consider yourself a team player
who defends Fair Play above all... there is a team waiting for you!

What do we offer you?

In this company, you can be yourself
and work with colleagues equally passionate about technology and innovation, ready to support you at all times. We want to see you evolve and grow with us. To that end, we invest in your professional development
with training, tech breakfasts, and attendance at forums. We are advocates of continuous learning
, which is why we provide a personal budget for staying up to date with market trends.

We care about well-being and happiness at work
, which is why we listen to needs to offer the best working conditions in a unique human environment. Due to the emphasis we place on flexibility and work-life balance
, we won the Madrid Flexible Company Award in 2020 and received an honorable mention in 2022.

This is a WIN-WIN
, and we have 42 benefits to offer you, but here are some highlights
:

💡 Professional Training & Certifications

⏰ Flexible hours

👏 Special timetable: Fridays and summer 7h.

🏖️ Every three years, 6 extra days off.

🎁 Day off on your birthday

🗣️ Bring a friend and benefit from it

🥳 Flexible Compensation

🧘‍♂️ Wellness - Gympass

🌳 Volunteering opportunities

🎊 Company Events And Team Buildings

To learn more about us, the protagonists of INNOCV will share more about the company.

If you identify with our work philosophy and share our passion for INNOvation and Code Vocation
, we want to meet you!

Loyal to our commitment with diversity and inclusion, we encourage everybody to apply, especially those belonging to underrepresented groups such as LGTBIQ+ members and those with disabilities.

The opportunity

Your Key Responsibilities

Support the analysis, configuration and development of proposed solutions in the projects in which you participate
Assist in the configuration and customization of Microsoft Dynamics 365 environments.
Develop and maintain Workflows, Plugins and Business Process Actions for Dynamics 365.
Build applications using Power Platform technologies, including Power Apps, Power Automate and Power Pages.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Fast learner approach. A good listener that applies learned concepts quickly
Basic knowledge of Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate or Dataverse).
Excellence communication skills in Spanish

Knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CRM).
Exposure to Power Platform projects through academic, personal or professional experience.
Familiarity with C#, .NET Core, JavaScript, HTML and CSS.

Ideally, you’ll also have

Microsoft certifications such as PL-900 or a willingness to obtain them.
Experience in BD, SQL, and PL/SQL is a plus
Good understanding of English

We are looking for motivated professionals with a passion for technology, innovation and continuous learning. You should be eager to develop your technical skills, work in international environments and contribute to delivering high-quality solutions for our clients. Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.

EY Global Delivery Services (EY GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network of over 75,000 people working across the world, to provide innovative and strategic business solutions to our clients worldwide. We play a vital role in growth strategy, helping our clients become agile and efficient, and helping fulfill our purpose to build a better working world.

Across our 10 locations and 21 cities, we work with teams from all service lines, geographies, and sectors. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, the Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Our EY GDS Spain office is located at Malaga Technology Park and currently employs over 750 people.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
130 years of trust, time to shape what's next. Allianz Group is one of the world's leading insurers and asset managers - built on over a century of stability, expertise, and financial strength. Allianz Services is where that legacy meets the future. 8,200+ people. Eight countries. Three continents. We deliver specialized services to clients within Allianz Group, powered by AI, advanced analytics, and a mindset that refuses to stand still. From core insurance operations to engineering and consulting services, we reimagine how insurance works. What truly sets us apart are our people and the trusted partnerships we build, anchored in our values of expertise, integrity, and empowerment. We don't support the business. We shape it.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Solutions Engineer (m/f/d)
to join the Data and AI Transformation Engineering team, responsible for designing and building scalable backend platforms that expose AI and automation capabilities as reliable, production grade services.

The role focuses on developing API driven systems deployed on Kubernetes, combining AI driven components with deterministic logic to support complex transformation and automation use cases across multiple business units. Operating in a regulated financial services environment, the role requires a strong engineering mindset with compliance, governance, and responsible use of AI treated as core design principles.

What You Do

Design and maintain RESTful APIs with robust versioning strategies, ensuring stability as model behaviour evolves across releases.
Define structured, validated response schemas that deliver deterministic, auditable outputs suitable for enterprise consumption.
Implement streaming response patterns (SSE / chunked HTTP) to enable real-time model output delivery to frontends and downstream systems.
Implement authentication and authorisation frameworks (OAuth 2.0, JWT, RBAC, scopes) including service principal patterns for cloud-to-cloud integration across Azure, AWS, and Databricks.
Enforce data controls at the API layer — including input sanitisation, output filtering, and guardrails — ensuring responses meet compliance standards before leaving the system.
Build audit logging into the API contract so that every request and response is fully traceable for regulatory purposes.
Design background job patterns that return immediately to callers while model inference executes asynchronously.
Integrate with message queues and event-driven architectures (Azure Service Bus, SQS, Kafka) for pipeline orchestration.
Implement polling and webhook callback mechanisms to deliver results without blocking consumers.
Establish structured logging on every API call — capturing inputs, outputs, latency, and model version metadata.
Integrate with enterprise monitoring platforms (Datadog, Azure Monitor, CloudWatch) to ensure full-stack visibility.
Implement drift detection hooks that flag when model outputs deviate from expected patterns.
Manage versioned model endpoints, enabling seamless deployment of new model versions without breaking existing API consumers.
Develop automated testing strategies for non-deterministic outputs, including contract tests, output validation, and regression benchmarks.
Deploy containerised APIs on Kubernetes (AKS/EKS) with health checks, autoscaling, and production-grade reliability.
Wrap managed AI services (Databricks Model Serving, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock) behind clean, internal API contracts.

What You Bring

University degree in Data Science, Data Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
7+ years of experience in backend engineering with Python, with a proven track record of delivering AI/ML, GenAI, and agentic systems into enterprise production environments (beyond prototypes or proofs of concept).
Hands on experience with cloud based AI services across Azure and AWS, including strong expertise in Databricks (MLflow, Delta Lake, Model Serving).
Strong background in designing clean, versioned APIs and building distributed systems, including asynchronous patterns, background processing, and message based architectures.
Proven experience deploying and operating services on Kubernetes, managing infrastructure using Terraform, and treating observability, structured logging, and monitoring as standard engineering practices.
Experience working in regulated environments, where auditability, data controls, security, and compliance are core engineering requirements.
Demonstrated ownership mindset: able to take systems from design through production and incident resolution, collaborate across business units, and create reusable platform patterns that enable other teams.
Good level of English (required), other languages (e.g. Spanish or additional European languages) are nice to have.
We highly welcome candidates with a genuine interest and affinity for Information Technology (IT) and Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI), as these attributes are considered valuable assets to our team.

What We Offer

We offer a hybrid work model which recognizes the value of striking a balance between in-person collaboration and remote working incl. up to 25 days per year working from abroad.
We believe in rewarding performance and our compensation and benefits package includes a company bonus scheme, pension, employee shares program and multiple employee discounts (details vary by location).
From career development and digital learning programs to international career mobility, we offer lifelong learning for our employees worldwide and an environment where innovation, delivery and empowerment are fostered .
Flexible working, health and wellbeing offers (including healthcare and parental leave benefits) support to balance family and career and help our people return from career breaks with experience that nothing else can teach.

About Allianz

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges is what makes us a unique employer.

We are united by a shared commitment: to put our customers first and at the center of everything we do. Their needs inspire our thinking and guide our actions.

Together, we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and confident to explore, grow and shape a better future – for our customers and for the world around us. At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. The foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and where integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust are at the heart of our culture.We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural Internal background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Join us as a Sr. Software Engineer on the R&D Software Team and own real software from the ground up — not a ticket queue. You'll shape the roadmap, make the technical calls, and build the real-time data platform that turns industrial IoT telemetry into decisions our customers can act on.

Where You'll Work: This is a remote-friendly role — most of your work in practice can be done remotely, with occasional in-person collaboration at our Porto office. Our engineers tell us that flexibility is one of the things they value most about working here.

Job Duties and Responsibilities: Reporting to the Digital Integration Director, you will own software solutions end to end, from framing the business problem to running services reliably in production, built on real-time telemetry from industrial IoT sensors monitoring liquid and gas storage tanks across industries including industrial chemical, industrial gas, propane, and other fuels. Collaborate for success

Own projects end to end, starting from a greenfield state: define your own requirements, shape the roadmap, and take solutions through to production.
Work cross-functionally with teams like Sales and Marketing, translating business goals into working software.
Make the technical decisions and contribute significantly to the implementation — this is a hands-on role, not a hand-off-to-others one.

Build data-driven systems

Build and operate the backend services and APIs behind a platform ingesting real-time telemetry from industrial IoT sensors at sites across the globe.
Design and run the data pipelines that turn that telemetry into something people can act on — including forecasting and anomaly detection on time series.
Work with the realities of sensor data: gaps, drift, irregular sampling, and a device population that keeps evolving. Bring the statistical judgment to tell a real signal from noise, and to say how confident we should be.
Run what you build — instrumentation, alerting, and the operational habits that keep a system healthy.

Engineer with AI assistance

Use agentic coding tools — Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, and similar — as a normal part of daily delivery.
Hold AI-generated code to the same bar as any other code. You are accountable for what you ship.
Structure repositories, tests, and documentation so both people and agents can work in them effectively, and share the patterns and guardrails that work so the team's baseline rises.
Apply Anova's AI Handbook guidance on risk and human-in-the-loop validation to any system whose output reaches a customer or drives an automated action.

Advocate for quality

Contribute to and continuously adapt best practices and Ways of Working across software engineering, data engineering, and platform operations, so the team ships high-quality solutions that create real impact for our clients.

What Success Looks Like

Backend services and data pipelines for real-time IoT telemetry run reliably in production, with strong instrumentation and alerting in place.
Forecasting and anomaly detection outputs are trustworthy enough that customers and internal stakeholders act on them with confidence.
Engineering practices — code review, testing, CI/CD, AI-assisted development — visibly raise the team's baseline, not just this person's own output.
Other engineers are actively mentored and leveled up through code review and design discussion.
Business stakeholders trust this person to translate technical trade-offs and uncertainty into decisions they can act on.

What you'll need to succeed: Minimum Requirements -

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or another quantitative or scientific field — or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
5+ years in software engineering or a closely related role, including hands-on production deployment (6–8 years preferred). A completed PhD in a quantitative or scientific discipline, with substantial hands-on programming, counts toward this.
Strong Python and the engineering habits that go with it: git, code review, linters, unit tests, and CI/CD pipelines are things you use daily.
Strong analytical ability and working fluency with statistics: distributions, uncertainty, correlation and causation, and knowing when a result is real.
Solid SQL and experience working with data at scale — pandas, PySpark, and platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or Postgres.
Experience operating software in production: deployment, monitoring, alerting, and a feel for the practices that make that sustainable.
Fluency with agentic coding tools.
Fluent in written and spoken English.

Preferred Qualifications -

Depth in the Azure Databricks platform: PySpark, streaming pipelines.
Time series work in production: forecasting, anomaly detection, or similar.
Experience with message queuing systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).
Experience implementing agentic workflows in production — building them, not just calling them.
Hands-on with an agent framework: LangChain / LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, MetaGPT, or similar. We care that you have shipped one, not which one.
Familiarity with the interoperability protocols — MCP (Model Context Protocol) and A2A (Agent2Agent) — for exposing systems as tools other agents can call directly, and for getting agents to talk to each other.
Experience with Microsoft Foundry for building, evaluating, and deploying agents.
Domain experience in industrial, energy, or IoT settings.

About Anova

We are very proudly “one” Anova — built by integrating the best in IIoT technology and expertise. Anova monitors more than 1,250,000 assets across nearly 80 countries for over 2000 clients, from family businesses to the largest LPG, Industrial Gases, and chemicals companies in the world. Our scale is global. Our service is local. We partner directly with customers, taking a holistic approach and delivering tailored solutions that drive innovation and improvement and make our world safer, more efficient, and reliable.

We believe that rewarding work should reward you. As part of Anova, your work, integrity, and commitment are rewarded through competitive compensation and reward strategies, through sincere appreciation, and through opportunities for growth and advancement. We put people first by providing benefits that support your life and well-being, from health and finance to recognition and reward, and so much more — we've got you covered.

If this sounds like a fit for you, apply to join Anova in connecting the industrial world — for better.

For more information about how Anova is transforming the Industrial IOT industry, visit us at Anova.com.

Je schakelt met operators, productieondersteuning, functioneel beheerders, ontwikkelaars en andere collega’s om gebruikersvragen te vertalen naar robuuste technische oplossingen.

Je ontwikkelt nieuwe functionaliteiten, verbetert bestaande oplossingen en helpt verstoringen structureel op te lossen. Daarbij werk je met onder andere SQL, JavaScript, TypeScript, API-koppelingen, data-integraties en MES-processen. Je denkt mee over de technische roadmap, migraties, beveiliging en de toekomst van het MES-landschap. Zo bouw je mee aan een platform dat belangrijk is voor de modernisering van treinen én voor de dagelijkse operatie in de fabriek.

Concreet houd je je bezig met:

Je ontwikkelt, configureert en onderhoudt oplossingen binnen het AspenTech MES-platform.
Je vertaalt productie- en onderhoudsprocessen naar robuuste, schaalbare en praktisch toepasbare technische ontwerpen.
Je werkt aan nieuwe functionaliteiten, API-koppelingen, data-integraties en optimalisaties binnen het MES-landschap.
Je analyseert complexe vraagstukken en lost technische verstoringen structureel op, soms direct in contact met de fabriek.
Je neemt een leidende rol in technische ontwerpkeuzes en bewaakt de kwaliteit, continuïteit en veiligheid van oplossingen.
Je werkt nauw samen met functioneel beheerders, een Product Owner, Scrum Master, ontwikkelaars en gebruikers zoals operators en productieondersteuning.
Je denkt mee over technische migraties, contracten, beveiliging en toekomstige ontwikkelingen op de roadmap van het MES-platform.
Je ondersteunt bij releases, migraties en technische verbetertrajecten.
Je deelt kennis binnen het team en helpt collega’s technisch verder, zodat de afhankelijkheid van enkele kennishouders kleiner wordt.

Hier ga je werken

Je komt terecht in het MES-team binnen NS Treinmodernisering in Haarlem. Hier worden treinen vernieuwd, verbeterd en toekomstbestendig gemaakt. Binnen die omgeving speelt digitalisering een steeds grotere rol. Het MES-platform ondersteunt collega’s op de werkvloer bij productie- en onderhoudsprocessen en vormt daarmee een belangrijke schakel tussen IT, OT en de dagelijkse operatie.

Het team bestaat uit een Product Owner, Scrum Master, ontwikkelaars, een technisch applicatiebeheerder en een functioneel beheerder. Samen zorgen jullie ervoor dat het MES-platform stabiel blijft draaien én meegroeit met de behoefte van de fabriek. Je werkt in een omgeving waar techniek, softwareontwikkeling en productie samenkomen. Dat vraagt om nauwkeurigheid, eigenaarschap, samenwerking en de rust om ook bij onverwachte situaties het overzicht te bewaren.

Geen dag is hetzelfde. De ene dag werk je aan een strategische verbetering van het platform, de andere dag help je een verstoring oplossen die direct impact heeft op de productie. Juist die combinatie van IT, techniek en operatie maakt deze functie interessant voor een ontwikkelaar die graag dicht bij de praktijk werkt.

Dit zijn de functie-eisen

Je bent een ervaren IT-professional of softwareontwikkelaar die technische diepgang combineert met een praktische aanpak. Je vindt het interessant om complexe systemen te doorgronden en krijgt energie van het slimmer maken van productieprocessen. Je kunt zelfstandig werken, denkt goed na over je aanpak en weet technische oplossingen begrijpelijk te maken voor verschillende doelgroepen.

Verder herken je jezelf in het volgende:

Je hebt hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in de richting van technische informatica, software engineering, industriële automatisering of vergelijkbaar.
Je hebt ruime ervaring als software engineer, systems engineer, IT engineer of ontwikkelaar binnen complexe en bedrijfskritische IT-landschappen.
Je hebt ervaring met of aantoonbare affiniteit met MES-systemen, productieomgevingen en industriële automatisering.
Ervaring met AspenTech MES, ASM of vergelijkbare MES-platformen is een sterke pré.
Je hebt goede kennis van SQL, databases en systeemintegraties.
Je hebt ervaring met JavaScript, TypeScript en bij voorkeur enige kennis van .NET.
Je hebt ervaring met API’s, koppelingen, data-integraties en technische architecturen.
Je kunt zelfstandig verstoringen analyseren, prioriteiten bepalen en tot een structurele oplossing komen.
Je communiceert duidelijk en weet technische oplossingen begrijpelijk te maken voor verschillende doelgroepen, van ontwikkelaars tot gebruikers op de werkvloer.
Je bent stressbestendig, verandergericht en zelfbewust: je blijft rustig bij onverwachte situaties en durft keuzes te maken met oog voor kwaliteit en samenwerking.

Dit zijn de arbeidsvoorwaarden

Werken bij NS betekent dat jij hét verschil kunt maken in de dynamische wereld van duurzame mobiliteit. Jij helpt mee om Nederland bereikbaar te houden, voor iedereen. Bij NS krijg je veel vrijheid en volop mogelijkheden om je te ontwikkelen. We beloven je dat geen dag hetzelfde is. En als één van de mooiste werkgevers van Nederland hebben we nog meer te bieden. Solliciteren naar deze baan

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Backend
jobs.description:
We’re On the Beach! Since 2003, we've been rewriting the rules of how people discover, book, and experience their perfect getaway. What started as connecting people to short-haul beach holidays has evolved into something much bigger - premium beach destinations, long-haul adventures, and vibrant city breaks – and that’s just the beginning of our story.

We send around two million holidaymakers on their dream breaks every year. And we're still growing.

Powered by our deep-rooted entrepreneurial spirit, proprietary tech, curiosity and our incredible people, we’re accelerating - delivering best in class technology, the ultimate holiday app, and experiences that keep our customers coming back for more.

Ready to build the future of travel with us?

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer (Backend), you’ll design and build scalable applications, services and platforms across On the Beach.

This is a full-stack engineering position with a stronger emphasis on backend engineering, distributed systems and cloud-native architecture.

Our backend engineers solve a wide variety of problems. You could be working on systems responsible for communicating with external travel suppliers, processing large volumes of hotel inventory and pricing information, powering customer search experiences, or ensuring bookings move reliably through complex transactional workflows.

You’ll work across the development lifecycle and collaborate with engineers, product managers and other technical specialists to design, build, deploy and operate reliable software at scale.

What You’ll Be Doing Day To Day

Designing and building scalable backend applications and services
Developing APIs used by customer-facing applications and internal systems
Integrating with external suppliers and third-party platforms
Building systems that process high volumes of requests and data
Designing distributed and event-driven architectures
Working with asynchronous messaging and streaming technologies
Solving problems around performance, latency, resilience and availability
Improving caching and data-access strategies
Building reliable transactional workflows
Developing applications and services within AWS
Deploying and operating containerised applications
Improving monitoring, alerting and observability
Exploring AI-assisted engineering and modern development tooling

At Senior level, you’ll be expected to understand the wider system rather than only the individual service you are working on.

You should be comfortable considering how systems behave in production, identifying failure scenarios and balancing scalability, resilience, maintainability and delivery speed.

We’re looking for strong full-stack engineers whose experience leans towards backend and platform engineering.

You’ll be a great addition to our team if you have the following skills, knowledge and experience

Strong commercial backend software engineering
C# and .NET or comparable experience building modern backend applications
Designing and developing APIs
Building distributed systems and service-oriented architectures
Developing cloud-native applications, ideally within AWS
Working with messaging, asynchronous processing or event-driven architecture
Designing reliable integrations with external or internal systems
SQL and/or NoSQL data stores
Building scalable systems handling significant traffic or data volumes
Performance optimisation, caching and latency reduction
Designing for resilience and failure
Containerisation and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
Observability, monitoring and operating production systems
Automated testing and modern engineering practices

We don’t expect candidates to have worked with every technology in our stack. Strong engineering fundamentals and evidence of solving comparable problems at scale are more important than matching every individual tool.

What We’re Looking For At Senior Level

Beyond the technologies themselves, we’re looking for someone who:

Can independently solve complex engineering problems
Thinks about the customer and commercial impact of technical decisions
Understands the trade-offs between speed, quality and long-term maintainability
Can contribute meaningfully to technical and architectural discussions
Communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical colleagues
Raises engineering standards through collaboration rather than hierarchy
Helps less experienced engineers develop
Is comfortable working in an environment where priorities and problems can change quickly

What To Expect From Our Interview Process

After a call with our Talent Acquisition Team, We will run a 3 stage interview process all on Microsoft Teams, Which will consist of:

Hiring Manager meet & greet - 30 Minutes

Behavioural & ways of working - 60 Minutes

Tech Pairing & System Design - 120 Minutes, broken down into two parts (50 minutes each) with a short break and time for your questions at the end.

We want to make sure everybody has the opportunity to perform at their best. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the interview process please let the Talent Acquisition team know and they will be happy to assist.

Ways of working

Our full time hours are 37.5 per week, but we don't have rigid working hours so you can find the working pattern that's right for you. We have core working hours between 10am - 4pm, so we can collaborate and enjoy the social side of work.

We also have hybrid working so we all work from home and from our Aeroworks office in Manchester City Centre. We operate a remote-first working model, with colleagues meeting in our Manchester office one day every two weeks. Please note that all applicants must be eligible to work full-time in the UK

Our Benefits

We might be biased but we think our colleagues are pretty great. They're the people that have made On the Beach what it is today and continue to make it vibrant and successful tomorrow. That's why we offer a competitive benefits package, known as our Beach Perks, to all On the Beach colleagues.

These Include

25 days holiday plus your birthday off
Generous discount on holidays, plus you will receive 2 extra days annual leave on top of your holiday allowance to use whilst you're away on your On the Beach package holiday
Access to Learnerbly learning platform, plus workshops, courses and professional qualifications
Enhanced maternity, paternity, shared parental leave and adoption pay, plus other family friendly support
Employee Assistance Programme and free access to counselling
Simplyhealth Optimise Health Plan
Company Sick Pay scheme
Regular wellbeing events
Gym discount
Share Incentive Plan (SIP)
Death in Service cover
Onsite subsidised coffee shop
The Sandbox (our very own bar)

jobs.title: DevOps Architect
jobs.description:
Er du klar for å bygge Azure -plattformer som faktisk havner i produksjon, ikke bare i PowerPoint?  
Vil du bli del av et fagmiljø som deler kunnskap, erfaringer og suksess – og som liker folk som både kan kode, forklare og utfordre?  
Vil du jobbe i Oslo hos en global Microsoft-partner, med lokale kollegaer, store kunder og prosjekter som sjelden er små?  

Vi har skrevet stillingen som kode. Nå mangler vi bare deg som kjører apply .

resource " devops_arkitekt " "softwareone" {  
  location = "Oslo" # men magien skjer hos kunden  
  language = [  
    " norsk ", # ( flytende )  
    " engelsk "  
  ]  
  security_clearance = " må-kunne-oppnås "  
  stack              = [  
    "Azure",  
    "Terraform",  
    "Bicep",  
    "Kubernetes/ containere "  
  ]  
  cost_conscious      = true  
}  

Terraform vil utføre følgende handlinger:  

# devops_arkitekt.softwareone vil bli opprettet  
+ ansettelse  

Plan: 1 å legge til, 0 å endre, 0 å ødelegge.  

Vil du utføre disse handlingene?  
Skriv 'ja' for å bekrefte. ▊  
Hvorfor akkurat denne rollen ?

De fleste arkitektroller ender opp i PowerPoint. Denne ender i produksjon.  
Som DevOps Arkitekt hos oss sitter du ikke og tegner mållandskap for et selskap du aldri møter. Du sitter hos kunden, der kompleksiteten faktisk bor, der legacy -systemet ingen tør å røre står ved siden av landingssonen dere skal bygge. Du får eierskapet fra første workshop til siste pipeline-kjøring.  
Og du gjør det uten å brenne kundens budsjett. Vi mener at god arkitektur er billigere enn dårlig arkitektur, og vi ser etter deg som klarer å forsvare en teknisk beslutning både overfor en utvikler og en økonomidirektør, i samme møte.  
L urer du på hvorfor selskaps navnet ikke klinger helt: mye av miljøet du kommer inn i, er det du kjenner som Crayon. Vi er nå SoftwareOne – samme fagfolk, samme kunder, større ryggdekning.  
Og internt er det høyt under taket. Stor tillit, kort vei til beslutninger, og et team som deler kunnskap, erfaringer og suksess. Du får rom til å utvikle deg i den retningen du selv vil.  
Dette blir hverdagen din

Designe og bygge infrastruktur i Azure ,  landingssoner, nettverk, sikkerhet og styring – etter beste praksis, ikke etter vane  

Skrive infrastruktur som kode i Terraform og/eller Bicep , slik at det som funker i dag også funker om to år og tre konsulenter  

Kjøre containerbaserte plattformer på Kubernetes , eller ta steget dit sammen med kunden  

Være kundens tekniske og strategiske motpart – den som sier «det der bør vi ikke gjøre», og som blir hørt  

Holde workshops og dele kunnskap med både teknikere og folk som ikke vet hva en YAML-fil er, og ikke burde måtte vite det  

Bruke KI aktivt i eget arbeid, og være nysgjerrig på hvordan det endrer måten vi leverer på

Vi tror du kjenner deg igjen i minst tre av disse

Du har konsulent- og prosjekterfaring, og trives best når du er ute hos kunden.  

Du kan Azure godt, og har erfaring med IaC – Terraform, Bicep eller begge.  

Du har jobbet med Kubernetes , eller i det minste containere, og vet hvorfor det ikke alltid er svaret.  

Du tenker kostnad og verdi før du tenker teknologi.  

Du har en gang skrevet « temporary fix » i en kommentar som fortsatt står i produksjon. Vi dømmer ikke. Vi har alle vært der.  

Erfaring fra AWS, GCP eller OVH Cloud er en fin bonus, vi jobber teknologiuavhengig.  

Job Requirements
H va du får igje n?

Et fagmiljø som faktisk deler – kunnskap, erfaringer og suksess. Sertifiseringer og kurs. Tett oppfølging fra din leder, med retning i egen utvikling.  
Naprapat på huset, og forsikrings- og pensjonsordning  

Rabatter på blant annet SATS, Ruter og Visma-biblioteket  

Dekket mobil og internett  

Rekrutteringsbonus når du henter inn en god kollega  

Nye lokaler med kantine, innendørs sykkelparkering og verksted, garderober, shuffleboard og eget hvilerom  

Hovedsponsor for Vålerenga Ishockey: trening på Jordal Amfi og tilgang til VIP-losje på Jordal  

Stay Social , Stay Professional og Stay Active – tre interne grupper som sørger for at året består av mer enn sprinter  

Om SoftwareOne

Vi er verdens største Microsoft-partner. Det betyr ikke så mye i seg selv, men det betyr at når du sitter hos en kunde og trenger å vite hvor Microsoft faktisk er på vei, så finnes svaret et sted i huset. Og at prosjektene som kommer inn døra sjelden er de små.  
Det betyr også bredde. Vi jobber på tvers av lisens, sky, sikkerhet og applikasjoner, så teknologivalgene du anbefaler kan følges hele veien, ikke bare til neste fakturagrense. Du får jobbe med kunder i mange bransjer, fra virksomheter som tar sine første steg i Azure til de som har levd der lenge nok til å ha samlet på teknisk gjeld.  
Klar for å kjøre apply ?

Send søknad. Vi lover å svare fortere enn en cold start på en Kubernetes -node en mandag morgen.  
Ingen ressurser vil bli ødelagt i prosessen.

SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.

Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference.

Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.

jobs.description:
¡Hola! Somos OGA

Nos ilusiona que estés considerando esta oportunidad de empleo.

Somos una compañía pionera en la hibridación de la Inteligencia Artificial y la Investigación Operativa, con sede en Sevilla. Nuestro objetivo es transformar la industria a través de soluciones innovadoras y de alto impacto para nuestros clientes, líderes en sectores como el logístico, supply chain, industrial o el químico.

Esto lo conseguimos gracias al talento de nuestro equipo, que incluye a matemáticos/as, estadísticos/as o desarrolladores/as de software, entre otros, y a la confianza de grandes clientes. Además, mantenemos una estrecha colaboración con la Universidad a través de nuestro Consejo Asesor Tecnológico, Grupo CÁTEDRA, compuesto por 14 catedráticos de renombre nacional e internacional, especializados en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos, y con el que reforzamos nuestra propuesta y valor científico.

Sobre la posición.

Buscamos un/a Senior Full Stack Developer con experiencia en el desarrollo de aplicaciones web, tanto en el lado del servidor como en el lado del cliente, para unirse a nuestro equipo.

¿Qué harás?

Desarrollarás Software, tanto en Backend como en Frontend.

Diseñarás, desarrollarás y mantendrás aplicaciones web completas, trabajando tanto en el frontend (Angular) como en el backend (.NET), asegurando un código limpio, mantenible y de alta calidad.

Propondrás y definirás arquitecturas de software escalables, eficientes y seguras, alineadas con las necesidades del negocio y las mejores prácticas del sector.

Crearás y consumirás APIs RESTful o GraphQL para garantizar una comunicación fluida entre las capas del frontend y backend, así como con servicios externos.

Diseñarás y administrarás bases de datos relacionales (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, etc.) y NoSQL (MongoDB, etc.), asegurando un acceso eficiente, seguro y adaptado al volumen de datos esperado.

Configurarás y mantendrás pipelines de integración y entrega continua, automatizando pruebas, builds y despliegues en entornos cloud o on-premise.

Actuarás como referente técnico, proporcionando retroalimentación constructiva en revisiones de código, guiando a desarrolladores junior y promoviendo la adopción de estándares de desarrollo y buenas prácticas.

Analizarás y mejorarás la velocidad, eficiencia y capacidad de respuesta de las aplicaciones, asegurando una experiencia de usuario óptima.

Trabajarás estrechamente con equipos de producto, diseño, infraestructura y otros departamentos, participando activamente en ceremonias ágiles (sprint planning, dailies, retros, etc.) para garantizar el éxito del proyecto.

Investigarás, evaluarás e implementarás tecnologías emergentes que puedan aportar valor al equipo o a los proyectos.

Timing de primeras semanas en OGA

Desde tu primer día, estarás acompañado/a por todo el equipo. El área de People organizará una serie de reuniones de Onboarding en tres niveles con distintos responsables de OGA: aspectos generales y sistemas internos, el propósito de la compañía y las tecnologías que utilizamos. También conocerás a tu Buddy, quien te guiará, especialmente en tu primer mes, durante todo el proceso de integración. Junto a tu Buddy, tendrás reuniones programadas para abordar cualquier tema que facilite tu adaptación.

¿Qué requerimos?

Titulación de Grado en Ingeniería del Software, alternativamente, Grado Superior en Desarrollo de Aplicaciones Web o Aplicaciones Multiplataforma.

Conocimientos en API REST, Docker, Plataforma Cloud: Azure, AWS o GCP y Pruebas unitarias.

Experiencia mínima profesional de 5 años en Desarrollo con framework Microsoft .NET 6, ASP.NET Core 3.1 o superior, en Angular v14, en Desarrollo JavaScript ES6+, HTML 5 y CSS 3, en Patrones de diseño: DDD, Clean Architecture, CQRS y en Lenguaje SQL y diseño de base de datos relacionales (SQL Server, PostgreSQL).

¿Qué valoramos?

Conocimientos en UI/UX.

Uso de herramientas de testing: Postman o Selenium.

Conocimientos de CI & CD.

Conocimientos de Kubernetes.

Conocimientos de Arquitectura de microservicios.

Conocimientos de Python.

Trabajo en equipo en marcos de trabajo Agile y uso de herramientas de gestión

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

Un entorno de trabajo dinámico y flexible, con proyectos y clientes tecnológicamente retadores en nuestra oficina de Sevilla.

Formar parte de un equipo apasionado por los datos y la innovación tecnológica, con perfiles senior y junior, de las áreas de las matemáticas, estadística, ciencia de datos o desarrollo de software, entre otras.

Colaboración permanente con el Grupo CÁTEDRA, el Consejo Asesor Tecnológico de OGA, compuesto por 14 catedráticos de renombre nacional e internacional especializados en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos.

Acceso a diversas herramientas de IA Generativa, que nos ayudan a acelerar tiempos de entrega, aumentar capacidad productiva, minimizar desgastes y sobrecargas, y en definitiva maximizar la eficiencia y rentabilidad de OGA.

Sesión de onboarding con responsables de OGA y de People, en la que te entregaremos tu kit de bienvenida.

Participación en eventos corporativos donde podrás conocer e interactuar con el resto del equipo de una forma distendida y divertida.

Asistencia al congreso anual del Grupo CÁTEDRA en Sevilla, donde se presentan los últimos avances y proyectos en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos, con una completa agenda científica, formativa y de debate.

Plan de formación continua. En OGA, la formación continua es un valor clave y un pilar de nuestro compromiso con el desarrollo personal y profesional. Nos inspiramos en el concepto de ikigai, buscando que cada persona encuentre aquello que le motive y le permita crecer dentro de la organización. Por eso, te propondremos acciones formativas que consideremos valiosas para tu crecimiento. Sin embargo, serás tú quien debe tomar la iniciativa en tu propio desarrollo, identificando aquello que te apasiona y proponiendo a tu responsable las formaciones que desees realizar. Juntos evaluareis su viabilidad, su aporte de valor y su alineación con la estrategia de OGA.

Compromiso con la inclusión y la diversidad. En OGA nos tomamos muy en serio el talento. Creemos que cada persona aporta algo único y especial, por lo que es parte de nuestro compromiso ofrecer un ambiente donde todos podáis brillar.

Beneficios sociales y profesionales integrados en un plan global de conciliación. Como ‘entidad familiarmente responsable’ - efr - desde 2015, certificada por la Fundación Másfamilia, en OGA hemos desarrollado un amplio catálogo de beneficios para tu bienestar personal y profesional.

jobs.title: Senior Support Analyst (API & Cloud)
jobs.description:
Strength in Trust

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.

The Challenge

OneTrust is looking for a Senior Support Analyst to join the CORE Platform Support team in Madrid. In this role, you will own complex technical support cases involving integrations, authentication, APIs, messaging, and platform-level functionality.

You will act as a trusted technical partner to customers and an escalation point for Support Analysts. You will investigate difficult issues, communicate clearly with customers, collaborate with Product and Engineering, and help strengthen the team’s technical capability through knowledge sharing and mentoring.

The CORE team supports customers across areas including Single Sign-On, SMTP, APIs, Data Discovery, Certification Automation integrations, tenant-wide performance issues, integration workflows, and integration requests.

Your Mission

Own and resolve complex CORE support cases escalated from Support Analysts, taking responsibility from initial investigation through resolution or an effective engineering handoff.
Troubleshoot advanced issues across SSO, SAML, SMTP, APIs, integrations, workflows, Data Discovery, and related platform capabilities.
Reproduce customer issues in appropriate test or support environments and use available evidence to identify probable causes and practical resolutions.
Analyse logs, trace information, configuration details, API requests, integration behaviour, and other technical evidence to isolate issues.
Provide clear, structured customer communication, including acknowledgement, investigation updates, action plans, and resolution explanations.
Determine when an issue requires escalation to Product or Engineering and raise high-quality Jira tickets with the relevant troubleshooting, evidence, impact, and technical questions.
Work closely with Product, Engineering, Incident Management, and other Support teams to drive complex issues to resolution.
Identify recurring issues, documentation gaps, workflow improvements, and opportunities to reduce repeat contacts and escalations.
Mentor and support other analysts through case reviews, technical guidance, troubleshooting walkthroughs, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
Contribute to onboarding and enablement for new analysts joining the CORE team.
Maintain strong case ownership, accurate documentation, timely updates, and adherence to support processes and service-level expectations.
Continue building expertise through product releases, technical training, office hours, hands-on investigation, and relevant certifications.

You Are

Experience in a technical customer support, technical account support, SaaS support, application support, or similar role.
Demonstrated experience handling complex technical issues and escalations in a customer-facing environment.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to work methodically from symptoms and evidence to a clear diagnosis.
Experience supporting integrations involving identity providers, APIs, data connectors, or workflow automation.
Practical understanding of several of the following areas:
SSO, SAML, identity providers, certificates, and authentication flows
SMTP, email delivery, connection testing, and email-related troubleshooting
Kubernetes
REST APIs, authentication, request/response analysis, and tools such as Postman
SaaS integrations, workflows, web technologies, and system dependencies

Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
Experience working with ticketing and engineering collaboration tools, such as Salesforce and Jira.

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.

Resources

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:

OneTrust Careers on YouTube
@LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview .
You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.

Our Commitment to You

When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.

OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

We're a team of independent thinkers who put quality, inclusion and integrity first. All around the world we bring a different experience to our clients. A better experience. NEW GROUND WON’T BREAK ITSELF.

We're hiring Senior Engineers into our team, based in the North of England. We’re happy to talk flexible working and consider reduced hours and job shares, we’ll support you to balance your work and life.

A look into the role

As a Senior Engineer within our team:

You'll work within a forward deployed engineering team or a delivery pod aligned to one of our service lines, alongside a product manager and under the technical direction of a Lead Engineer. The work spans the full stack of what engineering needs to do around a GenAI platform: solving problems natively, backend plumbing, API integrations, MCP server builds, and data connections.

Working in our GenAI platform doesn't always mean writing code. Often it means applying engineering judgement to solve problems natively, designing the right architecture, the right integration, the right data flow, directly within the platform itself. Knowing which mode the problem calls for is part of the craft here.

At Senior Engineer level, you'll own your delivery end-to-end. You translate business need into solutions and technical design, and work individually or as part of the team to solve those in the best way at pace.

You're fluent across AI-native engineering from building natively in the platform, using AI tooling to accelerate your own craft, and taking coalface experiments through to production-grade operationalised solutions.

At Senior Engineer level, that fluency is already there and you apply it independently.

Knowing you’re right for us

Joining us as a Senior Engineer, the minimum criteria you’ll need is

At Senior Engineer level you have a track record of owning delivery end-to-end in a team-based model. You've shipped production software and can speak to the decisions you made. You have real depth in backend and integration engineering using Python or C# .Net, and genuine judgement about when to solve natively in the platform and when bespoke engineering is the right call.

It would be great if you had some of the following skills, but don’t worry if you don’t tick every box, we’ll help you develop along the way.

Across both levels familiarity with Azure and Microsoft 365 is an advantage. Hands-on experience with LLM integration patterns, MCP tooling, and AI-enabled or agentic development environments is genuinely valued.
AI and LLM experience - you're comfortable using GenAI tools such as Copilot, Claude or ChatGPT.

Knowing we’re right for you

Embracing uniqueness, the culture at Grant Thornton thrives on the contributions of all our people, we never settle for what is easy, we look beyond to deliver the right thing, for everyone. Building an inclusive culture, where we value difference and respect our colleagues helps our people to perform at the best of their ability and realise their potential.

Our open and accessible culture means you’ll interact with leaders who are interested in you and everything you bring to our firm. The things that set you apart, we value them. That’s why we give you the freedom to bring your whole self to work and pursue your passions inside and outside of work.

Beyond the job

Life is more than work. The things you do, and the people you’re with outside of work matter, that’s why we’re happy to look at flexible working options for all our roles, and we’ll always do our best to keep your work and life in balance.

The impact you can make here will go far beyond your day job. From secondments, to fundraising for local charities, or investing in entrepreneurs in the developing world, you’ll be giving back to society . It’s that drive to do the right thing that runs through our every move, grounded in our firm’s values – purposefully driven, actively curious and candid but kind.

We’re looking for people who want to contribute, spark fresh ideas and go beyond expectations. People who want to be able to proudly do what’s right, for the firm, our clients, our people and themselves. It’s how it should be.

jobs.title: Regional Integration Specialist hos Toyota Northern Europe
jobs.description:
Vill du ta ägarskap för en kritisk integrationsplattform och vara med och forma hur ett globalt bolag bygger sin digitala ryggrad? Trivs du i gränslandet mellan teknik och affär och vill ha en roll där du faktiskt får mandat, påverkan och internationell räckvidd?

Då kan detta vara nästa steg för dig.

OM ROLLEN

Som Regional Integration Specialist hos Toyota Northern Europe får du en central roll i organisationens pågående digitaliseringsresa, där integrationslagret är avgörande för att koppla samman affärssystem, dataflöden och processer på ett skalbart, säkert och långsiktigt hållbart sätt. Du tar ett tydligt ägarskap för Toyotas Workato‑plattform i regionen och ansvarar för den arkitekturella riktningen, kvaliteten i integrationerna samt att arbetssätt, dokumentation och struktur håller en hög och enhetlig nivå.

I rollen ansvarar du för styrning och vidareutveckling av integrationsplattformen, inklusive struktur, säkerhet och gemensamma standarder för hur integrationer byggs, testas och dokumenteras. Du säkerställer att lösningarna följer Toyotas riktlinjer och bidrar till att sätta ramverk och best practices för regionen.

Du arbetar hands‑on med teknisk leverans och arkitektur, där du designar och driver integrationer mot centrala affärssystem, fungerar som teknisk kvalitetssäkrare och hanterar mer komplexa integrationsutmaningar. En viktig del av uppdraget är även arbete med API‑design, felhantering samt övervakning och uppföljning för att säkerställa stabil och tillförlitlig drift.

Samarbete är en naturlig del av vardagen. Du fungerar som teknisk rådgivare till verksamhet och projekt, samverkar med IT‑kollegor i Norden och Baltikum samt har löpande dialog med externa leverantörer och Workato‑support. Parallellt arbetar du långsiktigt med förvaltning och kontinuerlig förbättring, där du utvecklar integrationslandskapet, stöttar interna resurser och bidrar till roadmap och budget för integrationsområdet.

DIN PROFIL

Du är en erfaren integrationsutvecklare som trivs med ansvar och helhetsperspektiv. Du är nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och bekväm med att arbeta självständigt, samtidigt som du har lätt för att samarbeta och skapa förtroende hos olika stakeholders. Du har en naturlig förmåga att skapa ordning och tydlighet i komplexa miljöer och kommunicerar tekniska lösningar på ett pedagogiskt sätt.

Krav

Minst 3 års erfarenhet av integrationsarbete, gärna i enterprise‑miljö
Praktisk erfarenhet av Workato eller annan iPaaS‑plattform (t.ex. MuleSoft, Boomi, Azure Logic Apps)
Goda kunskaper i REST API, JSON, XML och autentiseringslösningar
Erfarenhet av integrationer mot affärssystem som Salesforce, Snowflake, Microsoft 365 eller liknande
Förmåga att kommunicera tekniska lösningar till icke‑tekniska stakeholders
Flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift

Meriterande

Workato‑certifiering (Automation Pro I/II eller liknande)
Erfarenhet från bilindustrin, retail‑nätverk eller multinationell organisation
Kännedom om Toyota Production System (TPS) eller liknande förbättringsmetodik
Erfarenhet av agilt arbetssätt och tvärfunktionella team

OM TOYOTA

Toyota är ett globalt varumärke med starkt fokus på kvalitet, hållbarhet och långsiktig utveckling. Hos Toyota möter du en stark och värderingsstyrd företagskultur, grundad i The Toyota Way – en levande kultur som genomsyrar vardagen och sättet att arbeta tillsammans.

KONTAKT OCH ANSÖKAN

At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions, enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed in the right ways, all more confidently and more often—that’s what we call the courage to thrive. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

As a wholly owned subsidiary of U.S. Bank, Elavon is committed to building the platforms and ecosystems that help over 1.5 million customers around the world to achieve their financial goals—no matter what they need. From transaction processing to customer service, to driving innovation and launching new products, we’re building a range of tailored payment solutions powered by the latest technology. As part of our team, you can explore what motivates and energizes your career goals: partnering with our customers, our communities, and each other.

We actively uphold transparent and fair hiring practices that support individual opportunity, inclusive culture, and career mobility across all levels of our organisation.

We offer meaningful opportunities for growth, a culture of inclusion, and a strong commitment to transparency and integrity in everything we do.

Job Description

Senior Integration Engineer

We are seeking an experienced API Engineer to design, build, secure, and operate enterprise-grade APIs that integrate cloud platforms with on‑premise banking application suites. The role focuses on developing reliable and scalable integration services, enabling secure data exchange across channels and systems (core banking, payments, fraud, risk, CRM, digital platforms), while meeting stringent regulatory, availability, and security requirements.

You will work closely with solution architects, platform engineers, security teams, and business stakeholders to deliver API products aligned to bank integration patterns, including synchronous REST services and event-driven integrations.

Direct line reporting:

Head of Architecture and Core Banking – Europe.
Accountabilities And Responsibilities

API Design & Delivery

Design and implement RESTful APIs and integration services connecting cloud services to on‑prem banking systems.
Create reusable API patterns for common banking capabilities (customer, accounts, payments, transactions, entitlements).
Define and maintain API contracts (OpenAPI/Swagger), versioning strategies, and backward compatibility.
Deliver APIs that meet performance, latency, availability, and resiliency expectations (e.g., timeouts, retries, circuit breakers).

Security, Compliance & Controls

Implement strong API security controls: OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, JWT validation, request signing, API gateway policies, and rate limiting.
Apply secure coding practices and align solutions with bank security standards, audit requirements, and regulatory expectations (e.g., least privilege, encryption in transit/at rest).
Collaborate with security to support threat modeling, pen test remediation, and secure configuration management.

Cloud–On‑Prem Connectivity & Integration

Build and operate integration flows using enterprise tooling (examples: API gateway, service mesh, ESB/iPaaS, message brokers).
Implement hybrid connectivity patterns such as VPN/ExpressRoute/Direct Connect equivalents, private endpoints, network segmentation, and secure routing.
Integrate with on‑prem technologies (e.g., MQ, legacy services, SOAP where required, databases, batch systems) and modern cloud services.

Observability & Operations

Implement observability: structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics, dashboards, and alerting.
Support production deployments and incident triage; conduct root cause analysis and introduce reliability improvements.
Automate CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure/Configuration as Code where applicable.

Engineering Excellence

Write clean, testable code (unit/integration/contract tests).
Participate in code reviews, technical design reviews, and architecture governance.
Document API products and integration runbooks for support and operational readiness.
Experience and Key Competencies:

Knowledge & Experience:

5+ years (adjust as needed) developing APIs/integration services in regulated enterprise environments; banking or financial services experience strongly preferred.
BA/MBA in IT or relevant experience
Proven experience building hybrid integrations: cloud to on‑prem application connectivity and secure data exchange.
Strong hands-on experience with API design, implementation, and lifecycle management.

Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in one or more of: Java (Spring Boot), .NET, Node.js, or Python for API development.
Strong experience with API gateways (e.g., Apigee, Kong, Azure API Management, AWS API Gateway, Mulesoft, etc.).
Experience with messaging/eventing platforms: Kafka, MQ, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, etc.
Experience with containerization and orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift.
Strong understanding of integration patterns: sync/async, pub/sub, idempotency, retries, backpressure, saga/compensation, and data consistency.
Strong understanding of data formats (JSON, XML, Avro) and schema evolution.

Security & Quality

Practical experience implementing OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, certificate management, secrets management (e.g., Vault, Key Vault, Secrets Manager).
Experience with SDLC controls: SAST/DAST, dependency scanning, secure CI pipelines.
Test automation: unit tests, integration tests, consumer-driven contract testing (e.g., Pact).

Personal Attributes

Highly organised, proactive, and detail‑oriented, with the ability to operate at pace.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and adapting to changing priorities.
Resilient, calm under pressure, and confident acting as an extension of the CIO.
Trusted partner with a collaborative, inclusive leadership style.
Banking domain knowledge: payments (SEPA/SWIFT), card processing, transaction monitoring, AML/KYC, customer onboarding.
Exposure to 4th generation banking platforms such as (Thought Machine or 10X)
Experience with service mesh (Istio/Linkerd) and zero trust patterns.
Familiarity with TOGAF, enterprise integration architecture, or API product management.
Experience with data privacy and retention requirements (GDPR), and operational controls.

Key Competencies:

Communications & Relationships:

Excellent communication skills required to manage third party relationships. Ability to use insights and relationships to influence and deliver. The ability to build connections and partnerships within own business area and beyond, through formal and informal channels, utilising considerable tact, diplomacy and people skills.

Agility and innovation:

Adapt quickly to changing priorities; create new and better ways for the organization to be successful.

Collaboration:

Build partnerships and promote a culture of teamwork to drive on U.S. Bank.

Drive for results:

Hold self and others accountable to consistently achieve meaningful results.

Ethics and trust:

Maintain high ethical standards; gain the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity and authenticity.

Inclusion:

Build a culture of equity and inclusion in which diverse ideas, talent and perspectives are welcomed and encouraged.

Customer centricity:

Build strong customer relationships and deliver customer-centric solutions.

Commercial Judgement:

Strong knowledge of business unit with the ability to understand USBE’s business and deliver the business performance needed to achieve USBE’s purpose and goals.

Managing Programs:

Proven analytical, decision-making and problem-solving skills, with the ability to plan and implement appropriate measures to mitigate the impact of an event affecting USBE’s ability to achieve its objectives. To complete day-to-day activities in a manner which is consistent with legal, regulatory and stakeholder expectations.

You must act with due skill and diligence

jobs.title: Full Stack .NET Developer (Innovation Lab)
jobs.description:
Protime
is een succesvolle internationale aanbieder van Workforce Management
oplossingen. Met onze software en expertise helpen wij bedrijven om efficiënter om te gaan met de tijd van hun werknemers: hun Human Capital, dus. Bij Protime krijg je de kans om te groeien, nieuwe dingen te proberen, je talenten te benutten en verder te ontplooien, … Er heerst een sfeer van samenwerking: together we get the job done. Je krijgt veel autonomie en kan ownership nemen in je rol, maar je staat er nooit alleen voor.

Ben jij een pionier die graag nieuwe technologieën verkent en ideeën omzet in werkende proof of concepts? Let’s meet! 🚀

Wat zal je doen als Innovation Developer bij Protime?

Als Full Stack .NET Develope
r werk je in ons Innovation Lab
. Samen met een gedreven team verken je nieuwe technologieën en ontwikkel je praktische toepassingen die direct waarde toevoegen aan onze producten.

Je werkt in een feedback-driven
omgeving, waarin je continu leert, verbetert en bijstuurt op basis van gebruikersinzichten en teaminput. Een nieuwsgierige houding
en een innovatieve mindset
zijn hierbij onmisbaar.

Vertaal ideeën naar prototypes: Je zet concepten om in werkende POCs binnen verschillende innovatietracks. Je schakelt snel van idee naar uitvoering en past continu bij op basis van feedback en testresultaten.
Verken nieuwe technologieën: Je experimenteert met de nieuwste tools en frameworks binnen het .NET-ecosysteem (vanaf versie 8) en combineert dit met moderne front-end technologieën zoals TypeScript en React. AI en data-driven oplossingen? Helemaal jouw ding!
Samenwerken en kennis delen: Je werkt nauw samen met interne experts (architecten, developers) en externe partners zoals Microsoft en AI-specialisten. Je introduceert nieuwe technologieën, deelt inzichten en inspireert je team.
Feedback-driven ontwikkeling: Je haalt actief input op bij eindgebruikers en gebruikt deze om prototypes te verfijnen. Je presenteert je ideeën aan zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders en zorgt dat iedereen begrijpt wat er mogelijk is.
Ruimte voor experimentatie: Je krijgt de vrijheid om buiten de standaard development flow te werken, nieuwe methoden uit te proberen en snel te schakelen.

Jouw skills en mindset

Je bent geen klassieke developer, maar een pionier
met een nieuwsgierige mindset en een brede interesse in zowel nieuwe als gevestigde technologieën. Je bent gepassioneerd over technologie en gedreven om steeds te ontdekken hoe je die in de praktijk kunt toepassen. Continu bijleren is voor jou vanzelfsprekend.

Ben jij de developer die we zoeken?

Je denkt kritisch, zoekt continu naar verbeteringen en weet je ideeën helder en onderbouwd over te brengen.
Je bruist van ideeën en experimenteert graag om tot verrassende inzichten te komen.
Je neemt graag initiatief en schakelt moeiteloos tussen verschillende projecten.
Je bent communicatief sterk en kan complexe concepten duidelijk uitleggen aan zowel technische als niet-technische collega’s.
Je blijft op de hoogte van trends in web development, service-oriented architecturen en AI-tools.

Technische skills

Sterke expertise in .NET 8 (of hogere versies).
Ervaring met frontend development (TypeScript of JavaScript; React is een plus).
Interesse in of ervaring met AI-development.
Vertrouwd met TDD, BDD, clean code en simple design.
Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Brutoloon: tussen €4000 en €5000 per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring.
Voordelenpakket:
Bedrijfswagen met tankkaart/laadkaart
Netto-onkostenvergoeding
Maaltijdcheques en ecocheques
Hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering
Eindejaarspremie en jaarlijkse bonus
GSM abonnement en een voucher voor een toestel
FIP-plan (Flex Income Plan/cafetariaplan)

Werkregime: 40-urenweek met 12 ADV-dagen

Waarom voor Protime kiezen? ⌚

Protime is een groeibedrijf met een internationale mindset. Dat betekent dat jij impact kan maken, jezelf voortdurend kan blijven ontwikkelen en kan meegroeien met het bedrijf.
Werken bij Protime staat voor werken binnen een omgeving met snelle beslissingsprocedures en korte communicatielijnen. We omarmen verandering en nieuwe ideeën worden volop aangemoedigd.
We houden ervan ons werk en elkaar naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Samen presteren op ons best en voldoening halen uit ons werk: daar gaan we voor!
Bij ons werk je hybride: afwisselend vanop ons hoofdkantoor in Mechelen en van thuis. De werktijden zijn flexibel. De focus ligt op de kwaliteit van je werk.
