jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer | Full-Stack | Media Translation
jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.

Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What Sets Us Apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication
. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 100 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join the Language Products Track
. This is the heart of DeepL. You will be building and expanding our flagship translation products, the core engines that power everything from our consumer web translator to our Enterprise Customization Hub (Glossaries, Translation Memory, and Style Rules) and complex multimedia localization flows.

We are shifting gears from "Software-First" to "Product-First." We don't hire engineers just to implement UI tickets or optimize algorithms in isolation. We hire product-obsessed
people who care deeply about the user experience and the business impact of their code . You will build the interfaces and backend systems that allow a global enterprise to maintain their brand voice across 100+ languages effortlessly, while keeping the experience simple enough for a casual user.

Your Responsibilities

Own the Core Experience End-to-End: You will architect and build complex, user-facing features across our primary translation products . Whether you are building the UI for the translation flow, engineering the backend logic to parse and translate complex document formats (PDF, Word, PowerPoint) without losing formatting, or integrating DeepL directly into enterprise workflows, you own the outcome.
Build for "Consumer-Grade" Enterprise: You will solve a unique product challenge: building an interface that feels instant and magical for a B2C user, but is powerful enough to handle the complex, multi-party collaboration and localization workflows required by enterprise teams.
Architect for Ambiguity: You will make high-stakes technical decisions regarding state management, API integrations, and performance. You don't wait for perfect requirements; you prototype, measure user friction, and iterate fast .
Bridge the Gap: You are bilingual in "Engineering" and "Business." You will collaborate closely with Research, Product, and Design teams to translate complex AI constraints into an intuitive UX . You will help win market trust by building transparency and performance metrics directly into the product.

Qualities we look for

A "Product-First" Mindset: You care deeply about who uses your software. You ask "Why are we building this?" before writing a line of code. You measure success by user adoption and reduced friction, not just pull requests merged.
Front-end Heavy Full-Stack Fluency: You are a strong Front End engineer who is comfortable traversing the stack to deliver a feature. You can build a highly interactive, performant UI in React and design the supporting backend logic in Python and C#/.NET Core, with the support of agentic tooling.
High Agency & Bias for Action: You don't wait for permission. If you see a performance bottleneck in the translation flow, you profile it. If the documentation for a new API is missing, you write it . You are comfortable unblocking yourself and your team.
A "System Thinker" for UI/UX: You understand that a simple UI often hides massive backend complexity. You can design systems that handle large document states, manage complex terminology rules (Glossaries), and maintain high performance in the browser.

What We Offer

Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

About Unily

With 20+ years of expertise, Unily unites people, technology, and knowledge into action through the only AI-native employee experience platform. As the intelligent digital front door to work, Unily helps enterprises from 1,000 to 100,000+ employees, including Estée Lauder Companies, CVS Health, and British Airways, remove friction, increase clarity, and accelerate productivity so work moves faster.

Unily is a five‑time Leader in Employee Experience, recognized as a Leader in the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Intranet Packaged Solutions, the 2024 Forrester Wave™: Intranet Platforms, and the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Experience‑Centric Intelligent Digital Workspaces 2025. This analyst leadership is reinforced by strong customer validation, including G2 Crowd Leader recognition for exceptional usability and enterprise‑grade performance. Unily also holds the prestigious ClearBox “Intranet Choices 2025” award. With these accolades, we continue to grow and expand our employee community with people who are passionate about joining us on this exciting journey.

Job Purpose

The primary purpose of the Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer role is to ensure the delivery of high-quality, reliable, and user-friendly software. This role is critical in identifying and addressing software defects through the design and execution of robust testing. Through collaboration with software developers, product managers, and other stakeholders, the QA Engineer will produce clear testing objectives and comprehensive test plans, with the goal being to prevent significant bugs or usability issues, thereby safeguarding the user experience and the Unily’s reputation.

This is a hybrid role with an expectation of 1 to 2 days per week in Eashing, Surrey

and occasional days at our London office. You may be expected to be available on call during holiday periods – always by prior arrangement.

Responsibilities

Collaborate with product and development teams during the design phase to identify potential issues early in the process.
Participate in refinement sessions to provide input on testability and potential edge cases.
Design and create comprehensive test cases to ensure all functionalities are examined with appropriate thoroughness.
Execute manual test cases to identify any discrepancies or issues in the software.
Analyse test results carefully to determine the root causes of any detected problems.
Validate and report bugs, providing detailed descriptions and steps to reproduce them.
Design and execute detailed test plans to cover all aspects of the software's functionality.
Design and execute automated tests to streamline the testing process and improve efficiency.
Maintain and update automated tests regularly to ensure they remain effective and relevant.
Provide support to other areas of the business through issue triage and root cause analysis, answering questions and interacting with customers and prospects where required.
Maintain awareness of QA processes and best practices to continuously improve testing methodologies.
Assist in ensuring quality standards are met by collaborating with the development team and providing feedback.

Requirements

Testing experience with web applications
A broad experience in a range of testing types and techniques
Professional test automation experience
Knowledge of Playwright ideally using C#
Knowledge of GIT
Experience using a cloud-based test device platform such as Sauce Labs/Browserstack
API Testing experience (manual or automated) including use of tools such as Postman
Awareness of industry standards and latest developments with test automation tools and practices
ISEB/ISTQB Foundation Level Certification
Knowledge of VSTS or Azure DevOps or equivalent
Experience with an Agile environment where Development teams practice Continuous Delivery
Experience with mobile automation (Appium)
Experience with non-functional testing
Experience of Azure or similar cloud services
Excellent spoken and written communication skills
Capable of working both independently and as part of a team
Passion for quality with high standards for personal and collective achievement

We are united by a shared purpose and are committed to truly understanding each other. We know that everyone is unique and has their own story. We strive to have a diverse workforce that embraces and celebrates one another. We are united in building connections and curious to learn from each other so that we continue to grow together to build the workplace of tomorrow.

Why Work For Unily?

In addition to a generous base salary and discretionary company bonus, here are some things we think you will love:

Our awesome team culture.

We are focused on achieving results as a team and having fun while we do it. You won’t find a friendlier or more dedicated bunch of people.

Our industry leading product.

jobs.description:
Methods Analytics (MA) is recruiting for a Data Architect to join our team a permanent basis.

This role will be mainly remote but require flexibility to travel to client sites, and our offices based in London, Sheffield, and Bristol.

What You'll Be Doing as a Data Architect:

Advocate the business benefit of data standards, championing and governing those standards across projects and the organisation
Demonstrate an overall perspective on business issues and activities, determining patterns, standards, policies, roadmaps and vision statements
Make and guide effective decisions, explaining clearly how decisions have been reached and resolving technical disputes across varying levels of complexity and risk
Communicate effectively across organisational, technical and political boundaries, making complex technical information accessible for non-technical audiences
Design how to expose data from systems (APIs, real-time streams), link data from multiple systems, and deliver modern data services
Ensure that risks associated with deployment are adequately understood and documented
Design end-to-end data solutions from requirements through implementation, including technical documentation and architecture blueprints
Lead complex data migration projects from legacy systems to modern cloud-native platforms
Evaluate and recommend appropriate technologies across the modern data stack to meet specific client needs
Mentor junior team members and collaborate with data engineers, software engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders

Your Impact:

Enable transformative business decisions through robust, scalable data architectures
Drive adoption of modern data platforms and AI-enabled analytics solutions
Establish technical standards and architectural patterns that ensure quality, security, and maintainability
Help cultivate a data-driven culture within client organisations and internally
Deliver architectures that seamlessly integrate traditional and modern data systems

Requirements

You Will Demonstrate:

Deep knowledge of the Azure data stack (Azure SQL Server, CosmosDB, Azure Data Factory, Purview, Synapse, Event Hub, Azure Databricks/Fabric)
Extensive data modelling experience: both normalised relational models and de-normalised Star Schema/dimensional models
Excellent relational database design skills with expertise in diagnosing and optimising performance across SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and cloud databases
Proven track record with complex data migration projects (terabyte+ datasets, multiple legacy source systems, structures and unstructured data)
Proficiency with Parquet/Delta Lake or other modern data storage formats
Experience with streaming architectures using Kafka, Event Hubs, or Kinesis for real-time data processing
Knowledge of data architectures supporting AI/ML workloads, including vector databases, feature stores and MLOps pipelines
Experience processing and managing unstructured data types (text, images, logs, sensor data)
Understanding of Lambda and Kappa architectural patterns and when to apply each

You May Also Have:

Exposure to high-performing, low latency or large volume data systems
Knowledge of and/or experience with Government Digital Service practices across Discovery/Alpha/Beta/Live phases
Understanding of vector databases and similarity search for AI applications
Experience with Infrastructure as Code and modern DevOps practices
Knowledge of how to design and analyse operational logs for data processing, and triage incidents
Awareness of advances in AI technologies, data services, and architectural practices
Industry specialisation in specific sectors (Engineering, Manufacturing, Healthcare etc.)
Public sector or defence experience
Experience with modern unified data platforms like Databricks or Microsoft Fabric
Understanding of data mesh or data fabric architectural approaches
Relevant industry certifications such as TOGAF 9, CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional), or Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)

Security Clearance:

UKSV (United Kingdom Security Vetting) clearance is required for this role, with Security Check (SC) as the minimum standard, either already held or with a willingness to undergo the process. Some roles/projects may require Developed Vetting (DV) clearance; while not mandatory, a willingness to obtain DV clearance would be beneficial. As part of the onboarding process candidates will be asked to complete a Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS); details of the evidence required to apply may be found on the government website GOV.UK - Government baseline personnel security standard. If you are unable to meet this and any associated criteria, then your employment may be delayed, or rejected. Details of this will be discussed with you at interview.

Our Hiring Process

At Methods Analytics, we believe in a transparent hiring process. Here's what you can expect:

Internal Application Review
Initial Phone Screen
Technical Interview
Collaborative Technical Exercise
Final Interview
Offer

Benefits

Working at MA

Methods Analytics (MA) exists to improve society by helping people make better decisions with data. Combining passionate people, sector-specific insight, and technical excellence to provide our customers an end-to-end data service.

We use a collaborative, creative and user centric approach to data to do good and solve difficult problems. Ensuring that our outputs are transparent, robust, and transformative. We value discussion and debate as part of our approach. We will question assumptions, ambition, and process - but do so with respect and humility.

We relish difficult problems, and overcome them with innovation, creativity, and technical freedom to help us design optimum solutions. Ethics, privacy, and quality are at the heart of our work, and we will not sacrifice these for outcomes.

We treat data with respect and use it only for the right purpose. Our people are positive, dedicated, and relentless. Data is a vast topic, but we strive for interactions that are engaging, informative and fun in equal measure. But maintain a steely focus on outcomes and delivering quality products for our customers.

We are passionate about our people; we want our colleagues to develop the things they are good at and enjoy.

By joining us you can expect

Autonomy to develop and grow your skills and experience
Be part of exciting project work that is making a difference in society
Strong, inspiring, and thought-provoking leadership
A supportive and collaborative environment

As well as this, we offer:

Annual two-day technical hackathon bringing together all technical teams for innovation and collaboration
Monthly Engineering & Architecture Community of Practice event
Bi-annual whole company teambuilding events bringing everyone together for a day of fun and connection
Development access to Pluralsight and LinkedIn Learning
Volunteering - 2 paid days per year to volunteer in our local communities or within a charity organisation
Private Medical Insurance which is non-contributory (spouse and dependants included)
Worldwide Travel Insurance which is non-contributory (spouse and dependants included)
Discretionary Company Bonus based on company and individual performance
Life Assurance of 4 times base salary
Time off - 25 days of annual leave a year, plus bank holidays, with the option to buy 5 extra days each year
Pension Salary Exchange Scheme with 4% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution
Wellness 24/7 Confidential employee assistance programme
Social - office parties, pizza Friday and commitment to charitable causes

Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

Reliable, high-performing software helps investment professionals make informed decisions and run critical business processes. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will help evolve the Portfolio Analytics area of SimCorp Dimension, strengthening the backend services and APIs that support our clients.

You will join an agile team of 5–7 colleagues working with C#, .NET, Dyalog APL, Oracle, and AI-assisted development tools. The team improves and supports the Asset Manager module in our SimCorp Dimension product. We use a variety of technologies, but the main ones are C# and an Oracle database. You will be working with backend and APIs. The present and near future main topics are good maintainability, high system performance, continuous integration, and delivery, and moving into our unified platform for cloud. We welcome engineers who are ready to grow further in technical leadership as well as those who already have experience guiding others.

What You Will Be Responsible For

Collaborate with product and engineering colleagues to understand customer needs, challenge assumptions, shape solutions, and deliver tested, supportable software.
Design, build, and maintain backend components and APIs for SimCorp Dimension using C#/.NET and related technologies.
Improve system performance, maintainability, reliability, and build efficiency through pragmatic engineering and continuous improvement.
Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly to support activities such as exploration, implementation, testing, documentation, and code review.
Contribute to automated testing, continuous integration, and continuous delivery practices that enable predictable, high-quality releases.
Help shape technical decisions and share knowledge through code reviews, pairing, mentoring, and constructive collaboration across the team.

What We Value

Experience developing production software with C# and/or APL, or comparable experience that demonstrates strong backend engineering capability.
Interest in contributing to technical design and helping the team make practical decisions about scalable, high-performing applications, services, or APIs.
Familiarity with software delivery practices such as automated testing, version control, continuous integration, and continuous delivery.
Openness to using AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully, while maintaining sound judgement around quality, security, and maintainability.
Curiosity and willingness to learn additional technologies, including Dyalog APL, and to deepen your understanding of investment-management software.
A collaborative approach to solving problems, sharing knowledge, and growing into technical leadership.
Experience with Angular, Node.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS, Oracle databases, or financial systems is welcome but not required.

Benefits

Flexible working hours and hybrid model - 2 days in the office, 3 days remote 
Modern office (next to Wilanowska metro station) with quiet zones and ergonomic workstations 
Base salary with annual bonus structure  
Occasional remote work across Poland and international options available (up to 24 days domestic, 20 days international per year - subject to internal policy) 
Employer-paid Medicover Platinum healthcare package (employee-paid family upgrade available) 
MyBenefit Cafeteria with a monthly budget provided by SimCorp, which can be used to finance a Multisport card (with a 25% employee contribution) or choose other lifestyle options 
Unum group life insurance (employee-paid upgrade available) 
Medicover travel insurance for private trips and global business travel insurance 
Possibility to join Deutsche Börse Group Share Plan (eligible after 1 year) 
Copyrights program for certain roles  
Professional training and courses provided by SimCorp 
Polish language classes for foreign employees; German and English classes based on business needs 

Compensation ranges are being disclosed at the initial stage of candidate engagement. Visit our career pages to learn more about working at SimCorp:

www.simcorp.com/career  

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Utveckla framtiden med oss!

Omegapoint är ett ledande cybersäkerhetsföretag som arbetar med säker digitalisering. Här får du möjlighet att arbeta tillsammans med branchens mest erfarna experter. Vi utvecklar och förvaltar säkra system tillsammans med våra kunder och nu söker vi fler vassa utvecklare till Stockholm.

Om rollen

I denna roll blir du en viktig spelare i vårt team och vi tror därför att du är en lagspelare med högt ansvarstagande och kvalitetstänk. Du trivs i kundnära relationer där du är en strukturerad och engagerad rådgivare och har förmåga att omsätta dina kunskaper i konkreta lösningar. Du agerar självständigt och tar egna initiativ.

För att trivas hos oss är du mer än en utvecklare, du är en teknisk problemlösare med ett brett perspektiv. Du är nyfiken på hur AI och ny teknik förändrar vårt sätt att bygga system och arbeta i team, och du vill vara med och forma hur dessa verktyg används för att skapa smartare, säkrare och mer värdeskapande lösningar. Du testar gärna nya arbetssätt och delar med dig av insikter till andra.

Vi tror att du:

Har minst fyra års erfarenhet av systemutveckling och en utbildning inom datavetenskap, systemvetenskap eller motsvarande.
Har god vana av att arbeta i Java, C#/.NET eller liknande språk i moderna utvecklingsmiljöer.
Har erfarenhet av distribuerade system, containerplattformar och eventdrivna arkitekturer (exempelvis Kubernetes och Kafka/RabbitMQ).
Är bekväm med testdriven utveckling, automatiserade tester och att bygga robusta, långsiktigt hållbara lösningar.
Har arbetat med CI/CD, IaC och DevOps/DevSecOps-principer i praktiken.
Ser AI som en naturlig del av modernt utvecklingsarbete och använder AI-baserade verktyg där de skapar värde. Du har ett säkerhetsmedvetet förhållningssätt och förstår vikten av att använda AI på ett ansvarsfullt och genomtänkt sätt.
Behärskar svenska och engelska flytande i tal och skrift.

Utveckla med AI i praktiken

På Omegapoint ser vi AI som en naturlig del av modern systemutveckling. Vi tror att framtidens digitala lösningar skapas när mänsklig kompetens, erfarenhet och omdöme möter artificiell intelligens.

Hos oss får du tillgång till moderna AI-verktyg som hjälper dig att skapa smartare, säkrare och mer värdeskapande lösningar. Vi uppmuntrar nyfikenhet, lärande och kunskapsdelning och värdesätter alltid säkerhet och kvalitet. I uppdrag med särskilda säkerhetskrav arbetar vi med lösningar och miljöer som ger den kontroll och trygghet som krävs.

Tillsammans med vassa och snälla kollegor formar du framtidens säkra digitala lösningar och bidrar till en framtid där människor kan lita på tekniken. 

Vi satsar på dig

Hos oss sätter vi din kompetens i centrum och ger dig alla förutsättningar för ett utvecklande och varierat jobb:

Utveckling och aktiviteter: vi ordnar regelbundet aktiviteter på vårt kontor på Vasagatan i Stockholm för att vi ska utvecklas och ha roligt tillsammans. Vi har bland annat en egen idrottsförening och festkommitté.
Kompetenskultur: vi samarbetar, delar kunskap och stärker varandra. Årliga kompetenskonferenser är ett självklart inslag. En gång i månaden har vi även Kompetensdag på kontoret.
Spännande uppdrag: vår kundbas sträcker sig från små specialistföretag till stora välkända företag och myndigheter, vilket ger både utmanande och roliga projekt.
Förmåner och trygghet: vi erbjuder marknadsmässiga löner, förstärkt föräldralön, anpassade förmånspaket, friskvårdsbidrag och sjukvårdsförsäkring.

Men viktigast av allt – vi har en kultur där vi utvecklas tillsammans, delar kunskap och har riktigt roligt längs vägen.

💚 Om oss

Omegapoint är norra Europas ledande konsultbolag inom säker digital innovation. Vi är över 800 medarbetare i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Örebro, Västerås, Enköping, Uppsala och Umeå.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Loyalty management
jobs.description:
We are super excited to announce that Jimmy Sigwid is looking for our next Staff Software Engineer
to join our Data & Integrations product area and Team Points.

Our mission is to make loyalty, incentives and customer data scalable, reliable and actionable across Voyado’s platform. Behind that mission are systems handling business-critical transactions and data for some of the world’s leading brands — and as Voyado and our customers grow, so do the technical challenges we need to solve.

A key focus going forward is evolving our platform architecture to support greater scale, stronger domain ownership and more independent services. This means working with everything from distributed systems and data consistency to event-driven architecture and service boundaries.

About The Role

The Points team owns the systems behind how consumers earn and use loyalty points and rewards across Voyado’s retail customers. Whether someone earns points from a purchase, uses them towards a reward, or interacts with a loyalty program across different channels, our services help make that experience possible.

These are business-critical systems that need to remain fast, reliable and consistent as transaction volumes and use cases grow.

Right now, the team is in the middle of an exciting technical transition. We are evolving parts of the architecture to handle greater scale, reduce dependencies between domains and make it easier for teams to evolve their services independently. A large part of this means moving towards more event-driven and service-oriented patterns and rethinking how services and data interact.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you’ll be one of the technical drivers behind that evolution. You’ll work hands-on with backend development and distributed systems while helping the team make architectural decisions that need to hold up over time.

The role combines deep technical work with technical leadership. You’ll drive complex initiatives, mentor other engineers and collaborate across teams to improve both our platform and the way we build software.

So, who are you?

We’re looking for an experienced backend engineer who combines strong technical depth with the ability to influence technical direction beyond their immediate team.

You enjoy taking ownership of complex technical problems where the solution isn’t always obvious. You’re comfortable creating clarity, evaluating trade-offs and bringing other engineers along in the direction you propose — while still staying close to the code.

You don’t need experience from our exact stack, but we believe you have worked with several of the following:

Backend development in C#, .NET, Java, Kotlin, Go, or similar
Distributed systems, cloud-native services and event-driven architectures
REST APIs, asynchronous workflows and message-based systems such as Kafka, RabbitMQ or Azure Service Bus
SQL databases, transactional consistency and scalable data handling
Observability, automated testing and secure engineering practices

We Also Think You

Enjoy driving technical direction and improving engineering practices
Are comfortable mentoring and supporting other engineers
Can lead technical initiatives that span teams or domains
Use AI coding tools as a natural part of software development and see AI-assisted engineering as an important capability going forward as we continue our journey toward becoming AI-native

Experience with high-volume transactional systems
, such as fintech, payments, loyalty or similar domains, is a strong plus — but previous retail experience is not required.

What's in it for you?

Voyado Wouldn’t Be The Powerful Platform It Is Without The People Behind It. We Really Care For Our Voyadoers And Some Examples Of What We Can Offer You Are

An engaged team with a knowledge-sharing and friendly culture
Summits where we hang out, workshop, discuss, and have a good time together
Opportunities for personal and professional growth and learning in a dynamic and supportive environment.
Work-life balance – we don't have a long work-hours culture, we value engagement over hours worked.
An office-first but flexible hybrid working policy.

Some Of Our Benefits

30 days of vacation, so you can spend time on the things you love
Beneficial bike lease, including e-bikes
Breakfast buffet on Fridays
Inhouse gym only for Voyadoers
A generous gadget-and-phone package (your choice!)
5000 SEK per year in wellness allowance
Parental leave top-up additional support for new parents
A wellness hour you can use every week

About Voyado

Voyado is the agentic CX suite for retail. We help retailers of all sizes to create exceptional experiences – from first click to lasting loyalty. Our products help retailers understand customers, predict behaviors, and deliver personalized journeys that drive conversion and loyalty.

With offices in Sweden, the UK, Germany, and the Netherlands, we work with hundreds of leading retailers like H&M, Stronger, Nudie Jeans, and Power. Voyado is backed by Viking Global Investors, Novax, Verdane, eEquity, and H&M Group.

Be yourself 🏳️‍🌈

At Voyado, we believe in gender equality. We are proud sponsors of Womengineer as well as Tjejer Kodar! Read more about Tjejer Kodar & Voyado here

Equality is not only about gender but also about making everyone feel welcome and heard in a multicultural and diverse environment. We at Voyado strive to make everyone feel like they can bring their true self to work every day. Gender-equal and diverse teams have more perspectives on life and bring different ideas to the table which in the end leads not only to making a better working environment but also a better product.

Ready to find out more?

Lovely! 🎉

Before one applies it can always feel like you need a better resume, more polish, or just another year of experience, but we say if you think this sounds like a place where you can shine don't hesitate to send in your resume!

Making it personal with AI

We truly believe you’ll position yourself best for success in the interview process by being yourself with support from AI where it makes sense, later in the process you will even be expected to use AI. But at the end of the day, what matters is meeting you, the person behind the application.

Note: As of right now we are unable to proceed with applicants outside of the EU, and a requirement of eligibility to work at Voyado is the right to work in the EU without limitations. Needless to say, this is something we are actively working on to be able to onboard colleagues from all over the world.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer - Investing Systems
jobs.description:
Company Overview

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

THE TEAM

The Investment Technology group at KKR builds and operates the systems that power the entire investment lifecycle, from deal sourcing and portfolio construction to risk management and monetization. We design platforms that connect data, people, and insights across Private Equity, Credit, Real Estate, Infrastructure, and Capital Markets, enabling investment teams to make faster, smarter decisions at scale. Our mandate is to transform how KKR invests by engineering shared, data-driven platforms that replace fragmented legacy tools with integrated solutions that drive efficiency, transparency, and alpha generation.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As part of our continued investment in Ireland, KKR is launching a Technology & Engineering Centre of Excellence in Dublin. This new hub will play a central role in building the world’s first technology platform engineered to manage over one trillion dollars in alternative AUM (assets under management.) Designed from the ground up for scale, security and speed, this is the infrastructure for the future of global finance. Areas of focus include investment technology, portfolio construction and management, liquidity solutions, risk analytics, and advanced data platforms.

This is an exceptional opportunity to join a growing team within one of the world’s leading investment firms. You will contribute to high-visibility, strategic initiatives that are critical to the success of KKR’s business, working alongside a talented group professionals.

We’re committed to attracting and developing top-tier technology talent in Ireland. We’re looking for exceptional engineers who are passionate about innovation, thrive in collaborative environments, and want to work on some of the most interesting challenges in financial technology. We need you to help establish this team’s reputation for excellence and leadership.

THE ROLE

As a Principal Engineer, you will define the technical vision for key parts of our stack, shaping how data, analytics, and applications come together to drive business value.

You’ll combine deep engineering expertise with a strategic mindset—designing scalable systems, mentoring top talent, and setting standards for technical excellence. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who thrives at the intersection of engineering, data, and finance.

Our stack includes AWS, Postgres, Python, and React, with an emphasis on AI-assisted development and automation to enhance speed and quality across the SDLC.

Responsibilities

Work at the scope of the Investment Systems group to drive Architecture and Technical Strategy: Define and evolve the architecture for complex, cloud-native systems that support KKR’s investment operations.
Shape Engineering Practices: Establish standards for design, testing, observability, and CI/CD across multiple teams.
Drive Innovation: Identify and introduce new tools, frameworks, and AI-driven approaches that improve developer efficiency and data insights.
Mentor and Grow Talent: Coach engineers at all levels, cultivating technical depth, ownership, and continuous improvement.
Deliver Measurable Impact: Align technology initiatives to business objectives, tracking progress and outcomes.
Champion Reliability and Security: Ensure systems are built for resilience, performance, and compliance.
Influence Talent Decisions: Play a key role in recruiting and retaining top engineering talent through technical leadership and cultural alignment.

Who We Are Looking For

~12+ years of professional software engineering experience, exhibiting technical leadership across complex, distributed systems.
Proven success designing and scaling cloud-based platforms (AWS experience strongly preferred).
Expertise in one or more object-oriented languages (Python, Java, C++, etc) and strong familiarity with modern front-end frameworks such as React.
Solid understanding of database technologies (SQL & NoSQL), with experience in optimizing data models, caching, and performance.
Proficient in leveraging AI tools within the developer workflow to enhance productivity.
Effective communicator who can connect technical vision to business goals.
Experienced mentor who elevates the skills and judgment of others.
Curiosity and enthusiasm for finance and investment technology.
Strategic thinker who values simplicity, automation, and measurable results.
Proven record of ownership, able to deliver in a fast-paced, dynamic business environment, with exceptional attention to detail.

jobs.title: AI Workflow Engineer
jobs.description:
About us

We build the KeyShot, one of the leading 3D rendering products in the world, used across product design, engineering, marketing, and manufacturing to visualize and communicate ideas even before they're real. Used by companies like Google, Rolex, Louis Vuitton, HP, Microsoft, Philips, Adidas, and many more.

You'll be joining our cross functional web team, that builds the web services that expand KeyShot Studio for its users — powering collaboration, effective workflows, and the infrastructure that lets people work with renderings the way that suits them. We're growing this team to keep pushing that experience forward.

What you'll do

Design and set up AI workflows for implementing backend services in TypeScript, running on AWS
Retain high quality in an increasingly AI-driven development process - having strong review practices and keep tests quality.
Work within a microservice architecture, building services that are reliable and observable
Own your code through our CI/CD pipelines, and treat our test suite as a first-class part of the job
Build the services that give KeyShot users and collaborators smooth, reliable workflows - from SSO, integrations with Studio, Cloud Rendering to collaboration features
Collaborate closely with your team - reviewing code, finding solutions, share your insights and taking shared ownership of outcomes rather than working in solitude

What we're looking for

Experience designing and running AI-driven development workflows - using agentic coding tools (like Claude Code) to build and ship real production software
A track record of keeping quality high while working AI-first: reviewing, verifying, and course-correcting AI-generated code rather than accepting it at face value
Solid experience with TypeScript in a backend context
Experience with AWS cloud services and cloud architecture best practices (Infrastructure as Code like CDK, CloudFormation, or Terraform is a plus)
Comfort working in a microservice architecture - working with serverless and event-driven application design (Lambda, DynamoDB, or similar)
Experience with CI/CD and a genuine belief that a strong automated test suite is the foundation for moving quickly on top of a robust foundation
A collaborative, self-driven working style - we don't manage tightly, but we rely on people to bring initiative and support their teammates in equal measure
You're past needing close guidance on how to do the job, and you're looking for a team where your judgment is trusted
Professional working proficiency in English, written and spoken - our colleagues come from all over the world and English is our primary working language

What you'll join

You'll join a 8 person team of backend, frontend, and QA engineers, most based in our Aarhus Office, building the web services around KeyShot. We run flat and self-driven, valuing finding the solutions as a team. We back your development with real structure: biweekly 1:1s and an ongoing growth plan, so you keep developing.

Beyond the work, we offer health insurance, good maternity leave terms and a pension program as standard. On top of that: lunch scheme, massage, foosball, and regular social events.

Application and Interest

We are looking for candidates based in Aarhus, Odense, or Copenhagen. If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we'd love to hear from you! Got any questions? Feel free to reach out to Steffen Østerby Muldbjerg at steffen.muldbjerg@keyshot.com .

Job Description

Build the enterprise platforms that power intelligent operations.

Join Agilent's Global OT & AI Engineering organization and help develop the cloud-native platforms that connect enterprise systems, manufacturing operations, and intelligent digital solutions across Agilent's global operations.

As a Digital Solutions Engineer – Platform Services, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services, enterprise APIs, integration platforms, and cloud-native applications that enable secure, reliable, and real-time information exchange across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Logistics, Quality, Engineering, and Operational Excellence.

Working closely with Application Experience Engineers, Data Engineers, AI & Data Scientists, Smart Factory Engineers, and business stakeholders, you will develop the enterprise services that power digital products, operational analytics, AI applications, and connected manufacturing systems.

We welcome candidates across multiple career stages. Responsibilities and technical ownership will be aligned with your experience, expertise, and demonstrated capabilities.

About Global OT & AI Engineering

Global OT & AI Engineering develops the digital platforms that power intelligent operations across Agilent's global manufacturing network.

Our organization combines software engineering, enterprise data platforms, Artificial Intelligence, industrial automation, cloud technologies, and Smart Factory solutions to build scalable digital capabilities that improve operational visibility, accelerate decision-making, and enable continuous improvement across global operations.

Our mission is to build the digital operating system for intelligent manufacturing.

Our portfolio includes:

Global Operations Control Tower
Enterprise Data Platform (GOLake)
AI & Decision Intelligence Platform
Smart Factory Applications
Manufacturing Knowledge Platform
Enterprise KPI Platform
Digital Twin Solutions
Manufacturing Data Exchange Platform
AI-powered Digital Coworkers

About The Role

Modern enterprise software depends on reliable, scalable, and secure platform services that connect business applications, operational technologies, enterprise systems, and cloud services into a unified digital ecosystem.

As a Digital Solutions Engineer – Platform Services, you will build the backend capabilities that power Agilent's digital products. From enterprise APIs and integration services to cloud-native microservices and event-driven architectures, your work will provide the foundation that enables seamless communication between applications, data platforms, AI services, and manufacturing systems.

You will collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to develop reusable platform capabilities that accelerate software delivery, improve system reliability, and support Agilent's long-term digital transformation strategy.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Services Development

Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services that support enterprise digital products.
Build reusable APIs, microservices, and shared platform capabilities that accelerate software development across multiple applications.
Develop secure and maintainable services that enable reliable communication between enterprise systems and operational platforms.
Ensure platform services are scalable, resilient, and designed for long-term maintainability.

Enterprise Integration

Develop integration services connecting ERP, MES, PLM, Quality Systems, AI platforms, enterprise applications, and cloud services.
Design API-first solutions that promote reuse and simplify system integration.
Implement event-driven and asynchronous communication patterns to improve scalability and responsiveness.
Enable secure and efficient information exchange across enterprise and manufacturing environments.

Cloud-Native Engineering

Develop cloud-native applications and services using modern architectural patterns.
Support containerized deployments, automated testing, and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD).
Optimize platform performance, reliability, scalability, and operational resilience.
Implement monitoring, logging, and observability capabilities that improve platform health and operational support.

Security & Reliability

Apply secure software development practices throughout the application lifecycle.
Implement authentication, authorization, and API security standards.
Support disaster recovery, fault tolerance, and high-availability strategies.
Continuously improve platform performance through proactive monitoring and optimization.

Cross-functional Collaboration

Partner with Application Experience Engineers to deliver end-to-end enterprise applications.
Collaborate with Data Engineers to expose trusted enterprise data through secure services.
Work with AI & Data Scientists to integrate AI capabilities into enterprise platforms.
Support Smart Factory Engineers by enabling secure integration between operational technologies and enterprise applications.
Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and Agile delivery activities.

Technology Environment

You will have opportunities to work with modern enterprise technologies including:

Backend Development

.NET
Python
Node.js (preferred)

REST APIs
GraphQL (preferred)
gRPC (preferred)
OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect

AWS

GitHub Actions

RabbitMQ (preferred)

Redis (preferred)

Monitoring & Observability

Azure Monitor

Qualifications

We welcome candidates across multiple career stages. Responsibilities and technical ownership will be aligned with your experience and demonstrated capability.

You should have:

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
Experience developing backend applications, APIs, or enterprise software platforms.
Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages such as C#, Python, or Java.
Understanding of API development, system integration, and relational databases.
Familiarity with cloud computing concepts and distributed application architecture.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Passion for building scalable software platforms that enable enterprise digital transformation.

Preferred Qualifications

Microservices architecture

Strong software engineering and systems design fundamentals.

Customer-focused problem solving with a commitment to delivering business value.
Excellent collaboration across multidisciplinary engineering teams.
Ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement mindset.
Curiosity to explore emerging technologies and modern engineering practices.
Ability to balance technical excellence with pragmatic business outcomes.

Additional Details

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
**Application instructions:**  

**Interested applicants, please apply for this job at this link:** https://grnh.se/7o1evgyx2us
  
  

Responsibilities
  
  

We're building the infrastructure layer that connects enterprise systems to AI: an
  
  

MCP Gateway
  
  

, an
  
  

AI Gateway
  
  

, and the services around them. These are the systems that sit between LLM providers and everything else — routing, auth, rate limiting, observability, protocol translation. We're looking for a senior engineer who understands both the systems layer and the AI protocol layer, and who can build production\-grade services in Go and/or Ruby.
  
  

**In this role, you will also be responsible to:**  

Design and develop the MCP Gateway and AI Gateway
  
  

— production services that mediate between applications, AI agents, and LLM providers. This means protocol\-level work: MCP server/client implementations, request routing, streaming, tool\-call proxying, authn/authz, and tenant isolation. You'll build the core infrastructure, not just applications on top of it.
  
  

Build high\-throughput, low\-latency network services.
  
  

**You'll work close to the wire:** TCP, TLS, HTTP/1\.1 and HTTP/2, JSON streaming, connection pooling, backpressure. When latency matters, you'll know exactly where it goes.
  
  

Own the data layer from the application side.
  
  

Deep PostgreSQL knowledge — schema design, indexing strategies, query planning, transactions and isolation levels, connection management. You're not a DBA, but you can read EXPLAIN ANALYZE output and fix the query, not just add an index and hope.
  
  

Design for concurrency.
  
  

Worker pools, queues, graceful shutdown, backpressure, race\-free shared state. You can profile a service under load (pprof, flamegraphs, query stats), find the bottleneck, and fix it.
  
  

Drive observability for AI systems.
  
  

Metrics, tracing, and logging that actually tell you what's happening — token usage, latency per provider, cache hit rates, failure modes, cost per request.
  
  

How we work with AI
  
  

We encourage — but never force — the use of AI/LLM tools in development.
  
  

If AI\-assisted workflows make you faster, use them heavily. If you prefer to write something by hand, that's equally respected. What we care about is the quality of what ships, not how it was typed.
  
  

You'll have access to nearly every major tool and model on the market
  
  

— coding agents, IDEs, frontier models — with very generous usage limits. We want tooling budget to never be the reason a good idea goes unexplored.
  
  

We actively explore and enhance automated development.
  
  

**You'll help shape how the team uses AI:** agent workflows, code review automation, internal tooling. We build AI infrastructure, so we hold ourselves to being its most sophisticated users.
  
  

We believe LLM tools give a single engineer full visibility across the product
  
  

, regardless of area — frontend, backend, infra, docs. We want people who use that leverage to own problems end\-to\-end rather than stay inside one layer.
  
  

But the accountability never shifts to the machine.
  
  

You own what you merge. You can explain every statement and decision in the final output, and justify and defend the architectural choices to human colleagues in design and code reviews. "The AI suggested it" is never an acceptable rationale.
  
  

Requirements
  
  

Qualifications / Experience / Technical Skills
  
  

Senior\-level experience (5\+ years) in Go, Ruby, or both.
  
  

**Any combination works:** deep Go, deep Ruby, or strong in both. What matters is that you've shipped and operated production services in at least one of them.
  
  

**Go candidates:**  

you know the stdlib deeply and prefer it over frameworks. net/http, crypto/tls, context, goroutines and channels, the memory model. You've done performance optimization on real services — allocations, GC pressure, lock contention — and you understand networking (TCP, TLS, HTTP, JSON) in depth, not just through a framework's abstraction.
  
  

**Ruby candidates:**  

strong Rails in production — you know where Rails ends and Ruby begins, you've tuned ActiveRecord rather than fought it, and you've built services that stay fast under load.
  
  

PostgreSQL depth from an application developer's perspective.
  
  

Query optimization, indexing, transactions, connection pooling, migrations at scale. You don't need to administer the cluster; you need to write code that treats it well.
  
  

Concurrency and profiling as a practiced skill
  
  

, not a bullet point. You've debugged a production incident with a profiler open.
  
  

Familiarity with Kubernetes and containers.
  
  

You can deploy, debug, and reason about your services in a containerized environment — resource limits, health checks, rolling deploys, networking basics.
  
  

You've built production services with proper observability, deployment pipelines, and security. You know how to run reliable systems and debug distributed systems when things break.
  
  

AI/LLM Experience
  
  

You've worked with LLMs at the
  
  

protocol level
  
  

— message structures, tool calling, streaming responses, caching strategies. You know what's happening on the wire, not just what the SDK abstracts away.
  
  

Familiarity with
  
  

MCP (Model Context Protocol)
  
  

is a strong plus — ideally you've built or integrated MCP servers/clients and understand the transport and capability negotiation layers.
  
  

You can integrate with OpenAI\-compatible and Anthropic APIs directly, evaluate responses, understand token usage, and optimize for latency and cost.
  
  

You can judge, audit, and verify LLM output.
  
  

You catch subtle bugs, security issues, and hallucinated APIs before they ship — and you're fluent enough in the underlying systems to know
  
  

why
  
  

the output is wrong, not just
  
  

that
  
  

it's wrong.
  
  

Soft Skills / Personal Characteristics
  
  

You learn fast and stay current. AI infrastructure is moving weekly; you follow it and can evaluate new protocols and approaches quickly.
  
  

You participate in technical design discussions and code reviews, and you can explain complex concepts clearly to engineers and non\-technical stakeholders alike.
  
  

**You're comfortable owning the full lifecycle:** design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
  
  

Workato is an award\-winning cloud intelligent automation and integration platform with enterprise\-grade capabilities and no coding required. Workato seamlessly integrates with over 300\+ business applications and enables integration and task automation across all those apps.
  
  

Recognised as a Leader in Forrester Wave iPaaS for Dynamic Integrations and Leader on Debut in Gartner’s Enterprise iPaaS Magic Quadrant, Workato is the only company that provides an easy, self\-service way to integrate cloud and on\-premise applications for all types of businesses — ranging from Fortune 500 Enterprises as well as SMBs.

You'll have a chance to build enduring relationships with these companies and establish yourself as a trusted advisor.  

  

As well as spending time working directly with customers, you'll also get plenty of time to "sharpen the saw" and keep your skills fresh. We have more than 175 services across a range of different categories, and it's important that we can help customers take advantage of the right ones. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agents (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
About Eye Security

Eye Security is an international scale-up providing cyber security with embedded cyber insurance to SMBs in Europe. Our cyber security innovations, state-of-the-art automation and platforms are being built and maintained by our Product and Engineering Teams. Our engineers and product managers collaborate closely with cyber security experts to ensure that their hacker's mindset is embedded into our platform.

Our platform is a proprietary Open XDR (eXtended Detection Response) system that brings in security data from several market leading cyber security products into our centralised repository. From here cyber security experts can work their magic. This makes sure that our hundreds of customers experience the same value via automated systems, allowing us to scale in Europe.

About This Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Agentic SOC team. At Eye, we organise engineering around streams: mission-driven groups with a clear outcome to drive, not a product area or a section of the codebase. This team's mission is to build LLM-powered agents that augment our security analysts, taking on repetitive investigation and triage work so humans can focus on the judgment-heavy parts of the job.

You will work in a small, full-stack team of 2 to 3 engineers contributing to your stream's goal, working across whatever systems and layers are needed to deliver it. This is a role for someone who wants real ownership, not a queue of tickets, and who is excited about shipping agents into a real production SOC where correctness, latency, and cost all matter.

In this role

Own features end-to-end as Feature Lead: scope the problem, coordinate work within your team, make day-to-day technical decisions, and ship it to production. You are trusted to take a high-level goal and turn it into a plan without close supervision.
Lead the design and delivery of LLM agents that plug into our SOC workflows, including tool design, prompt and context engineering, evals, and guardrails. Make sound tradeoffs on accuracy, cost, latency, and how much autonomy to give the agent versus keeping a human in the loop.
Drive technical design discussions in your stream and, where the work calls for it, influence architecture and standards beyond it. Set the bar for code quality, testing, and documentation on your team.
Ground engineering decisions in outcomes. Push back when the "why" is unclear, propose simpler or faster paths to the business result, and stay close to the security analysts and customers your agents are meant to serve.
Mentor engineers on your team and across the stream through pairing, code review, and design feedback. Act as a multiplier, not just a strong individual contributor.
Participate in hiring: interview candidates, help shape the bar, and support onboarding.
Contribute to a psychologically safe and outcome-oriented team culture. Lead by example in incidents and high-pressure moments.
The role is remote in the Netherlands or in Berlin, with a commitment to travel to the office (The Hague or Berlin) twice per week.

What You Will Need

5+ years of development experience, including meaningful full-stack exposure. You are comfortable working across backend and frontend layers and you pick up new technologies independently.
Depth in at least one technical area and broad competence across the stack. You have designed and shipped systems where performance, security, reliability, and maintainability all mattered, and you can explain the tradeoffs you made.
Experience with strongly typed languages (Typescript, Java, dotnet, PHP, or similar). We operate in Go and React, and we back ourselves to get a seasoned engineer with strongly typed experience up to speed in our stack quickly.
Hands-on experience building LLM agents, with evidence they were useful. You have built and shipped at least one non-trivial LLM-powered agent or agentic workflow, in production or as a side project with real users. You can speak concretely about the design choices you made around tool use, context and state, evals, failure handling, autonomy, cost, and latency and, just as importantly, what the agent changed for the people using it.
Comfortable using AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow.
A track record of raising the level of engineers around you through mentoring, code review, and design feedback.
Strong communication skills. You can translate technical tradeoffs for engineers, product managers, and leadership, and you write designs and decisions in a way others can build on.
Knowledge of secure coding practices and secure development principles to build safe, trusted systems.
Fluency in English is a must.

What We Offer

Work on genuinely hard problems in a complex domain: XDR, security data at scale, and tooling that empowers security analysts to protect hundreds of customers across Europe.
Real ownership in a small, autonomous team where every engineer is close to the work, close to the decision-making, and close to the impact.
A deliberate bet on AI-augmented engineering and AI-augmented security operations: we are building toward small teams that punch well above their weight through smart AI adoption, and you will be part of shaping how that works in practice for both how we build and how our SOC operates.
Be at the forefront of innovation, shaping the future of our technology infrastructure.
Enjoy a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits.
Join a young and thriving scale-up which is on its way to becoming the category leader in Europe.
We are a great place to work, filled with people who enjoy working together.

We are a rapidly growing company and believe in investing in our people. If you're a highly motivated and results-oriented engineer with a passion for building secure, scalable technologies, we encourage you to apply!

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
TOPdesk builds service management software used across education, healthcare, government, and manufacturing. We are 700+ colleagues in 11 offices worldwide. Founded over 30 years ago, we serve more than 10 million users worldwide and have been helping organisations deliver better services ever since.

We are an open, collaborative organisation with little hierarchy — people own their work end to end and are trusted to make the decisions that matter. We are reinventing ITSM and ESM for the agentic era, building AI agents our customers can trust, and this role is part of that.

Job Description

About the role

As an Engineering Manager, you lead one or two teams with a specific technical mission — front-end, middleware, back-end, data, or platform — giving both people and technical direction, and owning what your teams ship.

You set team-level technical direction within the wider architectural guardrails, grow strong engineers into stronger ones, and own delivery and operational outcomes — creating the conditions for your senior and staff engineers to provide technical leadership too. You operate agents yourself and lead our AI-native SDLC from the front. You report to your domain's senior engineering leader.

What this is not A purely process or Scrum-master role, or a hands-off manager who sets no technical direction. You lead people and technology together, and stay technically close through design, pairing, incident response, reviews, technical investigation, and agent workflows — regular individual coding output is not the measure of the role.

The team

You lead one or two teams with a specific mission — for example front-end feature development, middleware, back-end services, data, or platform.

Delivers its part of the domain's roadmap.
Sets and upholds the technical standards for its domain.
Adopts the target architecture and our AI-native SDLC practices.
Sits within a approx 170-strong engineering organisation across Delft, Budapest, and Kaiserslautern.

What you'll do

Provide technical direction

Set technical direction and standards for your teams' domain, alongside your engineers.
Make and steward the key technical decisions; uphold quality, security, and operational stability.
Contribute to system and architecture decisions for your domain with the Enterprise Architects and your peers.

Grow the people

Coach and develop your engineers — including growing strong ones into senior and staff engineers.
Hire, and act on tough talent calls with clarity and care.

Own the delivery and the bar

Own your teams' roadmap commitments and delivery and operational outcomes; protect cycle time, quality, and operational stability.
Keep review sustainable in an agentic SDLC — ensure your teams do not create excessive review burden or unnecessary code, match agent autonomy to the risk of the task, and keep human accountability clear.
Raise the engineering bar for your domain; make standards explicit and inspectable.
Operate agents yourself — build the subagents, evals, and patterns your team reuses, and contribute them back to the shared libraries.

Technical environment

Claude Code is our current primary agentic engineering environment: agents may plan and execute within defined constraints and governed environments, while engineers stay accountable for problem framing, architecture, acceptance criteria, security, verification, and production outcomes. Agent-generated work is backed by automated tests, runtime checks, reviewable evidence, and risk-based human approval — we match deterministic automation, structured workflows, or agents to the nature and risk of the task rather than maximising autonomy for its own sake.

Your domain: front-end, middleware, back-end, data, or platform — the specific stack depends on your teams' mission.
Legacy: Java, MS SQL, heritage architecture — being decomposed.
Modern: Python, TypeScript, Vue, Postgres, Azure, Kubernetes; cloud-native / service-oriented architecture; Terraform-managed infrastructure.
Mechanisms: subagents, MCP tool integrations, multi-agent workflows, and shared prompt, agent, and eval libraries.

Success in your first year

Your teams reliably deliver their part of the domain's roadmap, with measurably better cycle time, quality, and stability.
Technical direction and standards for your domain are clear, owned, and upheld — the bar has gone up.
Your engineers have grown, including movement into senior or staff roles.
AI-native ways of working are normal in your team, with patterns and evals you contributed.

Qualifications

Required

Engineering manager with a track record of growing engineers — including into senior and staff roles — and owning team delivery.
A strong technical foundation in a relevant domain (front-end, middleware, back-end, data, or platform) — you set team-level technical direction, not just run process.
Current, personal practice of AI-native software delivery (Claude Code or equivalent) — you can show your work and lead by example.
Strong on talent development; comfortable acting on tough calls.
Comfortable in ambiguity and inside legacy codebases; a strong communicator.

Nice to have

Led a team through a significant technical or operating-model change.
Has built and shared subagents, evals, or CLAUDE.md conventions a team reused.
Deep domain expertise relevant to one of the product domains.

Additional Information

What's in it for you

A strong focus on personal development — including, in the Netherlands, our “10 to Grow” programme: 10% of your time and budget for your own growth.
A hybrid working environment built on freedom, trust, and responsibility.
An open, informal, and supportive culture, with collaboration across national borders.
Excellent employment conditions.

Want to apply?

Does this sound like your next step? Apply with your CV and a short motivation letter via the application form. Tell us, with an example, how you gave both people and technical direction to a team — and what it shipped as a result.

Ben je klaar voor de stap naar Enterprise Level Solution Architectuur? Kom dan kennismaken bij HSO! Join the Journey!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Azure Integration Architect begeleid jij klanten inhoudelijk in hun reis naar de Microsoft Cloud of bij het professionaliseren van de Cloud Competence. Je houdt je bezig met de (Hybride) Cloud Architectuur, het realiseren van een veilige Azure-omgeving en het moderniseren (Cloud Native) van applicaties, integraties en bijbehorende infrastructuren. Je inspireert organisaties en helpt met het nemen van beslissingen rondom migraties. Daarnaast geef je workshops over Cloud Architectuur, Integratie, Infrastructuur, Governance en Security & Compliance. Je bent gewend om in complexe omgevingen te werken en je weet lastige vraagstukken moeiteloos te vertalen naar technische oplossingen. Kortom, jouw hart klopt sneller van de Microsoft-technologie!

Wat vragen wij van jou?

Je hebt HBO-werk- en denkniveau.
Je bent ondernemend en wilt graag helpen bij de doorontwikkeling van onze Managed Cloud.
Je hebt relevante Microsoft-certificeringen op het gebied van Azure-architectuur en -ontwikkeling.
Je hebt expertise in het Microsoft Azure-portfolio (Azure Well-Architected Framework, Cloud Adoption Framework, Azure Integration Services, Infrastructure as Code, Azure DevOps & CI/CD).
Je beschikt over goede Nederlandse taalvaardigheden (zowel mondeling als schriftelijk).

Wat bieden we jou?   

Werken bij HSO is uitdagend, we willen je daar graag een goede beloning voor teruggeven. Naast goede primaire voordelen bieden wij: 

Een competitief salaris, een jaarlijkse bonus op basis van bedrijfs-, team- en individuele prestaties;
Mobiliteitsvergoeding waarbij je of een auto kunt leasen of het bedrag toe kunt voegen aan je salaris. Daar bovenop krijg 100% betaald van de ov-kosten;
25 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er 35 van te maken; 
Hybride werken, vanuit huis, op kantoor (Rotterdam, Veenendaal) of zelfs tijdens je Workation; 
EUR 65,- netto vitaliteitsbudget – we vinden het belangrijk dat we gezond blijven en een veilige werkplek hebben, zowel op kantoor als remote; 
Je kunt deelnemen aan het leasefietsplan; 
En vooral een leven lang leren. Op dag één start jouw onboardingprogramma, daarnaast krijg je een persoonlijk studiebudget dat je kunt inzetten voor jouw professionele ontwikkeling en ontvang je ook een GoodHabitz account, een online trainingstool voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling.  

Vrijheid, flexibiliteit en fun

Je werkt in een internationale omgeving met professionals met verschillende nationaliteiten. Een flexibele werkweek van 40, 36 of 32 uur behoort tot de mogelijkheden omdat wij van mening zijn dat jouw manier van werken bij jouw levensstijl moet passen. HSO heeft professionals in dienst die plezier hebben in hun werk en klaar staan voor elkaar. Om het plezier in ons werk nog groter te maken, organiseren we uiteraard teamuitjes en bedrijfsfeesten, maar ook wekelijkse zomerborrels op ons dakterras, allerlei sportactiviteiten en is er de mogelijkheid bij te dragen aan onze Maatschappelijk Verantwoord Ondernemen-werkzaamheden.

Over HSO  

HSO is de eerste full-service Microsoft Partner in Nederland. Samen met ruim 2500 getalenteerde medewerkers in Europa, Azië en Noord-Amerika verlenen we ondersteuning op lokaal en internationaal niveau aan industriële bedrijven, retailers, financiële en zakelijke dienstverleners en overheidsinstellingen.  HSO is voortdurend op zoek naar nieuw talent. We blijven onze wereldwijde community uitbreiden en scheppen er plezier in om samen te werken met prestatiegerichte mensen met een ondernemersgeest. Professionals die voortdurend willen leren en innoveren.
