Job Description:

DEVELOPER INTERN

Merkle Aarhus, a Dentsu Company

SPRING 2027

Do you want to go on a journey in one of Denmark's largest digital bureaus? Do you like to build robust backend systems the right way, and do you have a flair for writing code? Then this might be something for you!

Being an intern at Merkle will give you a lot of opportunities to evolve within e-commerce and platform development. You will be a fully integrated developer in a unique team of backend developers, frontend developers, QA's, and our clients and stakeholders. A team where we help each other finishing the tasks, in a sometimes busy day. You will have a mentor, who will help onboarding you and help you feel ready for the tasks as a developer at Merkle.

What You'll Be Working On

You'll join Merkle's Aarhus software team to help develop an API Management system exposing endpoints from a marketplace for aircraft spare parts. You'll work primarily on the Backend-for-Frontend (BFF), handling users and applications against a database, running in Azure.

Methods and technologies

Java & Spring Boot
REST API development
Docker & Azure deployments
SCRUM & Jira, and agile methods
Git
CI/CD and version control workflows
Unit testing and automated E2E testing

Tasks And Responsibilities

Build and maintain backend solutions in Java/Spring Boot, including REST endpoints and integration with external services
Gain practical experience with unit tests, automated E2E testing, and debugging
Learn how a modern API Management system fits together (frontend, BFF, database, and platforms such as SAP APIM and Entra ID)
Understand the professional development process, from business requirements to running code via version control, code review, and CI/CD
Collaborate through pair programming and agile methods, contributing your own solution proposals

Personal And Professional Skills

You come from a relevant education in IT and software development
You are curious and willing to learn
You are engaging and open, and can work both independently and in teams
You are thorough, professional, and quality minded

Backend development and API management are becoming a bigger and bigger part of our company, and right now we are growing every year. As an intern you will get a lot of interesting and challenging tasks. You will get great knowledge of modern software development methods, cloud deployment, and of how it is to work in an innovative company. It is very important to us that you learn a lot, evolve personally, and that we have fun while doing it. There will be an opportunity to be hired afterwards if it is a great match.

About Merkle

Merkle is the strong combination of local and global. We are more than 200 colleagues here in Denmark and part of Merkle worldwide with more than 11,000 people. Merkle is a leader in data-driven customer experience management (CXM), and we deliver unique, personalized customer experiences across channels and devices.

We are also part of dentsu – a global agency network with more than 46,000 dedicated employees in 145 markets. But size isn't everything. At Merkle, our mission is to help our clients provide their customers with the best experiences possible. More than anything, this requires skills, passion and cooperation.

We provide expertise in customer experience strategy and consulting, user experience design, CRM, data management, commerce, mobile, content management systems (CMS), adtech and martech platforms.

Where, when and how?

We are located at the center of Aarhus with a nice office at Åboulevarden 18, 2. sal, 8000 Aarhus C.

The internship will be from mid-January and for the following 3–4 months, and in that period, there will also be time to make your project in cooperation with Merkle. The internship is fulltime and unpaid - but we do offer a lot of social events, lots of learning opportunities and free breakfast and lunch.

Is your heart racing a little now? If you can see yourself in all this - both the internship and being part of Merkle - don't hesitate. Send us your CV and application as soon as possible.

Architecture & Design: Architect, design, and implement resilient, stateless, and highly scalable microservices and APIs, ensuring they conform to Citi’s technical standards and blueprint.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer – Healthcare Integrations & Systems
jobs.description:
Who is FluidAI?

FluidAI Medical is creating a paradigm shift in post-operative care, utilizing the plethora of data within the body, to help in the detection of post-operative complications at their onset. Our clinically validated platform sensing technology augments existing wound drains and catheters, providing healthcare providers with a smart monitoring tool that can support earlier detection of deadly complications and enhance the delivery of care.
We are an equal-opportunity employer and have a diverse team representation across language, ethnicity, gender and nationality.

Why join FluidAI Medical?

Mission to save lives and improve patient care with revolutionary technology that's already deployed on patients in real-world settings.
Work with a high-performing and cross-functional team that is empowered to grow, learn, and contribute across all levels of the organization.
We are a team of passionate builders and boundary-breakers that are on a singular mission to disrupt how patient care is done. We aim to succeed and perform together - as a team and as individuals.
Gain exposure across the entire technical stack, from novel sensing technologies and proprietary hardware to mobile/web software and ML algorithms.
Personal career-focused development and training with access to workshops, coursework, and experienced mentors/consultants.

Backend Engineer – Healthcare Integrations & Systems

FluidAI Medical is at the forefront of integrating data, technology, and healthcare to improve patient outcomes. Our platform generates rich, high-frequency clinical data at the bedside, and for that data to change how care is delivered it must flow reliably into the systems clinicians already use. We are expanding our team to include a Backend Engineer who can design and build the integration layer that connects our platform to hospital EHRs, laboratory and device systems, and national health data exchanges.
This role is ideal for a hands-on backend engineer with strong experience building production APIs and services, deep familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 FHIR and HL7 v2, and a track record of shipping and supporting integrations in live hospital environments. Experience with EHR vendor integration (e.g., Epic, Oracle Health/Cerner, InterSystems) and regional health information exchange requirements is highly preferred.
This position is remote but requires travel across the Middle East to collaborate with the FluidAI team, hospital IT departments, and clients.

Responsibilities

🔌 Design, build, and maintain the integration services that exchange clinical data between the FluidAI platform and hospital systems (EHRs, LIS, ADT feeds, device gateways, and national health exchanges).
🧬 Implement and maintain HL7 FHIR APIs and resources (e.g., Patient, Encounter, Observation, Device, DiagnosticReport) as well as HL7 v2 message interfaces (ADT, ORU, ORM) for inbound and outbound data flows.
🏗️ Build clean, well-tested, production-grade backend services and APIs (REST and event-driven) that are secure, observable, and resilient to the realities of hospital networks.
🗺️ Own data mapping and transformation logic between FluidAI's internal data models and external standards, including terminology mapping (LOINC, SNOMED CT, UCUM) and vendor-specific profile variations.
🔁 Develop robust interface engine and integration patterns: message queuing, retries, deduplication, acknowledgement handling, idempotency, and reconciliation.
🏥 Lead the technical side of hospital onboarding: gather interface requirements, conduct connectivity and message testing with hospital IT and EHR analysts, and support go-live and hypercare.
🔍 Implement monitoring, alerting, and logging for integration health so that message failures and data gaps are caught early and traced end-to-end.
🔐 Apply healthcare security and privacy best practices, including OAuth2/SMART on FHIR, mutual TLS, VPN connectivity, audit logging, and data minimization, in line with regional regulations (e.g., Saudi NPHIES/SeHE requirements, HIPAA, PIPEDA).
📚 Create and maintain clear technical documentation: interface specifications, FHIR implementation guides, integration runbooks, and data flow diagrams.
🤝 Partner with product, clinical, regulatory, and QA teams to ensure integrations meet clinical workflow needs and medical device software standards (e.g., IEC 62304, ISO 13485 processes).
🏃‍♂️ Participate in sprint planning and Agile ceremonies, contributing to roadmap planning and prioritization from an integrations and platform perspective.
🔧 Collaborate closely with software, hardware, data, and ML teams to expose reliable data services across the full technology stack.

Qualifications

📚 Strong hands-on experience as a Backend Engineer, Integration Engineer, or Interoperability Engineer, ideally within healthcare or medical technology.
🧬 Deep working knowledge of HL7 FHIR (R4 and/or R5), including resource modelling, profiles, extensions, search, and bulk data, and hands-on experience with FHIR servers or SDKs (e.g., HAPI FHIR, Firely, Microsoft/Azure FHIR, Google Cloud Healthcare API).
📨 Solid experience with HL7 v2.x messaging, including message structure, segments, ACK/NACK handling, and common workflows (ADT, ORU, ORM, MDM).
🔌 Experience with integration/interface engines such as Mirth Connect (NextGen Connect), Rhapsody, InterSystems, Cloverleaf, or equivalent custom pipelines.
💻 High proficiency in at least one backend language such as Python, Java/Kotlin, C#/.NET, Go, or TypeScript/Node.js, with strong API design skills (REST, OpenAPI, webhooks) and familiarity with message brokers (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, MQTT).
🗄️ Strong SQL and data modelling skills with relational databases (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle) and familiarity with NoSQL or time-series stores.
☁️ Experience deploying and operating services in cloud and hybrid environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP; Docker; Kubernetes; CI/CD; infrastructure as code), including on-premise hospital deployments.
🔐 Working knowledge of healthcare security and identity standards: OAuth2/OIDC, SMART on FHIR, TLS/mTLS, encryption at rest and in transit, and audit requirements.
🏥 Direct experience integrating with EHR vendors (Epic, Oracle Health/Cerner, MEDITECH, InterSystems TrakCare, or regional systems) and working alongside hospital IT teams is highly preferred.
🧠 Familiarity with clinical terminologies (LOINC, SNOMED CT, ICD-10, UCUM) and with medical device connectivity standards (e.g., IEEE 11073, IHE profiles such as PIX/PDQ, XDS) is a strong plus.
📋 Familiarity with regulated software development practices (IEC 62304, ISO 13485, risk management, traceability) is a plus.
🗣️ Fluent in English; Arabic is a strong plus. Ability to communicate clearly with both engineers and hospital IT and clinical stakeholders.
✈️ Must be able and willing to travel within Saudi Arabia for work, including extended periods of time.
🤝 Comfortable working in cross-functional, fast-paced, and collaborative environments.
💡 Strong problem-solving mindset with a bias toward impact, ownership, and continuous improvement.

Application Process

📞 Introductory phone call (~15 minutes).
📝 Technical & systems design working session (~1 hour).
🎤 Final interview (~45 minutes).
📜 Offer stage.

If you are passionate about making clinical data flow seamlessly between systems and want to build the integration foundations that put real-time patient insights directly into clinicians' hands, we would love to hear from you.

Dubai

Technical Leadership & Architecture

Ensure the system supports reasonable latency, high-throughput, and fault-tolerant trading

Team Leadership & Collaboration

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Engineer – Azure
jobs.description:
Bij Solvinity werk je aan Azure-omgevingen voor organisaties die geen fouten kunnen veroorloven. Denk aan het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid en toonaangevende financiële dienstverleners. Maar deze rol gaat verder dan engineering alleen. Je werkt ook mee in het Cloud Center of Excellence van het ministerie, waar je de cloud-strategie van een van de grootste overheidsorganisaties van Nederland mede vormgeeft. Diepgaand technisch werk, gecombineerd met echte strategische impact.

Wat ga je doen?

Je ontwerpt, bouwt en beheert veilige Azure-omgevingen voor klanten met strenge eisen op het gebied van beveiliging en compliance. Je werkt met Terraform, Palo Alto firewalls (VM-Series) en Azure Policies. Deployments automatiseer je via CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps of GitLab. Wijzigingen rollen geautomatiseerd en foutloos uit. Je beheert het versie- en lifecycle management van cloud resources en zorgt dat alles gedocumenteerd en herleidbaar is.

Je stelt accreditatiedocumentatie op, voert risicoanalyses en security assessments uit en zorgt dat cloudservices aantoonbaar voldoen aan normen zoals BIO2 en NIS2. Je bent daarin een betrouwbare gesprekspartner voor security- en risk-stakeholders.

Jouw kerntaken

Ontwerpen en beheren van Azure-netwerkarchitecturen (VNet, NSG, UDR, BGP, VPN, ExpressRoute)
Configureren van Palo Alto firewalls (VM-Series) en implementeren van zero-trust netwerksegmentatie
Bouwen en onderhouden van Infrastructure as Code met Terraform en CI/CD pipelines
Opstellen en implementeren van Azure Policies en policy-initiatieven voor governance en compliance
Opstellen van accreditatiedocumentatie, risicoanalyses en security assessments

Je werkt in een klein, hecht cloudteam met korte lijnen. Er zijn twee à drie standups per week. Geen zware vergadercultuur, wel nauwe samenwerking met collega’s, klanten en stakeholders.

Wat bieden wij?

€5.356 – €7.961 bruto per maand (o.b.v. een 40-urige werkweek), afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring
Mobiliteitsvergoeding of een lease-auto
32 tot 40-urige werkweek
Grotendeels thuiswerken met een vaste dag per week op kantoor en bij de klant
80% pensioenbijdrage van de werkgever

26 vakantiedagen, met mogelijkheid tot uitbreiding

Tot €300 per jaar voor jouw sportactiviteiten

Solvinity investeert structureel in jouw ontwikkeling. Vanaf dag één volg je relevante opleidingen en trainingen. Na twee jaar in dienst ontvang je €1.000 extra opleidingsbudget dat je volledig zelf mag invullen. Denk aan een Azure-certificering zoals de AZ-104 of AZ-400, de Palo Alto PCNSE of een ander traject dat bij jou past. Jaarlijks stel je samen met je manager een persoonlijk opleidingsplan op.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een ervaren cloud engineer met een analytische instelling en een security-first mindset. Je bouwt niet alleen — je denkt ook na over waarom je iets zo inricht en wat de risico’s zijn. Je werkt zelfstandig, maar schakelt makkelijk met collega’s, klanten en stakeholders. Je bent nauwkeurig, documentatievaardig en weet complexe technische vraagstukken helder op te schrijven.

Wat Je Meebrengt

Minimaal 5 jaar werkervaring in een vergelijkbare cloud-rol
Diepgaande kennis van Azure-netwerken (VNet, NSG, UDR, BGP, VPN, ExpressRoute)
Hands-on ervaring met Palo Alto firewalls (VM-Series) en zero-trust segmentatie
Aantoonbare ervaring met Terraform en CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps of GitHub Actions)
Ervaring met Azure Policies, accreditatieprocessen en compliance-kaders (BIO2, NIS2 is een pré)

Kennis van Bicep of ARM is een pré. Een relevante Azure-certificering (AZ-104, AZ-400) of Palo Alto PCNSE is een pluspunt, maar aantoonbare praktijkervaring weegt minstens zo zwaar. Je beheerst het Nederlands goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk, op minimaal hbo-niveau.

Over Solvinity

Solvinity levert Secure Managed Cloud Services aan organisaties met hoge beveiligingseisen. Hiermee ondersteunt het bedrijf de (rijks-)overheid, gemeenten en toonaangevende organisaties in de financiële en zakelijke dienstverlening, zoals het ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid, Politie Nederland, TransLink (OV-chipkaart), ING en Klaverblad. Solvinity ontwerpt, bouwt en beheert de complexe platformen waarop bedrijfskritische applicaties veilig en optimaal functioneren. Daarnaast levert het bedrijf CI/CD, containertechnologie en ‘Stretched’ DevSecOps oplossingen voor softwareontwikkelaars.

Solvinity onderscheidt zich op het gebied van cybersecurity met een uitgebreid portfolio aan securitydiensten en -oplossingen en biedt, met een meerderheidsbelang in Securify.nl, aanvullende cybersecurity diensten. Daarnaast heeft het bedrijf certificeringen volgens (inter)nationale normen als ISO 27001, ISO 14001, ISO 9001, PCI DSS en heeft het als eerste MSP in Nederland SOC 1 en 2 compliance rapporten voor de gehele beheeromgeving van de private én Azure cloud.

Kijk voor meer informatie op [www.solvinity.nl](http://www.solvinity.nl), of volg Solvinity op LinkedIn.

Interesse?

Passen we bij elkaar? Wil je ons daarvan overtuigen? Bel of app dan onze recruitmentspecialist, Niels Moelard, op 06-30399509 of stuur een mail naar niels.moelard@solvinity.com We streven naar een snel en persoonlijk sollicitatieproces: na een eerste (online) kennismaking volgt een gesprek op kantoor in Amersfoort. Binnen twee gespreksrondes weet je waar je aan toe bent.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

We believe in the power of play. Through our innovative serious games, we are changing the way the world looks at people with cognitive challenges, such as dementia or intellectual disabilities. Our games combine smart hardware, thoughtful software, and evidence-based interactive content to create meaningful moments of joy for players and caregivers worldwide.
To scale our technology roadmap and lead our core engineering team, we are looking for a hands-on, empathetic, and technically grounded Manager Software Engineering
.

The Role

As Manager Software Engineering
, you will directly manage a cross-functional team of 7 engineers across systems, web, and QA disciplines.
You will bridge the gap between product strategy and technical execution while fostering individual growth. Because our domain spans embedded/systems engineering, web platforms, and quality assurance, we need a leader with a solid technical background who can speak the team's language, guide architectural decisions, and manage a diverse set of engineering disciplines effectively.

Key Responsibilities

People Management & Leadership:
Provide direct line management for a cross-functional team of 7 engineers. Conduct regular 1-on-1s, drive talent development, evaluate performance, and maintain a high-trust, collaborative engineering culture.
Cross-Functional Team Enablement:
Align distinct technical disciplines toward shared sprint goals, deliverable milestones, and seamless product releases.
Technical Guidance:
Leverage your software engineering background to engage in technical architecture discussions, review trade-offs, and help the team solve complex engineering challenges.
Delivery & Agile Processes:
Optimize team processes and workflows to ensure high code quality, reliable releases, continuous testing, and scalable architecture.
Cross-Department Collaboration:
Act as the primary liaison between your engineering team, Product Owners, UX/UI Designers, and Hardware teams to ensure smooth end-to-end integration.

Requirements

Leadership Experience:
3+ years in an engineering leadership role (e.g., Engineering Manager, Technical Team Lead) with a proven track record of managing cross-functional technical teams.
Strong Technical Background:
A solid background as a Software Engineer/Developer with the technical depth needed to guide cross-functional software teams effectively.
Cross-Functional Domain Knowledge:
Broad understanding of software development lifecycles across systems software, modern web applications, and QA automation/processes.
Leadership Style:
Coaching, servant-leadership approach. You prioritize removing roadblocks, empowering engineers, and fostering clear communication across disciplines.
Languages:
Professional fluency in both English and Dutch (spoken and written).
Bonus:
Experience in IoT, hardware-software integration, MedTech, or interactive media/gaming platforms.
Location:
Candidates need to located in the Netherlands. We do not offer relocation support.

What We Offer

Meaningful Impact:
Lead a key team building technology that directly improves the lives of hundreds of thousands of vulnerable people.
Inspiring Work Environment:
A dynamic, open, and friendly team culture in our Utrecht office.
Hybrid Working:
Balanced mix of on-site collaboration and working from home.
Benefits:
Annual salary up to 100K, company shares, 25 vacation days (full-time basis)and travel allowance.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist Solutions Engineer - Platform Security and Cloud Infrastructure
jobs.description:
(FEQ427R351) Senior Specialist Solutions Engineer - Platform Security and Cloud Infrastructure

As a Senior Specialist Solutions Engineer, you will guide customers in building big data solutions on Databricks that span a large variety of use cases. This is a customer-facing role that works with and supports the Field Engineering pre-sales teams and requires hands-on production experience with cloud infrastructure and big data technologies. Specialist Solutions Engineers help customers through the design and successful implementation of essential workloads while aligning their technical roadmap to expand the use of the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. As a deep go-to-expert reporting to the Specialist Field Engineering Manager, you will continue to strengthen your technical skills through mentorship, learning, and internal training programs to continuously consolidate the skills in your area of speciality.

The Impact You Will Have

Technical thought leader:
Provide technical leadership to guide strategic customers to successful implementations on big data projects, ranging from architectural and security design to development and deployment best practices, including automation
Assist Solution Architects with more advanced aspects of the technical sale, including custom proof of concept content, workload sizing, and custom architectures

Cloud Infra & Security Expertise

Architect production-level cloud native governed workloads
Provide technical expertise in cloud infrastructure and security relating to our Databricks Lakehouse Platform
Community & Adoption: Enable adoption by leading workshops, hackathons, and conference presentations, while actively contributing to the broader Databricks community.

What We Look For

Pre-sales or post-sales experience working with external customers (or internal clients/stakeholders) across industries
4+ years of experience designing Cloud infrastructure/Security and services, such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, applying best practices in cloud security and networking, including:
Architecting, designing, deploying, and maintaining cloud networks and connectivity (VPC/VNet design, routing, segmentation, private connectivity).
Identity & Access Management (e.g. role-based access control, using the principle of least privilege, integration with IdPs, etc)
Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure automation (e.g. Terraform or cloud-specific resource management tools like ARM, CloudFormation, etc).

Experience supporting customers (external or internal) in designing and implementing a security lakehouse/security data platform on Databricks to augment SIEM, enable security analytics and threat hunting, and build advanced detections.
Hands-on experience with prompt engineering, vibe coding and agentic tools
Foundational knowledge of large-scale processing/analytical engines for data pipeline architecture design.
Databricks Certification(s) will be advantageous for the role.

Notes On The Role

This will be an office-based contract (Amsterdam), with a hybrid schedule, requiring up to 30% travel when needed for customer visits, events & trainings.
An initial 12-month fixed-term contract is to be offered, with the expectation of extending/converting to FTE upon successful completion of the probation period.

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

jobs.description:
Wil jij bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van de volgende generatie GGZ? Hou jij ervan om samen met het team innovatieve oplossingen te ontwikkelen om de uitdagingen binnen de geestelijke gezondheidszorg aan te pakken? Lees dan snel verder!

Dit ga je doen

Als Mendix Developer
ben je een onmisbare schakel in het bouwen van de volgende generatie mentale gezondheidszorg. Binnen MentalCareGroup ontwikkel je samen met je team innovatieve oplossingen om de uitdagingen binnen de geestelijke gezondheidszorg aan te pakken. In deze rol draag je actief bij aan het ondersteunen van onze behandelaren en help je onze cliënten door vooruitstrevende digitale toepassingen beschikbaar te maken.

Je richt je op het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en implementeren van Mendix-applicaties die onze zorgprocessen verder digitaliseren. Denk hierbij aan ons innovatieve cliëntenportaal Empower, onze mobiele app, het behandelarenportaal of een van onze andere Mendix apps. Daarnaast werk je nauw samen met eindgebruikers zoals behandelaren, product owners en collega-developers om tot efficiënte en gebruiksvriendelijke oplossingen te komen. Met jouw oog voor detail vertaal je complexe vraagstukken naar intuïtieve en stabiele applicaties die de zorgkwaliteit verhogen én de cliëntbeleving verbeteren.

Jouw concrete werkzaamheden zijn:

Ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van Mendix-applicaties die bijdragen aan de kwaliteit van de zorg.
Samenwerken met collega’s om functionele wensen en technische requirements te vertalen naar slimme oplossingen.
Continu verbeteren van bestaande applicaties, onder andere op het gebied van UX/UI.
Integraties bouwen met externe systemen en databronnen
Bewaken en verbeteren van de codekwaliteit, onder andere door het toepassen van Mendix best practices.
Actief meedenken over de technische roadmap en architectuur van onze Mendix-omgeving.

Je standplaats is Woerden. Het team werkt tevens regelmatig samen op onze kantoren in Zwolle of Arnhem. Daarnaast behoort thuiswerken tot de mogelijkheden.

Dit bieden wij

Wij bieden veel verantwoordelijkheid, diversiteit en uitdaging in een fijne en informele werkomgeving.

Daarnaast bieden wij jou het volgende:

Een enthousiast team van Mendix-developers, waar innovatie en openheid voorop staan.
Volop mogelijkheden om je verder te ontwikkelen via ons uitgebreide opleidingsprogramma, inclusief (Mendix) certificeringen.
Een tijdelijk contract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband;
Hybride werken en flexibele werktijden: jij bepaalt samen met je team waar en wanneer je werkt, zolang je goed in contact blijft met je collega’s.
Een inspirerende werkomgeving vlakbij het station in Arnhem– óf de mogelijkheid om op afstand te werken als je bereid bent zo nu en dan naar Arnhem of een van onze andere vestigingen te reizen.
Een salaris tussen € 3610,- en € 5211,- bruto per maand op fulltime basis (40 uur per week) afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring;
Onbeperkt toegang tot de HSK Flow app met coaching, e-health modules, webinars en een Mental Fit Check
25 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband;
Ons pensioen welke is ondergebracht bij AEGON;

Leer ons kennen

Over het Team

Bij ons werk je samen met een groep enthousiaste collega’s die openstaan voor vernieuwing en innovatie. Innovatie en ontwikkeling staan daarbij centraal: vorig jaar hebben we bijvoorbeeld een geheel nieuwe cliëntenomgeving gelanceerd om de zorg nóg beter te maken.

Over Mental Care Group

HSK, Mentaal Beter en Opdidakt zijn allemaal onderdeel van Mental Care Group. Met meer dan 2000 medewerkers door het land zetten wij ons iedere dag in om de beste zorg te bieden aan onze cliënten, van jong tot oud en van Groningen tot Maastricht. Samen staan wij sterk voor een mentaal gezond, vitaal en veerkrachtig Nederland. Meer weten over Mental Care Group? Je leest het hier.

Vereisten

Je bent een expert op het gebied van Mendix, kent alle ins en outs van het platform en hebt een visie over de inzet van Mendix technologie.

In deze rol draag je actief bij aan het ondersteunen van onze behandelaren en help je onze cliënten door vooruitstrevende digitale toepassingen beschikbaar te maken.

Tevens:

Heb je een Mendix Advanced Certificaat of ben je bereid deze op korte termijn te behalen;
Ben je 32-40 uur per week beschikbaar;
Heb je een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift;
Heb je geen Mendix ervaring maar wel ervaringen met andere (low) code oplossingen? Dan staan we er ook voor open om het gesprek met jou aan te gaan!

Ben je enthousiast geworden?

We zien jouw sollicitatie met CV en motivatie graag tegemoet. Solliciteren kan via de sollicitatiebutton. Wil je eerst nog meer weten over deze vacature? Neem dan contact op met Ine Rothkrantz (manager recruitment) via 06 57473979 of werkenbij@mentalcaregroup.nl.

Goed om te weten:

Voor alle functies binnen Mental Care Group is een verklaring omtrent gedrag vereist. Tevens maakt het inwinnen van referenties onderdeel uit van het sollicitatieproces.
Er wordt geen einddatum gehanteerd. Zolang de vacature online staat, is deze nog actueel.
We begrijpen dat je als intermediair kandidaten wil aandragen voor onze functies en wilt bijdragen aan onze organisatie maar dit is niet hoe wij ons recruitmentproces hebben ingericht. jobs.title: Software Developer - Kubernetes, Java (Remote)
jobs.description:
About the Company

JetBrains is a software development company focused on creating developer tools and platforms. Since its founding in 2000, the company has developed a broad portfolio of products and is now evolving toward a unified, AI-native platform for software development.

The JetBrains Platform team is building infrastructure that connects developer workflows, team collaboration, and organizational controls across products, teams, and environments.

About the Role

JetBrains is looking for an experienced Staff Software Developer to join its Identity and Access Management team within the JetBrains Platform. The team owns foundational services responsible for authentication and authorization, as well as organizations, user memberships, groups, and workspaces.

These services support multiple JetBrains products and platform components, making reliability, security, scalability, and performance essential to the role.

As a Staff Software Developer, you will take ownership across the entire software development lifecycle, including architecture, development, code review, and production operations. You will primarily work with Kotlin, with some Go, while designing and evolving services within a distributed, multi-tenant SaaS environment.

Key Responsibilities

Own the complete software development lifecycle, including code, architecture, and operations.

Maintain and evolve production services primarily written in Kotlin, with some Go.

Ensure platform services remain reliable and performant as the platform scales.

Design and implement features across identity, organization, membership, group, and workspace domains.

Review and integrate pull requests from other platform teams.

Manage integrations with other JetBrains Platform components and connected applications.

Take ownership of existing production services and continuously improve their reliability and performance.

Collaborate with engineering teams across the platform to deliver robust identity and access solutions.

Required Qualifications

7+ years of JVM development experience, preferably with Kotlin.

Strong understanding of JVM performance and PostgreSQL performance optimization.

Experience building and operating production SaaS services.

Experience working with distributed and multi-tenant environments.

Ability to work with modern DevOps technologies and infrastructure.

Experience with Kubernetes (K8S), OpenTelemetry, and Grafana.

Demonstrated experience taking ownership of existing production services and improving them.

Strong software architecture and engineering skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with identity management protocols such as:

OAuth 2.0

OpenID Connect (OIDC)

SAML 2.0

SCIM 2.0

Experience designing and evolving domain models for organizational or identity systems.

Cybersecurity experience, including risk estimation, recognizing common vulnerability patterns, and promoting secure software development lifecycle practices.

Hands-on experience with Go.

Technical Skills

Kotlin

Java / JVM

Go

PostgreSQL

Kubernetes

OpenTelemetry

Grafana

Identity & Access Management

Testautomatisierung und Programmiersprachen: Du bringst mindestens 3 Jahre praktische Erfahrung in agilen Projekten mit DevOps mit und bist sicher in mindestens zwei Programmiersprachen wie Java, TypeScript, C# oder Python.

Sprachkenntnisse: Deine sehr guten Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir eine sichere Kommunikation.

Wenn Dinge „denken“ können, wird's für dich erst richtig spannend? Dann schließ‘ dich Accenture an und arbeite im IT / OT-Team unserer Cloud Software Infrastructure Domain an innovativen Lösungen rund um IoT, Industrie 4.0, Cloud Computing, Connectivity, Robotics oder Machine Learning.

Denn wie du brennen wir für Embedded Software, vernetzte Industrieanlagen oder Smart Devices. So bringst du eigene Themen voran und kannst eines der weltgrößten Technologie- und Beratungsunternehmen auf Fachkonferenzen vertreten.

Deine Mission

Du entwickelst in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden innovative Lösungen von der strategischen Planung, Konzeption über Design bis zu Implementierung und Betrieb, um echten Mehrwert für unsere Kunden zu schaffen.Du unterstützt den Vertrieb dabei, neue Geschäftspotenziale zu identifizieren, anspruchsvolle, digitale Lösungen anzubieten und somit nachhaltige Kundebeziehungen aufzubauen.

Das erwartet dich

Vielseitige Projekte: Entwickle innovative IT/OT Lösungen und konzeptioniere technische Architekturen auf Basis moderner Cloud-Plattformen

Künstliche Intelligenz: Kreiere KI-basierte Produkte und Plattformen, einschließlich LLM-basierter Anwendungen, RAG-Pipelines oder KI Gateways

Fachliche Entwicklung: Erweitere kontinuierlich Deine Skills in Software-Architekturen

Coaching: Als praxiserfahrene:r Expert:in gehört es auch zu Deinen Aufgaben, Softwareentwicklungs-Teams zu coachen und zu führen. Dabei arbeitest Du in agilen, internationalen Teams und übernimmst die Projektleitung

Darauf freuen wir uns

Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Digitalisierungs- und Transformationsprojekte, idealerweise im Umfeld IoT, Industrie 4.0, vernetzter Systeme oder digitaler Plattformen

Fundiertes Verständnis moderner Technologiearchitekturen wie IT/OT-Plattformen, Event Streaming, Cloud-Lösungen, AI/ML und digitaler Ökosysteme – mit der Fähigkeit, technologische Konzepte in geschäftlichen Mehrwert zu übersetzen

Erfahrung in der Steuerung interdisziplinärer Teams, agiler Delivery-Modelle sowie in der Verantwortung von Projektbudgets, Zeitplänen und Ergebnissen

Kenntnisse aktueller Entwicklungen im Bereich Generative AI, Agentic AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG und deren Einsatzmöglichkeiten zur Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen

Ausgeprägte Kommunikations-, Präsentations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten auf Managementebene in deutscher und englischer Sprache sowie projektbedingte Mobilität

Was wir dir bieten

Individuelles Arbeitszeitmodell in Voll- oder Teilzeit mit flexibel anpassbaren Arbeitszeiten

Arbeiten, wo du gebraucht wirst – an einem der Accenture-Standorte, remote oder beim Kunden vor Ort

Lohnenswerte Corporate-Angebote, beispielsweise für Freizeit, Versicherungen und Altersvorsorge

Einen Developer Laptop nach Wunsch

Accenture-Kultur: Hier machst DU den Unterschied

Deine Fähigkeiten, dein Naturell und deine Ambitionen machen dich einzigartig. Und wenn die unterschiedlichsten Talente, Stärken und Sichtweisen aufeinandertreffen, entsteht etwas Großartiges: Ideen, die in der Welt etwas bewegen. Deshalb setzen wir bei Accenture auf Diversität und freie Entfaltung. Schaffe dir ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du aufgehst. Mit Aufgaben, die dir am Herzen liegen. Mit einem Workload, der zu dir passt. Und mit einer Arbeitsweise, die sich an deinen Zielen orientiert. Wie du dich vernetzen, weiterbilden und persönlich wachsen willst, liegt bei dir. Es ist deine Karriere. Wir helfen dir, sie so zu gestalten, wie du es dir vorstellst.

Dein Kontakt

Noch Fragen offen? Dann wende dich gerne an unser Recruiting Team per E-Mail an recruiting_germany@accenture.com oder telefonisch unter 00800 45045045.

jobs.description:
Unser SIMARIS Team in Leipzig sucht Unterstützung im Bereich der Softwareentwicklung für Energieverteilprodukte und -Systeme. Als Software Architect (w/m/d) gestaltest Du die technologische Zukunft unserer Plattform. Mit Deiner Expertise in Cloud-Architekturen und modernen Entwicklungstechnologien erschaffst Du skalierbare Lösungen, die unseren Kunden echten Mehrwert bieten.

Was wir dir bieten:

Ein attraktives Vergütungspaket
30 Tage Urlaub sowie vielfältige, flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, die eine Auszeit für dich und deine Familie ermöglichen
2 bis 3 Tage pro Woche mobiles Arbeiten als globaler Standard
Bis zu 30 Tage Workation in bestimmten Ländern
Attraktive Siemens Altersvorsorge
Standortabhängige Kinderbetreuung, um Familie und Beruf zu vereinen
(Globale) Entwicklungsprogramme, die nach deinen Wünschen und Ambitionen angepasst werden können
Barrierefreie Standorte

Da jeder von uns 300.000 Mitarbeitenden andere Benefits als besonders wichtig empfindet und wir an dieser Stelle nicht unser ganzes Benefit-Portfolio auflisten können, findest du hier weitere Informationen. Die einzelnen Benefits unterliegen gesetzlichen, tarif-/vertraglichen oder betrieblichen Bedingungen. 

Verändere die Welt von morgen:

Du konzipierst und entwickelst globale, anspruchsvolle Webanwendungen und Services, wobei du sowohl Frontend- als auch Backend-Systeme in deiner Verantwortung vereinst
Darauf aufbauend entwirfst du komplexe System-Architekturen und stellst die optimale Integration von Cloud-nativen Technologien sowie Microservices sicher
Im engen Austausch mit UX/UI Designern und Entwicklern entwickelst du innovative und benutzerzentrierte Lösungen, die unsere Kunden nachhaltig begeistern
Zusätzlich verantwortest du den gesamten Build- und Release-Prozess, kümmerst dich um Systemintegration, Kalkulation und Planung und gewährleistest durch L2-Support die kontinuierliche Betriebsbereitschaft der Lösungen
Abschließend unterstützt du unsere Kunden bei der technischen Umsetzung und Implementierung, sodass eine reibungslose Einführung und Nutzung der Anwendungen gewährleistet ist

So überzeugst du uns:

Ausbildung: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Masterstudium in Informatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung sowie mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung
Erfahrungen und Kenntnisse:
Du verfügst über fundierte Expertise in Cloud-nativen Architekturen und Microservices
Du bringst umfassende Erfahrung mit Java/Spring Boot, Angular oder vergleichbaren Frameworks mit
Du hast Kenntnisse in Container-Technologien, DevOps-Praktiken und Datenintegrationslösungen (z. B. ETL-Prozesse)

Arbeitsweise: Du überzeugst durch ausgeprägte konzeptionelle und analytische Fähigkeiten sowie strategisches Denken und eine hands-on Mentalität
Sprachkenntnisse: Du besitzt verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse

Du bist viel mehr als deine Qualifikationen und wir glauben an das Potential jeder einzelnen Person. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Bei Siemens sind wir überzeugt: Wer sich wertgeschätzt und zugehörig fühlt, kann das eigene Potenzial voll entwickeln. Deshalb schaffen wir ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem jede Person ein Gefühl der Zugehörigkeit erfährt und in dem individuelle Perspektiven und Erfahrungen geschätzt werden. Unser Engagement für Fairness und Respekt gilt für alle Bewerbenden.

Wir legen Wert auf Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, ausdrücklich auch von Menschen mit Behinderung.

Über Uns

Bist du bereit, die Energiewende voranzutreiben?

Unsere Mission ist es, innovative und nachhaltige Lösungen zu entwickeln, die sowohl Energieeinsparungen ermöglichen als auch den CO₂-Fußabdruck von Gebäuden und Infrastrukturen reduzieren. Deshalb setzen wir bei Siemens im Bereich Smart Infrastructure Electrification & Automation alles daran, eine grünere Zukunft zu gestalten und unsere Lebens- und Arbeitsweise zu revolutionieren.

jobs.title: Quality Engineer (m/w/d) – Softwaretest & Automatisierung
jobs.description:
Die medatixx GmbH & Co. KG ist gemeinsam mit ihren Tochterunternehmen I-Motion GmbH und mediDOK Software Entwicklungsgesellschaft mbH ein führender Anbieter von Praxissoftware und ergänzenden Add-ons, umfassenden Systemhaus- und IT-Dienstleistungen sowie IT-bezogenem Wissen und Bildung für ambulante medizinische Einrichtungen in Deutschland. Gut 900 Mitarbeiter entwickeln die Praxisprogramme von medatixx kontinuierlich weiter und bieten zentrale und Vor-Ort-Dienstleistungen für alle Organisationsformen der ambulanten Versorgung an.

Ihre Aufgaben

Gemeinsam mit den Entwicklungsteams prüfen Sie Anforderungen und Akzeptanzkriterien auf Vollständigkeit, Widersprüche und Testbarkeit und leiten daraus aussagekräftige Testfälle ab
Aus einzelnen Testfällen entwickeln Sie nachhaltige manuelle und automatisierte Testsuiten und bauen unsere Regressionstestabdeckung kontinuierlich aus
Moderne KI-gestützte Werkzeuge nutzen Sie gezielt zur Ableitung von Testfällen, zur Validierung von Anforderungen und zur Unterstützung effizienter Testprozesse
Durch strukturierte Fehleranalysen, die Reproduktion von Fehlersituationen und explorative Tests decken Sie auch schwer auffindbare Grenzfälle auf
Mit Skripten automatisieren Sie wiederkehrende Aufgaben und unterstützen den Betrieb von Testdaten, Testumgebungen und Testinfrastrukturen
Darüber hinaus bringen Sie Ihre Ideen aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Qualitätssicherung und Testprozesse ein

Ihr Profil

Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung, ein Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation im IT-Umfeld bildet die Grundlage Ihres fachlichen Hintergrunds
Erfahrung im Softwaretest sowie im Entwurf von Testfällen, Testsuiten oder automatisierten Tests zeichnet Sie aus.Erste Berührungspunkte mit Programmierung, Skripting oder dem Lesen von Quellcode bringen Sie mit; Kenntnisse in CI/CD, API-Tests oder Datenbanken sind von Vorteil
Moderne Ansätze wie Testautomatisierung, TDD und der Einsatz von KI im Testumfeld wecken Ihr Interesse und werden von Ihnen mit einer kritischen Haltung begleitet
Eine analytische, strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise sowie Teamgeist und Ausdauer bei der Ursachenanalyse komplexer Fehler runden Ihr Profil ab
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1) setzen wir voraus; Erfahrungen mit Windows-, Netzwerk- oder Healthcare-Umgebungen sowie eine ISTQB-Zertifizierung sind willkommen, aber kein Muss

Unser Angebot

Sinnstiftende Tätigkeit durch die Mitarbeit an der Digitalisierung des Gesundheitssystems und der Verbesserung von Praxisabläufen
Zukunftssicherer Arbeitsplatz in einer wachstumsstarken Branche
Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
Hybride Arbeitsmodelle und Flexibilität durch Gleitzeit
30 Urlaubstage, Überstundenausgleich durch Freizeit
Attraktives Paket an Gesundheits- und Sozialleistungen (z.B. Bezuschussung von Bildschirmarbeitsbrille, Grippeschutzimpfung, Arbeitgeberzuschuss zur privaten Altersvorsorge, Fitness- und Gesundheitsapp und Dienstfahrrad)
Krippen- und Kindergartenzuschuss
Mitarbeiterrabatte bei namhaften Marken
Firmen- und Teamevents

jobs.title: Microsoft AI Solution Architect (all genders)
jobs.description:
Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso.

DEINE ROLLE

Architekturverantwortung: Du konzipierst und realisierst KI-gestützte Lösungsarchitekturen mit Microsoft Azure AI und Microsoft 365 Copilot.
Strategische Lösungsgestaltung: Du entwickelst Agenten-basierte Architekturen mit Technologien wie Semantic Kernel und Multi-Agent-Workflows.
Use-Case-Entwicklung: Du identifizierst und gestaltest Business Cases von der Vorstudie bis zur produktiven Umsetzung.
Technische Integration: Du orchestrierst hybride Cloud-Umgebungen, automatisierst CI/CD und arbeitest eng mit DevOps- und Security-Teams.
Einführung & Governance: Du begleitest Kundenteams bei der Einführung von Microsoft AI und etablierst Governance-Strukturen.
Strategische Mitgestaltung: Du prägst aktiv Portfolioentwicklung, Community-Arbeit und Presales-Prozesse mit deinem Fachwissen.

DEIN PROFIL

Technologie-Expertise: Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung mit Microsoft-Technologien, insbesondere Azure AI, Data Platforms und Power Platform.
Architektur-Know-how: Du kennst dich mit API-Design, Datenintegration, Multi-Agent-Systemen und Security im Microsoft-Umfeld aus.
Beratungs- und Coachingkompetenz: Du erklärst technische Inhalte klar, coachst Teams und verstehst branchenspezifische Anforderungen.
Innovationsfreude: Du verfolgst technologische Trends, teilst dein Wissen und förderst eine „AI First“-Denkweise.
Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 8 Jahre Erfahrung als Solution Architect oder in vergleichbaren Rollen mit.
Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst sehr gut Deutsch und verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse.

Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.

Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer | API Enterprise
jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.

Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What Sets Us Apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication
. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join the API Enterprise
team. We sit at the intersection of DeepL's API platform and our Enterprise ecosystem. Whereas the Core team obsesses over the self-service developer journey, our focus is on enterprise customer adoption: the usage insights, cost controls, RBAC , compliance, and data residency capabilities that enterprise IT and security teams depend on. We work hand-in-hand with a wide set of stakeholder teams to make DeepL's API the obvious and safe choice for global enterprises.

We are shifting gears. We are moving from "Software-First" to "Product-First." We don't hire engineers to just close tickets or optimize algorithms in isolation. We hire Missionaries
— builders who obsess over the Why before the How. You will contribute across the stack, shipping features that create delightful, frictionless experiences for both external developers and internal engineering teams.

Your Responsibilities

Drive Enterprise API Adoption: You will own the features that turn enterprise interest into deep, durable adoption. Examples include usage insights, cost and consumption controls, and the governance tooling that lets large organizations understand and manage how they use DeepL's APIs
Build for Governance & Compliance: You will design the controls enterprise IT and security admins rely on (roles and permissions, projects, data residency, and audit-ability), making DeepL the compliant default for regulated, global organizations
Guardianship of Quality & Production Reliability: You will own your services end-to-end, including participation in the API on-call rotation, with a shared goal of taking our public API to four nines of reliability. You will implement strong contract testing, monitoring, and SLOs, preventing breaking changes and security vulnerabilities before they reach our enterprise customers
Architect Across the Enterprise Ecosystem: You will work deep within DeepL's existing technical and organizational structures, navigating dependencies across different areas and many stakeholder teams to ship cohesive, reliable enterprise capabilities

Qualities we look for

An "Enterprise-First" Mindset: You treat enterprise IT and security admins as your primary users. You understand that earning their trust means clear governance, predictable cost control, robust compliance, fast response times and data residency. You're a strong communicator who's comfortable owning product decisions and implementing them
Backend Mastery at Scale (C# / .NET): You have deep expertise designing scalable backend systems, RESTful APIs, and distributed architectures, primarily in C# / .NET, and you've worked with high-scale distributed systems in production. Strong API design fundamentals and system design are core to how you work. Roughly 80-90% of the work is backend; working on the frontend (React/TypeScript) is a welcome plus, not a requirement
Enterprise Platform Fluency: You bring hands-on experience with the building blocks of modern enterprise APIs (MCP, CLIs, and OAuth) and know how to wield them to build secure, extensible integrations
Cross-Team Leadership: You have a track record of leading projects across multiple teams. You can align with different areas and other stakeholders, manage cross-team contracts and dependencies, and keep complex, interconnected systems coherent
Extreme Ownership & Operational Excellence: You own your services end-to-end (production operations, incident response, and on-call) and you're motivated by pushing reliability toward four nines. You write comprehensive tests, learn from incidents, and treat mature SLOs as a core engineering feature
AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like Claude Code, Codex or GitHub Copilot) to accelerate delivery so you can focus your energy on high-value architecture and complex problem-solving
Bonus points if you have: a track record of zero-downtime migrations on live systems; experience with metering, quota, or usage-data systems; worked in a compliance environment (SOC 2, ISO 27001, C5, or similar)

What We Offer

Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Virtual Shares: An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

Athera Healthcare delivers innovative healthcare solutions that improve patient outcomes and transform healthcare delivery.

About the role

We are looking for a QA Engineer who wants the opportunity to shape how quality assurance is done, rather than simply inherit an established testing process.
You will be our first dedicated QA hire and will work closely with the Head of Technology and the wider development team to define and establish a pragmatic QA approach across a varied technology estate.
Our applications span modern web technologies and long-established desktop systems, including React, Angular, .NET, Java, Delphi, WinForms/WPF and ASP.NET Web Forms.
Automation today is relatively limited. A major part of this role will be helping us change that.
We are particularly interested in someone who is keen to embrace AI-assisted testing and modern automation techniques. We do not expect you to arrive with every answer. We are looking for someone with strong QA fundamentals, good scripting and technical skills, and the curiosity to investigate new approaches and turn them into practical improvements.
This could suit an experienced mid-level QA Engineer who wants greater ownership and the opportunity to demonstrate that they can build and influence a QA capability.

What you'll be doing

The role will be approximately 50% test automation and 50% hands-on exploratory and manual testing, although the balance will naturally change depending on releases and projects.
You will:

Help define and continuously improve our overall QA strategy, processes and standards.
Build out automated regression coverage across both web and legacy desktop applications.
Investigate where AI can make testing faster, broader and more maintainable.
Convert existing manual regression tests into appropriate automated tests.
Use AI-assisted tools to help generate, maintain and improve automated test suites.
Investigate agentic and computer-use technologies for automating applications that are difficult to test using traditional automation frameworks.
Identify gaps in regression coverage and prioritise automation based on risk and business impact.
Create and maintain appropriate test data.
Use AI and automation tooling to analyse failures, diagnose issues and reduce brittle or unreliable tests.
Perform exploratory testing to identify issues that scripted and automated tests may miss.
Manually verify complex functionality and changes where automation would not provide sufficient confidence.
Test functionality across modern web applications and legacy Windows desktop systems.
Test APIs and integrations.
Participate in performance, security and non-functional testing where appropriate.
Review acceptance criteria and contribute to improving testability before development begins.
Produce proportionate test plans based on technical and business risk.
Participate in defect triage and help development teams understand and reproduce issues.
Contribute to release readiness and release sign-off.
Help manage test environments, test data and regression coverage.
Integrate automated testing into our Azure DevOps development and delivery processes.
Work closely with developers to encourage quality throughout the software development lifecycle rather than treating testing as a final release step.

AI and automation

We see AI as an important part of the future of software quality.
We are not looking for someone who simply uses AI to generate test scripts. We want someone interested in understanding where AI genuinely improves QA and where traditional engineering judgement remains essential.
You will be encouraged to investigate and apply AI to areas including:
Generating initial automated test cases and scripts.
Turning manual regression scenarios into automation
Identifying potential gaps in regression coverage.
Generating realistic and useful test data.
Analysing automated test failures and logs.
Diagnosing flaky or brittle tests.
Improving and maintaining existing automated tests.
Exploring AI-driven browser automation.
Exploring computer-use and agentic testing approaches for legacy desktop applications.
Supporting exploratory testing and identifying unusual edge cases.

AI-generated tests and results must still be critically reviewed. Strong QA judgement, curiosity and the ability to recognise unexpected behaviour remain central to the role.

What we're looking for

You should have:
Commercial experience in software quality assurance or software testing.
Strong exploratory and manual testing skills.
Experience testing web applications.
An understanding of automated regression testing and when automation is appropriate.
The ability to write scripts or test automation without needing to be a full-time software developer.
An interest in modern AI-assisted and low-code/no-code automation tools.
Experience investigating defects and providing developers with clear, reproducible information.
Experience creating test cases, test scenarios and regression suites.
An understanding of API testing.
An understanding of risk-based testing.
Experience working alongside software developers in an Agile or iterative development environment.
The confidence to question requirements and identify scenarios that may not have been considered.
The ability to work independently and establish structure in an environment where the QA function is still developing.

Most importantly,
you should be someone who is curious about how modern tools can improve software quality and willing to experiment, learn and challenge established testing approaches.

Useful experience

Experience in any of the following would be beneficial, but we do not expect candidates to have everything:
Playwright, Selenium, Cypress or similar web automation frameworks.
Windows desktop application automation.
Testing WinForms, WPF or Delphi applications.
Testing applications built using React or Angular.
Testing .NET or Java applications.
ASP.NET Web Forms applications.
REST API testing.
Postman or similar API testing tools.
Azure DevOps.
Automated testing within CI/CD pipelines.
Performance testing.
Security testing.
Accessibility testing.
AI-assisted development or testing tools.
Agentic automation or computer-use technologies.
Healthcare, audit or other environments where accuracy, traceability and reliability are particularly important.

What success looks like
During your first year, we would expect you to progressively:
Establish a clear and pragmatic QA approach across the technology team.
Create greater visibility of regression coverage and software quality risks.
Build a maintainable automated regression suite for our highest-value and highest-risk workflows.
Introduce appropriate automated testing into Azure DevOps pipelines.
Reduce the amount of repetitive manual regression testing required for releases.
Establish effective exploratory testing practices alongside automation.
Demonstrate practical uses of AI that improve testing speed, coverage or maintainability.
Develop workable approaches for automating appropriate parts of our legacy application estate.
Improve the quality and consistency of release readiness decisions.
Help developers consider testing and quality earlier in the development lifecycle.

The opportunity

This is not a role where you will simply execute someone else's test scripts.
You will have the opportunity to influence how QA develops across the organisation, experiment with new approaches and technologies, and demonstrate what a modern QA function can deliver.
There will be guidance and support from the technology leadership team, but we are looking for someone who wants ownership, is comfortable investigating unfamiliar problems, and is motivated by the opportunity to build something better.

Benefits

· £35,000 - £45,000 per annum, dependant on experience
· Company pension scheme
· Professional development opportunities
· 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays

Location

Leeds, Norwich or London – Hybrid / Remote

Athera Healthcare is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified individuals regardless of age, gender, race, disability, sexual orientation, religion or belief.

At Cogna, we're working hard to solve the productivity crisis. Lagging productivity is the biggest barrier to economic growth and a major obstacle to addressing our most important issues, such as climate change, healthcare, and social equality.

But it's not a single problem that can be tackled with a silver-bullet solution, it's the accumulation of millions of highly specific, context-driven challenges across every facet of every organisation that have to be addressed on their own terms.

Cogna is on a mission to solve this very complex problem. We're creating an AI-powered platform to understand these inefficiencies within customers' operating models, to define the requirements, and develop the software itself in a fully automated way. The result is high-quality, precision software at scale.

Since our launch in May 2023, we've already seen significant traction and customer revenue that outpaces most companies at our stage. We're backed by top VCs, including Notion Capital and Hoxton Ventures, and we're growing our world-class team - ex Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Palantir - to take us to the next level on our mission.

This is more than a job, it's an opportunity to be part of something genuinely transformative. Are you up for the challenge?

Overview

We are hiring multiple interns to join our team of experts building the future of software and natural language programming. Given the recent advances in AI, we're on the cusp of a seismic shift in the way software is developed. This is your chance to be part of it, and experience life at an AI startup.

There is a wide range of interesting technical challenges here in software engineering, programming languages, and AI: how to elicit requirements from end users, how to generate full stack code to meet those requirements, how to automatically generate tests, to repair faults, to generate verifiable code, and to deploy securely and to maintain and revise over time.

About us

Artlogic is a leading technology platform for the art world. Founded in 1989, Artlogic empowers over 6,000 galleries, dealers, and art professionals worldwide to streamline their operations and grow their businesses. The company’s integrated platform combines inventory management, CRM, websites, sales, marketing, and payment tools, everything needed to run a modern and successful art business.

In 2021, Artlogic was acquired by tech investors Cove Hill Partners to accelerate innovation and expand its global reach. Since then, the company has doubled in size, with employees across London, New York, Atlanta, and Cape Town.

Today, Artlogic is entering an exciting new chapter through its merger with ArtCloud, another industry leader in art technology. Together, the two companies are uniting complementary platforms to build the most comprehensive, forward-thinking solution for the art world. This collaboration brings together deep expertise across CRM, sales, marketing, inventory, payments, and AI-powered tools, empowering galleries, artists, and collectors worldwide.

Joining Artlogic means becoming part of a growing global team that is shaping the future of how art is bought, sold, and managed, both online and in person.

Our technology team comprises over 50 people across Product, UX and Engineering working in cross-functional teams geographically distributed principally between the UK and Brazil with a technical operations team in the UK and South Africa. At present, our technology stack comprises a combination of Python, Typescript, C# in Azure, GCP and AWS cloud environments.

About the role

We are seeking a pragmatic, impact-driven AI-Native Senior Software Engineer
to help evolve and extend our platform while guiding technical direction and supporting team development.

This role centres on solving real-world problems for art professionals, making thoughtful technical decisions that balance business impact with engineering trade-offs. You will work closely with Product Managers, Designers, and engineers to take ideas from inception through to production, ensuring we build the right solutions for our customers.

You will act as both a senior technical contributor and a product-minded engineer, someone who doesn’t just implement requirements but actively shapes them. You will challenge assumptions, ask the right questions, and help ensure we are solving meaningful problems in the most effective way.

You will contribute to technical strategy by identifying opportunities to improve system reliability, performance, and user experience within our current architecture, while also supporting the evolution of our strategic platform.

This role will play a key part in driving the adoption of AI across engineering, leveraging emerging technologies and embedding AI-native workflows to improve how we design, build, and deliver software.

This role is predominantly hands-on, with around 20–30% of time on technical leadership: architecture, mentoring, and shaping how the team works.

Key Responsibilities

Help the team move faster by adopting AI-native workflows and the shift to an agentic development lifecycle, without compromising the architectural qualities that make our platform reliable, scalable, and maintainable over the long term.
Define guardrails, review practices, and validation gates that hold AI-generated code to our standards for security, reliability, and cost-efficiency (FinOps). These are first-class concerns in agentic pipelines, not afterthoughts.
Design, build, and operate software across our platform, applying the same rigour to AI-augmented work as to anything else you ship.
Embed deeply with Product and Design from the earliest stages of discovery, using rapid prototyping and iteration to compress the gap between idea and validated solution.
Act as feature lead on a rotating basis, taking accountability for the development and delivery of a feature from shaping through to production. This means partnering with Product and Design on the approach, breaking the work down, coordinating the engineers contributing to it, removing blockers, and being the person who knows the state of the feature at any point
Serve as a critical technical voice, stress-testing AI-generated solutions, surfacing second-order risks, and ensuring the team builds the right thing, not just the fast thing.
Shape platform architecture with an architectural lens, contributing to long-term decisions about how AI tooling, LLM integrations, and human-in-the-loop controls evolve across the stack.
Continuously identify and exploit opportunities to improve performance, reliability, and user experience, using observability and analysis to find signals in noisy systems.
Navigate confidently across legacy and greenfield contexts, applying AI tooling pragmatically to modernise where it matters most.
Set the engineering standard, demonstrating through your own work what excellent looks like when much of the code is AI-generated.
Grow the team's capability and confidence with AI-native practices, coaching more junior engineers to think critically about model outputs, prompt design, and the boundaries of automation.
Define and evolve best practices for code quality, testing, documentation, and delivery in a world where much of the first draft is AI-generated.
Evolve CI/CD pipelines to incorporate agentic workflows, automated testing, AI-assisted code review, and intelligent deployment gates.
Champion secure by design principles across both human-written and AI-generated code, embedding security validation into the development pipeline rather than treating it as an afterthought.
Own system observability and reliability, moving from reactive alerting to proactive, model-assisted incident prevention.
Participate in on-call rotation, bringing the same rigour to incident response that you bring to day-to-day development.

About you

You're a hands-on senior engineer with a product mindset and the judgement to know which trade-offs matter. You care about business impact as much as engineering quality, and you've been building with AI tools long enough to know how to use them effectively.

You'll likely bring:

Deep experience building scalable, secure, cloud-based systems, giving you the foundation to confidently guide and validate agentic workflow outputs.
Proven ability to work across both legacy and greenfield codebases, using modern tooling to improve reliability and evolve architecture pragmatically.
Strong system design fundamentals across scalability, performance, and distributed systems, including API design (REST, GraphQL).
Hands-on experience with observability tooling (Datadog, Grafana, or similar) and a data-informed approach to system health and reliability.
Solid SQL and data management skills, with an appreciation for AI-enabled, data-driven systems.
Familiarity with CI/CD, containerisation (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Docker), and DevSecOps practices in modern AI development environments.
A pragmatic approach to testing, knowing what to cover, what to skip, and how to use AI to improve efficiency.
Experience mentoring engineers and supporting the adoption of modern tools and AI-native workflows.
Strong communication skills and the ability to articulate technical decisions and trade-offs clearly.

You'll stand out if you:

Ask "what problem are we solving and why?" before reaching for a solution.
Act as a genuine partner to Product and Design, shaping the problem, not just delivering against a spec.
Balance technical debt and feature delivery with long-term business value in mind.
Make confident decisions with incomplete information and thrive in fast-moving, evolving environments.
Bring curiosity and hands-on experience with agentic workflows, using them to raise the bar for engineering..

The Foundry operates differently to the rest of Redgate's product teams. You won't be handed a roadmap. Instead, you'll work across the full arc of innovation — from horizon-scanning and ideation through to early-stage research, rapid prototyping, and working directly with customers to validate what you're building.

You'll be part of a small cross-functional team (a Tech Lead plus four to six Software and Machine Learning Engineers), and you'll regularly run projects in parallel: contributing to ongoing experiments while also exploring entirely new directions. The tech stack is deliberately varied, the right tool for the job, not a fixed list, spanning C#, TypeScript, Python, and more across desktop, web, API, database, and ML development.

What makes this role different:

You'll work on problems where there is no established answer and you'll have the autonomy to explore them seriously.
Your work sits at the intersection of software engineering, customer insight, and product thinking; it's rare to find all three in one role.
You'll use and help shape how Redgate adopts agentic coding and AI development tools, not as an afterthought, but as a core part of how the team works.
The scope is genuinely broad: a typical day could see you balancing technical prototypes, customer interviews, and competitor teardowns.

What makes you a great fit

Proven experience using AI coding tools. You've used them extensively, understand their limitations, and have developed ways to work around them productively and safely.
Strong software design and coding skills across modern languages, particularly C#, TypeScript, or Python, enough to guide and review AI-generated code with confidence.
Hands-on experience building agentic systems using frameworks such as LangGraph, Microsoft Agentic Framework, or MCP, with a solid understanding of LLM capabilities and risks.
Experience designing and running experiments to validate ideas quickly, using technical prototypes, customer feedback, and lean startup principles to test assumptions and make clear decisions.
Comfortable engaging directly with customers and stakeholders: running interviews, demos, and concierge-style validation processes, and communicating findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
A product mindset; you think in terms of user value, outcomes, and market fit, not just features or technical delivery.

What we offer

Salary range: £55,000-£80,000
Hybrid working: home and Cambridge office
Monthly wellbeing allowance and generous paid time off
Genuine investment in learning, development, and career progression
Private health insurance

What happens next

Your application will be reviewed by a person, we don't use AI or automated tools to assess applications. Every profile is read by one of our Talent Partners.

You'll hear back within a few days, whether it's a next step or a no, we aim to respond promptly so you're not left wondering.

Our interview process is straightforward and consistent, you'll find more detail on our typical hiring process below, so you know what's coming and why.

Belonging at Redgate

We believe that people do their best work in an environment built on respect, fairness, and trust and that diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes. Redgate is an equal opportunity employer, and we make hiring decisions based on skill, potential, and alignment with our values.
