At Netwrix, our mission is to revolutionize data security by placing identity at the core - providing unparalleled visibility and control. Engineered and supported by over 900 highly talented, motivated employees and hundreds of trusted partners in nearly every geography, Netwrix solutions are relied upon daily by security professionals across more than 13,500 organizations in over 100 countries around the world.

Over the past two decades, Netwrix has expanded its market presence through innovation, organic growth, and strategic acquisitions, and are proud to be backed by renowned private equity firms, TA Associates and Centerbridge Partners. Netwrix maintains a global presence, fostering a remote-first work environment while encouraging and facilitating frequent face-to-face interaction with colleagues, customers, and partners.

Position Overview

Netwrix is on a mission to help customers protect and secure their identity and data landscape through market-leading on-prem and SaaS products and integrated solutions. Netwrix Identity products provide leading identity security solutions to thousands of enterprise customers worldwide.

We are seeking a highly skilled Software Engineer

who will develop new features and capabilities for Netwrix Identity Recovery, our enterprise solution for backup and recovery of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and Okta environments

. The Software Engineer will ensure scalable, secure, high-quality experiences for enterprise customers in both on-prem and SaaS environments.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced engineer to help build and shape the user experience for our identity recovery product that protects organizations when it matters most. You will own the browser-based administration console and desktop application, drive UX improvements across complex recovery workflows, and play a key role in evolving the product toward a modern SaaS platform. You will integrate AI capabilities into both the product and your development process and work closely with product leaders and engineers to deliver software that protects organizations worldwide against identity-based threats.

Your home base is the Netwrix Identity Recovery team. You will work within a shared engineering platform and technology stack, with opportunities to contribute to other products across the Netwrix ITDR portfolio — such as PingCastle, Threat Prevention, and Threat Manager.

Key Responsibilities

Build and maintain the web-based administration console for Netwrix Identity Recovery, creating intuitive and performant UX for complex enterprise recovery workflows

Contribute to the backend services layer to support new UI features — this role requires full-stack capability beyond the UI
Integrate data and capabilities with Netwrix's cybersecurity product platform and other ITDR products
Drive the evolution of the product's UI toward a modern SaaS and cloud-hosted architecture
Promote and optimize the use of AI tools and capabilities to accelerate Netwrix product development
Partner with customers and customer-facing teams to triage and address issues, understand customer needs, and gather feedback on product features
Collaborate across functions with product management, platform and product teams, and engineering leadership to align technical direction with business needs
Help foster a culture of innovation, security-first thinking, mentorship, professional growth, and technical excellence

Qualifications

Required Experience

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience
4+ years of software development experience with a focus on enterprise software
Production experience with C# and .NET in a web application context
Production experience with ASP.NET Core Blazor or a comparable component-based web framework (React, Angular, Vue.js)
Experience designing and delivering on-prem or SaaS software at scale
Understanding of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and monitoring/observability

Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in C# and the .NET ecosystem (.NET Core/.NET)
Familiar with C++ enough to read and understand it to trace bugs and understand backend behavior.
Solid grounding in web fundamentals: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and browser rendering
Experience with a modern component-based web framework — ASP.NET Core Blazor, React, Angular, or Vue.js
Understanding of authentication patterns: cookie auth, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and MFA flows
Proficiency in RESTful API design and consumption
Familiarity with real-time web patterns: WebSockets or similar push mechanisms
Experience with relational databases and the ability to read and understand a data model
Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure preferred), containerization fundamentals, and infrastructure as code

Soft Skills

Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams
Proven ability to balance technical quality with business priorities and timelines
Strong UX instincts: you notice when enterprise admin workflows are confusing and can advocate clearly for improvements
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to tackle complex, ambiguous challenges

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with ASP.NET Core Blazor Server and a commercial component library (Telerik, MudBlazor, or equivalent)
React and TypeScript experience, particularly for building enterprise admin or data-heavy SPA applications
Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Okta, or similar identity and access management concepts
Understanding of Active Directory and Windows identity concepts — directly applicable to recovery workflow design
Experience building or participating in on-prem to SaaS UI migrations

At Netwrix, Our Values Guide Every Action

Next-Level Customer Focus -Customers first, always. We listen, protect, and go the extra mile— because their success is our mission.
Excellence - We set high standards and take pride in delivering exceptional results. We celebrate wins, seek constant improvement, and address shortcomings professionally.

eXceptional Together - We believe in the power of collaboration and diverse perspectives. By valuing each other’s strengths, we achieve outcomes that surpass individual contributions.

Join us in a culture where integrity, respect, and hard work are foundational. Be part of a team dedicated to making a lasting impact.

The portfolio is predominantly C# / .NET and Python, with Angular, WPF/WCF frontends, SQL Server backends, and internal APIs. Working alongside senior London-based consultants, you will build and drive an advanced AI pipeline designed to improve existing codebases, lift automated test coverage past 70%, clear security vulnerabilities (CVEs), and migrate services to the cloud via GitHub Actions.

Responsibilities

Spec-Driven Insights & Agentic Diagnostics: Apply cutting-edge spec-driven approaches and agentic AI tooling (Copilot agent mode, internal client LLMs, Cursor, Windsurf, or Claude Code) to analyze code health, perform deep-dive assessments, and triage defects at scale.
Vulnerability Remediation: Validate and fix pre-identified security vulnerabilities, execute dependency upgrades, and resolve SAST/DAST/CVE findings to pass quality gates into modern delivery platforms.
Test Engineering & Quality Hardening: Build out functional, integration, and end-to-end test suites using AI tooling, replacing ineffective tests with high-confidence automated suites to reach 70%+ coverage.
Pipeline Extension & BAU Scaling: Enroll additional portfolio services into the standing agentic analysis and remediation pipeline while continuously refining the pipeline's automation patterns.
Extended Architectural Analysis: Perform deep architectural evaluations for flagship codebases exceeding 500k LoC to formulate targeted analysis and refactoring strategies.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner directly with London-based onsite consultants, business stakeholders, and technical teams to validate findings, prioritize backlogs, and align on remediation goals.

Requirements

General Engineering & Legacy Experience: Strong general software engineering background with proven ability to navigate, understand, and contribute production-quality changes across under-documented legacy codebases.
Agentic AI & LLM Proficiency: Demonstrated, hands-on experience using LLMs in software engineering settings to drive agentic coding workflows, generate tests, and remediate non-trivial code at scale.
Testing Discipline: Genuine test engineering mindset—writing high-confidence tests by default and differentiating between raw line coverage and true functional confidence.
Autonomy & Communication: High autonomy with a pragmatic, get-it-done attitude; fluent written and spoken English with clear technical communication capabilities.
Location: Based in Poland, comfortable working in a hybrid model (3 days per week in-office) with regular collaboration across Poland and London teams.

Nice to have

Core Tech Stack Experience: Production experience with C# / .NET (.NET Framework to .NET 6/8 modernization, WPF/WCF replacement) and/or Python.

Security & CI/CD: Practical experience with CVE triage, dependency upgrades, SAST/DAST tools, and enterprise CI/CD platforms (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy).
Domain Knowledge: Prior experience in financial services, asset management, or other heavily regulated enterprise environments.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer - Internal Developer Platform
jobs.description:
About Frontiers

At Frontiers, our purpose is simple yet ambitious: to make science open. We believe open science empowers the global scientific community to accelerate discovery and develop the solutions needed for healthy lives on a healthy planet.

We are one of the world's largest and most influential open-access research publishers. Every article we publish is peer-reviewed and quality-certified, ensuring research is accessible to everyone, everywhere. To date, Frontiers research has been viewed over 4 billion times, demonstrating the real-world impact of science without barriers.

Joining Frontiers means being part of a global, mission-driven organization at the intersection of science, technology, and innovation — working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about advancing knowledge for the benefit of society. To learn more about our impact and culture, please watch this video.

The Mission

At Frontiers, we are rewriting the rules of scientific publishing. To support our scale, we are transforming our Engineering Platform into a state-of-the-art Internal Developer Platform (IDP) built on modern principles and AI-augmented workflows — with a North Star of evolving it into an Agentic Development Platform (ADP) where human engineers and AI agents build software side by side, safely and at scale.

We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer
— Internal Developer Platform
to help build and run that platform and the AI-First Delivery capabilities on top of it. This is the modern evolution of the DevOps Engineer role: you won't run a ticket queue — you'll treat the platform as a product, own a capability area end to end, and ship the golden paths, guardrails and automation that let our Stream-Aligned Teams (and their agents) deliver faster and more safely. You'll work closely with our Platform Product Manager and Senior Cloud Architect — turning platform strategy and prioritised needs into working capabilities.

The Technical Context

You will build and operate the capabilities that make up the IDP.

Core Stack: Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes (AKS), containers (Docker); services in C#/.NET and Node.js
IaC & GitOps: Terraform, Helm, and a move toward GitOps with ArgoCD
CI/CD: Evolution from Azure DevOps toward GitHub Actions, modernizing pipelines (not a blind "lift and shift")
Integration: Azure API Management, Apollo Federation/GraphOS, n8n
Security: Azure Entra ID, SonarQube, Azure Policy, Key Vault
Observability: NewRelic and Grafana (proactive SRE and business-value metrics)
Developer Experience & AI: Backstage, our Technology Framework (policies/standards as executable AI context), MCP, and AI-driven development (e.g. Cursor AI, GitHub Spec-Kit)

What You'll Do

Build and operate the IDP: golden paths, self-service templates, the developer portal (Backstage) and IDP catalog, and guardrails that keep teams compliant by default (guardrails, not gates)
Own CI/CD and GitOps: GitHub Enterprise and GitHub Actions; help drive the migration off Azure DevOps; implement GitOps (ArgoCD) for AKS — rethinking deployments rather than lifting-and-shifting custom tasks
Provision cloud infrastructure as code: evolve Azure (AKS, networking, databases, APIM, Key Vault, Entra ID) with Terraform and Helm; manage reliability and cost (FinOps)
Improve observability & reliability: instrument systems (NewRelic, Grafana), define SLOs, reduce operational toil, and drive monitoring-cost accountability
Advance AI-First Delivery and the ADP: build agent-ready context (MCP, the Technology Framework), path definitions (e.g. validate-change, PR-review), and agent governance (non-human identity, sandboxed execution, evaluation, agent observability)
Own a capability area end to end and set the standard: take a platform domain (e.g. CI/CD & GitOps, or cloud foundations) from design to run, define the reference patterns and ADRs others build on, and raise the bar through code review, mentoring and pairing
Build for adoption, like a product: design capabilities around real internal customers, write docs that work, and gather feedback from the teams you serve — so the platform is genuinely the easiest, safest path. Partner with the Platform Product Manager on priorities, and let adoption, DORA and DevEx metrics (not ticket counts) tell you what to improve next

Requirements

A full-stack software engineering background (prerequisite): you've built and shipped production software yourself (e.g. in C#/.NET, Node.js, Python, Go or similar) — so you bring genuine developer empathy for the engineers you build the platform for, and you design self-service that you'd actually want to use
Senior-level experience: typically 5+ years building and operating cloud platforms or infrastructure, including owning a capability area end to end and setting patterns / mentoring other engineers
Cloud & Kubernetes: strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure (AWS/GCP transferable) and Kubernetes (AKS): networking, storage, managed databases
Infrastructure as Code & GitOps: Terraform and Helm; GitOps with ArgoCD or similar
CI/CD: modern pipelines (GitHub Actions ideal); experience migrating from other CI systems a plus
Observability & reliability: metrics/logs/traces, SLOs and error budgets; security/compliance as code (policy-as-code, secrets management, identity basics)
Product mindset for internal tooling: developer empathy, self-service design, guardrails not gates
AI-First: you already work with AI coding assistants (e.g. Cursor) and are excited to build golden paths and agent workflows, not just consume them
Language: Professional-level English (spoken and written)

Nice to Have

API platform experience (Azure APIM, Apollo Federation/GraphOS) and developer-portal experience (Backstage)
Exposure to agentic/LLM tooling, MCP, GitHub Spec-Kit, or building AI developer workflows
Interest or experience in Spec-Driven Development and AI coding assistants
Experience facilitating InnerSource or community-driven platform contributions
Familiarity with Team Topologies, DORA, SPACE / DX Core 4, CNCF platform maturity; workflow automation (n8n) and FinOps

How We Measure Success In This Role

Adoption: teams/services on golden paths; self-service actions; time-to-first-deploy for a new service
Delivery (DORA): deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change-failure rate, time to restore
Developer experience: internal NPS/satisfaction, support-ticket trend, golden-path coverage
Reliability & cost: SLOs met; cloud and monitoring spend under control

Why This Role Is Exciting

Platform engineering gets more
valuable in the AI era, not less: the platform does :90% of the work, the model :10%. You'll help move engineering effort from one-off delivery toward owning, running and evolving the platform and its agents
— the scarce, high-leverage work of the next decade — all in service of a mission that matters: making science open for everyone.

Benefits

We prioritise office presence and emphasise in-person collaboration, but also offer appropriate adjustments where needed, in line with company policy
Extra wellbeing days on top of your annual leave allowance
Up to 3 paid volunteering days each year
24/7 confidential Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, legal & financial support)
Learning & development support via the Frontiers Learning Hub

Equal opportunity statement

Recruitment is free from discrimination - including based on race, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation. With employees from more than 50 different nations, our diversity creates vibrant teams and constantly challenges us to appreciate multiple perspectives.

jobs.title: .NET Backend Developer — 6-Month Project (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
The Role

As a Backend Engineer at our client, you will contribute directly to the core index layer, processing video indexing based on signals from the algorithm team. Your work will power the auto-tagging engine—the system that splits sports games into distinct events and accurately assigns start and end times to each action. You will balance deep feature development with critical problem-solving in a highly collaborative, AI-integrated environment.

About The Product

The product is an AI-powered sports media platform used by major sports organizations to transform live broadcasts into personalized digital content at scale. Every live stream is continuously ingested, analyzed, and enriched with AI-generated metadata, enabling automatic detection of key moments, intelligent video indexing, and near real-time content creation.

Behind the scenes, the platform processes massive volumes of live and archived video 24/7, powering personalized fan experiences across web, mobile, social, and broadcast channels. The backend infrastructure is built for extreme throughput, low-latency processing, and elastic scaling, combining distributed microservices with production-grade ML inference pipelines to deliver reliable performance under unpredictable traffic peaks.

Team Structure & Collaboration

You will join a focused backend squad consisting of four developers, one QA, and one PM, led by the engineering manager. This squad sits within a larger group of two backend teams and two algorithm teams. Because the index layer relies heavily on algorithm signals, you will work in close daily collaboration with the AI and algorithm teams.

What You’ll Be Doing

Video Indexing & Auto-Tagging: Build and maintain the C#/.NET backend infrastructure that interprets algorithm signals to index videos and auto-tag live sports events
Technical Leadership: Elevate the team by actively participating in design discussions, driving code review standards, and mentoring fellow developers
On-Call Rotation: Participate in a shared on-call pool (approximately one week every five weeks). While critical nighttime or weekend outages are rare, you must remain reachable and have access to a laptop to respond to operations team escalations
Proactivity: Execute tasks independently, demonstrate strong problem-solving skills, and maintain prompt, proactive communication via Slack with the Israel-based team

What We Expect

Strong proficiency in C# and .NET, with 5+ years of commercial .NET experience
Hands-on experience developing within Azure cloud environments
Familiarity with and daily use of AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor)
Excellent interpersonal skills with a proven ability to mentor peers and lead design discussions
High autonomy, independent task execution, and proactive communication habits for effective distributed collaboration
Familiarity with event-driven messaging services such as Azure Service Bus or Kafka
Working knowledge of SQL databases (general proficiency; specific engines do not matter)
Basic familiarity with DevOps terminology and Kubernetes (operational expertise is not required)
Willingness to work in a hybrid mode, 3 days from the office in Warsaw

Why This Role Is Worth Your Time

Direct ownership of pure backend compute at scale—no full-stack dilution, focusing entirely on high-load microservices, indexing engines, and real-time processing
High-autonomy environment with modern workflows where AI tools (Claude, Cursor) are embraced to eliminate boilerplate and keep focus on architecture

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – NETSUITE ARCHITECT (FIXED TERM CONTRACT - 2 Years)

THE TEAM & THE JOB

The Enterprise Systems NetSuite team owns the support, development and strategic direction of YouGov's NetSuite ERP platform, the system underpinning the company's core finance processes. The team is being reshaped to combine operational analyst support with dedicated architectural capability under the Senior Finance Systems Implementation Manager.

As NetSuite Architect, you will be the expert-level professional providing technical leadership for the platform on a fixed term contract. You will own the overall technical vision and architecture, define the "how" and "what" of solutions on significant and unique issues, and act as the recognised subject matter expert advising senior stakeholders. You will translate the functional vision for the ERP into an architectural plan and guide its execution, maintaining a future-focused approach to scalability, maintainability and long-term platform evolution.

What You Will Be Doing – Key Responsibilities

Own the end-to-end technical vision and architecture for the NetSuite platform, translating business strategy into an architectural roadmap.
Design and architect end-to-end NetSuite solutions, including customisations, integrations and workflows, exercising considerable creativity, foresight and judgment.
Make high-impact technical decisions on integration patterns, customisation approaches and data models, evaluating trade-offs between business needs, intangibles and technical constraints.
Assess and document the existing customised NetSuite landscape (scripts, workflows, forms, integrations) to support future transitions and upgrades.
Architect integrations across multiple systems using SuiteTalk, RESTlets and middleware platforms.
Define and enforce NetSuite development standards, governance policies and best practices across the platform.
Lead complex, enterprise-wide NetSuite initiatives from requirements gathering through deployment and post-go-live support.
Conduct solution design reviews, code reviews and performance optimisation assessments, providing expert technical leadership and mentorship to the wider team.
Advise senior business and functional stakeholders, developing recommendations and persuading diverse audiences on platform decisions and module/third-party evaluation.
Produce comprehensive technical architecture documentation, data models and integration specifications so knowledge is retained beyond the contract term.
Work closely with the Senior Finance Systems Implementation Manager, the Senior NetSuite Analyst, Finance stakeholders and third-party providers, staying current with NetSuite platform updates and industry trends.

What You Need To Know (technical & Behavioural Skills/Competencies)

6–8+ years' hands-on NetSuite experience operating as an architect, with a proven track record of leading full implementation lifecycles as a technical leader.
Experience architecting solutions independently across multiple implementations or complex enterprise-wide projects, in more than one enterprise-sized organisation.
Deep technical expertise across the entire NetSuite platform, including expert knowledge of SuiteScript 2.x (Client, User Event, Scheduled, RESTlets, Map/Reduce) and custom development.
Extensive experience with SuiteFlow, SuiteTalk (SOAP/REST), SuiteAnalytics and SuiteBundler, and a deep understanding of NetSuite data architecture, saved searches and custom records.
Strong understanding of enterprise architecture patterns and experience with integration platforms (Boomi, Celigo, Workato, MuleSoft or similar).
Strong knowledge of accounting principles and ERP business processes (Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Financial Close).
Conceptual thinking to work on significant and unique issues where analysis requires evaluation of intangibles, with independent judgment on methods, techniques and evaluation criteria (be accountable).
Ability to convey complex, non-routine information and persuade diverse senior stakeholders across multiple cultures, frequently advising others on complex matters (communicate clearly).
A collaborative approach to technical leadership, building capability in others rather than holding knowledge (trust each other), and staying current with platform and industry developments (be fast).
NetSuite certifications (Administrator, SuiteFoundation; SuiteCloud Developer II preferred) and ideally architect qualifications such as TOGAF or CSA.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Why join YouGov?

Join our global team to help us achieve our social mission: to make millions of people’s opinions heard for the benefit of our local, national, and international communities.

Understanding diversity of opinion requires diversity of background. Although our global panel of millions of people worldwide powers our research, our biggest asset is our people. If our research is to be truly representative of what the world thinks, we need people from all walks of life to be part of the team to bring their perspective to the work we do.

Life at YouGov

We are driven by a set of shared values. We are fast, fearless, and innovative. We work diligently to get it right. We are guided by accuracy, ethics, and proven methodologies. We respect and trust each other, bringing these values into everything that we do.

We strive to provide YouGovers with best-in-class benefits to support their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. We want our employees to have a sense of belonging and uniqueness in a supportive workplace, so they can bring their full selves to work.

All employment decisions are made based on occupational qualifications, merit, and business need.

jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Full Stack Developer who enjoys building modern, scalable, and business-critical applications? Do you want to play a key role in a new strategic initiative within a global organisation while working with modern technologies and cloud-based solutions?

We are currently looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to join our Global Applications team in Malmö, Sweden.

In this role, you will take a leading part in developing new applications and enhancing existing solutions used across ASSA ABLOY's global business. You will work with technologies such as .NET, C#, React, TypeScript, SQL, and Microsoft Azure, collaborating with colleagues across multiple countries and functions.

This is an opportunity for an experienced developer who thrives in a hands-on role, enjoys technical ownership, and wants to contribute to the design, development, and future direction of business-critical applications. You will join a collaborative team environment where knowledge sharing, innovation, and continuous improvement are highly valued.

What you will do as our Senior Full Stack Developer

As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, maintaining, and improving applications and services that support our global business. You will work closely with colleagues across development, support, and business functions to deliver reliable, scalable, and user-focused solutions.

You would also:

Participate in daily operations and strategic digital transformation initiatives, contributing to the ongoing evolution of our application landscape.
Design, develop, maintain, and enhance applications, services, and platforms using technologies such as Microsoft Azure, .NET, C#, React, TypeScript, SQL, MS Windows, Visual Studio, and related tools.
Develop, maintain, and support application platforms and their underlying infrastructure, ensuring reliability, scalability, performance, and required maintenance activities.
Identify and drive improvement and automation opportunities, taking ownership from idea and solution design through implementation and documentation in line with best practices.
Act as a technical expert and trusted advisor, collaborating with internal and external stakeholders, development teams, business users, and business analysts to translate business requirements into practical solutions.
Architect, design, build, and implement application platforms and services, while delivering new functionality and enhancements for internal customers.
Analyse, troubleshoot, and resolve platform-related issues, coordinate defect resolution across teams, and support the ongoing maintenance, improvement, and documentation of application platforms.

The Skills And Experience You Need

We are looking for someone who has:

At least 5 years of experience in Full Stack Development.
Strong experience with C#, .NET, SQL, and modern application development.
Experience working with Microsoft Azure and cloud-based solutions.
Experience with frontend technologies such as React, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
Experience building and consuming APIs and working across the full software development lifecycle, from solution design to deployment.
Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and communicate effectively in English and Swedish.

You are a proactive, structured, and solution-oriented developer who enjoys taking ownership and turning ideas into practical, scalable solutions. You thrive in collaborative environments and are comfortable working closely with developers, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams. Experience working in Agile environments is important, and you bring curiosity, initiative, and a genuine passion for learning new technologies and approaches.

Experience working in enterprise-scale environments, setting up Azure infrastructure and cloud environments, and using tools such as Jira, GitHub, and ServiceNow is considered an advantage. Most importantly, you are someone who can navigate complex technical challenges, balance technical excellence with business needs, and contribute ideas that improve both our technology and the way we work.

What We Offer

We’re passionate about providing amazing opportunities and benefits, so you can continue and progress a lifelong career with us – here’s what we have to offer:

Learning and career development opportunities, whether it’s online learning, management training or enhancing your skills.
A competitive salary
Hybrid model of working
Stable employment in a friendly international atmosphere

We review applications regularly, so don't wait.

We are building diverse and inclusive teams and encourage applications from all who can envision themselves working with us.

To ensure that your personal information is secure, we do not review any applications sent via email or post. If you have any questions about the role or the process, please send an email to Khalil Kabakibi, Talent Acquisition Business Partner, at Khalil.kabakibi@assaabloy.com .

Let's together create a safer and more open world!

To find out more about us, visit www.assaabloy.com.

We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. Hos oss är lärande en naturlig del av vardagen. Genom certifieringar, utveckling i uppdrag och arbete i tekniskt komplexa Azure-miljöer får du kontinuerligt stärka din kompetens. Vi ger dig förutsättningarna att växa, både tekniskt och professionellt, och att utvecklas till en nyckelperson inom cloud.

I den här rollen spelar du en nyckelroll i:

Designa, implementera och optimera säkra och skalbara Azure-lösningar
Arbeta nära utvecklare, arkitekter och andra kompetenser i tvärfunktionella team
Arbeta med AI‑stöd i utvecklingsarbetet, till exempel för kodgenerering, refaktorering, test, felsökning eller dokumentation
Bidra med din Azure-expertis och aktivt delta i ständig förbättring och innovation

Vi arbetar enligt en hybrid arbetsmodell, där du varierar mellan arbete hos kund, på vårt kontor och hemifrån med flexibilitet utifrån uppdrag.

Minst 5 års erfarenhet som utvecklare, med goda kunskaper inom .NET och Microsoft Azure
Praktisk erfarenhet eller vana av att använda AI‑verktyg, exempelvis AI‑baserad kodkomplettering eller AI som “pair programmer” samt förmåga att kritiskt granska och kvalitetssäkra AI‑genererad kod ur perspektiv som säkerhet, prestanda och arkitektur
Erfarenhet av containerteknologier (t.ex. Kubernetes/AKS)
Erfarenhet av CI/CD, exempelvis via Azure DevOps eller GitHub
Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift

Det är meriterande om du har Microsoft Azure-certifieringar, exempelvis AZ-204 och/eller AZ-900 samt certifieringar eller erfarenhet inom AI.

Möjlighet att ta en viktig roll i utvecklingen av affärskritiska cloudlösningar, där du får påverka arkitektur, och hur AI‑stödd utveckling används i praktiken hos våra kunder
Arbete i tekniskt komplexa och moderna Azure-miljöer, där du får tillgång till och arbetar med den senaste tekniken inom moln, automatisering och AI, tillsammans med erfarna kollegor och ett starkt globalt nätverk av specialister.
En kultur som aktivt uppmuntrar lärande, innovation och kunskapsdelning, med tydliga möjligheter till certifieringar, kompetensutveckling och mentorskap, och där du ges förtroende att driva förändring, utvecklas som expert och skapa verkligt affärsvärde.
Flexibelt arbete som stödjer balans i livet, samt kontinuerligt lärande genom utbildningar, certifieringar och mentorskap
Engagerande tech communities och interna initiativ, i en inkluderande kultur med fokus på gemenskap, hållbarhet och välmående

Capgemini är en AI-driven global partner för affärs- och tekniktransformation som levererar konkret verksamhetsnytta. Vi formar framtiden för organisationer och förverkligar den med hjälp av AI, teknik och människor. Är du den vi söker?

Vi tror att du har en eftergymnasial utbildning inom systemutveckling eller motsvarande samt flera års erfarenhet av modern systemutveckling. Du har tidigare haft personalansvar eller lett utvecklingsteam och känner dig trygg i att kombinera ett coachande ledarskap med tekniskt beslutsfattande.

Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.

Vad vi erbjuder

Hos oss bygger du lösningar som används av tusentals kunder och blir en viktig del av vår resa mot framtidens molnbaserade affärssystem. Du får möjlighet att påverka både teknikval, arbetssätt och teamets utveckling i en organisation som värdesätter innovation, kvalitet och långsiktighet.

Vi erbjuder goda utvecklingsmöjligheter, en hälsosam balans mellan arbete och fritid samt attraktiva förmåner. Vi satsar på hälsa och erbjuder flera träningsaktiviteter, möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån ett par dagar i veckan och en arbetsmiljö där kompetensutveckling uppmuntras.

Hos Hogia får du en roll där ditt ledarskap och din tekniska förståelse blir avgörande för att forma framtidens produkter.

Tjänsten är placerad i Stenungsund med möjlighet till att arbeta två dagar i veckan på distans.

Vi arbetar med löpande urval och intervjuer, vilket innebär att tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Om Hogia-gruppen

Hogia utvecklar, säljer och supportar programvaror och IT-system för företag som effektivt vill fokusera på sina verksamheter i stället för krånglig och tidsödande administration. Vi erbjuder allt från mindre löne- och bokföringsprogram för småföretagaren till kompletta, branschspecifika IT-lösningar och -system för exempelvis kollektivtrafik, åkerier, godsterminaler, revisionsbyråer och fastighetsbolag. I Hogiagruppen finns 30 operativa bolag, som vart och ett verkar inom ett väl definierat verksamhetsområde. Vår organisationsform bygger uttalat på småskalighet och entreprenörsanda. Företagskulturen skapar engagerade medarbetare. Tillsammans ger vi våra kunder de bästa tänkbara affärslösningarna. Hogia startade sin verksamhet 1980 i Stenungsund. I dag har den privatägda koncernen totalt 650 anställda på kontor i Sverige, Norge och Finland. Mer information om Hogia finns på www.hogia.se.

Vi på Hogia utvecklar och levererar branschspecifika, verksamhetsstödjande system. Vi har mängder av affärskritiska branschanpassade system som underlättar livet, för att inte tala om lösningar inom ekonomi, lön/HR som passar alla, oavsett bransch.

Vi är experter på att göra administrativa och operativa processer enklare, effektivare och faktiskt lite roligare.

jobs.title: Software Test Engineer — Verification & Test Automation
jobs.description:
Denna annons är publicerad i samarbete med Jobbet.se. Ansökan sker via Jobbet.se:s hemsida.

Would you like to help build the world’s best artificial heart – a technology that could save the lives of people suffering from severe heart failure? Scandinavian Real Heart (Realheart) is a Swedish company developing and manufacturing an artificial heart that mimics the anatomy and function of the human heart. In Västerås, where the company was originally founded, our team is working to take the technology from development to clinical reality. Realheart is listed on Nasdaq First North Growth and has recently announced its goal of being ready for implantation in its first patient in February 2028.

About the role

We are hiring a Software Test Engineer to own software verification for a Class III medical device system spanning embedded firmware, desktop applications and the communication between them. This is a verification role in the regulatory sense: you will derive test cases from approved software requirements, demonstrate objectively that the software meets them, and produce the traceable, auditable evidence that supports the design history file and technical documentation.

You will also develop and maintain the automation that makes verification repeatable. Using a Python-based test framework integrated with CI/CD, you will help turn regression testing from extensive manual work into reliable pipeline-driven execution.

You will analyse software requirements and design specifications for testability, ambiguity and measurable acceptance criteria. You will create verification plans, protocols and test cases, select and justify suitable verification methods, define expected results and pass/fail criteria, and maintain traceability from requirement through execution record to result.

The role also includes executing protocols under configuration control, documenting objective evidence, managing deviations and amendments, investigating defects, and writing verification reports. You will contribute to design reviews and audits by clearly explaining and defending the verification approach.

On the automation side, you will design, build and maintain test frameworks and automated suites across unit, integration and system levels. This includes developing test harnesses, simulators, stubs and fixtures, as well as supporting hardware-in-the-loop testing where appropriate. You will integrate suites into GitHub Actions and help ensure that automated results can serve as reliable verification evidence.

About you

You have experience of working with software testing in a regulated environment and understand the importance of disciplined design control, configuration management and technical documentation. You are comfortable moving between detailed test work and the broader verification argument, and you can distinguish between requirement, implementation and test defects.

To succeed in the role, you combine a rigorous, structured approach with practical engineering judgement. You communicate clearly in English and enjoy collaborating closely with software, firmware, systems and QA/RA colleagues to keep requirements, code and tests aligned.

What we offer

This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of verification in a complex medical device environment and to contribute to both the verification process and the automation infrastructure that supports it. You will work across embedded firmware, desktop applications and connected interfaces, with a clear opportunity to influence templates, tooling and workflows as verification needs evolve. We welcome you to be a central member of our highly skilled and engaged team.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application. The application period runs from 18 September 2026 to 18 October 2026. For more information please feel welcome to contact Anna Nordanstig +46 70 306 55 64.

Interviews are conducted continuously, and the position may be filled before the closing date.

Requirements

Experience of software testing in medical devices or another comparably regulated industry, such as aerospace, automotive, rail, nuclear, defence or regulated pharma/IVD.
Understanding of formal design control or safety lifecycles, including the distinction between design verification and design validation.
Demonstrated experience of requirements-driven test design, including defining objective acceptance criteria, maintaining traceability, and producing verification protocols and reports suitable for audit.
Experience of building and maintaining automated test suites, including framework design, test data management and test fixtures.
Experience of version control, change control and formal defect management.
Strong technical documentation skills, with attention to detail and traceability.
Strong spoken and written English.

Preferred qualifications

A Bachelor’s degree or higher in engineering, computer science or a closely related technical field; equivalent demonstrable experience is also valued.
Working familiarity with .NET/C# and C++, including the ability to read code, understand architecture and create meaningful integration tests.
Practical Python experience for test automation, using a framework such as pytest, unittest or Robot Framework.
CI/CD experience, particularly GitHub Actions, including workflow YAML, runners, matrices, secrets, caching and artifacts.
Experience of IEC 62304 software lifecycle activities, including software safety classification, testing expectations, SOUP management and anomaly evaluation.
Familiarity with ISO 13485, ISO 14971, EU MDR technical documentation and IEC 62366 usability engineering.
Experience of ALM or requirements-management tools such as Polarion, Jama, Codebeamer, DOORS or Azure DevOps, including generating trace matrices.
Experience of embedded or hardware-adjacent testing, for example serial protocols, CAN bus, instrument control, logic analysers, test rigs or hardware-in-the-loop frameworks.
Experience of static analysis, code coverage measurement and their role in software verification.
Experience of FDA inspections, notified body audits, or regulatory submissions such as 510(k), PMA or CE submissions.
Exposure to cybersecurity testing for connected medical devices.

About the employer – Scandinavian Real Heart

Would you like to help build the world’s best artificial heart – a technology that could save the lives of people suffering from severe heart failure?

Scandinavian Real Heart AB is a Swedish MedTech company that develops a total artificial heart (TAH) for implantation in patients with life-threatening heart failure. Realheart® TAH has a unique, patented design that resembles that of the natural human heart. Only about 8,000 heart transplants occur annually worldwide, and the availability of donated hearts is very limited. Realheart’s mission is to save as many patients who suffer from congestive heart disease as possible through this advanced MedTech solution. Realheart has a an extremely competent and engaged team placed in Västerås in Sweden and is also carried out in very close collaboration with world-leading heart surgeons and international researchers and engineers. In 2028 the goal is to be able to perform the first implantation in a human patient. Realheart is a public company listed on Nasdaq First North and has recently announced its goal of being ready for implantation in its first patient in February 2028.

jobs.description:
Att välja Capgemini innebär att välja en arbetsplats där du ges möjlighet att forma din karriär på det sätt du själv önskar, där du ingår i en stödjande och inspirerande gemenskap med engagerade kollegor världen över, och där du får chansen att omdefiniera vad som är möjligt. Våra Cloud & Custom Applications team fokuserar på att utveckla skräddarsydda, skalbara och säkra cloudapplikationer, integrera IT-system och driva affärstransformation. AI är en nyckelteknologi i allt vi gör och en central del i hur vi formar och bygger moderna system och lösningar, där intelligenta AI-drivna arbetssätt och teknologier som Agentic AI driver utvecklingen framåt. Bli en del av oss och var med och forma framtidens system tillsammans med världsledande organisationer och bidra till att frigöra teknikens fulla potential i en mer hållbar och inkluderande värld!

Om rollen

Är du passionerad kring allt som rör molnet? Vi söker just nu en erfaren Cloud Solution Architect till vårt Architecture & BA-team i Malmö/Helsingborg. Teamet fokuserar på arkitektur, utveckling samt att bygga lösningar och tjänster på två av de största molnplattformarna – AWS och GCP. Du kommer att arbeta med kunduppdrag i Skåne-regionen, men som en del av Capgeminis globala organisation får du även möjlighet att samarbeta, utvecklas och växa tillsammans med kollegor världen över.

Teamet arbetar med att skapa moderna, skalbara och hållbara lösningar i molnet – alltid med kundens affär i fokus. Med både bredd och djup erbjuder vi fantastiska möjligheter att förädla dina arkitekturfärdigheter, dela kunskap och utveckla dig tillsammans med skickliga kollegor i teamet.

I den här rollen kommer du att ha en nyckelroll i:

Arbeta med applikationsdesign och arkitektur i molnmiljöer
Integrationer för molnbaserade tjänster
Cloud DevOps och DevSecOps samt Lösningsarkitektur
DevOps verktyg; Git, Docker, Maven, Kubernetes

Din profil

+5 års erfarenhet av utveckling i tekniker så som Java, J2EE, Node.js, och React
Du har hands on erfarenhet inom AWS eller GCP och kan bevisa det med motsvarande certifiering
Goda kunskaper av Mikrotjänster - Utveckling och distribution av mikrotjänster i molnet inklusive containerisering, orkestrering och infrastruktur som kod med hjälp av Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, BlackDuck, samt +2 års dokumenterade erfarenhet av att designa/implementera AI/ML-lösningar, med fokus på maskininlärning, djupinlärning, NLP och GenAI
Du skriver och talar flytande svenska då det används i det dagliga arbetet

Meriterande

Back-end erfarenhet inom följande: Python, TypeScript eller liknande
Front-end erfarenhet inom följande: Angular, Vue.js eller Jquery

Vad vi tror kommer få dig att trivas

Arbeta med de senaste teknologierna och påverka på nordisk nivå. Du samarbetar med andra specialister, kompetensväxlar och bidrar till att bygga AWS/GCP-kapabilitet i Norden – samtidigt som du påverkar några av världens största bolag.
Utvecklas genom utbildningar, certifieringar och interna initiativ. Du får tillgång till utbildningar och certifieringar inom AI, AWS/GCP och Microsoft Azure, samt möjlighet att engagera dig i Capgeminis fokusområden som Diversity & Inclusion, Sustainability, Wellness Club och Art Club.
Njut av en engagerande arbetsplats med starkt stöd och förmåner. Vi erbjuder friskvårdsbidrag, tjänstepension, bonusprogram, företagshälsovård och sjukvårdsförsäkring samt en inkluderande kontorskultur med sociala aktiviteter och teambuilding.

Ansökan

Redo att ta din karriär till nästa nivå? Vi ser fram emot din ansökan och återkommer till dig så snart som möjligt.

Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kommer identitetskontroll att genomföras genom granskning av ditt ID-kort, och bakgrundskontroller kan utföras vid behov.

Om Capgemini

Capgemini är en AI-driven global partner för affärs- och tekniktransformation som levererar konkret verksamhetsnytta. Vi formar framtiden för organisationer och förverkligar den med hjälp av AI, teknik och människor. Med vår starka historia på nästan 60 år är vi en ansvarsfull och mångsidig koncern med över 420 000 medarbetare i över 50 länder. Genom vår expertis inom strategi, teknik, design, ingenjörstjänster och affärsverksamhet levererar vi heltäckande tjänster och lösningar, baserade på vår djupa branschkunskap och vårt omfattande partnernätverk. Koncernen rapporterade globala intäkter på 22,5 miljarder euro för 2025.

Make it real | www.capgemini.com

jobs.title: Senior .NET Architect
jobs.description:
We are currently recruiting on behalf of a leading global technology and transformation organisation for an experienced Senior .NET Architect
to join a major client engagement in Dublin.

This is a senior technical architecture role for an experienced .NET professional who enjoys shaping complex software solutions, influencing technical direction and working closely with engineering teams and business stakeholders. You’ll play a key role in defining modern .NET and Microsoft Azure
solutions, ensuring they are scalable, secure, maintainable and aligned with wider business objectives.

The Opportunity

As Software Architect, you’ll take ownership of solution-level architecture across new software development initiatives. You’ll work closely with product, project and technical stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions, while providing architectural leadership to development teams.

The role offers the opportunity to work with modern Microsoft technologies, including Azure PaaS
, and to influence the evolution of software platforms within a complex enterprise environment.

What you'll be doing

Define and design software architectures that meet business, functional and non-functional requirements.
Make architectural decisions covering scalability, performance, security, resilience, maintainability and accessibility
.
Translate business and technical requirements into practical, scalable software solutions.
Lead architectural discussions with product managers, project managers, developers, technical leads and other stakeholders.
Establish and promote software architecture standards, patterns and best practices.
Provide technical leadership and guidance to development teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
Review designs and code to ensure solutions adhere to agreed architectural and engineering standards.
Identify technical risks, dependencies and challenges, developing appropriate mitigation strategies.
Evaluate and recommend technologies, frameworks and tools in line with the wider technology strategy.
Contribute to the software development roadmap and support proof-of-concept initiatives where appropriate.
Support development teams with complex technical issues and troubleshooting when required.
Mentor and coach developers and other technical team members, helping to raise engineering capability.
Ensure software development and implementation align with organisational standards and governance.

What we're looking for

We're looking for a strong .NET/Azure technical architect
with a proven track record of designing and delivering complex software solutions in an enterprise environment.

Essential experience

Extensive commercial experience with C#, .NET Framework and modern .NET
.
Strong practical experience designing and developing solutions on Microsoft Azure
.
Strong understanding of Azure PaaS
services and cloud development patterns.
Proven experience designing complex, scalable and maintainable software systems.
Strong knowledge of software architecture patterns, development principles and engineering best practices.
Experience with SQL Server and Entity Framework
.
Strong understanding of REST APIs and API-led integration
.
Experience with Azure DevOps
and modern software delivery practices.
Familiarity with SonarQube
and code-quality practices.
Experience considering non-functional requirements (NFRs)
including performance, security, scalability and resilience.
Awareness of accessibility standards
and their application within software solutions.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts and influence stakeholders at different levels.
Experience providing technical leadership, mentoring and guidance to software development teams.

Desirable experience

Experience with front-end technologies such as JavaScript, React, HTML, CSS and jQuery
.
Experience working within large-scale enterprise or transformation programmes.
Experience establishing or evolving software architecture standards and governance.
Experience with proof-of-concept development and technology evaluation.

Why consider this opportunity?

This is an opportunity to join a significant technology transformation environment where you'll have genuine scope to influence architecture, shape technical direction and work on complex enterprise solutions
.

You'll work alongside experienced engineering and technology professionals, with exposure to modern Microsoft technologies and the opportunity to contribute beyond individual projects.

Permanent full time position. Three days a week on site in Dublin
. Candidates must be eligible to work in Ireland/EU.

Salary dependent on candidate experience. Benefits: Annual Bonus Scheme. Contributory Pension. Private Medical Insurance. Life Assurance & Long-Term Disability. Employee Assistance Programme. 22 days annual leave + 10 public holidays. Relocation package. Continuous Learning & Development. Access to extensive training & certification resources. Lunch & Learn sessions. Additional perks including company discounts, on-site parking, and bike-to-work scheme.

For more information, please contact David Coyle
at 01 635 1748
or email david@methodius.com

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Bentley Systems

Location: Dublin, Ireland (Hybrid/On-site)

Position Summary

Operating directly within our global Product & Technology organisation, this role functions as an internal Forward Deployed Software Engineer. We are looking for an adaptable, highly autonomous senior engineer to tackle rapid prototyping, architectural de-risking, and tactical engineering initiatives.

Rather than maintaining a traditional product lifecycle, you will partner closely with our leadership team, including the CTO, senior engineers and architects on short-cycle strategic initiatives. Your customers are Bentley's global Product & Technology (P&T) organization - the teams responsible for building and operating the products and solutions that power our customers' success.

You will take on complex, ambiguous technical challenges, rapidly evaluate solution options across the full stack, from architecture and design to hands-on implementation, build functional proof-of-concepts, and transition successful solutions to our core product teams.

Responsibilities

Full-Spectrum Problem Solving: Fluidly navigate across varied technical domains depending on the project. One month you may be addressing deep performance profiling and cloud reliability; the next, you may be building modern front-end spikes or evaluating microservice patterns.
De-Risk Architecture: Architect, code, and benchmark functional proof-of-concepts (PoCs) to validate performance and evaluate emerging technologies before Bentley makes a company-wide commitment.
Operate Across the Stack & Cloud: Leverage a wide range of technologies, acting as a polyglot across multiple programming languages and major cloud platforms to deliver the right solution for the business.
Ensure Frictionless Hand-offs: Package your validated architectures, write the technical summary, and hand the clean, maintainable deliverables over to our global P&T teams so you can pivot to the next strategic unknown.

Qualifications

0-to-1 Experience: 7+ years of software engineering experience with a demonstrable track record of designing, building, and delivering complex, high-performance software in fast-paced environments.
Ownership and Bias for Action: You are highly self-directed, comfortable operating autonomously without extensive supervision, and driven to turn ambiguity into actionable solutions.
Curiosity and Learning Agility: You possess an aptitude to select the best tool for the specific problem at hand. You have working fluency across multiple programming languages (such as C#, TypeScript, Python, Java, or C++) and continuously learn new ones.
Empathy and Partnership: You view the global P&T organization as your customer, maintaining strong relationships and ensuring your prototypes are built with their eventual operational needs in mind.
AI-Amplified Output: Practical experience leveraging generative AI APIs, vector retrieval/RAG patterns, or daily integration of AI-assisted engineering tools to amplify output.
High-Signal Communication: Ability to synthesize complex technical discoveries, trade-offs, and architectural recommendations into direct, high-signal summaries for technical leadership.
Big Picture Architecture: Solid foundational knowledge of distributed systems, multi-tenant patterns, containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes), and at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP).

What We Offer

A great Team and culture – please see our colleague video.
An exciting career as an integral part of a world-leading software company providing solutions for architecture, engineering, and construction - watch this short documentary about how we got our start.
An attractive salary and benefits package.
A commitment to inclusion, belonging and colleague wellbeing through global initiatives and resource groups.
A company committed to making a real difference by advancing the world’s infrastructure for better quality of life, where your contributions help build a more sustainable, connected, and resilient world. Discover our latest user success stories for an insight into our global impact.

 About Bentley Systems

Around the world, infrastructure professionals rely on software from Bentley Systems to help them design, build, and operate better and more resilient infrastructure for transportation, water, energy, cities, and more. Founded in 1984 by engineers for engineers, Bentley is the partner of choice for engineering firms and owner-operators worldwide, with software that spans engineering disciplines, industry sectors, and all phases of the infrastructure lifecycle. Through our digital twin solutions, we help infrastructure professionals unlock the value of their data to transform project delivery and asset performance. www.bentley.com

Equal Opportunity Employer

Bentley is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and considers for employment all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, gender/gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, marital status, religion/belief, national origin, caste, age, or any other characteristic protected by local law or unrelated to job qualifications.

jobs.description:
Systemutvikling er vår spisskompetanse, og våre teknologer har lang erfaring med å gjøre om komplekse behov til brukervennlige løsninger. Vi hjelper kunder med å gjøre komplekse behov til brukervennlige digitale løsninger – fra automatisering av 800 000 årlige søknader om Europeisk helsetrygdkort til prosjekter innen autonome skip og bærekraftig havbruk. På Ålesundskontoret får du kombinere store, nasjonale prosjekter med et tett samarbeid med næringslivet på Sunnmøre, og bidra til løsninger som skaper verdi i en av Norges mest fremtidsrettede regioner.

I Twoday kan du starte karrieren som fast ansatt sammen med en håndplukket gjeng. Målet er å få deg raskt ut på prosjekt – parallelt med spennende kurs, fagkvelder og reiser. Gjennom vårt skreddersydde opplæringsprogram og veiledning av våre erfarne konsulenter, leverer våre graduates raskt på toppnivå og skaper konkrete resultater for kunder.

Som utvikler i Twoday kan du forvente spennende, komplekse og samfunnsnyttige prosjekter. På prosjekt jobber vi ofte i større team, og du får jobbe med både utviklere, arkitekter, designere og prosjektleder. Vi hjelper kundene våre ved bruk av teknologier som .NET, Java, C#, JavaScript, kunstig intelligens og skyplattformer som Azure og AWS. Vi ligger langt framme i å benytte KI-verktøy, på en bærekraftig og ansvarlig måte.

Vil du vite mer om hvordan det er å starte som Nytt Krutt? Bli kjent med oss på vår nettside.

Har fullført en relevant bachelor- /mastergrad før oppstart i august 2027
Trives godt i rollen som fullstack- eller backendutvikler
Ønsker å jobbe som konsulent og i team
Drives av å tilegne deg ny kunnskap og lære bort til andre

jobs.title: Bli med å kvalitetssikre samfunnskritiske IT-løsninger med Quality Engineering, Test og Testledelse
jobs.description:
Accenture søker erfarne og dedikerte testere som vil være med å videreutvikle vårt fagmiljø innen Quality Engineering. Du blir en del av et sterkt og erfarent team på ca. 30 personer – som sammen jobber med å kvalitetssikre noen av de mest komplekse og samfunnsviktige IT-løsningene i Norge.

I våre prosjekter jobber vi med helhetlig og kontinuerlig testing og kvalitetssikring av komplekse og samfunnskritiske IT-løsninger. I denne rollen får du utfordret deg på et bredt spekter av ferdigheter innen fagområdet Quality Engineering og Testing, inkludert bruk av Kunstig Intelligens i testrollen.

Høres dette spennende ut? Da vil vi gjerne høre fra deg.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Du er en kreativ og erfaren tester, med interesse for å koordinere testaktiviteter på tvers av team. Du synes det er givende å jobbe med samfunnskritiske systemer og du omfavner DevOps som tilrettelegger for effektiv testing og raske leveranser. Du har erfaring med API-drevet testing og du har et stort engasjement for automatisering. Du er initiativrik og har et detaljert øye for helheten i et prosjekt. Du er en person som er interessert i kontinuerlig læring og utvikling og trives i å sette deg inn i nye og komplekse funksjonelle og tekniske problemstillinger.

I tillegg er du løsningsorientert, nysgjerrig og liker å sette deg inn i nye problemstillinger der du deler av din kunnskap. Du har gode kommunikasjonsevner og trives i tverrfaglige team der du bygger bro mellom teknologi og forretning. Du liker å jobbe i team, samtidig som du liker å jobbe selvstendig med krevende arbeidsoppgaver hos våre kunder.

Du vil ha innflytelse på arbeidshverdagen og det du ønsker å jobbe med. Hos oss sitter du i førersetet for din fremtidige teknologikarriere, enten av om du ønsker å bli en ekspert innen et område, eller en leder med bredere faglig- og teknologibakgrunn. Accenture er en karriereskole der du coacher andre, og der du selv blir coachet.

Oppsummert, vi ser etter deg som:  

Har minimum tre års utdannelse som Bachelor

3+ års erfaring med test og kvalitetssikring som tester i team i smidige prosjekter

Erfaring med testadminstasjonsverktøy som Jira og Confluence eller lignende verktøy for oppgavestyring og testadministrasjon

Har vært utførende på test av GUI, funksjonell test av brukergrensesnittet, backend-testing, test av funksjoner og forretningslogikk

Har kjennskap eller erfaring med ett eller flere av følgende verktøy: Bruno, SoapUI, Postman, JMeter, Selenium, Playwright, SQL og databaseverktøy, Camunda, Kafka, Splunk

Har erfaring med testing på strømmende data og Kafka

Kjennskap til kunstig intelligens og prompt engineering

ISTQB Foundation sertifisering (eller planer om å ta den)

Flytende norsk muntlig og skriftlig (tilsvarende C1 eller bedre)

Hvem er vi? 

I tillegg til prosjektarbeid jobber vi i fagmiljøet med de nyeste innovative løsninger innen Quality Engineering. Vi organiserer workshops internt og for kunder, deltar og presenterer på konferanser, holder gjesteforelesninger på høgskoler og universiteter samt støtter salgsaktiviteter. Utover fagmiljøet har vi goder som firmahytter, sosiale grupper av mange slag, årlige fester og sosiale samlinger. Det er viktig for oss å trives på jobb!

Vi dyrker både fag og fellesskap, og hos oss får du støtte til å utvikle deg videre – enten du vil fordype deg som teknolog, eller gå en ledervei.

"Det mest givende med jobben min er kombinasjonen av teknisk utvikling og reell samfunnsinnvirkning. Vi jobber med nye teknologistakker, automatisering og AI – og bidrar samtidig til tryggere tjenester for folk flest."

— Shiladitya, systemtestleder i Accenture

Stillingen rapporterer til leder for Quality Engineering Norge. Arbeidssted: Oslo - med fleksible løsninger.

Høres dette interessant ut?

Send inn din CV og kort søknadsbrev så snart som mulig. Vi vurderer søkere fortløpende.

jobs.title: Software Developer (Application development)
jobs.description:
NAPA Design Solutions offers a comprehensive solution for 3D ship modeling and design tools covering hull form design and hydrodynamics, hydrostatics and stability, structural design, and information sharing across the shipbuilding process. These are among the most powerful tools in the industry, trusted by the world's largest shipyards and classification societies.

The role: what is it about?

The team is now looking for a Software Developer who will focus on application usability development with .NET, C#, WPF and XAML. Development, testing, and maintenance of the NAPA ship design solutions are part of your daily work. In this role you will mainly work on developing NAPA Engineer, a modern design and computing platform for naval architects. It combines trusted NAPA calculation capabilities with a redesigned, intuitive user experience and a powerful visual approach to engineering workflows. You can read more about the solution at: https://www.napa.fi/software-and-services/ship-design/software/napa-engineer/

You will do this work with artificial intelligence (AI) as a normal part of your toolchain. We use agentic coding capability across our development teams, which means using AI coding agents to plan, write, test, review and refactor code, and doing it in a way that improves both delivery speed and code quality. We expect you to use these tools in your daily work, to help us learn where they work well and where they do not, and to share those learnings with your team.

You will be working with Windows desktop applications, native libraries, third-party components, including a 3D graphics library, database engines, a licensing solution, and more
.

This job is permanent and full-time
.

Your team and job location

You will work in an international team where your closest colleagues are experienced software developers and naval architectural domain experts who will support you in your role. You will also interact with local and global colleagues
from various teams in software development, UX design, DevOps, and sales. Together with them you will also shape how we use AI coding agents in practice, from tooling choices to review practices.

Our office is located in Helsinki (Ruoholahti), and you can work at the office or in hybrid mode
. We hope to meet you at our Helsinki office regularly.

What are we looking for?

What matters most: you're curious about UI development, energized by AI-assisted development tools, and hungry to solve real problems as a self-starter
. If the visual side of UI excites you too, that's a big plus.

Our Ideal Candidate Would Have

Academic degree in a relevant field such as computer science, mathematics, physics, naval architecture, or engineering
Completed basic studies and/or having a good understanding of algorithms, data structures, and OOP (object-oriented programming)
2+ years of experience in building native Windows desktop applications
Experience in UI design
Experience using WPF, C#, and XAML
Understanding of user experience and the ability to apply it in your own design work
Hands-on experience of using AI coding assistants or coding agents in real development work, together with the judgment to review, test and take responsibility for what they produce
Interest in NAPA’s domain (maritime business)

Additionally, The Following Skills Would Be Considered An Advantage

Experience with agentic coding workflows
Knowledge or studies in usability
Experience with database solutions
Experience in automated testing methods
Knowledge of software reliability and maintainability
Experience in CAD or CAE applications

You do not need to tick every box on these lists. If this role feels like a good fit for you and you have most of what we are looking for, we hope you will apply.

We work in English
across all our offices, so you need to be comfortable using it in your daily work, both in writing and in conversation.

Why you will enjoy working in this role

You get to combine modern desktop application development on a next-generation engineering platform, combined with AI agentic development that we are scaling across the company
The design work of the world's largest shipyards and classification societies happens in the software you develop
Great colleagues with expertise in, for example, naval architecture, software development and UX design
A global team of 230 experts who support you and share what they know
When you join NAPA, you will be assigned an onboarding buddy who will help ensure a smooth start and introduce you to the NAPA way of working

Ready to get on board and join the napa crew?

We kindly ask you to send your application and CV to us as soon as possible (by clicking the "Apply for this job" button on the job ad page), but no later than 11 October 2026
. The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate has been found.

For more information about the position, please send your questions by e-mail to jobs@napa.fi. Notice that we cannot accept job applications sent by e-mail.

NAPA as a company and as an employer

With over 35 years of operation, NAPA is a leading software and data services provider for ship design and operations to enable safe, sustainable, and future-proof maritime industry. Headquartered in Finland, NAPA employs 230 experts, combining expertise in naval architecture, fleet operations and digital services. NAPA operates globally, with a presence in Japan, Korea, China, Singapore, the USA, Germany, Greece, Romania and India.

Build software at scale. Influence how we build it. Help modernize a product area at the heart of construction projects.

Dalux is growing, and we are looking for an experienced software developer to join our team called "Tender".

You will work on software that supports the bidding process for construction projects and is tightly integrated with the wider Dalux platform. It is a domain where reliability, data security, and good technical design matter – and where there is plenty of opportunity to influence how the product and architecture evolve.

You will also have the opportunity to influence how we increasingly use AI to make software development more effective.

Your role

As an Experienced Software Developer, you will take ownership of complex product and technical problems from idea to production.

You will join a full-stack development team working closely with a Product Manager and Product Designer. We expect experienced developers to contribute beyond their individual tasks: helping make good technical decisions, improving the codebase and architecture, sharing knowledge, and raising the engineering standard around them.

Within Tender, there is a particular focus on strengthening and evolving the technical foundation of the product while continuing to deliver new functionality.

Your work can include:

Owning complex features and technical problems end-to-end
Designing and implementing scalable, maintainable solutions
Contributing to architectural decisions and the technical direction of the team
Improving the structure of an established codebase and reducing technical debt
Helping evolve boundaries and modularity within the application
Sparring with and mentoring other developers
Working closely with Product Management and Design to understand problems and find the right solutions
Bringing new ideas, technologies, and development practices into the team when they create real value

We expect experienced developers to have opinions, challenge existing solutions, and be comfortable having their own ideas challenged in return.

AI-assisted software development

We are significantly increasing our focus on AI-assisted development across Dalux.

We are actively exploring how AI can improve the software development lifecycle – from understanding requirements and exploring technical approaches to coding, testing, review, debugging, refactoring, and automation.

The Tender team is already experimenting with how these tools can improve its day-to-day development work.

As an experienced developer, we want you to take an active role in that development: experimenting with new workflows, critically evaluating their value, sharing what works, and helping establish good engineering practices around AI-assisted development.

Practical experience using AI as part of your development workflow is an advantage. More importantly, you should be curious about how these tools are changing software engineering and willing to continue evolving your own way of working.

Technologies we work with

Tender is a full-stack product area primarily built with:

C# / .NET
Angular / TypeScript
MSSQL
Elasticsearch

Our wider platform runs on a distributed cloud architecture using AWS.

Experience with our exact technology stack is useful, but strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to understand and improve complex systems matter more.

What would make you a particularly strong match?

We are looking for an experienced software developer with strong technical fundamentals and the ability to influence the software around you.

For this particular team, we would especially value:

Strong professional experience with C# and .NET
Experience improving or modernizing established software systems
An understanding of Domain-Driven Design, modular architecture, or similar approaches to structuring complex applications
Experience mentoring or providing technical sparring to other developers
Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools and workflows

You do not need to match every point.

Technical judgment, curiosity, and the ability to make an established product better are more important than having worked with exactly the same technologies or architectural patterns before.

Product development at Dalux

Our product teams bring developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers together.

Developers are expected to understand the problem being solved and contribute to finding the solution – not simply implement specifications handed to them.

As an experienced developer, you will have an important voice in balancing user value, usability, technical feasibility, business viability, and long-term technical health.

Our products are relied upon by professionals worldwide, making performance, stability, maintainability, and quality important parts of everyday engineering.

What You Can Expect From Dalux

Dalux is a software company at heart.

As an experienced developer, you can expect:

Significant ownership of the software you build
Real influence on technical solutions and engineering practices
Skilled colleagues who enjoy technical discussions
Close collaboration between Engineering, Product Management, and Design
Short paths from technical ideas to decisions and implementation
Opportunities to improve an established product and architecture
An environment actively investing in AI-assisted software development
High levels of trust and freedom in how you solve problems
A social workplace with monthly events and employee-driven clubs

All Dalux software development takes place in-house at our headquarters in Vibenshuset, Copenhagen. Working together in person is an important part of how we collaborate, share knowledge, and make decisions quickly.

About Dalux

Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005 by Bent Dalgaard and Torben Dalgaard.

We build digital tools that make the construction industry smarter and more efficient. Using our own 3D BIM technology, Dalux develops user-friendly software used in more than 140 countries worldwide.

Our core technology is developed entirely in-house, giving our developers the opportunity to influence both the products and the technology behind them.

Interested?

If you are looking for a role where you can remain hands-on while gaining greater technical influence and helping evolve an established product and architecture, we would like to hear from you.

If you have any questions, feel free to contact IT Talent Acquisition Specialist Sara at sni@dalux.com.
