Despre ce este rolul?

Construim un produs folosit deja de zeci de mii de oameni și vrem să-l ducem la următorul nivel.

Problema pe care o rezolvăm nu e simplă: legislație complicată, multe excepții și așteptări mari de la utilizatori.

Căutăm un engineer care vrea să contribuie la soluții reale și să crească într-un mediu cu impact direct în produs.

Misiunea ta în acest rol

Vei lucra pe probleme reale ale utilizatorilor noștri , unele bine definite, altele în curs de clarificare
Vei contribui la implementarea și îmbunătățirea sistemelor existente
Vei colabora cu echipa pentru a livra funcționalități în producție
Vei participa la decizii tehnice și vei învăța cum să le iei în timp
Vei folosi AI în workflow-ul tău pentru a crește viteza și calitatea

Ce ne dorim de la tine

2–4 ani experiență în dezvoltare software;
Experiență cu backend (ideal .NET Core, dar nu obligatoriu);
Experiență cu baze de date relaționale și modelare de date;
Capacitatea de a lucra pe probleme care nu sunt complet definite;
Interes pentru produs și modul în care este folosit de utilizatori;
Te folosești de AI (Cursor, Claude, Copilot sau similar) pentru a-ți îmbunătăți modul de lucru și înveți să validezi output-ul.

Ce oferim

Salariu competitiv (în funcție de nivel);
Zile nelimitate de concediu (pe care le și folosim);
Program flexibil;
Abonament premium la clinicile medicale Regina Maria;
Abonament Bookster;
Acces la tool-uri AI (Claude, Cursor, Copilot etc.) și buget de utilizare;
Lucrăm hibrid din București. Poți lucra până la 2 zile pe săptămână de acasă. În perioada de probă, te așteptăm zilnic la birou: e cea mai rapidă cale să înțelegi contextul, să cunoști echipa, și să ajungi să livrezi pe cont propriu.

Despre cum lucrăm în general

Modul În Care Lucrăm Este Influențat De Valorile În Care Credem Și Pe Care Ne Propunem Să Le Aplicăm În Tot Ce Facem

Creșterea continuă și accelerată e ceva fundamental - ne așteptăm de la fiecare coleg să își dorească să se dezvolte și să profite pe deplin de toate resursele pe care le punem la dispoziție pentru învățare. Apoi, ne așteptăm ca fiecare coleg să fie interesat mai ales de rezultat, nu doar de efort în sine.
Clientul este în centrul activității noastre: îi înțelegem nevoia reală, îl tratăm cu empatie și alegem soluții simple și clare pentru el. Facem toate acestea în timp ce ne comportăm cu bunăvoință unii față de alții, oferim și acceptăm feedback și menținem și consolidăm un spirit de echipă în care să ne regăsim cu toții.
Fiind un start-up, ne dorim alături oameni energici, curajosi, autonomi, cu o gândire dincolo de tipare, cu simțul umorului și cu o mare flexibilitate mentală, pentru că adesea realitatea din jur și activitățile noastre de zi cu zi se schimbă din mers în timp ce direcția rămâne clară: suntem aici pentru a sprijini SOLOprenorii.

TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.

We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?

Every product feature our customers touch runs through the platform you'll help build. Our team owns the foundation, the shared components, state architecture, data flows, and performance infrastructure that dozens of feature teams build on every day. When we ship an improvement, it multiplies across the entire company.This is not a maintenance role. We're in the middle of an ambitious re-architecture of our platform, and AI-enabled experiences are becoming core to how our products work. You'll be at the intersection of deep technical craft and company-wide impact: the decisions you make will shape how every engineer here builds, and how every customer experiences our products. If you want your work to be the backbone rather than the trim, this is the seat

Responsibilities

Lead the design and evolution of our React-based platform architecture, serving as the technical anchor for one of the most demanding and highest-leverage projects in the company.
Own frontend performance end to end: rendering strategy, bundle optimization, data-fetching patterns, and the observability to prove improvements with real-user metrics (Core Web Vitals, INP, TTI).
Build and integrate AI-enabled features and infrastructure, including streaming LLM responses, real-time inference-driven UI, agentic workflows, and the state/data patterns that make AI experiences feel fast and reliable.
Define and champion state management strategy across the platform, choosing the right tool for the job across Redux, Zustand, and RxJS-based reactive patterns, and guiding teams on when and how to use each.
Evolve our build and developer-experience tooling on Vite, keeping local iteration fast and production builds lean as the codebase scales.
Partner closely with Product and Design to translate UX intent into technical architecture, advocating for the user in technical decisions and for technical reality in product decisions.
Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, raise the bar through design reviews, and influence engineering direction beyond your immediate team.
Make pragmatic build-vs-buy and prioritization decisions informed by business context, considering cost, time-to-market, customer impact, and long-term maintainability.

Requirements

8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with deep, hands-on expertise in modern React (hooks, concurrent features, server components are a plus).
Proven track record designing and scaling frontend platforms or design systems used by multiple teams.
Expert-level knowledge of state management approaches and their trade-offs. You have shipped production systems with Redux (including RTK), Zustand, and reactive streams with RxJS, and can articulate when each approach is most effective.
Strong command of frontend performance engineering, including profiling, code-splitting, caching strategies, rendering optimization, and measuring impact with real-user monitoring.
Experience with modern build tooling, ideally Vite, and a strong point of view on developer experience at scale.
Hands-on experience building AI-enabled user experiences, including integrating LLM APIs, handling streaming and partial responses, designing UI patterns for non-deterministic systems, or using AI-assisted development tooling thoughtfully in your own workflow.
Genuine UX sensibility. You understand interaction design, accessibility, and perceived performance, and pay attention to the details that improve the user experience.
Demonstrated business acumen. You connect technical investments to business outcomes, communicate trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders, and know when a pragmatic solution is more valuable than a perfect one.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience driving alignment through documentation, technical specifications, and cross-team collaboration.
Nice to have: Experience with TypeScript at scale, monorepo tooling (such as Turborepo or Nx), and module federation or micro-frontend architectures.
Nice to have: Experience with SSR or edge-rendering frameworks and a solid understanding of their performance implications.
Nice to have: Familiarity with prompt engineering, RAG patterns, or evaluating AI-powered features in production environments.
Nice to have: Previous experience working on platform, infrastructure, or developer-experience teams.

What We Offer

Onsite Onboarding in our HQ office for an optimal start
Great compensation and benefits packages including company achievement bonus or sales bonus and regular salary reviews
Premiums for the private pension plan (BAV) up to the maximum amount are topped up by TeamViewer
Public transport friendly offices
Option to lease an e-bike (Germany only)
Special terms for local gyms
Access to Corporate Benefits platform with many discounts
Regular Team events and company-wide celebrations
Open door policy, no dress code rules, frequent all Hands and Leadership Lunches
Hybrid and Flexible work time with up to 50% home office
Work From Abroad Program allowing up to 40 days of work outside your contracting country
We celebrate diversity as one of core values, join and drive one of the c-a-r-e initiatives together with us!

TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C-A-R-E and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. We are proud to have an open and embracing workplace environment that will empower you to be your best no matter your gender, civil or family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

If you require any accommodations or adjustments during the application or hiring process, including interview or onboarding support, please reach out to your Talent Acquisition Partner, who will be happy to support you.

Machelen.

Zoom on the job:

act as the primary maintenance engineer for baggage handling applications across international airport sites
diagnose and resolve production incidents including display issues, sorting problems, flight data discrepancies and system performance issues

bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, industrial automation or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience
minimum 3 years of experience in software engineering, systems integration or technical support within an industrial, logistics, transport or 24/7 production environment
experience with baggage handling applications, baggage tracking, sortation and reconciliation systems
solid knowledge of OPC UA, IATA 1745 BSM, SITA messaging, MQTT, AMQP and system integration concepts
strong debugging and root cause analysis skills across application, database, network and protocol layers

knowledge of baggage handling architecture, SAC systems, BMR, airline DCS integration and IATA airport operations standards
able to produce clear technical documentation and communicate effectively with customers, partners and colleagues
organised and comfortable managing activities across multiple sites and projects
collaborative approach with the ability to work independently when required
knowledge of French (both written and spoken — valuable for communication with many airport stakeholders)

For you this means:

a market rate salary in line with your education and experience
interesting training and career opportunities
group insurance, hospitalization insurance
eco vouchers, meal vouchers, representation allowance, 13th month, holiday pay
electrical lease car, bicycle lease plan
smartphone with subscription, internet fee

jobs.description:
Regular

1. Présentation de l’ETNIC

L’ETNIC (Entreprise pour les Technologies de l’Information et de la Communication) est l’opérateur informatique de la Fédération Wallonie-Bruxelles. Organisme d’intérêt public, l’ETNIC a pour mission de concevoir, développer, maintenir et faire évoluer les systèmes d’information et les infrastructures technologiques au service des administrations et établissements de la FWB.

Acteur central de la transformation numérique du secteur public francophone belge, l’ETNIC intervient dans des domaines variés tels que :

La gestion des infrastructures IT (réseaux, sécurité, data centers, cloud),
Le développement d’applications métiers sur mesure,
L’accompagnement des projets digitaux (analyse fonctionnelle, UX/UI, gestion de projet),
La cybersécurité et la protection des données,
Le support utilisateurs et la formation.

Dans un souci constant d’innovation, de performance et de service public, l’ETNIC collabore régulièrement avec des partenaires externes pour renforcer ses équipes à travers des missions de consultance IT. Ces collaborations s’inscrivent dans un cadre éthique, professionnel et orienté vers la qualité et l’impact concret des solutions livrées

2. Mission

Dans le cadre du programme ZEPHYR de l’Office de la Naissance et de l’Enfance (ONE)
, la mission d’Application Architect / Leader Technique couvre de nombreux aspects tels que l’élaboration de propositions d'architecture applicative, le développement, l'expertise technique, l'identification de solutions pour l’implémentation de systèmes complexes.

En tant qu’Application Architect / Leader technique, vous êtes responsable de l’implémentation de la solution, de la qualité du code et de la cohérence technique, des performances et des livraisons du produit. En tant que responsable du développement des applications, vous travaillez en collaboration avec les analystes fonctionnels et métiers, les testeurs, le chef de projet et les spécialistes du middleware afin de mener à bien les implémentations. Vous êtes responsable de la qualité du livrable et de la diffusion des bonnes pratiques en matière de design et de développement.

Les projets du programme ZEPHYR :

DOMES V2

Ce projet s’inscrit dans le domaine de l’accompagnement des enfants de 0 à 6 ans. Il vise à permettre aux professionnels de l’ONE de gérer le dossier de l’enfant, de l’éditer, de créer des consultations et de planifier les rendez-vous dans l’Agenda en lien avec le suivi de l’enfant.

Prénatal V1

Dans le cadre de l’accueil et du suivi médico-social de la future mère, Prénatal V1
vise à digitaliser le dossier social de la future mère
. La solution permet de soutenir les professionnels de l’ONE dans le suivi et l’accompagnement social des futures mères, tout au long de leur parcours au sein des services concernés.

e-VAX 2.0

Le projet e-VAX 2.0 vise à remplacer l’actuelle solution e-VAX CCR et à moderniser la gestion des données de vaccination. Il permettra notamment d’améliorer la collecte et l’échange des données vaccinales, de mettre en place une carte de vaccination transversale
et de renforcer le suivi de la chaîne d’approvisionnement des vaccins. La solution contribuera également au pilotage du programme de vaccination grâce à l’exploitation des données et à des fonctionnalités d’aide à la décision.

La mission s’inscrit dans un environnement Agile / SCRUM, avec une architecture orientée services et un environnement technique principalement basé sur Java et Angular.

Equal Plus Consulting has been engaged to search for a Senior Cloud Center of Excellence Azure Platform Engineer to work hybrid 60% on-site in Belgium or Czech Republic.

TITLE Senior Cloud Center of Excellence Azure Platform Engineer (Belgium)
START DATE 5 Oct 2026
END DATE 5 Mar 2027

LANGUAGES English
hybrid 60% on-site in

About the Role
The Cloud Center of Excellence (CCoE) is responsible for the design, governance and scaling of Azure and self-service platform.

We are looking for a senior engineer to help clean up the technical depth — from landing zone architecture to Terraform Enterprise module engineering, networking design and enterprise system integrations. This is a medior/senior individual contributor role: you're expected to work independently on well-defined scopes, but you'll be ramping up within an existing team structure rather than owning the full platform strategy from day one.

Current Situation
The Azure platform has grown fast — more application teams, more subscriptions, more consumers of our self-service capabilities every quarter. That
growth has been a success story, but it also means parts of our platform (governance controls, identity and access processes, networking/DNS patterns, and our Terraform Enterprise setup) were built for an earlier stage of adoption and now need to be modernized to keep pace with scale.

We're tackling this step by step: moving toward more standardized, automated and maintainable ways of working across governance, identity, networking and
infrastructure-as-code, so the platform can keep scaling without a proportional increase in manual effort.

To do that well, we're expanding the team with senior engineers who can contribute on two fronts: keeping day-to-day platform operations running smoothly for the
teams that depend on us, while also helping design and build the more standardized, scalable solutions we're moving toward.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities
Act as second-line escalation for Azure platform issues (RBAC, DNS, VNET/Private Endpoint connectivity, AD integration, Terraform Enterprise
runs) and write up root cause analyses.
Maintain and incrementally improve landing zones, archetypes, Azure Policy and naming/tagging standards; process governance exception requests.
Build, version and maintain Terraform modules; review consumer changes and evaluate Azure Verified Modules (AVM) as replacements for custom
modules.
Handle recurring IAM tickets (RBAC assignments, group memberships, access troubleshooting) and contribute to cleanup of legacy/exception-based
access.
Support DNS/connectivity requests and troubleshooting across the hybrid environment within existing patterns.
Maintain and troubleshoot existing PowerShell automation scripts used across platform operations.
Keep governance documentation current and contribute to internal Terraform Enterprise workshops and application team enablement.

Required Technical Expertise
Azure (hands-on production experience required)
Governance: management groups, subscriptions, Azure Policy (built-in and custom), RBAC design and troubleshooting.
Identity: Microsoft Entra ID — group-based access models, app registrations, managed identities, service principals.
Networking: VNET peering/hub-spoke, Private Endpoints, Private DNS Zones, Azure Firewall, Application Gateway, Azure Front Door, hybrid/on-prem DNS integration.
Landing zone concepts aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) archetypes.
Exposure to Azure Databricks networking (VNet injection) is a plus.
Infrastructure as Code
Solid production-level Terraform authoring — designing, versioning and publishing modules, not just consuming them.
Terraform Enterprise or Terraform Cloud experience specifically: workspaces, private module registry, VCS-driven workflows, policy checks (Sentinel/OPA).
Familiarity with Azure Verified Modules (AVM) and module lifecycle/versioning practices.

DevOps & Automation
CI/CD pipeline experience (Azure DevOps preferred): build/release pipelines, YAML pipelines, service connections.
Scripting for automation and troubleshooting (PowerShell, Bash or Python).
Comfortable working with KQL/Log Analytics for diagnostics is a plus.

Identity & Access Management
Practical RBAC design and troubleshooting at enterprise scale (role assignments, group nesting, inheritance issues, propagation delays).
Experience managing access for both human users and service/application identities.
Understanding of access governance concepts (ownership, periodic reviews, exception handling).

Networking
Solid understanding of enterprise DNS architecture, including hybrid on- prem/cloud scenarios.
Experience troubleshooting connectivity issues across VNETs, firewalls, and hybrid links.

Prior Experience we're Looking For
4–7 years in a cloud platform engineering, DevOps or infrastructure engineering role, ideally within a large, governed enterprise (not a greenfield/startup environment).
Demonstrated experience operating (not just building) an Azure landing zone platform at scale — supporting real application teams with real tickets.
Prior role involving Terraform Enterprise/Cloud in a production capacity, ideally including module authorship and CI/CD integration.
Experience working across team boundaries (IAM, Networking, Security, external partners/vendors) to resolve platform issues.
Microsoft certifications (AZ-104, AZ-204, AZ-305, or Terraform Associate) are a strong plus but not a substitute for demonstrable hands-on experience.
Personal Characteristics
Can operate independently on a well-scoped task from day one — this is a "plug in and go"; role, not a ramp-up position.
Comfortable working in a live, legacy-entangled environment where not everything is fully standardized yet.
Detail-oriented, especially around governance, documentation and naming/tagging consistency.
Good communicator — able to support application teams directly without needing everything translated by the platform lead.
Takes ownership of tickets/incidents end-to-end rather than escalating prematurely.

jobs.title: Bioinformatics Engineer
jobs.description:
Scientific Manager – Machine Learning Engineering (Computational Biology)

Ghent, Belgium (hybrid)

Who are we?

Excelra is a leader in biopharma data and analytics, that uniquely blends scientific understanding with technological expertise. This dual mastery empowers innovative drug discovery and development, transforming research data into actionable insights for groundbreaking discovery.

We have global locations in Ghent (Belgium), London (UK), Utrecht (The Netherlands), Boston/SFO (US) and Hyderabad (India).

www.excelra.com

About the role

We are hiring a Scientific Manager to take ownership of the machine learning and experimental design pipelines behind our customer’s genomic target prediction work. Much of this currently lives in individual scripts maintained by individual scientists. Your job is to turn it into an automated, version-controlled and reproducible platform the whole team can rely on – and to keep it scientifically sound by working shoulder to shoulder with our customer’s wet-lab and computational biology colleagues.

This is a hands-on engineering role in a scientific environment. You will spend more of your time building, automating and hardening pipelines than running individual analyses, so we are looking for someone who is as comfortable with Git, containers and workflow managers as with genomics data.

What will you do?

Automate and professionalize internal ML and experimental design pipelines for genomic target prediction.
Migrate existing scripts and notebooks into a production-ready, version-controlled codebase.
Reduce the manual input required for dataset preparation, settings configuration and pipeline execution.
Integrate pipelines into existing digital infrastructure, including AWS and HPC environments.
Implement version control, testing and reproducibility standards across ML workflows, and help the team adopt them.
Collaborate closely with wet-lab and computational biology colleagues to make sure pipelines meet real scientific requirements.
Run several projects in parallel, (re)assigning tasks as priorities shift, and present results concisely to stakeholders inside and outside your domain.

What do you bring?

A PhD in bioscience engineering, bioinformatics, computer science or machine learning engineering – or an MSc with 5+ years of equivalent experience. You can demonstrate this through peer-reviewed publications, contributions to public code repositories or relevant project work.
Strong Python, and the habit of writing code that colleagues can read, test and re-run.
Proven experience taking analysis code into production: version control with Git, code review, packaging, containerization (Docker, Singularity/Apptainer) and automated testing or CI/CD.
Hands-on experience with workflow orchestration – Nextflow, Snakemake or equivalent.
Experience running workloads on cloud infrastructure (AWS) and/or HPC clusters (e.g. SLURM).
Solid grounding in statistical modelling and machine learning applied to biological data, including model evaluation and experiment tracking.
The ability to translate between engineering and bench science, and to work with scientists who are not engineers.
You are eligible to live and work in Belgium.

Nice to have

Experience with genomics and transcriptomics data (RNAseq, single-cell, spatial, WES/WGS, …).
R alongside Python.
Experiment tracking and model registry tooling (MLflow, Weights & Biases) or infrastructure-as-code (Terraform).
Experience in a client-facing, consulting or CRO setting.

Who are you?

You enjoy project-based work and have a strong analytical mindset.
You enjoy working in a multidisciplinary environment with people of diverse professional backgrounds (IT, (molecular) biology, genomics, engineering, etc.).
You are communicative and customer focused.
You are fluent in English, both written and verbally.
You take initiative and have an eye for new opportunities.

What do we offer?

A challenging job environment with advancement opportunities.
Flexible hybrid working in an international (global) setting: largely home-based, with the option to work alongside colleagues in our Ghent office and occasional visits to our customers on site.
A dynamic company with an open culture, easy communication and an ambitious vision.
A rich & global team with a mix of backgrounds, experiences and expertise.
Independence and flexibility.
An attractive salary package with extra-legal benefits.

Interested?

Please send your resume and motivation letter to Helen De Block, HR Director: helen.deblock@excelra.com

jobs.title: Senior .NET Backend Developer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Funstage, our players come first. The Backend team creates the technology behind our social casino games, from bonus engines and progression systems to leaderboards, battle passes and real-time gameplay that keep players coming back for another round.

As a Senior .NET Backend Developer, this is a chance to turn great game ideas into reality, tackle exciting challenges at scale, and see your work make a real difference to the player experience. From idea to production, there’s plenty of room to shape how things are built, bring fresh ideas to the table, and have fun solving tricky technical problems along the way.

Your tasks

Analyse

Turn technical discussions and stakeholder feedback, including insights from Customer Support and CRM, into clear, actionable requirements and practical solutions
Explore, evaluate, and manage libraries and tools that help the team choose the right solution for each project

Develop

Design and build optimised distributed backend systems and real-time gaming features capable of handling hundreds of thousands of operations per second and up to 50.000 simultaneous players
Create and optimise databases and ETL pipelines to keep data reliable and systems performing at their best
Bring new features to life in our Vue.js Admin Panel by implementing their configuration

Test

Create and maintain automated and performance tests that keep features reliable under pressure
Develop and maintain Vue.js Test-Client features that make backend features easy to test and validate

Deploy

Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and fast, reliable rollback strategies
Work with web and mobile frontend teams to integrate backend services seamlessly across their platforms

Maintain

Build and continuously improve Kubernetes infrastructure and monitoring across Azure and local development environments
Maintain security protocols covering user roles, access controls, encryption, and security updates
Document incidents from root cause through resolution and post-mortem analysis, turning issues into opportunities to improve
Share your expertise with your colleagues and improve the overall team quality

Tools

Technologies: .NET 10, Vue.js, GraphQL via Hasura, WebSockets via SignalR, PostgreSQL, Cassandra, Redis, OpenTelemetry, and Identity Server

The Team

Architecture is a team effort. New solutions are discussed openly and shaped together, with team buy-in before development begins
Code reviews are part of how we grow. Every pull request is reviewed by the rest of the team within a few hours, helping us maintain quality while sharing knowledge along the way
We work as peers. The manager is part of the team, and technical decisions are discussed openly and made together
Choose what you build. Features aren’t simply assigned, team members can choose which features they want to work on from the sprint
Quality comes built in. Unit tests and Gherkin-based acceptance tests are part of our definition of done and are kept up to date
Keep it simple. We follow the YAGNI principle, avoiding unnecessary complexity and focusing on solid, evolvable architectures
Own the full picture. Everyone builds a strong understanding of our Kubernetes components and CI/CD, so infrastructure knowledge is shared across the team

Your profile

Professional experience working with .NET technologies, with .NET 5+ experience preferred
Strong knowledge of database technologies, with experience across SQL and NoSQL preferred
Familiarity with the API technologies that connect our backend to frontend experiences, including REST, GraphQL, and WebSockets
Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native technologies
Understanding of distributed systems and the challenges of building technology capable of supporting millions of players worldwide
Capable of building event-driven systems using message buses like Kafka, RabbitMQ, and Azure Service Bus
Strong product thinking, with the ability to turn stakeholder needs into clear and effective technical requirements
Collaborative mindset with experience in pair programming, team workshops, knowledge sharing, and supporting the growth of others
Agile mindset and a pragmatic approach to building solid, evolvable solutions
Confident communicating and collaborating in English, both written and spoken

Our offer

We believe great work happens when people feel supported, inspired, and balanced. By investing in our employees, we create an environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential. This commitment has been recognized through our Great Place to Work® certification. We offer the following benefits:
Flexible working hours and a hybrid model that fit your lifestyle, backed by a strong culture of work-life balance
A dedicated training budget to explore new skills, deepen your expertise, and shape your career journey
A welcoming office atmosphere at our Vienna HQ with daily fresh fruit, a wide range of teas, fair-trade coffee, and meals at our company-subsidized restaurant
Subsidized public transportation, plus access to pool e-bikes and e-cars — for both business and personal use
Plenty of ways to stay active and connected, from MyClubs app points to regular sports and company events
Attractive local employee discounts and healthcare benefits that make everyday life a little easier

Greentube GmbH, the global interactive unit of NOVOMATIC, is a leading developer and supplier of iGaming solutions. Greentube is a wholly-owned subsidiary of the NOVOMATIC Group, one of the biggest producers and operators of gaming technologies and one of the largest integrated gaming companies in the world. Do you want to turn business challenges into smart, scalable solutions with Microsoft Power Platform? At Tieto Tech Consulting, we work at the intersection of technology, consulting, and customer value - helping organizations automate processes and build modern digital solutions that make daily work easier and more impactful.

With over 8,000 colleagues worldwide and around 300 colleagues in the DACH region, we combine industry insight, software engineering, cloud expertise, data capabilities, and enterprise solutions know-how to help our customers design, build, and run their digital businesses.

We are looking for a Microsoft Power Platform Architect who can take ownership of enterprise-level solution architectures, guide customers in strategic technology decisions, and translate complex business needs into scalable, secure and future-ready Microsoft ecosystem solutions. If you are passionate about architecture, governance, cloud technologies and creating sustainable business value with Power Platform, this role offers the opportunity to shape impactful solutions together with skilled colleagues and forward-thinking customers.

When joining Tieto Tech Consulting as a Microsoft Power Platform Architect, you

Define and own end-to-end Power Platform architectures, ensuring scalable, secure and sustainable solution designs across Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI and Power Pages
Advise customers on best practices for Power Platform governance and lifecycle management
Lead the architectural integration of Power Platform solutions into broader Microsoft 365 and Azure ecosystems, aligning technical decisions with enterprise standards and customer strategy
Facilitate architecture workshops, guide decision-making with customers and provide expert recommendations on solution design, governance and technical roadmaps
Stay up-to-date with Microsoft certifications and contribute to internal capability building

Who We Are Looking For

We value diverse backgrounds and welcome candidates who bring:

5+ years of hands-on experience in a similar role
Very good knowledge of Cloud Enterprise Architecture, Power Platform, Azure and Azure AI ecosystems
A completed degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a comparable qualification
Certifications such as PL-200, PL-400, PL-600 or PL-900 are a plus
Hands-on knowledge of Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, and GPT-based solutions
Strong understanding of low-code/no-code development principles
Good programming skills, preferably with C#/.NET
Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions
A consulting mindset and strong communication skills in both German and English
Passion for continuous learning and staying up-to-date with new developments

As an individual, you are a team player who takes initiative and ownership. You communicate clearly, organize your work effectively, and enjoy solving complex challenges. You’re eager to learn and share knowledge, and you thrive in a fast-evolving technology landscape.

We offer

Collaboration with highly skilled experts across Europe and beyond
A culture built on trust, collaboration, and continuous learning
Flexible hybrid working models and modern ways of working
Benefits like laptop and smartphone also for private use, health programs, team events, excellent public transport connection, food vouchers, contribution to the costs of the Austrian “Klimaticket”, fresh fruits, the perfect environment to prosper professionally, and a lot more
Continuous professional development and international career opportunities
An attractive compensation package including performance-based incentives

The monthly gross salary for this position will start from € 4.476,00 (based on IT collective agreement, ST1 Erfahrungsstufe) on a full-time basis, depending on your qualifications and experience. Our aim is to provide you with a salary package that is both competitive and reflective of your relevant experience, while also aligning with current market standards.

Did we get you inspired?

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we would love to hear from you. Please attach your CV or LinkedIn profile, and we will get in touch.

If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact us: careers.austria@tieto.com.

We’re also happy to connect you with one of your future colleagues for an informal conversation. It’s a great opportunity to hear first-hand what the role looks like, how we work and what it’s like to be part of the team.

Please note that while we are happy to answer questions via email, we can only consider applications submitted through our online application system and therefore cannot accept applications sent directly by email.

Vienna, Linz, Graz

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

As a Software Architect, you will help shape the future of our SaaS platform as we evolve from a serverless, AWS-oriented approach toward a more container-based, cloud-native architecture. You will work across a mixed technology landscape, helping steer the platform in a .NET-preferred

Partner with product management, stakeholders, and technical leaders to shape and defend the technical roadmap.
Mentor engineers and help foster strong architectural and engineering practices across teams.

Your profile

Proven experience in a Software Architect or similar senior technical leadership role.
Strong experience designing distributed systems and cloud-native applications in container-based environments.
Solid knowledge of Kubernetes and modern deployment practices for containerized workloads.
Strong experience with .NET / C#, and the ability to guide architecture in a mixed-technology environment.
Strong understanding of software architecture principles, OOP, SOLID, design patterns, and maintainable system design.
Experience designing SaaS and multi-tenant solutions.
Strong knowledge of API design, HTTP, REST, and service integration patterns.

Work that matters

The technology we build at Materialise pushes the boundaries. You’ll find pride in building something that matters, whether you designed it, printed it, or shipped it. No matter your role, we unlock new possibilities to build a better and healthier world every day.

At the same time, we expect you to invest in the people around you — not just your own work — to make the group stronger than the sum of its parts.

At Materialise, we expect you to deliver on that trust and keep your commitments.

When you see opportunities for your career to grow at Materialise, we encourage you to go for them. People shape a fulfilling career at their own pace here.

jobs.description:
NUESTRO CLIENTE

Compañía tecnológica de capital privado, multinacional inglesa con fuerte presencia en Europa, especializada en servicios IT, cloud, infraestructura, ciberseguridad, workplace, managed services y transformación digital para grandes organizaciones. Con presencia en España desde hace más de 25 años. Global y large accounts.

EL PROYECTO

En el marco de su crecimiento en España (y global), la compañía está impulsando una nueva unidad de negocio especializada en Inteligencia Artificial
, concebida como una línea estratégica de alto impacto dentro del grupo. Se trata de una apuesta corporativa con visibilidad internacional, conectada con HQ y con participación activa en el CoE global de IA de la compañía.
Se trata de una posición de nueva creación
que reportará directamente al Director de la Unidad de Negocio de IA en España. Su misión será clave para convertir la estrategia de IA en soluciones reales, vendibles, escalables y ejecutables para clientes enterprise.

El rol tendrá una doble dimensión especialmente atractiva. Por un lado, será una figura clave de cara al mercado, acompañando a clientes en la identificación de casos de uso, diseño de arquitecturas, construcción de propuestas, desarrollo de PoCs/PoVs y defensa técnica de soluciones de IA ante interlocutores C-Level. Por otro, tendrá también un papel innovador dentro de la propia organización, ayudando a desarrollar capacidades, metodologías, arquitecturas de referencia, aceleradores y modelos de servicio que permitan consolidar la práctica de IA en España.
Es una oportunidad especialmente interesante para un perfil que quiera participar en la construcción de una práctica de IA desde una fase inicial, con respaldo internacional, exposición a clientes estratégicos y capacidad real de influir en la propuesta de valor de la compañía.

PRINCIPALES FUNCIONES

Acompañar a los equipos comerciales y account managers en sesiones de discovery con clientes, identificando necesidades, pain points, casos de uso y criterios técnicos de decisión.
Diseñar arquitecturas de soluciones Data & AI basadas en plataformas cloud y tecnologías como Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Copilot Studio, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Mistral AI u otras soluciones de IA privada o soberana.
Elaborar propuestas técnicas, Statements of Work, planes de PoC/PoV, estimaciones de esfuerzo, arquitecturas de referencia y documentación de solución.
Liderar respuestas técnicas a RFPs y RFIs, en coordinación con equipos de bid management, comercial, cloud, infraestructura, ciberseguridad y delivery.
Preparar y defender presentaciones técnicas, workshops de arquitectura, demos y sesiones ejecutivas ante CIOs, CTOs, responsables de datos, innovación, tecnología y negocio.
Diseñar patrones reutilizables para casos de uso habituales como Document Intelligence, Conversational AI, Knowledge Mining, RAG, automatización mediante agentes y procesos de IA aplicada.
Participar en la construcción de PoCs, PoVs, prototipos y aceleradores técnicos que permitan validar la viabilidad de la solución y demostrar valor de negocio.
Definir especificaciones técnicas para servicios gestionados de IA, incluyendo procedimientos operativos, monitorización, SLAs, LLMOps, AIOps y traspaso a equipos de delivery.
Garantizar que las soluciones diseñadas cumplen criterios de seguridad, privacidad, gobierno del dato, responsible AI y frameworks corporativos de cloud landing zones.
Colaborar activamente con el Centro de Excelencia Global de IA, incorporando buenas prácticas, metodologías, arquitecturas de referencia y capacidades diferenciales del grupo.
Mantenerse actualizado/a sobre nuevas herramientas, modelos, frameworks de orquestación y tendencias de mercado en el ámbito de IA generativa, agentes, RAG, MLOps/LLMOps y cloud AI.

PERFIL REQUERIDO

Buscamos un perfil técnico-consultivo con experiencia en arquitectura de soluciones Data & AI, preventa técnica o consultoría tecnológica, idealmente en compañías de servicios IT, integradores, consultoras tecnológicas, partners cloud, hyperscalers o empresas especializadas en datos e inteligencia artificial.

Muy valorable aportar experiencia real en el diseño de soluciones de IA aplicada, especialmente en arquitecturas GenAI, RAG, automatización, integración de APIs, plataformas cloud, gobierno del dato y modelos de operación.

The Future of Finance Institute (FFI) is being established as an industry platform that brings together financial institutions, FinTechs, technology firms and research partners to support the adoption of emerging technologies across Singapore's financial sector. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Workato**
=================



Workato is the leading Control and Execution Platform for Enterprise AI — the neutral platform enterprises trust to put AI to work across their business. Workato unifies data, applications, and processes into a single platform so AI can reliably orchestrate business processes in production at enterprise scale. Built on more than a decade of running mission\-critical processes for over half the Fortune 500 — including Nasdaq, Amazon, Cisco, Vodafone, Atlassian, and Lucid Motors — Workato turns over 14,000 enterprise systems AI needs to act on into one governed execution layer. For more information, visit workato.com.


**Why join us?**
================



Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a **flexible, trust\-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles**. We are driven by **innovation** and looking for **team players** who want to actively build our company.



But, we also believe in **balancing productivity with self\-care**. That's why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment along with a multitude of benefits they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives.



If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!



Also, feel free to check out why:


* Business Insider named us an "enterprise startup to bet your career on"
* Forbes' Cloud 100 recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world
* Deloitte Tech Fast 500 ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America
* Quartz ranked us the \#1 best company for remote workers
**Responsibilities**
====================



We're building the infrastructure layer that connects enterprise systems to AI: an **MCP Gateway**, an **AI Gateway**, and the services around them. These are the systems that sit between LLM providers and everything else — routing, auth, rate limiting, observability, protocol translation. We're looking for a senior engineer who understands both the systems layer and the AI protocol layer, and who can build production\-grade services in Go and/or Ruby.



In this role, you will also be responsible to:


* **Design and develop the MCP Gateway and AI Gateway** — production services that mediate between applications, AI agents, and LLM providers. This means protocol\-level work: MCP server/client implementations, request routing, streaming, tool\-call proxying, authn/authz, and tenant isolation. You'll build the core infrastructure, not just applications on top of it.
* **Build high\-throughput, low\-latency network services.** You'll work close to the wire: TCP, TLS, HTTP/1\.1 and HTTP/2, JSON streaming, connection pooling, backpressure. When latency matters, you'll know exactly where it goes.
* **Own the data layer from the application side.** Deep PostgreSQL knowledge — schema design, indexing strategies, query planning, transactions and isolation levels, connection management. You're not a DBA, but you can read EXPLAIN ANALYZE output and fix the query, not just add an index and hope.
* **Design for concurrency.** Worker pools, queues, graceful shutdown, backpressure, race\-free shared state. You can profile a service under load (pprof, flamegraphs, query stats), find the bottleneck, and fix it.
* **Drive observability for AI systems.** Metrics, tracing, and logging that actually tell you what's happening — token usage, latency per provider, cache hit rates, failure modes, cost per request.

### **How we work with AI**


* **We encourage — but never force — the use of AI/LLM tools in development.** If AI\-assisted workflows make you faster, use them heavily. If you prefer to write something by hand, that's equally respected. What we care about is the quality of what ships, not how it was typed.
* **You'll have access to nearly every major tool and model on the market** — coding agents, IDEs, frontier models — with very generous usage limits. We want tooling budget to never be the reason a good idea goes unexplored.
* **We actively explore and enhance automated development.** You'll help shape how the team uses AI: agent workflows, code review automation, internal tooling. We build AI infrastructure, so we hold ourselves to being its most sophisticated users.
* **We believe LLM tools give a single engineer full visibility across the product**, regardless of area — frontend, backend, infra, docs. We want people who use that leverage to own problems end\-to\-end rather than stay inside one layer.
* **But the accountability never shifts to the machine.** You own what you merge. You can explain every statement and decision in the final output, and justify and defend the architectural choices to human colleagues in design and code reviews. "The AI suggested it" is never an acceptable rationale.

**Requirements**
================


### **Qualifications / Experience / Technical Skills**


* **Senior\-level experience (5\+ years) in Go, Ruby, or both.** Any combination works: deep Go, deep Ruby, or strong in both. What matters is that you've shipped and operated production services in at least one of them.
* **Go candidates:** you know the stdlib deeply and prefer it over frameworks. net/http, crypto/tls, context, goroutines and channels, the memory model. You've done performance optimization on real services — allocations, GC pressure, lock contention — and you understand networking (TCP, TLS, HTTP, JSON) in depth, not just through a framework's abstraction.
* **Ruby candidates:** strong Rails in production — you know where Rails ends and Ruby begins, you've tuned ActiveRecord rather than fought it, and you've built services that stay fast under load.
* **PostgreSQL depth from an application developer's perspective.** Query optimization, indexing, transactions, connection pooling, migrations at scale. You don't need to administer the cluster; you need to write code that treats it well.
* **Concurrency and profiling as a practiced skill**, not a bullet point. You've debugged a production incident with a profiler open.
* **Familiarity with Kubernetes and containers.** You can deploy, debug, and reason about your services in a containerized environment — resource limits, health checks, rolling deploys, networking basics.
* You've built production services with proper observability, deployment pipelines, and security. You know how to run reliable systems and debug distributed systems when things break.

### **AI/LLM Experience**


* You've worked with LLMs at the **protocol level** — message structures, tool calling, streaming responses, caching strategies. You know what's happening on the wire, not just what the SDK abstracts away.
* Familiarity with **MCP (Model Context Protocol)** is a strong plus — ideally you've built or integrated MCP servers/clients and understand the transport and capability negotiation layers.
* You can integrate with OpenAI\-compatible and Anthropic APIs directly, evaluate responses, understand token usage, and optimize for latency and cost.
* **You can judge, audit, and verify LLM output.** You catch subtle bugs, security issues, and hallucinated APIs before they ship — and you're fluent enough in the underlying systems to know *why* the output is wrong, not just *that* it's wrong.

### **Soft Skills / Personal Characteristics**


* You learn fast and stay current. AI infrastructure is moving weekly; you follow it and can evaluate new protocols and approaches quickly.
* You participate in technical design discussions and code reviews, and you can explain complex concepts clearly to engineers and non\-technical stakeholders alike.
* You're comfortable owning the full lifecycle: design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Wat je gaat doen

Ben jij de architect die het overzicht bewaart zonder de diepte te verliezen? Die klanten weet te overtuigen in een pitch én intern de technische koers bepaalt, van eerste verkenning tot livegang? Dan past de rol van Solution Architect bij iO je perfect.

Als Solution Architect ben je de brug tussen de strategische ambities van onze klanten en de technische realisatie ervan. Je vertaalt functionele eisen én non-functionals naar een gedragen solution architecture, documenteert trade-offs en architectuurbesluiten, en begeleidt de realisatie, uitgevoerd door een team van gespecialiseerde engineers.

Je verschilt daarin bewust van de Software Architect: waar die inzoomt op code-architectuur en implementatiedetails, kijk jij naar het grotere geheel, platforms, integraties, schaalbaarheid en de organisatiedoelen die daarachter liggen. Je stuurt geen team aan in de traditionele zin maar je geeft wél technische richting en zorgt dat architectuurbesluiten helder zijn en nageleefd worden.

Binnen onze campus in Utrecht werken we intensief met Digital Experience Platforms (DXP), waarbij composable architectuur, headless-aanpakken en MACH-principes (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless) centraal staan. De focus van onze techstack ligt op .NET, Node.js, Drupal, headless CMS-platformen en frontend-engineering, en we begeleiden regelmatig complexe platformmigraties. Hoe breder jouw technische achtergrond, hoe fijner, maar voor de diepte-specialisaties staan Lead Engineers klaar.

Je bent ook nadrukkelijk client-facing: je werkt mee aan pitches, bouwt klantvertrouwen op en combineert technische scherpte met sterke communicatieve en adviserende vaardigheden.

De lijnen binnen én tussen de teams zijn kort. Collega-architecten staan altijd klaar voor een scrum-of-the-architects, en bij elk project is een projectmanager betrokken, zodat jij je volledig kunt richten op architectuur en advies.

Wat zijn jouw taken als Solution Architect?

Klantsamenwerking & pitches:
Je bent een vertrouwde technische gesprekspartner, van de eerste pitch tot en met de oplevering. Je neemt actief deel aan verkooptrajecten, helpt klanten de juiste technische keuzes te maken, en past je communicatiestijl aan op je gesprekspartner, of dat nu een CTO, een product owner of een business stakeholder is.

Architectuur & Design:
Je vertaalt requirements én non-functionals naar een heldere solution architecture. Je documenteert architectuurbesluiten en trade-offs, identificeert risico's vroegtijdig en bewaakt de architecturale integriteit gedurende de realisatie. Je denkt in alle lagen van de stack, van frontend tot backend, van cloud tot integratie.

DXP, composable & MACH:
Je begrijpt de principes achter moderne DXP-architecturen: composable, headless en MACH. Je weet wanneer welk principe van toepassing is, en welke concrete technologieën, zoals .NET, Drupal, Contentstack of andere headless CMS-platformen, daar het best bij passen. Je maakt het onderscheid tussen architectuurprincipes en de specifieke implementatiekeuzes die daaruit volgen.

Technische sturing:
Je geeft technische richting aan het projectteam. Je helpt engineers bij het nemen van de juiste beslissingen, signaleert pijnpunten en risico's vroegtijdig, en zorgt dat het team op de juiste architecturale koers blijft.

Data & Integratie:
Je kent de principes van moderne integratiepatronen: API-first, event-driven architectuur en messaging. Je ontwerpt integraties die schaalbaar, onderhoudbaar en toekomstbestendig zijn.

Security, Privacy & Compliance:
Security is voor jou geen afterthought, maar een architectuurprincipe. Je integreert privacy by design, IAM en compliance-overwegingen (AVG/GDPR, NIS2) structureel in je oplossingen.

AI-architectuur:
Je kunt klanten en teams adviseren over de rol van AI in hun technische landschap, van het integreren van AI-diensten tot het architecturaal borgen van datakwaliteit en governance.

Organisatiesensitiviteit & advies:
Je hebt een sterk gevoel voor prioriteit en weet hotspots en risicopunten te identificeren. Je geeft helder advies op basis van soms beperkte informatie, en begrijpt de dynamiek binnen verschillende organisaties.

Je groeit bij iO als Professional binnen het Solution Architecture-domein. Je krijgt ruimte om je persoonlijke groeipad volledig zelf vorm te geven, ondersteund door een persoonlijk ontwikkelingsbudget. Je bent actief lid van een relevant Chapter, waar je in lunch- en pizzasessies met collega's uit verschillende teams nieuwe technieken onderzoekt en proof-of-concepts ontwikkelt , denk aan microservices, API-gateways, serverless architectuur en de nieuwste DXP-innovaties.

Daarom ben jij de perfecte Solution Architect

Must-haves

Ruime ervaring in het (mee)bouwen van complexe applicaties en digitale platformen
Aantoonbare ervaring met solution architecture in complexe, digitale omgevingen
Kennis van DXP, composable architectuur, headless en MACH-principes
Ervaring met cloud-omgevingen (Azure of AWS) en moderne integratiepatronen (API-first, event-driven)
Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden: je vertaalt technische concepten naar begrijpelijke taal voor klanten en stakeholders
Je hebt ervaring met het werken in een adviserende rol en kunt op basis van bijvoorbeeld SWOT-analyses en strategisch inzicht weloverwogen keuzes maken.
Je kunt op een abstract niveau denken en je gedachten vangen in zowel tekst als diagrammen of een goed gesprek a.d.h.v. een presentatie

Pre's

Ervaring met .NET en/of Node.js
Kennis van Drupal en/of headless CMS-platformen
Ervaring met complexe platformmigraties
Kennis van security- en compliance-vraagstukken: privacy by design, IAM, AVG/GDPR, NIS2
Affiniteit met of kennis van AI-toepassingen in digitale platformen

Dit krijg jij van ons

25 vakantiedagen

Reiskosten & vakantiegeld

Uiteraard kun je rekenen op 8% vakantiegeld. Daarnaast hebben we verschillende mobiliteitsregelingen, maar afhankelijk van jouw functie en voorkeur een keuze.

Goede pensioenregeling

Hybride werken

Een goede werk- en privébalans is superbelangrijk. Samen met jouw team maak je afspraken over wanneer én waar je werkt.

Gezonde snacks & lunch

Op iedere iO campus pak je de hele dag een gezond tussendoortje en kun je tegen een kleine vergoeding gezond én gevarieerd lunchen.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer bij Navara

Bij Navara bouwen we software die werkt: oplossingen die live gaan en aantoonbare impact maken. Van digitale producten die miljoenen mensen gebruiken tot complexe systemen in het hart van organisaties. Je werkt in Navara teams waarin je richting geeft aan technische keuzes. Met moderne technologie, bewezen engineering practices en veel aandacht voor developer experience helpen we organisaties echte techbedrijven te worden.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior Software Developer geef je richting op technisch en architectuurniveau binnen complexe projecten. Je combineert hands-on development met het adviseren over technologiekeuzes, ontwikkelstrategieën, softwarearchitectuur en bewaakt de kwaliteit.
Verder:

Zorg je dat best practices worden toegepast (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development);
Vertaal je business- en technische vraagstukken naar schaalbare oplossingen;
Stimuleer je moderne engineering practices en Developer Experience binnen de teams;
Ben je een inhoudelijke sparringpartner binnen het team, je helpt het technische niveau structureel te verhogen.

Softwareontwikkeling als teamsport

We hebben een passie voor softwareontwikkeling en zien het als een teamsport. Je werkt met gedreven, hoogopgeleide en betrokken software engineers in Navara teams samen.
Kennisdeling zit verweven in ons werk. Denk aan code reviews, pair programming, kennisfestival, LunchLabs en hackathons. Zo blijf je jezelf technisch ontwikkelen en leer je continu van andere engineers.

Onze impact

Je werkt aan software die dagelijks door grote groepen mensen wordt gebruikt. Een aantal voorbeeld projecten waar we nu aan werken zijn:

BerekenJeRecht
: met een team van 5 een applicatie bouwen die miljoenen mensen helpt inzicht te krijgen in hun rechten en financiële situatie (TypeScript, React frontend met Next.js, CI/CD met GitHub Actions, en IAC met Bicep);
Integratie van het nieuwe pensioenstelsel (Wtp)
: alles wat deelnemers en werkgevers zien, loopt via systemen waar jij aan bouwt. Dit doe je samen met een team van 8 collega’s (Python, Docker, AWS, Azure);
Slim laden van elektrische auto’s
: software bouwen in een team van 8 die ervoor zorgt dat auto’s op duurzame en efficiënte momenten worden opgeladen (AWS en TypeScript, Kafka).

Je bouwt dus niet alleen systemen, maar oplossingen die zichtbaar impact maken in de maatschappij.

We werken ook met andere technologieën zoals C#, Java, Python, TypeScript en frameworks als Angular en React. Qua cloudtechnologie werken we met Azure en AWS.

Waarom werken bij Navara?

Bij Navara draait het om samen groeien en beter worden. Geen gebaande paden, maar echte uitdagingen in complexe omgevingen.
Verder kan je nog denken aan:

Er is veel aandacht en ruimte voor ontwikkeling, zo heb je sessies met je Technology Officer en mentor om je ontwikkeling gericht te sturen;
Een helder groeipad, richting technische diepgang of juist leiderschap;
Flexibel werken (hybride);
Regelmatige kennissessies, meetups, hackathons en andere bedrijfsactiviteiten;
Een salaris tussen de € 5.000,- en € 7.000,- euro per maand én maandelijkse bonus;
Een vast contract, leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding, netto telefoon- en onkostenvergoeding en een premievrij pensioen.

Wat verwachten we van jou?

Je ziet kansen voor verbetering en neemt het initiatief om samen met je team nieuwe technieken of methodieken uit te proberen. Verder heb jij:
Een technische bachelor, master en/of PhD op zak;
Minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring opgedaan;
Een onderzoekende houding waarbij je kritische vragen stelt en het leuk vindt om buiten de gebaande paden naar oplossingen te zoeken;
Een goede beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal in woord en geschrift.

Over onze Business Unit Zuid-Holland

Je komt terecht in het hechte team van Rotterdam, bestaande uit zo’n 50 collega’s. Ons kantoor ligt op een prachtige locatie aan de Parklaan, midden in het hart van Rotterdam. Het is de ideale uitvalsbasis om, naast het werken bij klanten op locatie, samen te komen met je Navara-collega’s en kennis en ervaringen uit te wisselen.

Naast hard werken vinden we ontspanning en plezier minstens zo belangrijk. Daarom lunchen we samen en organiseren we met enige regelmaat leuke activiteiten en gezellige borrels. Zodra de zon zich laat zien, genieten we van de lunch in onze groene tuin en sluiten we af met een wandeling door het park.

Ben je benieuwd naar meer informatie of wil je eerst even vrijblijvend sparren? Dan is dit natuurlijk mogelijk, we vertellen je graag meer! Solliciteer via LinkedIn of mail naar recruiters@navara.nl.

jobs.title: Wetenschappelijk Software Engineer | Geotechniek
jobs.description:
Heb je een civieltechnische opleiding en zoek je een baan waarin je jouw talent voor softwareontwikkeling inzet om de wereld duurzamer en leefbaarder te maken? Voor Deltares, het kennisinstituut voor water en ondergrond, zijn wij op zoek naar een wetenschappelijk software engineer.

Taken
Dit kun je verwachten als wetenschappelijk software engineer bij Deltares

Je komt te werken in het domein Geotechnical and Flood Defences software. In deze rol ben je dagelijks bezig met om jouw geotechnische kennis te laten landen in onze verschillende open-source softwareproducten.

Al onze producten, binnen de D-Serie waar jij aan gaat werken, zijn van hoge kwaliteit en dat is nodig! Onze wetenschappelijke modellen worden wereldwijd gebruikt voor beslissingen met grote maatschappelijke impact. Denk daarbij aan het beoordelen van damwandconstructies, funderingsontwerpen en stabiliteitsanalyses van dijken. Onderwerpen die hoog op de agenda staan van gemeenten, provincies en waterschappen. Zo draag jij direct bij aan hoogwaterveiligheid en kustverdediging.

Jouw hoofdtaken zijn

Het ontwerpen en programmeren van gebruiksvriendelijke wetenschappelijke software;

Het ophalen en vertalen van gebruikerswensen naar taken die je in samenwerking met (wetenschappelijke) software engineers en specialisten in een scrum-team uitvoert.

Het testen en analyseren van functionele en technische softwarevereisten samen met product owners en specialisten;

Het versnellen en vernieuwen van bestaande simulatiemodellen, waarbij je gebruikmaakt van moderne technologieën, zoals HPC-clusters;

Het verkennen van de mogelijkheden van AI en data science, en technologieën zoals cloud computing, voor nieuwe toepassingen in de deltatechnologie.

Je hoeft niet alle technologieën al te beheersen. Er is genoeg ruimte bij ons om verder te ontwikkelen.

Het
team

Je komt te werken in een team van experts in een samenwerkingsomgeving waarin geotechniek en geavanceerde softwareontwikkeling samenkomen. Een perfecte plek om te leren en jezelf te ontwikkelen! We werken volgens agile ontwikkelmethodologiën en gebruiken ontwikkeltechnieken zoals Test Driven Development, pair programming en Continuous Integration. De grafische user-interfaces worden geschreven in C#, de onderliggende rekenharten in C++ en de analysetools in Python. De specialisten van de diverse disciplines van Deltares zijn nauw betrokken bij de specificatie en de validatie van nieuwe software.

Vereisten
Wat verwacht Deltares van jou als wetenschappelijk software engineer?

Je hebt de ambitie om hoge kwaliteit software te ontwikkelen en zoekt een baan waarin je kunt blijven leren. Daarnaast vragen wij:

Een afgeronde MSc-opleiding in Civiele Techniek, Technische Natuurkunde, Geotechnical Engineering of een vergelijkbare studie, met minimaal 1 jaar programmeerervaring vanuit je studie of werk.

Basiskennis van geotechniek, grondmechanica, funderingen, waterkeringen of ondergrondse infrastructuur.

Affiniteit met stedelijke en infrastructurele vraagstukken, zoals damwanden, funderingen of pijpleidingen.

Het vermogen om concepten en modelleringsvereisten te vertalen naar robuuste softwareoplossingen.

Je hebt ervaring met objectgeoriënteerd programmeren, het schrijven van testen en het gebruik van versiebeheersystemen.

Het is een pre om kennis te hebben van onderwerpen zoals: softwarearchitectuur, Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery, Docker, Kubernetes en/of SOLID en GRASP principes.

Benefits
Wat wij bieden:

Deltares biedt een jaarcontract (minimaal 32 uur) met intentie tot vast dienstverband na het eerste contract. We zoeken een professional met 1 tot 5 jaar relevante werkervaring. Inschaling in schaal 15 of 16 vindt plaats op basis van je ervaring (min. €3968 - max €5100,- bruto per maand) o.b.v. 40 per week.

Je krijgt begeleiding van ervaren (scientific) software engineers en bouwt aan software met een wereldwijde impact.

Heb je behoefte aan flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om wanneer nodig hybride te werken? Dat kan, bij ons kun je goed door ons gefaciliteerd, ook een gedeelte thuiswerken.

34 vakantiedagen op basis van 40 uur, ABP pensioen, een vitaliteitsbudget, een mobiliteitsbudget en een bijdrage aan zorgkosten.

Uitstekende opleidingsmogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele groei. Samen kijken we hoe we jouw groei kunnen stimuleren.

Een volledig overzicht van onze arbeidsvoorwaarden vind je op onze website.

Deadline

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
In feite ben je als DevOps Engineer de brug tussen beheer en softwareontwikkeling waarbij de nadruk in deze functie op beheer ligt. Je zorgt dat onze developers schaalbare en betrouwbare applicaties bouwen, met de nieuwste technologieën én een DevOps-aanpak. Daarbij kijk je proactief naar beheer. Wat kun je automatiseren? Beter, veiliger en efficiënter maken? Haal je creativiteit dus maar uit de kast!

Wat ga je doen bij IVO Rechtspraak?

Als onderdeel van de Rechtspraak maken we de Nederlandse rechtspraak digitaal toegankelijk. We ontwikkelen belangrijke toepassingen als Rechtspraak.nl, webapplicaties voor digitaal procederen, API’s en S2S-services. Dat doen we in teams, met verschillende soorten engineers en mensen ‘uit de business’.

Security, privacy, CI/CD, normaliseren van de technology stack, machine learning en codekwaliteit. Jij zorgt dat de ontwikkelaars in jouw team het allemaal op de juiste manier toepassen. Ook stem je veel af met bestaande infrastructuur- en platformteams om zorg te dragen voor een hoog kwaliteit software delivery en ontwikkelproces. Spannend? Absoluut! Uitdagend? Ook dat! Want de servicelevels van onze diensten mogen niet in gevaar komen. En daar speel jij een grote rol in. Eenvoudig en simpel: dat zijn de sleutelwoorden bij alles wat je doet. Of het nu gaat om code, systemen of architectuur.

Herken jij je in uitspraken als ‘wisdom of production, ‘operations is a software engineering problem’ of ‘automate everything’? Solliciteren dan!

Dit krijg je ervoor terug

Om te beginnen een leuke, informele werksfeer. We houden de lijnen graag kort! En je arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn prima geregeld volgens de CAO Rijk. Wat belangrijke punten op een rij:

Contract: een jaarcontract voor 32 tot 36 uur per week, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband.
Salaris: je komt terecht in salarisschaal 11 (maximaal € 6.275,94 per maand bij een werkweek van 36 uur). Inschaling vindt plaats op basis van je werkervaring.
Keuzebudget: 16,5% van je jaarsalaris (maximaal € 1035 per maand) om je eigen arbeidsvoorwaarden samen te stellen. Zoals het kopen van verlof, het aanschaffen van een fiets of het verduurzamen van je woning.
Doorgroeimogelijkheden: je functie zit vol mogelijkheden om je kennis verder uit te breiden en je persoonlijke ontwikkeling te stimuleren. En bij onze IVO Academie kun je allerlei trainingen en opleidingen doen.
Werk-privébalans: je bent vrij om je werkdagen flexibel in te delen. Zo kun je deels vanuit huis werken. We dragen € 750 bij aan het inrichten van een comfortabele thuiswerkplek.
Vakanties en vrije dagen: je hebt 144 vakantie- en 64 keuzebudget-uren op basis van een 36-urige werkweek. Dat zijn dus in totaal 26 dagen.
Gratis OV: je krijgt van ons een OV-chipkaart voor je woon-werkverkeer.
Pensioen: je bouwt je pensioen op bij het ABP, een van de grootste pensioenfondsen van Nederland. Ook dat is dus goed geregeld.
Leuke activiteiten: een teamdag, borrelmiddagen, een after summer-feest … er gebeurt van alles. Of organiseer ook zelf iets met je collega’s, van padel tot yoga of een pubquiz.

Meer informatie over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden vind je op www.p-direkt.nl (http://www.p-direkt.nl/).

Wat we van jou verwachten

Een afgeronde hbo-wo IT studie (bijvoorbeeld Technische Informatica)
Je hebt minstens 5 jaar ervaring als DevOps- of SRE-engineer in een professionele omgeving
Ervaring met .NET core is een pré

Kom je bij ons werken, dan vragen we ook altijd een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag.

Hier kom je te werken

Bij IVO Rechtspraak werken rond de 1.000 bevlogen, trotse en betrokken professionals. Samen ontwikkelen en beheren we de digitale systemen voor de rechtspraak. Zo zorgen we dat rechtszaken iedere dag soepel verlopen. Onze kernwaarde integriteit is verweven in het DNA van al onze medewerkers. Van IT’er tot communicatieadviseur of beleidsmedewerker. Daarom vinden wij het ook belangrijk dat iedereen die bij ons werkt zich thuis voelt, plezier heeft in het werk en zichzelf kan zijn in een informele werksfeer.

IVO Rechtspraak >

jobs.description:
About Dash0

Join Dash0 and help us define the future of observability. We are OpenTelemetry-native, building a delightful, simple, and AI-centric platform that eliminates vendor lock-in and meaningless toil. Shape a product that developers love—all with transparent pricing and cost-control built in.

The Opportunity

As a Commercial Solutions Engineer, you will act as a trusted technical advisor to our customers and prospects in the commercial segment. You'll bridge the gap between product and customer outcomes — designing, demonstrating, and validating Dash0's technical capabilities in real-world environments.

You'll partner with sales and product teams to deliver high-impact Proofs of Concept, guide observability architecture discussions, and ensure customers realize the full technical value of Dash0. This role is based in Amsterdam.

Note: Your internal title would be a Solutions Architect. Our Solutions Engineers work across both Pre-Sales and Post-Sales!

What You'll Do

Design and architect observability solutions leveraging OpenTelemetry, Kubernetes, and cloud-native technologies.
Translate complex customer requirements into scalable, performant, and maintainable Dash0 implementations.
Develop and execute Proofs of Concept (POCs) that highlight Dash0's differentiated technical capabilities.
Deliver engaging technical demos and presentations tailored to engineering and executive audiences.
Collaborate closely with Account Executives throughout the sales cycle to position Dash0 as the technical solution of choice.
Provide architecture guidance and best practices for observability setup, telemetry data modeling, and OpenTelemetry collector design.
Create and maintain reusable demo environments, reference architectures, and POC templates.
Partner with Product Management to provide technical insights that influence roadmap and feature priorities.

What You Bring

Deep technical knowledge in Kubernetes, OpenTelemetry, observability pipelines, and distributed tracing.
Hands-on experience with instrumentation, telemetry data ingestion, and performance optimization.
Strong understanding of modern DevOps, SRE, and platform engineering practices.
Excellent communication skills — you can explain complex observability concepts clearly to both engineers and decision-makers.
Ability to create and execute technical demos, architectures, and POCs that prove business value.
Collaborative mindset — you work seamlessly across Sales, Product, and Engineering teams.

Nice to Have

Experience with CRM tools (HubSpot) for collaboration and pipeline visibility.
Contributions to technical content — blog posts, conference talks, or open-source documentation.
Familiarity with the CNCF ecosystem and community.
Experience in a high-growth, venture-backed startup environment.

Why Dash0

This is a unique opportunity to help build a generational company. Dash0 is backed by top-tier investors including Balderton Capital, Accel and Cherry Ventures and led by a founding team with decades of experience in observability. We're in the middle of a massive growth phase after our Series B — and we're just getting started.

If you're looking for a place where a great product meets great people, where momentum is real and your impact is visible from day one — this is it.

What we offer:

Competitive salary & meaningful equity participation — you'll own part of what you're building
Flexible, remote-first work environment with offices in New York, Amsterdam, and Munich
€60/month phone & internet allowance
Location-specific benefits
Collaborative, fast-moving team culture with a builder mindset
Clear path for career growth and development
Direct access to founders and leadership
