jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Hi there!

We are STX Next, a global IT consulting company specializing in customer-focused software services. Join a group of 500 professionals dedicated to helping customers build outstanding products. Leveraging the latest advancements in the field, and a passion for innovation, we're shaping the future of technology one project at a time.

Are you the NEXT one?

Type of contract
A B2B contract for your flexibility and competitive compensation package

Location
A remote model. Work anywhere from Poland but be ready for regular business trips.

Role Description

We are looking for an engineer
who would rather sit in a client's office and build the thing than sit in ours and specify it.

STX Next builds software for European companies, and we are changing how we do it. Instead of sending a team and a project manager, we send one engineer who owns the client. You work inside their business, you find out how it actually runs, and you build. Behind you sits an AI pod, a small team of engineers plus our own agent tooling on our AI SDLC, which takes on the bulk of delivery once you have proven what is worth building.

The name is literal. Forward deployed means physically there. Not remote, not from our office, not on a call. You will be at the client's premises around four days a month, and the whole role depends on it.

What This Role Is Not

You will write production code. If you want to stop being hands-on, this is the wrong move.
It is not a specialist post. Not only data, not only AI, not only backend. Versatility is the point, because you will not get to choose what the client's problem needs.
It is not project management. Reporting cadence, documentation and invoicing stay with our PM function.
It is not new business development. Winning new logos stays with Sales. You grow the client you already have.

What You'll Do

Own one client, end to end. You are the one name the client knows, from the first conversation through discovery, build, production and whatever comes after it. Nobody hands them on to a successor.
Find the real problem. Discovery is not a workshop. It is watching how the work is really done, listening for the manual workaround nobody has mentioned, and working out whether fixing it would actually move the client's numbers.
Build the prototype yourself. The way you prove something is worth doing is to build a working version of it and put it in front of the client. Not a deck, not a recommendation. A thing that runs.
Lead the AI pod behind you. You decide who is on it, you are accountable for what it ships, and you stay close enough to know when it is drifting. As delivery settles, more of it moves to the pod and more of your time goes to the next problem.
Make the value legible. You will show the client what a change saved them in hours, cost or risk, in numbers their own leadership can act on. Technical elegance is not the argument.
Unlock the next project. Once the current work is safe, your job is to spot the next problem, prototype the answer and put the case to the client. Our commercial team handles pricing, contracting and paperwork. The idea and the conversation are yours.
Bring it back to us. What you learn about how this client works, and about how we should estimate and sell this kind of work, comes back into our playbooks and accelerators. The second engagement should be cheaper than the first.

What We're Looking For

Strong, broad engineering. You can design, build, deploy and run a real system end to end, across the stack, in an environment that will not look like a clean internal codebase.
Working command of AI. Real understanding of what current AI tooling can and cannot do, and where an accelerator shortens the path. Not prompt literacy.
Translation, both directions. You listen to a business problem and come back with a technical option framed as a commercial decision. Cost, risk, payback, and what happens if the client does nothing.
Communication as a first-class skill. You can hold a room with a CTO and a CFO at the same time and make sense to both. You send the update before anyone asks for it, and bad news comes from you first.
You behave like an owner. The team is yours, the client is yours, the result is yours. You will have the mandate that goes with that, including the standing to advise a client against work we could have sold.
Comfort with ambiguity. No finished spec, a moving target, and a client who often cannot yet articulate the problem. If that reads as energising rather than exhausting, good.
Language. Fluent English, spoken and written. Polish if you will be working with our Polish clients.

Extra package

Pay that reflects the ownership. Market salary for a senior engineer of this calibre, plus an uncapped bonus tied to the margin your account delivers and to the new work you unlock.
A genuine mandate. Decision authority over your pod, your technical approach and the proposals that go to your client, with the access to project financials that makes that real.

What You'll Get

Remote-First Flexibility

Stay where you feel most productive. Here’s a remote-first environment with the freedom to set your own schedule. Whether you need a midday break or a specific routine, we trust you to manage your time and deliver results while maintaining your personal well-being.

Cafeteria & Health Membership

We provide access to premium medical packages which include Medicover Sport. You can also choose a MultiSport card and group insurance options. All these packages are managed through Cafeteria System, giving you the autonomy to choose exactly what fits your lifestyle.

Collaboration Mindset

Facing a complex challenge? At STX Next, you collaborate with true enthusiasts and experts who prioritize professional support and direct, honest feedback.

Tech Events

Gain access to specialized knowledge through bootcamps, Strategic Skills Labs, and Tech Knowledge Hubs focused on AI, Data, and Cloud. Beyond our internal webinars and technical materials, we host branded meetups like DevDuck and PAIDA.

In-person Networking

We support autonomy by enabling project groups to set up their own internal meetings in a location they prefer, often in our Poznań or Gliwice offices, which are great for coordination and building professional relationships. We also take a break from our screens twice a year for our Summer and Winter events.

Professional Toolkit

Prior to your first day as a NEXTer, you will receive a top-tier equipment setup: laptops, monitor, and peripherals tailored to your needs and specific project role.

jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
Papaya Global is a rapidly growing, award-winning B2B tech unicorn with an ambitious mission to revolutionize the payroll & payments industry. With over $400M raised from multiple tier-one investors, our innovative technology provides a comprehensive solution for managing global workforces, encompassing everything from hiring and onboarding to managing and paying employees in over 160 countries.

About the Role

We're looking for a Software Architect
to join Papaya's central Architects Team
— a small group of senior architects that partners with every R&D department in the company. In this role you won't own a single product silo; instead, you'll move across domains (payments, payroll, workforce management, platform, data, security) to help teams shape sound, scalable, secure systems and to keep Papaya's overall technical direction coherent.

This is a hands-on architecture role at the intersection of engineering, product, security, and DevOps. You'll be expected to dive deep into unfamiliar domains quickly, influence without direct authority, and bring the highest bar of technical thinking — including modern AI-assisted engineering practices — to everything you touch.

If you're energized by hard problems at global scale, by working across many teams rather than one, and by shaping how a modern engineering organization actually builds software in the age of AI, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Lead architectural design across multiple Papaya domains and infrastructure systems, ensuring solutions meet business, scalability, performance, and compliance needs.
Act as a trusted architectural partner to R&D, Product, Security, and DevOps teams — translating business and product requirements into clear technical direction.
Define and maintain high-level architecture across domains, with a focus on seamless integration, maintainability, and long-term evolvability.
Build hands-on Proofs of Concept (POCs) to de-risk architectural decisions, validate new technologies, and demonstrate viable paths forward before broad investment.
Lead technical Due Diligence on third-party vendors, platforms, and integrations — evaluating architecture fit, scalability, security posture, compliance, operational maturity, and long-term cost.
Drive secure-by-design practices, embedding security, privacy, and regulatory considerations into every stage of system design.
Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies, frameworks, and patterns — including AI/LLM-based capabilities — where they create real leverage for the business.
Champion the adoption of AI-powered engineering tools and agentic workflows across R&D, helping teams use them effectively, safely, and consistently.
Define and steward Papaya's architectural guidelines, standards, and best practices, and help ensure they are actually applied in day-to-day delivery.
Provide technical mentorship and architectural guidance to development teams across the company.
Review designs, RFCs, and critical implementations to maintain architectural consistency and system quality across projects.

Requirements:

Experience & background

8+ years of proven experience as a System / Software Architect designing robust, scalable systems.
12+ years of hands-on software development experience, with strong proficiency in Java (preferred) or an equivalent backend language.
Proven experience building enterprise SaaS platforms, self-service products, and highly scaled production systems.
Experience in financial technology (FinTech) or other regulated industries is a strong advantage.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

Technical depth

Deep expertise in cloud-native architecture; strong advantage for AWS (Lambda, ECS, S3, RDS, IAM, etc.).
Hands-on experience with microservices, event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS), and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
Strong command of software design patterns, SDLC, and system integration strategies.
Expertise in design paradigms such as DDD, TDD, EDD, and principles like SOLID, KISS, DRY, SSOT, and CQS.
Solid grasp of security fundamentals: encryption, authentication, authorization, data privacy, and secure coding practices.
Proficiency with SQL and NoSQL databases, and API design using REST and GraphQL.
Practical experience with Git branching strategies, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile development practices.

AI-powered engineering (required)

Deep, hands-on experience with at least one agentic AI coding tool such as Claude Code
, Cursor, GitHub Copilot (Agent Mode), or Codex CLI — used regularly on real, non-trivial work.
Practical fluency with AI productivity tools across the broader workflow: LLM chat assistants for design and review, AI-assisted code review, documentation generation, and research.
Ability to design effective context for AI agents — writing good prompts, structuring repos and docs (e.g. CLAUDE.md / rules files) so agents perform well, and knowing when to delegate vs. when to drive manually.
Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol)
and the broader pattern of connecting AI agents to internal tools, data sources, and services.
Awareness of the security, privacy, IP, and quality risks of AI-assisted development, and opinions on how to mitigate them at an organizational level.

jobs.title: Software Engineer in Digital Automation
jobs.description:
IKEA Group brings together three core businesses: Retail Concept, Range and Supply
. Together we work constantly to improve the IKEA offer and make it more accessible for the many people. IKEA Supply is responsible for securing that the product offer is produced and delivered to our customers. We lead the supply agenda across many functions and work together with all business areas, different business units, but also retail markets to secure customer availability in all markets and sales channels at lowest total cost.

Together we create a workplace where everyone feels free to be themselves, to experiment, try new ways, and dare to ask, “What if…?”. We believe in everyday personal growth and offer the opportunity to develop your career globally. At IKEA we have a vibrant culture where ideas are heard, where there is opportunity to learn new skills and where the goal always is “To create a better everyday life for the many people”. We give down-to-earth, straightforward people the possibility to grow, both as individuals and in their professional roles. We offer this position in a fast-paced, truly global environment with an endless supply of challenges and development opportunities.

Job Description

As a Software Engineer in Digital Automation, you will design, develop, test, deploy and maintain high-quality software that enables automation and supports business outcomes across the IKEA value chain. You will work within an agile, cross-functional team and contribute across the full software lifecycle, from understanding needs and shaping solutions to operating and continuously improving them in production.

You will apply modern software engineering principles and use appropriate tools, automation and delivery practices to create secure, reliable, reusable and maintainable solutions. Within Digital Automation, your work may include workflow and process automation, integrations, APIs, low-code or pro-code extensions, data models, cloud services and AI-enabled capabilities. The exact technology focus will depend on the assigned product, platform or technology domain.

More Specifically, In This Role You Will (be)

Develop and operate software for the assigned Digital Automation product, platform or technology domain, taking shared responsibility for quality throughout its lifecycle.
Deliver tested, deployable and maintainable code that supports agreed business outcomes, architectural principles and security requirements.
Apply and promote modern software engineering practices, including version control, code review, automated testing, continuous integration and continuous delivery.
Work collaboratively in an agile, cross-functional team, contributing to planning, backlog refinement, delivery, maintenance and continuous improvement.
Create and evaluate solution proposals and prototypes, such as mock-ups, data models, integrations or proof-of-concept implementations.
Continuously explore relevant technologies, tools, standards and working methods that can improve innovation, productivity, reliability and user experience.
Produce and maintain appropriate technical documentation and proactively share knowledge, learning and good practices with colleagues.
Contribute to team and product performance indicators and work with colleagues to continuously improve delivery effectiveness and technical quality.

Qualifications

We are on the journey to transform our digital capabilities, bringing core business processes, people, data & technology together - an enabler for IKEA to become an even better home furnishing company in the future. A journey that needs passionate people who embrace change, dare to question and want to make a difference. If that sounds like you, come and join us. Together we can do great things.

Experience & Qualifications

Formal qualifications in computer science, software engineering, or an equivalent engineering discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
Minimum three years of professional experience as a Software Engineer.
Experience designing, implementing, testing, deploying and maintaining software solutions.
Experience working in agile software development teams with a DevOps working setup, self-organisation and delivery against agreed commitments.
Experience working collaboratively in cross-functional and culturally diverse teams.
Experience with digital automation, workflow solutions, integrations, APIs, cloud services, low-code platforms or AI-enabled solutions is an advantage.

Good knowledge of software engineering principles and modern development practices using industry-standard tools.
Good knowledge of design and architecture concepts, and the ability to follow agreed architectural, security and interoperability requirements.
Technical knowledge of relevant technologies, standards, protocols and interfaces, and the ability to apply them effectively.
Clear communication skills, verbally and in writing, with the ability to collaborate and build relationships across organisational levels and backgrounds.
Passion for delivering high-quality software and a great user experience.

A solution-oriented, collaborative mindset, with the confidence to navigate uncertainty, challenge existing approaches and prototype new ideas.

jobs.title: Senior .NET Developer – Stockholm
jobs.description:
Är du en systemutvecklare inom .NET som inte bara skriver kod, utan utvecklar lösningar som fungerar idag såväl som håller och utvecklas över tid? På Solita vill vi också något mer, vi tar initiativ, samarbetar och utforskar för att skapa en AI- och datadriven framtid.

Som Senior .NET Developer blir du del av ett växande område med runt 20 konsulter inom cloud, AI och systemutveckling. Samtidigt får du kollegor från hela Solita med expertis i allt från data, strategi och mycket mer att dela kunskap och perspektiv med, läs mer om det här och ta del av insikter från utvecklare på Solita redan nu i vår Dev blog här.

När vi nu växer gör dina möjligheter också det, du får vara med och påverka kulturen, affären och din roll.

En dag på Solita

En dag på Solita kan börja med ett standup-möte med teamet på kunduppdraget, ibland består det av fler kollegor från Solita. Är det fredag kanske du jobbar från Solita kontoret i Stockholm för att starta dagen med frukost. Andra dagar jobbar du från kundens kontor eller hemifrån.

Sen kliver du in i ditt arbete, när du stöter på ett problem söker du upp en lång diskussionstråd i slack med insikter från kollegor som haft samma problem. Andra gånger passar du på att fråga en kollega vid kaffemaskinen om deras perspektiv för att komma vidare. Du kan också delta i interna utbildningsmöten där vi delar kunskap om allt från nya tekniker och arbetssätt till välmående. Vissa dagar avslutar du med AW, brädspel, filmkväll eller annan aktivitet du och kollegor tycker är kul.

Din roll som Senior .NET Developer

I rollen som Senior .NET Developer utformar och utvecklar du robusta och skalbara lösningar – från idé till produktion – för organisationer inom alla möjliga branscher från sjukvård till e-handel, transport och energi. En kollega beskriver sin roll som en “ Glue Engineer ”; du binder samman olika projekt genom att kombinera kundinteraktion, förundersökningar och kodning. Det roligaste med rollen enligt en annan kollega är “att få kombinera teknik och problemlösning: förstå hur olika delar hänger ihop, bygga något som verkligen används, och se helheten fungera i praktiken.”

Du kan exempelvis vara med och modernisera och migrera en plattform, utveckla nya datadrivna produkter eller optimera systemutvecklingsprocessen med implementationer av AI- eller automationslösningar där de skapar som mest värde.

Känner du igen dig i följande?

Du kan kommunicera på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Det är ett plus om du varit konsult tidigare, det avgörande är din förmåga att snabbt komma in i nya sammanhang och lära dig. Tack vare flera års erfarenhet av att bygga moderna lösningar genom hela utvecklingscykeln, främst i C# .NET, känner du dig trygg i rollen då du fått med dig:

Vana att jobba med distribuerade system och eventdriven, skalbar arkitektur. Gärna med tekniker som Kafka, RabbitMQ eller Azure Service Bus.
God förståelse för Dev(Sec)Ops-principer, CI/CD och orkestrering.
Erfarenhet av molnplattformar som Azure, AWS eller GCP. Har du jobbat med containerization (Kubernetes, Docker) eller Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Pulumi, Bicep) är det en extra tillgång.
Nyfikenhet på AI i utvecklingsarbetet: hur verktyg som GitHub Copilot, OpenAI API:er eller ML-integrerade pipelines kan göra kodningen smartare och effektivare.

Vi letar inte bara efter tekniska skills, vi vill jobba med dig som tar ansvar för att bygga rätt lösningar på rätt sätt genom att utmana med omtanke. Du ser kod som ett hantverk, inte bara ett medel till funktion: du bryr dig om kvalitet, läsbarhet och hållbarhet. Du kommer trivas hos oss om du tycker om att dela med dig av din kunskap lika mycket som du är nyfiken på- och lyfter andras.

Vad vi erbjuder

Vår företagskultur är väldigt viktig för oss. Vi värdesätter låg hierarki, självständighet och ansvar, värdeskapande arbete och trevliga kollegor. Här kan du läsa mer om vår kultur, och här kan du bläddra bland våra tech-bloggar.
Meningsfulla projekt: Arbeta i en agil miljö där du kan påverka teknikval och arbetssätt för att skapa de bästa lösningarna
Flexibilitet och autonomi för att utforma ditt arbete med flextider– läs mer från vår blogg här.
Ständig utveckling: Vi erbjuder kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling för att säkerställa att våra medarbetare ligger längst fram i teknikutvecklingen.
Innovativ kultur: Arbeta tillsammans med några av de främsta experterna inom data, analys och utveckling – läs mer i bloggen här.

Utöver detta får du även ta del av följande förmåner:

💰 Fast lön oberoende av beläggningsgrad med möjlighet till löneväxling till ditt pensionssparande
🏦 Pensionsavsättning i linje med ITP1 samt möjlighet till löneväxling till ditt pensionssparande vid inkomst över 8,07 inkomstbasbelopp
🏖️ 30 semesterdagar
🏥 Sjukvårdsförsäkring för både din mentala och fysiska hälsa som täcker dig även utanför tjänstetid
🏋️ ♀️ Friskvårdsbidrag på 5000 kr via Benifex (tidigare Benify)
🔗 Intern coach för att stödja ditt välbefinnande
🪩 After Work och hobbyaktiviteter
🥐 Fredagsfrukost

Vilka är vi?

Solita är ett värderingsstyrt konsultbolag med över 2200 medarbetare i 9 länder, varav ca 230 i Sverige. Vår storlek gör oss tillräckligt stora för att vara en stabil och innovativ arbetsgivare, men samtidigt tillräckligt små för att värna om våra medarbetare och kunder. Med bred kompetens inom digital transformation erbjuder vi en dynamisk arbetsmiljö. Hos oss får du friheten att utvecklas, både professionellt och personligt.

Intresserad av att höra mer?

Låter det som en intressant möjlighet? Skicka in din ansökan och bli en del av vårt team som ligger i framkant inom systemutveckling!

Om du har några frågor, skriv gärna till Jacob Beck på Linkedin alternativt kontakta via mail på Jacob.Beck@solita.fi.

Hur ser processen ut?

I rekryteringsprocessen tror vi på en snabb och effektiv process. Du ansöker med CV eller LinkedIn och svarar på några korta frågor. Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande. Om vi ser en potentiell matchning, bjuder vi in dig till ett första möte för att lära känna dig och berätta mer om vår kultur och våra värderingar på Solita. I andra intervjun fokuserar vi på din tekniska kompetens och din erfarenhet. Om allt går bra tar vi oss vidare till sista steget där vi presenterar ett erbjudande och välkomnar dig som ny Solitan!

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)

Join our team at our location in Stockholm or Tallinn – hybrid working conditions available.

Our solutions contribute to flexible and customer-friendly payment alternatives. We offer consumers the opportunity to choose when and how they want to pay, whilst guaranteeing a steady and predictable cashflow for merchants. Our products make us proud, but not content and we have high ambitions for our existing as well as upcoming products. We have a strong commitment to building the future of FinTech — human-centric and sustainable. With investments to back it up. You will be part of a new and quickly growing product & tech organisation, having the opportunity to shape our new teams as well as build the next revolutionary products.

You will join one of our product teams and on a daily basis:

Design, develop, test, and ship robust, maintainable, and readable software, applications, APIs, and other workflows
Initiate, participate in, and communicate technical architecture designs
Attend regular scrum ceremonies as a member of an agile cross-functional team
Analyze, discuss, and implement business requirements while maintaining good documentation of the systems and components you create
Bring in industry standards and best practices to continually improve our codebase and architecture
Make a positive impact on our engineering culture by adopting, implementing, and providing feedback on both organisational and industry standards and practices

Qualifications

What you bring:

Hands-on experience with C# and the .NET framework, with a minimum of 5 years of experience
Experience in developing, shipping, and maintaining cloud-based applications
Good knowledge and experience working with microservices and distributed architectures
A deep understanding and knowledge of RESTful APIs
Years of experience using relational databases, preferably SQL Server. Additionally, working knowledge of ORMs, preferably Entity Framework
Familiarity with cloud development; experience with Azure is a bonus
Practical knowledge of using messaging platforms in a distributed architecture (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka)
Knowledge and experience on a FinTech and banking industry is a plus
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot, and sound judgement about reviewing and testing what they produce, is a plus
Fluent English

Please note:
you need to have EU citizenship or a valid work permit for Germany.

About The Technologies We Use

Our teams have autonomy when it comes to tech choices. The example below will give you some insights, and we are looking forward to discussing this further with you.

All solutions developed cloud-native targeting Azure - Infrastructure defined using Terraform - Services deployed to Kubernetes clusters by default - A growing microservice ecosystem with event-based integration - Using latest .NET Core - RESTful API design - Single-page frontend apps served by CDN - Frontend tech using TypeScript, often Angular or standard Web Components (Stencil) - Automated tests in each layer.

Additional Information

Disclosure requirements pertaining to the collection of your personal data:

Responsible for processing the information provided in your application is the company specified in the job advertisement, with its registered office as indicated. The company processes your data for the purpose of establishing an employment relationship on the basis of Art. 6 (1) b GDPR / Section 26 (1) sentence 1 BDSG.

The retention period for your data is determined by the statutory time limits applicable in the respective country, beginning upon completion of the recruitment process. You can find these here.

You can contact the company’s Data Protection Officer at the above-mentioned postal address.

Further information on data protection and your rights can be found here.

Vi söker en erfaren Senior .NET-utvecklare med fullstackprofil som vill arbeta med utveckling av moderna och robusta system i tekniskt utmanande miljöer.

I rollen kommer du att ha .NET som din huvudsakliga kompetens och arbeta med både backend- och frontendutveckling. Du blir en viktig del av utvecklingsarbetet och kommer att vara involverad i allt från teknisk analys och design till implementation, testning och vidareutveckling.

Vi söker dig som har ett starkt tekniskt intresse och som trivs med att ta ansvar för hela utvecklingsprocessen. Du har förmågan att förstå komplexa tekniska problem, se helheten och samtidigt arbeta på detaljnivå när det krävs.

Vi har pågående projekt inom bland annat statliga myndigheter där du får möjlighet att arbeta med lösningar som stödjer viktiga verksamhetsprocesser och möter höga krav på kvalitet och stabilitet. I rollen kommer du bland annat att analysera behov och tekniska frågeställningar, utveckla och vidareutveckla funktionalitet samt arbeta med både backend- och frontendlösningar. Du kommer även att bidra i testning, felsökning och vidareutveckling av befintliga system.

Erfarenhet

Minst 7 års erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling, med .NET som huvudsaklig teknisk kompetens.
Erfarenhet av fullstackutveckling med både backend och frontend.
Minst 2 års erfarenhet av React.
Praktisk erfarenhet av cloudmiljöer, exempelvis AWS, Azure eller GCP.
Erfarenhet av Kubernetes och/eller OpenShift.
Erfarenhet av Docker och containerbaserade lösningar.
Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska i tal och skrift.

Erfarenhet av Apache Kafka och eventdriven arkitektur.

Här tror vi på frihet, möjligheter och medbestämmande. Att du som medarbetare ska ha möjlighet att utvecklas och forma ditt arbete utefter dina intressen och prioriteringar i livet. jobs.description:
Vill du bygga och vidareutveckla system som används för lån, sparande och kreditkort – i ett team som tar fullt ansvar från behov till drift? På Norion Bank söker vi nu en utvecklare som vill kombinera stark teknisk problemlösning med nära samarbete i team.

OM ROLLEN

I vårt team utvecklar vi bankens plattform, web och app för konsumentprodukter. Vi jobbar nära våra användare och produktchefer för att förstå deras och kundens behov.

Vår plattform bygger på modern teknik. Vi håller fokus på kvalitet och resiliens även när vi håller ett högt tempo.

Som devops-team tar vi ett helhetsansvar för utveckling, test, deployment, drift och support för vårt/våra system. Cybersäkerhet och sekretess är en naturlig del av vår vardag och genomsyrar såväl arbetssätt som designval. Alla ges utrymme (och förväntas) bidra med design- och arkitekturbeslut.

På Norion Bank har vi en cloud first-strategi vilket betyder att alla tjänster utvecklas mot och driftas i Azure.

OM DIG

Vi söker dig som har några års arbetslivserfarenhet inom utveckling i .NET. Du ser testbarhet, automatisering och observability som en naturlig del av utvecklingsarbetet. Som person är du nyfiken, lyhörd och kvalitetsmedveten.

Du har erfarenhet av drift i Azure och gärna även av att sätta upp infrastruktur med kod, gärna Bicep. Det är självklart för dig att skriva tester.

Vi tror att du som söker har erfarenhet och intresse för några av dessa områden:

.NET 10/C#
Blazor
Azure
SQL

Ett extra plus om du är intresserad av Domain Driven Design, CQRS och eventsourcing!

På Norion Bank vill vi bygga team där lösningar, utmaningar och hinder diskuteras öppet och hanteras tillsammans. Det ställer krav på att du är en person som engagerar dig, delar med dig av dina perspektiv och tar ansvar för helheten – inte bara din egen kod eller dina egna uppgifter. Hos oss behöver du kunna be om hjälp när det behövs, bidra till att stötta andra och våga ifrågasätta, utmana och driva tekniska resonemang framåt.

Koncernspråket är svenska och all dokumentation sker på svenska.

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med en provanställning i början, med start enligt överenskommelse.

På Norion Bank arbetar vi enligt en hybrid-setup med både kontorsarbete och distansarbete. Kontorsarbetet sker på vårt huvudkontor vid Lilla Bommen i Göteborg. Där sitter våra team tillsammans vilket främjar både kommunikation och samarbete.

Norion Bank Group är en affärsnära nordisk finansieringsbank. Genom koncernens varumärken Norion Bank, Walley och Collector erbjuds kundanpassade finansieringstjänster som möter distinkta kundbehov inom tre kundsegment: medelstora företag och fastighetsbolag, handlare och privatpersoner. Som specialist på finansieringslösningar är Norion Bank Group ett ledande komplement till traditionella storbanker, med visionen att vara den främsta nordiska finansieringsbanken inom de utvalda segmenten.  

Norion Banks erbjudande omfattar företags- och fastighetskrediter samt factoring för medelstora företag och fastighetsbolag. Genom varumärket Walley erbjuds flexibla betal- och checkoutlösningar till handlare och privatpersoner. Varumärket Collector tillhandahåller privatlån och kreditkort till privatpersoner samt sparkonton för privatpersoner och företag. Norion Bank Group (tidigare Collector Bank) grundades 1999 och har kontor i Göteborg, Stockholm, Helsingborg, Oslo och Helsingfors. Verksamheten bedrivs genom Norion Bank AB (publ) som är noterat på Nasdaq Stockholm.  

NORION BANKS ERBJUDANDE TILL DIG

För oss är det självklart att varje individs utveckling värdesätts högt vilket innebär ett stort fokus på självledarskap och kompetensutveckling. Gemenskap, innovation och modern arbetsmetodik är saker som kännetecknar Norion Bank Group. Vi erbjuder dig helt enkelt en organisation med snabba beslutsvägar, stor öppenhet och mycket energi.

Vi erbjuder dig ett spännande bolag med goda utvecklingsmöjligheter, löpande kompetensutveckling och gemensamma aktiviteter på och utanför arbetsplatsen.

jobs.title: Software Engineer | Product Management | Range Core
jobs.description:
Hej Software Engineer,

Do you want to furnish the future with innovative solutions?
With us, you can feel at home in your work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, discover new tech possibilities, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our Software Engineer, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before.

Our team is based in Malmö. We believe that your presence with the team and working the majority of the time in the workplace is important.

Your new job

We are hiring for two positions within this role. We’re looking for Software Engineers who wants to solve complex, real-world problems to make life at home simpler. Join us on our journey as we level up our technology to enhance everyday experiences. Your primary focus will be software development within the Product Management domain, contributing across several product components. You will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and maintaining solutions. Your expertise will be essential in driving the success of our projects and ensuring optimal performance.

The Product Management team manages the total offer by establishing and lifecycle-managing products and services in the range, ensuring product information can be managed or automatically derived from detailed engineering and manufacturing data. You will report to a Software Engineering Manager. The impact of your work will touch homes and hearts around the world. On a typical day, you will:
Develop, maintain and operate software code within the assigned technology domain, platform or product
Apply and promote good software engineering practices such as CI/CD within an agile and iterative development approach
Deliver tested, maintainable and well-documented code in line with agreed architectural principles and security requirements
Work closely with team members to ensure quality, reuse and learning across the product area

What we’d like you to bring to the table

The role as a Software Engineer requires you to:
Have good knowledge of software engineering principles and practices
Have solid experience in both frontend and backend development
While technologies and tools may vary between teams, you should feel comfortable working with programming languages such as React/NextJS, Typescript, C#, .net, Node.js
Have a solid understanding of API design and integration (REST/GraphQL)
Have some knowledge of databases (SQL &/or NoSQL &/or PostgreSQL)
Be familiar with version control (Git)
Have experience working in agile or iterative development teams, ideally with a DevOps setup
Have experience developing, testing and maintaining software in one or more relevant technology stacks
Be able to collaborate effectively with other engineers and cross-functional roles
Take responsibility for code quality, including automated testing, documentation and continuous improvement
Contribute to a product mindset by understanding user needs and business outcomes, and adapting how you develop software accordingly

It's a plus if you also:
Have experience working across multiple components or products within a digital product area
Support the ongoing shift towards treating data and software as products, by being open to new ways of working and value-based thinking
Experience in generative & agentic AI with principles surrounding, agent orchestration & systems thinking, context & memory management, evaluation & verification literacy, AI governance & security.
Experience in Microsoft Azure services, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as Code, Containerization & Orchestration, version control, scripting & automation.
Experience developing PIM solutions/applications with skills around Data modelling & governance, data migration & synchronization, workflow automation.

Be yourself, a Software Engineer, and more!

Inter IKEA Group is the group of companies that connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and aligns the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone. With us, you contribute to building a democratic brand and workplace that has a positive impact on both the planet and people's lives.

This position is based in a part of IKEA that we call 'Range Core'. We support key flows in managing the range offer as well as the capabilities needed to create physical products and their core information. Our mission is to simplify and enable product and information creation and maintenance through software.

Your health, wellbeing, and development matter most to us, and our benefits are designed with you in mind. As a co-worker and a person, you are an essential part of our down to earth, playful, and inclusive culture, collaborating with others across roles, departments, and even across the globe. In this curious and optimistic environment, you’ll find endless opportunities to grow. Make us the home of your career.

We welcome your application

Get ready to assemble something new! We look forward to receiving your application by 4th of October at the latest. If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, feel free to contact the Recruiter Vera Bendz, vera.bendz1@inter.ikea.com or Hiring Manager Joseph Jeffrey joseph.jeffrey1@inter.ikea.com.

Please note that applications sent by email will not be processed.

At IKEA, we are looking for people who believe everyone deserves a seat at the table. You’re welcome no matter where you come from, what you believe, and what you look like. We don’t even care how you have furnished your home. We’re interested in you simply because you’re you. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. We believe that people’s different perspectives, backgrounds, and personalities make us better at understanding our customers dreams and needs.

If you have a special need that requires accommodation in the recruitment process, just let us know.

We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. We will first consider co-workers employed at Inter IKEA Group impacted by organisational changes. For this specific recruitment priority will be given to impacted co-workers in Core Business Range and Inter IKEA Technology Services AB provided competence requirements are met for the role.

jobs.title: Azure AI Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
Att välja Capgemini innebär att välja en arbetsplats där du ges möjlighet att forma din karriär på det sätt du själv önskar, där du ingår i en stödjande och inspirerande gemenskap med engagerade kollegor världen över, och där du får chansen att omdefiniera vad som är möjligt. Våra Cloud & Custom applications-team fokuserar på att utveckla skräddarsydda cloudapplikationer, integrera IT-system och driva affärstransformation, med leverans av affärskritiska cloudlösningar i hög kvalitet och hastighet, möjliggjort genom Generative AI. Bli en del av oss och hjälp världsledande organisationer att frigöra teknikens värde och bygga en mer hållbar och inkluderande framtid!

Om rollen

Vill du arbeta hands-on med att utveckla och implementera AI-drivna lösningar i moderna molnarkitekturer? I ett av våra team på Malmökontoret leder Patrik ett engagerat, kompetent och prestigelöst team med stark sammanhållning. Teamet har ett tydligt fokus på Microsoft Azure och arbetar kontinuerligt med kompetensutveckling inom cloud, data och AI. Målet är tydligt: att vara en helhetsleverantör inom Microsoft Azure, end to end. Hos oss tror vi att verkligt värde skapas när du behärskar båda sidor av AI: att både bygga med AI och att bygga AI-lösningar som skapar affärsvärde för kunder.

Som Azure‑specialist på Capgemini blir du en del av ett högpresterande, agilt utvecklingsteam som bygger affärskritiska lösningar för våra kunder. Vi arbetar med breda, moderna och framtidssäkra tekniska lösningar, framför allt baserade på Microsofts ekosystem. Vi designar och bygger AI-enabled applikationer och skalbara cloudlösningar för internationella organisationer i framkant, inklusive integration av generativa AI‑tjänster, dataflöden och API:er i moderna cloudlösningar. AI är inte ett stöd, det är en central del av lösningarna vi bygger.

Du arbetar med internationella kunder i framkant och bidrar i transformationsprojekt som skapar verkligt affärsvärde. Samtidigt blir du en del av ett stöttande team där samarbete, lärande och innovation står i centrum, och där vi har roligt tillsammans längs vägen.

Under det senaste året har teamet intensifierat sin satsning på Azure AI, Generative AI och agentbaserade lösningar. Genom strukturerade kompetensinitiativ, XProjects och praktiska AI-use cases bygger vi nu vidare på vår Azure-expertis för att kunna leverera moderna, säkra och AI-drivna lösningar till våra kunder.

I den här rollen spelar du en nyckelroll i:

Designa, bygga och vidareutveckla skalbara, säkra och AI‑drivna lösningar i Microsoft Azure
Samarbeta tätt med utvecklare, arkitekter och andra specialister i tvärfunktionella och agila team
Arbeta med AI i två dimensioner: både som ett verktyg för att effektivisera utveckling (t.ex. generera, granska och förbättra kod) och som en kärnkomponent i de lösningar du bygger
Utveckla intelligenta lösningar såsom copilots, AI workflows och datadrivna applikationer som skapar mätbart affärsvärde
Arbeta aktivt med AI‑stöd i utvecklingsprocessen, exempelvis för att generera, granska, förklara eller förbättra kod samt för test och felsökning
Använda din Azure‑expertis för att driva förbättringar, dela kunskap och bidra till innovation och ständig utveckling

Vi arbetar enligt en hybrid arbetsmodell, där du varierar mellan arbete hos kund, på vårt kontor och hemifrån med flexibilitet utifrån uppdrag.

Din profil

Minst 4 års erfarenhet av arbete med Microsoft Azure
Stark bakgrund inom .NET, cloud development och DevOps
Erfarenhet av att både använda AI i utvecklingsprocesser och bygga AI-drivna lösningar
Förståelse för hur AI används i skalbara system och skapar affärsvärde
Erfarenhet inom ett eller flera Azure‑områden, till exempel Azure Integration, Azure Native Development, Cloud Adoption & Governance, App Modernization eller Azure Big Data, AI & ML
Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska

Vad vi tror kommer få dig att trivas

Möjlighet att bygga AI-drivna lösningar på riktigt, inte bara använda AI som verktyg
En roll där du utvecklar båda sidor av din kompetens: att arbeta effektivt med AI och att skapa AI-lösningar som gör skillnad
En modern tech-miljö där AI, cloud och data möts
En kultur som uppmuntrar lärande, innovation och kunskapsdelning, med tydliga möjligheter till certifieringar, kompetensutveckling och mentorskap
Flexibelt arbete som stödjer balans i livet, i kombination med kontinuerligt lärande och utveckling
Möjlighet att arbeta med teknik i framkant och påverka, i samarbete med andra specialister och några av världens ledande organisationer
En inkluderande kultur med stark gemenskap och attraktiva förmåner

Join our Team

About this opportunity:

Join our Business Area IPR & Licensing Patent Operations team as an AI and Automation Software Developer. You will help create secure, practical digital solutions that improve how patent professionals work with information and manage daily processes.

You will contribute across the full software development lifecycle, from understanding user needs and developing applications to deployment, maintenance and continuous improvement. Your work may support processes such as patent document analysis, claim comparison, invention evaluation and office-action preparation.

The role is based in Stockholm, with other possible locations in Madrid, Montreal or Aachen.

What you will do:

Design, develop and deploy AI-enabled applications and automation solutions for patent-related processes.
Build web applications, backend services, APIs, integrations and automated workflows using modern technologies such as Python.
Use generative AI and information-retrieval techniques to identify, process and present information from patent databases and other enterprise sources.
Develop AI-based assistants and automated solutions that support workflows from start to finish.
Integrate language models, enterprise data and machine learning capabilities into user-focused applications.
Work with patent professionals and other stakeholders to understand needs and turn them into effective technical solutions.
Write clear, maintainable and well-documented code.
Ensure that applications are reliable, responsive, maintainable and secure.
Apply appropriate controls for authentication, access management, secure data handling, secrets protection, audit records and enterprise-system integration.
Maintain, troubleshoot and improve existing applications based on user feedback and changing business needs.
Keep up to date with relevant developments in artificial intelligence, software engineering and patent technology.

The skills you bring:

Three to five years of practical experience developing software, AI-enabled applications, automation solutions or enterprise web applications.
A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering or a related field.
Strong Python and backend development skills, including APIs, databases and system integration.
Experience developing web applications; full-stack experience is an advantage.
Knowledge of web technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript and a modern frontend framework such as React, Vue or Angular.
Practical experience with generative AI, language models, retrieval-augmented generation or similar information-retrieval approaches.
Experience with SQL or NoSQL databases, REST APIs and software integration.
Familiarity with AI and machine learning tools such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, TensorFlow, PyTorch or similar.
Experience using Git and collaborative software development practices.
Understanding of software development processes, agile ways of working and secure application design.
Strong problem-solving and communication skills, including the ability to explain technical topics clearly to non-technical audiences.

Experience with vector databases, semantic search, prompt design, cloud platforms, containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD or knowledge-intensive domains such as patent technology is an advantage.

jobs.title: Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Vi tror på ett samhälle format av framgångsrika företag där entreprenörskap och samhällsnytta går hand i hand. Att vara en del av Fortnox är att vara en del av en ständig förändring - en förändring där du själv bestämmer hur långt du vill nå. Vårt största fokus är att ge dig rätt förutsättningar att få leva din passion tillsammans med oss. Var du kommer ifrån är inte relevant - det är vart du är på väg som är intressant för oss. Precis som vi igår inte kunde drömma om det Fortnox som finns idag, så kan du vara med och forma vilka vi är imorgon.

Om tjänsten

Nu söker vi en Test Engineer till Fortnox och produktområdet Styrning & Kontroll. I denna roll spelar du en central roll i att säkerställa kvaliteten på våra produkter genom att verifiera krav och testa funktionalitet. Du blir en del av ett team som driver utvecklingen av både kommunikation- samt ärendehanteringssystem. Här får du chansen att påverka, experimentera och vara med och skapa det som kommer att definiera morgondagens redovisning.

Som Test Engineer kommer du att vara involverad i analysarbete, felsökning och releasehantering samt hantera beroenden mot både interna och externa tjänster. Du ansvarar för att skapa rätt förutsättningar och metoder för att kvalitetssäkra produkten i ett så tidigt skede som möjligt. Du är med genom hela processen – från att diskutera krav och ta fram lösningsförslag till att deploya nya versioner av våra tjänster i olika miljöer. Genom ditt arbete säkerställer du den bästa möjliga upplevelsen för våra användare och har en direkt inverkan på tusentals företags dagliga verksamhet.

Om dig

För att trivas i rollen ser vi att du är lösningsorienterad och trivs i en dynamisk och föränderlig miljö. Du uppskattar teambaserat arbete, har en analytisk förmåga och tänker gärna i nya banor. Du är strukturerad och noggrann, samt kommunikativ och bekväm med att diskutera krav med utvecklare och övriga stakeholders i organisationen. Vi tror även att du:

Har några års erfarenhet av professionellt testarbete eller motsvarande erfarenhet från en liknande roll.
Har koll på testning av REST APIer (t.ex. med Postman, RestAssured, eller liknande verktyg).
Har jobbat med automatiserad testning med verktyg som Selenium, Cypress, Playwright eller motsvarande.
Har erfarenhet av scriptning (exempelvis med Python, JavaScript, Bash eller PowerShell).
Har jobbat med prestanda- och belastningstestning (exempelvis JMeter, k6, Locust).
Är flytande i svenska och engelska i såväl tal som skrift.

Fortnox - mitt i företagslivet

Fortnox hjälper företag att starta, växa och utvecklas. Med smarta tekniska lösningar för företag och redovisningsbyråer, smidig finansiering och ett ekosystem av starka partnerskap är Fortnox ett nav för företagande i Sverige. Vi drivs av visionen om ett välmående samhälle format av framgångsrika företag.

Fortnox grundades 2001 med huvudkontor i Växjö. Läs mer på www.fortnoxgroup.com.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Behandling av personuppgifter

Vi på Fortnox värnar om din personliga integritet. När du skickar in din ansökan till oss kommer vi att behandla dina personuppgifter för att administrera rekryteringsprocessen. Personuppgiftsansvarig är det bolag som du söker arbete hos och är något bolag inom Fortnoxkoncernen. Du kan läsa integritetsmeddelandet i sin helhet på följande länk:

What if developers could get the security guarantees of PKI without ever having to think about certificates? As a Software Engineer on the Identity PKI team, you will help make that vision a reality. Vi tror på, at holdbare tekniske løsninger skabes gennem godt håndværk, samarbejde og velovervejede skridt fremad. Derfor arbejder vi langsigtet og med fokus på kvalitet frem for hurtige genveje.

Om dig

Du har solid erfaring som senior .NET-udvikler og har arbejdet indgående med Umbraco. Du kender platformens styrker og muligheder, men også dens begrænsninger, og du trives med at finde løsninger, der skaber værdi både teknisk og forretningsmæssigt.

Du interesserer dig for arkitektur og systemdesign og har erfaring med komplekse løsninger. Samtidig ved du, at god arkitektur ikke handler om at følge de nyeste trends, men om at skabe den rette løsning til den virkelighed, den skal fungere i.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

Har flere års erfaring med .NET og gerne Umbraco
Har arbejdet med arkitektur, integrationer og skalerbare løsninger
Har erfaring med at sætte teknisk retning, formelt eller uformelt
Motiveres af at sparre med og udvikle andre mennesker
Tager ansvar, når udfordringer opstår, og deler succesen, når målene nås
Kan kommunikere komplekse tekniske valg til både udviklere, projektledere og forretningsinteressenter
Arbejder struktureret og kommunikerer klart, både mundtligt og skriftligt
Ser AI-værktøjer som en naturlig del af moderne softwareudvikling og er nysgerrig på, hvordan de kan skabe reel værdi i hverdagen

Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er mindre vigtig for os. Måske er du datalog, måske har du fundet en anden vej ind i faget. Det vigtigste er din faglighed, din nysgerrighed og din evne til at omsætte idéer til løsninger sammen med andre. Vi forventer ikke, at du har alle svar fra første dag, men vi håber, at du har lyst til at udforske dem sammen med os.

Om Søstrene Grenes Ånd

Hos Søstrene Grene stræber vi efter at røre folks hjerter gennem et unikt univers, der omfavner mangfoldighed og inklusion og skaber et imødekommende fællesskab for alle uanset køn, etnicitet, religion, handicap eller baggrund.

Vi har en arbejdsplads, hvor alle bliver kaldt "Søster" uanset køn. Vi deler glæder, gør hinanden stærkere og griner sammen. Dét kalder vi Søsterånd, og vi opfordrer på det varmeste alle til at søge og være med til at skabe en levende og rummelig arbejdsplads.

Der er mange gode grunde til at vælge Søstrene Grene

Hos os får du en attraktiv pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring og vi prioriterer det, der gør en forskel i hverdagen og skaber trivsel.

En vigtig del af den trivsel handler om fællesskab. Vi værner om det kollegiale sammenhold, som dyrkes både i de enkelte teams og på tværs af landegrænser og funktioner. Derudover har vi en aktiv personaleforening, som arrangerer alt fra fredagsbar og foredrag til sportsaktiviteter.

I vores nye, lyse lokaler midt i Aarhus kan du glæde dig til friskbrygget kaffe fra espressomaskinen og en af Danmarks bedste frokostordninger. Og fordi balance er vigtig, tilbyder vi fleksible rammer og mulighed for hjemmearbejde, så arbejde og privatliv kan gå op i en højere enhed.

Praktiske oplysninger

Arbejdssted: Åboulevarden 21, 8000 Aarhus C

Arbejdstid: 37 timer om ugen

Start: Hurtigst muligt

Job Description

Do you thrive in designing and developing software solutions for modular robotics platforms? Are you motivated by taking responsibility for the entire software development process and ensuring compliance with quality and architectural standards?

If so, we might have the right job for you!

As a Software Engineer within vision and robotics, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining software solutions while ensuring compliance with quality and architectural standards. Moreover, you will contribute to the successful implementation of solutions by conducting training sessions for internal stakeholders and end users. You will support projects, collaborate closely with the Technical Product Owner (TPO), and ensure valuable feedback from projects and site integration is used for adjustments and further development.

Responsibility for Vision and Robotics

Responsibilities

We are a global organization, but you will be working from our office in Aarhus and be part of a small team of highly skilled colleagues in logistics. You will join the Robot Product Team, which covers multiple disciplines – Electrical, Mechanical, Automation – with you as the software responsible. You will work in close collaboration with the TPO, who acts as Product Owner, and you will have sparring opportunities with software colleagues across the organization to support knowledge sharing and development. Here, your responsibilities will be:

Improving new software products related to vision and robotic applications and supporting their use in projects.
Maintaining and developing software applications according to our operating model and applicable standards.
Ensuring code quality through reviews, documentation, and adherence to coding and architectural guidelines.
Offering input to automation strategy and technical requirements and setting product requirements in collaboration with the business.
Testing and validating functionalities on our local test loop or on sites.
Collaborating with interdisciplinary teams on a common system and evaluating and selecting appropriate technologies for automation and system integration.

Experienced Software Developer

You are familiar with commonly used tools, frameworks, and libraries relevant to 3D vision, point cloud processing, and AI development, and can evaluate and apply them effectively based on product needs. Additionally, we imagine that:

You hold a bachelor's or master's degree, or an equivalent qualification in computer science, engineering, or a related field.
You have solid proficiency developing real-time applications in C# and Python.
You possess solid expertise in classical computer vision and 3D geometry, with a strong focus on point cloud processing and object recognition.
Experience or interest in machine learning and signal processing is highly relevant, as these fields play an increasing role in advancing vision and robotics applications.
You have experience in developing and maintaining various software architectures such as Docker and Kubernetes.
You possess strong knowledge of software design principles, design patterns, and effort estimation for development tasks, and have hands-on experience with version control systems (e.g., Git), as well as software prototyping and conceptualization.
You bring a solid understanding of high-level integration with robotic systems and can design and implement interfaces that enable effective communication between software components and robotic controls.
You can combine input from multiple sensors into valuable insights. This could be cameras, LiDAR's, encoders, safety sensors etc.

Moreover, you demonstrate innovative thinking, analytical skills, and a strong problem-solving mindset. You bring excellent communication skills, team spirit, and a high willingness to learn. You enjoy working collaboratively across disciplines in a diverse and inclusive environment.

Interested?

If you find the description interesting, please do not hesitate to contact Henning Horn Lauritsen +45 8741 4674 with any question you might have or apply via the link.

We look very much forward to hearing from you!

Conveying, loading, palletizing, packing, sortation, and distribution – BEUMER Group is a leader within the development and manufacture of high-technological intralogistics systems for global markets. Our employees stand out from others thanks to their ability to supply innovative solutions to our customers. They can do this because they know the industry and are passionate about continuously developing and expanding their knowledge. We support these high standards through teamwork, mutual respect and a working culture based on trust that fosters stability and security for all our employees. jobs.title: Student Software Engineer
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Are you studying computer science, software engineering, AI, or a related subject- and looking for more than an ordinary student job? Do you enjoy understanding complicated problems, building software that real people use, and exploring how AI and agents are changing the way software is developed?

We are looking for a Student Software Engineer to join the engineering team behind Omnidocs Create, its integrations, and related engineering projects.

You will work as part of our engineering team on real product challenges across frontend and backend development. You will also help us develop how we use AI and agentic engineering workflows to understand systems, investigate problems, plan solutions, implement changes, and verify results.

You do not need professional experience with our technology stack. We care more about how you think, how quickly you learn, and how you approach problems when the answer is not immediately obvious.

The basics

• 12–15 hours per week during the semester.
• Flexible scheduling around classes and exams.
• Possibility of additional hours during quieter study periods and holidays.
• Competitive salary.
• Opportunities to grow into greater technical ownership and responsibility.

What you will work on

• Contribute to established production codebases and new engineering projects.
• Build and improve functionality across our products and integrations, primarily using .NET, C#, and Blazor.
• Connect frontend experiences to backend APIs and services.
• Work on integrations and related engineering projects, sometimes involving unfamiliar systems or technologies.
• Help turn complex business rules and document workflows into understandable product experiences.
• Investigate defects, improve tests, and strengthen code quality.
• Work with product, design, and engineering colleagues to understand problems and shape solutions.
• Participate in code reviews, planning, technical discussions, and product demonstrations.
• Use AI tools and agents to explore code, plan, prototype, implement, test, and document.
• Critically evaluate and verify AI-generated work rather than accepting it at face value.

As you grow, you may take ownership of features and engineering projects from problem definition through delivery.

Who we are looking for

• Are pursuing a relevant degree at ITU, DTU, DIKU, or another comparable institution.
• Have a foundation in programming from your studies, personal projects, employment, or open-source work.
• Enjoy breaking complicated or ambiguous problems into understandable steps.
• Take initiative when you encounter something unfamiliar.
• Can explain your thinking, including uncertainty, mistakes, and trade-offs.
• Are interested in AI-assisted and agentic ways of working.
• Want to learn through feedback, collaboration, and practical responsibility.
• Can communicate effectively in English.
• Are able to work regularly from our Copenhagen office.

You do not need previous professional experience with Blazor or .NET. Experience with another programming language or web framework can provide an equally good foundation.

Helpful, but not required

Experience or experimentation with any of the following is a plus:
• C#, .NET, Blazor, React, TypeScript, Java, Python, or similar technologies.
• Web applications, APIs, databases, automated testing, or Git.
• UX, accessibility, responsive design, or component libraries.
• Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or other AI development tools.
• AI agents, MCP, automation, or AI-assisted prototyping.
• University, personal, hackathon, or open-source software projects.

We do not expect you to arrive as an expert. We expect you to be interested enough to investigate, experiment, and learn.

The company

For over 20 years, Omnidocs has been redefining productivity in document generation. Born as a consultancy and developed into a SaaS business, we help organizations create better documents and presentations through software, automation, and design.
Today, the Omnidocs Group has almost 200 professionals across several international offices. You will join a collaborative environment where you can work closely with experienced engineers, product colleagues, and designers while developing your own technical skills and responsibilities.

What we offer

• Meaningful responsibility in live production software.
• A dedicated engineering mentor and regular feedback.
• Close collaboration with experienced engineers, product colleagues, and designers.
• Flexibility around classes, exams, and university projects.
• Opportunities to explore and develop modern AI and agentic engineering workflows.
• The possibility of connecting university projects or a thesis to relevant engineering challenges.
• Career development opportunities and the possibility of continuing with Omnidocs after graduation when there is a mutual fit and an available position.
• An informal workplace in the heart of Christianshavn.
• Lunch scheme, social activities, sports activities, and other employee benefits.

How to apply

Please apply through our recruitment system and upload your CV. Links to GitHub, a portfolio, or projects are welcome but optional.
As part of the application, we will ask you a few short questions about your education, something you have built, how you approach unfamiliar problems, your experience with AI-assisted development, and a situation where you took ownership.
You are welcome to use AI tools when preparing your application. We are more interested in authentic examples and personal reflection than perfectly polished answers.
Please use the dedicated application link rather than sending your application by email.
Omnidocs encourages applicants of all backgrounds to apply. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team.

Processing of personal data

By registering in our HR system, BambooHR, and uploading your application and CV, you accept that Omnidocs stores the registered data and information included in the uploaded documents. All information is used solely for recruitment purposes and will be deleted within 12 months of upload.

Please do not include sensitive personal data in your application or CV, such as CPR number or information about race, religion, trade union membership, or health.
You can read more about Omnidocs' guidelines for processing personal data here:
https://omnidocs.com/processing-of-personal-data-in-the-context-of-recruitment/

jobs.title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Our Company RegASK is the Agentic AI Regulatory Operating System for life sciences and consumer products companies. We believe the future of regulatory work is not just better intelligence; it is intelligent execution.
Powered by vertical AI and backed by a global network of 1,800+ regulatory subject matter experts, RegASK enables organizations to anticipate regulatory change, assess its impact, and orchestrate compliance activities across 160+ markets. Our platform connects regulatory intelligence, decision-making, and workflow execution into a single system designed for modern regulatory teams.
Today, organizations use RegASK across Regulatory Affairs, Quality & Safety, Labeling, Packaging, R&D, and Legal to navigate increasing regulatory complexity with greater speed, confidence, and control. By combining agentic AI, human expertise, and enterprise governance, we are helping global companies transform regulatory operations from a reactive function into a strategic business capability.
As a fast-growing global company, we are always looking for curious, ambitious people who enjoy solving meaningful problems at the intersection of AI, regulation, and enterprise transformation. If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you.
Position Overview We are looking for a Senior Applied AI Engineer
to join our AI team, owning the design, evaluation and delivery of LLM-powered agentic systems into the RegASK platform. This role sits at the boundary between AI and product: you will build agent workflows in Python/Typescript and take them all the way into our Node/React platform, working side by side with the product engineering team rather than handling designs over the wall.

You will own outcomes end to end. That means the agent, the evaluation harness that proves it works, and the surface our customers actually touch.

Responsibilities: 
Design and implement agent workflows using LangGraph/LangChain, with a strong focus on orchestration, observability and debugging.
Build automated evaluation pipelines (factuality, robustness, hallucination detection, guardrails) and use them as the gate for what ships.
Optimise embedding models, vector store integrations and RAG pipelines for domain-specific regulatory content.
Integrate agentic services into the RegASK platform, working directly in our Node/React codebase alongside product engineering.
Maintain prompt pipelines and tune them against cost, latency and accuracy in production.
Own deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement of GenAI services (LLMOps), preferably in Azure: ML Studio, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry.
Partner with product, regulatory experts and engineering to translate requirements into agentic pipelines, and mentor colleagues on agent design and evaluation practice.

Requirements:
Hands-on production experience with LangGraph, LangChain or comparable agent frameworks.
Demonstrated ownership of LLM evaluation and observability: not just building agents, but proving and monitoring their behaviour in production.
Strong command of embedding models, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Mongo Atlas Vector Search) and retrieval optimisation.
At least one GenAI product surface you built and shipped to real users, end to end.
Strong Python engineering background (FastAPI, Transformers, spaCy) and working proficiency in TypeScript with Node and React. You will write both.
Experience with SQL and NoSQL data modelling and retrieval.
Solid LLMOps/MLOps practice: CI/CD, monitoring, scaling, cost control.
Excellent communication skills, able to explain system behaviour and evaluation results to non-technical regulatory and commercial stakeholders.

Good to have:
Experience with LLM fine-tuning or adaptation (LoRA, QLoRA, DPO) as a complement to retrieval and prompting.
Graph databases or knowledge graphs for hybrid RAG.
Continuous evaluation and A/B testing frameworks for agents in production.
Background in compliance, life sciences or regulatory intelligence.

What We Offer:
Flexible working arrangements (hybrid)
Opportunity to work in a high impact role at the intersection on AI, SaaS and Compliance/ Regulatory intelligence
Continuous learning and professional development

How to Apply:

If you are excited about this opportunity and believe you have the skills and qualifications to excel as our Senior Applied AI Engineer, please submit your resume for our consideration. 

We appreciate all applications, but only selected candidates will be contacted for an interview.

Thank you for considering joining the RegASK team. We look forward to reviewing your application!

jobs.description:
About Change

Change has been around longer than most fintechs you've heard of. Our Dutch entity was incorporated in Amsterdam in 2010, and we have been MiFID II authorised since 2015, a decade of operating as a regulated investment firm. Today we serve around 120,000 verified users across all 30 EEA countries, with full passporting rights, and we are MiCA-authorised as one of the early CASPs in the Netherlands.

We operate an app-based investment platform built for retail investors. Our users trade cryptocurrencies, alongside CFDs on stocks, indices, currencies, gold, oil and other financial instruments — all in one place, on mobile, with the regulatory protections of a Dutch investment firm.
We are a small senior team with a practical, low-bureaucracy culture. We value ownership, clear processes, strong judgement and real operational discipline over unnecessary ceremony.
We are hiring a Senior Engineer
who treats AI agents and tooling as a core part of the SDLC — building, shipping and operating systems with tools like Codex, Claude Code and automated reviewers as standard engineering practice.

What you will do

• Take ownership of one or two core domains end-to-end, execution, custody integration, market data, risk, or the trading core, and ship measurable improvements against real, regulated, money-moving systems.
• Contribute meaningfully to the Kotlin-vs-.NET architectural evaluation: prototype, benchmark, document, push back. Help us produce an honest decision rather than a fashionable one.
• Define and prove out our agentic SDLC: how we use coding agents in design, in review, in testing, in incident response. Make the patterns explicit so the rest of the team can copy them.
• Raise the engineering bar by example; clean, well-tested, observable code that other engineers want to read and extend. Become the person whose PRs others learn from.
• Partner closely with the Dutch business hub, our compliance and marketing functions, and our infrastructure team. Speed and regulatory standing are not in tension here; we expect you to deliver both.

Who we are looking for

Engineering depth

• 5+ years building production systems where correctness and uptime matter, ideally in finance, payments, trading or similarly demanding environments.
• Strong expertise in either the modern JVM ecosystem (Kotlin, Spring Boot, Kafka) or modern .NET (.NET, C#, ASP.NET Core), with openness to work across both.
• Comfortable with AWS, EKS, observability and infrastructure concepts; able to work confidently around cloud-native systems.
• Strong understanding of event-driven systems, idempotency, reconciliation and the realities of distributed systems in production.
• Systems thinker who can clearly communicate architecture, boundaries, data flows and constraints — for both engineers and coding agents.
AI-native, agentic-first

• You use coding agents (Codex, Cursor, Claude Code, Aider or similar) daily and understand both their strengths and failure modes.
• You have built or customised at least one real agentic workflow, tool or automation used in practice.
• You have clear judgement on where humans should stay in the loop in regulated environments. You are not impressed by demos.
• You are impressed by evals.
• You know how to provide the context, structure and guardrails agents need to operate effectively across complex tasks.
Mindset

• You communicate in writing well enough that meetings shrink. You write design docs that other engineers actually read.
• You give and take direct feedback without making it personal. You are visibly comfortable saying "I don't know" and "I was wrong".
• You want to grow your scope and impact here, not because of the title, but because you want the leverage. We will invest in that growth.

Nice to have

• Experience in a MiFID II, MiCA, PSD2 or similarly regulated environment.
• Familiarity with order management, market connectivity (FIX, REST/WebSocket exchange APIs), or crypto custody (BitGo, Fireblocks).
• Open-source contributions, particularly in the agent/MCP ecosystem.
• Greek or Dutch language is welcome but not required, we work in English.

What we offer

• Hybrid role (Athens)
• Travel to Amsterdam and Estonia a few times a year
• Competitive base salary
• Perks and benefits
• Learning budget to keep you sharp
• Real ownership and influence
• Fast decisions, zero politics
• A real shot at growing with the company long term

Process

Fast-moving and straightforward

• Conversation with senior management

This role is demanding but also rewarding. If you want to build, take ownership, and grow with a startup, we’d love to talk. Apply now.
