jobs.description:
Are you motivated by building technology solutions that change how businesses interact with their customers? Do you want to work across customer experience platforms, data architecture and modern AI, and make sure all of it connects and runs in production?

We are looking for a Data & AI Architect
who will own the technical design and delivery of customer technology solutions for our clients. You will work across CMS, CDP, commerce, CRM and AI, and work hands-on with delivery teams to bring it all to production.

In this key role, you will:

Design end-to-end solution architectures across customer technology landscapes, connecting content platforms, customer data, commerce systems and AI capabilities into scalable solutions

Lead technical delivery of complex, multi-platform projects, ensuring quality, integration and production-readiness from concept through go-live

Bring AI into customer technology by applying generative AI, agentic patterns and data-driven automation to CMS, CDP and commerce solutions

Bridge technology and business outcomes by translating client needs into concrete technical approaches with clear trade-offs across platforms and vendors

Keep on reading to learn more about the job, your future colleagues & all that Accenture has to offer!

Your Job

You are responsible for the technical vision and architecture of customer technology solutions across client engagements. You connect content management, customer data platforms, commerce, CRM and AI into working enterprise solutions, and you stay close to delivery to make sure what gets built matches what was designed.

You work hands-on with delivery teams: reviewing designs, unblocking technical challenges, validating integration approaches and making sure non-functional requirements (performance, security, scalability) are covered. The team comes to you when architecture gets complex, whether that’s a multi-platform CMS migration, a CDP integration with downstream activation channels, a Salesforce Agentforce implementation, or an AI-powered service automation.

You work with client stakeholders (IT leads, product owners, enterprise architects) to align solutions with their technology landscape and business priorities. You evaluate and recommend platforms, design integration patterns across vendors, and present options with trade-offs: what’s technically sound, what’s practical to build and maintain, and what delivers the most value.

You bring AI and data capabilities into the customer technology domain. Think generative AI applied to content and personalisation, agentic patterns for customer service, and data-driven automation across commerce and CRM.

You also contribute to Accenture Song’s practice by capturing reusable architecture patterns and sharing learnings across teams. You work with Accenture’s technology partnerships (Adobe, Salesforce, SAP, Sprinklr, Microsoft, AWS, Google Cloud) to bring the right capabilities to each engagement.

Your Team

Accenture Song is an incredible place to work where you can keep learning. By joining us, you’ll become part of a global company with a world-class brand and reputation. Besides the work we do for our clients, we’re proud of our vibrant, diverse workplace culture: we believe in openness and honesty, fairness and equality, common sense and realism. We want to get to know the real you and help you explore and grow - whatever it is you’re great at. So you will always have lots of learning opportunities (formal and informal) to improve your role-specific skills and expertise.

Your Background

5–8 years of relevant experience in solution architecture, technical delivery or senior engineering roles within consulting, digital delivery or enterprise environments

Proven experience designing and delivering customer technology solutions across multiple platforms, not just single-vendor implementations

Strong architecture skills across customer technology domains, with depth in at least two of the following:

Content Management: Adobe Experience Manager, Sitecore, CoreMedia, or composable/headless CMS (MACH architecture)

Customer Data Platforms: Salesforce Data Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Tealium, Segment, or similar

Commerce: SAP Commerce Cloud, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce (Magento), or composable commerce

CRM & MarTech: Salesforce (Sales/Service/Marketing Cloud, Agentforce), Sprinklr, Adobe Campaign, or similar marketing automation and customer engagement platforms

Data & AI: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Databricks, data pipelines, LLM orchestration, RAG architectures

Integration expertise: experience designing cross-platform architectures connecting CMS, CDP, commerce, CRM and back-office systems (ERP, ticketing, fulfilment) through API management, event-driven patterns and middleware

Interest and growing experience in AI applied to customer technology: generative AI for content and personalisation, agentic AI for service automation, data-driven decisioning

Ability to lead technical delivery: not just design on paper, but guide teams through implementation, troubleshoot issues and make sure things work in production

Strong communication skills: able to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and present architecture options with trade-offs

Proactive, hands-on attitude: you don’t wait for a perfect brief, you figure out the approach and iterate

Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business or equivalent experience

Fluent in English, with professional proficiency in Dutch or French

We are Bystronic - a global technology company passionate about shaping the future of industrial manufacturing. We want to work with people who support us in creating new possibilities for connected sustainable production worldwide.
As a leading provider of solutions for sheet metal and material processing, we combine laser cutting technology, press brakes, automation, and software with innovative laser applications for new materials and processes.

Bystronic Software. The digital future of sheet metal processing.

In this role, you will join our Bystronic Software team. With our software solutions, developed specifically for the sheet metal processing industry, we enable companies to digitize their entire processes - from the initial quote to the final delivery.
Join Bystronic Software to build world-class software solutions for manufacturing customers in the sheet metal industry. You will work in agile, multidisciplinary teams to design, implement and evolve robust software that helps digitize industrial production.

What you will be doing

• Design, develop and maintain HMI applications for laser cutting systems and industrial automation solutions.
• Implement intuitive and reliable user interfaces that enable operators to efficiently control and monitor machine and automation processes.
• Collaborate with PLC, motion control, automation and mechanical engineering teams to ensure seamless integration between software and machine control systems
• Contribute to the design and evolution of software architectures supporting machine operation, diagnostics and production workflows.
• Participate in technical discussions around architecture, implementation, performance and continuous improvement.
• Collaborate closely with product, engineering and domain experts to deliver real impact for our customers.

Your education & experience

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics or a related field.
• Professional experience in software development, ideally in product-oriented environments.
• Experience working in agile teams and contributing to shared engineering standards.

What you need to succeed

• Strong programming skills, with special consideration for full-stack experience in C#, .NET, WPF and React.
• Experience designing and developing Human Machine Interfaces (HMI) or industrial software applications.
• Ability to create clean, scalable and well-structured software solutions.
• Analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose issues across software and machine systems.
• Excellent English communication skills, both spoken and written.
• Team spirit, ownership and willingness to continuously learn.

What sets you apart

• Experience with industrial machinery, manufacturing systems or machine control software.
• Knowledge of laser cutting processes, sheet metal manufacturing or industrial automation environments
• Experience working directly with machine operators and translating operational needs into effective software solutions.
• Interest in shaping the digital factory of the future.

What's in it for you

• A hybrid work model connected to our offices in Bilbao, Derio and Vitoria.
• Flexible working schedule and reduced working hours during summer.
• Individual learning and development programs, including language courses, Microsoft certifications and participation in technical conferences.
• Multidisciplinary teams with diverse skills, perspectives and backgrounds working in agile ways.
• The opportunity to create real impact in the sheet metal industry and help shape the digital factory of the future.
• Salary and benefits aligned with the market and your experience.

People power our purpose

Imagine working in an environment that helps move the company to the next level, where your passion, values, and skills are integral to impacting industrial manufacturing and beyond. At Bystronic, this can become your reality. Our people are the edge to drive and nurture our ambitions and continued success. Together we have created a culture where our people are central, inspiring us to make decisions that best serve them and are aligned with our purpose. As much as we are in a technology business, human beings drive real change.

Life at Bystronic

Xoople is Earth’s System of Record™

jobs.title: Solution Architect – Industrial Data & Integration
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

SistelGroup delivers turnkey PLC, SCADA and OT data contextualization solutions for the manufacturing industry. For more than 30 years we have helped pharmaceutical, chemical, and food & beverage manufacturers run plants that are more efficient, safer and fully traceable.
We work as a partner, not a supplier. We learn our customers’ processes, we stay with them through the full life of a solution, and we are the people they call when something matters. That is why our clients stay with us for decades.
When you join us, you will work on international projects with advanced Industry 4.0 and digitalization technologies for leading manufacturing companies. You will also build your career in a group that covers both industrial automation and digital transformation for the manufacturing industry.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a Solution Architect to lead the technical direction of our industrial data and integration work. This is a hands-on architecture role, focused on Unified Namespace, industrial connectivity and data contextualization. You will design and build the architectures that connect the plant floor to business systems (SCADA, MES, ERP, warehousing systems, LIMS), and you will write the reference architecture and the standards that our engineers follow. Ignition is a particular focus: it is the platform we build most of these solutions on.
You are hands-on with the technology. You build proofs of concept, prototypes and demonstrations: to prove a design works, to show a client what is possible, and to give our engineers a working reference to learn from. Our project teams carry out the implementation and commissioning, and part of the Solution Architect role is to train them to do it well.
Much of this work is about context. A plant produces millions of values every day, but a value on its own means very little. Context is what turns it into insightful information: which equipment produced it, on which line, during which batch and for which product, and how it connects to the order in the ERP system and the result in the laboratory. You design the models, the naming and the relationships that carry that meaning, so that the same data serves an operator, a quality reviewer and a data scientist without anyone having to guess what it refers to.
You will work with our commercial team from the first client conversations, helping turn a business problem into a design, a demonstration, and a proposal. On projects: you are involved in the early stages — design, architecture and the technical decisions that shape the work — and then hand over to the delivery team. Most of our clients work in regulated industries, which means clear documentation and traceable design decisions are key.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Architecture and design

Design Unified Namespace architectures for plant data: namespace and topic structure, information models, and the context that gives each value its meaning.
Design the data models behind the architecture: equipment and site hierarchies, product and batch genealogy, and the relationships between assets, processes and quality results, using recognized models ISA-95 and ISA-88.
Design integrations between plant systems and business systems: PLC, SCADA, ERP, MES, LIMS, historians and data platforms.
Assess legacy plant and laboratory environments and design the modernization path for them.
Choose the technologies, and write reference architecture and design standards for this work.

Proofs of concept and integration

Build proofs of concept, prototypes and reference implementations that prove a design works before a project commits to it.
Build and prove data flows with MQTT, Sparkplug B, OPC UA and REST APIs.
Work with Ignition and similar platforms as the plant-side layer of these architectures.
Build prototypes of data-driven applications on top of the architecture: equipment monitoring, predictive maintenance, and batch reporting.
Integrate with ERP and MES using standard message formats such as B2MML, so that production orders, confirmations and quality results flow in both directions.
Make plant data findable and “end user friendly” to people who did not build the system, through consistent naming, documented models and clear metadata.
Connect to business and laboratory systems: SAP and other ERP systems, MES platforms, LIMS and quality systems.

Pre-sales and client consulting

Work with our commercial team during early client conversations: understand the business problem before designing anything.
Run technical workshops with clients, design the solution, and present it clearly to both engineers and management.
Build the demonstrations and solution concepts that our commercial team uses in client meetings.
Contribute to development of technical proposals, solution designs and estimates together with our commercial team.

Technical expertise and knowledge sharing

Train engineers to implement and commission the solutions you design, and build the team’s capability in Ignition, MQTT, industrial data connectivity, and data contextualization concepts.
Lead the design phase of new projects, then hand over to the delivery team with the documentation and guidance they need.

REQUIREMENTS

Degree in engineering, computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
8+ years of experience in industrial automation, industrial software or IT/OT integration, including several years in an architecture or solution design role.
Deep hands-on experience with Ignition (Inductive Automation): you build prototypes and demonstrations yourself, and you are comfortable working in the tools rather than only specifying them.
Proven experience designing and integrating plant-to-enterprise architectures in real production environments: Unified Namespace, PLC, DCS, SCADA, MES, ERP and LIMS.
Strong experience with MQTT, Sparkplug B, OPC UA, and REST APIs.
Proven experience modelling and contextualizing industrial data: hierarchies, naming conventions, metadata and the relationships between equipment, process and product.
Strong SQL skills, and at least one scripting language, preferably Python.
Experience delivering in GMP or other regulated environments, with working knowledge of GAMP 5, EU GMP Annex 11, 21 CFR Part 11.
The ability to explain a complex architecture simply, to engineers and to managers.
Commercial skills: effort estimation, and technical workshop facilitation.
English, spoken and written. Spanish is a plus.

DESIRABLE EXPERIENCE AND CERTIFICATIONS

The following skills are nice-to-have and will support the innovative engineering initiatives at our company.
Data-driven manufacturing applications: predictive maintenance, equipment monitoring, OEE, energy monitoring solutions, batch reporting and yield, golden batch.
MQTT broker platforms: HiveMQ, or the Cirrus Link modules for Ignition.
Cloud knowledge, preferably Azure.
Historians and industrial data platforms: AVEVA OSI PI, AspenTech Inmation, or similar.
Time-series and non-relational databases (MongoDB, InfluxDB, or similar).
Containers, CI/CD and version control (Docker, Kubernetes, Git).
Data analysis and dashboards (Power BI, Grafana or similar).
OT network and security design: segmentation, industrial DMZ, and ISA/IEC 62443 knowledge or certification.
MES platforms: Ignition Sepasoft, Körber PAS-X, Siemens Opcenter, or similar.
Multi-site standardization, or defining a technical service offering: creating a reference architecture or data model template and rolling it out across several plants or projects.
Regulatory awareness for industrial data: the EU GMP Annex 11 revision, and Annex 22 on artificial intelligence in GMP.

WHAT WE OFFER

A builder’s role with technical ownership: you design it, you prove it, and you see it become part of how the company works.
Training programs with our technology partners.
A direct line to the business: you work with our commercial team and see your designs turn into won projects.
Large international pharmaceutical clients and genuinely complex plants.
A specialized and collaborative technical team, and 30+ years of plant knowledge behind you. We are a people-oriented company, with special focus on ensuring the best environment for our engineers to work and collaborate.
Competitive salary according to your experience.
Flexible working hours and hybrid work.

POSITION DETAILS

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building scalable, secure, and maintainable backend services in cloud environments. The engineer will work closely with Tech Leads and cross-functional teams to implement high-quality solutions aligned with established architectural and engineering standards.

This role is not a Tech Lead or Architect position. The expectation is strong technical execution, active contribution to engineering quality, support for architecture compliance, and ownership of backend deliverables.

AI-assisted development practices are a core expectation for this role. Candidates should be comfortable using tools such as Cursor, Claude Code Codex, or similar within their daily engineering workflow.

Your Responsibilities

As a key member of the team, you will be responsible for:

Backend Development

Design, develop, and maintain backend services using C# and .NET Core.
Build secure, scalable, and high-performance REST APIs.
Implement backend solutions aligned with approved architectural patterns and technical guidelines.
Develop services capable of handling high concurrency and production-scale workloads.
Write optimized and maintainable database queries while ensuring data integrity and performance.
Troubleshoot and resolve backend and production issues efficiently.

Code Quality and Best Practices

Write clean, maintainable, testable, and production-ready code.
Apply SOLID principles and safeguard architectural practices such as Clean Architecture, Onion Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, and Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
Implement and maintain:
Unit tests
Integration tests
End-to-end tests
Performance/load tests
Participate actively in code reviews and engineering quality initiatives.
Contribute to continuous improvement of development standards, tooling, and workflows.

Collaboration and Agile Development

Work closely with Tech Leads, frontend engineers, QA engineers, and DevOps engineers
Translate technical and business requirements into high-quality implementations.
Support architecture compliance and contribute to solution improvement discussions.
Provide technical guidance and support to less experienced engineers when needed.
Participate actively in Agile ceremonies and team collaboration activities.

DevOps, Cloud and Architecture

Work with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Containerize backend services using Docker.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes.
Support observability and monitoring practices using logging, metrics, and tracing tools.
Follow security, reliability, and operational best practices in backend implementations.

Continuous Improvement

Stay up to date with advancements in backend technologies.
Propose and implement improvements in system architecture and development workflows.

Contribute to knowledge-sharing initiatives and technical documentation

What We're Looking For

Experience:
A minimum of 6 years of experience in backend development.
Experience in developing and maintaining scalable backend services.
Experience writing and maintaining unit, integration and performance tests.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and DevOps practices.
Hands-on experience with GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude-Code … configuration, rule management and use.
Experience working in cloud environments such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Languages: English (Interview will be conducted in English)
Communication: Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.
Technical Skills:
Strong proficiency in C# and .NET Core
Strong experience designing and implementing REST APIs
Strong SQL and relational database experience
Good understanding of:
SOLID principles
Design patterns
Clean Architecture
Domain-Driven Design (DDD)

Experience with Docker and CI/CD workflows
Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Understanding of scalable backend systems, observability, and reliability practices
AI Engineering
Practical experience using AI coding assistants in day-to-day software development (Cursor/Claude Code/Codex/Github Co-pilot)
Experience configuring or working with AI-assisted engineering workflows
Language Skills
Fluent in English (mandatory).
French language proficiency is a plus.
Soft Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and collaboration int cross-functional teams.
Ability to take ownership and drive initiatives to completion.
Interpersonal Skills: Ability to collaborate in a diverse and dynamic environment.

Our Recruitment Process

15-minute introductory call with our Talent Acquisition Specialist.
Interview with the Hiring Team
Technical Interview

What We Offer

We understand that flexibility and trust
are essential for our teams. Here are some of the benefits we offer:

🏡 Hybrid Work: Rotational model, 2 days onsite, three days remote.
💰 Annual Payments: 14 payments per year (12 monthly payments + 1 summer bonus + 1 Christmas bonus in November).
🍽️ Meal Voucher: €10.20 per working day.
🌴 Vacation: 23 vacation days, plus 24th or 31st December off.
🗣️ Language Training: Access to group classes in Spanish, English, or French.
⚕️ Private Medical Insurance: Multicare coverage.
Teambuilding: Join us for memorable afterworks and team activities!

Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging

At Nextlane, we are committed to creating a space where everyone feels valued and respected
. We firmly believe that diversity in experiences and backgrounds strengthens our culture and drives innovation.

Support for people with disabilities. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, let us know so we can provide the best possible experience.
Equal opportunities for all: We welcome applications regardless of age, gender, origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – Search & Relevance
jobs.description:
About the Role

Search is one of the primary ways people navigate our site, and it is a stream with significant headroom. We run Typesense and want to substantially extend how we use it - better relevance, broader coverage, faster and more reliable indexing, and search-driven discovery beyond the search box itself.
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer who understands that search is a product problem with an engineering substrate, and who is comfortable being judged on whether results actually got better.
This is a hands-on delivery role requiring hands-on experience with a search engine in production — relevance tuning, not just integration.

Responsibilities

Extend and improve our Typesense implementation across the site.
Tune relevance and ranking - weighting, synonyms, typo tolerance, faceting, filtering and sorting - against measured outcomes rather than intuition.
Build and harden indexing pipelines: index freshness, incremental updates, reindexing without downtime and consistency with source data.
Instrument search analytics - query logs, zero-result rates, click-through and conversion - and use them to drive the roadmap.
Run relevance experiments and build the evaluation harness that makes them trustworthy.
Extend search into discovery surfaces: autocomplete, related results, faceted browse and recommendations.
Evaluate hybrid and vector search where it measurably beats keyword ranking for our content.
Scale and operate the search infrastructure as index size and query volume grow.
Use agentic development tooling such as Claude Code as a core part of how you deliver, with the judgement to know when to rely on it and when not to.

How We Work

Small, focused streams with real ownership. Engineers shape work rather than receive tickets. We deploy frequently and expect people to own what they ship into production. Our stack is C# / .NET and React / Next.js running on on-prem infrastructure alongside managed cloud services.
We use agentic development tooling heavily, Claude Code and similar and expect you to be fluent with it. We are equally interested in your judgement about it: where it accelerates you, where you deliberately don't use it, and how you review what it produces before it reaches a customer.
To be clear about emphasis: this is a software engineering role first. We are hiring for demonstrated delivery of production systems. AI capability is part of how the work gets done, and sometimes part of what gets built - it is not the qualification.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Bij Itility werken we met projectteams van engineers, data scientists, projectmanagers en architecten aan digitale oplossingen die er écht toe doen. We ondersteunen klanten in de maakindustrie, energie, retail en defensie bij hun digitale transformatie. Dat doen we niet door standaardoplossingen te implementeren, maar door technologie slim en doelgericht in te zetten om processen te verbeteren, innovatie te versnellen en maatschappelijke impact te vergroten.

Of het nu gaat om het bouwen van dataplatforms die fabrieken efficiënter laten draaien, het ontwikkelen van slimme software voor duurzame energie, of het verwerken van satellietbeelden tot waardevolle inzichten, bij ons werk je altijd aan uitdagende projecten met tastbare resultaten.

We geloven dat je het meeste leert door te doen. Daarom werken we in compacte, multidisciplinaire teams waarin iedereen een actieve rol speelt: van ontwerp en ontwikkeling tot testen en opleveren. Je krijgt de ruimte om te experimenteren met nieuwe technologie, samen te werken met collega’s uit verschillende disciplines en je eigen expertise verder uit te bouwen.

Dit ga je doen

Je hebt al een paar jaar ervaring als software engineer en bent klaar voor de volgende stap: jezelf verder ontwikkelen in de breedte. Bij Itility krijg je die kans. Je werkt op het snijvlak van backend en frontend en bouwt mee aan moderne, schaalbare applicaties die direct waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. In de backend werk je met Python en C#, terwijl je aan de frontend werkt met de technologie die het best aansluit bij het project of dat nu React, Angular, Vue of iets anders is. Ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van backendfunctionaliteit in Python en C#
Bouwen van gebruiksvriendelijke en schaalbare frontend-applicaties
Werken in multidisciplinaire teams met engineers, data scientists en projectmanagers
Meedenken over software-architectuur en technische keuzes
Schrijven en uitvoeren van unit- en integratietests
Onderhouden en doorontwikkelen van bestaande applicaties

Daarnaast vind je het leuk om te schakelen tussen verschillende technologieën en je kennis steeds verder uit te breiden. Naast het programmeren denk je actief mee over architectuur en ontwerpkeuzes, en werk je nauw samen met collega’s uit diverse disciplines en met onze klanten. Zo leer je voortdurend bij, krijg je inzicht in de volledige keten en ontwikkel je je tot een allround engineer die in uiteenlopende omgevingen het verschil kan maken.

Bij Itility krijg je de vrijheid én ondersteuning om het beste uit jezelf te halen. Via onze eigen Itility Academy investeer je continu in je technische expertise en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Laptop en telefoon;
Hybride werken;
Gebruik van gym op kantoor

Dit ben jij

Uiteraard ben je betrokken, gedreven en werk je graag in een wereld die continu in beweging is. Om dat met succes te doen, heb je nodig:

Een bachelor- of masterdiploma in informatica, software engineering of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied
3–4 jaar ervaring als software engineer

Develop and implement innovative solutions according to Enza Zaden UI/UX, security and quality standards using a mix of modern application development technologies to automate and enhance business processes across departments
Work in multidisciplinary teams that deliver direct business value through pragmatic, user-friendly digital solutions
Collaborate with technical domain expert teams that are responsible for defining and building the foundations and standards of our platforms

colleague

Enza Zaden

Enza Zaden is an international family-owned company that has been developing innovative vegetable varieties since 1938. A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.

WORUM ES GEHT

Du baust dabei mit an unseren GovTech-Lösungen der nächsten Generation, die den Alltag von Millionen von Menschen einfacher machen. DEINE AUFGABEN

Als Application Support Engineer (m/w/d) bist Du erste Anlaufstelle für technische Probleme im Kundenbetrieb und sorgst für eine schnelle und strukturierte Bearbeitung von Supportfällen.
Deine zentrale Aufgabe ist die Analyse von Incidents unter Einbeziehung von Logs, Systemen, Datenbanken und Containern.
Du stellst sicher, dass Tickets vollständig, nachvollziehbar und reproduzierbar sind.
Probleme löst du eigenständig oder übergibst komplexe Fälle strukturiert an die Entwicklung.
Darüber hinaus koordinierst Du Supportfälle im 2nd- und 3rd-Level und agierst als Bindeglied zwischen Kundenbetrieb und Entwicklung.
Ein weiterer Schwerpunkt liegt im Aufbau von Know-how durch saubere Dokumentation und aktive Wissensweitergabe im Team.

WAS DU MITBRINGST

Nach Deinem Studium oder Deiner Ausbildung im IT-Umfeld hast Du bereits fundierte praktische Erfahrungen in der Betreuung von komplexen Infrastrukturen, IT-Prozessen und Applikationen gesammelt.
Erfahrung im Umgang mit IT-Systemen (z. B. Server, Netzwerke, Anwendungen).
Außerdem hast Du Spaß an Fehlersuche und Ursachenanalyse
Ein gewisses Grundverständnis von Softwareentwicklung (z. B. APIs, Datenflüsse, Fehlerbilder).
Du hast Erfahrung mit Logs, Debugging oder Monitoring.
Erfahrung im 2nd/3rd-Level-Support.
Du arbeitest strukturiert, lösungsorientiert und behältst auch in kritischen Situationen den Überblick.

HIERMIT ARBEITEN WIR

Betriebssysteme: Windows Server
Ticketsystem: Jira, Azure DevOps
Dokumentationssystem: Confluence
Programmiersprache: C#
Datenbanken: Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL
Container: Docker, Kubernetes (OpenShift)
Kommunikationsplattform: Rocket Chat, Microsoft Teams

WAS WIR BIETEN

Du möchtest Beruf und Privatleben unter einen Hut bekommen? Wunderbar. Genieße flexible Arbeitszeiten. Remotearbeit nach Kundenanforderung möglich.
Wir bezahlen heute schon Dein zukünftiges Ich. Wenn Du mal in Rente gehst, haben wir jeden Monat 338€ für Dich im Rahmen der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge zur Seite gelegt.
Du genießt gutes Essen? Dann profitiere hierbei von unserer Essenszulage.
Wir investieren in Dich durch regelmäßige Fort- und Weiterbildungen. Das Beste daran: Du entscheidest mit, wie Dein weiterer Weg aussehen kann.
Du connectest Dich gerne mit Deinen Kollegen? Das unterstützen wir als Firmenwert absolut, nur so kannst Du von Deinen erfahrenen Kollegen lernen und neue Aufgabenfelder für Dich entdecken.
Komm schnell von A nach B mit Deinem eigenen JobRad.
Ob Weinfest oder Weihnachtsfeier - wir feiern zusammen. Beim Sommerfest freuen wir uns zusätzlich über den Besuch deiner Familie.
Ob „old school“ LAN-Partys, Bouldern, Grillabende in unserem Garten oder Trampolinhalle, lass Deiner Fantasie freien Lauf, wir freuen uns auf neue Vorschläge. Du brauchst mal schnell den Kopf frei? Nutze den Tischkicker, den Billardtisch oder den Basketballkorb. Oder laufe innerhalb von 30m an das Rheinufer und lass die Seele baumeln und atme einmal tief durch.

INTERESSE AN DIESEM JOB?

Dann lass uns rausfinden, ob wir zueinander passen. Entwickel Deine tollen Ideen nicht länger für den Papierkorb, sondern für einen sinnvollen Zweck.

We’re looking for a Backend Developer who’s passionate about building reliable, high-performing systems and wants to keep learning and growing. You’ll join a tight-knit, cross-functional squad that owns its products from idea to delivery and works closely together to build great things.

You’ll have the chance to work with experienced engineers who’ll help you level up your skills in software design, cloud development and modern engineering practices. You’ll also get the opportunity to broaden your experience as a T-shaped developer, exploring areas like architecture, DevOps and product development.

We work together in our Liverpool HQ three days a week because we believe collaboration, feedback and shared problem-solving help us build better software and stronger teams.

Role:
Backend Developer

Location:
Liverpool City Centre HQ / Hybrid (3 days in office) **

Salary:
£45,000–£55,000 depending on experience**

What You’ll Do:

Build and maintain backend services using .NET 8.0 and Azure
Write clean, testable and maintainable code
Help design and implement APIs and data solutions
Deploy and manage applications with Docker and Azure Cloud
Work with product owners and designers to turn ideas into features
Learn from experienced developers and contribute to code reviews
Share ideas and help improve how we build and deliver software

Our Tech Stack:

Backend:
C#, .NET 8.0, Docker

Database:
SQL Server, Entity Framework, MongoDb

Infrastructure:
Docker, Azure

Monitoring:
Grafana, Loki Stack

Tooling:
Git, CI/CD pipelines, Unit and Integration Testing, Agile methodologies

If you’re interested in learning about Clean Architecture or the Mediator pattern, we’ll help you get there.

Engineering Practices:

We care deeply about building high-quality, maintainable systems.

CI/CD pipelines for fast, reliable deployments
Automated testing and code reviews as standard
Monitoring and observability with Grafana and Loki
Continuous improvement through retrospectives and experimentation

What We’re Looking For:

Experience building applications in C# and .NET
A good understanding of APIs, SQL Server and Entity Framework
Familiarity with cloud platforms like Azure and containerisation with Docker
An interest in learning best practices around testing and CI/CD
A collaborative mindset and eagerness to grow as a developer
A problem-solving attitude and pride in writing clean, maintainable code

Why Join Us:

Modern tech stack and strong engineering standards
Supportive environment where you can learn from experienced developers
Clear opportunities for career progression and skill development
A collaborative squad where your ideas are valued
Top-tier tools and a workspace built for creativity and teamwork

Team and Culture

You’ll be joining a squad that values curiosity, openness and craftsmanship. Everyone has a voice, and we help each other get better every day.

We believe in ownership, curiosity and craftsmanship. Everyone has a voice, and we encourage ideas from across the squad. We share knowledge, celebrate success and support each other every step of the way.

It’s a place where you can challenge yourself, grow your skills and build a career you’re proud of.

Grow with Acorn

At Acorn Insurance, we’re proud of our Liverpool roots — and even prouder of how far we’ve come. As part of the Acorn Group, we bring over 40 years of specialist insurance expertise to the table. From humble beginnings, we’ve grown into a national leader, now employing 1,700+ people across the UK and reached a milestone £750 million in total value of insurance policies written in 2024.

We’re growing fast, with new opportunities emerging every week. That growth is largely due to the values we share:

🦏 We run through walls for our customers and each other
🐐 We challenge the status quo
🐧 We succeed when we help those around us succeed
🐆 We decide quickly when the smart thing to do is use our judgement

Benefits:

🌴 A maximum of 35 days’ holiday (depending on role and tenure) including bank holidays, with additional buy/sell options
🧠 24/7 mental health support & free counselling available
☝ Grow with us: Through career fairs, leadership programs, and learning on the go!
💸 Flexible benefits, including early access to salary via our internal platform
🏡 Hybrid working options to support work-life balance and individual needs
🎉 Recognition awards, social events & more

Our Commitment to our colleague’s:

These aren’t just words — they’re the principles we live by. And we’re proud to back them up with real action, earning recognition and accreditation from leading organisations that share our commitment to people and growth:

🧠 Mindful Employer – championing mental health and wellbeing
♿ Disability Confident Level 1 & 2 – creating accessible, inclusive opportunities
🌸 Menopause Friendly accredited – supporting every stage of life
🎖️ Armed Forces Covenant signatory – honouring those who serve
🎖️ Armed Forces Defence employer recognition scheme - Supporting those who serve
🏆 Great Places to Work 2024/25 – fostering an engaging and positive workplace culture
📈 Best Place to Work for Development – proud to be investing in people’s future
👩‍💼 Best Place to Work for Women – breaking down barriers to women's career progression

If you’re looking for a company with a strong culture, real career progression, and a people-first approach — all rooted in the heart of Liverpool — Grow with Acorn.

A Few Things to Know Before You Apply

We’re really excited that you’re considering joining Acorn! To help everything go smoothly, here are a couple of things to keep in mind:

If your application is successful, we will commence relevant employment checks prior to you commencing employment with us. These will include a standard criminal record check and an insolvency register check.

🌍 Visa Requirements

Because our training is quite comprehensive, we can only consider applicants who have at least one year remaining on their Graduate or Post-Study Work visa. At the moment, we’re not able to offer visa sponsorship.

💬 We’re Here to Support You

We’re committed to creating an inclusive, supportive workplace where everyone can flourish. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process—or once you’re part of the team—just let us know. Whether it’s flexible hours, adapted equipment, or a bit of extra support, we’ll work with you to make sure you can do your best work.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
UCAS is at the heart of connecting people to higher education.

UCAS is the world’s leading shared admissions service for higher education. We provide application services for UK universities and colleges as well as delivering a wide range of research, consultancy and advisory services to schools, colleges, careers services, professional bodies and employers.

We’re a successful and fast-growing organisation, which helps hundreds of thousands of people every year. We're committed to delivering a first-class service to all of our customers — they're at the heart of everything we do.

Business Unit Description

The Digital Services business unit is at the heart of UCAS’ technical innovation, data and infrastructure. It focuses on leveraging data science, technology, and enterprise architecture to enhance UCAS' digital products and services.

The unit is dedicated to developing and improving customer-centric digital solutions, ensuring seamless and secure online experiences for all users. By providing insightful data and analysis, often made available to anyone with free-to-use intuitive dashboard, Digital Services empowers the Higher Education sector and those interested in the sector with valuable information to make informed decisions. By working in collaborative, expert led, multi-disciplinary teams, Digital Services drives UCAS’ mission to connect students with their next opportunities through advanced technological solutions.

About The Role Contractual Hours

35.00

About The Role

The Senior Software Engineer is the key development and technical specialist resource for the team, responsible for developing and delivering software solutions in line with UCAS’ Corporate and IT strategy, while maintain a detailed knowledge of existing UCAS applications and systems. They will work alongside other Senior Software Engineers to ensure compliance with UCAS coding and design standards.

Key accountabilities:

Provide technical leadership and innovation, utilising advanced technical skills.
Accountable for the development of quality solutions based on technical requirements, leading projects and/or project teams as required.
Provide coaching, mentoring support and feedback to team members in key technologies and developments, to improve general skill set of the team and increase knowledge of solutions.
Code/configure and document complex solutions from supplied specifications, using agreed standards and tools, and conduct reviews with others as appropriate.
Define and maintain coding and best practice standards and documentation guidelines.
Develop and maintain specialist knowledge of cloud technologies, design principles, architectures, and software.
Analyse data requirements to establish, modify, and maintain object/data models
Act as a subject matter expert (SME) for related technologies and understand the interactions between the systems.

For more information about this role please see the attached role profile.

Skills, Qualifications, And Experience

Educated to degree level in relevant computing discipline or able to demonstrate an equivalent level of professional experience.
Substantial experience of developing enterprise level .Net applications.
Significant experience leading and designing solutions
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with ability to communicate effectively to both non-technical and technical audiences
Experience of working successfully in a dynamic, large-scale agile department with multiple technologies.
Significant experience developing solutions for the cloud.
Highly proficient in automated CI/CD pipelines, including automated testing.
Significant experience of coaching and mentoring junior members of staff, with a proven ability to develop individuals and input into performance evaluation.
Proven ability to lead architectural designs, considering business need, cost, and delivery timescales.

Package

Salary up to £60,000

Purpose-driven work in a charity-led organisation connecting people to education and opportunity
Internal training, mentoring, and access to industry-recognised certifications through our development academies
Hybrid working model built on trust and flexibility, with a 35-hour week and flexible contracts
30 days annual leave, 3 concessionary days over Christmas, bank holidays, and the option to purchase additional leave
Everyday wellbeing support through Perkbox, offering discounts and wellness tools
Onsite facilities including a subsidised gym, café, and free parking at our Cheltenham office
Inclusive culture supported by employee networks, wellbeing champions, and Mental Health First Aiders
Recognition and reward through our quarterly employee scheme and an ex-gratia bonus for going above and beyond

Studies have shown that some groups of people are less likely to apply to a role unless they tick every box. At UCAS we recognise that talent comes in various forms and we are committed to delivering a fair and equitable recruitment process where applicants have an equal opportunity to demonstrate their skills. So, if you are interested in this vacancy, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please apply.

If you have any questions and would like to find out more about the role before applying please email the Talent Acquisition team via careers@ucas.ac.uk.

Working Arrangements
Is fully remote working an option?

No

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Engineering Manager

Salary:
Up to £100,000 base + 15% bonus
Location:
Croydon – 2 days per week in the office
Work Type:
Permanent

Role

We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to join an established engineering group at an important point in its journey.

This is a newly created role with the opportunity to make a genuine impact on how engineering operates. The business currently has an established desktop application environment and is preparing for its future transition towards SaaS and cloud.

Before that transition begins, there is an opportunity to strengthen engineering effectiveness across the existing environment – improving the SDLC, reducing manual processes, increasing automation and creating a smoother, more predictable approach to delivering quality software.

You’ll inherit leadership responsibilities within a wider engineering group of around 30 people and play a role in building and leading capability in Poland as part of the wider transformation.
This isn't about joining and rewriting everything from scratch. It's about understanding what already works, identifying where engineering can improve and bringing the team with you on that journey.

Responsibilities

As Engineering Manager, you'll combine technical credibility, people leadership and engineering strategy.

Your focus will include:
Leading and supporting engineers within the wider engineering organisation.
Improving engineering effectiveness across the software development lifecycle.
Identifying and removing manual steps from the current release process.
Improving CI/CD, automated testing and release automation.
Addressing flaky tests, quality issues and security vulnerabilities as systemic engineering challenges rather than isolated problems.
Helping engineers understand not only what they are doing, but why engineering processes and practices matter.
Preparing the engineering environment for the future transition from desktop applications towards SaaS and cloud.
Considering how AI-assisted development impacts the wider SDLC, particularly testing, security, quality and release processes.
Bringing greater Product thinking into engineering by understanding how and why customers use the software.
Playing a role in building and leading the Poland engineering capability as part of the wider transformation.
Improving engineering practices pragmatically, without unnecessarily replacing existing systems or processes that work.

Required Skills

We're looking for someone who has started their career in software engineering and progressed into engineering leadership while maintaining strong technical credibility.

Experience we're particularly interested in includes:
A strong software engineering background, ideally within C#/.NET environments.
Engineering leadership experience with the ability to challenge, coach and support technical teams.
Experience working with or leading teams responsible for desktop applications.
An understanding of the different challenges involved in developing and releasing desktop software compared with SaaS products.
Experience improving SDLC and engineering effectiveness.
Strong knowledge of CI/CD, automated testing and release automation.
Experience tackling engineering quality issues such as flaky tests, manual release processes and security vulnerabilities.
Strong people leadership skills.
The ability to balance technical, Product and customer considerations when making engineering decisions.
A pragmatic approach to transformation and continuous improvement.

Experience considering or implementing AI-assisted software development practices would also be valuable, particularly where you've looked beyond code generation at the impact increased development velocity has on testing, security, quality and release processes.

Why should I apply?

This is an opportunity to join before a significant engineering transformation begins rather than arriving halfway through one.

You'll have the chance to influence how an established engineering organisation evolves, improve the foundations of the existing desktop environment and help prepare the team for its future move towards SaaS and cloud.

There are tangible engineering problems to solve today – from automation and testing through to release processes and engineering effectiveness – alongside the longer-term opportunity to influence how the organisation approaches modern software delivery.

You'll also have the opportunity to shape teams across the UK and Poland, bringing your own experience into an established engineering group while helping define what the next stage of its journey looks like.

Interview Process

The interview process consists of three stages:
Stage 1:
45-minute conversation with the hiring team
Stage 2:
Technical test
Stage 3:
Two-hour onsite final interview in Reigate

Interested?

Apply for the role today or send your CV to pierre.rodriguez@wedotech.uk

Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.

The Opportunity

We are looking for senior software engineers who can also be people managers of other software engineers, for a share of their time (up to 50%).

On the software engineering part:

More than knowledge of a specific language or framework, we are looking for great software engineering skills:

ability to translate functional requirements into an elegant and simple design, and then deliver the code.

We are also looking for engineers who understand the product and the customer's needs in detail and can suggest innovative ideas: in the end, it's all about delivering value to end users.

On the people management part, here is what it entails:

coaching up to 6 direct reports (usually every 2 weeks)
defining expectations, collecting and delivering feedback
building career development plans (we have a skill leveling matrix)
participating in performance-related decisions with other managers (ex: proposing and calibrating salary raises), including under-performance remediation
(optional) leading ad hoc projects with other managers to structure engineering (ex: organize technical demos, animate an All Hands, lead evolutions to our skill leveling matrix)

Experience as a software engineer working on a product in production - for managers specifically, this experience must be evaluated during the interview process at a “senior” level (that is, usually from 7-8 years)
Experience in people management of at least 2-3 years,

Great team spirit with a problem-solving attitude

A well-established group supplying products and services into professional and healthcare-adjacent markets is bringing in an experienced Solutions Architect for a role they consider pivotal to the technology decisions ahead of them.

This is deliberately not a role for a specialist in one platform. What matters more here is breadth, practicality and the ability to hold your own in front of senior stakeholders, translating technical trade-offs into commercial and business terms rather than jargon. You'll report into the IT leadership team and will regularly be in front of the transformation director, so you need to be someone they can trust to break a problem down clearly, whilst thinking with a commercial mindset. 

The work itself spans a genuinely varied portfolio. You'll provide the architectural thinking and governance that keeps a broad set of change initiatives resilient and aligned with a future Group ERP and operating model, moving between modern platforms and long-standing bespoke systems as the work demands.

We're looking for someone with significant, hands-on solution architecture experience across complex, multi-system environments, comfortable stepping into technology they haven't used before rather than needing deep prior expertise in every system. A background across distribution, warehousing or digital sales environments will suit this better than one built purely in financial services. Strong integration and data architecture knowledge is essential, along with solid technical governance and the communication skills to work confidently with business stakeholders, suppliers and third parties. Exposure to platforms such as Dynamics 365, Sage or NetSuite would help, and any background in bespoke or legacy technologies like C#, Delphi or COBOL is advantageous, though not essential. A relevant degree or equivalent experience is expected, and an architecture certification (TOGAF or similar) would be a plus.

This is a fixed-term PAYE contract paying up to £80,000, running to 30 June 2027 (not an off-payroll engagement, so IR35 doesn't apply). There's a genuine expectation this becomes a permanent role, though that isn't guaranteed at this stage. Hybrid working is ideally three days a week from Witham, Essex, with some flexibility on that, plus occasional travel to support the wider group.

Alongside salary, you'll get 33 days' annual leave including bank holidays, an extra day off for your birthday, company pension, dental plan, life assurance, enhanced family leave, an interest-free SmartPay loan scheme, Cycle2Work, an employee discounts portal, and mental health and virtual GP support.

jobs.description:
About the job

Successful candidates may be based in any of our office locations – Cardiff, Glasgow, or London. We especially welcome applicants from Cardiff and Glasgow. (20% hybrid, 1 day per week)

Job summary

Across government, cloud technology underpins the delivery of secure, scalable and modern digital services. As organisations adopt cloud-first strategies, strong architecture is essential to ensure platforms are well-designed, governed and able to deliver long-term value. Ofgem plays a vital role in the UK’s energy system, protecting consumers and enabling a more secure, fair and sustainable energy future, and a robust Architecture capability is central to this mission.

Within the Digital, Data and Security Services (DDSS) directorate, we are modernising our technology estate and expanding our use of Microsoft Azure as a core platform. This includes building secure, scalable and cost-effective solutions that support data, AI and digital services across the organisation.

As a Principal Technical Architect (Azure), you will play a key role in shaping how Azure is designed and used across Ofgem. You will define standards and governance, guide technical decision-making and support delivery teams to build high-quality cloud solutions. Working across programmes and domains, you will ensure architectural consistency, manage risk and embed architectural best practice across our Azure environment.

This is a highly influential technical role within a fast-paced and evolving environment, requiring deep Azure expertise and strong architectural capability.

Job description

You will be responsible for:

Defining and shaping Azure architecture standards, aligned to organisational and government frameworks
Establishing and embedding architectural patterns, principles and governance
Providing oversight and assurance for complex cloud solutions
Supporting architectural decision-making and managing technical risk
Promoting reusable frameworks and best practice across teams
Collaborating with stakeholders to align technology and business needs
Evaluating emerging Azure capabilities and supporting their adoption
Mentoring architects and engineers, building capability across DDSS

We are looking for:

A highly experienced technical architect who can shape and guide cloud architecture in a complex environment. You will bring strong Azure expertise alongside the ability to influence across teams.
You may come from a infrastructure, cloud, enterprise or platform background, but you will demonstrate:

Strong experience designing and delivering solutions on Microsoft Azure
Solid understanding of cloud architecture, governance and optimisation
Experience contributing to architectural standards and decision-making
Knowledge of security, identity and compliance in cloud environments
Ability to collaborate across teams and guide technical outcomes

Relevant certifications (e.g. Azure Solutions Architect Expert) is expected (or achievable).
Experience with Infrastructure as Code, DevOps or regulated environments is beneficial.
This is an opportunity to play a key role in shaping Ofgem’s architecture capability and Azure cloud platform. You will help ensure systems are secure, scalable and fit for the future, supporting digital transformation and services that impact consumers across Great Britain.

Person specification

Essential Criteria

Extensive experience in design and delivery of complex solutions on Microsoft Azure (Lead Criteria).

Demonstrable proficiency in technical direction, team mentorship, and guidance across multi-disciplinary IT teams and architects (Lead Criteria).

Understanding Azure security frameworks, compliance standards, and identity management models.
Proven capability in the definition and implementation of governance models for cloud adoption and optimisation.
Proficiency in architectural modelling tools such as Archi and frameworks, such as ArchiMate, UML, or equivalent, with the ability to create and maintain architectural artefacts.

Holds or can obtain the following certifications or equivalent:

Formal Architectural Qualification such as BCS EA Certification or equivalent.
Cloud Architecture Certification: Microsoft Azure Solution Architect (Expert).

Desirable Criteria

Experience with Infrastructure as Code and DevOps practices.
Understanding government digital standards and assurance processes.

Behaviours

We'll assess you against these behaviours during the selection process:
Seeing the Big Picture
Making Effective Decisions
Leadership

Technical skills

You will also be asked to prepare a presentation. Full details of the presentation will be included in the invitation to interview.

Benefits
Alongside your salary of £63,443, OFGEM contributes £18,379 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides (opens in a new window).

Ofgem can offer you a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes; 30 days annual leave after 2 years; Excellent training and development opportunities; The opportunity to join the generous Civil Service pension which also includes a valuable range of benefits; hybrid working (currently 1 day a week in the office but this is kept under review), flexible working hours and family friendly policies. Plus lots of other benefits including clean and bright offices based centrally, engaged networks and teams and an opportunity to contribute to our ambitious and important targets of establishing a Net Zero energy system by 2050. This exciting blend of professional challenge and personal reward identifies career opportunities at Ofgem as something to get excited about.

Things you need to know

Artificial intelligence

Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance (opens in a new window) for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.

Selection process details

This vacancy is using Success Profiles (opens in a new window), and will assess your Behaviours, Experience and Technical skills.

When you press the ‘Apply now’ button, you will be asked to complete personal details (not seen by the sift panel), your career history and qualifications.
You will then be asked to provide a 1250 word ‘personal statement’ evidencing how you meet the essential and desirable skills and capabilities listed in the role profile. Please ensure you demonstrate clearly, within your supporting statement, how you meet each of the criteria listed in the role profile.

The Civil Service values honesty and integrity and expects all candidates to abide by these principles. You must ensure that any evidence submitted as part of your application or used during interview, including your CV and any statements or examples, are truthful and factually accurate. Ofgem takes any incidences of cheating very seriously. Please ensure all examples provided are of your own experience. Any instances of plagiarism or other forms of cheating will be investigated and, if proven, the relevant applications will be withdrawn from the process. Please note that plagiarism can include presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own.

Please refer to Civil Service candidate advice on the acceptable use of artificial intelligence within the recruitment and selection process - Artificial intelligence and recruitment , Civil Service Careers

The personal information we have collected from you will be shared with Cifas who will use it to prevent fraud, other unlawful or dishonest conduct, malpractice, and other seriously improper conduct. If any of these are detected, you could be refused certain services or employment. Your personal information will also be used to verify your identity. Further details of how your information will be used by us and Cifas, and your data protection rights, can be found by [ https://www.cifas.org.uk/fpn ].

At Ofgem, we expect our staff to carry out their roles with honesty, fairness and openness. They should follow the Civil Service code and be free from any influence or bias. We are committed to making sure interests are recognised, declared and managed appropriately so that we can fulfil our duties as an energy regulator. Our Conflicts of Interest policy outlines the types of interests Ofgem staff must declare before onboarding, and the rules they must follow throughout employment so that we can clearly demonstrate that our decisions are not influenced by private interests.

jobs.description:
Introduction

At IBM Consulting UK FutureNow, you’ll build a career at the forefront of hybrid cloud and AI, working with leading clients across the public and private sectors.

You’ll collaborate with top industry professionals, gain hands on experience with cutting edge technologies, and deliver solutions that create real business impact. From day one, you’ll work on meaningful, high profile programmes that stretch your skills and accelerate your growth.

We invest heavily in you—supporting continuous learning, in demand skills development, and long term career progression. You’ll thrive in a flexible, inclusive environment that values curiosity, encourages reinvention, and recognises what makes you unique.

We Offer

Tools and policies to support your work-life balance from flexible working approaches, sabbatical programs, paid paternity leave, maternity leave and an innovative maternity returners scheme
More traditional benefits, such as 25 days holiday (in addition to public holidays), private medical, dental & optical cover, online shopping discounts, an Employee Assistance Program, life assurance and a group pension plan through salary sacrifice.

Your Role And Responsibilities

We are seeking IT Architects to lead the design and implementation of hybrid cloud application modernisation projects with our Public Sector clients. You will provide technical leadership for migrating existing applications to cloud and for building new cloud native solutions.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Providing, architectural, consultative and engineering support for our customers’ journeys to the cloud
Bringing industry insight to deliver innovative solutions, that are tailored to the specific needs of our customers
Leadership for transformations of enterprise complex projects, from system requirements through delivery and production/deployment, providing architectural and hands-on technical leadership to ensure overall solution integrity
Building strong relationships with our clients and acting as a trusted advisor

Preferred Education

Bachelor's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

You will be familiar with AWS or/and Azure and be comfortable with Microservice architectures and a range of cloud, devops and integration technologies. You will have worked on hybrid cloud complex systems integration projects designing elements of the target cloud solution and its integration with existing on-premise applications.

You will be comfortable working in ‘rainbow’ teams with multiple different suppliers or as part of a wholly IBM team. Your background is likely to be a mix of large-scale waterfall deliveries and more agile projects. You will be a hands-on professional with a proven track-record in keeping your skills up to date, ideally evidenced through recognized certifications.

Proficiency in designing and implementing hybrid cloud solutions combining on-premises and cloud-based services.

Experience in creating architecture diagrams component models and technology stacks for hybrid environments.

Deep understanding of major cloud providers (e.g. AWS Azure Google Cloud) and their respective services.

Familiarity with cloud-native services serverless computing and managed services.

Experience in designing managing and optimizing on-premises infrastructure including virtualization storage and networking.

Knowledge of on-premises automation tools (e.g. Ansible Puppet Chef).

Proficiency in designing and implementing secure connectivity solutions (e.g. VPNs Direct Connect VPN Gateways).

Experience in integrating on-premi

Public cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, IBM Cloud, Kubernetes etc.)
Strong understanding & delivery experience of cloud native architectures
Extensive experience using agile delivery methods, i.e. Scrum
Good understanding of scaled agile delivery methods, i.e. SAFe or LeSS

This role is subject to pre-employment screening in line with the UK Government’s Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS). An additional range of Personal Security Controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NVS) may apply, this could include meeting the eligibility requirements for The Security Check (SC) or Developed Vetting (DV).

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

Good knowledge of system design & delivery
Java & JavaScript frameworks eg Spring Boot, React, Angular, J2EE
Enterprise integration technologies (Kafka, MQ, IBM Streams, ESBs, ETL etc)
Enterprise level persistence technologies (Oracle, Postgres, DB2, NoSQL, Redis, Graph etc.)
Estimation experience (top down, bottom up, planning poker etc.)
Experienced in architectural languages or frameworks e.g. UML, Zachman, TOGAF
Understanding of Automation in the development, testing and operations context.

Job Description

Grade UE08: £50,253 to £61,759 per annum, pro rata if part time

Information Services Group / Web and Communications (WAC)

Full-time: 35 hours per week

Fixed-term: for 1 year

Shape What Happens Next. Be Part Of Something Bigger.

Make a meaningful impact

Here, you can continue to make a difference in everything around you. Take on new challenges, grow your career, be recognised for your contributions, and benefit from our commitment to your wellbeing. Be part of something bigger — where your work has real impact and your development matters. There are so many reasons to take your next step with us.

Professional Services

The University of Edinburgh is a world-class organisation. We are a large University covering a wide range of activities. In Professional Services, we support the University’s research and teaching, offering many career and role specialisms.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Senior Web Developer to help lead the continuous development and ongoing support of the University's central web services, principally the Web Publishing Platform (EdWeb 2) — the open-source, Drupal-based service behind nearly 170 environments and over 600 subsites, curated by more than 1,200 editors and reaching around 30 million users a year from across the world.

This is a senior, technically leading role. You'll set technical direction, architect and build complex enterprise-level features in Drupal, and champion the development, testing and coding standards that keep a platform of this scale robust. You'll also mentor and support the mid-level and junior developers around you — sharing knowledge and helping the whole team deliver high-quality software "small and often", through an agile, continuous-improvement approach.

You'll join the Website and Communications (WAC) team, a highly collaborative and supportive part of Information Services. We work in the open: EdWeb 2 and the University's Student & Staff Portal (MyEd) are both built on open-source software, reflecting the University's commitment to open software and data across its services.

We'd love to hear from someone with deep Drupal and PHP expertise and strong front-end skills, who's a creative, adaptable problem-solver with a genuine enthusiasm for emerging technologies and for bringing them into mainstream use, someone excited to shape a platform the whole University relies on.

People have always been at the heart of our work. Our people are at the centre of the University community and everything we do. We value colleagues with drive, determination and a passion for what they do. We are a place where everyone is welcome and offer a range of policies and benefits designed to support you in building the right meaningful flexibility that works for you.

A career with us has a range of other benefits that can be tailored to your lifestyle:

Professional development and subject matter expertise
Opportunities to develop new skills and broaden your experience
Responsibility and autonomy
Contributing to the work and purpose of the University.

This post is full-time (35 hours per week); however, we are open to considering part-time or flexible working patterns, such as compressed hours or longer breaks in the working day.

The team office location is at the west edge of the University’s central campus, in 5 Forrest Hill, Edinburgh, EH1 2QL.

The role follows a hybrid working pattern, combining time working from home with regular time on campus: we ask that colleagues spend at least two days a week on-site, one of which is our shared team anchor day, so the team can collaborate, support one another and stay connected in person.

View the full job description (opens in a new browser tab)

How To Apply

We welcome informal enquiries about the role, to find out more, please email Gareth Alexander (Web Development Team Manager) at gareth.alexander@ed.ac.uk

Please Include The Following Documents In Your Application

CV
Cover letter

As a valued member of our team, you can expect:

A competitive salary
An exciting, positive, creative, challenging and rewarding place to work.
To be part of a diverse and vibrant international community.
Comprehensive Staff Benefits, including generous annual leave entitlement, a defined benefits pension scheme, a wide range of staff discounts, family-friendly initiatives, and flexible work options. Check out the full list on our staff benefits page (opens in a new tab) and use our reward calculator to discover the value of your pay and benefits.

Championing equality, diversity, and inclusion

The University of Edinburgh holds a Silver Athena SWAN award in recognition of our commitment to advance gender equality in higher education. We are members of the Race Equality Charter, and we are also a Stonewall Proud Employer, actively promoting LGBTQ+ equality.

The University is committed to equality, diversity and inclusion. If you have the right skills for the job, we want to hear from you. We encourage applications from the right candidates regardless of age, gender identity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, belief or race.

Prior to any employment commencing with the University, you will be required to evidence your right to work in the UK. Further information is available on our right to work webpages
(opens new browser tab)

On this occasion the University will not consider applicants requiring sponsorship for this role. International workers will therefore only be able to take up this role if they can demonstrate an alternative right to work in the UK.

Key dates to note

The closing date for applications is 2 October 2026.

Unless stated otherwise, the closing time for applications is 11:59 pm UK time. If you are applying outside the UK , the closing time on our adverts automatically adjusts to your browser’s local time zone.

Interviews will be held at Forrest Hill (In-person)
the week commencing 12th October.

About Us

As a world-leading research-intensive University, we are here to address tomorrow’s greatest challenges. Between now and 2030 we will do that with a values-led approach to teaching, research and innovation, and through the strength of our relationships, both locally and globally.

About The Team

The Learning, Teaching & Web Services Directorate (LTW) brings together technology enhanced learning, e-learning, the University website, web services, graphics, multimedia, digital skills training and classroom technology teams to support learning, teaching and outreach for an enhanced student experience.

We provide a wide range of technology and support services for innovative learning and teaching, including classroom tools, virtual learning environment (VLE), blended learning, bespoke development, online video, open educational resources (OER), taught online Masters programmes, massive open online courses (MOOCs), feedback and assessment. We manage the continuing expansion and diversification of the University website, student portal, and provide digital technology services in 400 teaching rooms and study spaces across the campus.

Every year we host student internships, projects and events which promote innovation and align with the University strategic aims to promote new ways of working in learning, teaching and research.

You will have the opportunity to lead initiatives, influence decision-making, and deliver solutions that leave a tangible mark on both clients and the organization.
Engage with a diverse range of customers across multiple industries, working on complex infrastructure challenges and gaining exposure to a wide variety of technologies, environments, and skillsets. This variety ensures continuous learning and the opportunity to apply expertise in innovative ways.
Flexible, remote-first working arrangement with occasional travel, offering the freedom to manage your own schedule while maintaining strong client and team collaboration.

Lead the architecture of enterprise DevOps, DevSecOps, and Platform Engineering solutions.
Design engineering platforms supporting cloud-native and hybrid delivery models.
Define end-to-end CI/CD pipelines covering automated build, testing, security validation, deployment, and observability.
Embed security, governance, and compliance controls throughout the software development lifecycle.

Lead customer workshops and contribute to technical bids, proposals, cost models, and executive presentations.
Support the development of Atos DevOps, Platform Engineering, and Cloud-Native offerings and accelerators.

Skills And Experience

At least seven years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or Solution Architecture roles
Strong experience designing enterprise CI/CD platforms using Azure DevOps, GitHub Enterprise, GitLab, Jenkins, Argo CD, or equivalent technologies.
Proven experience architecting secure DevSecOps pipelines and automated compliance frameworks.
Deep knowledge of Infrastructure as Code and platform automation.
Experience designing Kubernetes-based container platforms.
Experience with observability technologies such as Datadog, Dynatrace, Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk, or Elastic.
Experience supporting complex presales engagements and explaining technical solutions to senior business and technology stakeholders.

Technical Architect

Contract

Rate
