Storm ID is an award-winning Edinburgh-based digital transformation consultancy that helps organisations accelerate their use of digital, data and AI. We believe in tailored solutions, assembling expert teams to address each client's unique needs. Our services span strategy, design, technology and data & AI, ensuring seamless end-to-end delivery of platforms, products and services with real-world impact.

Role Overview

Storm ID has delivered the Alpha phase of a prominent Scottish Government digital transformation programme. The work is focused on shaping and validating an end-to-end service model, including service mapping, early-stage integration activity and the development of an initial working capability within a secure test environment. 

The programme includes multiple related delivery streams being delivered by a mixed supplier and Scottish Government team. These streams cover user-facing digital journeys, supporting content and information architecture, and the underpinning service model and technical approach required to enable future phases. 

That architecture is documented in both a PoC High Level Design and Full-Service High-Level Design, supported by Architecture Decision Records.
The next phase requires: 
one or more iterations of the Full Service HLD based on a re-evaluation of technical and integration constraints. 
a body of options papers and ADRs that show the reasoning, alternatives and trade-offs behind each decision before the decision is written up. 
integration strategies for each justice partner that are specific to that partner's systems, appetite and supplier landscape. 
low level design of sufficient depth to assure, cost, plan and build a Beta. 

Essential skills and experience 

Substantial experience as a technical architect on complex, integration-heavy digital services, with a track record of designs that were successfully delivered. 
Demonstrable ownership of HLD and LLD artefacts through multiple iterations and formal architectural assurance, in a governed public sector or comparably regulated environment. 
Deep, practical systems integration expertise: event-driven and message-based architecture, service buses, asynchronous patterns, idempotency, replay, dead-lettering, eventual consistency, change data capture and reconciliation. 
Strong API design and integration with legacy and third-party systems that you do not control and cannot change. 
Data architecture: modelling, entity correlation and matching across systems without shared identifiers, data quality, migration and seeding, retention and deletion. 
Cloud architecture on Azure — networking, identity, data services, messaging, secrets, IaC and CI/CD; ability to size and cost a workload. 
Security and privacy by design: authentication and identity (OIDC/OAuth2, federated identity), threat modelling, data protection and information governance for sensitive personal data. 
Written argument. Options papers, ADRs and design documents that a sceptical technical reviewer can follow and act on.  
Stakeholder credibility. Able to hold a design position under sustained challenge from an assurance function, concede accurately when the challenge is right, and negotiate with partner organisations whose interests are not aligned with the programme's. 

Desirable skills and experience 

Experience in the justice, policing or public safety sector
Familiarity with Scottish Government common components; ScotAccount, Digital Mailbox, SG Cloud Platform, Scottish Government Design System and the Digital Scotland Service Standard. 
Experience designing services for vulnerable users
Experience with viewpoint-based architecture description (Rozanski & Woods or similar) and with C4 or equivalent modelling. 
Multi-organisation programme experience where architectural progress depends on organisational agreement.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Longshot Systems we build advanced platforms for sports betting analytics and trading.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to join the team that owns and develops our trading platform. Longshot is a small, focused company and so the role suits someone who can architect and implement whatever is needed to meet our next product, performance or stability goal. The team owns the technical standards and coding guidelines, CI/CD, observability and security. This role suits someone who wants to ship features and contribute to the wider technical excellence in the team and platform.

The trading platform at Longshot handles integrations with many bookmakers and exchanges worldwide. It normalises and combines the global odds data for many sports and makes it available internally for strategies to trade on. We handle thousands of odds updates and trades per second and have very strict bounds on latency, correctness and overall quality of the feed and trading. You would be at the heart of this team: integrating more trading venues, optimising key parts of the platform, making trading safer and faster, etc. We also maintain a significant historical data repository and support wider trading and research efforts around the company.

Our key platform systems are all in Golang, with message buses and databases at the core of the architecture. You don't need to be fluent in Golang, but it would help. It's easy to learn and we have a team full of experts able to teach you.

We are a hybrid working company, working Thursdays in our London (Farringdon) office and flexible the rest of the week. Our typical working hours are 10 am to 6 pm UK time, Monday to Friday, but we support flexible working and trust our team to manage their own schedules to meet their goals.

Interview Process

Intro call (30 mins) - your background + interests
1st Technical interview (30 mins) - live code review & pair programming
2nd Technical interview (60 mins) - deep dive technical questions
Full assessment day (10:30-5pm) - a one day systems programming exercise designed to be similar to the real work we do in the team. Meet some of the team, see the office, have a nice lunch (on us)

Requirements

Bachelors or Masters in a quantitative or technical subject (e.g. Maths, EE, Physics, Comp Sci) from a top university
2+ years experience building mission critical distributed systems (finance, gaming, telco, ad-tech, etc.) where throughput, correctness and availability are a hard requirement
Proven track record delivering and maintaining production systems in at least one systems language (Go, C++, Rust, Java, C#, etc.), with clear, idiomatic designs
Startup experience: shipping products in small, fast moving teams
Architecture & design: Able to reason about trade offs and produce clean, evolvable service boundaries
Cloud & DevOps: comfortable working in AWS, linux and wrangling build pipelines. We have dedicated DevOps people, but you do need to be competent in the core skills here
Fluent written and spoken English. Communicating with the team is as important as the technical work. You need to be able to effectively collaborate on everything from low level details to long term strategic planning

Nice to have

Trading, market making or exchange experience

Benefits

Participation in the uncapped company bonus scheme
10% matched pension contributions
Private healthcare insurance
Long term illness insurance
Gym membership

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Desktop
jobs.description:
What is Box?

Box (NYSE: BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.

By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It's the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together — and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

Why Box needs you:

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Desktop Applications team at Box, you'll be at the heart of building and evolving the products that millions of users rely on every day - Box Drive, Box Tools, and Box for Office on both Windows and macOS. You'll work across the full depth of the desktop stack, from virtual file systems and OS integrations to sync, networking, and UI, helping shape how enterprise content comes to life on the desktop. You'll collaborate closely with Product Managers, QA engineers, and designers to deliver features that are fast, reliable, and secure - and you'll bring a growth mindset and a passion for leveraging AI tools to accelerate your impact.

What you'll do:

Design, develop, and ship high-quality features for Box's desktop applications (Box Drive, Box Tools, Box for Office) on Windows and macOS, ensuring they are performant, user-friendly, and secure
Work across the full desktop stack — including virtual file systems, data persistence, OS integrations, network and sync layers, and UI — to solve complex technical challenges at scale
Contribute to cross-platform development using React Native, bridging front-end and native desktop experiences
Collaborate daily with Product Managers, QA engineers, and designers to translate requirements into robust, well-tested software
Lead and participate in design discussions, architecture reviews, and code reviews to uphold engineering quality and share knowledge across the team
Diagnose and resolve complex performance, reliability, and compatibility issues affecting millions of end users
Attend and engage in weekly stand-ups, team meetings, and manager 1:1s

Are you excited about leading high-scale platform engineering in the core fintech sector? We are searching for a dynamic Engineering Manager who leads the platform engineering team responsible for JVM and .NET platform health, DevOps tooling, CI/CD, observability, and deployment infrastructure across all FinTech products.

You will be accountable for platform reliability, cost efficiency, developer velocity, and AI readiness across the FinTech engineering organization. For this position, the candidate must be an engineer specializing in either .NET or Java.

Important things for you:

Flexible working hours
in the hybrid model (4/1) — working hours start between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. We also have 30 days of occasional remote work.
Depending on your annual assessment and the company's results we offer:
Annual bonus
based on your annual performance and company results.
Long term discretionary incentive plan
based on Allegro.eu shares (restricted stock units).
Our team is based in Warsaw
.

Your responsibilities:

Leads and manages a cross-functional platform engineering team.
Drives platform adoption and removes technical and operational blockers across product teams.
Oversees infrastructure provisioning, cloud resource management, and container orchestration on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
Coordinates fleet-scale migrations, including JVM and .NET platform development, Java, .NET, and Spring Boot upgrades.
Optimizes CI/CD pipelines, GitOps deployment safety (canary releases, configuration versioning), and infrastructure cost efficiency.
Integrates AI tools into platform engineering workflows to accelerate developer velocity company-wide.

Main challenges in this role:

High cloud logging and observability costs requiring validation and deployment of alternative logging backends like VictoriaLogs.
Scaling pipeline throughput and deployment safety to match the accelerated development speed driven by AI tools.
Modernizing JVM and .NET platform and tracking library adoption across products.
Balancing tight roadmap deadlines with team capacity and high operational interrupt volumes.

You are a strong leader with competencies in People Management, Talent Development, Strategic Thinking, Problem-Solving & Decision-Making, and Stakeholder Management.

Well-located offices (with e.g. fully equipped kitchens, bicycle parking, terraces full of greenery) and excellent work tools (e.g., raised desks, ergonomic chairs, interactive conference rooms).
A 16" or 14" MacBook Pro or corresponding Dell with Windows (if you don't like Macs) and all the necessary accessories.

English classes that we pay for related to the specific nature of your job.
A training budget, inter-team tourism (see more here), hackathons, and an internal learning platform where you will find multiple trainings.
An additional day off for volunteering, which you can use alone, with a team, or with a larger group of people connected by a common goal.
Social events for Allegro people - Spin Kilometers, Family Day, Fat Thursday, Advent of Code, and many other occasions we enjoy.

And that's just the beginning! You can read more about the benefits here.

You will love our level of autonomy in team organization, the space for continuous development, and the opportunity to try new things. You get to choose which technology solves the problem and you are responsible for what you create.

jobs.description:
Get to Know Us:

It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they're doing! At BlackLine, we're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business of enterprise applications. Since being founded in 2001, BlackLine has become a leading provider of cloud software that automates and controls the entire financial close process. Our vision is to modernize the finance and accounting function to enable greater operational effectiveness and agility, and we are committed to delivering innovative solutions and services to empower accounting and finance leaders around the world to achieve Modern Finance.
Being a best-in-class SaaS Company, we understand that bringing in new ideas and innovative technology is mission critical. At BlackLine we are always working with new, cutting edge technology that encourages our teams to learn something new and expand their creativity and technical skillset that will accelerate their careers.
This role is specifically for our AI-powered Invoice-to-Cash solution, a market leading platform that uses intelligent automation to help companies collect cash faster, unlock working capital, and supercharge efficiency in their accounts receivable processes.

Make Your Mark:

As an AI Engineer at BlackLine, you will be a key player in our mission to bring autonomous finance to every company in the world. You will be at the forefront of developing and deploying innovative applications that leverage the power of Large Language Models (LLMs) and foundation models. We are looking for a candidate with a deep understanding of AI Engineering with practical experience deploying GenAI solutions at scale.

You'll Get To:

Design, build, and deploy production-grade applications that leverage foundation models to deliver unprecedented insights and efficiency to Finance & Accounting teams.
Develop and implement robust evaluation methodologies for open-ended AI systems, including the use of "AI as a judge" to ensure our solutions meet the highest standards of accuracy and reliability.
Master and apply a variety of model adaptation techniques, including prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and fine-tuning, to tailor foundation models to specific financial use cases.
Create and manage datasets for training and fine-tuning models, ensuring data quality and relevance.
Build and deploy AI agents that can automate complex financial workflows and interact with various tools and systems.
Optimize the performance of our AI applications, focusing on reducing latency and cost to deliver a seamless user experience.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and implement the best AI-powered solutions to address the challenges faced by the office of the CFO.

What You'll Bring:

Technical/Specialized Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

Proven experience in developing and deploying applications using foundation models (e.g., GPT-4o/o3, Claude Opus 4.x / Sonnet 4.x, Llama 3.x).
A strong understanding of the principles of AI Engineering, as distinct from traditional Machine Learning Engineering.
Hands-on experience with prompt engineering, including techniques for few-shot and zero-shot learning, and defensive prompt design.
Practical knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture and its application in building knowledge-intensive applications.
Experience with fine-tuning LLMs and an understanding of when to use fine-tuning versus RAG.
Experience with building and evaluating AI agents that can perform complex, multi-step tasks.
Familiarity with the challenges of evaluating foundation models and experience with designing and implementing evaluation pipelines.
Proficiency in Python or C# and experience with relevant libraries and frameworks (e.g., Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, LangGraph, PyTorch).

We're Even More Excited If You Have:

Experience designing or operating AgenticOS patterns (e.g., memory management, tool registries, agent lifecycle orchestration, and inter-agent communication) to build reliable, production-grade autonomous agent systems.
Knowledge of techniques for optimizing inference, including quantization and other methods to improve latency and cost.
Expertise in multi-modal generative models (e.g., text, image, audio) and a proven ability to apply them to create innovative enterprise solutions.
A deep understanding of dataset engineering, including data curation, augmentation, and synthesis. Proven experience in designing and building end-to-end Generative AI systems, from data ingestion and model orchestration to scalable deployment and continuous monitoring.
A strong grasp of LLMOps principles and hands-on experience with tools and platforms for managing the entire lifecycle of Large Language Models in production.
Experience with Model Composition (MCP) techniques, demonstrating an ability to solve complex problems by intelligently combining multiple specialized models or AI agents.
Deep knowledge of Responsible AI principles and practical experience in implementing robust guardrails, safety filters, and ethical considerations into generative models to ensure fairness, transparency, and accountability.
Familiarity with the financial domain and the challenges of applying AI in a regulated industry.

Thrive at BlackLine Because You Are Joining:

A technology-based company with vision and ambition.
A culture that is kind, open, and diverse.
A workplace that empowers growth and continuous learning.
Professional development seminars and inclusive affinity groups.
Equal opportunity employer - inclusivity at the core.
Hybrid work model: at least 3 days per week in office for local candidates

jobs.description:
Dołącz do Etteplan

W Etteplan wierzymy, że technologia ma sens tylko wtedy, gdy pomaga rozwiązywać realne problemy biznesowe. Tworzymy i rozwijamy rozwiązania software'owe dla klientów z różnych gałęzi przemysłu, łącząc kompetencje z obszaru software, inżynierii i digitalizacji.

Obecnie poszukujemy Senior Java Developera
, który dołączy do projektu realizowanego dla międzynarodowego klienta z sektora przemysłowego i będzie współtworzył rozwiązania wykorzystywane w codziennej działalności organizacji działających na rynkach międzynarodowych.

O projekcie

Dołączysz do zespołu rozwijającego platformę wspierającą procesy produkcyjne oraz zarządzanie dokumentacją i jakością w środowisku przemysłowym. Rozwiązanie wykorzystywane jest przez międzynarodowe organizacje i odgrywa istotną rolę w ich codziennej działalności operacyjnej.

Projekt obejmuje zarówno rozwój nowych funkcjonalności, jak i utrzymanie oraz stopniową modernizację istniejących rozwiązań. Nie jest to wyłącznie development ani wyłącznie maintenance - zależy nam na osobach, które potrafią spojrzeć na system całościowo, proponować usprawnienia i brać odpowiedzialność za jakość dostarczanych rozwiązań.

Na co dzień będziesz współpracować z międzynarodowym zespołem oraz ekspertami biznesowymi i technicznymi po stronie klienta.

Jak wykorzystujemy AI?

W tym projekcie narzędzia AI są naturalnym elementem codziennej pracy zespołu. Wspierają analizę kodu, implementację nowych funkcjonalności, automatyzację powtarzalnych zadań oraz zwiększanie efektywności procesu wytwarzania oprogramowania.

Szukamy osoby, która świadomie wykorzystuje rozwiązania AI jako wsparcie swojej pracy i chce rozwijać ten sposób tworzenia oprogramowania.

Dlaczego warto?

W tej roli:

rozwijasz rozwiązania wykorzystywane przez międzynarodową organizację z sektora przemysłowego,
masz realny wpływ na kierunek rozwoju systemu oraz jakość dostarczanych rozwiązań,
pracujesz w środowisku, które ceni samodzielność, inicjatywę i odpowiedzialność zamiast szczegółowego zarządzania zadaniami,
współpracujesz bezpośrednio z doświadczonym zespołem oraz klientem,
wykorzystujesz nowoczesne narzędzia AI wspierające proces tworzenia oprogramowania,
masz możliwość okazjonalnych wyjazdów służbowych do Finlandii lub Norwegii.

W tej roli będziesz odpowiadać za:

rozwój oraz utrzymanie aplikacji opartych o Javę,
implementację nowych funkcjonalności oraz analizę i usuwanie błędów,
pracę z relacyjnymi bazami danych oraz warstwą dostępu do danych,
integrację aplikacji z pozostałymi komponentami środowiska klienta,
współpracę z zespołami technicznymi i biznesowymi,
dbanie o jakość kodu, wydajność oraz dobre praktyki inżynierskie,
proponowanie usprawnień oraz aktywny udział w rozwoju systemu,
wykorzystywanie narzędzi AI wspierających proces wytwarzania oprogramowania.

Jesteś naszym brakującym ogniwem, jeśli:

masz kilkuletnie doświadczenie komercyjne jako Senior Java Developer,
bardzo dobrze znasz Javę oraz środowisko WildFly,
posiadasz praktyczne doświadczenie z Hibernate, JPA lub innymi rozwiązaniami ORM,
pracowałeś/-aś z bazami danych Microsoft SQL Server oraz Oracle,
rozumiesz zagadnienia związane ze środowiskami kontenerowymi, maszynami wirtualnymi oraz infrastrukturą aplikacyjną,
lubisz przejmować odpowiedzialność za realizowane rozwiązania i doprowadzać zadania do końca,
dobrze odnajdujesz się zarówno przy rozwoju nowych funkcjonalności, jak i utrzymaniu istniejących systemów,
wykorzystujesz narzędzia AI jako wsparcie codziennej pracy programistycznej,
swobodnie komunikujesz się w języku angielskim.

Docenimy również doświadczenie w jednym lub kilku z poniższych obszarów:

integracja systemów z wykorzystaniem brokerów komunikatów, takich jak RabbitMQ,
rozwój i utrzymanie aplikacji działających w środowiskach produkcyjnych,
projektowanie lub rozwój systemów o rozproszonej architekturze,
współpraca z klientami z sektora przemysłowego lub produkcyjnego,
wykorzystanie narzędzi AI do automatyzacji i usprawniania procesu developmentu,
zainteresowanie tematyką spawalnictwa lub doświadczenie zdobyte w branży przemysłowej.

W Etteplan możesz liczyć na:

rozwój poprzez pracę w międzynarodowym środowisku i różnorodnych projektach oraz wymianę wiedzy w grupach kompetencyjnych,
budżet szkoleniowy i indywidualną ścieżkę rozwoju wspieraną przez regularne spotkania z managerem,
prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover, kartę MultiSport, grupowe ubezpieczenie na życie oraz dofinansowanie do posiłków,
elastyczne godziny pracy i możliwość współpracy w modelu hybrydowym,
udział w inicjatywach technologicznych oraz społecznościach eksperckich,
możliwość okazjonalnych wyjazdów służbowych do krajów nordyckich.

Możesz też zajrzeć na naszą stronę internetową lub Facebooka i zobaczyć, co ciekawego się u nas dzieje!

jobs.title: Azure Cloud Architect
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services. We offer solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Accenture Song. For more information about Accenture Technology Poland please visit our website.

THE WORK

As an Cloud Architect in our Accenture Cloud First team, you will help enterprise clients design and evolve secure, scalable and cost‑efficient cloud landscapes, supporting their digital transformation journeys. Your work will include:

Designing end‑to‑end architectures for cloud, hybrid and on‑premises environments on Microsoft Azure, including Azure Landing Zones, governance and security models.

Defining and implementing compute environments (autoscaling, load balancing, serverless solutions), Azure database services and CI/CD pipelines, with integration to existing on‑premises services.

Designing cloud‑native networking (VNETs, peering, firewalls, container networking) and security & compliance controls (IAM, resource hierarchy, data security, cost management and billing).

Implementing monitoring, logging, profiling and alerting solutions to ensure reliability and observability of client platforms.

Preparing migration approaches and onboarding plans to Azure, including effort estimation, cost and resource calculations, and optimization scenarios.

Partnering with DevOps and engineering teams to apply Infrastructure as Code and automation practices, improve delivery pipelines and support a mature DevOps culture.

Leading or supporting incident, request, change and problem management activities, acting as a trusted technical advisor for client stakeholders.

Flexible: The work location for this role may include a mix of working remotely, onsite at a client or in an Accenture office - depending on specific project circumstances. With all our roles, there is some in-person time for collaboration, learning and building relationships with clients, peers, leaders, and communities. As an employer, we will be as flexible as possible to support your specific work/life needs.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

Join Accenture’s Cloud First team if you are motivated to embrace new opportunities, enthusiastic about professional growth and dedicated to evolving your skills. You will:

Work on large‑scale cloud transformation projects for international enterprise clients, expanding your Azure and architecture skill set.

Shape modern cloud, hybrid and on‑premises platforms using automation, containers and DevOps practices, continuously enhancing your technical expertise.

Collaborate with experienced cloud professionals in a diverse team, gaining insights and feedback that support your continuous learning and development.

HERE’S WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

5+ years of hands‑on experience in Azure cloud infrastructure engineering.

In‑depth knowledge of Microsoft Azure, supported by advanced/Expert‑level Azure certifications.

Ability to oversee the work of development teams, plan their tasks and translate technical requirements into a structured and actionable backlog.

Experience designing and planning highly available systems, including implementing Disaster Recovery strategies.

Ability to translate client business requirements into technical specifications and ensure their implementation through appropriate configurations within a broader Landing Zone architecture.

Strong understanding of container technologies and orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes, OpenShift, AKS).

Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation tools.

Solid grasp of virtualization technologies.

Comprehensive knowledge of DevOps culture, practices and tools (e.g., Jenkins, Git/GitLab, Pipelines, Helm charts, ArgoCD).

Ability to develop scripts and applications using at least one language (e.g., Bash or Python).

Experience in cost and resource calculations, as well as optimization for cloud environments.

Enterprise architecture experience within public cloud environments, including creating migration plans and managing onboarding processes.

Proficiency in troubleshooting and managing incidents, requests, changes and problems.

Upper‑intermediate level of English and Polish (spoken and written).

Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively in a team.

BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE:

Experience with at least one modern programming language (e.g., PowerShell, Azure CLI, Node.js, React, .NET, Python or Java).

Expertise in one or more Azure service categories, such as:

Azure systems infrastructure (Windows/Linux OS, networking, storage, high availability, disaster recovery, cloud security, application performance).

App Services (Web Apps, Mobile Apps, API Apps, Logic Apps).

Experience in technical sales support or pre‑sales activities.

Kubernetes Developer or Security‑oriented certification.

Research indicates that some candidates, especially the most diverse ones, may hesitate to apply for positions if they don't meet all requirements. If you believe you possess the necessary skills, even if not meeting every requirement, we wholeheartedly encourage you to submit your application.

WHAT WE OFFER?

A permanent employment contract.

Individual support of a People Lead and a specific path of professional development, as well as the possibility of a session with a Coach.

A wide training package (soft, technical, and language training offer, access to the e‑learning platforms, Gallup test, GenAI training, possibility of co‑financing courses, and certification).

Employee Assistance Program – legal, financial, and psychological consultations.

Accenture employees eligible for the Employee share purchase plan automatically become eligible for quarterly dividends if they own company shares

Paid employee referral program.

Private medical care, and life insurance.

Access to the Worksmile platform (possibility of using a wide range of products and services, including the Multisport card).

WHAT WE BELIEVE:

Accenture does not discriminate against employment candidates based on race, religion, color, sex, age, disability, national origin, political beliefs, trade union membership, ethnicity, denomination, sexual orientation, or any other basis impermissible under Polish law. Inclusion and diversity are fundamental to our culture and core values. Sustainability is one of our greatest responsibilities, and we embed it into everything we do and for everyone we work with.

jobs.title: System Developer - Portfolio Investments Applications
jobs.description:
Myntro is a company in the middle of a transformation, shifting toward a more product- and technology-driven, data-enabled business. We are looking for a System Developer who wants to join that journey and help build our future. Are you a curious builder who enjoys creating new systems, navigating complexity, and using modern technology to solve real business problems? Then keep reading!

About The Role

As a System Developer at Myntro, you'll join a small DevOps team with end-to-end ownership of applications and systems at the heart of our debt portfolio investment business. Working closely with our investment team, you'll help turn complex portfolio data into reliable systems that support valuation, purchasing decisions, and portfolio management.

Our current focus is building a new investment platform and the services around it. You'll have real opportunities to design and build new capabilities, while also improving and maintaining the existing systems that keep the business running. You'll contribute across the development lifecycle and help shape technical decisions with both immediate and long-term impact.

In this role, you will:

Design, build, and maintain systems, services, and integrations for our debt portfolio investment business.
Develop a new investment platform that supports portfolio valuation, purchasing, and management.
Take ownership from design and implementation through deployment, operation, and continuous improvement.
Build with C#/.NET, SQL, Azure services, and microservice and event-driven architectures.
Improve and simplify existing applications and data flows in a complex technical landscape.
Contribute to architecture, Azure infrastructure, code quality, testing, observability, and how we build.

Who You Are

We are looking for someone who is curious, self-driven, and likes real engineering work. You enjoy understanding both the business problem and how systems actually behave, finding weak points, and making them better. You're comfortable exploring unfamiliar areas and learning what you need to move the work forward.

You take ownership, care about quality, and like building things that hold up in production. You're pragmatic and collaborative, but you don't wait for someone else to define every step. You can move between new development, architecture, infrastructure, data, and existing applications based on what the problem requires.

AI-assisted development isn't new to you; it's already part of how you work. You have your own setup, your own opinions, and you're paying attention to where the craft is heading. That matters here. We're actively building AI into both how we develop and what we deliver, and we need people who are already leaning in, not catching up.

We see that you likely have:

A degree in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
3+ years of software development experience, ideally in production-critical environments.
Strong .NET/C# development skills.
Solid understanding of SQL, data modelling, and data flows.
Hands-on experience with Azure, cloud infrastructure, and microservice architectures.
Good communication skills in Swedish and English.

Experience in investment systems, finance, or debt portfolios is not required. What matters is that you're interested in learning the business context and applying your engineering skills to it.

Why join Myntro?

At Myntro, you'll work in a small team with broad ownership and close access to the people who use what you build. The new investment platform is important to how we value, purchase, and manage debt portfolios, and there is still plenty to design, build, and shape.

This is a good place if you are looking for variety, responsibility, and the opportunity to combine software development with architecture, cloud infrastructure, data, and real business problems. You'll be part of a team that's expected to think, build, operate, and improve together.

Our culture is built on care, accountability, and the belief that the best results come from working together. Collaboration, customer focus, personal accountability, and simplicity are how we actually make decisions, not just words on a wall.

Interested? Welcome to apply!

Sounds like your next challenge? We review applications and interview on a rolling basis, so don't wait too long to apply. The role is full-time and based at our head office in central Gothenburg.

For questions regarding the role or recruitment process, please contact Azra Semic, our Talent Acquisition Specialist – azra.semic@myntro.com.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Act as a senior technical colleague by mentoring less experienced developers, reviewing their work and sharing knowledge across the team.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Onsite Messaging
jobs.description:
We’re excited to welcome our first Staff Software Engineer to the newly forming Onsite Messaging team at Voyado.

Onsite Messaging (OSM) is one of Voyado’s most important customer engagement channels. Instead of communicating through email or SMS, OSM enables retailers to engage customers directly on their websites with personalized experiences based on real-time behavior. Every interaction can be measured, understood and optimized, making OSM a key part of creating seamless customer journeys.

We’re now bringing OSM onto Voyado’s Engage platform, and this role will play a central part in making that happen. You’ll join at the beginning of that journey, helping shape both the technical direction and the engineering practices while building a brand-new team in Stockholm together with colleagues in India.

About The Role

This is a Staff Engineer role for someone who enjoys leading through technology.

You'll act as the technical driver for Onsite Messaging. The frontend is moving into Voyado's Engage platform, while the backend continues to run and evolve on AWS — so you'll own both sides of that seam and make sure it holds together well. The transition is one chapter, not the job description. Although the role comes with significant technical ownership, it remains deeply hands-on. You’ll write code, review code, challenge architectural decisions and help the team make sound engineering choices every day.

Initially, much of the focus will be understanding the existing solution, reviewing code and working closely with our engineering team in India as knowledge and ownership gradually move to Stockholm. As the transition progresses, your focus will shift towards driving the technical roadmap, enabling new product development and shaping the future Onsite platform.

Onsite Messaging also sits on a shared JavaScript foundation that several Voyado products load on retailer sites. Getting that foundation into good shape — as a platform other teams can build on — is part of this role.

Who you are

We're looking for someone operating at around 8-10 years of engineering experience, who has been the person other engineers turn to on hard system design questions.

You don’t need experience from our exact technology stack, but we believe you’ve worked with several of the following:

Modern backend development in C#, .NET (out tech stack), or Comfortable moving between languages; Java, Kotlin, Go or similar
JavaScript and TypeScript, with experience working across both frontend and backend when needed
AWS, and serverless architecture in particular — our backend runs on that. Experience with Azure or GCP equivalents is fine if you're happy to work in AWS
Distributed systems, scalable web applications and high-traffic products
System design, software architecture and large technical migrations
CI/CD, observability, automated testing and engineering best practices

We also think you:

have successfully led complex technical initiatives or migration projects
enjoy reviewing code and helping other engineers grow
communicate confidently across teams, cultures and technical disciplines
thrive in environments where not everything has been defined yet
enjoy collaborating with distributed engineering teams
use AI coding tools as a natural part of software development and know how to review and quality-assure AI-generated code

High Impact. Great People. Real Growth.

You’ll join a company with strong momentum, modern technology, and a collaborative culture where ideas and initiatives are encouraged.

At Voyado, we care about creating an environment where people can grow, collaborate, and enjoy the journey together. We move quickly, challenge ideas, and work closely across teams to deliver meaningful impact.

Some of our benefits:

30 days of vacation
Wellness allowance
Personal development opportunities
Summits and team activities
Four days from the office and one day from home

About Voyado

Voyado is the Agentic Customer Experience Suite for retail.

More than 500 retail brands across 100 markets use Voyado to unite CRM, loyalty, product discovery, e-commerce personalization, and retail media with retail-trained AI that acts on real-time shopper intent.

By combining customer data with product intelligence, Voyado helps retailers deliver more relevant experiences across every channel — online and in-store. The result is more traffic, higher conversions, stronger customer relationships, and measurable business impact.

We’re growing across Europe and are looking for people who want to help shape the future of retail technology.

Ready to make an impact?

Fantastic! 🎉

Applying is easy — submit your LinkedIn profile or upload your resume. We’d love to hear what excites you about this role and what challenges you’re eager to take on. Be yourself, and let your passion shine through.

Additional information

As part of our recruitment process, we conduct a background check on the final candidate.

Making it personal with AI

We believe you’ll position yourself best for success in the interview process by being yourself, with support from AI where it makes sense. Later in the process, you may even be expected to use AI. At the end of the day, what matters is meeting you — the person behind the application.

There is no such thing as a perfect candidate; we’re all human, so please bring your authentic self. Don’t let AI over-polish your CV or answers to the point where we can’t hear your real voice, because that’s what we care about most.

In today’s hyper-competitive market, we help over 500 retail brands across 100 markets attract, convert, and retain loyal customers.

As the Agentic CX Suite for Retail we help retailers achieve a unified customer view through AI-powered CRM, loyalty management, product discovery, and advertising to increase customer lifetime value.

Description

Customer Support Engineer – Hybrid – Gothenburg, Sweden

We seek a Customer Support Engineer to join our team at Microdeb in Gothenburg, Sweden!

About The Role

We're looking for a Support Engineer to join our team in Gothenburg. This is not a ticket-shuffling role. You'll be the person customers rely on when something breaks, when a query won't return, when a deployment misbehaves — and you'll have the technical depth to actually fix it, not just escalate it. You'll work across SQL databases, light development tasks, and customer-facing troubleshooting, with modern AI tools as a core part of how you work.

What You'll Do

Own customer issues end-to-end, from first contact through root cause and resolution.

Answer and handle incoming customer support calls as part of the day-to-day role, providing first-line technical assistance, troubleshooting issues, and taking ownership of follow-up through to resolution.

Diagnose and resolve database problems: query performance, indexing, locking, data integrity, backup and recovery.

Write and review SQL — from quick investigative queries to stored procedures and schema changes.

Read, debug, and occasionally patch application code to identify the source of issues.

Reproduce bugs in test environments, file detailed reports for engineering, and follow through. Build internal tools, scripts, and automations that reduce repeat work and speed up diagnosis.

Experience with cloud databases (Azure SQL, AWS RDS, Snowflake, or similar). Familiarity with observability tools (Datadog, Grafana, OpenTelemetry). Exposure to CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code. Swedish language skills are a must for this role.

Why this role

:

Demonstrable SQL expertise: joins, window functions, CTEs, indexing strategy, query plan analysis, and performance tuning on a major RDBMS (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Oracle)

Working knowledge of Git and standard development workflows (branches, pull requests, code review)
Experience using AI coding assistants and LLMs as part of a daily workflow — writing prompts that produce useful output, knowing when to verify, knowing when not to use them.
Strong written and spoken English. Eligible to work in Sweden

Preferred

Familiarity with Linux command line, shell scripting, and basic networking (DNS, TLS, HTTP, firewalls)
Exposure to containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes). Experience with logging and observability stacks (ELK, Datadog, Grafana, Splunk, OpenTelemetry)

Swedish language skills

Curious by default — you want to know why something broke, not just how to make the symptom go away

jobs.title: AI Software Developer i Stockholm
jobs.description:
Vi tror på- och vill förverkliga en AI- och datadriven framtid. Vi söker AI Software Developers som vill vara med och hjälpa våra kunder inom olika branscher att omvandla AI-experiment till skalbara, säkra och värdeskapande lösningar.

Hos oss blir du del av ett växande område med runt 20 konsulter inom Cloud, AI och systemutveckling. Samtidigt får du kollegor från hela Solita med expertis i allt från data, strategi och mycket mer att dela kunskap och perspektiv med, läs mer om det här.

När vi växer gör dina möjligheter också det, du får vara med och påverka kulturen, affären och din roll.

En dag på Solita

En dag på Solita kan börja med ett standup-möte med ditt team på kunduppdraget, ibland består det av fler kollegor från Solita. Är det fredag kanske du jobbar från Solitas kontor i Stockholm för att starta dagen med frukost. Andra dagar jobbar du från kundens kontor eller hemifrån.

Sen kliver du in i ditt arbete: när du stöter på ett problem söker du upp en lång diskussionstråd i slack med insikter från kollegor som haft samma problem. Andra gånger passar du på att fråga en kollega vid kaffemaskinen om deras perspektiv för att komma vidare. Du kan också delta i våra interna utbildningsmöten, där vi delar kunskap om allt från nya teknologier och arbetssätt till välmående. Vissa dagar avslutar du med AW, filmkväll, brädspel eller annan aktivitet du och kollegor tycker är kul.

Din roll som AI Software Developer

Du är med i hela utvecklingscykeln, inte sällan från tidigt pre-sales stadie eller i förstudier, för att utveckla, driftsätta och optimera agent-baserade och datadrivna system som hjälper kunder fatta bättre beslut eller automatisera processer på ett intelligent sätt. Exempelvis kan du arbeta med prompt optimering, designa och implementera RAG-arkitektur, utveckla AI-agenter, MCP-servrar, APIer och backend lösningar för att integrera befintliga system till LLM-tjänster. Läs mer om att jobba med AI på Solita här.

Utöver moderna systemutveckling-tekniker kommer du arbeta med diverse AI-verktyg och ramverk som exempelvis LangChain, Tensorflow, AI Foundry och Semantic Kernel för att nämna några. Då vi jobbar teknikagnostiskt får du stor frihet att forma teknikval och arkitektur för att möta affärsbehov. Läs mer om hur kollegor jobbar och diskuterar kring olika teknikval i vår Dev blog här.

Känner du igen dig i följande?

Du kan kommunicera på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Det är ett plus om du varit konsult tidigare men det huvudsakliga är din förmåga att snabbt komma in i nya sammanhang och lära dig. Du är trygg i rollen tack vare din erfarenhet av både systemutveckling (särskilt om du jobbat i C# .NET eller Java Spring Boot) samt:

RAG- eller AI-agentarkitektur
Att bygga AI-drivna applikationer med moderna ramverk som ex. Semantic Kernel, LangChain eller liknande.
Att implementera molnbaserade AI-tjänster och produktionssätta AI-lösningar med hjälp av DevSecOps och IaC.

Vi letar inte bara efter tekniska skills, vi vill jobba med dig som tar ansvar för att bygga rätt lösningar på rätt sätt genom att utmana med omtanke. Du ser kod som ett hantverk, inte bara ett medel till funktion: du bryr dig om kvalitet, läsbarhet och hållbarhet. Du kommer trivas hos oss om du tycker om att dela med dig av din kunskap lika mycket som du är nyfiken på- och lyfter andras. .

Vad vi erbjuder

Vår företagskultur är väldigt viktig för oss. Vi värdesätter låg hierarki, självständighet och ansvar, värdeskapande arbete och trevliga kollegor. Här kan du läsa mer om vår kultur, och här kan du bläddra bland våra tech-bloggar.
Meningsfulla projekt: Arbeta i en agil miljö där du kan påverka teknikval och arbetssätt för att skapa de bästa lösningarna
Flexibilitet och autonomi för att utforma ditt arbete med flextider– läs mer från vår blogg.
Ständig utveckling: Vi erbjuder kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling för att säkerställa att våra medarbetare ligger längst fram i teknikutvecklingen.
Innovativ kultur: Arbeta tillsammans med några av de främsta experterna inom data, analys och utveckling

Utöver detta får du även ta del av följande förmåner:

💰 Fast lön oberoende av beläggningsgrad med möjlighet till löneväxling till ditt pensionssparande
🏦 Pensionsavsättning i linje med ITP1 samt möjlighet till löneväxling till ditt pensionssparande vid inkomst över 8,07 inkomstbasbelopp
🏖️ 30 semesterdagar
😃 Sjukvårdsförsäkring för både din mentala och fysiska hälsa som täcker dig även utanför tjänstetid
🏋️ ♀️ Friskvårdsbidrag på 5000 kr via Benifex (tidigare Benify).
💻 Ett brett nätverk av erfarna specialister från olika områden inom tech att samarbeta med
🔗 Intern coach för att stödja ditt välbefinnande
🪩 After Work och hobbyaktiviteter
🥐 Fredagsfrukostar

Vilka är vi?

Solita är ett värderingsstyrt konsultbolag med över 2000 medarbetare i 9 länder, varav ca 230 i Sverige. Vår storlek gör oss tillräckligt stora för att vara en stabil och innovativ arbetsgivare, men samtidigt tillräckligt små för att värna om våra medarbetare och kunder. Med bred kompetens inom digital transformation erbjuder vi en dynamisk arbetsmiljö. Hos oss får du friheten att utvecklas, både professionellt och personligt.

Intresserad av att höra mer?

Låter det som en spännande möjlighet? Skicka in din ansökan och bli en del av vårt team som ligger i framkant av AI-utveckling!
Skicka in din ansökan och bli en del av vårt team som ligger i framkant inom AI-utveckling. Om du har några frågor, skriv gärna till Jacob Beck på LinkedIn eller mailadressen jacob.beck@solita.se.

Hur ser processen ut?

I rekryteringsprocessen tror vi på en snabb och effektiv process. Du ansöker med CV eller LinkedIn och svarar på några korta frågor. Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande. Om vi ser en potentiell matchning, bjuder vi in dig till ett första möte för att lära känna dig och berätta mer om vår kultur och våra värderingar på Solita. I andra intervjun fokuserar vi på din tekniska kompetens och din erfarenhet. Om allt går bra tar vi oss vidare till sista steget där vi presenterar ett erbjudande och välkomnar dig som ny Solitan!

Placeringsort för denna roll är i Stockholm, Sverige

You will strive to constantly improve our results by leveraging AI and analyzing data to answer business questions and guide our engineering decisions.

Play a fundamental role in defining and building products used by millions of people.

Work in a modern new workspace as part of a team that values results, flexibility, and fun.

Description

Are you excited by the prospect of solving some of the hardest and most valued technical challenges of cloud computing? Do you want to apply your deep analytical and engineering skills to the space of highly-available replicated databases? Come join us in Amazon RDS and help us innovate!

The AWS Relational Database Service (RDS) is one of the largest cloud database businesses, providing super-simple provisioning and management for databases in the cloud. Customers can set up a new database with just a few clicks, and complex administrative tasks like scaling, fail-over, and monitoring are handled in an automated fashion by our control systems. Providing such simplified management for customers comes with the challenge of building sophisticated and reliable control systems. The systems we build manage huge numbers of databases and vast amounts of storage across multiple datacenters world-wide, and our service is growing rapidly, requiring constant innovations in our systems in order to handle the next order of magnitude in service scale.

We’re looking for a Software Development Engineer to join us and take ownership of significant features and components end-to-end. You’ll work on distributed systems that operate at scale across every AWS region from Active Directory and Kerberos authentication improvements, to third-party integrations, to tooling that helps customers manage their workload in our managed service. You will own the design and delivery of complex components, work independently through ambiguity, and help raise the technical bar for the team through design and code reviews and mentorship of junior engineers.

AWS Utility Computing (UC) which provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Own and Lead design discussions, making sound trade-offs across performance, security, reliability, and maintainability.
Work on third party integrations and security capabilities.
Troubleshoot production issues and drive both immediate fixes and long-term corrective actions.
Mentor junior engineers, participate in design and code reviews, and contribute to team-wide engineering standards.
Collaborate with product managers, partner teams, and stakeholders to translate customer needs into technical deliverables.

Build high-impact solutions to deliver to our large customer base.
Participate in design discussions, code review, and communicate with internal and external stakeholders.
Work cross-functionally to help drive business decisions with your technical input.
Work in a startup-like development environment, where you’re always working on the most important stuff.

We are the Dublin based team for RDS SQL Server, a close-knit group of engineers who care deeply about building secure, reliable database management technology that customers trust with their most critical workloads. Our work spans vendor integrations, security and authentication, multi-region expansion, and migration tooling, so no two problems look quite the same.

We value ownership, curiosity, and a bias for action. Whether it’s deepening your database internals expertise, working across AWS service teams, or driving a feature from design to global rollout, you’ll find room to grow here and a team that has your back.

We are a collaborative team that values ownership, customer obsession, and technical excellence. We partner broadly across RDS and take pride in making complex things simple. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

The Opportunity

At Easee, we're building technology that makes electrification effortless. Our products are used across Europe, and our success depends on attracting people who share our ambition, curiosity, and commitment to great results.

As our Software Engineer, you'll help build, test, and maintain the RESTful APIs and microservices that power Easee's platform. You'll write clean, well-tested code while working closely with senior engineers on backend architecture. This is a role designed for someone with solid backend foundations who is ready to take ownership of real services in a supportive, collaborative environment.

Working alongside the API team, Frontend Engineers, the Platform team, and Product Support, you will help make sure our services are reliable, well-tested, and built to scale.

What's In It For You

A collaborative environment with experienced senior engineers for code reviews, architectural discussions, and technical sparring
High ownership over feature design and implementation, backed by strong team support when you need it
Opportunities to design end-to-end systems independently, particularly in the EV charger domain
A clear path from Software Engineer to Senior Software Engineer as you grow

Core Outcomes

Short-term

You have completed onboarding, set up your local development environment, and have a clear understanding of our core API codebases.
You have shipped early bug fixes and feature enhancements to production, building familiarity with our system architecture and review practices.
You have integrated smoothly into the API team's daily workflows, code review practices, and sprint cadence.

Long-term

You have full autonomy in designing and deploying end-to-end API features.
You have a deep understanding of our core system architecture and data flows.
You actively contribute ideas that improve our test and development workflows.

What You Need To Bring Along

A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or equivalent practical experience. Relevant hands-on experience can compensate for formal education.
2–4 years of professional backend development experience in a production environment.
Proven experience building, testing, and maintaining RESTful APIs or microservices.
Core programming skills in at least one backend language (e.g., .Net and C# (what we use), Java, or Go).
A solid understanding of REST principles, HTTP, and relational or NoSQL databases.
Familiarity with Git, Docker, automated testing frameworks, and CI/CD pipelines.

Interview Process

(30m) Recruiter Screen
(30m) Hiring Manager Screen
(90m) Hands-On Challenge and Technical Deep Dive

We request two professional references in our final round. We may conduct background checks if necessary.

Who we are

Easee is a Norwegian technology company with a clear purpose: Effortless Electrification for All.

We develop smart charging and energy solutions designed to make access to electrification simpler, smarter, and more scalable.

Our Culture Is Built Around Three Values

Dare:
We challenge assumptions and explore new possibilities.

Care:
We support each other, our partners, and our customers.

Deliver:
We take ownership and follow through on our commitments.

We believe great results come from ambitious people who care about each other, challenge the status quo, and take ownership.

What We Offer

A key role in developing Easee's next-generation EV chargers
The chance to work alongside some of the experts behind one of the world's best-selling EV chargers
Collaboration with skilled colleagues across hardware, software, and product
A part in Easee's international expansion into new markets
A modern company culture that values innovation, people, and fun
Competitive salary and benefits package

jobs.title: AI Full-Stack Developer
jobs.description:
We at Solita have helped leading Nordic companies turn early AI experiments into scalable, secure, and value-driven AI programs. With hundreds of projects and 2,000+ experts in the areas of software development, data, AI, cloud and design, we bridge the gap between ideas and impact. Join us to build tomorrow’s technical solutions!

Currently, we’re on a mission to build intelligent systems for our customers that unlock and harness the value of data and AI. Also, AI is transforming how we build software: automating routine work, amplifying creativity, and letting developers focus on solving real problems.

We are now looking for AI Full-Stack Developers
to join our growing community of experts and help shape the future of intelligent software. In this role, you can work in the Helsinki, Lahti, Oulu, Tampere, or Turku regions with hybrid working options.

At Solita, you’ll find a community that values both technical excellence and human connection. We believe in autonomy, continuous learning, and building together things that matter. You’ll have the chance to work on impactful projects with meaningful use of AI, collaborate with top experts across data, cloud, and design.

Read more of our thoughts on AI from our website, and get to know our very own LLM platform FunctionAI that our experts use in project deliveries.

Your role in a nutshell

As an AI Developer, you get to develop various agent-based and data-driven software solutions that have a real impact on our customers in various industries, both in private and public sectors. In addition to utilizing modern software development toolkits in your daily work, you will be working hands-on with various AI tools and frameworks, such as AWS Bedrock, Google AI, LangChain, MCP or AI Foundry to build secure, scalable and maintanable AI-powered software solutions that help our customers make better decisions, automate intelligently, and create real business value. You’ll work closely with a team of other software developers, AI/Data Scientists and Engineers, participating in the entire software development cycle.

We are a technology-agnostic company, always choosing the modern frameworks and platforms that best support the customer’s needs. The diversity of our projects offers excellent opportunities for learning, skill development, and rotation. You can find more information about our work on our Dev blog and in the results of our Developer Survey.

Here’s how our developer Miska describes his experience working on AI-based projects:
“I’ve had the opportunity to work on two AI-based projects at Solita and have been involved in both design and implementation. In both projects, it became clear that truly leveraging AI requires a pragmatic approach, continuous measurement, and above all, a deep understanding of the problem being solved. During the projects, I’ve worked with tools such as Cursor, LangGraph, Copilot, Claude, and ChatGPT. Developing AI solutions has been one of the most rewarding experiences of my career: it’s rare to work on something that simultaneously feels like exploring something entirely new and building the future.”

Read more of our developers’ thoughts on ‘How AI is reshaping software projects’ from our website, and get to know our very own LLM platform FunctionAI that our experts use in project deliveries.

What we are looking for

We hope you share our passion for writing high-quality code and collaborating in cross-functional teams. You don’t need to have worked under the title “AI Developer” before: what matters most is your curiosity towards AI, strong technical skills, and the ability to bridge software development and AI in your daily work.

We Expect You To Have

A strong background in software development: at least 5 years of professional experience in full-stack software development using Java, TypeScript, C# or Python.
Experience using agentic coding assistants as part of your daily work (like Github Copilot or Claude Code)
An understanding of AI agent architectures and modern AI frameworks (e.g. AWS Bedrock, Google AI, LangChain, MCP, or AI Foundry) is considered an advantage.
Experience with cloud-based AI services (AWS or Azure) and bringing AI solutions into production using DevOps and IaC practices is considered an advantage.
Fluent English language skills. fluent Finnish skills are considered as an advantage.
Strong problem-solving skills and a consultative mindset.

Why Solita is a great place to work

An expert community: Join our Dev community of over 400 top-tier software professionals in Finland. You’ll also get to collaborate with colleagues across our organization with other +2,000 Solitans.
Rotations and growth: At Solita, your career path doesn’t have to be linear. Many of our people have explored different roles and projects within the company, supported by our internal rotation opportunities, mentoring, and the Solita Growth Academy.
Freedom and flexibility: We know there is more to life than work. That is why we value flexibility and support a healthy work–life balance through trust, autonomy, and a culture that puts people first.
People first: Your wellbeing matters to us as much as your skills. We offer flexible ways of working, comprehensive employee benefits, and dedicated People Leads who provide support in all kinds of everyday situations.
Benefits for every need: Pick the devices that suit you best, enjoy extensive occupational healthcare, relax with regular massages, work with our in-house coaches, or recharge through our hobby clubs and community activities.
Fair and transparent pay: We believe great teamwork happens when there’s no pressure from billing-based salary models: that is why we offer a fixed monthly salary and encourage collaboration and shared success.

Got interested?

Let’s find out together if this could be the next step in your career at Solita! Please send us your CV, or link to your LinkedIn profile.

Our recruitment consists of two rounds of interviews where you will meet our team and learn more about working at Solita. You will be given the opportunity to show your skills and ask us questions. The purpose is to get to know each other better.

Any thoughts or questions, please reach out to our recruiter Neea Turunen / neea.turunen@solita.fi

As a key technology, data, and design partner, Solita’s business is built on trust and responsibility. For this reason, the selected candidate’s identity and employment background will be verified. These checks are carried out in accordance with and within the limits of the Act on the Protection of Privacy in Working Life. In addition, some of our customers may carry out a separate security clearance vetting made by the Finnish Security and Intelligence Service, for example in case you start working for a customer operating in critical infrastructure sector.

jobs.title: Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Are you a subject-matter-oriented Solution Architect ready to shape digital transformation in complex environments? Do you enjoy tackling business challenges in an international setting and collaborating closely with customers and fellow experts? Then this role might be just right for you.

Nortal is currently looking for a Solution Architect to join impactful projects with our enterprise customers. In this role, you will collaborate closely with both our customers and internal development teams, focusing on understanding business needs through active stakeholder discussions and shaping them into high-value solution opportunities. You play a key role in engaging with stakeholders, gathering and refining requirements, demonstrating solutions, and proactively identifying how we can best support business goals.

What you will do

Support customers in their digital transformation across areas such as data modelling and architecture, system integrations, platform modernization, and AI-driven solutions.
Engage in regular discussions with stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable requirements.
Translate high-level architectural directions into concrete guidance for development teams.
Own and prioritize the backlog, ensuring alignment between business value and technical feasibility.
Produce documentation, technical diagrams, architectural notes, and decision records.
Work closely with developers to clarify technical implications, even if you don’t write code yourself.
Collaborate closely with Nortal colleagues, including development, project management, and data/architecture experts.

Our tech environment
In this role you don’t need to program hands-on, but a background in software engineering is essential. Technologies in use include Azure (Azure SQL, Functions, Data Lake, Container Apps etc.), MS Fabric, C#, React, and API management.

What will help you to succeed

Ability to understand business needs and ways of working, enabling smooth collaboration.
Solid technical understanding and ability to discuss architectural-level topics such as software and data architectures, integrations, and AI.
A background in software development (hands-on coding experience at some stage).
Ownership mindset and ability to drive initiatives forward.
Consultant-like approach: proactive, solution-oriented, comfortable in the client interface, willingness to ask questions.
Excellent communication skills in Finnish and English.

If you’re not yet familiar with Nortal, we are a global leader in strategic change and technology. Our 2,500+ employees worldwide share the vision of creating a better future through seamless digital transformation, and we're constantly on the lookout for new talents to join us on this journey. We maintain offices in Helsinki, Oulu, Turku, Jyväskylä, and Uusikaupunki. We highly value flexibility, giving you the option to work from home, your local office, or find a balance that suits your needs.

Why join us?

You’ll play a central role in driving digital transformation for our customers. You’ll gain broad visibility into complex ecosystems—and real ownership of key areas. You’ll work closely with a friendly and experienced team.
We value individuals not just for their skills, but also for their cultural alignment. Our core values include a commitment to delivering value and results, taking ownership, empowering oneself and others, and owning your future and growth. In addition to our professionalism, we appreciate a touch of good humor!
We prioritize your growth and development. At Nortal, we actively support constant improvement and knowledge sharing, both internal and external training opportunities, self-learning, a mentorship program, and strong 1:1 culture.
We prioritize your health and well-being by offering a flexible range of benefits, including adaptable working hours, access to high-quality occupational healthcare, massage services, and bicycle benefit. We are also a remote friendly company.

Salary range: 5200-7800€ / month (full-time). Final compensation will depend on factors such as relevant experience, role seniority, and skill set.

Please note that we will begin reviewing applications in week 31.

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.

What You Can Expect

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Cloud Engineer to support the provisioning, configuration, and maintenance of cloud infrastructure within our Microsoft Azure environment. In this hands-on role, you will work alongside experienced engineers to automate deployments, manage containerized workloads, and contribute to secure, scalable, and efficient cloud operations. This is an excellent opportunity for a technically curious individual eager to build a career in cloud engineering.

How You'll Create Impact

Provision, configure, and maintain Azure cloud resources across development, QA, staging, and production environments.
Implement and maintain infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Bicep and ARM templates, following established standards and approval processes.
Monitor cloud environments for performance, availability, cost optimization, and application health using Azure Monitor, Azure Log Analytics, and Azure Application Insights.
Assist in analyzing logs, metrics, traces, and alerts to support incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement.
Participate in day-to-day cloud operations including incident response, change management, access reviews, and cloud resource tagging.
Deploy, operate, and support containerized applications on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) with an emphasis on secure-by-default and safety-focused configurations.
Support AKS safety and security features including:
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and least-privilege access
Network policies and private cluster configurations
Pod and container security best practices
Cluster and workload observability using logs, metrics, and alerts
Patch management and Kubernetes version upgrades under guidance

Perform scaling, health monitoring, and basic troubleshooting of Kubernetes workloads using kubectl, Helm, and Azure CLI.
Contribute to CI/CD workflows and deployment automation in collaboration with developers using GitHub Actions, with attention to deployment safety, validation, and rollback strategies.
Create and maintain documentation for cloud infrastructure, deployment processes, observability standards, security controls, and operational procedures.
Participate in agile ceremonies including sprint planning, retrospectives, and internal knowledge-sharing sessions.

Your Background

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure and core services such as Virtual Machines, App Services, Storage, Networking, and identity services.
Practical understanding of Kubernetes fundamentals (pods, deployments, services, namespaces) and container orchestration concepts.
Experience using Docker and container deployment tools such as Helm.
Familiarity with application monitoring and observability tools, including Azure Monitor, Azure Log Analytics, and Azure Application Insights.
Experience with scripting or automation using PowerShell, Bash, or programming languages such as Python or C#.
Understanding of cloud security fundamentals including RBAC, identity management, network segmentation, and least-privilege principles.
Ability to follow defined processes and controls while progressively taking ownership of assigned systems and tasks.
Strong communication skills and a collaborative, team-oriented mindset.

Travel Expectations

Occasional overnight travel as necessary.

This is a full-time position and it may reasonably require additional hours during the week and weekend; specific requirements will be determined with Manager.

jobs.description:
What Join us in building a new generation of financial services. Vahva's belief is simple: financial services work best when customers' and companies' interests are fully aligned. We're starting with insurance, because we think it's one of the clearest places to prove that financial services can be done differently, and better. Insurance is our starting point, not our end goal.

Why us Vahva is a Finnish fintech company built to put customers first, starting with how insurance works. We see insurance as a modern financial product, not a legacy category to maintain. Insurance and cashback are the beginning of a long, healthy customer relationship, one we build our wider portfolio of products around.
We're a seed-stage company, which means your voice shapes where we go next. You'll have real influence over decisions and over our customers' lives. We're building the founding team now. Join us.

What you'll do Build Vahva's consumer platform from the ground up, working side by side with the founder. You are the founding engineer in a growth-stage company bringing a new kind of insurance concept to market, first in Finland under the Vahva brand.
Ship product end-to-end: design, implement, deploy, and operate the services behind our cashback and insurance products (vahva.fi), which reward customers with real money for claim-free months, and the car-insurance products the platform grows into.
Shape the architecture of a platform that has to be reliable, secure, and scalable in a regulated industry, and ready to expand from Finland to the Nordics and beyond.
Take AI-first engineering from idea to practice: build AI into the platform and into how we work, from the ground up rather than bolted on afterward.
Set the engineering culture and lay the foundations the future team will build on: how we build, test, ship, and run software.
Work openly and close to our earliest users, who help develop the service with us; what they experience each month is the direct result of what you ship.

What we look for A senior product engineer who has built and run production systems end-to-end and is comfortable being the one who makes it work, from API design through distributed and event-driven architectures to operating enterprise-grade, cloud-native systems in production.
Experience taking an early-stage product from zero to launch: you make pragmatic calls, cut the right corners, and keep quality where it matters.
An AI-native way of building: AI-assisted development tools (Claude, GitHub Copilot, or similar coding agents) are already part of how you work, and you've designed, built, or orchestrated AI agents and agentic workflows, with a solid grasp of prompt and context engineering, RAG patterns, tool-calling agents, and multi-agent systems.
The foundations that let a small team ship fast and safely: infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and automated deployments, and a working command of observability, security engineering, and cloud governance.
An ownership mindset: you want the responsibility and the upside of a founding role, not a ticket queue. You take end-to-end responsibility for outcomes, from delivery quality and reliability to long-term maintainability, and you create leverage for every engineer who joins after you.
Care for the trust our product runs on: money, insurance, and personal data demand security and correctness. Experience with fintech or other regulated domains is a clear advantage.
Fluent English; Finnish is a strong plus in a product built first for the Finnish market.

Technologies Applicants are expected to have knowledge of:
TypeScript
Node.js
React
PostgreSQL
Building cloud-based B2C products
AI engineering, applied from the ground up

Where we are today We're moving from pre-launch to launch and are now onboarding our first paying customers. This is a rare opportunity to join with zero technical legacy: you'll define how things are truly done, together with our earliest customers.

In your CV or cover note, tell us about something you've built and shipped end-to-end: what you chose, what you cut, and how it ran in production.
