jobs.title: AI Architect
jobs.description:
We are currently looking for an AI Architect to join our AI, Analytics & Agents business area in Finland.

At Solita AI, Analytics & Agents community, we support our customers throughout their entire AI journey, from early ideation to scaling AI adoption across the whole organization. We believe that impactful AI solutions are created through multidisciplinary collaboration, combining business and process expertise, cutting-edge technology & AI expertise, and human-centered design. Generative AI and the application of large language models are an increasingly important part of our solutions.

We take a holistic approach to our customers’ challenges and help them build sustainable, production-ready AI solutions that deliver value in real use cases.

Your role in a nutshell

As an AI Architect, you take lead responsibility for designing, developing, and driving production‑grade AI solutions for our customers. You combine hands‑on architectural work with project‑level technical leadership, acting as both the solution architect and a senior technical contributor.

In this role, you own the overall AI solution architecture: mapping the current state of data, analytics and AI capabilities, defining future target architectures, identifying opportunities, and creating concrete, actionable roadmaps. You will be involved in all phases of the project, from ideation, and solution design to production deployment, and continuous development.

Your work places a strong emphasis on LLM-based and generative AI solutions that are embedded into real business processes. You ensure that AI solutions are designed as part of a broader IT and enterprise architecture with clear attention to security, scalability, reliability and responsible AI.

You lead AI architecture work in large projects and across teams, collaborating closely with Data Scientists, AI/ML Engineers, Cloud Architects, data specialists and business stakeholders. While you are expected to be hands-on when needed, your key responsibility is to own the overall AI solution architecture, make critical technical decisions, and ensure high‑quality outcomes.

In addition, you contribute to Solita’s technical leadership in applied AI by shaping best practices, supporting pre‑sales and solution planning, mentoring colleagues, and influencing how production‑grade AI is delivered across customer projects.

We will discuss the exact scope and focus of your role based on your experience, skills, and interests. Depending on your level of experience and responsibility, your monthly salary will range from 5800 € to 7200 €.

In practice your work includes:

Taking technical lead responsibility in AI projects, acting as a hands‑on AI Architect and guiding the overall solution from concept and implementation to production.
Working closely with customers in a consultative role, translating business needs and constraints into concrete technical designs and implementation plans.
Designing and developing LLM‑based and generative AI solutions, such as knowledge and information retrieval systems, agent‑based workflows, systems that increase the level of automation in (customer) service processes and document processing solutions.
Defining end‑to‑end AI system designs, including data flows, model orchestration, system integrations, evaluation, guardrails, and human‑AI interaction.
Designing cloud‑based AI and LLM platforms, primarily on Azure, leveraging services such as Azure AI / ML, Databricks, and cloud‑native infrastructure.
Leading architectural decisions related to scalability, security, cost efficiency, reliability, and responsible AI, in alignment with broader IT and enterprise architecture.
Participating in pre‑sales and early project phases, supporting solution scoping, technical proposals, and architecture planning in collaboration with sales.

What helps you succeed in this role

Proven experience in designing and implementing AI/ML solutions in production environments, especially with generative AI and LLM technologies.
Solid experience in mapping out architecture-level AI solutions for both business decision-makers and the implementing experts in an understandable way.
You understand deeply the logic and practicalities related to AI solutions, and non-deterministic solutions in general, and their successful development.
Hands-on experience as an AI Architect, ML Architect, Lead AI/ML Engineer or similar role, with clear responsibility for architectural decisions.
Experience with generative AI and agent architectures, including LLM technologies (e.g. Azure OpenAI / Foundry, Databricks Agent Bricks, LangChain, Semantic Kernel), RAG methods, and multi-agent solutions.
Experience in production deployment and solution operations using technologies such as Azure AI/ML Services, Databricks, MLOps/LLMOps, evaluation and guardrail tools.
Architectural and hands-on experience with cloud-based AI platforms (Azure, AWS), including building cloud infrastructure using IaC tools.
Programming skills, especially with Python but other languages such as Java or C# are also beneficial.
Ability to act as a trusted consultant, guiding and challenging our customers and collaborating effectively with teams.
Passion for solving customer needs and exploring the latest AI technologies and methods (e.g. multi-agent architectures and collaboration mechanisms, self-optimizing AI agents, agent skills, advanced knowledge and memory management solutions, etc.)
Fluent working proficiency in English.
Ability to communicate clearly with both technical experts and business stakeholders and to lead discussions around architecture
Solita's values (caring, casualness, courage, and passion) align with what you value in your work community and colleagues.

What do we offer?

Challenging, meaningful, and impactful projects with a wide variety of clients, from global companies to public organizations.
A diverse community of exceptional professionals who love to learn, challenge and support each other. You won’t be left alone.
A relaxed, caring and trust-based culture where you can be yourself.
A workplace with both freedom and responsibility. That’s what our employees see as one of the biggest benefits at Solita.
Freedom to work either remotely in Finland, in our customers’ premises, or in our offices across Finland – which option suits best at a given time.
Mentoring, coaching, and cross-unit learning opportunities to grow your expertise through Solita's multidisciplinary collaboration, long-term client work, or domain specialization (e.g., Retail, Industrial, Health).

Read more about our projects and insights from our professionals:

Solita employs several dozen professionals in data science & AI/ML engineering who work on domestic and international projects in Finland and the Nordic countries. Our professionals work as in-depth experts in their respective fields in various customer projects, e.g. in projects like this or for example at KONE.

“ At KONE we are for example supporting them to develop an intelligent maintenance service called KONE 24/7 Connected Services. An exciting project around machine learning and sensor data from more than 150,000 elevators. ” – Mikael Ruohonen, AI, Analytics & Agents, Business Lead

On a journey towards AI-driven HR service solutions across 50 countries – Solita

Significant opportunities for Kela through AI – Solita

Driving AI solutions in sustainable stainless steel production – new digital innovation hub – Solita

Data and AI strategy helps YIT boost productivity – Solita

Breaking new ground in software development with AI-powered collaboration – Solita

Got interested?

Otamme kokonaisvaltaisen näkökulman asiakkaidemme haasteisiin ja autamme heitä rakentamaan kestäviä, tuotantokelpoisia AI-ratkaisuja, jotka tuottavat arvoa oikeissa käyttökohteissa.

Työsi pähkinänkuoressa

AI / ML Engineerin roolissa suunnittelet ja toteutat älykkäitä ratkaisuja hyödyntäen generatiivista tekoälyä, agenttipohjaisia arkkitehtuureja ja uusimpia menetelmiä. Työ sisältää muun muassa LLM-teknologioiden hyödyntämisen, agenttien suunnittelun, monimutkaistenkin työprosessien tehostamisen sekä ihmisen ja tekoälyn yhteistyön kehittämisen käytännön asiakasratkaisuissa. Olet mukana projektin kaikissa vaiheissa: ideoinnista, datan tutkimisesta ja ratkaisumallien kehittämisestä aina tuotantoon vientiin ja jatkokehitykseen.

Työsi pitää sisällään muun muassa

AI-ratkaisujen suunnittelua ja toteuttamista asiakkaille – esimerkiksi asiakaspalveluprosessin tehostamista, tiedonhakuavustajia tai dokumenttiprosessien tehostamista LLM-teknologialla
Pilvipohjaisten LLM- ja koneoppimisalustojen rakentamista ja mallien käyttöönottoa julkipilvialustoilla, kuten Azure, AWS tai GCP
MLOpsin ja CI/CD-putkien suunnittelua ja toteutusta
Konsultointia ja teknistä sparrailua asiakkaiden kanssa – usein lähellä liiketoimintaa ja päätöksentekoa

Työskentelet osana kokeneiden AI/ML-arkkitehtien, datakonsulttien ja ohjelmistokehittäjien muodostamaa tiimiä. Ratkaisut rakennetaan yhteistyössä, mutta roolissasi pääset ottamaan vastuuta ja vaikuttamaan kokonaisuuteen alusta asti.

Keskustelemme kanssasi roolin tarkemmasta vastuusta ja painotuksista aiemman kokemuksesi, osaamisesi ja kiinnostuksesi perusteella. Riippuen lopullisen roolisi kokemus- ja vastuutasosta, kuukausipalkkasi on noin 4300–5800 euroa.

Toivomme sinulta:

Käytännön kokemusta AI/ML-ratkaisujen suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta tuotantoympäristöissä – erityisesti generatiivisen tekoälyn ja LLM-teknologian parista
Generatiivinen tekoäly ja agenttiarkkitehtuurit: LLM-teknologiat (esim. Azure OpenAI / Foundry, Databricks Agent Bricks, LangChain, Semantic Kernel), RAG-menetelmät ja multi-agent -ratkaisut)
Kokemusta pilvipalveluista (Azure / AWS / GCP) ja pilvi-infrastruktuurin rakentamisesta ML-tarpeisiin IaC-työkaluilla
Kokemusta tuotantoon viennistä ja ratkaisujen hallinnasta mm. seuraavilla teknologioilla: Azure AI/ML Services, Databricks, MLOps/LLMOps, evaluointi- ja guardrail-työkalut.
Ohjelmointiosaamista, erityisesti Python – mutta myös esimerkiksi Java- tai C#-tausta tukee tehtävässä
Kokemusta CI/CD-prosesseista ja DevOps-työskentelystä
Intohimoa asiakkaiden tarpeiden ratkaisuun ja uusimpien teknologioiden tai menetelmien tutkimiseen (esim. Multi-agent -arkkitehtuurit ja yhteistyömekanismit, itseoptimoivat AI-agentit, AI-agenttien taidot, kehittyneet tiedon- ja muistinhallintaratkaisut, jne.)
Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

Lisäksi arvostamme:

Kykyä työskennellä asiakasrajapinnassa, kiteyttää liiketoiminnan tarpeita ja muotoilla niihin sopivia teknisiä ratkaisuja

Arvomme ovat välittäminen, rentous, rohkeus ja intohimo. Työntekijämme ovat valinneet ne itse, ja ehkäpä juuri siksi arvoihin perustuva toiminta näkyy ja tuntuu joka päivä. Tässä on muutamia esimerkkejä:

Rakennamme aitoja kumppanuuksia asiakkaidemme kanssa. Tämä vaatii joskus rohkeutta olla eri mieltä asiakkaan kanssa ja sanoa se myös ääneen.
Intohimo:
Solitalla työtä tehdään suurella intohimolla, mutta samalla pidetään hauskaa. Olemme ylpeitä työmme laadusta.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
With a passion for life

Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.

Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.

Plenty of developers have tried an AI agent. Fewer have run several in parallel, built their own tooling to keep them on track, and worked out exactly where they shine and where they still fall over. If you are on top of these things and want to contribute to the build-up of an agentic software organization, we should talk.

Getinge is looking for Senior .NET Developers in Copenhagen. You will be building software that hospitals around the world depend on every day, and you will be helping shape how a large software organization adopts AI. We have several positions open.

What You Would Be Building

Getinge is a global MedTech company, and our teams in Copenhagen, Hamburg and Aarhus build software that runs at the heart of a modern hospital. Our solutions track surgical instruments through sterile reprocessing with full traceability, orchestrate fleets of robots and reprocessing equipment, plan and optimize the surgical day, coordinate patient flow and staff in real time, and keep thousands of connected medical devices running in the field.

Our software is mission-critical, deeply integrated with hospital IT and physical equipment, and built to a high standard of quality. It is also software where the impact is immediate and real: better use of an operating room, an instrument set that arrives on time, a surgery that goes ahead instead of being cancelled. Not everyone gets to end the week knowing their work helped someone get treated.

What We Work With

Our teams work primarily in C#/.Net &Blazor, with focus on containerization and cloud deployment to Azure, across the organization that spans web and mobile applications, cloud services, real-time systems, and integration with physical equipment.

We are not looking for a checklist match for all of it. What matters is that you are strong in .NET, that you are comfortable working across a stack rather than in one corner of it, and that you pick new things up quickly. The exact mix varies by team, and we will find the right fit together.

Where we are with AI

We are currently in the process of accelerating our software factory with AI. Our teams have been exploring AI-assisted and agentic development processes for some time and are implementing our learnings. However, we are seeking additional fresh perspectives on the matter. This is where you come in.

If you have real experience here and strong opinions about what works, you will find both room to use them and colleagues who will argue back.

Our developers have access to the latest models and a meaningful budget for AI tooling and usage, and we are also looking at introducing new and improved methods and tools to improve our way of working.

What You Will Do

Design, build, and maintain robust .NET services and applications for mission-critical hospital software.
Build and integrate agentic AI capabilities – designing, orchestrating, and evaluating AI agents and LLM-driven workflows in our products and in how we work.
Drive AI adoption in your team and across the organization, setting the standard for how modern tooling improves quality, speed, and value delivered.
Contribute to system architecture, code quality, and engineering practices.
Work closely with product owners, architects, UX/UI, and developers across multiple sites.

You will bring

Strong .NET expertise – deep, hands-on experience building and maintaining production software in C# and modern .NET.
Breadth and adaptability – you are happy to work across the stack and into the cloud, and you are not thrown by a technology you have not used before.
Real depth with AI in practice – you use AI tools in your daily work, you are hands-on with agents and LLM-driven workflows, and you can point to things you have actually built with them. We care more about what you have done and how you think about it than about years on a CV.
A proactive, positive, and constructive mindset – you take ownership from start to finish, communicate openly, and make the people around you better.
The ability to build maintainable, high-quality solutions and to work independently as well as in a team.

Nice to have

Experience with hardware–software integration, robotics, or embedded systems.
Experience with event-driven architecture, messaging, or distributed systems.
Experience working in Agile teams on regulated or safety-critical products.

What We Offer

Getinge is a leading global provider of products and systems that improve healthcare quality and efficiency, with the ambition to be the most desired MedTech company in the world. You would join our Digital Health Solutions department, which counts around 165 people across Denmark, Germany, and the UK, plus a further 100 colleagues in Getinge offices globally.

A smart working environment with shared desks, several work-from-home days per week, and a budget for your home office setup.
Flexible working hours.
Competitive benefits including health insurance and pension.
Opportunities for professional growth and continuous learning.
A collaborative, inclusive, and motivating culture.

Application

Applications will be reviewed continually, and we therefore recommend sending us your application as soon as possible, but no later than 17-10-2026

We kindly ask you to submit your application in our recruitment system by clicking the “apply now” button. Due to GDPR regulations we do not accept applications via e-mail.

If you have any questions regarding the role, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Joakim Martinsson at joakim.martinsson@getinge.com

We look forward to receiving your application. We hope you will join us on our journey to become the world’s most desired MedTech company.

About Us 

With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

jobs.location: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Start your software development career building real products used by professionals around the world.

Are you about to finish – or have you recently finished – your Master's degree in Software Development, Computer Science, or a related field?

At Dalux, you will join a product team where you can develop your technical skills while taking real responsibility from the the outset. You will work alongside experienced developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers to build software used across the global construction industry.

Your role

As a Full-Stack Software Developer, you will work across our technology stack and take part in developing features end-to-end – from understanding the problem and designing a solution to implementation and delivery.

You will not be expected to know everything when you join.

Instead, we expect you to be curious, willing to learn, and ready to take increasing ownership as your skills develop. You will have experienced colleagues around you for daily technical sparring, code reviews, and support.

Your work will include:

Designing and developing new product functionality
Working across both front-end and back-end technologies
Collaborating with developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers
Writing maintainable, reliable, and high-quality software
Learning our products, architecture, and engineering practices
Taking increasing ownership of features and technical decisions as you develop
Contributing ideas for how we can improve our products and the way we build them

Developing software with AI

AI-assisted development is becoming an increasingly important part of how we build software at Dalux.

We are actively exploring how AI can help developers understand code, explore solutions, implement and refactor functionality, create tests, debug problems, and automate repetitive work.

You do not need to be an AI expert. But we are looking for developers who are curious about these tools, willing to experiment, and able to think critically about when AI improves a solution – and when it does not.

If you have already experimented with AI-assisted development through your studies, student job, personal projects, or other work, we would be interested to hear what you learned.

Technologies we work with

Our main full-stack technologies include:

C# / .NET
Angular / TypeScript
GitHub CoPilot
MSSQL
Elasticsearch
Optionally, Android / iOS development using .NET MAUI

You are not expected to know our entire stack when you join. Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn are more important.

Product development at Dalux

Our developers do more than implement specifications.

You will work in a product team together with a Product Manager and Product Designer, combining different perspectives on user value, usability, technical feasibility, and business viability.

This means understanding why we build something, contributing to how we solve the problem, and seeing your work become part of a product used by professionals worldwide.

We work according to agile principles and maintain a strong focus on quality, stability, and long-term maintainability.

Your background

We expect that you:

Have, or are about to complete, a Master's degree in Software Development, Computer Science, or a similar technical field
Have a solid foundation in software development and computer science
Are curious and motivated to learn new technologies
Enjoy solving problems and understanding how things work
Care about building good software, not simply making code compile
Are comfortable asking questions, receiving feedback, and challenging yourself
Want to take ownership and responsibility as your skills grow

Professional experience is an advantage, but not a requirement.

What matters most is your technical potential, curiosity, interest in software craftsmanship, and willingness to learn.

What You Can Expect From Dalux

Dalux is a software company at heart, and software development is central to what we do.

You can expect:

Meaningful product responsibility early in your career
Daily sparring with skilled and experienced developers
Short paths between ideas, technical decisions, and implementation
High levels of trust and freedom in how you solve problems
Close collaboration with Product Management and Design
The opportunity to learn how AI-assisted development is changing software engineering
A social development environment with monthly events and employee-driven clubs

All our software development takes place in-house at our headquarters in Vibenshuset, Copenhagen. We believe working together makes learning, technical collaboration, and knowledge sharing significantly easier – particularly at the beginning of your career.

About Dalux

Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005 by Bent Dalgaard and Torben Dalgaard.

We build digital tools that make the construction industry smarter and more efficient. Using our own 3D BIM technology, we develop user-friendly software used in more than 140 countries.

Our core technology is developed entirely in-house at Dalux.

Ready to start your development career?

If you are looking for a place where you can learn quickly, take real responsibility, and build software with visible impact, we would like to hear from you.

Our recruitment process is ongoing and typically consists of:

Application
Screening
First interview
Second interview
Job offer

We hire several Software Developers throughout the year as Dalux continues to grow.

Application deadline:

Job Description

Trackman is the leading brand in its field, trusted by elite athletes worldwide. We’re growing and looking for a Senior Full Stack SDET who is passionate about quality engineering and excited to help test and improve world-class sports technology products.

This senior, full-stack quality engineering role spans backend API testing and frontend (Windows and web) application testing. You’ll combine strong automation skills with the ability to define end-to-end quality strategies across the Trackman ecosystem—from radar data pipelines to TM Performance Studio used by athletes and coaches worldwide.

You’ll join an international team and help elevate quality practices by mentoring peers, partnering closely with developers, product owners, and UI/UX designers, and championing a quality-first approach throughout the development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain robust test automation frameworks for both backend APIs (REST/GraphQL), web applications and Windows desktop applications
Architect end-to-end test strategies covering integration, system, performance, and regression testing
Lead test planning and review sessions within Agile/Scrum ceremonies alongside developers and product owners
Drive quality across the full stack: from data ingestion APIs and cloud services through to client-facing Windows/Web applications
Define and enforce test coverage standards, reporting metrics, and quality gates within CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
Explore and implement AI-assisted testing techniques — including AI-generated test cases, intelligent test prioritisation, and anomaly detection — to increase testing efficiency and coverage
Mentor and guide junior QA engineers and SDETs across the team
Collaborate with DevOps and platform engineers to embed testing earlier in the development pipeline (shift-left)
Participate in design reviews and contribute to technical architecture discussions from a testability perspective
Conduct exploratory and risk-based testing to uncover edge cases beyond automated suites

Job Requirements

The Ideal Candidate

Holds a relevant degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent (bachelor's level minimum)
Has 5+ years of experience in quality engineering or SDET roles, with proven seniority in at least two of: backend API testing, desktop/Windows application testing, or test framework architecture
Is highly proficient in C# for test automation, with strong understanding of object-oriented design principles.
Has hands-on experience with API testing tools and frameworks (e.g., RestEaze, Postman, Playwright, SpecFlow, or similar)
Has experience testing Windows/Web based applications and understands UI automation frameworks
Is experienced with Azure DevOps or equivalent CI/CD platforms for pipeline integration and test reporting
Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to diagnose complex, cross-layer defects

AI & Emerging Technologies

Has experience with and understands how AI and machine learning concepts can be applied within a quality engineering context

It Will Also Be a Plus If You Have

Experience in the gaming or sports technology industry
Knowledge of radar, computer vision, or sensor data systems
Golf knowledge or broader sports interest — you don't need to be a pro, but a genuine passion for sports helps!

We Offer

A senior, high-impact role in which you will directly shape Trackman's quality engineering culture and practices
The chance to work with and test the world's leading sports tracking technology, trusted by elite athletes across golf, baseball, and football
A collaborative, cross-functional team with 40+ highly skilled colleagues from more than 35 nationalities
Exposure to cutting-edge technology — radar, computer vision, real-time data, and AI — in a unique product domain
An open, informal, and ambitious company culture where great ideas are heard and innovation is encouraged
Continuous learning and growth opportunities as Trackman scales
Social activities and a vibrant team culture

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible.

Game Engineer - Tech Pod

SYBO
is part of the Miniclip family and known for the widely popular game, Subway Surfers - the most downloaded mobile game in the world, with over four and a half billion downloads. Located in the heart of Copenhagen, we aim to create playful moments that inspire our fans to care.

Hundreds of millions of players play Subway Surfers
each month, and enjoy smooth gameplay, new features and a concept that’s now worked for over fourteen (Yes, 14!) years - and we’re looking for a talented Game Engineer for our Tech Pod
to make sure the game and the technology behind it keeps running.

As a Game Engineer - Tech Pod, you’ll work closely with engineers and other disciplines to develop the systems, integrations, and technical foundations behind Subway Surfers. You’ll have the opportunity to take ownership, contribute to technical decisions, and help us continuously improve the game, its technology, and the way we build it.

Nothing’s worse than playing an unstable game. If unstable gaming annoys you, make you'll take enjoyment in making stable games for others. More below!

Responsibilities

Develop and maintain systems, platform capabilities, and SDK integrations that enable us to deliver new features and content for Subway Surfers using Unity, C#, and native code
Collaborate with other Engineers to take technical solutions from concept through implementation and release
Write clean, maintainable code and contribute to the long-term health of the Subway Surfers codebase
Review code and collaborate with other Engineers to share knowledge and maintain engineering quality
Debug and resolve issues across Unity, native platform code, backend integrations, and live systems
Integrate Subway Surfers with SYBO's platform and backend services, bringing shared platform capabilities into the game
Integrate and maintain third-party SDKs and services across iOS and Android
Contribute to improving our CI/CD pipelines, tools, workflows, and development practices, including Jenkins

Life at SYBO

In your first month
, you’ll get to know SYBO, Subway Surfers, our technology, and how the team works. You’ll work closely with the Technical Owner and other Engineers in the Tech Pod, familiarize yourself with the codebase, development and release pipelines, platform integrations, and key technical systems, and start making your first contributions.

In your first three months
, you’ll be contributing independently to systems and integrations and taking an active role in the team’s development process. You’ll work with both SYBO platform services and third-party SDKs, participate in technical discussions around implementation, system design, and architecture, and become increasingly comfortable working across the Subway Surfers technology stack.

In your first twelve months
, you’ll be a trusted and impactful member of the Subway Surfers team, contributing to technical systems and integrations from planning through release. You’ll help shape solutions across the game, platform integrations, and development pipeline that allow us to reliably deliver Subway Surfers to hundreds of millions of players.

Requirements

Strong knowledge of OOP languages, primarily C#
Solid experience developing games in Unity, ideally for mobile
Good understanding of software engineering principles, data structures, algorithms, and common design patterns
Experience writing native code for iOS and Android
Experience working with version control systems such as Git
Experience integrating client applications with backend services and APIs
Experience working in Agile methodologies

Bonus points

Experience with mobile build and release processes for the App Store and Google Play
Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Jenkins

About SYBO

We're SYBO, the mobile games studio behind the legendary Subway Surfers, with over 4.5 billion downloads worldwide! Join our team in the heart of Copenhagen, where creativity flourishes in our new, state-of-the-art studio.

If you join us, you'll have the opportunity to dive into exciting and creative projects alongside a diverse group of like-minded colleagues from over 40 countries across the globe.

We truly believe you perform your best, when you have the equipment you need - and our IT team is always on hand to ensure you have access to the latest tools and gear, enabling you to be at your best - even remotely with a home-office budget!

We also pride ourselves in taking care of your well-being, offering a delicious lunch buffet, a variety of healthy snacks, and regular social events to keep the energy flowing.

Not in Copenhagen? Not a problem! We have in-house relocation specialists who will help you relocate, and feel right at home in Copenhagen and at SYBO!

SYBO is committed to providing equal opportunities to all applicants, regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Build the operational applications that power the future of intelligent manufacturing.

Join Agilent's Global OT & AI Engineering organization and help develop modern operational applications that transform how work is performed across our global operations.

As a Digital Solutions Engineer – Operational Applications, you will design, develop, and maintain intuitive digital applications that empower operators, engineers, technicians, supervisors, and manufacturing leaders with real-time access to information, workflows, and intelligent decision support.

Your solutions will extend enterprise capabilities beyond traditional desktop applications by delivering secure, connected, and user-centric operational experiences across mobile devices, tablets, industrial workstations, and other frontline technologies.

Working closely with Application Experience Engineers, Platform Engineers, Data Engineers, AI & Data Scientists, Smart Factory Engineers, and business stakeholders, you will build applications that simplify operational processes, improve workforce productivity, and accelerate Agilent's digital transformation.

We welcome candidates across multiple career stages. Responsibilities and technical ownership will be aligned with your experience, expertise, and demonstrated capabilities.

About Global OT & AI Engineering

Global OT & AI Engineering develops the digital platforms that power intelligent operations across Agilent's global manufacturing network.

Our organization combines software engineering, cloud technologies, Artificial Intelligence, enterprise data platforms, industrial automation, and Smart Factory solutions to create scalable digital capabilities that improve operational visibility, accelerate decision-making, and enable continuous improvement.

Our mission is to build the digital operating system for intelligent manufacturing.

Our portfolio includes:

Global Operations Control Tower
Enterprise Data Platform (GOLake)
AI & Decision Intelligence Platform
Smart Factory Applications
Operational Applications
Manufacturing Knowledge Platform
Digital Twin Solutions
Enterprise KPI Platform
AI-powered Digital Coworkers

About The Role

Operational excellence depends on providing the right information to the right people at the right time.

As a Digital Solutions Engineer – Operational Applications, you will develop applications that connect frontline employees with enterprise systems, operational data, and intelligent services. Whether supporting manufacturing execution, quality inspections, maintenance activities, warehouse operations, engineering workflows, or operational approvals, your applications will help simplify work and improve decision-making across Agilent's manufacturing network.

You'll work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams to build secure, scalable, and intuitive operational applications that integrate seamlessly with enterprise platforms, AI capabilities, and Smart Factory technologies.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Application Development

Design, develop, and maintain modern operational applications that support manufacturing, quality, supply chain, engineering, warehouse, logistics, and operational workflows.
Build intuitive applications that improve productivity, simplify frontline activities, and enhance user experience.
Develop reusable application components that accelerate delivery across multiple operational solutions.
Ensure applications are responsive, secure, accessible, and optimized for operational environments.

Workforce Productivity Solutions

Develop digital work instructions, operational checklists, inspection applications, maintenance workflows, inventory transactions, approvals, and task management solutions.
Deliver intuitive user experiences that reduce manual effort and improve operational consistency.
Support offline capabilities and reliable synchronization where network connectivity may be limited.
Design solutions that enable users to complete operational tasks efficiently across various devices.

Enterprise Integration

Integrate operational applications with enterprise platforms including SAP, MES, enterprise data platforms, AI services, and backend APIs.
Collaborate with Platform Engineers to consume secure enterprise services.
Work with Data Engineers to deliver trusted operational information.
Embed AI-powered capabilities such as intelligent recommendations, conversational assistants, and contextual insights into operational workflows.

User Experience & Adoption

Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand operational challenges and user needs.
Design simple, intuitive workflows that improve adoption and reduce training effort.
Continuously enhance application usability through user feedback and iterative improvements.
Promote consistent user experience across operational applications.

Innovation & Emerging Technologies

Evaluate emerging technologies that improve operational productivity, including enterprise mobility, wearable devices, barcode and QR technologies, camera integration, voice interaction, and AI-assisted user experiences.
Prototype innovative digital capabilities that enhance frontline operations and operational efficiency.
Contribute to Agilent's long-term Operational Applications strategy by identifying opportunities to simplify work through technology.

Cross-functional Collaboration

Partner with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Engineering, and Operational Excellence teams to understand operational requirements and deliver practical digital solutions.
Collaborate closely with Application Experience Engineers, Platform Engineers, Smart Factory Engineers, Data Engineers, and AI specialists to develop integrated enterprise applications.
Participate in Agile development, architecture discussions, technical reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Technology Environment

You'll have opportunities to work with modern enterprise technologies including:

Application Development

Flutter
React Native
.NET MAUI
React
TypeScript

Programming

Dart
JavaScript
C#

Enterprise Integration

REST APIs
GraphQL (preferred)
SignalR

Cloud Platforms

Microsoft Azure
AWS

Device Capabilities

Barcode & QR Code
Camera Integration
NFC
Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE)
Push Notifications
Offline Data Synchronization

Enterprise Platforms

SAP ERP
SAP ME / MES
Enterprise Data Platform
AI Services
Global Operations Control Tower

DevOps

GitHub
Azure DevOps
CI/CD Pipelines

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

We welcome candidates across multiple career stages. Responsibilities and technical ownership will be aligned with your experience and demonstrated capability.

You should have:

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Mobile Computing, or a related discipline.
Experience developing enterprise applications using modern web, mobile, or cross-platform technologies.
Understanding of RESTful APIs and enterprise application integration.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
Passion for building digital solutions that improve operational efficiency and user productivity.

Build the operational applications that power the future of intelligent manufacturing.

Join Agilent's Global OT & AI Engineering organization and help develop modern operational applications that transform how work is performed across our global operations.

As a Digital Solutions Engineer – Operational Applications, you will design, develop, and maintain intuitive digital applications that empower operators, engineers, technicians, supervisors, and manufacturing leaders with real-time access to information, workflows, and intelligent decision support.

Your solutions will extend enterprise capabilities beyond traditional desktop applications by delivering secure, connected, and user-centric operational experiences across mobile devices, tablets, industrial workstations, and other frontline technologies.

Working closely with Application Experience Engineers, Platform Engineers, Data Engineers, AI & Data Scientists, Smart Factory Engineers, and business stakeholders, you will build applications that simplify operational processes, improve workforce productivity, and accelerate Agilent's digital transformation.

Our organization combines software engineering, cloud technologies, Artificial Intelligence, enterprise data platforms, industrial automation, and Smart Factory solutions to create scalable digital capabilities that improve operational visibility, accelerate decision-making, and enable continuous improvement.

Atlas and Advanced Services: Gain expertise in Atlas (fully managed cloud database service), Atlas Stream Processing, Atlas Data Lake, Atlas Full-Text Search, Atlas Vector Search, and Charts

jobs.description:
All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.

About JumpCloud®
JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.

As we continue to grow JumpCloud internationally, we are hiring software engineers to expand our product. You’ll have the opportunity to play a key role in the success and development of our engineering teams in addition to growing your own career.

About the Role:

In this role, you will specifically work on the Device Management (MDM / Endpoint Management) vertical at JumpCloud, the role shifts focus from broad cloud microservices to deeply understanding operating system internals (macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android) and how they communicate with the cloud.

In the Device Management vertical, you will build the software that allows IT administrators to remotely configure, patch, secure, and monitor thousands of endpoints from a single pane of glass. You will work on cross-OS device management engines, mobile device management / Declarative Device Management(MDM/DDM) telemetry, custom system agents, and zero-touch enrollment pipelines. This role balances local client-side programming (interacting with the OS) and building high-availability cloud APIs.

What you’ll be doing:

Primarily working with Go and Node.js for cross-platform applications on Windows, macOS, and Linux

Gaining or utilizing expertise in areas like Windows services, kernels, Event Loggers, Mac Launch daemons, and macOS internals

Collaborating with architects, UX designers, and DevOps to ensure our systems are highly available, scalable, and deliver exceptional user experiences

Working within a Scrum framework to drive agile development

Learning and working with mTLS protocols and related security concepts. Prior experience in these areas is a plus

Using OAuth/OIDC flows for secure user authentication and service access

Writing Unit test cases, Functional test cases, acceptance tests along with automating these test cases

Contributing to the future of our Device Management services by participating in strategic planning and scoping sessions with product managers

Embodying our core values: building strong connections, thinking big, and striving to improve by 1% every day

We’re looking for:

7-10 years experience developing MAC, Windows, or  Linux applications (including integration with third-party applications) in any modern language (Python, Java) or Golang. Experience in one of them is a must

Experience using one of the public cloud providers (AWS, GCP or Azure) with CI/CD pipelines (preferably Github Action) to build, test and deploy. Knowledge of containerization technologies and orchestration with Kubernetes

Strong hands-on experience in backend software or full stack development is a must

Working knowledge of Swift, C Sharp, C++ would be an added advantage

Working knowledge on device MDM would be an added advantage

Willingness to mentor junior members of the team

Bonus points if you have experience with Services, event logger, Kernel in Windows OS and/or Launch demon, app hosting in Mac

Where you’ll be working/Location:

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role. 

Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.

Language:

JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

Why JumpCloud?

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  

One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud.  Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.   

JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Scam Notice:

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. If it’s iGaming, we know a thing or two. At Light & Wonder, It’s all about the games, and our digital team leads the global iGaming market, providing jaw-dropping content and innovative software that powers the world's most successful online gaming providers.

Position Summary

The Senior Software Architect is a senior technical leadership role within the iGaming Platform team. This is not a "heads-down coding" role, nor is it a purely advisory one — it sits at the intersection of hands-on delivery and architectural ownership. You will be expected to make and defend design decisions, lead cross-team technical alignment, and ensure the platform scales, integrates, and operates reliably at global scale.

You bring established architecture experience, deep software engineering instincts, and the credibility to influence without authority across multiple platform portfolios. You will contribute to the Architecture Review Board (ARB), own Architectural Decision Records (ADRs), and play a central role in shaping how the OpenGaming platform evolves.

Architectural Leadership

Own and produce Architectural Decision Records (ADRs) for significant design decisions, ensuring rationale, context, and consequences are documented and retained
Participate actively in the Architecture Review Board (ARB), reviewing solution designs across platform portfolios and applying the L&W Architectural Standards
Define and enforce architecture patterns, integration contracts, and non-functional requirements (NFRs) across the Nova platform and adjacent systems
Contribute to the Tech Atlas, Asset Registry, and governance artefacts that underpin L&W's architecture practice
Lead threat modelling exercises using structured approaches (STRIDE, Threagile) and translate outcomes into actionable security requirements

Technical Design & Delivery

Produce high-quality solution designs — from C4 context and container diagrams through to component and sequence-level detail — that can be directly implemented by engineering teams
Design and evolve RESTful and event-driven APIs using OpenAPI specifications, establishing contracts that support independent team delivery
Architect integrations with third-party systems including payment providers, identity services, regulatory reporting endpoints, and operator platforms
Provide technical governance over CI/CD pipeline design, environment architecture, and deployment strategies using GitHub Actions, Kustomize, and ArgoCD
Hands-on prototyping and proof-of-concept development when needed to de-risk architectural decisions

Engineering Quality & Standards

Define and champion non-functional standards: performance baselines, resilience patterns, observability requirements, and security controls
Lead or contribute to performance and load testing design, interpreting results in the context of SLAs and platform growth targets
Establish and evolve coding and integration standards across Java/Spring services on the platform
Drive adoption of structured security practices through the Security Champions programme and DevSecOps tooling integration

Collaboration & Influence

Provide technical mentorship to Associate and mid-level architects and senior engineers, building architectural thinking across the team
Translate complex technical positions into clear, concise communication for delivery leads, product managers, and executive stakeholders
Drive alignment between iGaming and wider L&W engineering teams on shared concerns: API strategy, data platforms, observability, and shared services
Participate in hiring and technical assessment processes for engineering and architecture candidates

Qualifications

Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or demonstrably equivalent experience. Professional certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP) are valued but not a substitute for practical architecture experience.

7+ years in software engineering with at least 3 years in an explicit architecture role — designing systems, not just building them
Proven track record of owning architectural decisions end-to-end: from initial discovery and option analysis through to documented ADR and post-implementation review
Strong Java/Spring Boot background with demonstrable experience designing cloud-native microservices at scale
Experience designing and operating event-driven systems using Kafka or equivalent messaging platforms
Hands-on exposure to API gateway technologies and federated API management across multiple consumer profiles
Experience operating in a regulated or compliance-driven environment (gaming, fintech, payments, or similar)
Demonstrable experience working within or contributing to a governance process — ARB, design authority, technical steering, or equivalent
Comfortable producing architecture artefacts independently: C4 diagrams, ADRs, threat models, NFR matrices

Additional Information

The opportunity to interact with global teams on a regular basis and the possibility to switch teams and projects as you and our business continues to develop and grow.

and flexible working

Als Solution Architect draag je bij aan het ontwerpen van het IT-landschap van de organisatie op basis van de business-strategie. Je fungeert als de belangrijkste schakel tussen de business en IT voor strategische initiatieven en bent ook de technische leider van een transversale squad die verantwoordelijk is voor een portfolio van kritieke businesstoepassingen.

Je komt bij een team dat momenteel bestaat uit een product owner, een scrum master, een analist en een ontwikkelaar. In deze rol leg je de technische visie vast, stuur je architecturale beslissingen aan, mentor je teamleden en waarborg je de duurzaamheid op lange termijn van de oplossingen die onder jouw verantwoordelijkheid vallen.

Een bijzondere uitdaging van deze positie is dat de squad meer dan 40 kritieke businesstoepassingen beheert, inclusief verschillende legacy systemen en moderne, op Azure gebaseerde, oplossingen. Je moet in staat zijn om aan meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd te werken en daarbij de operationele stabiliteit waarborgen en de lopende transformatie-initiatieven ondersteunen.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Betrokkenheid bij de ontwikkeling van projecten

Helpen businessbehoeften en -vereisten in kaart brengen tijdens workshops en ontdekkingssessies.
Verschillende oplossingsopties evalueren en de meest geschikte architectuur aanbevelen op basis van de business-strategie, architecturale principes, kosten, risico’s en overgangsplannen.
Oplossingsarchitecturen definiëren, documenteren en communiceren aan belanghebbenden uit zowel de business als de IT, en de bijbehorende architecturale modellen en documentatie opstellen en bijhouden.
De gevolgen en onderlinge afhankelijkheden tussen bestaande toepassingen, lopende projecten en toekomstige initiatieven identificeren, en prioritering binnen de roadmap van de organisatie ondersteunen.
Businessvereisten omzetten in haalbare technische oplossingen en implementeringsroadmaps.
Bijdragen aan discussies over technisch ontwerp, en ontwikkelingsstandaarden en beste praktijken vaststellen.
Ondersteuning bieden bij financiële prognoses, het inschatten van de benodigde inspanningen, het identificeren van risico’s en het opstellen van plannen voor risicobeperking.

Technische Leiderschap

Optreden als de technische leider van de squad en advies geven over architecturale en technische beslissingen.
Ontwikkelaars en andere teamleden coachen, mentoren en ondersteunen in het versterken van hun technische expertise.
Beste praktijken voor software engineering, codekwaliteit, beveiliging, onderhoudbaarheid en schaalbaarheid bevorderen.
Technische reviews leiden en ervoor zorgen dat de architecturale standaarden worden nageleefd.
Het oplossen en verhelpen van complexe technische kwesties in het volledige toepassingenlandschap ondersteunen.
Initiatieven voor voortdurende verbetering binnen het team aansturen.

Jouw profiel

Ervaring en opleiding

Masterdiploma in computerwetenschappen of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
Minstens 5 jaar ervaring als Solution Architect, Technical Lead, Senior ontwikkelaar, of een gelijkaardige rol, idealiter in complexe bedrijfsomgevingen.
Ervaring met agile en SAFe-omgevingen; ervaring in de verzekeringssector, gezondheidszorg of andere sterk gereguleerde sectoren is een grote troef.
Frans of Nederlands is vereist, met een zeer goed begrip van de andere taal, alsook een uitstekende beheersing van het Engels.

Technische Vaardigheden

Uitstekende kennis van oplossings- en integratiearchitectuur, met een sterke achtergrond in softwareontwikkeling en levenscyclusbeheer van toepassingen.
Sterke ervaring met .NET/C# en uitgebreide kennis van JavaScript/TypeScript, inclusief Angular en Single Page Applications (SPA).
Hoge bekwaamheid in Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL en T-SQL.
Hands-on ervaring met Microsoft Azure-diensten, cloud-native architecturen en REST API’s; ervaring met Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Event-driven Architecture of Azure PaaS is een groot voordeel.
Ervaring met het implementeren van DevOps-praktijken en CI/CD-pipelines, met een sterk begrip van Git; vertrouwdheid met Infrastructure as Code, Azure DevOps Pipelines, Docker en containerisatie is een pluspunt.

Initiatieven die het welzijn bevorderen en de onderlinge band versterken: yoga, padel, inspirerende workshops, filmavonden, seizoensgebonden drinks, rondetafelgesprekken in het Nederlands of Frans, …

Tâches et responsabilités

En tant que Solution Architect, vous contribuerez à la conception du paysage IT de l’organisation sur la base de la stratégie business. Vous servirez de lien principal entre le business et l’IT pour les initiatives stratégiques, tout en assumant le rôle de leader technique d’une squad transversale chargée d’un portefeuille d’applications business critiques.

Vous rejoindrez une équipe actuellement composée d’un Product Owner, d’un Scrum Master, d’un analyste et d’un développeur. Dans ce rôle, vous serez chargé de définir la vision technique, d’orienter les décisions architecturales, d’encadrer les membres de l’équipe et de garantir la pérennité à long terme des solutions relevant de votre responsabilité.

L’un des défis particuliers de ce poste réside dans le fait que la squad gère plus de 40 applications business critiques, dont plusieurs systèmes hérités et des solutions modernes basées sur Azure. Vous devrez être en mesure de travailler sur plusieurs projets tout en garantissant la stabilité opérationnelle et en soutenant les initiatives de transformation en cours.

Tâches et responsabilités

Implication dans le développement de projets

Contribuer à la formulation des besoins et des exigences métier lors d’ateliers et de sessions de découverte.
Évaluer différentes options de solution et recommander l’architecture la plus appropriée sur la base de la stratégie métier, des principes architecturaux, des coûts, des risques et des plans de transition
Définir, documenter et communiquer les architectures de solution aux parties prenantes business et IT, et mettre en place et maintenir les modèles architecturaux et la documentation associés.
Identifier les impacts et les dépendances entre les applications existantes, les projets en cours et les initiatives futures, et contribuer à la hiérarchisation des priorités dans le cadre de la feuille de route de l’organisation.
Traduire les exigences métier en solutions techniques concrètes et en feuilles de route d’implémentation.
Participer aux discussions sur la conception technique et établir des normes de développement ainsi que des bonnes pratiques.
Contribuer aux prévisions financières, à l’estimation des efforts, à l’identification des risques et à la planification des mesures d’atténuation.

Leadership technique

Assumer le rôle de responsable technique de la squad et fournir des conseils sur les décisions architecturales et techniques.
Coacher, encadrer et soutenir les développeurs et les autres membres de l'équipe afin de renforcer leur expertise technique.
Promouvoir les meilleures pratiques en matière d'ingénierie logicielle, qualité du code, sécurité, maintenabilité et évolutivité.
Diriger les revues techniques et veiller au respect des normes architecturales.
Contribuer au dépannage et à la résolution des problèmes techniques complexes au sein de l'ensemble du paysage applicatif.
Piloter des initiatives d'amélioration continue au sein de l'équipe

Description du profil

Expérience et formation

Master en informatique ou équivalent par expérience.

Français ou néerlandais requis, avec une très bonne compréhension de l’autre langue, ainsi qu’une excellente maîtrise de l’anglais.

Compétences techniques

Excellente connaissance en architecture d’intégration et de solution, avec une solide expérience en développement logiciel et en gestion du cycle de vie des applications.
Solide expérience avec .NET/C# et connaissance approfondie de JavaScript/TypeScript, notamment Angular et les applications monopages (SPA).
Maîtrise approfondie de Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL et T-SQL.
Expérience pratique des services Microsoft Azure, des architectures cloud natives et des REST API ; une expérience avec Azure Functions, Logic Apps, l’architecture orientée événements ou Azure PaaS constitue un atout majeur.
Expérience dans l’implémentation de pratiques DevOps et de pipelines CI/CD, avec une solide compréhension de Git ; la maîtrise de l’« Infrastructure as Code », d’Azure DevOps Pipelines, de Docker et de la conteneurisation est un atout.

Expérience en estimation des coûts, en gestion des risques et en gouvernance technique.

Forte capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes, associée à une approche structurée et organisée.

Excellentes compétences interpersonnelles, de communication et de gestion des parties prenantes, notamment la capacité à expliquer des concepts techniques complexes à des publics tant techniques que non techniques.

jobs.title: Agentic Software Delivery Architect
jobs.description:
Company Description

Inetum is a European leader supporting organizations as they navigate continuous technological change.

With deep industry expertise, a strong innovation culture, and a scalable international model, we help clients transform their operations and generate sustainable impact across business and society.

Guided by European values, we empower local businesses to create positive impact and unlock society’s full potential. This vision drives us to deliver on our promises, attract the best talent, and turn uncertainty into opportunity, building a future where technology unleashes the possibilities within us all.

Job Description

Software engineering is being fundamentally redefined.

Artificial Intelligence is no longer a supporting tool that helps developers write code faster. It is becoming an active participant in how software is designed, built, tested, secured, modernized, deployed and operated.

Organizations that succeed in the coming years will not simply adopt AI tools. They will transform how software delivery works by combining human expertise, intelligent agents, automation and modern engineering practices into a new operating model.

At Inetum Belgium, we are building that future through our Agentic Software Delivery Factory
.

We envision an environment where architects, engineers, AI agents and delivery teams collaborate to accelerate innovation, improve quality, increase predictability and create greater business value. Beyond transforming software delivery, we help organizations design and build the next generation of Agentic and AI-infused applications, combining intelligent agents, enterprise data and modern cloud platforms to deliver adaptive and business-aware solutions.

To help shape this transformation, the Cloud & Application Unit
within our Technology Division is looking for an Agentic Software Delivery Architect
.

This is not a traditional architecture role.

This is a leadership role focused on defining, implementing and scaling AI-enabled software delivery, while architecting the next generation of Agentic and AI-infused applications that combine human expertise, intelligent agents, enterprise data and modern cloud services.

You will help customers and teams navigate one of the biggest technology shifts of our generation and define what software engineering looks like in the age of Agentic AI.

Your Mission

As an Agentic Software Delivery Architect
, your primary mission is to accelerate the adoption of AI-native software engineering and help organizations evolve towards next-generation delivery models.

You will help organizations evolve their software and solution delivery capabilities across the spectrum of AI-assisted, AI-augmented and AI-native engineering
, enabling teams to leverage AI as a true force multiplier throughout the software development lifecycle.

You will act as a bridge between business strategy, engineering excellence, AI innovation and delivery transformation.

You will help define how AI agents, engineering platforms, automation capabilities and human expertise work together throughout the Software Development Lifecycle.

While architecture remains an important part of the role, your impact will be measured by your ability to transform software delivery, drive adoption and create tangible business outcomes through AI-enabled engineering.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You lead by example, working alongside delivery teams, architects and engineers to validate emerging practices, experiment with new AI capabilities and turn innovation into scalable delivery outcomes. You operate at the frontline of AI innovation, continuously exploring how Agentic AI can reshape the way software is designed, built, tested and operated.

You will not simply design solutions.

You will design the future of software delivery itself.

What You Will Do

AI & Agentic Software Delivery Leadership

Drive the evolution of our Agentic Software Delivery Factory.
Define and promote AI-native software delivery practices.
Identify opportunities where AI agents can augment engineering teams and delivery processes.
Establish reusable frameworks, methodologies and patterns for AI-enabled delivery.
Help delivery teams operationalize AI throughout the Software Development Lifecycle.
Drive measurable improvements in productivity, quality, predictability and customer outcomes.
Promote responsible, secure and governed use of AI.

Software Delivery Transformation

Help customers redefine their software delivery operating models.
Guide organizations through AI adoption and engineering transformation journeys.
Identify opportunities to optimize delivery processes using automation and intelligent agents.
Support the implementation of modern engineering practices and platform-based delivery models.
Help organizations move from traditional software development approaches towards AI-assisted and AI-native engineering.

Architecture & Modernization

Design modern solution architectures that enable AI-enabled delivery and business innovation.
Guide application modernization initiatives leveraging cloud, automation and AI.
Support architecture decisions across cloud-native, distributed and enterprise platforms.
Define scalable, secure and maintainable technology landscapes.
Ensure architectural decisions support long-term business objectives and delivery efficiency.

AI Strategy & Innovation

Track emerging developments in AI, Agentic Systems and software engineering.
Translate innovation into practical customer solutions.
Experiment with new approaches that improve engineering effectiveness.
Contribute to the creation of new services, offerings and differentiators around AI-enabled delivery.
Support strategic initiatives that position Inetum as a leader in AI-driven software engineering.

Customer Advisory & Pre-Sales

Act as a trusted advisor to customers and stakeholders.
Facilitate workshops on AI adoption, delivery transformation and modernization.
Help customers understand the impact of Agentic AI on software delivery organizations.
Shape solution approaches and transformation roadmaps.
Support pre-sales activities and contribute to winning new business opportunities.
Translate technical capabilities into measurable business value.

Community & Thought Leadership

Lead knowledge-sharing initiatives across engineering communities.
Mentor architects, engineers and technical leaders.
Create reusable assets, accelerators and best practices.
Promote a culture of experimentation, learning and innovation.
Represent Inetum in customer engagements, industry events and technical communities.

Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for technology leaders who understand that software engineering is entering a new era.

You do not need to have all the answers.

But you should be excited by the opportunity to help shape them.

Essential Experience

Proven experience as a Software Architect, Technical Leader, Engineering Lead, Transformation Consultant or Senior Technology Advisor.
Strong understanding of modern software engineering and software delivery practices.
Experience with cloud-native platforms, DevOps, CI/CD and automation.
Demonstrated ability to lead technical transformation initiatives.
Strong stakeholder management and customer-facing skills.
Ability to connect technology decisions with business outcomes.
Experience driving change across teams, departments or organizations.
Strong communication, workshop facilitation and advisory capabilities.
Passion for innovation and continuous learning.

AI-Focused Capabilities

Strong interest in AI-enabled software engineering and Agentic AI.
Understanding of how AI can transform software delivery and engineering organizations.
Experience with GitHub Copilot, AI-assisted development tools or software engineering automation platforms.
Ability to identify practical opportunities for AI adoption.
Understanding of responsible AI, governance, security and risk considerations.
Ability to guide organizations through the people, process and technology aspects of AI transformation.
Curiosity regarding emerging AI capabilities and future engineering practices.

Experience In One Or More Of The Following Areas

Microsoft Azure and .NET ecosystems.
Java and cloud-native platforms.
Integration and API platforms.
Event-driven architecture and distributed systems.
Platform engineering.
Application modernization.
Software Quality Engineering.
DevOps and DevSecOps practices.
Cloud transformation programs.

What Makes You Successful

You see beyond today's software delivery practices.

You understand that the future is not about replacing people with AI.

It is about creating high-performing engineering systems where people and intelligent agents collaborate effectively.

You

Think strategically while remaining hands-on.
Are comfortable leading change and challenging established ways of working.
Inspire teams to embrace innovation.
Balance experimentation with governance and business value.
Translate emerging technologies into practical outcomes.
Build trust with customers and stakeholders.
Focus on measurable impact rather than technology for technology's sake.
Continuously explore new possibilities and share what you learn.

Most importantly, you are passionate about shaping the future of software engineering.

Additional Information

Why Join Us?

You will help shape some of the most important transformations for our customers.

The transition from traditional organizations toward modern enterprises where people, data and AI work together to create value.

You Will Work At The Intersection Of

Business Transformation
Product Innovation
Digital Strategy
Artificial Intelligence
Modern Operating Models
Human-AI Collaboration
Customer Experience
Software Delivery and Technology

Most importantly, you will help organizations create meaningful business outcomes by combining the best of human expertise, proven delivery practices, and emerging technologies.

Technology is not the destination. Value is.

And your role will be to help customers get there.
