jobs.title: Product Software Architect
jobs.description:
**Shape the technology behind our products and influence how we build for the future.**  

**Work with talented Product and Engineering teams to solve complex challenges and make smart technical decisions.**  

**Stay close to the technology, from prototypes and spikes through to real\-world solutions.**  

**Bring your ideas, experience and technical leadership to a role where you can make a real impact.**


Main Purpose of the Role:


The Product Software Architect provides architectural leadership across the Mail Metrics product software estate. The role helps Product delivery teams make fast, safe and well\-informed technical decisions while maintaining a cohesive view of the wider product architecture.


Working in partnership with Lead Developers, Engineers, Product, Quality and domain subject\-matter experts, the role shapes target\-state architecture, guides significant initiatives, establishes reusable software patterns and makes key technical trade\-offs and non\-functional requirements explicit.


Architecture is lightweight, pragmatic and delivery\-focused. The role contributes architectural direction, constraints, dependencies, risks and enabling work into the single integrated product roadmap, alongside customer, commercial, operational and regulatory inputs.


The Product Software Architect remains technically hands\-on, using spikes, prototypes, reference implementations and code\-level engagement to prove direction, reduce uncertainty and build credibility. The role develops distributed architectural capability through partnership, mentoring and constructive challenge, while holding clear decision accountability for material cross\-product, high\-risk or unresolved software architecture choices.

  

Location:


Hybrid role based from the Huddersfield or Leicester office, with flexibility to work remotely in line with company policy.


The role requires regular collaboration across the UK, Ireland and Poland and occasional travel to company, customer or partner sites.


Role Description:

### **Product Architecture Direction and Integrated Roadmap**

* Define and evolve the target\-state software architecture for the Mail Metrics product estate across the Migrate, Run, Grow and Transform agenda.
* Maintain a cohesive architectural view across product components, integrations, data flows and shared capabilities.
* Identify architectural constraints, dependencies, technical debt, technology lifecycle risks and enabling work that may materially affect product outcomes or delivery.
* Provide clear architecture input into the single integrated product roadmap, helping Product make informed prioritisation and sequencing decisions.
* Translate product strategy, client needs, operational requirements and business goals into pragmatic architectural direction and deliverable change.

### **Initiative Architecture \& Technical Discovery**

* Guide the architecture of significant product initiatives, making design options, assumptions, constraints and trade\-offs explicit.
* Lead or support architecture discovery across migration gaps, service improvements, product capabilities and strategic initiatives.
* Use spikes, prototypes and reference implementations to validate direction, reduce uncertainty and demonstrate viable approaches.
* Contribute directly to production software on an exceptional basis where targeted involvement will materially unblock delivery, reduce risk or demonstrate architectural direction.
* Take ownership of ambiguous technical challenges, engage the right stakeholders and drive decisions through to implementation.

### **Patterns, Non\-Functional Requirements and Assurance**

* Establish lightweight software architecture principles, patterns and guardrails that enable teams to make safe and consistent decisions without unnecessary governance overhead.
* Identify and shape architecturally significant non\-functional requirements, including security, privacy, resilience, performance, scalability, availability, observability, maintainability, supportability and cost.
* Embed regulatory and compliance considerations into software architecture from discovery through delivery.
* Review significant designs and implementations proportionately to their risk and impact, maintaining coherence while preserving distributed technical design ownership.
* Ensure material decisions, assumptions, deviations and exceptions are consciously understood, risk\-assessed and recorded using Architecture Decision Records or comparable lightweight techniques.
* Make or arbitrate material cross\-product, high\-risk or unresolved software architecture decisions, escalating through appropriate governance where business acceptance of risk is required.

### **Product Technology, IP \& Build, Buy or Partner Decisions**

* Define clear boundaries between strategic Mail Metrics software intellectual property, commodity capability and third\-party technology.
* Guide build, buy or partner decisions by assessing strategic fit, differentiation, time to value, total cost of ownership, integration complexity, security, operability, extensibility, vendor dependency and exit risk.
* Evaluate cloud, automation, AI\-enabled and third\-party technology options as potential approaches rather than predetermined solutions, recommending the option that best balances customer value, risk, cost and architectural fit.
* Collaborate with Infrastructure and Data Architecture colleagues so software designs align with wider strategies while preserving clear accountability between disciplines.

### **Architecture Knowledge, Technical Leadership \& Influence**

* Maintain a purposeful, right\-sized product architecture repository using C4, Architecture Decision Records and other appropriate techniques to show context, boundaries, significant decisions and future direction.
* Establish simple documentation expectations that support consistency, traceability and knowledge sharing without duplicating detailed engineering documentation.
* Mentor Lead Developers and Engineers in architectural thinking, patterns, trade\-off analysis and non\-functional considerations, developing decision\-makers rather than centralising authority.
* Facilitate cross\-component technical discussions where changes span product or service boundaries.
* Influence technical direction through credibility, clarity of reasoning and partnership.
* Communicate architectural options, constraints and recommendations clearly to Product, Technology, senior stakeholders, clients and partners.
* Define and monitor a small set of useful architecture effectiveness measures, such as decision lead time, recurring exceptions, reduction of material technical risk and reuse of shared capabilities.


Required Qualification/Experience/Skills:

### **Essential Skills**

* Significant experience designing, delivering and evolving complex production software in a software engineering or architecture role.
* Strong architecture experience across distributed, cloud\-based, integration\-heavy, event\-driven, messaging\-heavy or high\-volume transactional systems.
* Experience shaping significant product initiatives by identifying architectural options, constraints, trade\-offs and non\-functional requirements.
* Experience evolving established software estates through migration, compatibility, coexistence and progressive change.
* Practical experience using C4, Architecture Decision Records, spikes, prototypes or reference implementations to guide decisions and reduce uncertainty.
* Experience working with Lead Developers, senior engineers and Product delivery teams where technical design ownership is distributed.
* Experience evaluating build, buy or partner options and presenting clear recommendations based on customer value, risk, cost and trade\-offs.
* Experience setting pragmatic technical standards or guardrails and conducting proportionate architecture or design reviews.
* Experience incorporating security, privacy, resilience or regulatory considerations into software design and delivery.
* Strong understanding of distributed software architecture, including component and service boundaries, APIs, integration, messaging, event\-driven patterns and data ownership.
* Strong knowledge of high\-volume asynchronous processing and the trade\-offs involved in designing reliable distributed systems.
* Strong understanding of cloud\-native, containerised and orchestrated application environments and their implications for resilience, scalability and operability.
* Ability to identify and balance non\-functional requirements across security, privacy, resilience, performance, scalability, availability, observability, maintainability, supportability and cost.
* Strong software engineering capability, including the ability to engage credibly in code\-level discussions and contribute directly where targeted involvement adds material value.
* Ability to create purposeful architecture artefacts without unnecessary process or duplication.
* Ability to distil complex choices into clear options, trade\-offs and recommendations for technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Strong facilitation, mentoring, influencing and stakeholder communication skills.
* Professional fluency in written and spoken English.

### **Essential Behaviours**

* Acts as a collaborative technical leader who develops decision\-makers rather than centralising authority.
* Builds credibility through sound technical judgement, practical experience and direct engagement with engineering challenges.
* Challenges unnecessary complexity and seeks simpler approaches that improve delivery speed and product outcomes.
* Balances strategic direction with pragmatism, favouring evolutionary improvement where appropriate.
* Is open about assumptions, uncertainty, technical debt and architectural risk.
* Takes ownership, embraces ambiguity and drives decisions to a clear conclusion.
* Works constructively across organisational and technical boundaries through influence, clarity and partnership.

### **Desirable**

* Experience in high\-volume, regulated or compliance\-sensitive environments.
* Experience across a multi\-component SaaS or product software estate.
* Knowledge of .NET, Golang and React, or evidence of becoming effective quickly in comparable technologies.
* Experience of legacy modernisation, platform consolidation, customer migration or complex systems integration.
* Knowledge of document composition, workflow orchestration, customer journey or decisioning platforms.
* Knowledge of business messaging and conversational channels such as RCS, WhatsApp, SMS or comparable services.
* Experience designing or evaluating AI\-enabled product capabilities, including data boundaries, failure handling and human oversight.
* Experience supporting client, partner or supplier\-facing technical discussions in an enterprise environment.
* Professional working capability in Polish.
* Relevant professional architecture, cloud or security certification.


Company Benefits:

26 Days Holidays plus Bank Holidays


24/7 Employee Assistance Programme


Enhanced Maternity/Paternity


Refer a Friend Scheme

* Site Visits: Willingness to travel for site visits and site surveys, primarily within the

**SP Energy Networks, Prenton Way, Prenton, Birkenhead. CH43 3ET**

**Purpose**

The position of Senior Field Engineer (Telecoms) is positioned within the Telecoms function of SP Energy Networks. In this role you will provide effective support on the planning, delivery and cost effectiveness of the Operational Telecom infrastructure to the Strategic Telecom Manager. You will act as the delivery authority, supporting the planning of designs on behalf of internal customers liaising with Telecom service providers to deliver their business requirements.


Required to Project and Delivery manage Telecom projects for Adds, Moves and Changes to Strategic Telecoms networks, services must be delivered to customers on time and by the ‘Request for Service’ date prior to being handed to the Operations and Maintenance function completed to levels set by the Design \& Standards function.


We are looking for individuals with experience in managing a Utility sector internal operational Telecom network, with proven experience and expert knowledge. You will also possess good inter\-personal and communication skills with the ability to form effective working relationships with other departments and businesses.


**Responsibilities**  

In this role, you will support SP Energy Networks' Operational Excellence goals and wider business objectives, ensuring that Health, Safety, Security, Environment and Quality (HSSEQ) standards are consistently achieved in all activities.


* **Delivery Management**

You will play a key role in overseeing the safe and effective delivery of Telecommunications projects and operational activities. This will include reviewing site safety arrangements and safe working practices adopted by SPEN Telecoms Contractors, assessing project plans to ensure baseline programmes are realistic and achievable, and providing work instructions to Contractors. You will monitor and review build and civil engineering activities to ensure all work is completed to the required standards.


You will also review and approve CHG requests, ensuring associated activities are completed to the appropriate standard, validate network records, rack and floor diagrams where required, and review end\-of\-job documentation to confirm it aligns with project scope and delivery requirements.


Successful delivery of these responsibilities will be supported through regular site visits and audits.


* **Project Management**

Working closely with customers, you will help develop and maintain an excellent customer experience, responding to requests in a timely manner while ensuring project delivery remains achievable and aligned with agreed project plans and customer expectations.


You will engage with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders across projects and programmes of work to drive successful delivery. This includes collaboration with desk\-based Engineers within Engineering \& Design (E\&D) and Design \& Solutions (D\&S), OTNOM and OTP Contractor resources, end customers, District colleagues, and wider SP Energy Networks teams such as RTS and Cyber. A key aspect of the role will be coordinating with field\-based resources to ensure projects are delivered safely, on time and within budget.


In addition, you will assist with forecasting and reporting activities, supporting the identification and preparation of budgets and helping to maintain accurate CAPEX and OPEX expenditure against project, task and activity budgets. You will also be responsible for managing the field service provision required to support operational telecommunications requirements.


**What you’ll bring**

To be successful in this role, you will hold a degree level qualification, or equivalent, in a relevant technical discipline such as Electrical, Electronic or Telecommunications Engineering.


With proven experience in Project Management, alongside a strong technical background in IP networking technologies, including LAN, WAN and Firewall environments, you will be proficient in Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel and PowerPoint, with experience in using Visio and Microsoft Project. Experience working with operational Telecommunications networks is also essential.


Possessing a solid understanding of SP Energy Networks HSSEQ standards with knowledge of Telecommunications technologies including Fibre, Copper, Microwave Radio, and Public and Private Cellular Technologies, you will be familiar with MPLS\-IP and MPLS\-TP architectures, as well as PDH and SDH technologies, IP telephony solutions and network synchronisation techniques such as SyncE, ToD, NTP and Phase synchronisation. In addition, you will understand Telecommunications equipment power requirements, including \-48V DC systems, Batteries and UPS technologies.


You will have excellent presentation and interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate effectively, influence stakeholders and build strong relationships with both customers and internal teams. As a self\-starter with a proactive, can\-do approach, you will be comfortable working under pressure while balancing the requirements of customers and internal stakeholders, ensuring solution designs remain practical, feasible and deliverable.


Demonstrating a sound understanding of design best practice, Telecommunications business processes and industry frameworks such as eTOM or ITIL, which support the delivery of complex solutions, you will have the ability to quickly learn and master new skills, products and platforms, enabling you to adapt effectively within a fast\-paced and evolving technical environment.


**Whats in it for you**

As well as a competitive salary which is reviewed annually, you can also enjoy a number of other benefits. With our pension scheme, we’ll double match your contribution up to a company contribution of 10%.


At ScottishPower, we believe it’s the little things we do in life that make a big difference. From helping you look after your family’s wellbeing, save for your future and take personal steps for climate action – our benefits are designed to help you do just that \- so that you have everything you need to take care of your world – today and tomorrow. That’s why our benefits include:


* 36 days annual leave
* Holiday purchase – perfect your work/life balance with extra annual leave
* Share Incentive Plan and Sharesave Scheme
* Payroll giving and charity matched funding
* Technology Vouchers – save more and spread the cost of your technology purchases
* Count us in – pledge to reduce carbon emissions and help fight climate change
* Electric Vehicle Schemes – to help you transition to green/clean driving
* Cycle to Work scheme and public transport season ticket loans
* Options to purchase dental insurance, private medical insurance, health cash plan and annual health assessments
* Life Assurance (4x salary)
* Access to ‘nudge’ financial wellbeing support
* Plus shopping, leisure, restaurant and gym discounts, and unique employee deals on travel insurance and more

***Why SP Energy Networks***

SP Energy Networks is part of the Iberdrola Group, one of the world’s largest integrated utility companies and a world leader in wind energy. We keep electricity flowing to homes and businesses through Central and Southern Scotland, North Wales and in the North West of England. We operate over 4000km of cables and lines that make\-up the transmission network – connecting infrastructure like wind farms into the electricity system. It’s a role that puts us right at the heart of Scotland’s ambition to be Net Zero by 2044\. And we’re taking it very seriously.


We’re investing \>£10\.6 billion into our transmission network, directly supporting the rapid growth needed in renewable energy. With diverse opportunities across our businesses and a commitment to invest in our own internal talent, ScottishPower can offer people real career opportunities that meet personal and professional goals, in a global organisation.


Inclusion, diversity, and a social purpose are at the heart of everything we do. Together with our values, they bring us together into a stronger, more sustainable business with direct links to the communities we serve. It takes all kinds of people to build a large\-scale business like ours, so whatever your background, you’ll fit right in.


We are committed to providing reasonable support or adjustments in our recruiting processes for candidates with disabilities, long term conditions, mental health conditions, or who are neurodivergent or require pregnancy\-related support. If you need support, please reach out to careers@scottishpower.com .

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
**Driving Innovation and Trust: Ten’s Journey to Redefine Service Excellence**


Ten is on a mission to become the most trusted service business in the world. Technology\-driven Product is at the centre of our strategy to create a hugely successful service and business. Millions of members already have access to Ten's services across lifestyle, travel, dining and entertainment on behalf of over 50 clients including HSBC, Swisscard, Visa, Mastercard and American Express. Ten's partnerships are based on multi\-year contracts generating revenue through platform\-as\-a\-service and technology fees.


We have the advantages of already being at scale globally with a critical mass of high\-net\-worth members via stable, multi\-year revenue\-generating contracts. We already have a market leading consumer proposition and credibility (and many integrations) with the leading suppliers/partners across our ‘big 4’ service categories of restaurants/travel/entertainment and luxury retail.


We are debt\-free, profitable and the first B Corp listed on the London Stock Exchange (AIM market).


Our plans are to continue to invest into technology (including AI) to become the main way that our members organise their leisure lives. The next few years will see Ten speed up our progress via our Growth Engine strategy making the next huge steps to achieve our ambitions together.


For more information about Ten, please check out our Welcome to Ten video and this article.

**Join Our Team as an AI Engineer!**

Ten is currently building a bigger team of AI engineers in London, and as part of those efforts, we’re currently looking for an **AI Engineer** who will play a critical role in designing, building, deploying, and monitoring AI systems that scale across the business and to our millions of members globally.


Your role will involve working in a cross\-functional team, collaborating with product, data and platform teams to produce high quality working software released to a frequent cadence. The team adopts a ‘you build it, you run it’ and DevOps mindset and likes to be hands\-on in all aspects of development. You will be responsible for ensuring the software meets quality through rigorous automated testing and metrics. You will also be responsible for assessing and choosing the right solution for the task at hand whilst considering cost implications and timelines.


If you have a curiosity and passion for AI, whilst a firm grounding in software engineering principles enabling you to build industry leading products, we'd love to hear from you!

 **Requirements**  

* Proficiency in at least one programming language. I.e Python, C\#, JavaScript, Kotlin, Java, Go..
* Experience with Gen AI tools (e.g LangGraph, CrewAI, Hugging Face, OpenAI APIs etc)
* Experience in building and optimising systems for performance, scalability, and reliability
* Understanding of ML fundamentals (training, evaluation, deployment) and LLM\-specific challenges (prompt engineering, latency, cost optimisation, hallucinations, evaluation)
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform etc).
* Hands\-on with DevOps/Infra tooling (CI/CD, Docker, K8s) and observability (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog etc)
* Experience building distributed systems
* Knowledge and hands\-on experience with multiple datastores (both SQL and NoSQL)
* Desired experience in building agents and workflows (e.g autonomous systems or multi\-agent architectures)
* A passion for AI Engineering
* Fluent in English (C2 proficiency)

**Guidelines for Hybrid/Home Office :**

* Located in London
* Please note that if you live within a commutable distance of the office you will be asked to enter into a hybrid working arrangement \- at least 2/3x a week in the office.
* A secure home office at your confirmed address, free from background noise or other distractions.
* You must meet our minimum internet speeds if you want to work remotely / in our hybrid model and this will be checked during the recruitment process and again when you join. We also have a great office that you can work from as an alternative.

  

**Benefits**  

Our people are at the heart of the business, and we have a culture of recognition and reward \- both through regular appraisals but also annual Extra Mile Awards where we celebrate those who have gone that extra mile in their role. We also encourage all our staff to incorporate their aspirations and interests into their career at Ten and we are there every step of the way in supporting development.

***Rewards designed around you:***

* A competitive salary will be offered depending on experience
* Offer flexible work arrangements including Hybrid work possibilities
* Annual Leave of 25 days per annum and an additional 3 extra days of annual leave in the third year
* One (1\) month paid Sabbatical after every 5 years of Service, without tapping into annual leave
* Employer\-contributory company pension (with a scheme that allows full decision making about what investments are made, levels of risk, ethical funds etc.)
* Lucrative Ten Loyalty Rewards program
* Remote Working Holidays \- Travel and Work for up to 4 weeks per year!
* Access to lots of great travel and entertainment discounts as our clients’ members would!
* Be part of our global, dynamic, and inclusive Team, with diversity at its core.
* Possibility of growth within a dynamic and international company

**Who Are We**


Ten is a leading lifestyle and concierge company helping our clients discover, organise, enjoy and get the most from life. We partner with global financial institutions and other premium brands to attract and retain wealth and mass affluent clients. Established in the UK in 1998 and with over 25 years of experience, Ten operates in over 20 cities worldwide, in over 26 languages, with 65% of our workforce globally distributed and is publicly listed on the London Stock Exchange ('TENG'). We were the first concierge business to be awarded the B Corp certification in the UK in 2023\.


Ten’s strategy focuses on four key areas: deliver a world\-class member experience, invest in technology, expand contracts with new and existing clients as well as develop our foothold in new markets by leveraging our market\-leading service proposition.


At Ten, you’ll be part of a global, dynamic, and inclusive team, with diversity at its core and endless opportunities for growth.


Join us and experience a workplace where you can truly thrive. https://tenlifestylegroup.com/ten\-tv/

**Commitment to Diversity**


We encourage diverse philosophies, cultures, and experiences. We appreciate diversity and are dedicated to creating an inclusive work environment for our employees. This idea unites the teams at TEN. All aspects of our relationship, including the decision to hire, promote, discipline, or terminate, will be based on merit, competence, performance and business needs.

jobs.title: Structural Engineer for calculations (for projects in Sweden)
jobs.description:
### **Job Description**


In Sweden we currently have 80 Structural building engineers working within Public and Commercial places. We work with a wide scope of assignments ranging from the planning\-stage to execution of drawings for final production. In general we work in 10\-15 persons teams assigned to different projects, our engineers have a typical workload of 2\-4 ongoing projects.


Typical projects are within the segments airports, hospitals, offices, schools, public transportation, high security facilities, defense, retail and residential.


**Our Service Areas\-you will become part of one of the described Teams:**


Region East \- Structural Engineering


Region East consists of approximately 35 structural engineers located across Stockholm, Norrköping, Linköping and Motala. The organization is characterized by a strong senior profile, with the majority of its engineers having 10\-35 years of experience in structural engineering and building design.


The region delivers structural engineering services across a broad range of sectors, including healthcare facilities, schools, airports, sports facilities, defense, residential developments, office buildings, energy facilities, and transportation/infrastructure projects. Clients are primarily public sector organizations, such as municipalities, regional authorities, government agencies, and public property owners, complemented by collaborations with contractors and private developers.


With offices strategically located in both the Stockholm area and Östergötland, Region East combines extensive technical expertise with strong local presence and the capacity to manage complex multidisciplinary projects throughout Sweden. The region is led by Joakim Tornberg (Market area manager), Daniel Warminski (SAM Stockholm South), Victor Prevé (SAM Stockholm North), and Peter Svensson (SAM Östergötland).


Region West \- Structural Engineering


Region West consists of approximately 30 structural engineers based in Göteborg, Skövde and Alingsås. The organization is characterized by a strong senior profile, with the majority of its engineers having 10\-30 years of experience in structural engineering and building design.


The region delivers structural engineering services across a broad range of sectors, including healthcare facilities, schools, residential developments, defense projects, and energy\-related facilities. Clients primarily comprise public sector organizations, such as municipalities and regional authorities, as well as major construction companies and contractors.


With offices strategically located across western Sweden, Region West combines extensive technical expertise with strong local presence and the capability to support projects ranging from complex public buildings and healthcare facilities to residential and energy\-sector developments. The region is led by Karin Stagemyr (Market area manager), Keyvan Zeidi (SAM Skövde/Alingsås) and Magnus Clase (SAM Göteborg).


Region North – Structural Engineering


Region North consists of a team of 15 structural engineers, the majority of whom have 5\-15 years of experience in the industry. The unit is located in the northern part of Sweden with offices in Östersund, Umeå, Örnsköldsvik, Mora, Lycksele and Sollefteå. Typical projects for this unit include hospitals, schools, residential and defense facilities. Clients are often public\-sector organizations such as municipalities or government organizations. The region is led by Rasmus Brink (Market area manager) and Joel Melander (SAM).


**Based on your experience and qualifications we will recognize you at the position of assistant structural designer or junior structural designer.**


Your key responsibilities


* Develop structural designs for buildings
* Perform structural calculations and analysis according to Eurocode
* Collaborate with architects and other engineers to optimize building designs
* Ensure compliance with building codes and regulations
* Prepare detailed technical drawings and specifications
* Report and follow up on own progress and budget

### **Qualifications**


We expect that you have


* Master's degree in Civil Engineering or Structural Engineering
* A minimum of 3 years of experience in structural design for buildings
* Proficiency in performing structural calculations both manually and using structural analysis software
* Proficiency in designing load\-bearing structures according to Eurocode
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent communication skills in English
* An unpretentious attitude, a team player, and a solution\-oriented mindset.

We appreciate if you also have


* Experience of working with projects in Sweden
* Proficiency in modelling and drawing production in Tekla or Revit
* Knowledge of Swedish

### **Company Description**


AFRY provides engineering, design, digital and advisory services to accelerate the transition towards a sustainable society.


AFRY employs over 18,000 professionals in more than 50 countries. Net sales in 2024 were SEK 27,160 million.


AFRY is organized into three Divisions: Energy; Industry and Transportation \& Places.


The Global Division Transportation \& Places is active within transportation infrastructure, real estate, water and environment in the Nordics and Central Europe. The division has about 6,500 employees and is structured around two segments: Road \& Rail and Public \& Commercial Places.


### **Additional Information**


To individuals who join our team, we offer:


* Employment based on an employment contract
* Private medical insurance, life assurance, sport card (Multisport) and a social found
* Exciting and challenging projects
* Personal development opportunities
* Friendly working atmosphere in a multidisciplinary and international team
* Helping to shape a sustainable future

We value a healthy work life balance and are committed to your wellbeing. We will operate a hybrid working environment.


*We are excited to receive your application,* ***please ensure your CV is in English****.*


Should you be successful you will be invited for a telephone interview followed by a 2 steps virtual or live face to face interview.


*At AFRY, we engineer change in everything we do. Change happens when brave ideas come together. When we collaborate, innovate technology, and embrace challenging points of view. That’s how we're making future. We are actively looking for qualified candidates to join our inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. Join us in accelerating the transition towards a sustainable future.*

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
**Data powers every package we deliver—and as our Engineering Manager, you’ll power the team behind it.**


At Instabee, our Data Platform team is at the heart of how we make faster, smarter decisions, from lead times and locker performance to merchant checkout analytics. We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead this team, someone who's ready to grow people, scope projects and shape deliveries, and manage stakeholders with ease.


You should understand the product roadmap well enough to contribute to it, be comfortable facilitating discussions and unblocking the team, and bring enough high tech fluency to support the team when it's needed. You'll join our EM crew and work closely with your team's Product Manager, Staff Engineer, and business stakeholders across the company.

**Some of the things you'll do:**

* Lead a small, sharp team of engineers. 1:1s, coaching, hiring, and performance, all on you
* Continue build a team culture where psychological safety isn't a buzzword, it's the baseline
* Build a strong partnership with your Product Manager and Staff Engineer to clearly advocate for the team’s roadmap and constraints, while effectively bridging communication with Engineering Directors and Business Leads
* Help the team break down messy, ambiguous problems into concrete next steps
* Own delivery and team health in a lean setup. No safety net of extra support layers beneath you
* Help shape a strong EM culture by sharing what you learn (and stealing what works from others)

##### **Your future team**


The Data Platform team is a central team building a modern data platform on GCP and Snowflake for delivering core data products and metrics to the whole organization. It is pulling in data from everywhere, and owning everything from CI/CD and infrastructure\-as\-code to pipeline orchestration. The work is technical, high\-impact, and essential to whether the rest of the business can actually trust its data.

##### **What we're looking for**


We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys leading people and isn't afraid to dive into the messy parts of building a team.

**What you'll bring to the table:**

* **A coaching mindset and passion for team dynamics:** You are genuinely energized by growing people, building trust, and shaping high\-performing teams.
* **The courage to guide through change:** You have the guts to hold hard conversations when necessary and steer the team through organizational shifts.
* **Adaptive leadership:** The instinct to know when to lead versus when to manage, and the wisdom to tell the difference.
* **Scoping, prioritizing, and planning:** Proven ability to break apart complex projects into clear, actionable steps and realistic goals.
* **Ways of Working \& unblocking:** Expertise in agile practices, facilitating technical discussions, and clearing roadblocks to keep the team moving forward.
* **Clear stakeholder communication:** Strong expectation management skills across business leads and directors..
* **High\-level technical fluency:** Enough tech background (e.g., modern data platforms, infrastructure) to earn respect, understand context, and support the team where needed.
* **Product roadmap alignment:** Experience contributing directly to product strategy to advocate for the team’s roadmap.
* **Language skills:** Spoken or written Swedish is a plus, though English is our daily working language.

##### **What you'll get**


We can promise you'll be challenged, grow fast, and work alongside genuinely excellent people. If you like shaking things up and building new ways of working from scratch — this is your place.

**Beyond the usual essentials, we've also got:**


**Six months' parental pay:** Step away and give your little one everything they need


**A day off on your birthday:** Because you deserve to celebrate properly

**Hybrid \& Flexible:** Work the way that works for you


Diversity and inclusion matter deeply to us, and we're committed to building a workplace where every perspective is valued and everyone has room to grow.

**If leading through change, growing great engineers, and turning complex challenges into clear paths forward sounds like your kind of work, we’d love to hear from you!**

**Note on our process:** *As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and trustworthy workplace, all candidates applying to Instabee in Sweden will undergo a background check conducted by Svensk Bakgrundsanalys. This review examines public criminal records and is a mandatory step in our recruitment process. While the results are public information, we handle all data with the utmost confidentiality.*

RWS is a global AI solutions company empowering the world’s most trusted enterprise AI.  

Our proprietary Cultural Intelligence Layer, powered by 250,000 data specialists, cultural and language experts and deep domain professionals, backed by 45\+ patents, makes enterprise AI culturally fluent, contextually accurate and secure, ensuring every interaction reflects a brand’s tone, context and customer values.  

Through our Generate, Transform and Protect segments, we deliver intelligent content, enterprise knowledge, large\-scale localization and IP protection for global growth. Headquartered in the UK, RWS is listed on AIM (RWS.L).
More information: rws.com. **About Propylon**  

  

Propylon is the Dublin\-based content‑management arm within the RWS group, specialising in software for legal and regulatory workflows. For more than 20 years, Propylon has helped governments, standard bodies and regulated organisations manage legislation, regulations and legal content in a smarter, modular way.  

Joining Propylon means working in a people\-led, innovation\-driven environment recognised as one of Ireland’s Best Workplaces in Tech \- while having the backbone and global reach of RWS. You’d be contributing to meaningful projects that shape law, compliance and global content workflows, with the support and flexibility to grow your skills and career.

* Work with a highly skilled engineering team who are experts in their field
* Design and implement new features for Propylon’s core product suite
* Build in\-depth experience with Python, JavaScript, and C\#
* Work on exciting data challenges such as NLP, topic discovery, similarity detection and more

  

**Daily activities include**  

* Attending daily team standups
* Participating in the code review process
* Writing software for our core product suite
* Working alongside senior engineers, software architects, and team leads to solve problems for our clients and implement new product features

  

**An ideal candidate should have:**  

* A love for technology
* Confidence in taking on large projects and initiatives
* Some experience in Linux\-based systems
* Ideally, prior experience with one of the following: Python, C\#, or JavaScript
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills
* Experience with machine learning would be a plus

 **Location:**  

This role is based in our Dublin office, in Rathfarnham, South Dublin, though we operate a very flexible hybrid model which facilitates regular home\-working. (There are transport links located directly outside the office, bus routes: 16, 16D, 15B, 74, and S6\. There is also an underground car park with free parking available.)  

Find out more about the Internship experience at Propylon: https://youtu.be/RQscalg1VTM

**Life at RWS** **\-** If you like the idea of working with smart people who are passionate about growing the value of ideas, data and content by making sure organizations are understood, then you’ll love life at RWS.  

Our purpose is to unlock global understanding. This means our work fundamentally recognizes the value of every language and culture. So, we celebrate difference, we are inclusive and believe that diversity makes us strong. We want every employee to grow as an individual and excel in their career.  

In return, we expect all our people to live by the values that unite us: **to partner**, putting clients fist and winning together**, to pioneer**, innovating fearlessly and leading with vision and courage, **to progress**, aiming high and growing through actions and **to deliver**, owning the outcome and building trust with our colleagues and clients. **RWS embraces DEI** and promotes equal opportunity, we are an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. RWS is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at RWS are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, religion, nationality, ethnicity, sex, age, disability, or sexual orientation. RWS will not tolerate discrimination based on any of these characteristics.

**RWS Values**

jobs.description:

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X .

  

**Position Overview:**  

Analog Devices is seeking an RF Application Engineer based in Limerick, Ireland who will focus the on development of the latest RF product ICs. The RF product portfolio of this strategy consists of RF Phase Locked Loops (PLL), Voltage Controlled Oscillators (VCO), integrated PLL/VCOs, JESD204 and Network Clock ICS, frequency multipliers, Direct Digital Synthesizers (DDS) and frequency dividers used in a wide range of different markets and applications.


The Applications Engineer will perform a range of tasks in all phases of the product life cycle from product definition, new product development, technical training and customer support of new and existing products. These tasks include hardware design, block diagram verification, hardware user guides and application notes, working with other product lines to understand and develop complete signal chain solutions, developing training material for field applications engineers, making device measurements and providing input for new product definitions.


**As an Applications Engineer, you will:**

* Become an RF product expert that will interface with customers and field applications to solve challenging customer design problems.
* Provide timely responses to customer and FAE questions.
* Support customer design\-in activities and resolving challenging design problems.
* Develop datasheets, user guides, evaluation boards, and application notes for products supported.
* Development of technical training material for field application engineers.
* Develop in\-depth understanding of customer applications and convert this into inputs to new product definitions.
* Perform measurements in lab and develop python\-based scripts for data capture.

**Requirements:**

* B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Electronics or Electrical Engineering.
* Hands\-on experience with silicon evaluation.
* Hands\-on experience with test instruments, such as Spectrum Analyzers, Phase Noise Analyzers, Vector Network Analyzers.
* Hands\-on programming experience in either Python, C, C\+\+, or C\#.
* Some knowledge of programmable logic (FPGA) and SoC development is a plus.
* Excellent presentation and technical writing skills.

Good communication skills and ability to work as part of a multidisciplinary team.

jobs.title: Data Centre Commissioning Engineer – Process Water Treatment
jobs.description:
**About the Role:**


The Commissioning Engineer will lead the commissioning, testing, optimisation and handover of advanced process water treatment systems within hyperscale and enterprise data centre environments. This role ensures that all mechanical, electrical, control and process\-treatment systems operate safely, efficiently and in accordance with project specifications, industry standards and client requirements.


The ideal candidate has strong technical expertise in water treatment processes, instrumentation and control systems and thrives in fastpaced, highreliability sectors such as missioncritical data centre operations.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

**Commissioning \& Testing**

* Plan, execute, and document commissioning activities for water treatment systems (e.g., filtration, softening, RO, UF, chemical dosing, polishing).
* Conduct functional testing, FAT/SAT support, equipment startup, performance testing, and process optimisation.
* Verify operation of pumps, valves, skids, chemical handling systems, controls and treatment stages.
* Ensure all systems comply with project specifications, HSE requirements and relevant standards.

**Data Centre Systems Integration**

* Coordinate commissioning activities with mechanical, electrical, and BMS/SCADA teams within data centre environments.
* Validate water quality and system performance to meet cooling, humidification and process\-water requirements.
* Troubleshoot system interactions related to cooling towers, adiabatic systems, closed\-loop circuits, and humidity control.

**Technical Documentation \& Reporting**

* Develop commissioning plans, method statements, risk assessments and testing protocols.
* Produce detailed commissioning reports, performance summaries and O\&M documentation.
* Maintain accurate logs of test results, deviations, punch\-list items and rectification plans.

**Client \& Stakeholder Coordination**

* Work closely with project managers, design engineers, contractors and client FM/operations teams.
* Participate in technical meetings, design reviews and handover discussions.
* Provide technical support and training to client operations teams during transition to steady\-state operations.

**Quality, Safety \& Compliance**

* Ensure all commissioning activities follow safety legislation, environmental guidelines and internal quality systems.
* Identify design or installation issues and propose/implement corrective actions.
* Champion safe work practices within highrisk, missioncritical environments.

 **Required Skills \& Experience:**

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong knowledge of water treatment technologies (e.g., RO, UF, ion exchange, chemical dosing, disinfection, filtration).
* Experience with instrumentation, control systems, PLCs, and BMS/SCADA interfaces.
* Understanding of mechanical and electrical systems in industrial or missioncritical facilities.

**Experience**

* Previous commissioning or process engineering experience in water treatment, industrial utilities, or data centre sectors.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot mechanical, process and control system issues.

**Qualifications**

* Degree/HND in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering or related technical discipline (or equivalent experience).
* Relevant certifications (e.g., IOSH/NEBOSH, water treatment qualifications) beneficial.

**Behavioural Skills**

* Strong problem\-solving ability and technical curiosity.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills.
* Flexible, selfdriven and capable of working independently or within multi\-disciplinary teams.

 **Desirable Experience (Optional):**

* Commissioning in hyperscale cloud provider facilities (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google).
* Experience with highpurity or ultrapure water systems.
* Familiarity with data centre cooling systems and redundancy models (N, N\+1, 2N).
* Knowledge of environmental compliance related to water discharge and chemical handling.

 **Working Conditions:**

* Site\-based or hybrid role depending on project phase.
* May require travel to national or international project sites.
* Work in construction, live data centre, and plant\-room environments.

 **Compensation Package:**

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Opportunities for professional development and career growth
* CPD accredited employer
* A collaborative and supportive work environment
* Laptop or desktop and work mobile phone provided
* Flexible working options, dependent on location and role requirements
* See company website for more information on the benefits of working in EPS Group

  

We welcome speculative applications from individuals of all levels.

**If you have any questions about this role or would like further information, please contact our recruiting team by emailing jobs@epswater.com.**

 **Equal Opportunity Statement** \- EPS Group is an equal opportunities employer.

 **Company Profile**

*Since 1968, we have grown from a modest electrical and pumping services business and developed into an innovative, internationally exporting product and service provider, now focused upon the water, wastewater and clean technology sectors, operating across the Republic of Ireland, the UK and Northern Europe.*

*We are an international water infrastructure specialist, one of the few genuine end\-to\-end service providers in the global water sector, providing large scale employment, bringing market leading and ground breaking technologies to Ireland and working to improve the country's water infrastructure.*

*Our vision is to be the best and most rewarding place to work for our teams, to be our customer's outstanding partner of choice and we are committed to being a Net Zero, sustainable business.*

jobs.description:

---------------


Amazon Web Services is hiring a Software Development Engineer III for the RDS for Oracle team. We are looking for an experienced engineer to design and build the next generation of managed database services that power mission\-critical applications worldwide.  

  

About the Role  

  

As a Software Development Engineer III on the RDS for Oracle team, you will own the design and implementation of complex features that scale to millions of database instances. You will work on the full stack—from kernel\-level optimizations and storage architecture to customer\-facing APIs and operational tooling. Your work directly impacts how enterprises run their most critical databases on AWS.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

You will lead the architecture and design of large\-scale, distributed database systems using RDS Oracle in AWS cloud environments. This includes optimizing performance for high\-availability and scalability, developing solutions that integrate Linux\-based RDS Oracle with AWS infrastructure, and designing integrations between Oracle and other AWS services such as EC2, VPC, and IAM.  

  

You will serve as a technical lead for enterprise\-level database services, addressing complex customer requirements and concerns. You will collaborate with account managers and solution architects to design and implement database solutions that meet specific enterprise needs. You will engage directly with customers to gather requirements, provide technical consultations, and support complex implementations, translating customer needs into technical specifications and product roadmap items.  

  

You will lead agile development cycles to quickly prototype, develop, and deploy new database features and improvements. You will balance speed of delivery with code quality, security, and scalability requirements. You will stay abreast of competitor offerings and contribute to product strategy by proposing and implementing innovative features to maintain AWS's competitive edge in the database services market.  

  

You will develop and implement strategies for managing database performance at massive scale, supporting thousands of concurrent customers. This includes creating advanced monitoring and troubleshooting tools for large\-scale database deployments and designing sophisticated automation systems for database management tasks. You will integrate AI and ML technologies to enhance database performance, security, and ease of use.  

  

You will ensure all database solutions meet required security standards and compliance regulations such as FedRAMP, GDPR, and HIPAA. You will develop and implement security best practices for database management in cloud environments.  

  

You will provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior team members, conduct design reviews, and offer feedback on architecture, performance, and scalability issues. You will create comprehensive technical documentation for internal teams and customers, including best practices guides, whitepapers, and other educational materials related to RDS Oracle on AWS.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.description:
**Senior Software Developer**
=============================

Date: Sep 17, 2026
Location:
Copenhagen, DK
Company: Getinge IT Solutions ApS
Remote Work: 1\-2 days at home (site based)  

**With a passion for life**

  

Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life\-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.


Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.

  

Plenty of developers have tried an AI agent. Fewer have run several in parallel, built their own tooling to keep them on track, and worked out exactly where they shine and where they still fall over. If you are on top of these things and want to contribute to the build\-up of an agentic software organization, we should talk.  

  

  



Getinge is looking for Senior .NET Developers in Copenhagen. You will be building software that hospitals around the world depend on every day, and you will be helping shape how a large software organization adopts AI. We have several positions open.  

  

  



**What you would be building**


Getinge is a global MedTech company, and our teams in Copenhagen, Hamburg and Aarhus build software that runs at the heart of a modern hospital. Our solutions track surgical instruments through sterile reprocessing with full traceability, orchestrate fleets of robots and reprocessing equipment, plan and optimize the surgical day, coordinate patient flow and staff in real time, and keep thousands of connected medical devices running in the field.


Our software is mission\-critical, deeply integrated with hospital IT and physical equipment, and built to a high standard of quality. It is also software where the impact is immediate and real: better use of an operating room, an instrument set that arrives on time, a surgery that goes ahead instead of being cancelled. Not everyone gets to end the week knowing their work helped someone get treated.  

  

  



**What we work with**


Our teams work primarily in C\#/.Net \&Blazor, with focus on containerization and cloud deployment to Azure, across the organization that spans web and mobile applications, cloud services, real\-time systems, and integration with physical equipment.


We are not looking for a checklist match for all of it. What matters is that you are strong in .NET, that you are comfortable working across a stack rather than in one corner of it, and that you pick new things up quickly. The exact mix varies by team, and we will find the right fit together.  

  

  



**Where we are with AI**


We are currently in the process of accelerating our software factory with AI. Our teams have been exploring AI\-assisted and agentic development processes for some time and are implementing our learnings. However, we are seeking additional fresh perspectives on the matter. This is where you come in.


If you have real experience here and strong opinions about what works, you will find both room to use them and colleagues who will argue back.


Our developers have access to the latest models and a meaningful budget for AI tooling and usage, and we are also looking at introducing new and improved methods and tools to improve our way of working.

  

**What you will do**


* Design, build, and maintain robust .NET services and applications for mission\-critical hospital software.
* Build and integrate **agentic AI** capabilities – designing, orchestrating, and evaluating AI agents and LLM\-driven workflows in our products and in how we work.
* Drive AI adoption in your team and across the organization, setting the standard for how modern tooling improves quality, speed, and value delivered.
* Contribute to system architecture, code quality, and engineering practices.

Work closely with product owners, architects, UX/UI, and developers across multiple sites.  
* 

**You will bring**


* **Strong .NET expertise** – deep, hands\-on experience building and maintaining production software in C\# and modern .NET.
* **Breadth and adaptability** – you are happy to work across the stack and into the cloud, and you are not thrown by a technology you have not used before.
* **Real depth with AI in practice** – you use AI tools in your daily work, you are hands\-on with agents and LLM\-driven workflows, and you can point to things you have actually built with them. We care more about what you have done and how you think about it than about years on a CV.
* **A proactive, positive, and constructive mindset** – you take ownership from start to finish, communicate openly, and make the people around you better.

The ability to build maintainable, high\-quality solutions and to work independently as well as in a team.  
* 

**Nice to have**


* Experience with hardware–software integration, robotics, or embedded systems.
* Experience with event\-driven architecture, messaging, or distributed systems.

Experience working in Agile teams on regulated or safety\-critical products.  
* 

**What we offer**


Getinge is a leading global provider of products and systems that improve healthcare quality and efficiency, with the ambition to be the most desired MedTech company in the world. You would join our Digital Health Solutions department, which counts around 165 people across Denmark, Germany, and the UK, plus a further 100 colleagues in Getinge offices globally.


* A smart working environment with shared desks, several work\-from\-home days per week, and a budget for your home office setup.
* Flexible working hours.
* Competitive benefits including health insurance and pension.
* Opportunities for professional growth and continuous learning.
* A collaborative, inclusive, and motivating culture.
  

**Application**
Applications will be reviewed continually, and we therefore recommend sending us your application as soon as possible, but no later than 17\-10\-2026


We kindly ask you to submit your application in our recruitment system by clicking the “apply now” button. Due to GDPR regulations we do not accept applications via e\-mail.

  

If you have any questions regarding the role, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Joakim Martinsson at joakim.martinsson@getinge.com  

We look forward to receiving your application. We hope you will join us on our journey to become the world’s most desired MedTech company. \#LI\-JM2  

**About us**

With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.

  

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

jobs.title: Bliv Senior Software Engineer til Core Customer i en foreningsejet Nykredit-koncern
jobs.description:
*Vil du bruge din tekniske tyngde dér, hvor stabilitet, kvalitet og sikkerhed virkelig betyder noget – og samtidig være med til at flytte Nykredits digitale fundament?*


Vi søger en Senior Software Engineer, der mestrer sit håndværk, sætter en ære i clean code og robuste løsninger og har lyst til at tage et tydeligt teknisk ansvar i et af Nykredits mest forretningskritiske udviklingsteams.


Du bliver en central spiller i udviklingen af løsninger, der understøtter og håndterer centrale kundedata på tværs af hele koncernen. Det er software, der bliver brugt hver dag, og som skal fungere hver gang. Samtidig får du mulighed for at påvirke arkitektur, teknologivalg og udviklingsmetoder i tæt samarbejde med både forretningen og de teams, der er afhængige af jeres leverancer.


**Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver bliver**  

Som Senior Software Engineer får du en rolle med både hands\-on udvikling og mulighed for teknisk lederskab:


* Udvikling af services og API’er: Design, udvikling og vedligeholdelse af højkvalitets software i Java afviklet på WebLogic og Kubernetes.
* Cloud platforme: Drive og understøtte ibrugtagning af cloud\-infrastruktur inden for kundedatadomænet.
* Kvalitet og standarder: Sikre høj kodekvalitet gennem bl.a. code reviews, ”Clean Code”\-principper og automatiserede tests som fx Behavior\-Driven Development (BDD), Test\-Driven Development (TDD).
* Performance og sikkerhed: Indtænke performance og sikkerhed i hele udviklingslivscyklussen – fra design til drift.
* Innovation og AI: Tage ejerskab for anvendelsen af AI\-værktøjer i udviklingsarbejdet og bidrage til smartere og mere effektive leverancer.
* Samarbejde på tværs: Arbejde tæt sammen med andre teams i Nykredit, hvor vores løsninger ofte er en kritisk byggesten i større initiativer.

**Er det dig, vi leder efter?**
  

Vi forestiller os, at du:


* Har minimum 5 års erfaring som softwareudvikler og er tryg i rollen som senior.
* Har en relevant uddannelse inden for datalogi, software engineering eller lignende – eller tilsvarende erfaring.
* Arbejder solidt med Java (Java EE / Jakarta EE / Spring Boot) og har erfaring med:
	+ API\-design og microservices
	+ CI/CD, event frameworks, datamodellering og databasemodellering
	+ Værktøjer som fx Atlassian tool suite, \-Maven, \-Github, \-SonarQube og \-Snyk m.fl.
* Anvender AI i dit daglige arbejde (i alle faser af udviklingsarbejdet)
* Har interesse for – og gerne erfaring med – finansielle systemer og komplekse forretningsdomæner.
* Tænker i løsninger, tager ansvar og trives med både selvstændigt arbejde og tæt samarbejde.
* Kommunikerer klart på dansk og engelsk og har lyst til at dele viden og løfte andre omkring dig.

Kendskab til Quarkus, .NET og Azure er en fordel, men ikke et krav.


Til gengæld lover vi både udvikling og muligheder til dig, der vil og kan.


**Dit nye team**
  

Du bliver en del af Core Customer\-teamet i Nykredit Core Banking, som har ansvaret for at levere IT\-løsninger inden for kunde\- og partsdata, herunder relaterede systemer, og som er i gang med en teknologisk transformation mod cloud\-baseret arkitektur.


Teamet er tværfagligt og består af udviklere, QA og forretningsprofiler fordelt mellem København og Warszawa, hvor samarbejde og fælles ejerskab for leverancerne er i fokus.


Vi glæder os til at tage godt imod dig som vores nye kollega.


**Hvorfor skal du vælge os?**
  

I Nykredits IT\-afdeling bliver du en del af en organisation, hvor teknologi, samarbejde og kontinuerlig læring er centrale drivkræfter. Vi arbejder med komplekse og forretningskritiske løsninger, der har en konkret betydning for den finansielle sektor, og hvor kvalitet, stabilitet og sikkerhed ikke er til forhandling.


Du får mulighed for at arbejde på udfordrende projekter med reel forretningsmæssig værdi, i et miljø præget af faglig sparring, videndeling og fokus på arkitektur og bæredygtige løsninger. Samtidig tilbyder vi konkurrencedygtige vilkår, attraktive personalegoder, mulighed for én hjemmearbejdsdag om ugen og gode muligheder for både faglig og karrieremæssig udvikling i en organisation, der investerer i sine medarbejdere.


Stillingen er placeret på Nykredit\-koncernens hovedkontor i Nordhavn. Vi lægger vægt på fleksibilitet i hverdagen, så arbejdsliv og privatliv kan hænge fornuftigt sammen.


**Vil du vide mere?**
  

Du er velkommen til at kontakte mig, Development Manager Jesper Søndergaard på tlf. 22 45 10 41, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen. Du kan også finde mig på LinkedIn her: Jesper Søndergaard \| LinkedIn


Har du spørgsmål til rekrutteringsprocessen, kan du kontakte rekrutteringsteamet på nytjob@nykredit.dk


*Vi inviterer løbende til samtaler og ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning og dit CV.*


Ansøgningsfrist


30\.09\.2026


By


Nordhavn

jobs.title: Fullstack udvikler .Net / AI
jobs.description:
**Job i Eksponent**
-------------------


Vi søger en erfaren/senior udvikler til vores kontor i København. Udvikleren vi søger skal arbejde med en bred række opgaver inden for området \- både med arkitektur, DevOps, udvikling og selvfølgelig sparring til kunder og kollegaer.


Du bliver en central brik på en række af vores vigtigste projekter og i vores organisation, hvor du med din erfaring og kompetencer er med til at styrke vores leverancer. Området vi søger indenfor driver nogle af vores største web\-applikationer.


Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med andre dygtige og ambitiøse udviklere. Derudover indgår projektledere, rådgivere, designere og UX\-specialister på vores teams.

### **Hvad leder vi efter?**

* Ca. 5 års fuldtidserfaring inden for softwareudvikling og har opnået en solid forståelse for hele softwareudviklingsprocessen – fra arkitektur og specifikation til udvikling og vedligeholdelse.
* Erfaring med C\#/.NET/Azure økosystemet og glad for postgress.
* Erfaring med web\-applikationer og uforskrækket over at lave mindre React\-opgaver, selvom det ikke er din primære kompetence.
* Nysgerrig over for AI og så meget hands\-on erfaring at du ved, hvad der (ofte) virker. Bruger Claude Code eller Codex eller Pi.dev eller OpenCode eller tilsvarende. Du behøver ikke være totalt AI\-pilled.
* Gode mundtlige og skriftlige kommunikationsevner og kan formidle komplekse tekniske problemstillinger på en forståelig måde til både tekniske og ikke\-tekniske interessenter på dansk.
* Er selvstændig, struktureret og \- meget vigtigt \- nysgerrig på, hvad der sker inden for de nyeste teknologier inden for webudvikling.
* Du synes, at det er sjovt at løse problemer med teknologi generelt \- ikke kun når du får penge for det.
* Hvis du har erfaring fra bureau eller konsulentvirksomhed er det en fordel.
* Et særligt plus, hvis du har erfaring eller domæneviden fra offentlige kunder og sagsbehandlingssystemer.

**Hvad kan du forvente i Eksponent?**
-------------------------------------

* Dygtige kolleger og ambitiøse kunder
* Et fleksibelt arbejdsmiljø, hvor der er plads til hjemmearbejde
* Effektive projektforløb, hvor du løbende ser resultatet af dit arbejde
* Et godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi arbejder tværfagligt og passer på hinanden
* En faglig konto til kurser og læring
* En hardwarekonto og eget valg af computer og telefon
* God kantineordning og masser af sociale events
* Konkurrencedygtig løn med pensionsordning, sundhedsforsikring, telefon og internet

### **Hvem er vi?**


I Eksponent arbejder vi med digitalisering. Vores mål er at hjælpe kunder med at forbedre kommunikation, samarbejde og services. Vi designer og udvikler ambitiøse digitale produkter \- fra websites til forretningssystemer. Vi rådgiver, faciliterer, og inddrager brugere og kunder. Kulturen er uformel, men professionel. Nysgerrighed, faglighed og fællesskab går hånd i hånd.


Samarbejdet med vores kunder er baseret på et partnerskabs\-mindset, hvor vi gør meget ud af at forstå vores kunders forretning og organisation. Det gør os i stand til at styre og rådgive bedre, og det er forudsætningen for den særlige kundekultur, som Eksponent er kendt for.

### **Vil du vide mere?**


Vil du vide mere om stillingen, og hvordan vi arbejder med softwareudvikling i Eksponent, er du velkommen til at kontakte Martin (martin.bjorn@eksponent.com) eller Christian (christian.dalager@eksponent.com).

### **Søg stillingen**


Send din ansøgning og dit CV til job@eksponent.com og skriv “Fullstack udvikler .Net / AI” i emnefeltet. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og lukker opslaget, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Working closely with Application Experience Engineers, Platform Engineers, Data Engineers, AI \& Data Scientists, Smart Factory Engineers, and business stakeholders, you will build applications that simplify operational processes, improve workforce productivity, and accelerate Agilent's digital transformation.  

  

We welcome candidates across multiple career stages. Responsibilities and technical ownership will be aligned with your experience, expertise, and demonstrated capabilities.

**About Global OT \& AI Engineering**

  

Global OT \& AI Engineering develops the digital platforms that power intelligent operations across Agilent's global manufacturing network.


Our organization combines software engineering, cloud technologies, Artificial Intelligence, enterprise data platforms, industrial automation, and Smart Factory solutions to create scalable digital capabilities that improve operational visibility, accelerate decision\-making, and enable continuous improvement.

Operational excellence depends on providing the right information to the right people at the right time.


As a Digital Solutions Engineer – Operational Applications, you will develop applications that connect frontline employees with enterprise systems, operational data, and intelligent services. Whether supporting manufacturing execution, quality inspections, maintenance activities, warehouse operations, engineering workflows, or operational approvals, your applications will help simplify work and improve decision\-making across Agilent's manufacturing network.


You'll work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams to build secure, scalable, and intuitive operational applications that integrate seamlessly with enterprise platforms, AI capabilities, and Smart Factory technologies.

jobs.title: AI Application Engineer - (Public Sector)
jobs.description:
At Xtremax, we are looking for an **AI Application Engineer** to help turn promising AI prototypes into secure, production\-ready applications. You will work on AI\-enabled solutions such as chatbots, RAG applications, workflow assistants, agents, automation tools, and AI\-powered business applications.


You will work across the full application lifecycle, from understanding business outcomes and assessing early prototypes to engineering, testing, deployment, observability, and production support. The role combines strong software engineering fundamentals with practical AI application development, giving you the opportunity to work with technologies including **Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Graph, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, .NET, Java, and modern CI/CD platforms**.


This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of experimentation and production. You will help establish reusable engineering patterns for AI applications while ensuring that security, privacy, responsible AI, observability, cost management, and long\-term supportability are built into solutions from the start.


Responsibility* Refactor prototypes and AI\-assisted applications into secure, maintainable, production\-grade solutions with clean architecture, robust APIs, authentication, and automated deployment pipelines.
* Design, build, and harden AI\-enabled applications including chatbots, RAG solutions, workflow assistants, agents, automation tools, and AI\-assisted business applications.
* Work with product owners and business stakeholders to translate use cases into clear user journeys, measurable outcomes, adoption metrics, and production\-readiness requirements.
* Develop full\-stack application capabilities across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, data integrations, authentication, authorization, logging, and monitoring.
* Integrate applications with approved AI and enterprise services such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Azure Machine Learning, Microsoft Graph, and enterprise APIs.
* Apply secure and responsible AI patterns including prompt management, retrieval grounding, input/output controls, human\-in\-the\-loop workflows, auditability, and content safety controls.
* Develop reusable AI application patterns, starter templates, and engineering playbooks to accelerate delivery across different use cases.
* Build automated testing for AI applications, including functional and regression testing, prompt evaluation, response quality checks, and guardrail validation.
* Implement application and AI observability covering logs, model usage, latency, token consumption, errors, user feedback, cost, and key business metrics.
* Collaborate with platform engineering teams on cloud deployment, CI/CD, containerisation, API management, secrets management, monitoring, production support, and operational handover.

  

**Requirements**  

* 7\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience, including experience building, deploying, and supporting enterprise or cloud\-native applications.
* Strong full\-stack engineering capability using modern frontend, backend, and API technologies such as **React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, .NET, Java**, or equivalent.
* Hands\-on experience designing and integrating **REST APIs, backend services, databases, authentication mechanisms, and enterprise application integrations**.
* Practical experience building AI\-enabled applications using **large language models, RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, agents, workflow automation, or AI orchestration frameworks**.
* Working knowledge of Azure services including **Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Azure Machine Learning, Azure App Service, Azure Container Apps, API Management, Key Vault, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics**.
* Experience applying secure software development practices including input validation, secrets management, least\-privilege access, dependency scanning, logging, error handling, and secure configuration.
* Understanding of authentication and authorisation standards including **OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, JWT, RBAC**, and enterprise identity integration using **Microsoft Entra ID**.
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD pipelines using **Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitHub Actions, ShipHATS**, or equivalent platforms.
* Familiarity with containerisation, cloud deployment patterns, environment promotion, deployment rollback, and production support practices.
* Ability to assess prototype quality and identify what needs to be rebuilt, hardened, monitored, or redesigned before production release.
* Good understanding of AI application risks including hallucination, data leakage, prompt injection, unsafe tool use, policy bypass, privacy risks, and poor explainability.
* Strong documentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions and production trade\-offs clearly.
* Comfortable working in an agile, product\-oriented environment where solutions are delivered iteratively and improved through user feedback and engineering practices.

**Nice to Haves**

* Experience building chatbots, knowledge assistants, workflow agents, document intelligence solutions, recommendation assistants, or AI\-enabled internal tools.
* Experience with AI application frameworks such as **LangChain, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI**, or equivalent orchestration tools.
* Experience with vector databases or search technologies such as **Azure AI Search, PostgreSQL with pgvector, Cosmos DB, Pinecone**, or similar platforms.
* Experience with AI evaluation, prompt testing, red teaming, safety evaluations, grounding quality checks, or responsible AI controls.
* Experience integrating with **Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Microsoft Graph, Power Platform**, or enterprise workflow systems.
* Familiarity with public sector cloud environments, government security requirements, data classification, privacy, and compliance obligations.
* Exposure to observability, SRE practices, incident response, service health dashboards, and production support models.

You will be one of the engineers on a focused AI team solving hard scientific problems in precision product development. You will own two real responsibilities from day one — not toy tasks, but actual team workflow contributions that senior engineers depend on. You will be introduced to physics\-informed AI, Bayesian methods, and product development ML systems within your first year under direct mentorship from engineers and researchers who have worked at world\-class institutions. * **Deep Learning Model Contribution:** Build and train CNN\-based models for image classification and defect detection under team’s guidance. Contribute to model evaluation cycles, configuration comparisons, and training run analysis.
